name: Swarmania
description:
Steer your swarm. Turn everything your color.

Swarmania is a fast strategy game about flowing swarms. Thousands of tiny particles follow your finger through the basin like a liquid. Surround an opponent and its particles change sides. Whoever owns the basin when time is up wins.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap or drag in the basin: your swarm flows there.
• Flow around the rocks, split your opponent, close the ring.
• Zoom into the fight with two fingers.
• A match takes only a few minutes.

25 BASINS
Small, medium and large basins, each with its own rocks and paths. Play with two, three or four swarms and pick your basin with a swipe.

FIVE LEVELS OF OPPONENTS
From Easy to Master. The computer opponents hunt, encircle and defend, and on the higher levels they do it well.

PLAY TOGETHER
Up to four play against each other online, each on their own phone. One opens a room, the others join with its number or a QR code. No account needed. If someone leaves, the computer takes over.

SIX STYLES
Neon, Retro, Comic, Microscope, Chalk and Sea Chart. Each style has its own look, its own music and its own sounds.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• Pay once. No ads, no in-app purchases.
• No account, no tracking.
• Playing alone works without an internet connection.
• In English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.

name: GlassMetric Forge
description: स्क्रीन पॅरामीटर बेंच — समकोनाच्या प्रमाणावर पिक्सेल घनता (PPI), बिंदू अंतर, पाहण्यायोग्य क्षेत्रफळ आणि प्रसरण गणना करा. सामान्य स्क्रीन तपशील, दोन डिस्प्लेची बाजू-बाजूने तुलना, प्रमाण रूपांतरण आणि स्वतःच्या डिव्हाइसचे स्थानिक सेव्ह — सर्व काही ऑफलाइन. निकाल या फोनवर जतन राहतात; अॅप बंद करून पुन्हा उघडल्यावरही डेटा कायम राहतो. डायगोनल, इंच किंवा सेंटिमीटर, सानुकूल नावांसह — एकाच ठिकाणी स्क्रीन घनता अभियांत्रिकी.

name: 2Si Games: Seekville
description:
Seekville is a hidden-object picture game for children about 3 to 10. Every picture is a busy little world full of small stories to notice: a kite carried off by the wind, a hat rolling down the street, a cat asleep on the roof.

Meet Maya, a girl in a yellow raincoat, and Finik, her little white fox cub. They turn up again and again, and your child will soon spot them in a second.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY

Books
Four picture stories: an autumn day in Little Town, a snowy winter, a summer trip down the river, and a spring mystery about a seed. Each book has 12 big pages, and every page has four games: find the characters on the cards, show who is gone, find what has changed, and answer "Who is doing what?"

Find in the Crowd
Sixteen packed scenes where almost everyone looks alike. Can you find Maya and her friends? Play calmly or against the clock.

Treasure Hunt
It is night, and things got lost. Slide the flashlight over 18 scenes and tap the things shown on the cards.

Bring It to Life
30 black-and-white engravings with animals hidden inside. Tap an animal and it gets its colors.

MADE FOR SMALL CHILDREN

- No reading needed. A narrator can read every task aloud. The voice stays off until someone turns it on with the speaker button.
- Characters and tasks change from round to round, so a page stays fresh the second and third time.
- A hint button is always there when your child gets stuck.
- Pinch to zoom in and see the smallest details.
- Stars for finished games are saved on your device.

QUIET AND SAFE

- No ads
- No in-app purchases
- No accounts and no sign-up
- No analytics and no tracking
- No links that lead out of the game
- The first pictures play offline; the rest download once and stay on your device

Seekville comes from 2Si Games, the makers of Color by Number and the @2SiPlay channel on YouTube.

Language: English.

name: 36.9 WDJE: DojoEarth Radio
description:
DojoEarth Radio 36.9 WDJE is an independent station streaming around the clock from the mountains of North Carolina.

Tap play and you're in: virtual DJs hosting real shows all day and night, from Morning Vibe to Night Drift, the Earth Report, and From the Dojo with James True.

• Listen live with one tap, including on the lock screen and in the background
• See what's playing, who's spinning it, and which show is on
• Call or text the station line, (785) 369-WDJE, with a request or a shout-out
• Open the Live Room on the web to chat, vote on songs and make requests
• Members can share a video or a photo with the station right from the app. Rhonda at the front desk gets it, and it may make it onto the air with a thank-you from the DJ.

No ads, no tracking.

name: A2 Permit Tracker
description:
A2 Tracker follows your building permits, plan reviews and inspections with the building departments and tells you when anything changes.

EVERY PERMIT IN ONE PLACE
All your jobs, every permit and sub-permit, grouped and filtered the way you work: by job, status or building department.

READ FROM THE BUILDING DEPARTMENT FOR YOU
Twice a day A2 Tracker reads each building department's public records, so status changes, plan review comments and inspection results show up without anyone checking the portal by hand.

INSPECTIONS, WITH THE ROUTE
- The week ahead: every booked inspection on its day.
- On inspection day, your stop on the inspector's route as soon as it is posted ("stop 4 of 11, 3 ahead").
- Failed inspections with the inspector's remarks, until they are booked again.
- Progress by permit: what passed, what is booked and what is still ahead.

PLAN REVIEW AT A GLANCE
Each permit in review, discipline by discipline: what is approved, what came back for corrections, and how long the rest has been with the building department.

NOTHING EXPIRES QUIETLY
Every open permit by the time it has left, with reminders at 30, 14 and 7 days.

TOLD, NOT ASKED
Push notifications and email, as you choose, plus a weekly summary of everything that moved.

YOUR WHOLE TEAM
Admins, members and viewers; people limited to the jobs they work on. Sign in with a password, a passkey or an emailed link, and Face ID to get back in.

BUILDING DEPARTMENTS
Reading today: City of Miami, Miami-Dade County (unincorporated) and City of Coral Gables, with more added as customers ask. Permits anywhere else can be tracked by hand, with their dates, inspections and reminders.

A free account tracks one permit of your own and shows a live preview of real public permits.

Permit, plan review and inspection information comes from each building department's public records; the building department's own records are the official ones. A2 Tracker is not affiliated with any building department.

name: AanitasoLuotain
description: AanitasoLuotain is a sound-level and noise-dose calculator for microphone range, time weighting, daily exposure and calibration. Plan occupational hearing checks with a reliable decibel reading.

name: ABVGDeika Buses
description:
A child waits at the bus stop holding a balloon with a number or a letter. A voice names it, and your toddler finds the bus with the same sign and taps it. The bus pulls up, the children get on, and the voice counts: one, two, three.

The game teaches Russian and Kazakh: the voice and the alphabets are in these two languages, chosen by the parent.

How it works
• Numbers 1 to 10: one bus first, then two, and so on up to ten.
• Boarding is counting: three children get on bus number 3, linking the digit to the quantity.
• Letters one at a time: each opens with a picture card and a word. Earlier letters come back for review.

For toddlers
• There is no way to lose. The wrong bus only wobbles and the voice gives a hint.
• If the child pauses, the right bus lights up and a hand points at it.
• No reading needed: the voice leads the game.

For parents
• No ads, purchases or subscriptions.
• No data collected, no internet needed.
• Settings open only with a long press, so a toddler won't get there by accident.

name: AC Help: Heating & Cooling Fix
description:
Furnace not heating? AC blowing warm air? Strange noise from the outdoor unit? AC Help walks you through it step by step, the way a seasoned HVAC tech would.

AC Help was built by Shane Fischer, an HVAC contractor with 35 years of experience, to help homeowners sort out common heating and cooling problems safely, and to know when it's time to call a pro.

START FREE
• Answer three quick questions: heating or cooling, is the thermostat lit, and what kind of system you have.
• Get free step-by-step guides for the most common problems, like an AC that won't turn on, warm air, ice on the lines, water leaks, a blank thermostat, a furnace that won't light, short cycling, odd noises and smells, and high bills.
• Browse free answers to common homeowner questions.
• Upload photos and videos for free. For noises, record a short video with sound so the noise can be heard.

WHEN YOU NEED MORE
Tap "Get my answer" and choose the help that fits:
• Get my answer: one AI answer to your question, based on your intake, photos, video and sound.
• 24-Hour Question Session: unlimited AI questions with photos and video for 24 hours.
• Live Technician: a live HVAC technician responds within 20 minutes and helps with this problem for up to 2 hours.

All paid options are one-time in-app purchases. There's no subscription and no account to create.

SAFETY FIRST
If you report a gas smell, a carbon monoxide alarm, burning smells, sparks or other electrical hazards, AC Help stops troubleshooting and tells you to get to safety and call 911 or your utility. Some repairs, like gas, refrigerant and high-voltage work, should only be done by a licensed professional, and AC Help will tell you when that's the case.

AC Help provides general troubleshooting information and doesn't replace an in-person inspection. Available in the United States.

Privacy policy: https://server-production-cc7d926c.up.railway.app/privacy
Terms of use: https://server-production-cc7d926c.up.railway.app/terms

name: Acorn Rhythm Quiz
description:
Learn rhythm and music notes by playing a fun game!

Winter is coming, but Bandi the cheeky raccoon took Tori the squirrel's acorns and hid them in the trees. Listen to the rhythm, tap the spots where you heard a sound, and press Check. Get it right and Tori gets the acorns back, while each tree shows the rhythm in real music notation.

Simple enough for children, and fun for grown-ups too.

• 10 levels across four seasons, from quarter notes to triplets, 16th rests and 32nd notes
• 4/4, 3/4, 6/8 and 9/8 time
• Notation appears as you play, so listening and reading grow together
• Beat Bandi at the end of every level to level up
• Today's rhythm: one new rhythm every day
• Helpful items: Peek, Shape, Slow and Double
• Decorate Tori's home with the acorns you collect. Tap the music box or radio and Tori dances!
• My quizzes: teachers can build their own sets of up to 10 rhythms and present them in class
• Available in 10 languages
• No ads. No account. Nothing is collected.

Spring (Levels 1–3) is free. One purchase unlocks everything else. No subscription.

Made by DrumMate, the drum learning app.

name: Adetty
description:
Build a learning habit in just a few minutes a day.

Adetty gives you three multiple-choice questions each day. Answer before time runs out, get immediate feedback, build your daily streak, and see how you compare on the weekly leaderboard.

Features:

• Three questions every day
• English and Greek content
• Quick timed challenges
• Immediate answer feedback
• Daily streak tracking
• Weekly leaderboard
• Optional notification reminders
• Free to use, with no ads or subscriptions

Designed for short, focused daily sessions, Adetty makes learning something new a simple part of your routine.

name: AFFi Support New
description:
AFFi Support by AtoZ FoneFix India is the learning and support app for mobile phone repair technicians.specially iPhone Repair at master level. Basic to Master Level.A complete iPhone Repair Solution.

ONLINE COURSES
Learn mobile and iPhone repair step by step with clear video lessons, PDFs and real repair cases from our workshop. Watch at your own pace, continue where you stopped, and save lessons for offline viewing inside the app.

REPAIR SOLUTIONS FOR EVERY MODEL
Find solutions by phone model and problem: videos, schematics, test points and step-by-step guides for common faults such as no power, no charging, no display, network and Face ID problems.

LIVE CHAT WITH EXPERTS
Stuck on a repair? Send your question with photos, videos or voice messages and get help from our experienced technicians. Support hours: 11 AM to 6 PM, Monday to Saturday (India time).
SUPPORT PLANS
Choose Chat Only, Solutions & Updates, or Chat + Solutions, for 3, 6 or 12 months.

NEWS
Stay up to date with new courses, new solutions, live classes and offers.

Whether you are starting out or already run a repair shop, AFFi Support helps you repair faster and learn more.

name: After Hours: Quiet Heist
description:
Your plan begins after closing time.

In After Hours: Quiet Heist, lead two specialists through guarded miniature locations. Your team has two action points each round. Give both to one character or split them: move, influence security, secure the loot and escape together.

SEE YOUR PLAN
Inspect the entire movement route, current sight lines and the guards' next intentions. Turn preview uses the same rules as execution. Dangerous intermediate cells count too – a safe destination alone is not enough.

TWO ROLES, ONE HEIST
Combine both characters' abilities with eight distinct tools. Each mission offers suitable loadouts. Choose your approach, manage charges and time each effect.

24 CURATED MISSIONS
Explore a museum and gallery, a luxury hotel, a guarded archive and an auction house leading to the final heist. Each theme contains six missions. The first two missions stay free. One full-game purchase unlocks missions 3–24, with no further purchases for this campaign.

PLAY AT YOUR PACE
Normal mode lets you undo a complete turn, including after an alarm. Local Challenge mode uses the same visible rules, without undo and with separate best results. Save your heist and continue later.

REPLAY YOUR ACTUAL PLAN
Watch completed heists again and export a short movie from your actual gameplay. Sharing happens only when you choose it through the system share sheet.

The campaign and unlocked content work offline. No game account, ads or subscription. Menus, missions and help are available in English and German. Music, effects and haptics have separate controls. Restore Purchases is available in the offer and settings; restoring after reinstalling may require a connection to Apple.

name: Afterlit – Party Games
description:
Afterlit is the party and group game that sets your friend group's night on fire. One phone is all you need: add the players, pick a category and let the spotlight choose who's up.

12 CATEGORIES, EACH ITS OWN GAME
• Warm-up: break the ice and get everyone talking.
• Court: the spotlight picks a defendant and the table votes: guilty or not guilty?
• Flirt: texts, first dates and exes hit the table.
• Football and Movies & TV: properly hard quizzes with a leaderboard at the end.
• Showdown: two teams go head to head.
• Sleepover: everyone who says "Me too!" gets caught.
• Family: play within the family, all together or two families head to head. Fun for all ages.
• 18+ After Midnight section: Duo, Confessions, Midnight and Red Line. Adults only.

TENSION THAT BUILDS LEVEL BY LEVEL
Every category has 3 levels. The higher you go, the more personal the questions and the heavier the penalties.

YOUR RULES
Pick your penalty unit: sips, push-ups, penalty cards, songs or your own. Works just as well without drinks.

PLAY OFFLINE
Afterlit works completely offline. Cards you've already seen go to the back, so every night brings fresh ones.

AFTERLIT+
Warm-up is free. Afterlit+ unlocks every category and every level with no ads. Free players can watch one ad a day to unlock 10 cards from any category.

Afterlit+ is a weekly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://dogukanipekk.github.io/legal/afterlit/privacy.html

name: Agile Music
description:
Agile Music is a music app for songs from Agile Developer’s own studio. Every song comes with synced lyrics, beautiful artwork and a player that feels like brand-new software.

LISTEN
• Big player with colours from the cover, a moving backdrop and a waveform to scrub
• Music keeps playing with the screen off or while you use another app
• Controls on the lock screen, in the notification and with headphone or Bluetooth buttons
• Gapless transitions, loudness levelling, sleep timer, shuffle and repeat
• Reorder the queue, “Play next” and a radio of matching songs at the end

SYNCED LYRICS
• Highlighted line by line and word by word
• Tap a line to jump right there
• Switchable translation

HOOKS
• The best moments of every song as a feed: swipe, listen, decide
• Like, Not for me, play the full song or add it to a playlist

FOR YOU
• Recommendations that learn from your listening – even without an account; your profile stays on your device
• “More like this”, a home screen for the time of day, categories by mood, occasion and tempo
• Search that understands what you mean: “calm song to wake up to” or a line from the lyrics

LIBRARY AND OFFLINE
• Liked songs, your own playlists, history
• Download songs and listen without a connection, with storage overview
• Share playlists by link and edit them together

EVERYWHERE
• “Now playing” widget for your home screen
• Links to songs, albums and playlists open right in the app, even with a timestamp
• With an account, continue on your next device where you left off
• A notification when a new song is released – only if you turn it on

PRIVACY
• Listening works without an account
• No ads, no third-party trackers
• Playback statistics are anonymous only

The catalogue is growing: new songs arrive straight from the studio. The voice in the first song “Premier Matin” is synthetic.

name: AI Coloring Book: Page Maker
description:
Turn any idea into a printable coloring page in seconds.

Type what you want to color, or pick a theme, and AI Coloring Book draws clean black-and-white line art that is ready to print. A unicorn in a flower garden, a pirate ship, a mandala, a farm full of animals: if you can describe it, you can color it.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick a detail level, from big simple shapes to intricate patterns
- Choose one of 16 themes or write your own idea
- Create 1 to 4 pages at a time
- Print, share as a PDF, or collect pages into your own coloring books

MADE FOR PRINTING
- Pure black lines on white paper, no grey shading
- One page per sheet in the PDF
- Save favorites and build books you can print again any time

FAIR AND SIMPLE
- Your first 5 pages are free
- Need more? Get a page pack: each coloring page uses one page
- No ads, no subscription, and pages never expire

SAFE BY DESIGN
- Every idea passes a content filter, and the image model has its own safety checker
- No account, no sign-up, no tracking

Perfect for rainy afternoons, classrooms, birthday parties, quiet time and anyone who loves to color.

name: AI Keyboard - Smart Replies
description:
AI Keyboard reads the conversation and writes the reply for you, in your own voice. It works inside the apps you already use: WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, Messages, Mail and any other app with a keyboard.

WHAT IT DOES

• Reply: tap once and get three replies to the chat on screen, each with a different intent: a yes, a no, a question.
• Tell it: say what you mean in your own words, like "tell him not today, let's go Friday", and it writes the message.
• Check: see how your draft will land before you send it, with calmer or clearer versions.
• Fix Grammar: correct spelling and grammar without changing what you meant.
• Tone: rewrite as friendly, professional, short, formal and more.
• Translate: answer in any language, in a casual and a polite version.
• Scam Check: find out whether a suspicious message is safe, and what to do.
• Speak: say it instead of typing it.

ARABIC THE WAY PEOPLE WRITE IT

Gulf, Egyptian, Levantine, Sudanese, Maghrebi or Arabizi. AI Keyboard answers in the dialect of the chat, with an Arabic key layout built in.

SOUNDS LIKE YOU

It learns how you text from your own messages: length, punctuation, emoji and the words you use.

FOR BUSINESS CHATS

Add your prices and policies and set a goal such as "close the sale". Replies to customers stay within your limits.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL

AI Keyboard only suggests text. It types the suggestion you pick, and you press send. Conversations are used to produce the answer and are not stored.

PHONE AND LAPTOP

One subscription covers your iPhone and one laptop. Connect the Mac app with a 6-letter code from your phone.

SUBSCRIPTION

AI features require AI Keyboard Pro, which starts with a 3-day free trial.
• Monthly: $9.99 per month
• Yearly: $99.99 per year
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at the end of the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Privacy policy: https://smarttextkey.com/privacy
Terms of use: https://smarttextkey.com/terms

name: AI Literacy for Teens: Cogwick
description:
Cogwick is an AI literacy course for ages 13 to 18. Instead of reading about artificial intelligence, you build small pieces of it on your phone and then answer questions about your own build.

EIGHT STATIONS, EIGHT HANDS-ON LABS
1. Is it AI? Write keyword rules for a spam filter and see where rules fail.
2. How machines see. Paint a picture as numbers and slide an edge filter over it.
3. Learning from examples. Add labelled dots and watch a nearest-neighbour model draw its regions.
4. Neurons and nets. Set weights, then let the nudge rule teach a neuron.
5. Maps, search and deciding. Draw walls and watch breadth-first search find the shortest path.
6. Language models in plain words. Count which word follows which, and change the temperature.
7. When AI goes wrong. See how skewed data hurts one group, then fix it with more data.
8. Using AI safely and fairly. Move a decision threshold and compare mistakes for two groups; privacy, deepfakes and honest use.

HOW IT WORKS
Short cards of two or three sentences, one lab per unit, a quick question while you learn, an optional 8-question check and an 8-question bonus round. Missed questions come back once, gently. There are 128 questions with worked solutions, and every lab ends with a question computed from what you built.

BUILT ON TRUSTED FRAMEWORKS
Aligned to the AI4K12 five big ideas (perception, representation and reasoning, learning, natural interaction, societal impact) and CSTA AI topics. Each unit lists its sources, including university AI courses and research papers. Numbers in questions are checked by independent code. Cogwick is not reviewed by an outside expert, and it says so.

MADE FOR TEENS
No account, no sign-up, works offline. Text size from 85% to 200%. If you say you are under 18, only non-personalised ads are shown. Not directed to children under 13.

FREE WITH OPTIONAL AD-FREE
All lessons and labs are free. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never inside a lab or a question. Watch an optional video for a credit that opens a bonus round, or subscribe to Ad-Free Monthly: $3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial; it only removes ads. Cancel anytime in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Content as of 2026-11-17. Facts about current AI products and laws change, so the app marks its date and is refreshed regularly.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are linked in the app.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-cogwick.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-cogwick.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-cogwick.html

name: AI Operator: Human + AI
description:
AI Operator is the companion app for The ADOPT Method™ AI Accelerator. Everything from your program on app.aioperator.com, on your phone:

• Watch every session recording, with chapters, subtitles and the written summary.
• Take the Knowledge Checks and see your score.
• Join the next live session in one tap, and answer its live polls and quizzes from your phone.
• Read and post in your cohort's forum, and message the AI Operator team.
• Keep your daily AI habit and follow your progress to the certificate.
• Program leads see their people's progress, ratings and answers on the Dashboard.

Sign in with the work email your invitation was sent to. AI Operator is for members of an AI Operator program.

name: AirVeyra
description:
See what each product really earns.

AirVeyra helps independent sellers, makers and small brands connect pricing decisions to actual sales and inventory held at cost.

PRICE WITH PURPOSE

Enter product costs, packaging, merchant shipping and channel fees. Find your break-even price, the price that meets your target contribution margin, and how far you can discount while keeping that target. Save and compare up to three pricing snapshots for each product.

SEE WHAT EACH SALE CONTRIBUTES

Record orders, discounts, fees and selling costs. Confirm an order to update stock and preserve the original product cost. For comparable single-unit orders, see how the recorded price and costs changed the result from your plan. Record refunds and sellable returns against the original order.

UNDERSTAND THE STOCK YOU HOLD

See stock quantities, inventory value at cost and where that value is concentrated. Review recent sales, low stock and movement history. Current inventory uses a moving weighted average cost, while each confirmed sale retains its original cost.

KEEP YOUR RECORDS HANDY

Work without an account. Export product, inventory and order records as CSV, or create a complete backup that includes optional product photos.

Operating contribution excludes unrecorded expenses such as labor, rent and taxes. Fee rates are entered by you. Inventory is valued at cost.

name: Al Hayat Self Services
description:
Al Hayat Self Services – Employee Attendance Management

Al Hayat Self Services is an internal employee application for Al Hayat ICE, designed to make attendance tracking simple, accessible, and organized.

Employees can use the app to monitor their attendance and check their check-in and check-out records in one convenient place.

Key Features:

Employee check-in and check-out tracking
View attendance history
View daily attendance records
Check-in and check-out times
Easy access to personal attendance information
Simple and convenient employee experience
Secure access for Al Hayat ICE employees

Al Hayat Self Services helps employees stay informed about their attendance records while providing a convenient way to access their work attendance information.

name: Alarmika: Loud Alarm Clock
description:
Snoozing through every alarm? Alarmika is a loud alarm clock you can only turn off by getting up. When it rings, you complete a wake-up mission, so by the time it's quiet, you're awake.

WAKE-UP MISSIONS
• Push-ups, squats, jumping jacks, plank or dance, counted by your camera. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
• Object hunt: take a photo of your bathroom sink, your shoes, a plant or the sky.
• Math and memory puzzles that switch your brain on.
• Shake your phone or walk a few steps.
• Surprise: a random mission from the ones you choose.
• Put several missions in one alarm, and try any of them first in practice mode.

AN ALARM THAT DOESN'T LET YOU SLEEP IN
• Rings through silent mode and Focus, right on your lock screen.
• Stopping it from the lock screen isn't enough: backup alarms ring every 5 minutes, for up to 30 minutes, until you do your mission.
• Wake-up check: about 10 minutes after your mission, one more ring makes sure you didn't go back to bed.
• Reps counted aloud, with a separate volume for missions.

BUILD THE MORNING HABIT
• Streaks, achievements and your wake-up times over the last 30 days.
• A morning screen with your next alarm and a quote to start the day.
• Your sleep from Apple Health next to your wake-ups. Alarmika only reads it, and it stays on your iPhone.
• Bedtime reminder based on your sleep goal, and an evening nudge when tomorrow has no alarm.

ALARMIKA PRO
All alarms and missions need Alarmika Pro: a weekly plan, or a yearly plan that starts with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://alarmika.dimas-software.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://alarmika.dimas-software.com/privacy

name: Alerte - Outage Map
description:
Is the power out in your area right now? Is the water weak, or is it just your building? Alerte answers in seconds.

Alerte is a live map of public service problems built by the people who live there. When someone reports an outage, everyone nearby can see it, confirm it, and know when it is fixed.

LIVE OUTAGE MAP
• Electricity: full outages and power fluctuations
• Water: no water or weak pressure
• Internet and mobile network outages
• Sewage problems
• Traffic accidents and road problems
Reports expire automatically unless people confirm the problem is still there, so the map stays accurate.

REPORT IN ONE TAP
Choose the problem and send. Your report is tied to where you are, which keeps the map honest and prevents false alarms.

ALERTS THAT COME TO YOU
• Get a notification when a new outage is reported near your home.
• Two hours after you report, Alerte asks whether the problem is still there. Answer "Yes" or "No" right from the notification.

RATE YOUR AREA
Rate public services in your area, from electricity and water stability to hospitals, public transport, roads and traffic signals, and see how your area scores.

EMERGENCY NUMBERS
Quick access to emergency numbers for your country.

ARABIC AND ENGLISH
The whole app, including notifications, works in Arabic and English.

FREE AND ALERTE PRO
Free: report, see reports and rate services around your home (2.5 km).
Alerte Pro: report wherever you are, follow outages anywhere on the map, rate the area you are in, and see the ratings of any area.
Alerte Pro is available as a monthly auto-renewable subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

name: Alesta Jump
description:
Ulfer is a mountain courier trying to relight old lanterns scattered across the sky. He jumps by himself every time he lands. You steer him left and right, by tilting the phone or by touching the screen.

CLIMB THROUGH FOUR SKIES
The Windmills, Cloud Harbor, Storm Line and the Northern Lights, all in a single climb. Each region has its own sky, wind, platforms and music.

ROPES SNAP, YOU RISE
Rope scaffolds bounce you on the first landing. Then the ropes snap and they float upward. Land on them again and they carry you to a side path you could not reach otherwise.

FREEZE WHAT FALLS
Pieces fall from above, with a red warning first. Tap one to throw ice and freeze it in place. Never land on a frozen piece; hit it from below and it breaks.

READ THE WIND
Ulfer's scarf, the streaks in the air and the drifting clouds show which way the wind pushes. Your steering always wins.

LIGHT THE LANTERN
Land on the mark in the middle of three platforms in a row to fill your lantern. Then tap the wing in the air: your cape opens and slows your fall.

DAILY CLIMB
The same route for everyone, every day.

WARDROBE
Collect lantern shards on the side paths and unlock scarves, capes and lanterns. Looks only, no advantage.

No walls: leave the screen on one side and you come back on the other. Plays offline.

The game is free and shows ads between runs. A one-time purchase removes them. Watching an ad to continue or to double your shards is always optional.

name: Alpi's Feeding Time
description:
Alpi's Feeding Time is a simple feeding game for young children.

Pick a place on the world map: the farm, the forest, Africa, Asia, Australia, the polar regions, the ocean or the sky. Each animal is hungry and has three foods on its tray. Drag a food to the animal's mouth. The right food makes it happy, and the wrong one gets a funny reaction.

Each animal needs three correct foods before the next one arrives. Collect hearts as you feed them all.

The game is available in Turkish and English.

name: Alpi's Fish Catch
description:
Alpi's Fish Catch is a simple fishing game for young children.

Choose a continent on the map, read a short note about its waters and the creatures that live there, and start fishing. Tap the water to cast your line and catch as many fish as you can before the time runs out.

Seven continents, each with its own levels.
Earn stars and paw coins in each level.
Spend paw coins in the shop on new fishing rods. Paw coins are earned by playing.

The game is available in Turkish and English.

name: Alpi's Learning Fun
description:
Alpi's Learning Fun brings together three activities for young children.

Coloring
Pick a theme such as the farm, the forest or the ocean, choose a drawing and color it in with a palette of 12 colors.

Letters
See each letter in upper and lower case with an animal picture and its name, then play by dragging the letters into their places.

Numbers
Learn the numbers and their names, then count the hearts on the screen and tap the right number.

You can earn stars as you play. The game is available in Turkish and English.

name: Alpi's Memory Match
description:
Alpi's Memory Match is a gentle animal game for young children, with two games to play.

Memory Cards
Look at the cards while they are face up and remember where each animal is. When they turn over, tap the cards to find the pairs. Each card shows the animal's name.

Find the Shadow
Drag each animal onto its matching black silhouette.

Choose a continent on the world map and play through its levels. Each game has its own map, and you can earn up to three stars in every level.

The game is available in Turkish and English.

name: Alpi's Music Band
description:
Alpi's Music Band is a free-play music game for young children.

Choose an instrument from the stage: piano, xylophone, drums, guitar, violin, flute or trumpet. Each one has its own screen with big, colorful parts to tap or strum. The guitar has chord buttons, and the piano and xylophone have a record button.

Animals
Pick a place such as the farm, the forest, Africa or the ocean, then tap the animals to see their names.

There are no scores or levels, so children can play at their own pace.

The game is available in Turkish and English.

name: AMA HR
description:
AMA HR is the employee app of the AMA HR human-resources platform. Sign in with the account your company created for you and reach everything about your work from your phone.

• Attendance: clock in and out from your phone within the area your company sets, with a face check done on the phone itself — the image never leaves it.
• Requests: file leave, permission, salary-advance and other requests and follow their approval step by step.
• Approvals: managers approve, reject or delegate their team's requests from anywhere.
• Pay: view and download your payslips as PDF.
• Leave: your balances, your leave plan and upcoming public holidays.
• Circulars, mail and notifications: never miss a circular or an answer to a request.
• My profile: your details, documents and employment history.
• Security: unlock with fingerprint or Face ID, and two-step verification.

Note: the app requires an account from a company subscribed to AMA HR; accounts cannot be created inside the app.

name: Amorito
seller_name: Shanghai Zhiyou Changlian Technology Co., Ltd
description:
Chat with AI characters and shape stories through your choices. Explore different personalities, start a conversation, or step into a story and decide what happens next.

Create your own character by choosing a name, personality, and speaking style.

Optional in-app purchases include gem packs and Amorito Pass, a monthly auto-renewing subscription.Chat with AI characters and shape stories through your choices. Explore different personalities and create your own character by choosing a name personality and speaking style. Optional in-app purchases include gem packs and Amorito Pass a monthly auto-renewing subscription.

name: Analyza: архив анализов
description:
Соберите бланки из разных лабораторий в одном месте. Перед приёмом откройте Analyza, найдите нужный анализ и покажите оригинал врачу.

Добавьте PDF, фотографию или скан. Укажите дату сдачи и лабораторию. Текст можно распознать прямо на телефоне, сверить строки с бланком и сохранить. Также доступен ручной ввод.

Чтобы увидеть историю, выберите показатель и единицу измерения. Приложение покажет сохранённые значения по датам. Любая запись ведёт к исходному бланку.

Архив бесплатный и работает без регистрации. Оригиналы хранятся на устройстве. Поделиться отдельным файлом можно через системное меню телефона.

name: Andre: Dimension Shift
description:
Andre had one promise left to keep. Then the night broke.

Andre: Dimension Shift opens on a quiet street at night: Andre, Maxine, a ten-year promise, and a single shot that changes everything. What follows is a chase across fire escapes, rooftops and canal bridges, and a fall into a world that is no longer quite real. The city is redrawn in paper and black ink, and something is crawling out of the asphalt.

- A cinematic noir opening. Rain-slick streets, amber lamps and a story told in full voice.
- A chase you play. Climb, vault and run after the hooded kid through a hand-built city block.
- An ink world that fights back. Ink creatures that spit, shield and swarm. Learn to block, parry and counter. Shove, push and solve your way through a broken laundromat, a collapsed stairwell and an open square.
- Made for touch and gamepad. Built for iPhone, with full controller support and haptics.

Chapter 1, "The Block", is free: the full real-world prologue and the paper island. More chapters are coming.

No ads. Plays fully offline.

name: AnimalBook Business
description:
AnimalBook Business is the panel for businesses and organisations that work with animals: vets, groomers, hotels, pet sitters, trainers, behaviourists, pet shops, shelters and foundations.

CALENDAR AND BOOKINGS
Visits, bookings and requests from AnimalBook customers in one calendar. Accept, move or cancel with one tap. Team schedule, breaks, days off and holidays.

SHOP
Products with variants and stock, orders from acceptance to shipping, parcel lockers, returns and complaints, discount codes. Cash on delivery, bank transfer or online payment through Stripe.

CARE, GROOMING AND HOTELS
A price list, instant or on-request bookings, stay cards and pet documents, and photo updates for owners during a stay.

PATIENT RECORDS
Patient cards with visit history and medical entries, finding a pet by its AnimalID, client cards with team notes.

CHAT AND VIDEO CONSULTATIONS
Conversations with clients, visit reminders and video consultations right in the app.

INVOICES AND REPORTS
VAT invoices as PDF, payments and payouts, booking and sales reports with export to Excel.

REVIEWS
Client reviews after visits and purchases, and your replies — the rating shows on your profile.

SHELTERS AND FOUNDATIONS
Adoption listings and applications, fundraisers, needs and volunteering.

NOTIFICATIONS
New orders, bookings and messages straight to your phone.

16 LANGUAGES
The whole panel in Polish, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Ukrainian, Czech, Slovak, Lithuanian, Romanian, Hungarian, Swedish and Greek.

Your profile appears in the AnimalBook app, where pet owners look for services and products nearby. Setting up a business account takes a few minutes.

name: Antique ID & Value Scanner
description:
Point your camera at an antique or vintage piece and find out what it is, about when it was made, whether it looks original or a later copy, and what pieces like it sell for right now. Furniture, pottery, glass, silver, toys, tools, jewelry, signs and more. No ads, no account, and no free trial that turns into a charge.

WHAT IT IS, AND WHEN
Take a photo or two, including any mark on the bottom. The app names the piece, the likely maker and the era, explains why, and lists what else it could be. When it cannot tell, it says so plainly instead of guessing.

ORIGINAL OR LATER COPY
Many popular antiques have been reproduced for decades. The app points out signs of a copy and gives you one simple check to do with your own eyes, like how sharp the casting is or how a mark is applied.

WHAT IT SELLS FOR
See auctions on eBay for that kind of piece that have real bids and end soon, so you know what buyers are actually paying, plus current asking prices for originals and for copies kept apart. Open the listings behind every number.

ASK ABOUT ANY PIECE, OUT LOUD
Hold up a piece and ask: how do I clean it, what does this mark mean, where should I sell it. The answer looks at your photos and the prices and is read back to you.

FOR HUNTERS AND SELLERS
A hunting list with deal alerts when something lists at or under your price, a ready-to-paste eBay listing for anything you sell, your collection with values, an inventory PDF with photos, and spreadsheet export. Everything stays on your phone, with backup and restore.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 5 scans, unlimited typed lookups and prices, 3 spoken questions, your collection and exports.
Pro: up to 500 scans a month, ask about any piece out loud or typed, and deal alerts. Monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime price. Subscriptions renew until you cancel in Settings.

Privacy: https://plainworkgroups.duckdns.org/privacy/antique

name: AÖF Hazırlık: Çıkmış Sorular
description:
AÖF Hazırlık: Çıkmış Sorular, Açıköğretim Fakültesi öğrencilerinin Güz, Bahar ve Yaz Okulu sınavlarına tek bir yerden hazırlanmasını sağlayan kapsamlı bir soru bankası ve deneme sınavı uygulamasıdır. Son 10 yılın çıkmış sorularını çözerek sınav pratiği kazanın ve başarı notunuzu yükseltin.

26 AÖF Bölümü ve Güncel Müfredat Dersleri:
• İşletme, İktisat, Kamu Yönetimi, Maliye, Uluslararası İlişkiler, Sosyoloji, Tarih, Türk Dili ve Edebiyatı, Felsefe, Sağlık Yönetimi ve Yönetim Bilişim Sistemleri lisans bölümleri.
• Adalet, İlahiyat, Çocuk Gelişimi, Bilgisayar Programcılığı, Web Tasarımı ve Kodlama, Tıbbi Dokümantasyon ve Sekreterlik, İş Sağlığı ve Güvenliği (İSG), Muhasebe ve Vergi, Dış Ticaret, Lojistik, Bankacılık ve Sigortacılık, Emlak Yönetimi ve Halkla İlişkiler önlisans bölümleri.
• Güz ve Bahar yarıyıllarına göre ayrılmış ders kartları ile sadece kendi dönem derslerinize odaklanın.

2016–2026 Son 10 Yıl Çıkmış Sorular Arşivi:
• Her ders için 2016–2017 akademik yılından 2025–2026 akademik yılına kadar son 10 yılın Vize (%30 etkili), Final (%70 etkili) ve Yaz Okulu (%100 etkili) sınavlarına erişin.
• Son 10 Yıl Başarı Grafiği üzerinde yıllara göre Vize ve Final puan dağılımınızı tek bakışta takip edin.

Gerçek Süreli Deneme Sınavı ve Anında Çözümlü Çalışma Modu:
• Süreli Deneme Sınavı (30 Dakika): Resmi AÖF sınav formatına uygun olarak 20 soruluk ve 30 dakikalık geri sayım sayacıyla gerçek sınav provası yapın.
• Süresiz Çalışma Modu (Anında Çözüm): Süre sınırı olmadan soruları çözün; şıkkı işaretlediğiniz anda doğru cevabı ve detaylı ünite çözüm açıklamasını görerek konuyu öğrenin.
• Zorlandığınız veya tekrar bakmak istediğiniz soruları tek dokunuşla Hata Defteri ve Kaydedilen Sorular listesine ekleyin.

Gerçek AÖF Net Hesabı, Sınav Sonuç Karnesi ve Not Simülatörü:
• Sınav sonunda 4 yanlışın 1 doğruyu götürdüğü resmi AÖF kuralına göre doğru, yanlış, boş, net, 100 üzerinden puan ve harf notu (AA–FF) karnenizi anında görüntüleyin.
• Dönem Sonu Not Simülatörü ile Vize (%30) ve Final (%70) puanlarınızı kaydırıcılarla değiştirerek hangi harf notuyla doğrudan veya koşullu geçeceğinizi hesaplayın.
• 1000 üzerinden AÖF Hazırlık Puanınızı, soru başına ortalama çözüm sürenizi ve ders bazlı tamamlanma oranlarınızı analiz ekranından takip edin.

name: AoMau Cybersecurity
description:
Prepare for the CompTIA Security+ SY0-801 exam, ten questions at a time.

AoMau Cybersecurity is a study app for the new Security+ exam (SY0-801). Every question is written from scratch against the official SY0-801 exam objectives, and every answer comes with a short key point and a full explanation. Open it on the train or during a break, clear today's ten questions, and build up all five domains.


■ 730 original questions across all five domains

The question bank follows the five domains and the objectives of the SY0-801 exam: General Security Concepts; Threats, Vulnerabilities, and Attacks; Security Architecture; Security Operations; and Security Program Management and Oversight.

• Multiple-choice questions written in the style of the exam ("Which of the following BEST…")
• Scenario questions for the objectives that ask you to apply what you know
• Two-part explanations: a one- or two-line key point to remember, then why the correct answer is right and where each wrong option goes wrong
• Each explanation lists the exam objective it is based on (for example, Objective 3.2)
• "New in V8" marks questions on topics added since the previous exam (SY0-701), and you can filter to practice just those


■ Performance-based practice

Practice the hands-on style of question: put steps in order, match items, or complete a table. Each cell is scored separately, so you see exactly what you got right.


■ Practice exams: 90 questions in 90 minutes

• Practice Exams 1 to 3: exam-only questions that never appear in the question bank, split across the domains by the official weights
• A random exam drawn fresh from the bank, and a mini exam for each domain
• A pace guide shows which question you should be on by now
• See your score by domain, and pause and resume at any time

The real exam is scored on a scale of 100 to 900 with a passing score of 750. CompTIA does not publish how that maps to a percentage, so the app uses 75% correct only as a rough target.


■ Today's Pick

Open the app and Today's Pick is ready: ten questions from the domain where your mastery is lowest. Your study streak helps you keep going.


■ Ask AI about any question

From an explanation or a results screen, "Ask AI" builds a prompt with the question, the options, your answer, and the correct answer. Send it to the AI app you already use, or copy and paste it. The app itself never contacts an AI service.


■ Target your weak spots

Flag questions as "No Idea" or "Not Sure" and filter by flag to review them. Terms from the questions you answer collect in My Flashcards, where you can write your own memory hooks.


■ Pricing

The first 10 questions in each domain, 3 performance-based questions, and a 15-question trial exam are free.

• Full Access (one-time purchase)
Unlocks every question, all practice exams, and every flashcard. No subscription. See "In-App Purchases" on this page for the price.


■ Pick up where you left off on iPhone and iPad

Your study history, flags, and notes sync through your own iCloud account, so you can study on your iPhone on the go and on your iPad at home (when signed in with the same Apple Account). Your data is never sent to the developer. No sign-up, no login, and every feature works offline.


■ Your colors, and Dark Mode

Choose from six color themes. Dark Mode is supported.


AoMau Cybersecurity is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by CompTIA. CompTIA and Security+ are trademarks of CompTIA, Inc.
All questions and explanations are original and are not actual exam questions. Using the app does not guarantee that you will pass the exam.

name: Apexa Inspect
description:
ApeXa Inspect is the phone app of the ApeXa management system (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001). People who work on site use it to carry out the checks assigned to them and to record what they see, on the spot.

What you can do:
• See the checks assigned to you and their due dates
• Answer each line of the checklist, add notes and photos
• Record a safety observation in a minute
• Work without internet: everything is kept on the phone and sent when the connection returns
• See the state of every record: kept on the phone, being sent, sent
• Unlock the app with Face ID or your fingerprint
• Use it in Azerbaijani, English or Russian

Who it is for: employees of companies that use ApeXa. Your account is created by your company's administrator. If your company does not use ApeXa yet, request a free demo at apexa.az.

name: AppGranted
description:
AppGranted helps you lend your own iPhone with clearer boundaries. Choose apps to protect or apps to allow, save a setup, and start a lending session. Parent controls use your separate AppGranted passcode or enrolled Face ID.

WISH PASS
A child can request one protected app or 15 more minutes. Each approval requires a parent. App passes are limited to one app, expire within 15 minutes or when the session ends, and leave other restrictions in place. Add individual apps to Wish Restricted to exclude them from app wishes.

PLAY SPACE
Keep simple play and tasks together with five offline games, local task checklists, and parent-selected website tiles.

YOUR PHONE, YOUR SETTINGS
Save named setups and use lending timers, daily or weekly app allowances, learning goals, quiet times, website rules, and private Screen Time reports. Optional reminders, widgets, Live Activities, Siri, Control Center, and a paired Apple Watch companion help you access supported controls.

PRIVACY
AppGranted has no developer account, advertising, analytics SDK, or developer server. Parent credentials stay in the private device Keychain. Approved websites connect to their own servers and follow their own privacy policies.

PLEASE NOTE
AppGranted manages the parent’s own iPhone. It does not remotely supervise a separate child device. Apple determines which apps can be selected and shielded; individual Screen Time permission can be revoked and background enforcement may be delayed. Usage allowances count all use of selected apps on this phone, including the parent’s use.

Volume Limit setup provides directions to Apple’s native Settings; AppGranted cannot set or verify a system volume ceiling. It cannot freeze Home Screen icons, disable every camera or flashlight path, or make Photos read-only.

Requires iOS 17 or later. Direct shield-to-parent-app handoff requires iOS 26.5 or later; website tiles require iOS 18.4 or later; Control Center controls require iOS 18 or later.

name: Aprex Enterprise
description:
Aprex Enterprise gir bedrifter ett arbeidsområde for AI-boter og samarbeid. Start en samtale, gi boten en oppgave, og følg med på svar og godkjenninger fra mobilen.

Bruk egne private boter og samtaler. Del arbeidsflyter med kolleger i teamrom, og følg opp oppgaver underveis.

Appen er for bedrifter som bruker Aprex Enterprise. Logg inn med kontoen bedriften har gitt deg tilgang til.

name: ARC-Hive
description:
ARC-Hive is where instructors teach and students learn, in one simple app.

Every instructor has a Hive: a home for their courses, their students and their team. Join a Hive, ask to enrol in a course, and start learning as soon as your instructor approves.

FOR STUDENTS
• Find instructors and their Hives in Explore
• Try a course's trial lesson before you ask to enrol
• Watch video lessons made for a phone screen
• Open course materials: PDF, Word and PowerPoint files
• Take quizzes and see your score right away
• Pick up where you left off: progress is saved for every lesson
• Get a notification when your request is answered

FOR INSTRUCTORS
• Apply from your profile and get your own Hive
• Build courses with video lessons, materials and quizzes
• Review enrolment requests and decide who gets access
• See each student's progress and quiz results
• Invite a team to help you run your Hive

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads and no advertising trackers
• Lessons open only for students their instructor approved
• Delete your account at any time from your profile

Questions? Write to support@arc-hive.cloud

name: ArcHive — личный архив
description:
ArcHive собирает заметки, документы и фотографии в личном архиве. На iPhone быстро сохраните файл или мысль во «Входящие». На iPad откройте список и страницу рядом, чтобы видеть контекст.

• Добавляйте документы, фото и видео из системных «Файлов» и «Фото».
• Находите страницы по названиям и тексту, открывайте PDF и другие вложения в системном просмотрщике.
• Сохраняйте заметки и вложения даже без подключения. Очередь отправится, когда вы снова откроете приложение с интернетом.
• Читайте ранее открытые страницы и скачанные вложения без сети.

Для входа нужен аккаунт ArcHive.

name: Arilus
description:
Bei mehreren Kunden wird deine Aufgabenliste schnell lang, und du startest mit einem schlechten Gefühl in den Tag. Arilus zeigt dir nur die eine Aufgabe, die jetzt dran ist, und später, was du schon geschafft hast.

Wenn du keine Lust auf eine große To-do-App hast, von der du das meiste nie brauchst, passt Arilus zu dir.

Was oben steht, ist dran Die oberste Aufgabe in deinem obersten Projekt steht allein auf der Fokus-Seite, und als Widget siehst du sie auch auf dem Sperrbildschirm. Ein Projekt ist zum Beispiel ein Kunde oder ein Auftrag. Willst du etwas vorziehen, schiebst du es in der Liste nach oben, dann ist es sofort im Fokus.

Abhaken, dann kommt die nächste Bist du fertig, tippst du auf den Kreis, und danach steht die nächste Aufgabe da. Hast du zu früh getippt, holst du die Aufgabe mit einem zweiten Tipp in den nächsten drei Sekunden zurück. Später blendest du Erledigtes unter der Liste ein und holst es mit einem Tipp auf den Kreis zurück. Ist ein Projekt fertig, erledigst du es, dann verschwindet es aus deiner Projektliste und bleibt bei deinen Erfolgen.

Am Ende siehst du, was du geschafft hast Bei den Erfolgen findest du alles, was du erledigt hast, nach Projekten geordnet und mit der Zeit für jede Aufgabe und jedes Projekt. Die Zeit misst der Timer, sobald du auf der Fokus-Seite auf Play tippst. Läuft er, siehst du ihn als Live-Aktivität auch auf dem Sperrbildschirm.

Mit KI anlegen, wenn du möchtest Tippst du beim Anlegen auf „Erklär dein Projekt“, schreibst oder erzählst du in deinen Worten, was zu tun ist, und die KI schlägt dir daraus die Aufgaben vor. Für die KI brauchst du einen eigenen Schlüssel und Guthaben bei OpenRouter, OpenAI oder Claude. Ein ChatGPT- oder Claude-Abo reicht dafür nicht. Der Anbieter rechnet meist ein paar Cent pro Projekt ab.

Deine Daten Alles, was du anlegst, speichert Arilus nur auf deinem iPhone, und du brauchst dafür kein Konto. Bei einem neuen iPhone kommen deine Projekte und Aufgaben mit der normalen iPhone-Sicherung mit. Nutzt du die KI, gehen dein Text und der Projektname erst nach deiner Zustimmung an den Anbieter, den du gewählt hast.

Was kostet Arilus? Mit einem Abo legst du neue Projekte und Aufgaben an, so viele du willst. In Deutschland kostet das Monatsabo 4,99 € im Monat und das Jahresabo 49,99 € im Jahr. Du bezahlst über dein Apple-Konto.

Beim Monats- und beim Jahresabo sind die ersten 3 Tage ein kostenloser Test, einmal je Apple-Konto. Du startest ihn in Arilus, sobald du dein erstes Projekt anlegen willst. Nach den 3 Tagen beginnt das Abo, das du gewählt hast, von selbst zum vollen Preis, außer du kündigst spätestens 24 Stunden vor Ende des Tests.

Danach verlängert sich das Monatsabo jeden Monat und das Jahresabo jedes Jahr, außer du kündigst spätestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf. Kündigen kannst du jederzeit in Arilus unter Mehr › Einstellungen › Abo oder in den Einstellungen deines iPhones unter deinem Namen › Abonnements.

Endet dein Test oder später dein Abo, bleibt alles da, und du kannst weiter abhaken, ordnen und Zeit messen.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://arilus.app/nutzungsbedingungen/ Datenschutz: https://arilus.app/datenschutz/

name: ArtHoney
description:
Make stickers, cards, and gift tags on your iPhone. Start with a favorite photo, a blank canvas, or a design from the ArtHoney Project Library.

• Edit photos. Crop and resize your images, adjust brightness and color, and try different filters.
• Make cutouts and stickers. Keep the part of a photo you want, tidy the edges, and add an outline.
• Add and edit text. Change the words, font, size, and color. Adjust spacing and alignment, or curve the text around your artwork.
• Build your design in layers. Add photos, shapes, and drawings. Move, rotate, or duplicate each piece on the canvas.
• Personalize cards and crafts. Start with a Library design, make your own card cover, and write a message inside.

Start for free with two project slots and a selection of Library designs. An optional monthly or yearly ArtHoney Premium subscription adds unlimited projects, more Library designs, the ability to save your own templates, and PDF and SVG export.

Make it yours.
