name: Artifact Computing
description:
Artifact Computing is the iPhone app for your company's steering workspace.
Sign in with your work account. See the direction published to your agents, review an open intervention, and read the receipts of what changed. Connect a coding or research agent from the Agents tab.
Artifact records receipts of what changed in a response. It does not store your agents' prompts or replies. This version has no in-app purchases.

name: Artikle: der die das
description:
Artikle makes the hardest part of German finally click: der, die or das.

Swipe through beautifully simple flashcards and learn the gender of 1,000 of the most common German nouns — the words you actually use every day. Swipe left for der, right for die, down for das (or tap the buttons, or use the arrow keys on iPad). Instant feedback with sound and haptics keeps every round fast and fun.

A smart spaced-repetition system (SRS) tracks what you know and brings words back exactly when you're about to forget them, so they stick for good.

WHY ARTIKLE
• 1,000 common German nouns, checked for the correct gender
• Levels A1 to B2 — start easy, grow with you
• 10 topics: food, travel, work, home, nature, people, health, technology, culture and more
• Spaced repetition: review the right word at the right time
• Progress stats: accuracy by article (der/die/das) and by level
• Swipe, tap, or arrow keys — your choice
• Works fully offline
• No ads, no tracking, no account needed
• Free

Whether you're starting German or polishing your grammar, Artikle turns article practice into a quick daily habit. Master der, die and das — a few minutes at a time.

name: Asnali Clienti
description:
Asnali Clienti is the official app of Studio Asnali Prato (CAF Impresa Asnali), giving clients simple and secure access to their private area.

With the app you can:
• View your files, documents and payslips
• Keep track of deadlines and messages from your advisor
• Sign in quickly and safely with fingerprint or Face ID
• Send and follow up your assistance requests

Designed exclusively for clients of Studio Asnali Prato, the app keeps you connected with your trusted office for tax, payroll, labour and business consulting services.

Access is reserved for clients with credentials provided by the firm.

name: Atlas Zoom – Geography Quiz
description:
Atlas Zoom is a geography quiz for all 195 countries. The picture starts zoomed in and slowly zooms out – the sooner you recognise the country, the more points you get.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
• Zoom Quiz: flags and outlines under the magnifier
• Capitals & Cities: “What is the capital of …?”, “Which country is Rio de Janeiro in?”, “Which capital is marked on the map?”
• Neighbours: which country borders Türkiye? Four answers, only one is right – then all neighbours appear on the map with their names
• Flags: with look-alike flags as traps
• Where is it?: tap the country on the world map – points by distance
• Learn: new countries on a flash card, mistakes come back soon, what you know only after days
  ↳ One country: learn the biggest cities, rivers and mountains of any country you pick

TRIP OF THE DAY
Eight stops along real borders, the same for everyone. Every correct stop earns a stamp for your passport.

YOUR PROFILE
Collect experience points, keep your daily streak and climb eight levels from pupil to professor – each with its own outfit. Choose boy or girl, hairstyle, hair colour and skin tone. In My Atlas the world turns gold, country by country.

ALSO
• Daily reminder for a quiz if you like (on your device only)
• Flags, outlines, capitals, big cities and population for every country
• In 14 languages, no account, works offline

Free with ads. A one-time “Ad-free” purchase removes the ad breaks; the optional video to double your XP stays available.

Map data: Natural Earth, world-countries (ODbL), Wikidata. Borders and names are for learning and do not imply any position on disputed territories. Developed with the help of AI (code, text, translations).

name: Atomick
description:
Atomick is a clock that keeps time as close as possible to real atomic time.

Your iPhone's clock is usually close, but not exact. Atomick checks it against public time servers run by Apple, Cloudflare and NIST, corrects for the difference, and shows how accurate the result is, for example ±8 ms.

FACES
• Digital: large, thin numerals
• Analog: a plain dial with slim hands
• Orbital: hour, minute and second electrons circling a nucleus
• Instrument: UTC and local time, Unix time, Modified Julian Date, day of year, ISO week and live sync details

Swipe or tap the page dots to change faces.

PRECISION
Show minutes, seconds, tenths, hundredths or milliseconds. The display changes when the true second does, not when your phone's clock does.

TIME SYNC
• Each server's offset, round trip, stratum and error bound
• Servers that disagree with the others are left out
• Atomick picks the best server automatically, or you choose one
• Sync Now updates the time on demand
• The sync state at a glance: Locked, Holdover, Acquiring or Offline

iPAD AND iPHONE DUO
On iPad, the sync details sit beside the clock in landscape and below it in portrait. On an unfolded iPhone Duo, the clock stays on the right half and the details open on the left.

OPTIONS
12- or 24-hour time, local time or UTC, date on or off, light or dark appearance, five accent colors, and keep the screen awake.

Works with VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion.

PRIVACY
Atomick collects no data. No ads, no analytics, no account. It only connects to the time servers.

name: Aussie Citizenship Test Hub
description:
DISCLAIMER: Aussie Civics is an independent, unofficial study app. It is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by or representing the Department of Home Affairs or the Australian Government. Its questions are original practice questions, not the questions used in the real test.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no account.

Aussie Civics is made for future citizens — clear, simple, and easy to use, even with limited English.

Aussie Civics helps you prepare for the Australian citizenship test. Every question is written in our own words from the four testable parts of the booklet Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond.

THE REAL TEST
• 20 multiple-choice questions in 45 minutes
• 5 of the 20 questions are about Australian values
• To pass you need at least 15 of 20 correct AND all 5 values questions correct. One wrong values answer means you don't pass, even with a high score.

WHAT'S IN THE APP
• 341 practice questions from the four testable parts of Our Common Bond: Australia and its people; Australia's democratic beliefs, rights and liberties; Government and the law in Australia; and Australian values (94 values questions).
• Practice Test: 20 questions with exactly 5 on values, 45 minutes, marked with both rules. 
• Values Mode: practise only the values questions, in rounds of 10 or all 94.
• Every answer comes with a short explanation.
• Learn: each testable part in plain English, with key facts, key terms and the booklet part, heading and page they come from.
• Test-day guide: how the test is arranged, the ID to bring, what happens at your appointment, results, and what happens if you don't pass.
• Exam Mode: a 45-minute test-day simulation with a question grid. Pass three in a row before your appointment.
• Flashcards, Quick Review and Weak Spots: questions you miss come back more often.
• Listen Mode: hear questions and answers read aloud in Australian accents, female or male (voice clips built into the app, work offline).
• Question of the Day and an optional daily reminder.
• Progress by part, quiz history and a countdown to your test date.
• Works offline. For iPhone, iPad and Android phones and tablets.

YOUR PRIVACY
No account and no tracking. Your name, progress and settings stay on your device.

OFFICIAL SOURCES (please check current information here)
• Citizenship test and interview (Home Affairs): https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/citizenship/test-and-interview
• Our Common Bond, testable section (Home Affairs): https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/citizenship-subsite/files/our-common-bond-testable.pdf

SOURCE CREDIT
Based on Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond  Commonwealth of Australia 2020 (Department of Home Affairs), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Questions and text are original and not endorsed by the Department. The Commonwealth Coat of Arms and the booklet's photos are not used.

Aussie Civics is a study aid only. Practising does not guarantee a pass. Always check the current rules on the Home Affairs website.

Good luck on your journey to Australian citizenship!

name: AutoMoM – Meeting Minutes
description:
Record a meeting and get clear minutes and a time-stamped transcript, on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac.

• Mac: records your voice and the other side of Teams, Zoom or Meet calls, no virtual audio driver needed
• iPhone and iPad: record in-person meetings, even with the screen off
• Apple Watch: record from your wrist; your iPhone or Mac writes the minutes
• Transcription runs on your device. Audio never goes to any AI company
• Minutes with on-device Apple Intelligence, or with your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini API key (sent only with your permission)
• Summary, decisions and action items with owners and due dates
• Word and Markdown files, saved to iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox and shared across your devices
• Edit the minutes in Word and AutoMoM shows your edited version

No subscription. Your first 3 meetings are free; one purchase unlocks unlimited minutes on all your Apple devices. Recording is always free.

Please follow local laws and let participants know before you record.

name: AwayBrief
description:
Going away is easier when the person taking over knows what to do. Make a care brief for your home, pet, or someone you look after, with routines, useful contacts, and the practical details they need. Keep door codes and passwords in a separate section on your device.

Start with one care brief for free. The optional one-time Lifetime purchase lets you create more briefs, review version history, and export a PDF. Private access details stay out of the PDF.

Your briefs work offline. In Settings, you can save a backup to Files, including iCloud Drive when available.

name: Axis Padel
description:
Axis Padel is the home of padel tournaments. Register with your partner, follow the draw, groups and results live, and see where you rank among players.

• Find a partner and invite them to a tournament
• Register your team and see your match time and court
• Clear groups, knockouts and brackets with results for every group
• Season ranking with points and player categories
• Notifications for invites, matches and results
• Fully Arabic with English support, following your phone's language

Tournament fees are paid at the venue. There are no in-app purchases.

name: AzimuthForge
description: Banc de brúixola per al mòbil: llegeix el cap magnètic, mostra un quadrant dibuixat a mida, desa rumbos, fixa lectures, defineix un objectiu amb indicació de desviació esquerra o dreta, i guia la calibració en forma de 8. Dades només al dispositiu; sense connexió excepte «Sobre nosaltres». Compatible amb iOS 15; vertical i horitzontal.

name: Bà Ơi! Learn Vietnamese
description:
Bà Ơi! helps children of Vietnamese families abroad learn short, real phrases to say to their grandparents — "Con chào bà ạ", "Bà khỏe không ạ?", "Con nhớ bà" — and then actually say them on the next call.

MADE FOR TALKING WITH GRANDPARENTS
• 129 everyday phrases in 10 themes: greetings, family, food, feelings, play, daily life, festivals and more
• Call scripts: practise a few phrases, then call Ông Bà. Each line comes with what grandparents can answer or ask back, so the call becomes a real conversation
• "Đã nói với ông bà" — mark the phrases your child really used with grandparents

LEARN A LITTLE EVERY DAY
• One phrase of the day, with gentle spaced review so phrases come back before they are forgotten
• Short lessons: listen, say it, pick the picture, match and build the sentence (activities grow with your child's age)
• The child records their own voice and hears it back — no automatic scoring, every regional accent is right

FAMILY VOICES
• Parents and grandparents can record phrases in their own voices; the app plays them instead of the sample voice
• Northern (Bắc) or Southern (Nam) Vietnamese, matching how your family speaks
• Call grandparents "Bà nội", "Bà ngoại", or by their own name — the app says it the way your child does

STORIES AND BEDTIME
• 20 Vietnamese stories, from Sự tích bánh chưng to Thánh Gióng, with read-together questions for parents
• Bedtime mode plays audio only and lets the screen turn off

FOR PARENTS
• A family Vietnamese plan: when you call grandparents, who speaks Vietnamese and when, with an optional reminder before calls
• Weekly progress report, daily time limit, up to 5 child profiles
• Backup and restore your family's data yourself

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no data collected
• Everything stays on your device
• Purchases and anything that leaves the app sit behind a parental gate

Menus are in Vietnamese; phrases include English translations.

Free to try with 19 phrases and 2 stories. Unlock everything once with Family Lifetime — no subscription, shared with your family.

name: Baby Tracker - Nurture Log
description:
Every moment with your baby is precious. Baby Tracker helps you keep track of your little one's daily activities and important milestones in one simple, organized place.

Whether you're tracking feeding sessions, sleep routines, diaper changes, or growth measurements, Baby Tracker makes it easier to stay informed about your baby's daily routine.

FEATURES

Feeding Tracker
- Track breastfeeding sessions and feeding duration.
- Record bottle feeding amounts in milliliters.
- Keep a history of feeding activities.

Sleep Tracker
- Track your baby's naps and nighttime sleep.
- Record sleep start and end times.
- Monitor sleep duration and daily patterns.

Diaper Tracker
- Record wet, dirty, and mixed diaper changes.
- Keep track of your baby's daily diaper activity.
- Review previous diaper records.

Growth Tracker
- Record your baby's weight, height, and head circumference.
- Keep a history of growth measurements.
- Follow your baby's growth over time.

Baby Profile
- Create your baby's profile with a name, birthday, gender, and profile picture.
- Keep your baby's information organized in one place.

Today's Summary
- Get a quick overview of your baby's daily activities.
- See feeding, sleep, and diaper statistics at a glance.
- Focus on the activities that have been recorded.

YOUR BABY'S DAILY JOURNAL, ALL IN ONE PLACE

From the first feeding to bedtime, Baby Tracker helps you stay organized and remember the little details that matter.

name: Bald Head Rub: Grow Hair
description:
A silly game where you rub a bald head to grow hair.

■ Rub, then let go
Rub a 90-year-old grandpa's bald head with your finger to build up static. Let go and ZAP! His hair shoots up.

■ Too much? You get shocked
Let go in the gold zone of the meter for an extra-big boost. Charge too much and KABOOM! You see his bones, and his hair turns into a frizzy afro.

■ Grow it to the moon
The longer his hair, the faster it grows. Giraffe, house, building, tower, mountain, airplane... Every time you pass one, the camera flies up to the tip of his hair. 20 seconds per round.

■ Expect the unexpected
A cat sticks to his head. It was a wig all along and it flies away. Lightning strikes. Rainbow hair. A bird builds a nest on top.

■ Unlock with coins
Earn coins by playing. You can also get them by watching ads.
- Tools: balloon, yarn, cat (each builds static differently)
- Grandpas: undershirt, muscle, polo shirt

■ Leaderboards and achievements
Compare your tallest hair and total hair grown on Game Center. 12 achievements. Share your results and wild moments.

name: BalkanChat - private messages
description:
BalkanChat is a private messenger for family and friends. Messages, photos, videos, voice messages, statuses and calls are end-to-end encrypted on your phone. Our server only relays locked data and cannot read it - not even we, the owners, can.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Private chats and groups, with delivered and read ticks
• Voice and video calls - encrypted, directly between devices
• Send photos, videos, voice messages, files and your location - all encrypted
• Statuses that disappear after 24 hours
• Channels for news and announcements
• Your own stickers and GIF search
• Translate messages on your phone (Google ML Kit) - the text never leaves your device
• Lock individual chats
• Find friends from your contacts - names stay on your phone
• 15 languages, including English, German, Bosnian, Croatian, Serbian, Macedonian, Slovenian and Albanian

SAFETY
• Warnings for scam messages that ask for codes or money, or contain suspicious links (checked on your phone only)
• Block and report any person, group or channel
• Hide when you were last online
• Encrypted backup, protected by your own password that we never know

PRIVACY
• No ads, no tracking - we never sell or share your data
• Messages are deleted from the server once they are delivered
• Delete your account at any time in the app

Sign up with your phone number and an SMS code. BalkanChat is for people aged 16 and over.

Privacy policy and terms: https://chat.balkanloop.com/privatnost.html

name: Bar Exam Pacing Timer
description:
Bar Exam Pacing Timer keeps your pace while you work multiple-choice questions from a book or a printout, with no data connection needed.

• Set a block of questions and a time, and see your budget in seconds a question
• One tap on Next for each question, every tap logged
• Drift at every checkpoint: how many seconds ahead of or behind your pace
• Pause and Undo for slips and interruptions; paused time counts for nothing
• Time left, with what it leaves for each question still to go
• After the block: final drift, a row for every checkpoint, your five slowest questions
• Ready-made blocks at 108 seconds a question, and room for your own
• History of finished blocks with your average drift

Set a block, say 100 questions in 3 hours, and the app works out your budget: 108 seconds a question. Tap Next as you finish each question. Every tap is logged, and at each checkpoint you see how many seconds ahead of or behind that budget you are.

WHILE YOU WORK
The question you are on, its time next to the budget, your drift at the last question, and the time left with what it leaves for each question still to go. A light haptic tap marks every checkpoint, and the screen stays on while the clock runs.

SLIPS AND INTERRUPTIONS
Tapped twice by accident? Undo takes it back. Pause when someone needs you; paused time counts for nothing.

AFTER THE BLOCK
Your final drift, a row for every checkpoint, how many questions ran over budget, your five slowest questions and your average time a question.

YOUR SETUPS
Three ready-made blocks at 108 seconds a question (100 in 180 minutes, 50 in 90, 25 in 45) and room for your own, from 1 to 200 questions and 1 to 600 minutes, with a checkpoint every 5, 10, 20 or 25 questions.

HISTORY
Every finished block stays on your iPhone, with your average drift a question over the last five.

WHAT IS FREE
One block a day is free; a block counts when you start its clock. Bar Exam Pacing Timer Pro, bought once, lifts the daily limit and lets you export your history as CSV.

No account, no sign-in, no ads. Your blocks stay on your iPhone.

Bar Exam Pacing Timer is a study aid that times you; it brings no questions of its own. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by a bar, an examining body, a school or a course provider, and its ready-made blocks are plain arithmetic, not official exam timings.

name: BarakaMatch: Faith & Marriage
description:
BarakaMatch is for Christian and Muslim singles who want marriage, not endless swiping.

Tell us about your faith, family and the life you want to build. We show you a short daily list of people whose values, practice and timeline fit yours, each with a compatibility score and the reason behind it.

BUILT AROUND FAITH
- Choose to see only members of your own faith, or be open to both.
- Share how you practise: church attendance, prayer, denomination or sect.
- Say when you hope to marry and whether you want children.

RESPECTFUL BY DESIGN
- Chat opens only when both of you are interested.
- Optionally copy a trusted family member on a conversation.
- Photo verification shows who is real.
- Blur your photos, hide your age or pause your profile at any time.

SAFE
- Every member must be 18 or older.
- Block or report anyone in two taps; our team reviews every report.
- Messages asking for money, or sharing numbers and links too early, are flagged.

FREE FOR FOUNDING MEMBERS
Everything is free at launch, including seeing who is interested in you.

Terms: https://theaiventureacademy.com/barakamatch-terms
Privacy: https://theaiventureacademy.com/barakamatch-privacy

BarakaMatch is made by The AI Venture Academy LLC, Statesboro, Georgia.

name: Barber Doc
description: Barber Doc è un’app di prenotazioni intuitiva e facile da usare. Con questa app potrai prenotare tutti i tuoi appuntamenti con semplicità, da qualsiasi luogo e in qualsiasi momento. Grazie alla sua interfaccia utente moderna e dinamica, potrai cercare e prenotare i tuoi servizi preferiti con una semplice pressione del dito. L’app di Barber Doc ti permette di avere il controllo completo delle tue prenotazioni, visualizzando le date disponibili e molto altro ancora. L’app di Barber Doc ti aiuta a risparmiare tempo e a organizzare la tua routine in modo semplice ed efficiente. Scarica l’app di Barber Doc oggi stesso e inizia a prenotare i tuoi appuntamenti con tranquillità!

name: Bariz
description:
Stop hovering by the counter. Bariz tells you the moment your order is ready.

When you order at a café, restaurant or shop that uses Bariz, just scan the QR code on your receipt or at the counter. That's it: no account, no sign-up, no personal details.

FOLLOW YOUR ORDER LIVE
• See your order status on the Lock Screen with Live Activities
• Glance at it in the Dynamic Island while you use other apps
• Add the Home Screen widget to keep your current order in view

GET ALERTED WHEN IT'S READY
• Your phone rings and vibrates as soon as your order is ready
• Go sit down, take a call or step outside; you won't miss it

NO DOWNLOAD NEEDED
• Bariz works as an App Clip, so you can follow an order straight from the QR code, even before installing the app

LOYALTY IN YOUR WALLET
• Collect stamps on a Bariz loyalty card in Apple Wallet and get rewarded for coming back

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up and no account
• Bariz only uses your order code to show its status and notify you

Bariz: the order's ready.

name: BayAreaShaadi.com
description:
Private matchmaking for single Indians in the Bay Area who are serious about marriage. No photos. No swiping. No games. Your privacy is the whole point.

Every Tuesday at 5 PM, our AI sends you one carefully matched introduction by email. You review it, and if you're interested, you unlock their contact details for $99/year or $9.99/month (cancel anytime). Joining is free. Sign up today and get your first introduction this Tuesday.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Sign up free — create your account in seconds with Google, Facebook, Microsoft or Apple.

2. Create your profile — answer a few quick questions by tapping the options that fit: age, religion, education, profession, your timeline, and what you're looking for. It takes under a minute, and your profile stays private.

3. Tuesday introductions — every Tuesday at 5 PM, our AI curates your best match and emails you the introduction. Your first 4 introductions include your match's contact details at no cost. After that, a paid membership unlocks contact details every week.

FREE MEMBERSHIP — $0, forever
• Full private profile
• An AI-matched introduction every Tuesday at 5 PM — 52 a year
• Matched on religion, mother tongue, education, timeline and values
• Your first 4 introductions with contact details, free

PAID MEMBERSHIP — $9.99/month, or $99 for a full year. Cancel anytime.
• Everything in Free Membership
• Contact details for every match after your 4 free ones — email and phone, unlocked
• No photos, no swiping, no public visibility

BUILT ON TRUST, NOT PHOTOS

Marriage-focused, not dating. This is not a dating app. Every member states the year they hope to get married, and the AI matches on shared religion, mother tongue, education, timeline, and what you each say you're looking for — not on a swipe.

How members are verified. Before anyone joins, they complete an application that our AI screens instantly. Email addresses are confirmed with a one-time code, and an introduction is only ever sent to members whose profiles pass that review.

What happens to your information. No photos are displayed, and members are shown first names only. Your details are used solely to match and introduce you — never sold, never shared with third parties. Delete your account and your profile is removed completely.

Marriage is a multi-year journey. Our AI walks with you every step of the way — discreetly, patiently, and intelligently.

Private · Discreet · San Francisco Bay Area, California.

name: BBC School QEA
description:
BBC School QEA is the official mobile platform for Quality Education Algérie (Q.E.A) — BBC School in Cheraga, Algiers.

Designed for school leadership, teachers, floor managers, preschool educators, and parents, the app brings all 6 school portals together in one fast, multilingual (English, French, and Arabic RTL) mobile experience:

• Main School Portal — Director, Staff, Teachers, Floor Managers, Preschool, Coordination, and Parent views
• Raida Executive Portal — Academic oversight and activity corners
• Supervision Portal — Comprehensive daily follow-up and reporting
• BBC Kids (Teachers & Parents) — Préscolaire curriculum, routines, and communication
• Parent Registration Form — Fast bilingual digital intake

Key Features:
• Instant portal switching across all 6 school spaces
• Native PDF printing, report downloads, and document sharing
• Direct photo and document uploads from camera or gallery
• Direct WhatsApp, phone, and email communication links

name: Bêafrîka
description:
Bêafrîka puts the Central African Republic in your pocket: our history, our peoples, our land and your rights under the 2023 Constitution, explained simply. Everything works without internet, even on small phones.

DISCOVER THE COUNTRY
• Land and nature, history, peoples and cultures, landmarks, farming and the economy
• Short cards with real photos, each read in two minutes
• The prefectures, the leaders since independence and a timeline of the constitutions
• The Central African Republic in the world: its organisations, treaties and partners
• The national anthem, to listen to in French and in Sango, and the coat of arms
• Visit the CAR: the essentials for visitors, with official travel advice

KNOW YOUR RIGHTS
• The Constitution of 30 August 2023 as clear cards: arrest, school, health, land, voting…
• Every card quotes the exact article, and the full text is in the app
• The rights that hold even in a state of emergency
• The Maputo Protocol on the rights of women in Africa

LEARN BY PLAYING
• Daily quiz, True or false, Timeline, Word of the day and Map puzzle
• Two-minute games and a daily streak to keep
• A reminder in the morning and the evening, only if you want one

FOR EVERYONE
• Every card can be read aloud, for people who read little or prefer to listen
• Big buttons, the flag's colours and a help button on every screen
• In French and English; Sango is coming soon

SHARE
• Send a card as a picture on WhatsApp or Facebook in one tap
• Share your scores, and tell the people close to you about the app

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No account, no ads, no trackers. Your scores and progress stay on your phone. The internet is only used to receive new cards.

SOURCES FOR EVERYTHING
Every card shows its source. The Constitution is the one promulgated on 30 August 2023 (Official Journal of the Central African Republic, JORCA/ES no. 9, 4 September 2023). Each photo has a code linked to its full reference in Sources and credits.

IMPORTANT
Bêafrîka is an independent app published by Xeraxon Care Ltd. It is not affiliated with the Central African government or any political party. It helps you understand your rights but does not replace a lawyer's advice.

A question, a mistake, an idea for a card? Write to us: support@xeraxoncare.co.uk

name: Beaver Bridge: Learn to Play
description: Meet Beaver Bridge, an amazing app to learn bridge.

name: Before You Pop
description:
Don't overpay for the most important ring you'll ever buy.

Natural or lab-grown, the same diamond can be priced very differently from one jeweler to the next. Lab-grown prices have dropped fast while many stores haven't lowered theirs, and a natural diamond's price can jump on grade differences you can't even see. Whether you're looking at a listing online or a quote in a store, Before You Pop tells you in seconds whether the price is fair, and whether the stone is what the store says it is.

HOW IT WORKS
• Works for natural and lab-grown diamonds
• Paste the link to a ring or diamond you're looking at online, and its details and price fill in
• Or scan the GIA or IGI grading report with your camera, or enter the details yourself
• Get a clear verdict: Below market, Fair price, Overpriced or Walk away

CHECK THE PAPERWORK
• Compare the stone with the lab's own record on GIA's or IGI's website, detail by detail
• Catch an altered report, a 1.50 carat stone sold as 1.52, or a lab-grown stone sold as natural
• Reads GIA's newer lab-grown reports, which say Premium or Standard instead of color and clarity

COUNTER MODE
• Keep your target price, fair range and walk-away number on your lock screen, in the Dynamic Island and on Apple Watch while you're at the store
• Numbers only, no ring words, and it turns itself off after 4 hours

WHAT YOU GET
• The fair price and fair range for that exact stone, natural or lab-grown
• How much you'd overpay
• Red flags, like a lab-grown stone priced like a natural one, a "1 ct TW" total weight, clarity you're paying for but can't see, or a complete-ring price that includes the setting
• A word-for-word script to negotiate, using your numbers
• Every check saved so you can compare jewelers

FREE TOOLS
• Tag decoder: scan a price tag or paste a listing to see what "1 ct TW", grade ranges and "compare at" prices really mean
• Financing check: see what a "no interest" store card could cost if you fall short
• Lab or natural: see how big a diamond your budget buys each way
• Hint card: send your partner the ring you love, with its price already checked and no prices shown
• Ring buying guide: every step from budget to proposal, in plain English
• Diamond words: VS2, ct TW, GIA, halo and the rest of the jargon explained, with a ? next to each field when you check a price
• Surprise mode: Face ID lock and a plain app icon, so the proposal stays a secret

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking, no notifications. Your checks stay on your phone. Store and lab pages open inside the app and are read on your phone; nothing about them is sent to us.

Your first price check is free. Ring Pass unlocks unlimited checks for a one-time price. No subscription.

Before You Pop gives estimates based on current market data, not appraisals. It reads the grading report and the lab's record; it can't inspect the stone itself.

name: BFT Air
description:
BFT Air, BFT motorlu bahçe ve garaj kapınızı telefonunuzdan, internet üzerinden açmanızı sağlar.

BFT Air kumandası motora, kontrol kartına ya da kapıya bağlanmaz; kablo veya servis gerekmez. Motorunuza yeni bir kumanda gibi S1 (START) öğrenme düğmesiyle bir kez tanıtılır. Sonra evinizde Wi-Fi'ın çektiği bir yerde durur ve kapıya standart anteniyle açık alanda 200 metreye kadar radyo sinyali gönderir. Mevcut BFT kumandalarınız çalışmaya devam eder.

ÖNEMLİ: Uygulama tek başına çalışmaz; BFT Air kumandası gerekir. Kurulum, cihazın kutusundaki QR etiketi okutularak başlar.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Kapıyı aç: Basılı tutarak açma, yanlışlıkla açılmayı önler; isterseniz Face ID onayı eklenir.
• Kolay kurulum: Kutudaki QR etiketini okutun, cihazı Wi-Fi ağınıza bağlayın, motorun S1 düğmesiyle tanıtın.
• Birden fazla kapı: Tüm kapılarınız tek hesapta.
• Kumanda yönetimi ve paylaşım: Kumandalarınızı uygulamaya tanıtın, aile bireyleriyle süreli ya da süresiz paylaşın, istediğiniz an geri alın.
• Zamanlanmış basışlar: Kumandanın belirlediğiniz saatlerde otomatik basılmasını ayarlayın.
• Yaklaşınca aç ve Kestirmeler: Kapıya yaklaştığınızda açma ve iPhone Kestirmeler ile açma.
• Bluetooth ile aç: İnternet olmadığında yakındaki uyumlu BFT Air cihazına Bluetooth ile komut gönderin.
• Bildirimler: Elektrik kesildi/geri geldi, cihaz çevrimdışı oldu gibi durumlarda uyarı.
• İşlem geçmişi: Kim, hangi kapıyı, ne zaman açtı.

GÜVENLİK
• Tüm bağlantılar TLS ile şifrelenir.
• Parolalar yalnızca Argon2id özeti olarak saklanır.
• Her komut tek kullanımlıktır ve tekrar oynatılamaz.
• Verileriniz satılmaz, reklam yoktur.

Kapınızın güvenlik ekipmanları (fotosel, acil durdurma vb.) uygulama tarafından devre dışı bırakılmaz. Kapıyı çalıştırırken hareket alanında kimse olmadığından emin olun.

name: Bible Anywhere
description:
Bible Anywhere is a calm, fast Bible reader for iPhone and iPad that works offline.

READ TWO TRANSLATIONS
개역한글, the Berean Standard Bible, the World English Bible and the King James Version. Show two of them verse by verse — side by side on iPad, one under the other on iPhone. Swipe to change chapters; the app opens where you stopped.

SEARCH IN AN INSTANT
Type a reference (“John 3:16”, “Rom 8:28-39”, “요 3:16”, “시 23”) or a few words in Korean or English.

MARK WHAT MATTERS
Tap verses to copy, share, highlight in five colours, write a note or bookmark them. Notes belong to the verse, so they show in every translation. My Notes lists everything.

IN SYNC WITH YOUR MAC
Highlights, notes and bookmarks sync between iPhone, iPad and Bible Anywhere for Mac through your own iCloud. No account to create; turn sync off any time.

CROSS REFERENCES AND READ ALOUD
118,000 cross references from OpenBible.info, and the chapter read aloud with the voices on your device, offline, continuing into the next chapter.

FREE, WITH ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE
Every feature is free with a small banner below the text. One purchase (Bible Anywhere Pro, no subscription) removes it, and also unlocks the Pro tools in the Mac app.

INCLUDED TEXTS (public domain)
개역한글 (1961) · Berean Standard Bible · World English Bible · King James Version. Copyrighted translations such as NIV, ESV and 개역개정 need a publisher's license and are not included.

name: Billimeoward
description:
Billimeoward is a physics puzzle where cats sit on the billiards table and get in the way of your balls. Read each cat's rule and sink every ball in as few shots as you can.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag near the cue ball and let go to shoot. The direction you pull is the direction of the shot, and the length is the power.
- Sink every ball to clear the stage. The fewer shots you use, the more stars you earn (up to 12 per stage).

THE CATS
- Sleeping cats bounce balls back like walls, and wake up after 2 hits.
- Awake cats swat any ball that passes in front of them (the fan) in a set direction.
- Boxed cats block pockets, and move out of the way when hit.

PLENTY TO PLAY
- 66 stages in 8 worlds, on tables of all shapes: L-shapes, crosses, octagons, C-shapes and more.
- Clear the last stage of a world to unlock the next one.
- Play with hints (each cat's paw reach and swat direction) or with no time limit.
- Share a video of your clear.
- Available in English and Japanese.

PRICE
- Free to play. Ads appear on the clear and fail screens and every 5 games.
- Buy the one-time in-app purchase "Remove Ads" to turn all ads off.
- No account needed.

name: BirdSpot: Bird Identifier
description:
Which birds can you see near you today? BirdSpot tells you what's around this season, helps you identify the bird you just photographed, and shows on an Apple satellite map which birds live in each area.

BirdSpot is a birdwatching app for iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs, made for birders who head out every weekend and for anyone who just spotted a bird in the yard and wants to know what it is.

TODAY, NEAR YOU
• The birds of your area, each with its own illustration (or a silhouette until it has one), its common name (if it has one) and its scientific name, with this month's highlights first: passing through on migration, just arriving, year-round residents or winter visitors.
• Tap a bird for its page: illustration, community photos, which months it shows up in your area and where it has been seen, by area; vulnerable species only show as present in the district.

WHAT BIRD IS THAT?
• Snap the bird or choose a shot from your library: the AI gives you the common and scientific name with a confidence percentage, and tells you when it isn't sure.
• The field marks visible in the photo and the look-alikes, and how to tell them apart.
• Its protection in Spain: the general protection of all wild birds and, if it's in the Spanish Catalog of Threatened Species, the status that comes with it. Plus a tip for watching it without disturbing it.
• Photograph a nest or a chick and BirdSpot asks you to keep your distance, and the sighting's location is saved as visible only to you.

THE BIRDING MAP, ON APPLE 3D SATELLITE IMAGERY
• In Europe, nearly 8,000 bird blinds and observation towers by wetlands in 26 countries, from OpenStreetMap, plus the EU's Special Protection Areas for birds, with a breeding-season and drone reminder.
• In every area, an illustration of the easiest bird to see there this month and a "+N" badge: tap it to see the photos people have uploaded there and the other birds found there.
• Press and hold anywhere to see its birds, save it as a spot or head there.

YOUR JOURNAL, LIFE LIST AND FRIENDS
• Every sighting with its photo, species, date and place. You choose who sees it: only you, your friends or everyone.
• Your life list: every different species you've seen, with the first date for each.
• Your spots stay private. Save them with GPS or on the map, and "Go" guides you there with a compass showing bearing and distance.
• Add friends with a code and follow the sightings feed: everyone's, your friends' or just yours.

SAFE FOR BIRDS
• Endangered species never appear with their location, and vulnerable ones only with a rough area of about 6 miles.
• An ethics reminder covers how to watch: from a distance, with no playback lures or bait.

GETTING STARTED
Sign up with just a username, no email or password. Needs an internet connection. On a Mac, which has no compass, "Go" shows bearing and distance.

FREE AND BIRDSPOT PRO
• Free download, ad-supported: a banner and a full-screen ad while each photo is being identified, never before you take it.
• BirdSpot Pro removes both ads, billed monthly or yearly; you'll see the price in your currency in the App Store before subscribing. Includes a 7-day free trial if you haven't tried Pro before.
• With or without Pro, up to 40 identifications per day per account.
• The subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. You can manage or cancel it from Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

DATA
Map: Apple. Bird blinds and towers: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Protected areas: European Environment Agency. Bird records: GBIF. Illustrations: BirdSpot's own.
AI identification is a guide and can be wrong. Rules vary by place: check the ones for the area you visit.

Get outside today and add the first bird to your life list.

Privacy Policy: https://cdpoma.github.io/birdspot/privacidad.html

name: BLOKURA
description:
Bounce. Connect. Break it all.

BLOKURA is a brick breaker built around satisfying chain reactions and well-aimed shots. Slide your finger to move the paddle, bounce the ball, and clear the blocks. Hit the edge of the paddle to change your angle.

60 STAGES, SIX DIFFERENT WORLDS
Start in Neon Garden, trigger explosive chains, slip between moving walls, warp behind blocks, and learn to work with gravity. Every tenth stage brings a boss battle. The final world combines the mechanics into new challenges.

SIX WAYS TO TURN THE TIDE
Catch multiball, a wider paddle, automatic lasers, piercing balls, safety nets, and magnets that let you catch and relaunch a shot.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose Easy, Normal, Hard or Extreme. Every stage is available from the start. Earn three stars by clearing a stage without losing a life, and keep your best scores on your device.

One purchase includes every stage and difficulty. No ads. No in-app purchases. The complete game works offline. Japanese and English are supported.

Support: kuniaki.ma@gmail.com

name: Blokzade: Blok Bulmaca
description:
Blokzade'ye hoş geldin! Rengârenk mücevher blokları 8×8 tahtaya yerleştir, satır ya da sütun dolunca patlat!

KOLAY ÖĞREN, BIRAKAMA
Üç parçayı tahtaya sürükle. Bir satır ya da sütun dolunca patlar. Yer kalmayınca oyun biter. Basit mi? Rekoru kırmaya çalış!

KOMBO VE TERTEMİZ
Aynı anda birden çok çizgi patlat, art arda patlatarak kombo yap. Tahtayı tamamen temizle, "Tertemiz!" bonusunu kap.

25.000 MACERA BÖLÜMÜ
Yakut, zümrüt, safir ve kehribar elmasları topla. Simetri, çerçeve, dama, çapraz, yığın ve ada desenleri; her bölüm biraz daha zor. Az hamlede bitir, üç yıldız al.

HAFTALIK LİG VE DÜELLO
Kullanıcı adını seç, 50 kişilik grubunda puan topla; her pazar ilk 15 üst lige çıkar. Arkadaşına ya da rastgele bir rakibe meydan oku: günün en yüksek puanını yapan kazanır. 44 rozeti topla!

KLASİK MOD
Sonsuz oyun, en yüksek puan. Yarım kalan oyunun kaydedilir, istediğin an devam et.

- Tamamen ücretsiz, gerçek parayla satın alma yok
- Reklam yok
- İnternetsiz de oynanır (lig ve düello için internet gerekir)
- Süre baskısı yok

name: Boater Exam Prep: All States
description:
Independent exam prep. Not affiliated with any state agency or NASBLA. This app does not issue a boater education card.

Pass your boating exam the first time. Practise the rules, aids to navigation, lights, sound signals, safety equipment and emergencies that boater safety exams cover, plus the rules for your state.

WHAT YOU GET
• More than 550 national questions, each with an explanation and its official source
• State modules for 15 states, including Florida, Texas, California, New York and Michigan
• Timed practice exams: 50 questions, 60 minutes, 80% to pass
• Buoy and marker, night light and sound signal drills
• Weak-topic review and a readiness score
• Daily streak and optional reminders
• English and Spanish

GOOD TO KNOW
Rules change. Check your state's official boating agency for current requirements and the approved course that issues your card.

SUBSCRIPTION
Full access needs a subscription (weekly with a 3-day free trial, quarterly, or yearly) or a 7-Day Weekend Cram Pass, a one-time purchase that does not renew. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings.

LEGAL
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://boatprep.reworked.dev/terms
• Privacy Policy: https://boatprep.reworked.dev/privacy

name: Bocce Match Night
description:
Never forget the score or who won the last match.
Two teams, a target score and one tap per end: the total updates on huge numbers you can read in the sun from across the court.
A scorekeeper for real bocce games played in person, with undo for every mistake and your match night results kept on your iPhone.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Type two team names, or keep Team A and Team B.
2. Pick the target (12 by default), the most points one end can award (4 by default) and, if your group plays it, win by two.
3. After each end, tap who scored and how many points, or record an end nobody won.
4. When a team reaches the target, finish the match and see the result.

ADD EACH END IN SECONDS
- Big team buttons and point buttons, built for one hand.
- Save shows exactly what will be added, such as "Olive Rollers +2".
- Each end is saved before the board shows it, and a double tap can never add it twice.
- The score is calculated from the end-by-end log, so the total always matches what was entered.

UNDO A SCORING MISTAKE
- Undo is always on screen and takes back the latest end.
- Correct a finished match: reopen it, fix the ends and finish again.
- The match log shows every end with the running score.

YOUR HOUSE RULES
- Target from 1 to 50 points, up to 1 to 8 points per end, optional win by two.
- Defaults are a common casual setup; your group decides the rules. Custom settings are labeled.
- A match can be finished early by agreement, and a level score is shown as a tie.

SAVE TEAMS FOR NEXT TIME (PRO)
- Team groups with your regular teams and, if you like, who plays on each.
- Renaming a team later never changes matches already played.

SEE YOUR MATCH NIGHT RESULTS (PRO)
- Group the matches of one evening into a match night.
- Wins, losses, ties and points for and against for every team. Teams level on wins are shown as level, with no hidden tie-break. Matches still in progress aren't counted.
- Full match history with all-time standings.
- Formatted PDF scorecards for a match or a whole night, shared only where you choose.

FREE
- Unlimited individual matches with end-by-end scoring, undo and corrections
- Your current match plus your most recently finished match
- Before a new result replaces the previous one, the app asks first and offers a free backup
- JSON backup export and import

PRO
- Saved match nights
- Reusable team groups
- Multi-match history and standings
- Formatted PDF scorecards

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Saved matches, nights and team groups stay readable and exportable, and new individual matches stay unlimited.

Try one clearly labeled demo end before your first match. It isn't saved.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Teams, scores and results are stored on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. The app records the ends you enter; it doesn't measure distances or settle disputes.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Terms: https://motleystudio.site/bocce-match-night/terms

name: BOM DIA FIGURINHAS E GIFS
description:
Comece o dia espalhando carinho! O Bom Dia reúne mensagens de bom dia, boa tarde e boa noite, frases lindas, imagens prontas e figurinhas animadas para você enviar para a família, os amigos e quem você ama. Todo dia uma nova mensagem de bom dia, uma mensagem de boa tarde e uma mensagem de boa noite esperando por você.

MENSAGENS PARA CADA MOMENTO
- Bom dia para cada dia da semana: segunda, terça, quarta, quinta, sexta, sábado e domingo
- Boa tarde e boa noite com imagens lindas
- Sextou! Feliz sexta e bom fim de semana
- Bom dia amor e boa noite amor: mensagens românticas para quem você ama
- Bom dia com café, com flores, com passarinhos, com a natureza, com amor e com carinho

FRASES E REFLEXÕES
- Frases de motivação, esperança, amizade, amor e reflexão
- Citações de grandes autores
- Ditados populares e frases para status
- Mensagens de aniversário e legendas para fotos
- Sabedoria de vida: 1000 conselhos para o seu dia

IMAGENS PRONTAS
- Imagens de Bom dia, Boa tarde e Boa noite para compartilhar
- Centenas de fotos lindas: paisagens, flores, passarinhos e pôr do sol

CARTÕES ANIMADOS
- Cada mensagem vira um cartão bonito com foto e letra romântica
- Escreva o nome da pessoa no cartão: Para Maria
- Formato para status (9:16), tela cheia
- Crie o seu próprio cartão com a sua foto e o seu texto

FIGURINHAS
- Pacotes de figurinhas de bom dia, boa noite, ursinhos, rosas, chocolates, emojis e muito mais
- Figurinhas animadas de rosas
- Adicione os pacotes ao WhatsApp com um toque

COMPARTILHE FÁCIL
- Envie os cartões pelo WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram e outros apps
- Copie o texto da mensagem com um toque

NOTIFICAÇÕES DO SEU JEITO
- Receba uma mensagem de bom dia toda manhã
- Escolha também Boa tarde, Boa noite, Frase do dia ou Sextou, no horário que preferir

E MAIS
- Busca inteligente por tema, palavra ou autor
- Favoritos para guardar as mensagens que você mais gosta
- Várias cores para o aplicativo, modo claro e escuro

O Bom Dia é gratuito e não pede cadastro. Escolha uma mensagem, deixe o cartão do seu jeito e faça o dia de alguém mais feliz!

name: Bookwormly
description:
Bookwormly gives you the key points of well-known nonfiction books in about 15 minutes each. A short quiz asks about your interests, your goal and your time. From that you get first recommendations and a reading plan.

THE LIBRARY
• Over 950 books: over 800 nonfiction books from 12 fields, such as psychology, money, career, productivity, health, relationships and philosophy, plus over 190 classics
• Every summary: introduction, who the book is for, six to nine key points and a conclusion
• Search by title, author or topic, plus collections and an insight of the day
• Our own cover art instead of the original covers

READ AND LISTEN
• Section by section with a progress bar and four text sizes
• Read aloud with your device's voice, at the speed you choose
• Tap sentences to highlight them, long-press to add a note
• My library: saved, started and finished books

REMEMBER
• Five flashcards for every book, coming back with the SM-2 method
• A daily goal from 5 to 30 minutes, streak, levels and badges

YOUR READING PLAN
• 8 weeks, 2 to 7 days a week, each session 5, 10 or 15 minutes
• Exercises such as "Core idea in one sentence" and "Key sentence and explain it"
• 4 guides, such as "Remember instead of forget" and "Using summaries well"
• Challenges: 14-day reading habit, 21 days to remember what you read, 7 days to finish what you start, 10 days with 10 nonfiction books
• Journal for what you understood, your reading minutes and a note

HONESTLY BUILT
• The summaries are our own texts and do not replace the full book.
• Bookwormly is not affiliated with the authors or publishers.
• Highlights, notes and learning progress stay on your device.

PURCHASE
Without a subscription, one book a day is completely free: the free book of the day. For every other book you can read the info page and the first section. Week 1 of your reading plan is free too. The subscription opens every book in full, weeks 2 to 8 of the reading plan and the challenges. Terms: 1 month (the first week is free for new subscribers) or 3 months. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends in your store account settings. No ads, and an account is optional.

name: BPApp: Wellness Insights
description:
Blood pressure tracking made simple. Big numbers, easy logging, and clear reports you can share with your doctor.

BPApp is a simple, easy-to-read blood pressure log designed to make daily record-keeping comfortable and effortless.

With oversized numbers, high-contrast screens, and a clean, uncluttered design, BPApp makes it easy to record your readings and review your personal history.

No complicated menus. No unnecessary distractions. Just the information you need, clearly displayed.

 WHY YOU'LL LOVE BPAPP

1. Big Numbers. Easy Reading.

Enjoy an easy-to-read display with oversized numbers and high-contrast colors. Choose from four comfortable themes: Warm Ivory, Classic Blue, Warm Paper, and Night Mode.

2. Quick & Simple Blood Pressure Logging

Record your systolic, diastolic, and pulse readings in seconds using simple, easy-to-use number controls.

Enter readings taken with your home blood pressure cuff and keep everything organized in one place.

3. Clear Charts & Daily History

Review your personal records with easy-to-understand 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day charts.

See your daily readings, averages, and historical trends at a glance.

4. Easy-to-Share PDF Reports

Create clean, printable PDF summaries for 7, 30, or 90 days.

Your reports include:
- Average blood pressure readings
- Morning and evening comparisons
- Highest and lowest recorded readings
- Complete measurement history

Save, print, or share your reports when discussing your records with your healthcare professional.

5. Gentle Daily Reminders

Set convenient morning and evening reminders to help you maintain a consistent recording routine.

6. Apple Health Integration

Connect BPApp with Apple Health to keep supported health information organized in one place.

Manage your health data permissions through Apple Health settings.

7. Simple & Private

No account or login required.

Your personal records are stored on your iPhone. You stay in control of your information and Apple Health permissions.

 BPAPP PRO

BPApp is free to download and includes essential blood pressure logging, daily reminders, and personal history tracking.

Upgrade to BPApp Pro for additional features:

- Optional fingertip camera-based wellness features
- Morning and evening reminders
- Apple Health integration
- Printable PDF reports

Choose from available weekly, yearly, or one-time lifetime purchase options.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

 IMPORTANT INFORMATION

BPApp is designed for personal health record-keeping and general wellness purposes.

BPApp does not measure blood pressure. Blood pressure readings must be obtained using a separate blood pressure monitor and entered manually.

BPApp is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice or a clinically validated medical device.

Always consult your doctor or a qualified healthcare professional when interpreting your readings or making decisions about your health.

Never change medication or treatment based on information displayed in BPApp.

name: BrainAnatomy
description:
BrainAnatomy là ứng dụng học tập và tra cứu giải phẫu não người, dành cho sinh viên y khoa và người học chuyên ngành giải phẫu học.

Mỗi cấu trúc có hình ảnh minh họa rõ ràng và phần mô tả chi tiết, giúp bạn ôn lại kiến thức chỉ trong vài giây: trước giờ học, trong buổi thực hành hay trước kỳ thi.

NỘI DUNG
• 77 chủ đề: đại não, tiểu não, thân não, gian não, hệ viền, nhân nền, hệ thống não thất và các xương sọ
• 240 hình ảnh chất lượng cao: mỗi chủ đề có ảnh chính và các ảnh liên quan
• Mô tả chi tiết vị trí, giới hạn và chức năng của từng cấu trúc
• Hồi, rãnh và thùy não: hồi trước và sau trung tâm, rãnh trung tâm, rãnh bên, thùy trán, đỉnh, thái dương, chẩm, thùy viền, thùy đảo
• Cấu trúc sâu: đồi thị, vùng dưới đồi, hồi hải mã, hạch hạnh nhân, nhân đuôi, nhân bèo sẫm, cầu nhạt, thể chai, vòm não
• Xương sọ: xương trán, chẩm, thái dương, bướm, sàng, hàm trên, gò má, mũi, lệ, khẩu cái, lá mía

TIỆN LỢI KHI HỌC
• Tìm kiếm nhanh theo tên cấu trúc
• Yêu thích: đánh dấu sao các chủ đề đang ôn và lọc chỉ hiện những chủ đề đó
• Xem toàn màn hình: vuốt chuyển ảnh, chụm để phóng to và kéo để xem chi tiết
• Lưu hình vào Photos để làm ghi chú, slide
• Hình ảnh có sẵn trong app, xem được khi không có mạng sau khi đăng nhập
• Hỗ trợ iPhone và iPad, tự điều chỉnh theo cỡ chữ của hệ thống

DÀNH CHO
• Sinh viên Y, Răng Hàm Mặt, Điều dưỡng đang học giải phẫu, giải phẫu thần kinh
• Học viên sau đại học, bác sĩ nội trú chuyên ngành giải phẫu, thần kinh, ngoại thần kinh
• Giảng viên cần tài liệu hình ảnh tra cứu nhanh khi giảng dạy

BrainAnatomy chỉ phục vụ mục đích học tập và tra cứu, không phải thiết bị y tế và không dùng để chẩn đoán hay điều trị.

Mọi ý kiến đóng góp xin gửi về: heroht369@gmail.com

name: Brew - Coffee Journal
description:
Brew is your personal specialty coffee companion, recipe journal, and interactive brew timer.

Whether you are dialing in a light roast Ethiopian on a V60, pressing an AeroPress, or pulling the perfect espresso shot, Brew helps you track every variable to consistently craft better coffee.

KEY FEATURES:
• Detailed Recipe Tracking: Log grind size, dose, water ratio, temperature, and specific steps.
• Step-by-Step Brew Timer: Visual and audio cues for blooms and multi-stage pours with background support.
• Tasting Notes & Sensory Radar: Rate sweetness, acidity, body, clarity, and bitterness to map your palate.
• Bean Inventory & Gear Locker: Track remaining bean weight, roast dates, and your favorite drippers & grinders.
• Seamless Sharing & Import: Share your recipes instantly via elegant QR codes or web links.
• Community & Inspiration: Explore recipes and brewing tips shared by fellow coffee lovers.

Brew clean. Sip slow.

name: Brew Street Café
description:
Welcome to Brew Street Café! The little coffee shop on the corner is now yours. Customers are at the door and the machines are warm, so let's get brewing!

BREW AND SERVE
Customers walk in, take a seat and show their order in a bubble. Brew coffee at the espresso machine or the brew bar, bake desserts in batches, and serve everything while it's fresh. Be quick: customers won't wait forever!

25 COFFEES, 10 DESSERTS
Espresso, americano, cappuccino, latte, macchiato, Turkish coffee, filter coffee, flat white, cortado, mocha, iced latte, iced americano, caramel macchiato, white mocha, cold brew, Vienna coffee, frappé, affogato, espresso tonic, hazelnut latte, cookie frappé, dalgona, pumpkin spice latte, choco frappé and Spanish latte, each in its own cup and shown by picture and name in the customer's bubble, plus cookies, croissants, donuts, brownies, cheesecake, tiramisu, macarons and more. Each one joins your menu at its own level.

EXPAND YOUR CAFÉ
Start in a cozy 6×6 room with a rug and 4 tables and grow all the way to 9×9. Every expansion makes room for more tables and more customers. Furnish it with marble, iron bistro and farmhouse tables, plus rattan, bentwood and cushioned chairs. Pick and customise the character at your till: hairstyle, skin tone, hair, sweatshirt and sneaker colours.

ARRANGE IT YOUR WAY
Move tables, plants and the jukebox to any tile you like. Add a neon sign, a wall clock, a coffee shelf and a rug. A cozy café means more patient customers!

PICK YOUR COLORS
Sage, blush, sky blue, lavender and more wall paints, plus oak and walnut planks, checkerboard, terrazzo and tiled floors. Spend your coins to give the café your own look.

UPGRADE
Speed up your machines, widen your counter, use bigger dessert trays and prepare more orders at once. Hire a waiter to carry ready orders to the tables.

OPEN NEW BRANCHES
When your café has grown, open new branches on the beach, in a snowy winter village, at the mall and on a university campus. Each branch has its own look and its own special recipes, and your old branches keep earning while you are away.

ACHIEVEMENTS AND SPECIAL GUESTS
Complete achievements to earn gems. When a celebrity or a food critic walks in, be quick: happy guests pay off big!

ADD YOUR FRIENDS
Name your café and share your café code with friends. Visit their cafés, leave a like and you both get a gift!

DAILY QUESTS
Fresh quests every day: serve customers, sell the coffee of the day, collect stars and earn coins and gems.

KEEP YOUR STARS HIGH
Happy customers raise your rating, and a higher rating brings an even busier café.

DAILY REWARDS
Drop by every day and complete the 7-day reward streak. Your café keeps earning while you're away: collect your earnings when you're back.

Relax to a cozy café soundtrack.

Brew Street Café is free to play. It contains optional in-app purchases and optional rewarded ads. Playable offline.

name: Brick Crusher: Idle Blaster
description:
Smash colorful bricks with an automatic cannon, upgrade it and watch the numbers fly. Brick Crusher is a relaxed idle shooter: your cannon keeps firing on its own, and you decide how to make it stronger.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap and hold to aim, or let the cannon fire by itself
• Upgrade damage, fire rate, income, critical hits and multishot
• Break waves of bricks and defeat a boss every few levels
• Catch falling bonuses: rockets, mega bomb, laser, lightning, gold rain, shield and more
• Earn coins even while the game is closed

LOTS TO UNLOCK
• 15 cannons, each with its own look and perk: pierce, chain, poison, freeze, force field and more
• 12 animated worlds to play in
• 8 kinds of bricks: armored, gold, gift, explosive, regenerating and others
• Combat drones that fight next to your cannon
• A headquarters with buildings, defense turrets, a daily supply crate and a wheel of fortune
• Raids with random modifiers and power-ups between waves
• An ultimate attack for every cannon
• Reboot to earn Cores that make every next run stronger

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Ads are optional: you only watch one when you tap a reward button
• Daily limits keep ads from taking over the game
• Remove Ads is available as a one-time purchase
• Plays offline; an internet connection is needed only for optional rewarded ads and purchases

Languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish.

Questions or ideas? Write to s.games.global.official@gmail.com

name: Bricklet GO
description:
Bricklet GO is a brick breaker puzzle where one well-aimed volley can clear half the board. Pick your angle, bounce balls off the walls, and break every target brick before it reaches the danger line.

MAKE EVERY SHOT COUNT
Tap or drag to aim. Go straight for a weak spot or take a bank shot into the space behind the bricks. A number on each brick tells you how many hits it can take. Clear the board within the turn limit and aim for three stars.

BREAK THROUGH 100 WORLDS
Play 3,000 levels with changing layouts and gradually tougher challenges. Ice, shields, and portals change how you approach each board. Break special bricks to trigger lasers, explosions, and chain reactions.

FIND THE RIGHT POWER-UP
Unlock extra balls, bombs, lasers, and more as you progress. Freeze the board to buy time or use an extended aim guide to line up a tricky shot. Complete daily missions and work toward longer-term achievements.

Pick an angle. Let the balls fly. See how much you can clear in one shot.

name: Bridgestock
description: तुमच्या फोनवरच उरलेले अन्न नोंदवा, ते पुढील जेवणाशी जोडा, घरात असलेल्या साहित्याचा विचार करून खरेदीची फरक यादी तयार करा आणि वाया गेलेल्या अन्नाची नोंद ठेवा. आठवडाभराचे जेवण नियोजन, पाककृती नमुने आणि निर्यात—सर्व माहिती या डिव्हाइसवर सुरक्षित साठवली जाते; खाते नाही, फक्त सिस्टम ब्राउझरमधून बाह्य दुवा.

name: Brushline – Fire Clearance
description:
Mandatory wildfire brush clearing: Brushline traces your zone around the house on the land register, shows what falls on your neighbor’s land, reminds you of the deadline and keeps your before and after photos.

• My property: pick the town and the plot, reuse the registered buildings or draw them by hand.
• Indicative outline: 50 m around buildings (100 m where the order or the mayor requires it), area on your plot and area on each neighbor’s plot, with its reference.
• Neighbors: status of each plot touched, one-month countdown after your letter, letter template for the neighbor and template to inform the mayor as PDF.
• Deadlines: your département’s date, reminders 60, 30 and 7 days before, spring maintenance.
• Dated before / after photos, optional location and direction, and a PDF file with the plan.
• Greece: declaration steps and link to the government platform.

Each rule cites its official source and the date it was checked. An unchecked rule is never shown as a requirement: the app gives you the link to the text.

Privacy: no account. Your address, plots and photos stay on the phone.

Only the official prefectural or municipal order is binding. The outline is indicative; this is neither legal advice nor an official document.

Available in 25 languages, for owners in France, Portugal, Spain and Greece.

Free: the demo municipality, one traced property (rules, sources, deadlines, reminders) and today’s fire danger in the app (except Portugal). One-time purchase: unlimited properties, PDF letter templates, PDF file, before/after photos. Optional yearly subscription: “high danger” alerts by notification, renewing automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your account settings. Prices shown in the app before purchase.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

https://sogerg.github.io/brushline-legal/

name: Buddy Baggage: Offline Puzzle
description:
Sort the bags. Let them depart!

Buddy Baggage is a cosy, endless luggage-sorting puzzle. The bags are all mixed up on the airport belts: tap a belt to pick up the bags at its front, put them with bags for the same city, and when four bags for one city are together, the flight boards and takes off.

ENDLESS PUZZLES
Every flight is a fresh puzzle, and every one is checked by a solver, so it can always be finished. Easy to start, deeply satisfying to master.

10 AIRPORTS AROUND THE WORLD
Fly from Paris to Rome, Athens, London, Tokyo, New York, Madrid, Amsterdam, Dublin and Stockholm. Every 10 flights Buddy lands somewhere new, with its own terminal, skyline and welcome sign.

TWISTS THAT KEEP COMING
Mystery bags that hide their city, fragile bags, golden VIP bags, closed belts, small belts, big flights and rush flights against the clock.

STAMPS AND OUTFITS
Collect a passport stamp in every city and dress Buddy in a beret, a laurel crown, a bowler hat, a festival headband and more.

A NEW FLIGHT EVERY DAY
Play the daily flight to build your streak, and open a gift from Buddy every day.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Undo, X-ray, an extra belt, or Buddy the Porter, who shows you the next good move.

PLAYS OFFLINE
No Wi-Fi? No problem. No account needed. Your progress is saved on your phone.

Buddy Baggage is free to play with optional add-ons

name: Bundespolizei Eignungstest
description:
Hinweis: Diese App ist kein Angebot der Bundespolizei oder einer anderen Behörde und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Behörde. Sie dient ausschließlich der privaten Vorbereitung auf den Einstellungstest.

Offizielle Informationen zum Auswahlverfahren findest du bei der Bundespolizei. In der App sind offizielle Seiten verlinkt.

Bereite dich gezielt auf den Einstellungstest der Bundespolizei vor – für die Ausbildung im mittleren Dienst oder das Studium im gehobenen Dienst. Die App trainiert typische Aufgabentypen aus Einstellungstests – wann und wo du möchtest, ganz ohne Konto.

Trainingsbereiche

Bundespolizei-Fachwissen
40 Fragen zu Aufgaben und Befugnissen nach dem Bundespolizeigesetz, Grundgesetz, Organisation, Ausbildung und Studium sowie Grenze und Schengen – jeweils mit Erklärung.

Mathematik
Dreisatz, Prozent & Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen und Zahlenpuzzle.

Sprache
Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien und alphabetische Reihen.

Logik
Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix und Dominosteine.

Allgemeinwissen
Über 100 Fragen aus Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Geografie, Recht und EU – mit Themenfilter.

Gedächtnis
Zahlen merken und Buchstaben merken.

Testsimulation
30 Aufgaben aus allen Bereichen, auch Bundespolizei-Fachwissen, mit 30 Minuten Zeitlimit und Auswertung nach Bereichen.

Bundespolizei im Überblick (kostenlos)
Ablauf des Einstellungstests im mittleren und im gehobenen Dienst, Testinhalte, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Seiten.

So funktioniert die App
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Zu den Aufgaben gibt es Lösungen, bei vielen Aufgabentypen mit Lösungsweg oder Erklärung.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen der Bundespolizei.

name: Bunker Tycoon
description:
The world up there is lost. Dust, ruins and silence. But deep below the earth there is still hope: an old bunker – and people who need you.

Bunker Tycoon is a relaxed idle game about digging, building and surviving. Dig level by level into the rock, build workshops and living quarters, and turn a dusty hole in the ground into a thriving underground city. And when the time is right, launch a rocket and take your colony to the stars.

DIG DEEPER
• Dig new levels and build workshops, generators, water filters, hydroponics and more
• Upgrade rooms and watch your scrap income grow
• Keep an eye on power, water and food – every resident counts

BRING SURVIVORS HOME
• Send residents on expeditions to find scrap and survivors
• Hire supervisors who keep working – even while you're offline
• Weather storms, power failures and other surprises

FROM EARTH TO THE STARS
• Build a rocket silo and travel on to 19 more worlds: Mars, the Moon, Europa, Titan and far beyond
• Every planet has its own rock, its own storms and bigger rewards
• All your colonies keep producing at the same time

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO
• Tasks with rewards and a daily reward that grows day by day
• Achievements with star cards as rewards
• Move to a new bunker and collect permanent badges
• Offline earnings: your bunker works while you sleep

FAIR AND RELAXED
• Everything in the game can be reached without buying
• Playable offline
• Available in 15 languages

Optional purchases: Ad-free, Starter pack, star cards and the Bunker Pass (monthly subscription: double offline earnings and 1 star card every day). The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oliverwalter33-design.github.io/privacy.html

name: BVQSS Damage
description:
BVQSS Damage is the field app for teams who use BVQSS Damage Assessment, the disaster damage assessment and insurance claims platform built by Browne's Valuation & Quantity Surveying Services in St. Vincent and the Grenadines.

ASSESS IN THE FIELD
• Rapid assessments in about five minutes: location, household, cause, damage level, safety tag and photos.
• Detailed assessments with component damage, works required and line-item costing.
• Tap to place the property on the map with your phone's GPS.

WORK WITH NO SIGNAL
• Download the country map on Wi-Fi before you go out.
• Assessments and photos are saved on the phone and sync automatically when you're back online.

INSURANCE CLAIMS AND LOSS ADJUSTING
• Policy details, loss schedules, exclusions, average and deductibles, with reports as PDF or Word.

RESIDENT REQUESTS AND APPROVALS
• Residents can request an assessment after a storm; teams verify, approve assistance and record works.
• Share selected records with an insurer or lender as read-only.

ROLE-BASED ACCESS
• Field assessors see only their own data-entry forms; verifiers, adjusters, government officers and insurers each see only what their role allows.
• Every organisation works in its own private workspace.

BVQSS Damage requires an account. Accounts are provided to invited organisations under a subscription arranged directly with BVQSS; your organisation's admin invites you by email.

name: BVQSS Value
description:
BVQSS Value is the field and office app for valuers who use BVQSS Valuation, the property valuation platform built by Browne's Valuation & Quantity Surveying Services in St. Vincent and the Grenadines.

INSPECT IN THE FIELD
• Record site and building details on a phone-sized form built for inspections.
• Take property photos and attach deeds and survey plans with the camera.
• Tap "I'm at the property" to place the property on the map with your phone's GPS.

WORK WITH NO SIGNAL
• Download your country's map on Wi-Fi before you go out.
• Inspections and photos are saved on the phone and sync automatically when you're back online.

ONE MAP FOR EVERY VALUATION
• Jobs and comparables on a live map with parcels, roads, terrain and flood zones.
• St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Jamaica, Antigua and Barbuda, and Barbados.

REPORTS ON THE GO
• Open report PDFs and Word exports and share them from your phone, or save them to Files.

ROLE-BASED ACCESS
• Field inspectors see only their own data-entry forms; valuers and admins manage the full workflow, approvals and reports.
• Every company works in its own private workspace.

BVQSS Value requires an account. Accounts are provided to invited firms under a subscription arranged directly with BVQSS; your company's admin invites you by email.

name: Cadencefold
description: ਇਹ ਐਪ ਤੁਹਾਨੂੰ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਕੰਮਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਟੱਚ ਰੱਖਣ ਦੀ ਲੋੜੀਂਦੀ ਲੈਅ ਠਹਿਰਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਤੁਸੀਂ ਰਿਸ਼ਤੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਹਫ਼ਤੇ ਤੈਅ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਹਰ ਇਕ ਜਣੇ ਲਈ ਵੱਖਰਾ ਰਿਦਮ ਚੁਣ ਸਕਦੇ ਹੋ, ਅਤੇ ਐਪ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸੁਝਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਅੱਜ ਦੀ ਛੋਟੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਗਿਨਤੀ ਅਤੇ ਸਕਿੱਪ ਕਾਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਕੰਮ ਕਰੋ; ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਨ ’ਤੇ ਅਗਲੀ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਆਪੇ ਬਣ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ। ਰਿਕਾਰਡ, ਅੰਕੜੇ ਅਤੇ CSV ਐਕਸਪੋਰਟ ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਜੰਤਰ ’ਤੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹੈ; ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਦਿਆਂ ਸਿੱਧਾ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਨ ਲਈ ਡਿਜ਼ਾਇਨ ਹੈ।

name: CadenceLab: Marathon & Trail
description:
CadenceLab is the running app for half marathons, marathons and trail races. It turns the data already on your Apple Watch and in Apple Health into a clear plan: what to run today, how to fuel during the race, how to pace the hills, and when your shoes are worn out.

TODAY
• A daily training suggestion based on your recent load and recovery, for example "Easy 45 min · Zone 2".
• Recovery from your HRV, resting heart rate and sleep (wear Apple Watch to bed).
• Acute:chronic training load, so you can see when you are building fitness and when you are doing too much.

FUELING PLAN (PRO)
• Plan carbs, fluids and electrolytes for long runs and races.
• Get fueling and hydration reminders on your Apple Watch at the right time, so you never miss a gel or a drink.

GRADE-ADJUSTED RACE PACING (PRO)
• Import the GPX file of any race course.
• CadenceLab adjusts your target pace for every climb and descent, so you run an even effort instead of blowing up on the first hill.

RUNNING FORM & METRONOME
• Track cadence, vertical oscillation and ground contact time.
• Use the built-in metronome to train toward your cadence target.

INSIGHTS
• CadenceLab analyzes the runs in Apple Health from Apple Watch, Garmin, Strava or anything else synced to Health.
• See fitness, fatigue and form trends over time.
• Training load and overtraining alerts (Pro).
• A full coach summary after every run: heart rate drift, pacing, fueling and form (Pro).

SHOES
• Add the shoes you run in. CadenceLab assigns runs automatically (trail runs go to your trail shoes) and tells you when the cushioning is worn out.

APPLE WATCH APP
• Start a run from your wrist and see time, distance, heart rate and pace.
• Fueling and hydration reminders with haptics during your run (Pro).
• Runs are saved to Apple Health.

PRIVACY
Your health data stays on your iPhone and Apple Watch. CadenceLab has no accounts, no ads and no tracking, and never sells or shares your data.

CADENCELAB PRO
CadenceLab is free to download. CadenceLab Pro unlocks fueling reminders, grade-adjusted race pacing, the full coach summary after every run, training load and overtraining alerts, unlimited shoes and all share card styles.
• Yearly: $34.99/year with a 7-day free trial
• Monthly: $7.99/month
• Lifetime: $69.99 one-time purchase
Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.
