CadenceLab is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.

name: Calculus II Course: Sumlark
description:
Calculus II Course: Sumlark is a complete Calculus II course that adapts to you. It follows the standard Calculus II syllabus: techniques of integration, applications of integration, sequences and series, power series and Taylor series, and parametric and polar curves.

ADAPTIVE PRACTICE
Sumlark keeps track of what you know, topic by topic, and notices the kind of mistake you make, for example forgetting to change the limits after a substitution. The next question is chosen from your mistakes, and topics you have mastered come back for review at growing intervals. Prefer the textbook order? Switch to the traditional path at any time.

PRACTICE THAT TEACHES
- More than 350 original problems with a full worked solution for every one, including many variants of each problem type.
- Solutions are never locked behind an ad or a credit.
- Unit checkpoints and a timed mock exam. There are no ads while the clock runs.

SIX 3D STUDIOS AND FOUR WORKBENCH LABS
Every studio starts from a real object and a real question, then shows two independent answers that must agree.
- Wine Glass on the Lathe: how many millilitres does a turned goblet hold? Discs against shells, with a cut-away.
- Suspension Cable: how long is the cable? Straight chords against the arc-length integral, hanging chain against loaded cable.
- Dam Wall Pressure: how large is the force on a dam face? Strips of water pressure against the integral.
- Bouncing Ball and Zeno: how far and how long does an endless bounce travel? Partial sums against the limit.
- Pendulum and Taylor Polynomials: where does each polynomial of sin let go of the true swing?
- Gear Wheel in Polar Form: the area of a toothed wheel and the length of its rim.
Drag to orbit, pinch to zoom. Live formula labels sit over each scene. A calm-motion switch freezes idle animation; Reduce Motion is respected.
- Plus the Taylor Polynomial Lab, Series Convergence Explorer, Solids of Revolution Slicer and Parametric and Polar Tracer.

YOUR LENGTH, YOUR LEVEL
Choose 5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number of questions, and a level from beginner to research-level, or follow the course order. Each studio ends with a predict-then-test card and a quiz at the length and level you chose.

SOURCES YOU CAN OPEN
Every topic and studio cites its references (MIT OpenCourseWare, OpenStax, standard textbooks, video series) with the exact section. Each opens in a reading sheet that shows the licence and what we used, then links to the original site. All lessons, problems and solutions in the app are original. Topics: integration techniques, applications of integration, sequences and series, Taylor series, parametric and polar curves.

FREE TO STUDY, ADS ONLY AT NATURAL BREAKS
The app is free, with short ads after a finished set or on results, never during a timed test and never before an explanation. You can watch an optional video to earn credits for the mock exam. Or subscribe to Calculus II Course Ad-Free Monthly to remove ads.

SUBSCRIPTION
Calculus II Course Ad-Free Monthly: auto-renewing monthly subscription that removes ads. Price is shown by the App Store before you subscribe. New subscribers get a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase after the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for.

Your progress stays on your device. No account is needed.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by MIT, Stanford, Harvard, OpenStax, Khan Academy, edX, Coursera or any author or publisher named for further study.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-calculus-ii-course-sumlark.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Call The Scores
description:
Think you know your sport? Prove it.

Call the Scores is the free sports prediction game for fans who love a bit of banter. Call the scores and results across football, rugby, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL and AFL, climb the rankings and settle the debate with your mates once and for all.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
- Call the Score: predict the exact scoreline. Nail it for maximum points.
- Call the Result: just pick the winner. Quick, simple and perfect for every sport.
- Last Call Standing: a survivor format where one wrong call and you're out. Last one standing wins.

EVERY LEAGUE, ONE APP
Football across 12 leagues including the Premier League, Championship, La Liga, Bundesliga, Serie A and Ligue 1, plus tournaments such as the Champions League, Europa League and Nations League. Rugby including the Gallagher Premiership, Top 14 and the Six Nations. And the big American leagues too: NFL, NBA, MLB and NHL, plus AFL.

PLAY WITH YOUR MATES
Create a private league in seconds and share the link straight into your group chat. Track who's top of the table every week and enjoy the bragging rights.

THE SHOW
Build your own home for sport. Choose the competitions you care about, switch between sports and keep everything in one place.

XP, BADGES AND STREAKS
Earn XP for every call, keep your day streak going and unlock over 100 badges as you go.

SEE HOW YOU COMPARE
Crowd prediction stats show how everyone else is calling each fixture, from call splits to the most popular scoreline, so you can back yourself or go against the crowd.

MATCH CENTRE
Head-to-heads, recent form, line-ups, match events and full-time results, all alongside your predictions.

MADE YOURS
Pick your favourite club and the app takes on your team's colours.

Call the Scores is a free-to-play prediction game. There is no gambling, no betting and no odds - just sport, skill and bragging rights.

We're sports fans who built something to bring mates and a community together across all sports. Download Call the Scores, make your first call and see if you've got what it takes.

name: Calm Flight: Fear of Flying
description:
Feel calmer before and during your flight.

Enter your route and see a turbulence outlook in plain words, built from public aviation weather reports. On board, follow a phase-by-phase guide that explains each sound and feeling, from taxi to landing, with audio that works in airplane mode.

WHAT YOU GET
• Turbulence outlook for your route, with its data source and limits
• Flight phase guide with offline audio
• Calm me now: guided breathing and a 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise
• G-meter that shows how small most bumps really are
• Short daily lessons on how planes fly and why your body reacts
• English and Arabic

GOOD TO KNOW
Calm Flight is a self-help tool, not medical treatment. Forecasts can be incomplete; always follow your crew. If your fear is severe, talk to a health professional.

SUBSCRIPTION
Calm Flight Pro is a subscription: weekly with a free trial, or yearly. A 72-hour Flight Pass is a one-time purchase and does not renew. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings.

name: Calor-Seurannan
description:
Calor — Seurannan. Muoto, joka jää kun lämpö lähtee.

Kuppi nostetaan pöydältä ja kostea pyöreä jälki jää. Valurautapannu otetaan liedeltä ja reuna hehkuu vielä hetken oranssina. Käsi painetaan kylmään ikkunaan ja huurun ääriviiva vetäytyy hitaasti takaisin. Lämpö lähtee aina ensin, jälki jää jälkeen. Calor tekee tästä hetkestä näkyvän, säilytettävän ja uudelleen katsottavan.

【Lämpölinssi】
· Suuntaa kamera pinnalle — oikean reunan asteikko liukuu lämpöeron mukaan
· Syötä lämpötarran lukema, kirjoita lämpötila käsin tai luota pelkkään silmään
· Hienosäädä lämpötilaa kuvauksen jälkeen, kuva seuraa mukana

【Tunnelman uudelleen sytytys】
Neljä sävyä, valitse yksi tai anna huoneen päättää:
· Lämpökehä — jäännöslämpö leviää reunalle kuin juuri liedeltä nostettuna
· Kylmävuoto — kylmän kondensaatio piirtyy ohueksi harsoksi
· Lämpökukka — venyttää lämmön suunnan ja näyttää sen kulkeman reitin
· Korventuma — korostaa paahtunutta reunaa kuin leivinpaperissa

【Ympäristön sovitus】
Lukee sijainnin lämpötilan ja vuodenajan ja valitsee sopivimman tunnelman; voit myös lukita sen käsin, jotta kuva pysyy sellaisena kuin sen muistat.

【Muistiinpanot】
Jokainen jälki voi kantaa tuntoa ja lämpötilaa: kuiva lämpö, kostea viileys, karhea metalli. Arkisto säilytetään salattuna laitteessasi.

【Nimetön sirpalevirta】
Selaa tuntemattomia lämpöjälkiä, jättäen jäljelle vain yhden lämmön ja yhden kuiskauksen.

【Diffuusio ja aikajana】
Anna jäljen levitä ja jäähtyä laboratoriossa ja jätä siitä aikajana. Katso, miten lämpö poistuu.

【Kalibrointi】
Säädä uunin teho, höyryn tiheys, rakeisuus ja ajautumisnopeus omaan tuntuusi sopivaksi.

name: CalQuarry
description:
Inspect ICS events and recurrence definitions, then preview split and merge operations before exporting separate calendar files.

1. Import a UTF-8 ICS file and inspect its event and issue summary.
2. Browse event properties and supported recurrence previews.
3. Filter source events into a split working copy.
4. Merge documents with an explicit duplicate-UID policy.
5. Choose whether missing UID/timestamp fields may be repaired, then export ICS or PDF.

Supports a documented RFC 5545 subset, not every recurrence extension. Files are limited to 5 MiB and 10,000 events; recurrence previews to 2,000 occurrences or five years. It does not access the system calendar or send invitations.

name: CamerMeet - Cameroonian
description:
CamerMeet is the dating app for Cameroonian women and men – at home and in the diaspora (France, Canada, USA, Germany, Belgium, UK…).

NO FAKE PROFILES
• Every profile is verified: 2 recent photos (portrait and full body) are checked before anyone can see them – a real person, alone in the picture, no internet pictures or screenshots.
• You can change your photos once a month; they are checked again.
• Report with one tap. Suspicious messages (money requests, contact details) are detected automatically.

SUGGESTIONS THAT FIT YOU
• Compatibility by country and city of residence, region of origin (Cameroon’s 10 regions), age and interests.
• View on marriage: monogamy, polygamy or no preference – we only suggest compatible people.
• “Discover”: a clear list, most compatible first.

LIKE, MATCH, CHAT… AND VIDEO CALL
• Like each other and it’s a match. Get notified as soon as a new message arrives.
• Private Club: one 60-second video call per match to get to know each other before the first date – nothing is recorded.

PRIVACY
• No real name, no phone number, no GPS tracking. Your email is only used to log in.
• Your photos are visible to subscribers only.

name: CandyCue : Little joys
description:
Pick up little joys. Keep little clues.

The train you took, the food you loved, the view you found. Snap a photo, add a line, and that's a candy. Later, when you sort your photos, it brings the whole day back.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add a candy: pick a photo or take one. The time comes from the photo.
• A day can have lots of candies, lined up from morning to night.
• No photo? No problem. A note alone is a candy too.
• Put in Pocket: turn your day into one collage, scattered like photos on a table. Save it to Photos or Files, or share it.

CANDIES MELT
CandyCue keeps little clues, not a forever archive. Each candy lasts 30 days from its date, then melts away. Want to keep a day? Put it in your pocket. Pocket photos never melt.

OUR LITTLE PROMISE
CandyCue isn't one more thing to do. No daily check-ins, no captions for every photo, no need to make life picture-perfect. Living comes first. Having fun is the real job!

PRIVACY
No accounts. No ads. No tracking. Your photos and notes never leave your iPhone.

CANDYCUE SWEET PLUS
Not more features. Just more time.
• Candies made while subscribed last 90 days. That's 60 extra days to look back.
• If you stop, your candies keep their original melt date.
• Monthly and yearly plans. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://pick-a-number-app.web.app/CandyCue#terms
Privacy Policy: https://pick-a-number-app.web.app/CandyCue#privacy

Happy candy picking!

name: Card Brief
description:
Met someone worth following up with? Photograph their business card and Card Brief does the rest.

SCAN THE CARD
Take a photo of the front and back, or upload one. Card Brief reads the name, role, company, email, phone, website and address, and saves the contact. Only uncertain fields ask for a quick check.

KNOW THE COMPANY
Card Brief reads the company's own public website and writes a short brief: what they sell, who they serve, and facts with links to the page they came from. Website claims are labeled as the company's own, and anything inferred is marked as a suggestion, not a fact.

FIND THE OPPORTUNITY
Tell Card Brief about your business, or your own networking goals, and each contact gets a fit score, possible needs and ways to work together, based on what you offer. Use it for your own company, the company you work for, or personal networking.

SEND THE FOLLOW-UP
Card Brief drafts a follow-up email that mentions what you actually talked about. Open it in Gmail, Outlook or your default email app, edit it, and send it yourself. Card Brief never sends email for you. Pick several contacts to follow up in one go, one email at a time.

STAY ORGANIZED
• Dashboard of who is worth a call this week
• Search and filter by status, fit and event
• Follow-up dates you can add to your calendar
• Notes, tags and event labels
• Record a voice note about the conversation instead of typing
• Open a contact on LinkedIn
• Export everything, including card photos

SHARE YOUR OWN CARD
Publish My Card when you choose to, then share a link or QR so someone can open your card, save it to their phone, or save it into their Card Brief Contacts. Drafts stay private until you publish. Your scanned contacts stay private to you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Scanned contacts, notes and card photos are visible only to you. My Card is public only after you explicitly publish it. Nothing is sent for AI processing until you allow it, and you can turn AI off at any time. Voice notes are transcribed and the audio is not kept. Delete single cards, all your data, or your whole account from Settings. No ads.

FREE TO TRY
Your first 3 card scans are free. After that, Card Brief Pro (monthly or yearly subscription) lets you keep scanning new cards. Viewing, editing, exporting and deleting your contacts always stay free. One subscription works on the web and in the app with the same account.

Terms: https://cardbriefapp.com/terms
Privacy: https://cardbriefapp.com/privacy
Support: support@cardbriefapp.com

name: Carpet Twist
description:
Twist, drop and weave! Carpet Twist is a cozy puzzle game where every move turns a 2×2 block of wool tiles. Rotate the blocks, let the tiles fall and match the carpet's pattern in as few moves as you can.

FOLLOW THE CARPET ROAD
• 2,500 levels on a winding road through 16 regions of Türkiye
• Every few levels a new carpet joins your collection
• Easy to learn: Tiftik the little goat shows you the ropes

CLEVER OBJECTS ON THE LOOM
• 13 objects keep every level surprising: chests, portals, pedals, tassels and more
• Tiftik explains each new object the moment you meet it

POWER-UPS FOR TRICKY LEVELS
• Crochet Hook, Yarn Ball, Beater, Pattern Card and Brush
• A free hint on every attempt

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Daily Puzzle: a fresh puzzle every day
• Rush: race the clock and beat your best score
• Gallery: collect 125 carpets, each with the story of its motif
• Friends: add friends with a code and send each other lives

YOUR PROGRESS, SAFE
• Sign in with Apple or Google to keep your progress on a new phone
• Available in 10 languages

Carpet Twist is free to play. It offers optional in-app purchases (gold, bundles and Remove Ads) and shows ads, including optional reward videos.

name: CarPoolIsCool
description:
CarPoolIsCool makes coordinating rides simple for any group activity — hockey, swimming, tennis, robotics, dance, scouts, classes, and more.

Create a board for your activity, share its unique link with your group, and everyone sees the same live board. No accounts needed for families, no endless group texts, no spreadsheets.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a board — pick your activity and group name, and you get a unique link.
2. Share the link — families open it in any browser, nothing to install.
3. Drivers claim a trip — post the date, direction, and how many seats you have.
4. Riders claim a seat — type a name and the seat is reserved, with a live count of spots taken and left.

FEATURES
- Unlimited boards for different activities and groups
- Every board has its own unique, shareable webpage
- Trips to and from the activity, with dates on every trip
- "Both ways" driving? One post creates both trips, each with its own riders
- Live seat tallies — everyone sees the same numbers in real time
- Location notes on every trip so nobody guesses the pickup spot
- Start-a-new-day reset clears the board in one tap

Built by a parent, out of a real robotics carpool group chat that needed rescuing.

Questions or feedback: busbizplex@gmail.com

name: CarTally: Car Maintenance Log
description:
Never miss an oil change again. CarTally is a simple car maintenance log that tells you what is due next, by date or by mileage, whichever comes first. Log service and fill-ups in seconds, see your real MPG and what your car really costs. No ads, no account, and your records never disappear.

MAINTENANCE REMINDERS THAT WORK
• Oil change, tire rotation, brakes, filters, inspection and any service you add
• Every few months or every few thousand miles, whichever comes first
• CarTally learns how much you drive and estimates the due date
• Notifications on the due date and one week before
• Mark a reminder done in two taps and the countdown restarts

A SERVICE HISTORY YOU CAN TRUST
• Log what was done, odometer, cost, shop and notes
• Several services in one visit
• Make, model and year are free text, so any car, truck or motorcycle works, including new models
• Search your history and see totals per year

GAS MILEAGE TRACKER
• Log fill-ups with amount and total cost; price per gallon is calculated for you
• Accurate MPG with the full-tank method, including partial fills
• Forgot a fill-up? Add it later, or mark a missed one, and your average stays right
• Miles or kilometers, US or UK gallons or liters, MPG, L/100 km or km/L

KNOW WHAT YOUR CAR COSTS
• Fuel and maintenance spending this year, last year and all time
• Cost per mile and distance driven
• Monthly cost chart (Pro)

SELLING YOUR CAR?
• Export a clean PDF service history to show buyers (Pro)
• Export service and fuel logs to CSV (Pro)

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account and no sign-in. Everything is stored on your iPhone
• Back up to a file and restore it on a new phone anytime
• Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Japanese, Korean and Vietnamese

FREE OR PRO
Free: one vehicle, unlimited service records and fill-ups, reminders, fuel economy, cost totals and backup.
CarTally Pro adds unlimited vehicles, PDF service history and CSV export, cost charts and color themes.
Pro is $19.99/year with a 7-day free trial, or $39.99 once for lifetime access. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

We ask for a rating at most once, and only after you have used the app for a while.

Privacy Policy: https://conhan.github.io/tnp-apps-legal/cartally/privacy.html

name: Casena: Warranty Tracker
description:
Casena keeps your receipts and warranty dates together with a list of what you own, all on your iPhone.

Scan a receipt and your iPhone’s text recognition reads the store, the date and the price. You add the name of the item and Casena counts down to the end of the warranty. Before it ends, you get a reminder.

Receipts and warranty dates
• Scan a receipt with the camera or enter an item by hand
• Text recognition runs on the device; no receipt is uploaded to be read
• You set the warranty period for each item; two years is the default
• Reminders 30, 14, 7 days or 1 day before a warranty ends, depending on which ones you turn on
• A Home Screen widget shows the warranties that end soonest

Home inventory
• Items sorted by room, with photos of the item and its receipt
• Serial number from the barcode or from a photo of the label
• Search by name or brand, filter by category and warranty status
• The number of items and their total value on the first screen

Insurance report (Casena Pro)
Casena Pro turns the inventory into a PDF sorted by room, with photos, purchase dates, prices and serial numbers. This is the kind of list an insurer asks for after a burglary or a fire. Casena Pro also includes a CSV export for Excel or Numbers.

What it costs
Adding items is free and unlimited, including scanning, reminders, rooms and photos. Casena Pro is a one-time purchase. It adds the insurance report and the CSV export, and it can be shared through Family Sharing. There is no subscription. The app shows the price for your country before you buy.

Your data
Your data is stored on your iPhone and, if you use iCloud, in your private iCloud. Casena has no accounts and no server of its own. There are no ads and there is no tracking. You can lock the app with Face ID.

Germany only
In Germany, Casena also has a rights check and sample letters based on German consumer law. They appear only when the iPhone’s region is set to Germany. The in-app purchases “Case unlock” and “Thank-you” are part of that module and are not offered anywhere else.

Questions and bug reports: ronny@rapidspark.de

name: Cavale – Carnet de partie
description:
Cavale est ton carnet de partie pour le grand jeu de 2026 en Floride : tous les codes de triche avec leurs combinaisons, un testeur pour les taper sans erreur, tes missions à cocher, ton pourcentage de sauvegarde, la carte des 6 régions avec tes prochaines missions, 302 véhicules et 61 armes.

– Codes : les combinaisons publiées, ce qu'il faut faire pour les débloquer, et une mise à jour automatique dès qu'un nouveau code est confirmé.
– Ma partie : recopie ton pourcentage, coche ta dernière mission, et l'app te montre ton chapitre et la suite.
– Carte : les régions de l'État, et où commencent tes prochaines missions.
– Garage et armes : la liste complète, avec les codes qui les font apparaître.

Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée.

Cavale est une application indépendante et non officielle, ni produite, ni approuvée, ni soutenue par Rockstar Games ou Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto et Grand Theft Auto VI sont des marques de Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc.

name: Chalkak - Snap Camera
description:
Chalkak is a snap camera that makes photos look good the moment you take them.

- Shoot with a look
Pick a look such as Film, Pastel or Cream and press the shutter. Looks are grouped by Portrait, Insta, Street, Landscape, Food and Retro.

- Scene guides and camera lessons
Choose a scene like portrait, food or still life and the camera shows a framing guide with a short tip. Short lessons cover level horizons, the rule of thirds, backlight and more.

- Soft skin mode
Brighter, smoother skin, mild or strong.

- Pro mode
Program, shutter priority, ISO and manual. Set shutter speed, ISO, exposure and focal length (16-200mm) yourself.

- Four-cut, timer and date stamp
Shoot a four-photo strip, use a 3 or 10 second timer, add a film-style date stamp, and choose 1:1, 3:4 or 9:16.

- Library and editing
Keep your shots and photos imported from Photos in one place, edit them and save back to Photos.

- Make a post
Pick several photos, set their order, ratio (4:5, 1:1, 1.91:1, 3:4) and border, add a caption, and share to Instagram, Threads or X.

No account, no ads. Your photos never leave your phone.

name: Chap Plus Rider
description:
Chap Plus Rider helps delivery riders manage assigned orders, navigate between pickup and delivery locations, and complete deliveries efficiently.

Sign in to view available delivery requests, accept new orders and follow each order through the complete fulfillment process. Track pickup and customer locations, review order details and update delivery status directly from the app.

Key features:
• View nearby and available delivery orders
• Accept or manage assigned deliveries
• Track pickup and delivery locations
• Navigate routes with integrated maps
• View package, customer and order details
• Update order and delivery status
• Request payouts and review payout history
• Track earnings and delivery activity
• Receive notifications for new order updates
• Maintain rider profile and vehicle information

Chap Plus Rider is designed to make local delivery work organized and convenient, with clear order information and real-time status management.

name: Chat to PDF & Export
description:
Turn your chats into clean, professional PDFs – right on your iPhone.

Save, print and share text messages from any chat app. Perfect for keeping records, sharing proof with a lawyer, or saving conversations you never want to lose.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add your chat – [yahan likhein: screenshots import karein ya chat export file kholein]
2. Review your messages – names, dates and times in order
3. Export to PDF and save, print or share

FEATURES
• Chat to PDF – clean chat bubbles with names, dates and times
• Print text messages directly from your iPhone
• Works with SMS and chats from popular messaging apps
• Save conversations to Files, email or cloud storage
• No computer, no cables needed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your messages are processed on your iPhone
• Nothing is uploaded to our servers
• No account needed

GREAT FOR
• Legal and court records
• Business and client communication
• Insurance, rental and landlord disputes
• Keeping memories of special conversations

PREMIUM
Unlimited exports, long chats and all PDF styles.

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase.

name: Chegaí Mobilidade
description:
O Chegaí Mobilidade conecta passageiros e motoristas de Corumbá e Ladário.

PARA QUEM PEDE
• Peça corrida de carro (Corrida ou Premium) ou de moto.
• Você escolhe quanto quer pagar. Os motoristas veem o seu pedido e fazem ofertas, e você escolhe quem aceitar.
• Veja o motorista, o carro, a placa e a nota antes de embarcar, e acompanhe o trajeto no mapa em tempo real.
• Converse com o motorista pelo app, sem mostrar o seu telefone.
• Entregas: peça um entregador para levar um pacote de um ponto a outro.
• Compartilhe a viagem com a família e use o botão SOS em caso de emergência.

PARA QUEM DIRIGE
• Cadastre-se como motorista, escolha os pedidos perto de você e proponha o seu valor.
• Acompanhe seus ganhos, o seu nível e as avaliações dos passageiros.
• Aceite também entregas de pacotes.

SEGURANÇA E TRANSPARÊNCIA
• Motoristas com cadastro e documentos conferidos.
• Denunciar e bloquear usuários, regras claras e canal para contestar punições.
• Pagamento da corrida combinado diretamente entre passageiro e motorista, em dinheiro ou Pix.

Disponível em Corumbá e Ladário (MS).

name: Chessproved
description:
Chessproved turns a few minutes a day into sharper chess tactics.

Each day brings a short session built around one focus theme. It opens with a warm-up, mixes in other themes and returns to the focus near the end. Difficulty follows your training rating, so puzzles stay hard but solvable.

DAILY SESSION
• 5, 8 or 12 puzzles: about 5, 10 or 15 minutes
• Hints that point the way without giving the answer away
• A short explanation after every puzzle: the fork, the check, the material won
• A streak that counts finished sessions

PUZZLE BLITZ
• 5 minutes, puzzles from easy to hard, no hints
• Three mistakes end the run
• Beat your record as the puzzle ratings climb

LEARN FROM MISTAKES
• Missed puzzles come back after 1, 3, 7 and 14 days
• Save any puzzle and replay it later

PRACTICE BY THEME
12 themes: mate in 1, mate in 2, back-rank mate, hanging piece, fork, pin, skewer, discovered attack, removing the defender, deflection, attraction and defensive moves.

PROGRESS AND AWARDS
• Training rating, accuracy by theme and weekly trend
• 134 award levels for habits, milestones and skill

MAKE IT YOURS
• Eight board themes and three piece sets, light and dark
• VoiceOver and large text support
• Progress syncs through your own iCloud account. No sign-up, no ads, no data collected.

FREE AND PRO
Free: the full daily session, streaks, saved puzzles, basic statistics, Mate in 1 practice (10 puzzles a day), 5 mixed practice and 3 review puzzles a day, and one Puzzle Blitz run a day.
Chessproved Pro unlocks all 12 themes, unlimited practice, review and Puzzle Blitz, and all statistics. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription (new subscribers get a free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Puzzles come from the Lichess puzzle database (CC0), and every one is checked move by move.

Privacy Policy: https://hkayalar.github.io/chessproved/privacy.html

name: Chinese Idioms 成语一百
description:
Learn Chinese idioms (chengyu) the fun way — one picture at a time.

Chinese Idioms (成语一百) brings together 100 common idioms, each drawn as a funny comic: 50 everyday idioms with A-Hua and 50 with HANZUMIO's guardian beasts.

• Swipe through picture cards with characters, pinyin and word-by-word English
• Tap Learn more for the meaning and two example sentences, with pinyin over every character and a translation in your language
• Listen to every idiom and example sentence
• Use the app in 15 languages: English, 한국어, 日本語, ไทย, Tiếng Việt, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu, Filipino, Русский, Français, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Português, العربية
• Idiom Challenge: guess from the picture, pick the meaning, tap the characters in order, fill the gap — with lives, timer and combos
• Mood diary: pick the idiom that matches your day, add a photo and a sentence
• Create: put idiom stickers on your own photos, or copy the pose and make a side-by-side picture to share

No account, no ads. Your photos and diary stay on your phone.

name: Chirpy: Tower Tactics
description:
Plan a woodland defense in Chirpy, a portrait tower-defense game with short battles and a company of animal guardians to grow between adventures.

Explore thirty campaign trails across five illustrated regions. Read the roads and build clearings before a battle, choose your company, place guardians, and send the next wave. Upgrade a defender, select a branch, move to a better position or sell it to rethink the lane. Spells and the Bloom ability give you another way to respond when a trail gets busy.

Six guardians bring different attacks and roles. Earn progress through play, develop individual talents, and spend in-game seeds on camp blessings. Try different squad presets and inspect upcoming waves to prepare a new approach.

Return for the Daily trail or explore modes including Rush, Endless, Firefly swarm, Crown gauntlet and Four paws. Save an unfinished battle and continue it later. Battle history records the result and each guardian's contribution.

At Camp, make a keepsake card with a guardian, a photo and an optional cheer of up to eight seconds. Save it locally, export a card or share it when you choose. Camera, microphone and add-only Photos access are requested for those optional actions. Game progress and keepsakes are stored on your iPhone, and the battles work offline.

name: Chordstand: Chords & Setlists
description:
Photograph a chord sheet, open a PDF or paste text — Chordstand turns it into a clean chart with every chord above its syllable. Play it in any key, build tonight's setlist and read it on stage, on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

READ ANY SHEET
• Scan a page with the camera, pick a photo, open a PDF, text or ChordPro file, or paste chords written above the words
• Everything is read on your device; you check the chart before it is saved
• Write your own songs: type the words, tap a word, pick the chord
• Correct charts in a ChordPro editor with a live preview and a one-tap chord bar

EVERY KEY, SPELLED RIGHT
• Transpose in half steps or pick the key you want; sharps and flats follow the new key
• Capo positions, with the easiest one suggested
• Chord names the way you read them: C D E F G A B, German H, Do Re Mi, or Nashville numbers

SETLISTS FOR EVERY NIGHT
• Drag songs into order and give each song its own key for the night
• Total length, venue, date and notes
• Play the whole set on stage, song after song

SHEET MUSIC TOO
• Keep PDF scores exactly as printed, mixed into the same setlists
• Turn pages by tap, pedal or MIDI; two pages side by side on a wide screen

PRACTICE TOOLS
• Tuner and reference pitch (adjustable A), and a keyboard to play any note
• Backing tracks follow the key you play in, slow down for practice and loop any part

CHORD SHAPES AND TEMPO
• Diagrams of every chord in the song for guitar, ukulele and piano, in the key you play
• Tempo with a tap, a click track with an accented downbeat, and a one-bar count-in

ON STAGE
• Big, clear charts that fit the screen; two columns on wide screens
• Your own notes for the stage above the chart, and the next song at the end of each chart
• Backing tracks: attach your own recording to a song and start it from the stage
• MIDI pedals and controllers turn pages and choose songs; Bluetooth MIDI pairing built in
• A lyrics screen without chords for a singer's monitor or a projector (AirPlay, a cable, or a second window on Mac)
• Page turns by tap or with a Bluetooth page-turner pedal (arrow and page keys)
• Scrolling at the song's pace, and a silent beat light at the song's tempo
• Singer mode: words only, one tap; chord diagrams above the chart if you want them
• Bright or dark stage, whatever the system is set to
• iPhone Duo: the unfolded screen becomes a two-page music stand; the folded cover keeps the full chart

MORE
• Key, tempo and length suggested from a recording of your own (on systems that offer Apple's on-device music analysis)
• Siri and Shortcuts: open a song, play a setlist, go to the next song
• Export any song as ChordPro or PDF, and print a whole setlist as one songbook PDF

name: ChoriNova 調理師試験 一問一答・模擬試験
description:
ChoriNova（チョウリノバ）は、調理師試験の対策アプリです。公衆衛生学・食品学・栄養学・食品衛生学・調理理論・食文化概論の 6 科目を、テキスト・一問一答・本番形式の模擬試験で一つのアプリで。弱点の分析と合格予測が、次に何をやるかを決めてくれます。法令・基準は 2026 年 11 月 1 日時点の内容です。

■ 今日の学習（弱点の分析と合格予測）
一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。合格予測は本番の配点（公衆衛生学 9・食品学 6・栄養学 9・食品衛生学 15・調理理論 18・食文化概論 3）で出し、合計 6 割に届いているか、極端に低い科目がないかを知らせます。

■ テキスト（30 本）
全 30 単元に、要点・表（食中毒の原因菌と潜伏期間、大量調理施設衛生管理マニュアルの数字、ビタミンと欠乏症、野菜の色素の変化、行事食と郷土料理など）・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。読んだらそのまま単元の問題へ進めます。

■ 一問一答（423 問）
・公衆衛生学: 衛生行政、生活習慣病、感染症、環境衛生、母子・学校・産業・高齢者の保健、調理師法
・食品学: 食品の成分、植物性食品、動物性食品と油脂、加工と貯蔵、食品表示（アレルゲン 9 品目）
・栄養学: 栄養素、ビタミンと無機質、消化と吸収、食事摂取基準（2025 年版）、ライフステージと病気の栄養
・食品衛生学: 食品衛生法、細菌・ウイルスの食中毒、自然毒・寄生虫、食品添加物、変質と保存、HACCP と衛生管理
・調理理論: 非加熱操作と計量、加熱調理と機器、植物性・動物性食品の調理、調味とおいしさ、大量調理と新調理システム
・食文化概論: 世界の食文化、日本の食文化・行事食・郷土料理
本番と同じ 4 択と、要点を確かめる ○× で。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・10 回分、各 60 問）
本番と同じ科目の順と問題数で、4 択 60 問・120 分。自動で採点して科目ごとの点を示し、全問の正解と解説で見直せます。
問題冊子・答案用紙（マークシート）・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。

■ 通知
毎日のリマインダー（時刻を選べます）は、その日の復習の数と弱点の単元を本文にします。本番の日を入れると、ホームに残り日数が出て、1 週間前・3 日前・前日・当日にも知らせます。

■ 記録
合格予測、弱点の単元、科目ごとの正答率、模擬試験の点の推移、日ごとの学習量を残します。

■ 料金
無料: 各科目の最初の 20 問と最初の単元のテキスト、模擬試験の第1回（印刷・紙の採点を含む）。弱点の分析・合格予測・通知は無料で使えます。
すべての問題（買い切り ¥980、1 回払い）: すべての一問一答・テキスト・模擬試験。今後の版で増える問題も追加料金なしで使えます。
・サブスクリプションではありません。自動更新はなく、お支払いは 1 回だけです。
・機種を変えたときは、同じ Apple ID で「購入を復元」を押すと引き継げます。

■ 安心してお使いいただくために
通信は一切しません。アカウントも広告もありません。記録はこの iPhone の中だけに残り、通知もこの iPhone の中で組みます。

■ 問題について
問題と解説はすべて当社の書き下ろしで、実際の試験の過去問ではありません。2026 年 11 月 1 日時点の調理師法・食品衛生法・食品表示基準・日本人の食事摂取基準（2025 年版）・大量調理施設衛生管理マニュアルなどにもとづいています（2024 年 4 月の食品衛生基準行政の消費者庁への移管、2026 年 4 月のアレルゲン表示へのカシューナッツの追加などを含みます）。改正があれば更新します。統計の数値は年ごとに変わるため扱っていません。
本番の合格基準は都道府県ごとに定められ、合計 6 割前後に加えて、平均点を大きく下回る科目があると不合格になる場合があります。アプリの合格予測は目安です。誤りに気づかれた場合は、サポートページからお知らせください。

調理師試験は都道府県知事が行う試験で、多くの都道府県では公益社団法人調理技術技能センターが試験事務を行っています。本アプリはこれらの公式アプリではなく、承認や推奨を受けたものではありません。

description:
রাজা · মন্ত্রী · চোর · পুলিশ — the chit game every Bangladeshi adda grew up with, now beautifully made for your phone.

Fold the chits, shuffle and pick one. Peek at your secret role. The Raja calls out "আমার পুলিশ কে?" — "Who's my Police?" The Police has to catch the Chor among the suspects… guess wrong and the Chor walks away with the Police's points!

name: CHRISPSDesign

CHRISPS is the client app for CHRISPS Design, a design and development studio in Cambridge, Ontario. See every service with its price up front, get a quote in a minute, and follow your project from the first call to launch.

See what Ontario agencies publish for the same jobs, from landing pages and websites to branding, SEO and care plans, next to our prices. Every source is listed.

name: Christmas Toy Match
description:
Welcome to the coziest toy shop in town! 

Christmas Toy Match is a relaxing 3D matching puzzle full of festive toys. Tap three of a kind to clear them from the pile, finish every goal before time runs out, and earn tickets to decorate your own Christmas toy shop.

Teddy bears, toy trains, nutcrackers, rocking horses, Santa, snowmen, gifts, candy canes and many more charming 3D toys tumble onto the board. Spot three of the same toy and tap them to clear the set!

Each level has goals to collect. Plan your taps, keep the tray tidy and clear the board before the timer ends.

Stuck? Use Magnet to pull matches in, Undo to take a move back, Shuffle to mix up the pile, and Freeze to stop the clock.

Every win earns display tickets. Use them to place the toys you discover in the Front Window, the Doll Corner and the Train Table, and open new shop corners as you go.

Daily rewards, free gifts, star chests, level chests and Snow Globe quests keep the presents coming.

• Hundreds of festive levels, from easy to tricky
• Beautiful, colorful 3D toys and a warm Christmas atmosphere
• Simple one-tap controls, great for a quick break
• Relaxing music and satisfying sounds
• Play offline, anytime

Grab a cup of cocoa, settle in and start matching. Merry Christmas!

name: CleanAI: Remove AI Photo Tags
description:
Edited your own photo and got an "AI" label anyway? Many editing apps quietly write AI tags, Content Credentials and edit history into your files, even after a small retouch or a background fix. CleanAI shows you exactly what is hidden inside your photos and videos and wipes it in one tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. No uploads, no account, no tracking. Your originals are never changed.

CleanAI removes data stored inside your files. It doesn't change how your photo looks, and it can't control labels that a platform applies based on its own analysis of the image. Please follow the rules of the platforms you post on.

description:
Click Business Cards turns paper business cards into tidy contacts you can find again.

Point the camera at a card. The app finds the edges, straightens the picture and reads the text. You check the details on a review form before anything is saved. You can scan several cards in a row, and add the back of a card.

READ ON YOUR IPHONE
The text on a card is read on your iPhone with Apple's on-device technology. The card text and image are not sent to any AI service to be read.

KEEP AND FIND
- Name, job title, company, several phone numbers and email addresses, websites, address, tags and notes for every card.
- Add as many tags as you like to a card.

- Find duplicate cards and merge them, or keep the one you choose.

- The price of each plan is shown in the app before you buy, in your local currency.

name: Coffeeine Time
description:
How much of your afternoon coffee might still be with you at bedtime?

Coffeeine Time lets you log coffee, tea, cola, energy drinks and chocolate, then see how your estimated caffeine level changes throughout the day.

• Log what you had. Pick a preset, drag the cup to adjust your serving, or enter the caffeine amount in milligrams. Set when you had it and save your usual servings as favourites.

description:
Unwind with four calm, colorful block puzzles in one cozy little lab. There are no timers and no rush: take each puzzle at your own pace and enjoy that satisfying moment when everything slots into place.

BLENDLINGS
Swipe jelly blobs to the door of their color. Bump red into yellow and you get orange. Push two of the same color together and they merge into a bigger blob.

TIPSY BLOCKS
Tilt the tray and every block slides at once. Line them up so each one pops out through its own door.

LOAD UP
Tap a crate and it drives off along its arrow. Matching crates load right into the truck, and the rest wait in the bay until their truck pulls in.

SHELLIES
Glide each Shellie into the door that matches its outer shell. Pop! It bounces back wearing the color underneath. Peel every layer to send it home.

MADE FOR RELAXING
• No timers: think as long as you like
• 100 levels in each game that gently get harder, with new pieces as you go and more on the way
• Gentle guided first levels, and a free hint every day
• Satisfying little rewards: combos, a gift every few wins and a daily streak
• Color symbols for colorblind players

No account needed. Coins are earned by playing and can also be bought. No Ads removes the ads between levels and on the level-complete screen.

name: Completr: 100% Tracker
description:
Stop squinting at the pause menu. Show Completr your progress screen and it tells you exactly what's left for 100%, and what to do in the time you've got.

SCAN, DON'T TYPE
• Import screenshots shared from your console app, or snap a photo of the TV
• On-device text recognition reads every "87 / 100" counter and matches it to the right checklist row
• You review every match before anything is saved

THE FULL 100% CHECKLIST
• All 35 completion requirements across Story & Robberies, Collectibles, Activities and Discovery
• Progress bars, what's still to go, and which rows can be skipped
• Tap any row to adjust it by hand or change its target

PLAN YOUR NEXT SESSION
• Pick 15, 30 or 60 minutes
• Completr ranks the unfinished rows that move you furthest, and favours ones you can close completely
• Every pick comes with an original, spoiler-free tip

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Screenshots are processed on your iPhone and never uploaded

FREE VS PRO
Free: the full checklist, manual tracking, 3 scans and your top session pick.
Completr Pro (one-time purchase, no subscription): unlimited scans and the full session planner.

Completr is an independent, unofficial companion tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All trademarks belong to their respective owners. Checklist targets come from community research and can be edited.

name: Computer Science A AP: Bytelet
description:
Bytelet is an independent study app for the AP Computer Science A exam. Every question is about real Java, and every answer to a code question was checked by actually running the code.

HOW IT WORKS
Miss a question and it lands on your stack. Pop the stack to drill that topic again with a fresh question. Nothing slips through, and a frame that keeps defeating you sinks to the bottom so you are never trapped.

WHAT YOU GET
- All 4 units and 53 topics of the course: using objects and methods, selection and iteration, class creation, data collections.
- 179 multiple-choice questions, each with a full written solution and a reason for every wrong choice.
- 8 original free-response questions in the four exam styles (methods and control structures, class design, ArrayList, 2D array) with point-by-point rubrics, model answers and a self-scoring checklist.
- Trace stepper: watch real programs run line by line with the true variable values.
- Number lab and String lab: integer division, remainder, overflow, substring, indexOf and compareTo, Java style.
- Quick check (12 questions) and a full mock: 42 questions in 90 minutes, then 4 free-response questions in 90 minutes, with a rough 1 to 5 estimate.
- Text size controls (A- and A+), works offline, no account.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL AD-FREE
The app is free and shows ads. Watch an optional video to earn credits for extra practice. A monthly ad-free subscription removes the ads and nothing else: $3.99 per month with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Cancel anytime; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-bytelet.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-bytelet.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-bytelet.html

AP is a trademark registered by the College Board, which is not affiliated with and does not endorse this app.

name: Conspectit
description:
Conspectit turns recordings of meetings, lectures, and interviews into transcripts and concise summaries. After a meeting, find the phrase you need in the transcript, summarize the key points, and share them with colleagues. After a lecture, jump back to the right moment and save a summary to review later.

• RECORD AND TRANSCRIBE
Record audio on your iPhone or import an existing audio or video file. Transcription starts automatically when you finish recording. On-device transcription is free and runs directly on your device.

• SUMMARIES AND UPDATES
Create a concise summary from a transcript or draft a short update for your team chat. When speed matters, use high-accuracy cloud transcription.

• FOLDERS AND SEARCH
Organize your recordings with folders and tags. Search by recording title or transcript text. With iCloud sync enabled, your library is available across all your devices.

• EXPORT
Save transcripts as TXT or PDF, with optional timestamps. Export summaries as PDF or editable DOCX files. You can also share the original recording as a separate audio file.

• FREE AND PRO
Recording and on-device transcription are free. With a Conspectit Pro subscription, transcription is several times faster.

name: Contacts Lx
description:
Clothes and art, curated in one place.

Browse the latest pieces, explore the floor plan as if you were in the space, and save what you want to come back to. When a pop-up is coming up, join as a guest or artist in a few taps.

name: Cookii
description:
Bring your characters and stories to life with Cookii.

Explore community-created characters, start a story, and guide the conversation in your own direction. Create original characters and worlds, refine your writing, and organize the details that make each story yours.

Cookii for iOS provides SFW content only. Report content or AI responses from their menus, block abusive users, and manage your privacy choices in Settings.

AI features share relevant content with the AI services disclosed in the app after your permission. AI responses can be inaccurate; use your judgment and avoid sharing unnecessary personal information.

Cookii is intended for adults. AI features use account credits and applicable usage limits. Credits can be earned through the available reward activities. Credit purchases are not offered in this version.

name: Cool Balloon Breeze Tool
description:
Balloon Breeze is a delightful exploration of hot air balloon science and flight.
Discover how hot air balloons rise, calculate theoretical lifting capacity, explore flight weather conditions, and learn fascinating facts about balloon design and aviation.
Whether you're curious about the science of flight or simply love the beauty of hot air balloons, Balloon Breeze brings the world of balloon exploration right to your fingertips.

name: Cool Swimmer
description:
Cool Swimmer is your swimming in one place: every best time, every goal, every test set, and what they add up to. It opens on your progress.

MY SWIMMING
How many events you have improved this season, how many goals you have reached, and a table of every event with your best, your goal and your gain. Switch between this season, the last 12 months and all time.

EVERY SHIFT COUNTS
Tap an event for its history: your bests over the years, your gain in time and in speed, your rate of improvement, and your career season by season. A faster 100 kick in practice is progress too, and it shows up beside your races.

TRACK IT YOURSELF
Pick a set you can repeat, a 100 kick for time or 3 x 100 best average, and record it every few weeks. You can do it on your own. It tells you whether training is working between meets.

WHAT MIGHT HELP NEXT
From your own times: how much speed you hold as the race gets longer, whether speed or endurance comes first for your goal, and which events to get a time in so the picture is complete. Built on the Cool Coaching system by Steve Friederang.

BRING IN YOUR TIMES
Type a time with its date, or paste a whole list copied from a times search or a results page.

SHARE WITH YOUR COACHES, OR DON'T
Connect to a coach who uses Cool Coaching with their team code. They see your progress, add to it, message you, and share the weeks they write, with every set at your own pace. Share with as many coaches as you have: club, school, private. You choose who sees your swimming and can stop at any time.

YOURS
No ads and no tracking. Sign in with Apple or with a link by email, with no password. Delete your account and everything in it from Settings.

Cool Swimmer is free. For ages 13 and up.

name: Corewords: English Vocabulary
description:
Learn the English words you'll actually meet, the most useful ones first.

Corewords teaches English vocabulary in frequency order. The core deck is the New General Service List (NGSL): 2,800 words that cover about 92% of the words in everyday English text. Learn them and most of what you read and hear is made of words you know. Then go on to 5,000 words, about 98%.

EVERY WORD, PROPERLY
• A short definition in simple English and a natural example sentence
• IPA for American and British English, with audio for both accents
• Word forms (go, goes, went, gone) and its frequency rank
• Turkish translations for Turkish speakers

SPACED REPETITION THAT TEACHES
Each word comes back just before you would forget it. Exercises move from recognizing a word to producing it:
• Word → meaning and meaning → word
• Listen and choose
• Fill the gap in a sentence
• Type the word
• Say it: on-device speech recognition checks your pronunciation

START AT YOUR LEVEL
A 3-minute placement test finds the words you already know, so you don't start from zero. Set a daily pace, keep a streak, get a reminder, and watch your coverage grow: "the words you know cover 74% of everyday English."

PHRASAL VERBS
205 everyday phrasal verbs, from get up and look after to put up with, with notes on which ones can be separated.

THE SMALL WORDS THAT MATTER MOST
The, of, to, in, a and for make up a huge share of every text. 18 short lessons explain articles (a, an, the, no article), in/on/at for place and time, to/for, will and going to, would, can/could/may/might, must and should, some and any, and more, each with a quiz.

PRONUNCIATION
All 44 sounds of English with tips, and a minimal-pair trainer to hear the difference: sheep or ship, three or tree, vet or wet.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
Native app for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with layouts that use the extra space.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device and works without internet.

FREE AND PRO
Free: the 2,800-word core deck with every exercise, all grammar lessons, the 44-sound chart, the placement test and progress. A one-time Pro purchase adds the extended list (2,200 more words), phrasal verbs, the full minimal-pair trainer and Say it. No subscription.

Word lists: NGSL 1.2 and NGSL-GR by Browne, Culligan and Phillips, CC BY-SA 4.0. Pronunciation data: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary and Britfone. Definitions and examples were written for Corewords.

name: Cost Control.
description:
Cost Control is an all-in-one app for managing project costs, whether in contracting, manufacturing, or both, from budgeting through to the approved report. It lets site engineers and management work on a single, shared set of data from different devices, whether a mobile phone, a tablet, or a MacBook.

Choose your project's cost mode
• Contracting: phases and BOQ items, with cost analysis split into materials, labor, equipment, subcontractors and overheads.
• Industrial: products, bills of materials (BOM), operations, production orders, work centers, batches, outputs and scrap.
• Mixed: contracting items and industrial items in one project with unified costing.

Sync and share across devices and users
• Share the database through iCloud, the local network, or an encrypted package (.ccpkg).
• Encryption with a passphrase stored in the Keychain on each device.
• When data conflicts, you choose which version to keep. Nothing is overwritten without your decision.

Follow-up between site and management
• Assign each user to specific projects with an access level: view only, enter and edit, or manage and approve.
• Site engineers record labor, equipment hours, receipts and production. After sync, management reviews and approves.
• Separate roles: Administrator, Project Manager, Cost Engineer, Procurement, Storekeeper, Production Supervisor, Finance, and Viewer.
• An audit log shows who changed what and when.

Control your costs
• Approved budgets and revision versions, plus variation orders.
• Actuals, variance, earned value (CPI) and estimate at completion (EAC).
• Purchase requests and orders with an approval cycle, and stock receipts and issues that post cost to items.
• Subcontractor and client certificates with retention and tax, and a configurable policy for exceeding the contract value.
• A schedule with dependencies and a baseline, cash-flow forecast, risk register, what-if scenarios, and a feasibility study.

Reports as formal paper sheets
• Your company logo and details, with Prepared, Reviewed and Approved signatures.
• Export to PDF, Excel and CSV.

Designed for you
• Full Arabic right-to-left support, with an English interface.
• Light and dark modes, with separate color customization for each.
• Built-in user guide.
• Currency follows your device's currency.
• Deleting a project is protected by a warning and your password.

Built for contracting companies, factories, consulting offices, project managers and site engineers.

name: Countless Memories
description:
Countless Memories is a private, beautiful home for your pregnancy journey, your children's milestones and your family's favorite moments.

CAPTURE EVERY LITTLE MOMENT
• Add memories with photos, a short story and the date in seconds
• Organize by chapter: pregnancy, firsts, milestones, everyday moments and more
• Your photos' dates are read automatically, and location data is removed before upload

MAKE MEMORY BOOKS
• Turn a year of memories into a keepsake book in minutes
• Choose from illustrated designs like Teddy Bear, Woodland Baby and Rainbow Baby
• Download print-quality PDFs to print or share

INVITE YOUR FAMILY CIRCLE
• Invite grandparents, partners and aunties with a private link
• Choose exactly which children each person can see
• Relatives can suggest memories, which only appear after you approve them
• Invited family members never pay

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Nothing is ever public: no ads, and we never sell your data
• Optional Face ID lock
• Download or delete everything anytime

PREMIUM
Start with a 3-day free trial, then $9.99/month or $49.99/year. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

Terms: https://www.countlessmemories.app/terms
Privacy: https://www.countlessmemories.app/privacy

name: CozySunrise
description:
Follow the markets, research companies on your iPhone. Search for stocks, build a watchlist, and explore historical prices with interactive charts. Compare major U.S. and Hong Kong indices, browse U.S. market movers, and find companies by sector or industry.

Open a stock’s research page to view company profiles, valuation metrics, financial statements, earnings history, trading sessions, and dividend and split records. Read market news from its original publishers and bookmark stories for later.

Start your paper portfolio with **$100,000 in virtual cash**. Simulate buy and sell orders, track your positions, and review your trade history. Use the compound growth and trade return calculators to explore different scenarios, and record what you learn in a private photo journal.

 Choose a light or dark appearance, or let the app follow your system settings.

name: Crew Dog Law
description:
Practice the bar exam by doing the lawyering. Spot the hearsay. Find where the stop turned into a search. Tell the client what the contract lets her do. That's how you study here. Every answer names the Federal Rule, Model Rule, statute or case behind it, so you can open it and check us.

Everything's inside the app and works in airplane mode. You don't need an account to start.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 13 games. SIDEBAR puts testimony in front of you. Object in time and name the ground. SUPPRESSION hands you a police report. Find the line where police crossed it. ETHICS DESK is a first-year associate's week. Call it must, may, only if or must not, then back it with the rule.
- THE TRIAL, a capstone that takes one made-up case from the first client meeting to the verdict.
- A rule sheet for each of 8 bar subjects. Every rule in one plain sentence with its source.
- More than 1,900 original practice questions. On the bar and ethics questions, you'll see why the right answer is right and why every wrong choice is wrong.
- More than 1,000 flashcards. Run the ones you miss again.
- 20 integrated question sets and 6 performance tasks with a 60-minute clock.
- 16 practice essays, 30 minutes each, with a model answer and a point list to grade yourself.
- Timed practice: a 200-question multiple-choice exam in two 3-hour sessions, or a 100 or 50 question set. You get your raw percent and a subject breakdown.

THE EXAMS
- The bar exam: Evidence, Contracts, Torts, Real property, Constitutional law, Criminal law and procedure, Civil procedure and Business associations. One bank serves the old exam and the new bar exam that started in July 2026.
- The legal ethics exam: 12 short lessons, ETHICS DESK and a practice set of up to 60 questions on a 2-hour clock.
- The patent bar: a 100-question practice test on a six-hour clock. Every answer is backed by a quote from the MPEP, the patent statute or the rules. Three games drill finding sections, counting deadlines and working fees.

BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
You'll feel a tap on a right answer and a buzz on a wrong one. Share a score from the results screen. Essay and task drafts stay on your device. iPad works in any orientation.

WHO BUILT IT
We're Crew Dog Electronics, the team behind Crew Dog Ground School. Law runs on the same study engine. Every question is ours and every fact pattern is made up. None come from the exam's publisher or a prep company.

HOW WE CHECK IT
We write each rule from the rule text or the case itself, and we only cite cases we've opened and read. A separate AI review checks the law. No attorney has reviewed it, and we'll keep saying so until that changes. Think a question's wrong? Tap Send feedback in any game, or write to us. We open the rule or the case, and if we got it wrong, the fix ships in the next update.

READ THIS
Study aid for exam practice. Not legal advice, and using it doesn't create an attorney-client relationship. Bar exam answers follow the majority rule and the federal rules. Ethics answers follow the ABA Model Rules. Your state's rules can differ, and rules change, so check your jurisdiction's current rules. Crew Dog Law is an independent study aid, not affiliated with or endorsed by the National Conference of Bar Examiners or any bar admission authority. Patent bar practice isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the USPTO. Not reviewed by an attorney. No guarantee of passing any exam. If you have a real legal problem, talk to a lawyer licensed in your state. No ads.

Questions? Write to games@crewdogelectronics.com.

name: Critter Fling: Brick Breaker
description:
Pull back, let go, and watch a grumpy-cute critter ricochet through a board of colorful bricks. Critter Fling is a one-thumb brick breaker with a roguelike twist: every wave you pick a new power-up, every boss you beat rescues an egg, and every egg hatches a new critter for your squad.

BARON BRICKBOTTOM WANTS THE GARDEN PAVED
His blocks march on the Nest one row every wave. Fling your critters to smash them before they cross the red line, then chase the Baron through Sunny Garden, Mossy Hollow and Thorn Thicket across 150 stages.

ONE THUMB. INSTANT FUN.
• Drag back to aim: the dotted line previews your first two bounces
• Let go to fling and watch the chain reaction
• Tap mid-flight to trigger your critter's special ability
• Fine-aim mode and a sensitivity slider for perfect trick shots

A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN
• Pick 1 of 3 power-ups after each wave: ×2 Gate, Triple Shot, Chain Lightning, Fire Trail, Rubber Walls and 25 more
• Every card tells you exactly what it does
• Stack them into wild combos and turn one fling into a swarm
• A boss every 10 waves: shield phases, moving walls and block spawners

HATCH, COLLECT, EVOLVE
• 30+ critters, each with its own way to bounce: Pip the Hamster, Zip the Mouse, Splat the sticky Frog, Fizz the splitting Ladybug, Boom the exploding Beetle, Echo the ghost-copy Bat and many more
• Match a critter's color to the bricks for double damage
• Duplicates level critters up; fuse two max-level critters into an evolved form
• Every run, win or lose, earns coins for permanent upgrades

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY WEEK
• One seeded board for everyone, refreshed every Monday
• Climb the Game Center leaderboard and challenge your friends

FAIR BY DESIGN
• No energy, no lives, no waiting to play
• Earn coins and gems just by playing; optional gem packs hatch eggs and power up critters faster
• Egg odds are always shown in the Hatchery before you hatch
• No ads in your first session, and rewarded videos are always your choice
• Optional Remove Ads purchase turns off between-wave ads
• Short 3 to 5 minute runs, perfect for a coffee break
• Satisfying haptics on every bounce, break and hatch

Download Critter Fling and save the Nest!

Terms: https://thunderapps.xyz/terms
Privacy: https://thunderapps.xyz/privacy

name: CRM Scienza del Respiro
description:
L'app riservata a chi lavora nel team commerciale della Scienza del Respiro: venditori e setter.

Entri con le credenziali che ti abbiamo dato. Gli account li creiamo noi: non c'è registrazione.

Per i venditori:
• i lead assegnati e la scheda di ognuno
• «Chiama adesso» direttamente dalla notifica
• dopo la telefonata, «Com'è andata?» per segnare l'esito in pochi secondi

Per i setter:
• la giornata con i contatti da scrivere
• i contatti di oggi salvati in rubrica con un tocco
• «Inviato?» quando torni da WhatsApp o dagli SMS
• un avviso prima della verifica e uno quando un tuo contatto prenota

Per entrare devi essere già nel team.

name: Cruise Control: Study
description:
Study together, even when you're apart.

Cruise Control turns study sessions into flights you take with your friends. Share a code, everyone boards, and you all take off at the same moment. Your planes cross a real map while you work, and you land together. Plan what to work on with a departures board for your to-do list, and watch your focus time add up.

STUDY WITH FRIENDS • Host a group flight and share a 4-digit code or link: up to 8 friends board and take off together • Everyone lands at the same time, wherever they're studying • See who's on board and what each person is working on • Late? Friends can still join a flight already in the air • At landing, see everyone's focus time and the group's total • Save your study group as a crew and fly together again without a new code • A weekly crew leaderboard for focus time, flights and streaks, with a trophy for last week's top flyer • Get a notification when someone in your crew is boarding

PLAN ON A DEPARTURES BOARD • Your study planner, as an airport departures board • Add tasks with planned times and notes, for today, tomorrow or later in the week • Tasks show as BOARDING, SCHEDULED or DELAYED as the day goes on • Repeating tasks join the board on the days you choose, like daily vocab or weekly problem sheets • Tap a task to board it and fly it; mark it landed when it's done and see it on Arrivals • Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and "Add a departure" with Siri

FLY EVERY SESSION • Choose how long to focus and pick a real city that far away, or shuffle for a surprise • Put each subject at its own gate, so your time adds up by subject • Watch your plane climb, cruise and descend on a live 3D map • A split-flap countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island • Cabin noise, rain, ocean waves and calm focus music

STATS AND STATUS • Focus time, flights, distance, streaks and daily average • See how your time splits across subjects • A flight log of every route you've flown, plus countries and airports visited • Earn status from Bronze to Diamond as your hours add up

PRIVATE BY DESIGN • No account, no ads • Your flights and planner stay on your device • Group flights and crews use iCloud and only share your name and totals with the people you fly with

Airlines in the app are fictional. Airport data from OurAirports.

name: CSS Connect
description:
CSS Connect is the direct line between you and the company that takes care of your home or your community. Ask for a service in a minute, see what is happening with it, talk to the office and pay your invoices, all in one place and without phone calls.

Open the app, choose your service company and you are in. No password to remember: you sign in with a code sent to your email.

REQUEST A SERVICE

• Browse the services your company offers
• Describe what you need in your own words
• Add photos and videos so the crew knows what to expect
• Say which day and time suit you, and whether it is urgent
• Keep several addresses and choose the one that needs service

FOLLOW EVERY REQUEST

• One list with the status of everything you asked for
• Read the quote and accept or decline it inside the app
• See when the visit is scheduled, when the crew starts and when the work is done
• Rate the service when it is finished
• Cancel a request while it has not been quoted or scheduled

VISITS

• Your next visit on the home screen, with its day and time
• Upcoming and past visits in one tab

MESSAGES AND SUPPORT

• Write to the office about a request or about anything else
• Send photos, videos, documents and a location on the map
• Open a support ticket by topic and see when it is answered
• Call or write to the office from the Support page

INVOICES AND PAYMENTS

• Open invoices first, with what is due and when
• Pay by card on a secure payment page
• Quotes and invoices as PDF, ready to save or share

NOTICE BOARD

• Announcements from your service company
• Maintenance notices for your community or homeowners association

MADE FOR YOU

• Notifications when the office answers, sends a quote or schedules a visit
• Face ID or fingerprint to open the app
• English and Spanish
• Light and dark mode
• Delete your access at any time from your account

CSS Connect (Customer Self Service) is built by Garcia Innovations for service companies and their customers. The first company to offer it is Garcia Irrigation, in Sarasota, Florida. The services themselves are provided by your service company, under the quote and invoice of each job.

Location is used only when you ask the app to mark your address on the map or to send a place in a message. The app has no advertising and no tracking.

name: csvQRScan
description:
csvQRScan is a fast CSV table editor with a built-in QR scanner. Point the camera at a label and the MAC address lands in the selected cell — no typing, no typos.
 
SCAN
• Automatic mode writes each code the moment it is recognized
• Manual mode shows what was found and writes it when you tap Write
• MAC addresses with colons or without separators
• After each scan the selection can jump one row down
 
EDIT
• Open, create, save, export and share CSV files
• Edit in the cell or in the line at the bottom
• Select ranges, copy, cut, paste, clear, undo and redo
• Search the whole document
• Move and delete columns, tables up to 10,000 rows × 200 columns

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline, no account, no ads, no tracking
• Your files stay on your device
 
FREE AND PRO
Edit tables up to 45 rows and scan manually for free (up to 30 scans per file). Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription, and adds tables up to 10,000 rows, unlimited scanning, automatic mode, duplicate handling, frozen rows and columns and fill-in-ascending-order.
 
Available in English, German, Ukrainian and Russian.

name: CynéScout
description:
CynéScout permet de suivre une battue de chasse en temps réel, sur la carte du territoire.

Chaque participant (chasseur posté, fusil dans la traque, rabatteur) apparaît sur la carte IGN du territoire. Tout le monde sait où sont les autres : un vrai plus pour la sécurité des tirs et la coordination des traques.

EN DIRECT PENDANT LA JOURNÉE
• Positions des participants sur la carte, mises à jour au plus une fois par minute pour préserver la batterie
• Signalements instantanés : animal vu, danger, tir
• Traques : début et fin de chaque traque, lignes de rabatteurs
• Repères, miradors et contour du territoire
• Signal de présence : un participant sans réseau apparaît grisé avec « il y a 10 min »

ORGANISER
• Un territoire, plusieurs journées de chasse, chacune avec son code du jour
• Les actionnaires se déclarent à chaque journée avec leur code, les invités indiquent l'actionnaire qui les invite
• Cotisations de la journée (chapeau, renard…) tenues par les actionnaires
• Éditeur de carte : contour, repères, miradors

APRÈS LA CHASSE
• Replay de la journée et résumé : participants, traques, tirs, tableau de chasse

MODE SPECTATEUR
Suivez la journée sans envoyer votre position.

RESPECT DE LA VIE PRIVÉE
Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucun pistage. Votre position n'est partagée qu'avec les participants de la journée, et seulement pendant la journée de chasse.

La localisation en arrière-plan permet de rester visible téléphone en poche pendant la traque ; elle s'arrête dès que vous quittez la journée. L'utilisation prolongée du GPS en arrière-plan peut réduire l'autonomie de la batterie.

name: Daily Span Trivia
description:
One game. Every day. How much do you really know?

Daily Span serves up a fresh set of trivia questions every day, spanning ten topics: science, space, animals, geography, history, movies & TV, music, sports, food & drink, and the human body. Come back tomorrow for a brand-new challenge.

HOW IT WORKS
Every answer is a number: a year, a weight, a count. You don't type the answer. You lay a range on the line: where you think it is, and how wide a net you need. A narrow net is worth more than a wide one. Then commit:
• HEDGE is safe: you score if you're right and lose nothing if you're wrong.
• CALL pays 1.75×, but a miss costs you half.
• CALLED SHOT pays triple, and a miss costs you the lot.
Five questions. A perfect day is 500. A bad one can go below zero.

KNOW HOW SURE YOU ARE
Over time the game tracks how often you're actually right at each level and tells you whether you're overconfident. Most people are. The trick isn't knowing more than everyone else. It's knowing how much you know.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP COMING BACK
• A new challenge every day — quick to play, easy to fit into your routine
• Ten topics that span everything from black holes to box-office hits

name: DANCER LOVE
description:
The practice tools dancers need, in one app: loop sections, slow down with the pitch kept, mirror, zoom in and step frame by frame, with the count on the video. No account, no ads.

PRACTICE PLAYBACK
AB Sections: set IN and OUT, loop, and save with a name. Speed from 0.25x to 2x with the pitch kept. Pinch to zoom. Step by 1 or 10 frames, or 1 or 5 seconds. Mirror view. A 3, 5 or 10 second countdown with a voice, a beep or no sound.

COUNT SHEET
Finds the tempo (BPM) and beats in the music and shows the count on the video, such as “Eight 3, count 5”. Adjust with “Tap” or “This is 1”, play clicks or a spoken count, and snap times to the beat.

YOUR PRIVACY
No account, no login, no ads. The app itself does not talk to any server. Videos, audio, breakdown videos, member face photos, formations and lyrics stay on this device; the developer never receives them. Person detection and text recognition run on the device. Purchases and restores are handled by Apple's App Store.
The camera and microphone are used only for breakdown videos, and adding to Photos only to save exported videos. Only the videos and images you choose are imported.

BREAKDOWN VIDEOS
Record yourself explaining or dancing. The song starts a little before the chosen section, with a count. Watch clips next to the reference video or as a run-through, and save them to Photos or share them.

FORMATIONS FROM YOUR VIDEO
On the Formation tab, tap “Guide”: Floor, Members, Analyze. The app reads each member's position across the video and places numbered circles on a stage map that move as the video plays.
Floor: line up the floor on a video frame by its corners or the numbered marks taped on it, or set the scale from a member's height.
Members: pause where everyone is visible; the app finds and numbers each person from the left. Name them while looking at small face photos.
Analyze: runs on your device. Detection has limits, so drag the marks on the video or the circles on the map to fix them; scenes worth checking are listed under “Needs review”.
You can also place dancers yourself, and export a formation video with the video and map side by side.

LYRICS
Paste lyrics, or read English lyrics from images such as screenshots. Tap “Stamp” as the song plays to time each line; the current line lights up, and tapping a line jumps to it.

Requires iOS / iPadOS 16.0 or later (iPhone and iPad).
Languages: Japanese, English, Spanish, Korean, Thai, Traditional Chinese.

PLEASE NOTE
Videos and music you import belong to their copyright owners; use them only for your own practice. Position reading is approximate and can be off when people overlap or look small in the distance.

PRICE
Free to download. Creating and editing (new projects, editing, video analysis, recording, exporting) needs one of the options below. Without it, you can still open, play and delete projects and change settings.
Yearly: auto-renewing subscription, 800 JPY per year in Japan. New subscribers get the first month free.
Lifetime: one-time payment, 1,500 JPY in Japan, all features forever. Switch to Lifetime any time, even during the trial or a yearly subscription (the subscription does not stop on its own; cancel it after buying).
Buy from “Purchase” at the top left of the project list; “Restore purchases” is on the same screen. Family Sharing is not supported. Prices in other regions are shown before you buy.

ABOUT THE SUBSCRIPTION
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the free trial ends, it becomes the yearly subscription and you are charged. After that, it renews and is charged automatically every year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
Cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions, or with “Manage subscription” on the app's purchase screen.
