name: Data Science Basics: Datawren
description:
A university-level data science course for your phone, built as a notebook of nine short analyses. Each cell starts with a real situation: a messy cafeteria spreadsheet, an ice-cream stand on a boardwalk, a lunch-line survey of 2,000 students, two hospitals with different patients, a study app on trial.

Predict first, then run it. Drag the sliders and the picture, the numbers and the equation change together. Tap any symbol in the equation to see where it lives in the simulation. Then answer questions computed from the setup you just made.

What you work through
- The data science lifecycle and what data can and cannot say
- Cleaning and wrangling: blanks, repeats, tidy tables
- Exploring data: mean, median, spread, correlation and the traps in them
- Visualisation principles: honest axes and how readers decode charts
- Sampling and variability: standard error, bias and the bell shape
- Estimation and hypothesis tests: shuffling, bootstrapping, p-values
- Regression and prediction: least squares, R squared, held-out data
- Confounding and causation: Simpson's paradox and experiments
- Pipelines, reproducibility, leaks and reporting

Built to respect your time: three-to-eight minute sessions, no timers, missed questions go to a gentle replay list. Text size from 85% to 200%. Works offline, no account, all data sets are made up for teaching.

Every claim carries sources you can open inside the app (UC Berkeley Data 8, Data 100 and Data 102 pages, open textbooks and original papers). Every numeric answer is re-computed by independent code. Not reviewed by an expert; not affiliated with any university.

Free with ads at natural breaks. Optional monthly ad-free subscription ($3.99, 7-day free trial, cancel anytime; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle). Or watch a short video to earn credits.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-datawren.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-datawren.html

Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-datawren.html

name: DayInk - 手書きデジタル手帳
description:
DayInk は、紙の手帳の心地よさをそのままに、予定・タスク・手書きノートをひとつにまとめるデジタル手帳です。

【7つの手帳ビューを、ひとつのバインダーに】
ホーム・デイリー・ウィークリー・マンスリー・イヤー・タスク・メモの7つのビューがひとつの手帳につながり、iPhone の下部タブバーや iPad 右側のインデックス見出しからワンタップで行き来できます。今日の概要、バーチカル時間軸、週間・月間・年間の俯瞰、タスク管理やフリーメモまで、今日へ戻る操作や月送りもスムーズです。

【Apple Pencil で、紙に書くように】
デイリーから開くノートや専用のメモキャンバスで、PencilKit による滑らかな手書きに対応。ペン・鉛筆・マーカーを切り替え、色や太さも自由に選べます。Apple Pencil の筆圧と傾きを活かした自然な線で、予定の合間のメモや日記、アイデアスケッチをそのまま残せます。ピンチズーム（0.5x〜4.0x）で細部まで書き込めます。

【写真を貼って、手帳を豊かに】
PhotosPicker から選んだ画像をノートに貼り付け。ドラッグで移動、ピンチで拡大縮小、回転も直感的に行えます。旅の写真や資料、スクラップを手書きと一緒にレイアウトできます。

【iOS カレンダーと連携】
EventKit を通じて、iCloud・Google・Outlook などの予定を読み取り専用で表示。仕事とプライベートの予定を手帳のタイムラインに重ねて確認できます。DayInk から外部カレンダーを書き換えることはありません。

【ウィジェットで、今日をすぐに】
Small / Medium サイズのホーム画面ウィジェット（WidgetKit）とアプリ内プレビューで今日の予定とタスク進捗を表示。ウィジェット上でのインタラクティブなタスク完了操作にも対応します。

【オフラインでも、安心して】
通信がなくても予定・タスク・手書き・画像の編集を継続できます。複数の端末で編集したデータは、ポータブル JSON バックアップ＆多端末スマートマージ復元で失われないようマージされます。

【自分好みに整う設定 & PDF 書き出し】
週の開始曜日（月曜／日曜）、12/24時間表示、ライト／ダーク／自動の外観モード。用紙スタイルは罫線・方眼・ドット方眼・白紙、用紙カラーはアイボリー・クラフト・セージ・ホワイト・ダークから選べます。作成した手帳ページは高解像度 PNG、またはベクター罫線付き高解像度 PDF 書き出しに対応し、外部アプリや iCloud Drive へ共有できます。

【プライバシーを第一に】
アカウント登録は不要。独自サーバーへの通信は行わず、データは端末内の安全なローカルサンドボックスにのみ保存されます。トラッキングや広告 SDK は一切使用していません。

【DayInk Pro（アプリ内課金・任意）について】
基本機能（7つの手帳ビュー、手書きノート、フリーメモ、タスク管理、標準用紙、1ページあたり画像3枚まで等）は無料でご利用いただけます。
すべての用紙カラー（セージ・クラフト・ダーク等）、無制限の写真貼り付け、全期間アジェンダ検索、高解像度 PDF / 画像書き出しをご利用いただける「DayInk Pro」をご用意しています。
・年額プラン：¥2,800 / 年（7日間無料トライアル付き・自動更新）
・月額プラン：¥300 / 月（7日間無料トライアル付き・自動更新）
・買い切り（Lifetime）：¥5,800（一度のお支払いで永続利用・自動更新なし）

お支払いはご購入確定時に Apple Account へ請求されます。自動更新サブスクリプションは、期間終了の24時間前までに Apple Account の設定（サブスクリプション管理）から解約しない限り自動更新されます。

対応端末: iPhone / iPad（iOS / iPadOS 18.0 以降）
Apple Pencil での利用を推奨しますが、指での手書きにも対応しています。

name: Deltawy Attendance
description:
دلتاوي للحضور والانصراف هو لوحة تحكم شركتك في جيبك: تابع حضور موظفيك لحظة بلحظة، ووافق على الطلبات، وراجع الرواتب والتقارير من أي مكان.

التطبيق مخصص لأصحاب الشركات والمديرين وفريق الموارد البشرية، ويعمل مع أجهزة البصمة ونظام دلتاوي للحضور على الويب.

لوحة تحكم الشركة
• من سجّل بصمته اليوم، والحاضرون والمتأخرون والغائبون في نظرة واحدة
• آخر البصمات تصل لحظيًا من أجهزة البصمة
• رسوم بيانية للحضور خلال آخر 7 و30 يومًا

الحضور اليومي
• حالة كل موظف في أي يوم: حاضر، متأخر، غائب، في إجازة، عمل إضافي
• بحث بالاسم أو الكود وتصفية حسب الحالة
• يوم الموظف بالتفصيل: البصمات، ودقائق التأخير، والتصحيحات
• تقويم شهري ملوّن لكل موظف مع ملخص الأيام وساعات العمل

صندوق الموافقات
• طلبات الإجازة والعمل الإضافي وتصحيح الحضور في مكان واحد
• وافق أو ارفض بلمسة واحدة، مع ذكر السبب عند الرفض
• رصيد الإجازات المتبقي ظاهر قبل أن توافق

الموظفون
• قائمة كل الموظفين مع البحث والتصفية
• بيانات الموظف وتفعيل أو إيقاف حسابه

الرواتب
• فترات الرواتب وحالة كل فترة
• صافي الرواتب والمكافآت والخصومات لكل موظف
• كشف راتب تفصيلي لكل موظف

التقارير
• تقارير الحضور والتأخير والغياب اليومية والشهرية
• تصدير أي تقرير إلى Excel أو CSV ومشاركته فورًا

وأيضًا
• أجهزة البصمة: حالة الاتصال وآخر مزامنة وسجل البصمات لكل جهاز
• الفروع والأقسام مع حضور اليوم لكل منها
• الورديات ومواعيدها وأيام العمل
• إشعارات بكل طلب جديد
• العربية والإنجليزية
• حماية الحساب بالتحقق بخطوتين

ملاحظة: يتطلب التطبيق حساب مدير على نظام دلتاوي للحضور. تواصل مع مسؤول النظام في شركتك للحصول على حساب.

description:

name: Dial Camera: Retro AI Camera

HOW IT WORKS

• A tape under the LCD reads the next move like an instrument, with the reason
• Turn the dial to AI, GUIDE or PLAIN. Flip the AUTO switch and AI mode shoots by itself when the dot holds on the target

PLUS AND PRO

• Pro (AI Director): everything in Plus and every editing tool: light, colour, curves, 8-colour mixer, colour grading, effects, detail, person, sky and background masks, 21 looks and 41 presets. Also a spot map with where to stand, spoken pose direction, next-shot ideas, background extend and background blur

PRIVACY

name: DigiPrism
description:
DigiPrism keeps your projects, tasks, support tickets, and conversations together, so your team can stay connected from iPhone or iPad.

KEEP WORK MOVING
View project details, track tasks and milestones, and manage reminders. See what needs attention and update work wherever you are.

GET SUPPORT IN ONE PLACE
Submit support tickets, follow their status, and keep replies and attachments with the original request. Filter tickets by business, application, or submitter to find the right conversation.

CHAT WITH YOUR SUPPORT TEAM

name: DilSePlay: Games for Couples

DilSePlay is a cozy little game room for two. Make a room, send the link to your person, and play live together wherever you are, with voice chat built in.

23 GAMES MADE FOR COUPLES

PLAY LIVE, TALK LIVE
• Every move shows up instantly on both phones
• Private voice chat while you play, straight from phone to phone and encrypted
• Chat and cute stickers in every room
• Up to 4 players in Ludo, Snakes & Ladders and Crazy Eights

LOVE LEVELS
• Every game you finish together earns love points
• Daily quests, together streaks and level-up rewards
• Name your couple and unlock room themes like Starry Night and Chai Café

WORKS WITH THE WEBSITE
Already play on dilseplay.com? Sign in with the same Google or Apple account and your rooms, games and Love Levels are right there. Your partner can join from the app or from any browser.

name: Don't Get Dropped!
description:
You're live as a guest. The show is going well. Then your phone rings - and the call takes over your audio and drops you from the show.

Don't Get Dropped! makes sure that never happens.

HOW IT WORKS
Save your shows and their guest links in the app. When it's time, tap Go Live: the studio opens inside the app, and an automatic shield you set up once turns on by itself. Incoming calls go straight to voicemail instead of interrupting you. When you leave the app, the shield turns itself back off and your calls come back.

THE SHIELD
iOS does not let any app switch Airplane Mode or a Focus on or off by itself, so Don't Get Dropped! uses Apple's own Shortcuts automations - the in-app wizard walks you through the one-time setup in about two minutes, step by step:
- At home: Airplane Mode ON with Wi-Fi ON. Your show streams over Wi-Fi and cellular calls physically cannot reach your phone.
- Outdoors: a "Live" Focus that allows nobody. Calls are silenced to voicemail while your show keeps streaming over cellular data.
- A closing automation turns everything off when you leave the app.
An optional extra shield can forward calls at your carrier before they reach the phone.

WORKS WITH YOUR STUDIO
Any web studio guest link works: StreamYard, Riverside, Restream, Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, YouTube Live, or any other web studio link your host sends you. Your camera and microphone work right inside the app, popups open as they should, and if the connection ever drops, the app rejoins the studio for you.

FREE TRIAL AND PRO
The app is free to download and includes a one-time 2-minute live trial so you can feel the shield work. A one-time Pro purchase - no subscription - unlocks unlimited live time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no servers, no analytics, no tracking. Your shows, links and history are stored only on your device and never leave it.

Door Tech is the inspection and estimate tool built for garage door technicians.

CHECK THE DOOR IN 3D
Walk a full 3D model of the door, part by part: springs, cables, drums, rollers, hinges, tracks, opener, sensors and seals. Mark each one Good, Worn, Replace or N/A. The camera flies to every part, so nothing gets missed.

THE ESTIMATE BUILDS ITSELF
Every part you flag becomes a line on the estimate, priced from your own price book. Add labor, discounts and tax, reorder lines, and you're done in under a minute.

A PDF YOUR CUSTOMER UNDERSTANDS
Send a clean estimate with a picture of the customer's own door, numbered markers on the parts that need work, and a close-up of each one. Customers see what's wrong before they see the price.

SPRING CALCULATORS
Measure a spring and get its lift, turns and cycle life, plus every spring that replaces it. Design a pair from the door's weight and size. Weigh a door from the springs on it.

QUOTE A NEW DOOR
Build a door with the customer: style, color, windows and size. Price it and send the estimate on the spot.

BUILT FOR EVERY SETUP
Single and double doors, 7 and 8 foot. Torsion and extension springs. Chain, belt and wall-mount openers.

YOUR BRAND
Add your logo, contact details, license number, terms and estimate color with Door Tech Pro.

FREE TO START
The free plan includes 5 door checks and 1 estimate. Door Tech Pro unlocks unlimited checks and estimates, the springs to order, branded estimates and every inspection guide.

Door Tech Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Spring calculations are a guide for trained technicians. Always verify against the door and the manufacturer's specifications. Garage door springs are under high tension and can cause serious injury.

Privacy Policy: https://doortech.io/privacy

name: Drive Left Japan
description:
Drive Left Japan is a pre-trip practice app for visitors renting a car in Japan, where traffic keeps left and the driver sits on the right.

The app runs in English or Traditional Chinese, following your device language. Road signs appear in Japanese, as on the road.

What catches visitors out is a handful of reflexes: switching on the wipers instead of the turn signal, cutting a right turn into the oncoming lane, swinging a left turn into the second lane, missing a 止まれ (stop) sign. This app turns them into drills you repeat on iPhone or iPad until they are automatic.

SIX REAL ROUTES, EVERY TURN CHECKED AGAINST THE ACTUAL ROAD
Haneda Airport to Gotemba, Okinawa main island, central Hokkaido, the Kyushu hot-spring loop, Fuji Five Lakes and Hakone, and the Chubu "Shoryudo" route: 19 segments and 147 checkpoints.
• Real places only. Every turn, fork, exit and toll gate you are tested on is an intersection or interchange that exists in Japan, and you turn the same way as on the real route. Road layout is based on OpenStreetMap data.
• Signs as they read on site. Guide signs were checked one by one against street-level imagery and the expressway operators' official junction diagrams, at more than 180 locations, and use the Japanese wording on the real boards. Where a sign could not be confirmed, the app shows no sign rather than inventing one.
• Wrong exits and wrong-lane forks are left in. Take one and the app tells you where that road leads.
• 3D view from the driver's seat or behind the car, with landmarks such as Otaru Canal, Kumamoto Castle, Lake Ashi and Shirakawa-go.
• To fit in more turns, distances between junctions are shortened and some lanes and signals are simplified. Roads change; on the day, follow the signs in front of you.

DRIVING PRACTICE
• Turn into the correct lane: tight left turns, wide right turns. One notch of the steering wheel is one lane, so you know which lane you are entering as you turn.
• 11 levels from simple to hard: single-lane turns, multi-lane roads, a roundabout, expressway merging and exits, leaving a parking lot and a turning exam, plus a random route that is new every time.
• 6 advanced levels where you work the signal stalk, wipers, headlights and pedals yourself, from residential streets and railway crossings to the expressway.
• Clear, rain or snow, day or night, switchable while you drive. Braking takes much longer on snow and ice.
• Voice coach, a stamp card, and a replay of every mistake.
• Every rule cites the article of Japan's Road Traffic Act it comes from.

TURN-SIGNAL STALK
In Japanese cars the turn signal is on the right, the wipers on the left. A timed drill until you stop hitting the wipers.

HOW TO TURN
Top-down animations of left and right turns, with the typical mistakes.

ROAD SIGNS
65 common Japanese signs with names, readings and meanings. Flashcards, a quiz and a list of the ones you got wrong.

SCENARIO QUESTIONS
80 questions on railway crossings, flashing signals, pedestrian priority, junctions without signals and more, each with an explanation.

BEFORE YOU GO
License translation for Taiwanese license holders, insurance, refueling, ETC, parking and what to do after an accident, plus five things to do when you first sit in the driver's seat.

ONE-DAY TRIAL AND FULL VERSION
For 24 hours from first launch, everything is open. No payment details, no automatic charge. Afterwards the turn-signal drill, turn animations, sign guide, pre-trip guide and checklist stay available, with part of the quizzes. Driving Practice, including the six real routes, requires the full version: a single purchase that unlocks every level, route and quiz.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no personal data collected. Practice records stay on your device.

This is a practice tool. It does not replace formal driving instruction and is not a license test. The signs, signals and laws you meet in Japan always take priority. Never use your phone while driving.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

LET YOUR DAY UNFOLD

TOTALLY DUO-ABLE

name: Echo: Weich dir selbst aus
description:
Jeder Weg, den du fliegst, kommt zurück.

Halte den Finger auf den Bildschirm, und du steigst. Lass los, und du fällst. Von Wand zu Wand fliegst du von allein und sammelst Funken – doch jeder Funke macht deinen Weg bis dorthin zum Echo. Es fliegt diese Bahn von nun an immer wieder ab, hin und her. Nach ein paar Funken teilst du dir die Arena mit lauter früheren Ichs. Berührst du eines, ist die Partie vorbei.

Weich dir selbst aus.

SO SPIELT SICH ECHO
• Ein Finger: halten zum Steigen, loslassen zum Fallen
• Jeder Funke bringt einen Punkt – und ein neues Echo
• Spring von oben auf ein Echo, und es zerplatzt. Mehrere kurz hintereinander ergeben eine Kette mit immer mehr Punkten
• Der Glutfunke bringt dich zum Glühen: Dann zerplatzt alles, was du berührst
• Zerplatzte Echos kommen nach einer Weile zurück
• Erwischt? Das Glücksrad zeigt offen, wie groß deine Chance ist, dich loszureißen

TAGESECHO
Jeden Tag dieselben Funken für alle – und nur dein erster Versuch zählt.

DUELLE GEGEN FREUNDE
Tausch mit deinen Freunden den Freundescode und fordere sie heraus. Ihr spielt dieselben Funken, und der Lauf deines Gegners fliegt als Geist neben dir her. Jeder Lauf wird auf dem anderen iPhone nachgespielt und geprüft – geschönte Punkte zählen nicht. Mitteilungen melden neue Herausforderungen und Antworten, die Rangliste unter Freunden zeigt, wer vorne liegt. Für Duelle brauchst du ein iCloud-Konto auf deinem iPhone; ein eigenes Konto mit Passwort gibt es nicht.

WERKSTATT OHNE OBERGRENZE
Aus jedem Punkt wird ein Splitter. Damit baust du in der Werkstatt aus:
• Befreien: bessere Chance, dich aus einem Echo loszureißen
• Glühen: länger glühen nach dem Glutfunken
• Nachhall: zerplatzte Echos bleiben länger weg
• Verstärker: 10 % mehr Punkte je Stufe – und damit mehr Splitter
Keine Stufe ist die letzte, jede kostet etwas mehr als die davor. Deine Ausbauten fliegen immer mit, auch im Duell. Und hat dich ein Echo erwischt, lebst du gegen Splitter weiter – ohne Zeitdruck, jedes weitere Mal in derselben Partie zum doppelten Preis.

ECHO PLUS
• Doppelte Splitter aus jeder Partie
• Das erste Weiterleben jeder Partie ist gratis
• Jeden Tag 50 Splitter als Geschenk
• Eine Krone neben deinem Namen bei Freunden und in Duellen

Echo Plus kostet 0,99 € im Monat; in anderen Ländern kann der Preis abweichen. Bezahlt wird über deinen Apple-Account, sobald du den Kauf bestätigst. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch um je einen Monat, wenn du es nicht spätestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf kündigst; die Verlängerung wird in den letzten 24 Stunden vor Ablauf abgerechnet. Kündigen und verwalten kannst du es jederzeit in den Einstellungen deines iPhones: Tippe auf deinen Namen und dann auf „Abonnements“. Nach der Kündigung bleibt Plus bis zum Ende des bezahlten Monats aktiv.

IN-APP-KÄUFE
Echo ist kostenlos und enthält In-App-Käufe: Echo Plus und Splitter-Pakete von 200 bis 30.000 Splittern für 0,99 € bis 99,99 €. Splitter kannst du dir auch erspielen. Gekaufte Splitter sind Verbrauchskäufe und liegen wie deine Werkstatt-Stufen nur auf deinem iPhone – löschst du die App, sind sie weg. Echo Plus stellst du im Laden mit „Käufe wiederherstellen“ auf jedem iPhone mit demselben Apple-Account wieder her. In-App-Käufe lassen sich in den Bildschirmzeit-Einstellungen sperren.

Keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

PERFECT FOR

SIMPLE BY DESIGN

name: EdiosBoneLab
description:
Edios Bone Lab is a completely offline 3D skeletal anatomy and biomechanics reference studio crafted for anatomy learners, biomechanics students, physical science educators, and curious minds on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

SIX INTERACTIVE LEARNING STAGES

1. 3D Skeletal Atlas (206 Bones)
Orbit, zoom, and inspect selectable skeletal regions—Femur, Cranium, Spine, Ribcage, Pelvis, Humerus, and Tibia & Fibula—with cortical vs. trabecular density bars, anatomical landmarks, and an interactive trabecular lattice overlay.

2. Synovial Kinematics (6 Joint Classes)
Compare Hinge, Ball-and-Socket, Pivot, Condyloid, Saddle, and Plane joints using interactive kinematic schematics and live goniometer excursion sliders.

3. Wolff's Law & BMD Educational Simulator
Adjust a simulated World Health Organization (WHO) T-score reference scale (-4.0 to +2.0 SD) and mechanical load profiles to observe how trabecular connectivity, osteoblast deposition, and osteoclast resorption respond to loading.

4. Fracture Morphology & 4-Stage Bone Repair Cascade
Walk step by step through Hematoma (0–48h), Soft Callus (2–3w), Hard Callus (4–12w), and Lamellar Remodeling (1–2y), alongside six classic fracture pattern diagrams.

5. Biomechanical Gait Cycle & Goniometry
Scrub or step through all eight sub-phases of human gait (60% Stance / 40% Swing) with real-time hip, knee flexion, and ankle dorsiflexion goniometry readouts and muscle synergist notes.

6. Osteo-Master Study Quiz + Printable Study Sheets
Reinforce concepts with immediate anatomical rationales, generate a printable PDF Study Sheet via native AirPrint/macOS Print, or export a plain-text Study Summary with one tap.

100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
All 3D models, biomechanical calculations, audio feedback chimes, and printable study exports execute locally on your device—with zero accounts, zero tracking, zero ads, and zero external network calls.

EDUCATIONAL REFERENCE NOTICE
Educational skeletal anatomy and biomechanics reference studio for students, educators, and anatomy learners. Not a medical device, DEXA diagnostic tool, or substitute for licensed orthopedic or medical evaluation.

name: EdT365 Scam Spotter
description:
Please note: EdT365 Scam Spotter is an independent educational app by Edtech365 Solutions Vietnam. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or acting for any government agency. Authorities appear only as the bodies scammers pretend to be; the reporting channels are taken from the official pages listed at the end of this description.

EdT365 Scam Spotter helps you and your family build the habit of recognizing phone and online scams common in Vietnam. Every question is a simulated screen: a text message, a TramChat chat, a phone call, an email, a web page, a social media post, a QR code on a shop counter or a money-transfer screen. Decide Scam or Real, then see the signs highlighted right on the screen, with a short explanation and what to do.

SCAM OR REAL?
- 140+ scenarios, about 4 in 10 perfectly normal genuine messages: you learn to read the signs, not to distrust everything.
- Gold highlights for warning signs, green for signs of a genuine message.
- Some scenarios tell you they are scams and you tap each suspicious detail.

12 COMMON SCAM TYPES
Fake bank staff, fake police, fake family and friends, online shopping and couriers, easy-money tasks, crypto and stock schemes, refunds and public services, fake apps, prizes, online romance, flights and travel, and job scams.

PRACTICE LIKE A GAME
- Every scam type has 3 mastery stars; mistakes go into a review list.
- Today's scenario, a daily streak, levels from Newcomer to Expert, and 16 badges.
- A 10-question Challenge scored by difficulty, with a bonus for answers in a row.

GUIDE
- 12 common warning signs, each with an example.
- The rules: Stop, Check it yourself, Ask someone you trust.
- If you have been scammed: the steps to take right away and the official channels to report to in Vietnam (113, local police, the VNeID app, 5656 and 156, tinnhiemmang.vn), each linked to its source page.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
- Every bank, wallet, carrier, shop, phone number and link in the scenarios is made up and cannot be tapped.
- Scenarios are written by Edtech365 based on official warnings from Vietnamese authorities; sources are listed below and in About.
- A calm, practical tone with no scare tactics.

EASY FOR ADULTS OF ALL AGES
- Large text; light, dark or automatic appearance; a layout made for iPad.
- English and Vietnamese.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. No internet needed. Your progress stays on your device.

- Ministry of Public Security, 25 online scam scripts in 2026: https://bocongan.gov.vn/bai-viet/nang-cao-canh-giac-truoc-25-kich-ban-lua-dao-tren-khong-gian-mang-nam-2026-1788865614

name: EEADYG – Temple Emmanuel
description:
L'application officielle du Temple Emmanuel des Assemblées de Dieu de Yopougon Gare (Abidjan). Restez relié à votre église toute la semaine : annonces, prédications, événements et échanges avec vos frères et sœurs, au même endroit.

ACTUALITÉS ET NOTIFICATIONS
• Les annonces de l'église dès leur publication, avec image
• Des notifications pour ne rien manquer : cultes, réunions, programmes spéciaux

PRÉDICATIONS ET ENSEIGNEMENTS
• Réécoutez et revoyez les prédications et les enseignements
• Retrouvez-les par thème ou par prédicateur

MESSAGERIE DE L'ÉGLISE
• Une discussion pour chaque département et chaque groupe, et le canal « Annonces de l'église »
• Textes, photos, messages vocaux et documents
• Signalement des messages inappropriés, traités par les responsables

ÉVÉNEMENTS ET RÉUNIONS
• Le calendrier des cultes, réunions et événements
• Votre badge digital pour valider votre présence aux réunions

VIE SPIRITUELLE
• La Bible, un plan de lecture et vos méditations personnelles
• Les témoignages de la communauté

DÉPARTEMENTS ET GROUPES
• Le bureau et les membres de chaque département et groupe

ET AUSSI
• Offrandes et dîmes à votre église

• Élections internes et demandes d'adhésion

L'application est réservée aux membres du Temple Emmanuel : la création d'un compte est validée par l'église. Vous pouvez supprimer votre compte à tout moment depuis votre profil.

name: Eefs index
description:
Deze app helpt je een maaltijd of tussendoortje te passen binnen een streefwaarde voor de hoeveelheid koolhydraten. Of je zoekt iets dat je extra vezels levert binnen die streefwaarde. Of je zoekt iets lekkers dat je trek stilt en je calorie-inname beperkt. Deze app heeft het Nederlands Voedingsstoffenbestand (NEVO-lijst) van het RIVM gerangschikt naar hoeveel gram een product is bij het aantal koolhydraten dat je kiest, en wat dan de meeste vezels geeft of de trek het beste stilt.

Je kiest hoeveel gram koolhydraten je wilt eten. De app laat dan bij elk product zien hoeveel gram dat is, met de kcal en vezels in die portie. Andersom kan ook: kies een aantal gram en zie hoeveel koolhydraten, kcal en vezels erin zitten.

Met de camera gaat het nog sneller. Richt hem op je bord en de app herkent wat erop ligt, met Eefs index (Eefi) en hoeveel gram past bij de koolhydraten die je kiest. Herkent de camera iets niet, dan leer je het hem zelf aan met foto's. En dat hoef je niet alleen te doen: deel de foto's met je groepje, dan herkent hun camera het ook, en wat zij aanleren delen zij met jou. Zo leren jullie de app samen het eten te herkennen. Het herkennen werkt op je iPhone, ook zonder internet.

WAT JE ERMEE DOET
• Zoek in 2.328 producten op naam of trefwoord.
• Kies koolhydraten of kies gram; de hele lijst rekent direct mee.
• Sorteer op elke kolom met één tik.
• Markeer je eigen favorieten met een ster en toon alleen die.
• Geef producten eigen trefwoorden, zoals ontbijt of snack.
• Stel eigen gerechten samen en zie de totalen voor koolhydraten, kcal en vezels.
• Vergelijk producten met Eefs index (Eefi): veel vezels bij weinig kcal en weinig koolhydraten scoort hoger.
• Liggend en op de iPad: de Trekindex, een getal van 0 tot 100 uit eiwit en vezels tegenover vet en koolhydraten.

CAMERA
• Lees met stand etiket de barcode, het merk, de naam en het etiket van een verpakking.
• Laat stand eten herkennen wat er voor je ligt.
• Herkent de camera het niet, tik dan op Niet herkend? en leer het zelf aan met foto's.
• Deel de foto's van een product met je groepje.

EIGEN GERECHTEN
Tik op een product en daarna op Zet in gerecht; liggend en op de iPad staat er ook een plusje achter elke regel. Pas per product het aantal gram aan en zie het totaal. Een gerecht dat klaar is, staat tussen de producten in de lijst en rekent mee met je gekozen koolhydraten.

ZONDER INTERNET EN ZONDER ACCOUNT
De lijst en het rekenen werken zonder internet. Er is geen account nodig. Alleen als je een barcode scant, gaat die barcode naar Open Food Facts; als je foto's zoekt bij een product, gaat je zoekterm naar Wikimedia Commons. Delen doe je zelf, via de deelfuncties van Apple. Je favorieten, trefwoorden, eigen gerechten, foto's en je groepje staan alleen op je eigen toestel.

ZES TALEN
Nederlands, Engels, Duits, Frans, Spaans en Italiaans. Zodat je de kaart in het buitenland kunt checken.

GOED LEESBAAR
Letters groter of kleiner met A+ en A−. In liggende stand zijn de kolommen breder.

HERKOMST VAN DE GEGEVENS
Gebaseerd op gegevens van NEVO-online versie 2025/9.0, RIVM, Bilthoven. De voedingswaarden zijn ongewijzigd overgenomen. Eigen gerechten zijn herkenbaar aan het bordje voor de naam. De Duitse, Franse, Spaanse en Italiaanse productnamen zijn voor deze app vertaald, niet door het RIVM.

GEEN MEDISCH ADVIES
Deze app geeft informatie over voedingswaarden en is geen medisch advies. Het is een handig hulpmiddeltje. Overleg met je arts of diëtist over je voeding.

name: Eleska Mail
seller_name: ELESKA INTERNET HIZMETLERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Eleska Mail is a fast, clean and secure email app for your Eleska business email account. The inbox you know from your computer, now on your phone.

STAY INFORMED
• Get a push notification the moment new mail arrives, even when the app is closed.
• Tap the notification to open that email directly.

A TIDY INBOX
• Conversation view: replies on the same subject in one thread.
• Combine unread, attachment and starred filters.
• Fast search across sender, subject and content.
• Labels, pinning, archive and folders.
• Filter rules run on the server, so mail lands in the right folder before it reaches your phone (shared with Roundcube).

EASY WRITING AND REPLYING
• Rich text editor, signatures and attachments.
• Reply, reply all, forward; the conversation thread is kept.
• Undo send and scheduled sending.
• Vacation mode: automatic replies between the dates you choose.

NO LANGUAGE BARRIER
• Translate an incoming email, subject included, into 9 languages with one tap; links and tables are preserved.
• Interface in English, Turkish, German, French and Italian.

WORK WITH AI (optional)
• Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot or Cursor to your mailbox: summarize unread mail, find emails, draft replies.
• Nothing is sent without your approval and your password is never shared.

SECURE AND PRIVATE
• No ads, no tracking, your data is never sold.
• Your emails stay on the Eleska mail server.
• If your password is changed, your session is closed safely.
• Dark mode and an easy-on-the-eyes design.

Eleska Mail works with business email accounts hosted on Eleska. Sign in with your Eleska email address and password.

name: Elf Planner
description:
Make December mornings magical without the last-minute stress!

Elf Planner is your all-in-one December planning companion, designed to help busy parents organize 25 days of elf adventures, keep track of supplies, and capture special holiday memories.

PLAN YOUR DECEMBER
Organize your elf’s daily adventures from December 1–25. Schedule creative setups, add instructions and notes, and mark each day complete.

EXPLORE THE IDEA BANK
Browse reusable elf ideas, save your favourites, and filter by setup time, supplies needed, or ideas you haven’t scheduled yet.

STAY ORGANIZED WITH SHOPPING LISTS
Keep track of everything you need for your elf setups. Add supplies directly from your scheduled activities, check off purchased items, and share your shopping list.

CAPTURE THE MEMORIES
Save photos and notes from completed setups in your personal Photo Log so you can look back on your family’s favourite moments.

MADE FOR BUSY PARENTS

See Tonight’s Setup at a glance.
Track your progress throughout December.
Personalize your planner with your elves’ names.
Reuse your favourite ideas year after year.
Plan and organize offline.
No account registration required.

Spend less time planning and more time enjoying the magic of the season with Elf Planner!

name: Elfo Infame
description:
Manda un video dell’Elfo Infame su WhatsApp e fai ridere tutto il gruppo!

Elfo Infame trasforma in 1 minuto le manie dei tuoi amici, parenti e colleghi in un video natalizio animato con voce italiana parlante, 21 mestieri e 14 sfondi illustrati, un segreto coperto dal [BEEP] e il gioco interattivo "Chi ha fatto la spia?".

COME FUNZIONA IN 3 SEMPLICI PASSI:
1. CREA IL TUO ELFO SU MISURA
Scegli tra 21 mestieri e travestimenti (Poliziotto, Commercialista, Medico, Avvocato, Chef, Operaio, Olimpionico, Ladro e tanti altri), personalizza corporatura, viso, occhi, capelli, barba, vestiti e accessori — oppure scatta una foto e metti la tua faccia sull’Elfo!

2. SCEGLI LA SCENETTA, LE FRASI E LA VOCE ITALIANA
• 3 scenette animate HD (Salotto Taglia Luci, Studio TG Polo Nord, Elfo Commercialista) e 14 sfondi illustrati abbinati ai mestieri.
• 8 voci italiane diverse e 3 toni di recitazione: Simpatico, Infame o Senza Freni.
• Modalità Scherzo, Auguri di Natale o Auguri Aziendali con il tuo logo sulla divisa e sull’insegna!

3. METTI IL [BEEP] E INVIA SU WHATSAPP, REELS E TIKTOK
Inserisci un piccolo segreto coperto dal [BEEP]. Chi riceve il link guarda subito il video senza login e ha 3 tentativi con indizi progressivi per smascherare chi ha fatto la spia e sbloccare il video senza censura!

PRIVACY E SICUREZZA:
• Video, foto e testi eliminati automaticamente dopo 60 giorni.
• Moderazione automatica e pulsante "Segnala questo video".
• Eliminazione account completa direttamente in-app dalla sezione Account.

name: EMBER BARRAGE
description:
Hold the perimeter in EMBER BARRAGE, a portrait defense shooter. Drag left or right to guide your squad while it fires automatically. Break supply crates to recruit teammates and boost your firepower.

CAMPAIGN
Clear five defense missions and replay sectors to earn challenge stars.

ENDLESS DEFENSE
Keep your squad alive through successive waves and try to beat your personal best.

FIELD KIT
Bring up to two supplies into battle. Choose when to deploy a shield, call in supplies, or use a rescue beacon.

GEAR
Earn crystals in battle and spend them on outfits, effects, and supplies. Optional crystal packs are available through in-app purchase.

Music and sound effects have separate controls. Progress and your crystal balance are saved on your device.

name: Ember Run: Mesa Blaster
seller_name: Bidwell Family Farms Limited Liability Company
description:
The mining machines have gone rogue, and the mesa belongs to them now. Grab your rifle and take it back.

Ember Run is a fast, colorful run-and-gun arcade game built for iPhone. Sprint across a desert mesa at dusk, leap between steel ledges, blast waves of spiked scrapper bots, buzzing drones, cannon turrets and heavy crusher walkers, then fight your way through a lamp-lit mine tunnel to face the Harvester, a towering machine with a buzz saw, twin cannons and a core laser.

PICK YOUR HERO
• Sgt. Buck Liberty: a square-jawed veteran commando with a heavy rifle
• Juno: a quick salvage pilot with a red scarf and a pulse blaster

FOUR WEAPONS
• Pulse: reliable, all-round blaster
• Fan: five-way spread shot
• Rapid: a stream of fast rounds
• Lance: a piercing beam that cuts through rows of enemies
Shoot down supply carriers to grab new weapons.

BIG BOSS FIGHT
The Harvester tears open as you damage it, calls in drones, and charges a laser you'll need to dodge.

MADE FOR TOUCH
A floating stick on the left, jump and fire on the right. Aim in eight directions, crouch, and drop through ledges.

ARCADE EXTRAS
• Chase your best score
• Explosions, debris and screen shake on every kill
• Original chiptune soundtrack and sound effects
• A classic secret code on the title screen for extra lives

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No data collected.

name: Encore Room
description:
Encore Room gives singers a place to prepare for their next performance and hear how their practice is going. Use it for an open mic, a party set, or an evening of singing at home.

SET DATES
Keep venue details, set lists, and soundcheck notes together. See upcoming and past performances, and set a local reminder for showtime.

SONGBOOK
Keep your go-to songs in one place. Record each song's key, tempo, vocal range, arrangement, and rehearsal notes. Export your songbook as a CSV and share it from your iPhone.

VOICE LAB
Record a practice take, play it back, and note what you want to work on next. Keep exercises and recordings together so you can revisit them between rehearsals.

PITCH MONITOR
Sing a steady note to see its pitch in real time. The monitor shows the nearest note, frequency in hertz, and how flat or sharp you are in cents.

INSTRUMENTS
Track the instruments you play alongside your singing, including tuning, repertoire, and maintenance notes.

The app opens with editable examples so you can explore each section right away. Your library and saved practice recordings are stored on your device.

KEYWORDS
singing,voice recorder,vocal warmup,pitch monitor,tuner,setlist,gig planner,voice training,rehearsal

name: Enravage
description:
Your camera roll has thousands of photos. A handful are worth posting. Enravage finds them.

Keep five photos you'd post and Enravage starts learning your eye: the light, the angles and the moments you actually like. Then it works through your whole library and picks the shots worth posting. The more you rate, the more the picks look like you.

HOW IT WORKS
• Rate: Keep or Pass, one photo at a time. It starts with photos from across your whole library, not just this week's.
• Picks: a grid of your next posts, chosen by your taste. Pin, swap or reorder, and see why each photo was picked.
• Best of the burst: ten look-alike shots become one. Enravage shows the sharpest, best-composed one, and you can swap it in a tap.
• Set aside: screenshots, documents, blurry and dark shots are kept out of the way. Change your mind? Show anyway, or bring back a whole category.
• Browse: explore your library by look, and see why a photo didn't make the cut.
• People: optionally group photos by who's in them. Off until you turn it on.
• Saved: everything you save goes into an "Enravage" album in Photos, ready to post.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Every photo is analysed on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, nothing is sent to us.
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking.
• Free. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases.
• Enravage never edits, moves or deletes your photos.

Made by one person who wanted a faster way to find the photos worth posting.

name: Ephodoner
description:
Follow stocks and ETFs listed on TWSE and TPEx, from the day's index moves to who bought and who sold.

See the market's day in one screen: TAIEX and the TPEx index, how many stocks rose and fell, how many closed at limit up or limit down, sector moves, and the day's gainers, losers and most active names.

Find out who moved the money. Ephodoner breaks out net buying and selling by foreign investors, local fund houses and dealers, session by session. Slide across recent sessions to replay each day, see which stocks each group bought or sold most, and spot the names they've been buying or selling several sessions in a row.

Open a stock's page for its candlestick chart with 5, 20 and 60-day averages, the five bid and ask levels, today's price band between its daily limits, valuation ratios, and how much each investor group bought or sold over recent sessions.

Plan around dividends with a calendar of coming ex-dates, cash amounts and yields, and a gap tracker that shows how much of each recent ex-date's price drop has been recovered.

Keep your own records too. Log what you bought, add a target and a stop, and see your holdings' value, today's change, and what a sale at the current price would leave after brokerage and transaction tax. A watchlist keeps the stocks you follow one tap away. Your records stay on your device.

Market data is shown for reference only and does not constitute investment, financial or trading advice.

name: EpochHarbor
description:
Convert Unix seconds, milliseconds and ISO dates; inspect one instant across time zones; validate and export timestamp batches.

1. Choose the input format and source time zone.
2. Enter one timestamp, or import a UTF-8 CSV and map its timestamp column.
3. Choose target time zones. Resolve ambiguous repeated local times explicitly.
4. Inspect valid rows and row-level errors, then save a named batch.
5. Export a CSV or PDF snapshot from the batch result.

Time-zone rules come from the installed system. Invalid dates and missing DST times are rejected. Repeated local times require a choice.

name: EventLead: Client Events
description:
EventLead helps companies that host events for their own clients, from the guest list to the report after the event.

Each group or agency submits its guests through a private link or an Excel file. A person you choose approves every guest, and duplicates between groups are flagged to you. EventLead prepares one invitation draft per guest in the guest's language, and you send it from your own mailbox when you decide.

You follow registrations per group and in total, with the replies still missing. The registration page carries your logo and colours, with the programme, the practical information and a waitlist when the event is full.

On the day, the app becomes your check-in desk. Tick arrivals or scan the personal QR code sent with the confirmation. Check-in works without network. It syncs when the connection returns, and the colleagues you chose are told as soon as key guests arrive, so they can come and greet them.

After the event, the photographer uploads the photos through a private link and your guests find them in a private gallery.

EventLead uses the Lead account shared by the Lead apps. Create it in the app or sign in with yours, and delete it from the app whenever you like. The app sells nothing.

name: Everpage: Decorated Journal
description:
Everpage is a decorated journal for iPhone and iPad. Write with Apple Pencil or your finger, type, and add photos, stickers, washi tape and even a little music player to the same page.

BIND A NOTEBOOK OF YOUR OWN
• Pick a binding, a cover, the paper and a name, then close the book yourself.
• Over 100 paper templates: lined, grid, dot, planners, monthly calendars, Cornell, Japanese patterns.
• A5 or A4, with pages that turn like a real notebook.

WRITE AND DRAW
• Pen, highlighter, brushes (marker, watercolour, crayon, pencil), and an eraser that removes whole strokes or just where you touch.
• Smooth ink with Apple Pencil; hold the pen to snap a line, circle or rectangle.
• Ruler, zoom box for small writing, and search that finds your handwriting.

DECORATE
• Thousands of stickers, plus washi tape, covers and seasonal paper.
• Photos cut into circles, hearts and stars; lift a photo's subject right on the device.
• A vintage music player with instrumental tracks to write to.

ON IPAD
• Two pages open side by side like a real book; drag a sticker across the spine.
• Apple Pencil has Write and Swipe modes for turning pages.
• Import a PDF and write right on it.

QUICK NOTES
• Notes, checklists, document scans, text from photos, and voice memos.
• Stick a note into a notebook with one tap.

YOUR NOTEBOOKS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
• No account. Notebooks, photos and recordings live only on your device.
• Back up to one file and restore on a new device.
• Export a PDF or an image to print and share.

FREE PACKS AND COINS
Many sticker, washi, paper and music packs are free: claim them with welcome tickets, or by watching a short video when you choose to. Other packs open with coins you earn by writing each day or watching videos. No ads while you write.

Privacy policy: https://everpage.work/privacy
Support: support@everpage.work

name: EvPlay Mirror: Phone to Car
description:
Show whatever is on your phone on the car screen: navigation, music, messages, video or any other app.

EvPlay Mirror brings your phone screen to a car screen that has a web browser (or to any screen with a browser). No cable, no adapter, nothing to install in the car: the picture arrives over the car's own internet connection.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open evplay.app/yansit in the browser of the car screen.
2. Scan the QR code on that screen with EvPlay Mirror.
3. Tap "Start broadcast", then switch to the app you want to show.

Put the phone down; its screen stays on the car screen. Stop at any time from the app or from the red indicator at the top of your phone screen.

HIGHLIGHTS
• Every app on your phone, on the car screen: directions, music, podcasts, photos
• Sharp picture, low delay
• Nothing to install: works on any screen with a browser
• No account, no sign-in

PRIVACY
The video goes through our server only to the screen you paired with; it is not recorded or stored. No sound is sent. The app has no ads and no tracking.

SAFETY
If you are driving, touch the phone and the car screen only while the car is stopped, and follow traffic laws.

SUBSCRIPTION
EvPlay Mirror requires a subscription: monthly or yearly, both starting with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://evplay.app/en/gizlilik

name: Exodaki: Expenses & Budget
description:
• The receipt QR. Scan the QR code on a Greek cash-register receipt and the amount and time fill in by themselves. The app remembers the shop, and next time it fills in the category too.
• Apple Pay logs itself. Set up one automation in Shortcuts and every payment with your iPhone is logged, without opening the app.
• No internet and no account. Everything stays on your iPhone and pictures are read on the device. The app does not collect, send or share any data.

FROM YOUR BANK, WITHOUT TYPING
• Screenshots from your banking app: one screenshot becomes many transactions, up to 10 pictures at a time.
• Statement files from e-banking: CSV, Excel (.xlsx) and PDF. The app finds the columns and remembers them for next time.
• Share from other apps: send the file or the screenshot to Exodaki.
• Nothing goes in before you see the list and choose what goes in, the category and whether it is an expense or income. Anything uncertain waits under To review for you to fix.
• No piled-up duplicates: the same purchase from QR and Apple Pay becomes one entry, and anything that looks like a duplicate in a file or screenshot starts unticked.

WHEN THERE IS NO QR
• Photo of the receipt: the app finds the total, the date and the shop.
• E-invoicing QR codes have no amount inside, so the app takes you to the photo instead.
• By hand in 3 taps: amount, category, done.

BUDGETS AND THE 30% RULE
• Monthly budgets per category and in total, colored when you get close or go over.
• A meter for the Greek 30% rule: how much you have paid electronically this year against 30% of your income, with an estimate of the tax on the gap. The official figure is always in myAADE.
• Charts: the month by category, the last 12 months and one category over time.
• Greek categories from the start, yours to change, and search that ignores accents.

YOUR DATA, IN YOUR HANDS
• Lock with Face ID or your iPhone passcode.
• Back up everything to one file and restore from it.
• Export your transactions to CSV for any spreadsheet.

Greek and English, amounts in euros. Light or dark, following your iPhone. Large text and VoiceOver. Free, with no ads, purchases or subscription.

name: ExpoApp
description:
ExpoApp, fuar, kongre ve etkinliklere katılanlar için hazırlanmış resmi etkinlik uygulamasıdır. Girişten oturum programına, katılımcı firmalardan iş bağlantılarınıza kadar etkinlikte ihtiyacınız olan her şey tek bir uygulamada.

Kayıt olurken kullandığınız telefon numaranız veya e-posta adresinizle, SMS ya da e-postayla gönderilen tek kullanımlık kodla giriş yaparsınız. Şifre hatırlamanıza gerek yoktur.

HIZLI VE TEMASSIZ GİRİŞ
• Kişisel QR kodunuz her zaman telefonunuzda hazır
• Turnikede ya da kayıt masasında kodunuzu okutun, sıra beklemeden içeri girin
• Yaka kartı yazdırmanıza ya da çıktı taşımanıza gerek kalmaz

ETKİNLİK PROGRAMI
• Tüm oturumları gün, saat, salon ve konuşmacı bilgileriyle görün
• İlgilendiğiniz oturumları favorilerinize ekleyerek kendi programınızı oluşturun
• Favori oturumlarınız başlamadan önce hatırlatma bildirimi alın
• Oturum bittiğinde kısa bir değerlendirme anketiyle görüşünüzü paylaşın

KATILIMCI FİRMALARI KEŞFEDİN
• Etkinlikte yer alan firmaları sektör, kategori, salon ve stand bilgisiyle inceleyin
• Arama ve filtrelerle aradığınız firmaya saniyeler içinde ulaşın
• Her firmanın sayfasında ürünlerini, açıklamasını ve iletişim bilgilerini görün
• Firmanın dijital kataloğunu uygulama içinden açın
• Web sitesi, e-posta, telefon ve LinkedIn bağlantılarına tek dokunuşla erişin

SİZE UYGUN FİRMALAR
• İlgilendiğiniz sektörleri ve kategorileri seçin
• ExpoApp, seçimlerinizle örtüşen katılımcı firmaları size önersin
• Fuar alanında zaman kaybetmeden doğru standlara yönelin

KARTVİZİT OKUTUN, BAĞLANTI KURUN
• Tanıştığınız kişilerin QR kodunu okutarak onları bağlantılarınıza ekleyin
• Her bağlantıya not ve etiket ekleyerek görüşmelerinizi kayıt altına alın
• Ziyaretçi listesinden kişileri doğrudan bağlantılarınıza ekleyin
• Topladığınız bağlantıları CSV dosyası olarak dışa aktarıp ekibinizle paylaşın

DUYURULAR VE BİLDİRİMLER
• Organizatörün yaptığı duyuruları duyuru panosundan takip edin
• Program değişiklikleri, salon güncellemeleri ve önemli gelişmeler anında bildirim olarak gelsin
• Geçmiş bildirimlerinize istediğiniz zaman geri dönün

ANKETLER
• Organizatörün hazırladığı anketlere uygulama üzerinden katılın
• Etkinliğin daha iyi hale gelmesine katkıda bulunun

GİZLİLİĞİNİZE ÖNEM VERİYORUZ
• Bilgileriniz yalnızca kayıtlı olduğunuz etkinlik kapsamında kullanılır
• Hesabınızı ve verilerinizi dilediğiniz zaman silme talebinde bulunabilirsiniz

ExpoApp, Visitego altyapısını kullanan etkinliklerde çalışır. Uygulamayı kullanabilmek için etkinliğe kayıtlı olmanız gerekir. Hangi modüllerin açık olduğu etkinliği düzenleyen organizatöre göre değişebilir.

Etkinliğinizin tamamı cebinizde. ExpoApp'i indirin, fuarı ve kongreyi en verimli şekilde değerlendirin.

name: Ezus Trip
description:
Ezus Trip is the companion app for the trip your travel agency organised for you.

Enter the code your agency gave you, or scan its QR code, and find your whole trip in one place:

• The day-by-day programme, with times, addresses and useful contacts.
• A map of your stops, available offline.
• Your travel documents, kept on your phone.
• Messages from your agency and programme updates, by notification.
• The essentials before you leave: packing list, formalities, local customs, emergency numbers.
• A personal travel journal that stays on your phone.
• Depending on your trip: a group chat, a shared photo album, and an assistant that answers questions about your programme.

No account to create, no password: your agency's code is all you need.

No code yet? Explore the app with the sample trip.

Ezus Trip shows no advertising and does not sell your data.

name: Fable: Sealed Capsules
description:
Fable gives a small circle a shared moment to look forward to. Create a private photo capsule, choose when it opens, and let each member add one image before the host seals it.

Make an invite-only circle and invite friends by their handles. While a capsule is gathering, members can add or change their own contribution. Once sealed, editing stops and the contributions remain closed until the chosen opening time.

When the date arrives, open the capsule, look through the photographs, reply and appreciate the moments your circle kept. Waiting holds capsules still to open, and Gallery gathers the ones already revealed.

Community is a separate public space. Share a photo and caption, add an optional place label or a voice note of up to 30 seconds, then follow people, save posts and join their comments. Private circle capsules are kept separate from public community posts.

An account and internet connection are needed to sync circles, capsules and community content. Photo selection uses the system picker. Camera and microphone access are requested for their optional posting actions; saving a community photo requests add-only Photos access. Settings provides profile and account controls, blocked people, reporting access and published privacy information.

name: Fantasy Map Maker - Inklands
seller_name: MAKS YAZILIM VE TEKNOLOJI SANAYI TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Inklands is a fantasy map maker built for iPad and Apple Pencil. Draw the coast of your world, brush in its mountains and forests, name its kingdoms, and finish with a sheet you can print.

DRAW IT, DON'T ASSEMBLE IT
• Coast pen: paint the land and the coastline inks itself, with shallows drawn around every shore.
• Range brush: one stroke lays a chain of mountains, hills or volcanoes.
• Terrain brush: forest, marsh, dunes, snow and grassland.
• Line pen: rivers that widen toward the sea, roads that meet the towns they serve, borders that follow coasts and rivers.
• Stamps: hamlets, towns, cities and capitals, each with a name you can change.
• Label quill: letter realms, seas and notes straight, or along any curve you draw.
• Ink pen, wash and eraser for hand-drawn detail, with Apple Pencil pressure and tilt.

EVERYTHING STAYS EDITABLE
Every mountain range, river, town and name is an object in its own layer, not paint. Move a city, rename a sea, turn a forest into a marsh or take a road away, long after you drew it. Show, hide and reorder layers in the legend.

FINISH THE SHEET
• A neat line in single, double or ornate rule
• A compass rose and a title cartouche
• A hex or square grid, and a scale bar in your own units

PRINT IT
World, region, city and battle map sheets up to 8192 × 6144 pixels at 300 dpi. Export PNG or PDF.

FOR WORLDBUILDERS, AUTHORS AND GAME MASTERS
Map the setting of your novel, the kingdom your D&D or Pathfinder campaign crosses, or the battle map for the next session of your tabletop RPG.

YOUR MAPS ARE YOURS
Maps are files on your iPad, or in your own iCloud Drive if you move them there. No account, no advertising.

INKLANDS PRO
Free keeps one map and exports up to 2048 pixels with a small "Made with Inklands" line. Inklands Pro keeps every map and exports the full sheet, clean. Pro is a subscription billed monthly or yearly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Fathomboard
description:
Find out how far each major coin sits below its all-time high, and how today's fall compares with the ones that came before.

• A water column of the largest coins, each placed at its distance from its high. Drag the line to count how many sit deeper.
• Depth zones from the shallows to the trench, with lists sorted by depth, size or time spent below the high
• Coin pages with an underwater chart, the deepest past falls and how long each took to recover
• Climb back: drag to a depth and see the rise needed to return
• Past Dives: the current fall of Bitcoin, Ethereum or the total market laid over earlier cycles, day by day from each high
• Dive Log: your own purchase records with target and stop levels, kept on your iPhone

Stablecoins, wrapped and staked tokens and tokenized assets are left out, so the lists show coins whose prices move on their own.

Market data is shown for reference only and does not constitute investment, financial or trading advice.

name: Fawnsong: Christian Pregnancy
description:
Fawnsong is a calm companion for Christian moms preparing to give birth. A few quiet minutes a day: a guided prayer, a verse for your week, and slow breathing you can carry into labor.

GUIDED SESSIONS
20 guided prayers and relaxations, 5 to 15 minutes, for pregnancy, every stage of labor, induction, cesarean birth, long hospital nights, your birth partner and the first days home. Turn on soft rain if you like. Everything plays offline.

FITS YOUR BIRTH PLAN
Choose vaginal birth, induction, planned cesarean or not sure yet. Fawnsong suggests sessions that fit your plan and how you feel today: anxious, can't sleep, tired, hopeful, or labor started.

A VERSE FOR EVERY WEEK
See your pregnancy week and a Bible verse with a short reflection for each week from 4 to 42.

THE WAVE
A full-screen breathing pacer for labor. The wave rises as you breathe in and falls as you breathe out, with one short phrase of Scripture on each breath, large enough for your partner to read from across the room. Choose Calm 4/6 or Slow 4/8, with gentle haptics.

BIRTH DECK
60 cards that pair a short affirmation with a verse, in themes like Strength, Peace, Trust, Made by God and Baby. Build My labor deck of up to 15 cards and present them full screen during labor, one card at a time.

PRAYER JOURNAL
Write prayers for your baby, mark the ones God answered and add how. Search them any time.

ONE-TIME PRO, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Start with 5 sessions and 24 cards. Fawnsong Pro is a single purchase that unlocks all 20 sessions, all 60 cards and Present mode. No subscription to cancel.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your prayers stay on your iPhone.

Scripture quotations are from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB), public domain. Guided sessions use an AI-generated voice. Fawnsong is for calm and prayer. It is not medical advice and not a substitute for your doctor or midwife. Always follow your care team's guidance.

name: Fellside: Stone Wall Puzzle
seller_name: TUTKU YAZILIM BILGISAYAR HIZMETLERI SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Fellside is a calm, relaxing puzzle game about an old country craft: building dry stone walls with no mortar at all.

Every job is a gap in an old field wall. Pick a stone from the grass, carry it over the wall and see its shadow show you exactly how it will sit. Turn it, flip it, dress it flat with the hammer and find the place where it locks in. Lay one stone across two, keep the joints from lining up, reach the string and set the cope. Then the farmer walks the wall and gives you up to three stars and your day's wages.

• Five dales, five kinds of stone: limestone, gritstone, slate, granite and schist, each with its own character
• An endless round: every lap brings a new season – spring, summer, autumn and snow-covered winter
• Today's wall: a special wall every day and a run of days with prizes
• My valley: every two walls something new appears on your own land – a farmhouse, a sheepfold, an orchard, sheep…
• The stone book: 30 rare finds hide in the heaps – ammonites, trilobites, crystals, garnets
• Waller's names from Apprentice to Legend of the Dales, each with better pay
• No timer, no rush, no lives. Plays offline. Ten languages.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, building games and quiet brain teasers, Fellside is a peaceful place to unwind: a relaxing stone puzzle where every wall you build is your own, set in hand-painted countryside with sheep, ponies and goats grazing beyond the wall.

name: Felora: Cozy Island Resort
description:
Welcome to Felora, a cozy island resort you build at your own pace.

Start with a small beach and a single villa. Build cottages, a restaurant, a pool and a dive centre, and watch your tiny island turn into a resort guests dream about.

YOUR ISLAND, YOUR STYLE
• Build and upgrade villas, restaurants, pools and more
• Paint roofs and decorate paths, palms and boardwalks
• Earn reputation stars and unlock new buildings as you level up

GUESTS WHO LOVE YOUR ISLAND
• Welcome VIP guests and read their reviews in your guest book
• Send guests diving and fill your reef log with new species
• Complete Coco's daily goals for rewards

RELAXED IDLE PLAY
• Your resort keeps earning while you're away
• Hire and train staff to run the island for you
• Collect postcards as you travel through your resort journey

FAIR AND CALM
• No ads
• Everything on your island can be earned for free
• Gems only save time, they never decide who progresses
• Your island is saved in the cloud, so you can bring it to a new phone

Coco the parrot is waiting on the beach. Your island resort starts now.

name: Feuerwehr Eignungstest Trainer
description:
Diese App ist kein Angebot einer Feuerwehr, einer Stadt oder einer anderen Behörde. Sie dient der privaten Vorbereitung auf das Auswahlverfahren.

Die App ist für Bewerberinnen und Bewerber bei der Berufsfeuerwehr gemacht, zum Beispiel für die Ausbildung zur Brandmeisterin oder zum Brandmeister.

TECHNISCHES VERSTÄNDNIS
40 Aufgaben zu Hebel, Zahnrädern, Flaschenzug, Druck und Hydraulik, Auftrieb, Wärme und einfacher Elektrik, jede mit Erklärung und Rechenweg.

FEUERWEHR-FACHWISSEN
40 Fragen zu Brandklassen und Löschmitteln, Verbrennung, Organisation der Feuerwehr und taktischen Einheiten, jeweils mit Erklärung.

FEUERWEHR IN DEINER STADT (KOSTENLOS)
Ablauf des Einstellungstests, Sporttest, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Seiten der Berufsfeuerwehren Berlin, Dortmund, Frankfurt am Main, Hamburg, Köln und München.

TESTSIMULATION
30 Aufgaben in 30 Minuten mit technischem Verständnis, Mathematik, Sprache, Logik und Allgemeinwissen, danach eine Auswertung nach Bereichen.

DIE GRUNDLAGEN DES TESTS
Mathematik: Dreisatz, Prozent und Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen, Zahlenpuzzle
Sprache: Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien, alphabetische Reihen
Logik: Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix, Dominosteine
Gedächtnis: Zahlen merken, Buchstaben merken
Allgemeinwissen mit Themenfilter

SO FUNKTIONIERT DIE APP
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen. „Feuerwehr in deiner Stadt“ ist immer kostenlos.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen einer Feuerwehr.

name: Final countdown: Years Left
description:
Final countdown turns a date and a time horizon you choose into a simple daily countdown. Set your birth date and the number of years, then see the remaining time and progress in the app or on your Home Screen.

Choose from four widget styles and light or dark widget themes. Add multiple widgets and configure each one separately. Your settings stay on your device and are shared only between the app and its widget extension. No account or internet connection is required.

The time horizon is your personal reference point, not a prediction of life expectancy.

name: FishSpot: Fishing Map & Tides
description:
Check the tide, the sea and the best places before you go fishing, and find out what you caught with a photo. FishSpot puts tides, currents, waves and wind, rivers and lakes, thousands of fishing places and the fish of each area on one 3D satellite map.

A MAP MADE FOR ANGLERS
• Apple satellite imagery: tap 3D and tilt the map to see the coast, coves and jetties in relief.
• Rivers, streams, canals, lakes and reservoirs in blue, on from the start.
• Layers from one button: Tides, Sea direction, Fishing places and Fish in the area, plus towns, trails and contour lines.
• Press and hold any point to open its card: the tide, the sea and the fish of that place, with Save as my spot and Go.

TIDES AT A GLANCE
• More than 3,600 stations in 110 countries, calculated right on your device: high, mid or low tide, rising or falling, and its height.
• Tap one for the next high and low tide with time and height, the 24-hour curve and today's range. At the top, always, the station nearest the center of the map.
• Where the tide is only a few centimeters, as in the Mediterranean, it tells you: there, wind and pressure rule.

WHERE THE SEA IS MOVING
• Animated particles follow the current, the waves or the wind.
• At any point: current in knots and where it flows, wave height, where it comes from and its period in seconds, and wind in km/h. Data from HYCOM and NOAA, with its time.

WHERE TO FISH AND WHAT LIVES THERE
• More than 9,700 fishing places in 26 countries, mapped by people on OpenStreetMap: sea, river or lake, and whether they are paid. Save them as your spots.
• Fish in the area: species recorded nearby (GBIF), river and lake or sea, with an approximate season when it is known. During the salmon run, if salmon have been recorded nearby, they show first, with a closed-season warning.

WHAT FISH IS THIS?
• Take a photo or pick one from your library: the AI gives you the common and scientific name with its confidence, and warns you when it is low.
• Whether it is edible (edible, eat with caution, not edible or toxic), with real risks such as anisakis.
• Whether it is dangerous to handle because of spines or venom, whether it is protected or on Spain's invasive species list, its features and look-alikes.
• No minimum sizes, closed seasons, bag limits or license rules, which change by area and year: check your local rules.

YOUR CATCHES AND YOUR SPOTS
• Post your catch with a photo and a description, and tick "I put it back in the water". You choose who sees where you caught it: only you (the default), your friends or everyone.
• Save spots with GPS or by tapping the map. They stay private until you share them with friends, on your wall or by message.
• Go: a compass that points to the spot with bearing and distance, plus Directions by car in your maps app.
• Add friends with a code and see their catches and the spots they share with you.

NO EMAIL, NO PASSWORD
All you need is a name. It needs the internet to identify fish, load the map and sea data, and share. Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple silicon (Macs have no compass, so Go shows bearing and distance).

FREE AND PRO
• Free to download, with ads: a banner and a short video before each photo analysis. Every feature is free.
• FishSpot Pro, a subscription, removes the banner and the videos; you see the price in the app before paying.
• There is a daily limit on photo analyses per account, with or without Pro.
• The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends, in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

IMPORTANT: the AI can be wrong, and tides are an astronomical prediction without wind or waves. Do not rely on the app alone to go out to sea or fish from rocks, and always check your local fishing rules.

Download FishSpot and plan your next fishing trip.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://cdpoma.github.io/fishspot/privacidad.html

name: Fling Fortress
description:
Pull back the slingshot, let your hero fly and send a whole fortress of skeletons tumbling!

Fling Fortress is a bite-sized physics roguelite. Every run takes you through the Wobbly Woods: ten stages of wobbly forts, tough elites and a boss who will not stay still. Aim, release and watch the blocks crash.

FLING, BONK, REPEAT
• Drag back to aim, release to fling – easy to learn, satisfying to master
• Wooden walls break, stone walls don't, ice is slippery and powder barrels explode in chains
• Clear a stage with fewer shots to earn more stars

BUILD A WILD COMBO EVERY RUN
• After each stage, pick one of three Sling Charms
• Stack bounces, explosions, ghost copies, magnets and more
• No two runs play the same

COLLECT CUTE HEROES
• Flit, Smolder, Puffcap and friends, each with a tap ability in mid-air
• Level heroes up, gear them with helmets, armour and charms
• Open chests for gear and hero shards – the odds are shown in the game

YOUR CAMP KEEPS WORKING
• The kitchen and training dummy earn coins and XP while you're away
• Come back, collect and upgrade

FAIR AND FRIENDLY
• Play offline, no account needed
• Ads only play when you choose to watch one for a reward
• Optional gem packs and a one-time starter pack

Pull back. Let it fly. Bonk the fort!

name: Flip Through
description:
Open your camera roll and start with one small batch. Swipe through photos, keep your favorites, and set aside items for deletion. Undo a choice or review the pending list before confirming with Apple Photos.

ON THIS DAY
Open a date to see photos from past years. Browse each year’s album and revisit the day in the order it happened.

PLACES
Explore geotagged photos and videos by country, city and day. Tap a stop on the map to see the photos taken there.

REVIEW AT YOUR PACE
Browse videos, focus on screenshots, play Live Photos and check your review statistics. You control which photos the app can access.

TRY YOUR OWN LIBRARY
Use all real-library features free for 48 hours on this device. The trial starts when you choose it and ends without an automatic charge. A sample library is available anytime.

After the trial, Full Library Monthly unlocks continued access to your own library. The US price is $0.99 per month. Your App Store shows the local price before you buy. The subscription renews automatically until canceled. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://flip-through-photos.sunset-isle-2889.chatgpt.site/privacy.html

name: Focus Bakery: Study Timer
description:
Meet Crumble, a tiny hedgehog baker who bakes while you focus.
Start a pomodoro-style focus session, put your phone down, and watch dough turn into pastries. Every finished session joins your display case.
Gentle, cozy and lock-friendly: a calm space for study sessions, deep work and ADHD-friendly focus without the pressure.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose 15, 25, 45, 60 or 90 minutes, or a custom time from 10 to 120.
• Add an optional tag (Study, Work, Read, Create or your own) and a short task note.
• Crumble mixes, kneads, proofs, bakes and decorates as your session moves along.
• Finish to collect your pastry and earn crumbs and XP.
• Take a 5, 10 or 15 minute break, then bake again.

LOCKING YOUR PHONE NEVER COUNTS
Lock your screen and walk away. Your bake keeps going.
If you switch apps, you get a grace period (10 seconds by default, adjustable from 5 to 30) and a friendly nudge.
• Gentle mode (default): the bake pauses and Crumble waits while the dough cools. Pause more than 3 times, or for more than 5 minutes, and you get a flat loaf.
• Strict mode: leaving past the grace period makes a flat loaf.
Flat loaves are funny little collectibles with their own gallery. No guilt trips, ever.

COLLECT AND DECORATE
• 70+ recipes across 6 tiers
• 150+ decor items: counters, shelves, lights, plants, wall art, rugs, wallpaper, floors and window views
• 25+ outfits for Crumble
All paid for with crumbs you earn by focusing.

GROW A WHOLE STREET
Your total focus hours grow the bakery into a street: Bakery, Café Corner, Upstairs Flat, Flower Stall, Bookshop and Tea House.

LITTLE DAILY RITUALS
• Today's Special: 2× crumbs on one bake a day
• A daily goal of 1 to 6 bakes, with a bonus chest
• Streaks with automatic streak freezes (earn one per 7-day streak, hold up to 2)
• A weekly order board with 3 customer orders
• Seasonal menus throughout the year, from Winter Menu and Strawberry Season to Spooky Sweets and Cozy Cocoa

STATS AND SHARING
• Today, week and month totals
• A bar chart by day and a flour-dust calendar heatmap
• Breakdown by tag and your best streak
• Share cards sized for stories (9:16) and Pins (2:3)

HOME SCREEN WIDGET
Today's bakes vs. your goal, your streak and a tiny picture of your bakery.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No data collected. Works in airplane mode. Export or import a backup file any time.

FOCUS BAKERY PLUS
An optional one-time purchase: the Moonlit Patisserie decor set, extra outfits, unlimited custom tags, full stats history and an evening theme. The core baking loop is always free.

Put the phone down. Crumble's got the oven.

name: Focus-UNIWA
description: Το Focus-UNIWA είναι η εφαρμογή του Πανεπιστημίου Δυτικής Αττικής. Φέρνει ειδήσεις από τα ελληνικά πανεπιστήμια, ανακοινώσεις του ΠΑΔΑ και προκηρύξεις προγραμμάτων και υποτροφιών.

name: Fog Map: Uncertainty Check
description:
Fog is not a wall. It’s a map you haven’t drawn yet.

Some days the uncertainty is loud: a decision you can’t make, news you’re waiting for, a plan that keeps dissolving. Fog Map gives that background hum a shape — and turns it into one small step you can take today.

HOW IT WORKS
• Nine quiet ratings. Rate how clear each zone of your life feels today across Matter (money, body, time), Information (facts, goals, plans) and Energy (feelings, motivation, strength) — What, Whither and How.
• Your fog index. See today’s fog from 0 to 100 — clear day, moderate fog or thick fog — with a five-band battery and a nine-zone map.
• The one cell that matters. Fog Map finds your main gap: the place where one small action gives the most clarity.
• Three honest strategies. Reduce (find out, ask, check, try), Insure (prepare a cushion, plan B or skill) or Endure (walk through it with rest, support and the body). Each comes with a concrete 10–15 minute step, its limits, and what to notice afterwards.

A DAILY CLARITY RITUAL
• History and trend chart: watch your fog lift over days and weeks.
• Streaks and a “step done” check-off.
• Gentle daily reminders at the time you choose.
• A beautiful share card of today’s map.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Fog Map works fully offline. Your readings stay on your phone. No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking — no data collected.

Fog Map is a Triadic Intelligence™ tool by ALEXZ.US. Want to go deeper? The full 27-cell map, free practical guides and more tools are at alexz.us.

Fog Map is a self-reflection exercise. It is not a medical device and does not replace a consultation with a doctor or psychotherapist.

name: Foldence: Fold Counter
description:
Follow your iPhone Duo from the first opening of the morning to the last closing of the day. Revisit each recorded transition, its time and its source in a private journal.

Opening adds an inner-mode entry. Closing adds an outer-mode entry. Either display can remain asleep.

On iPhone Duo with iOS 27.2 or later, create one personal automation for each action.

Full history and CSV and JSON exports are free. A single Pro purchase unlocks replay, heatmaps, reports and a customizable dashboard.

No account. Your journal stays on this device.

name: Food Find Rabbit
description:
Food Find Rabbit is a quick, one-thumb arcade game about a hungry little rabbit on a tiny 3×3 grid.

Swipe up, down, left or right to hop one tile at a time. A snack appears somewhere on the grid – reach it to score a point, and a new one pops up right away. Sounds easy? Puppies keep dashing across the board from every side, and a single touch ends the run.

There are no levels and no waiting – just you, your reflexes and your best score. Every round takes only seconds, so it's perfect for a short break or a "one more try" moment.

FEATURES
• Simple swipe controls – easy to learn, hard to master
• Tiny 3×3 grid where every move counts
• Endless gameplay with instant restart
• Beat your own high score
• Clean, minimal design

How many snacks can your rabbit grab before the puppies catch up?

name: Food in Sight: Kitchen & Meals
description:
Food in Sight keeps everyone in your home on the same page in the kitchen: what's in the fridge, freezer and pantry, what needs using up, what to cook tonight, and what to buy.

Out of sight shouldn't mean out of mind.

WHAT'S ON HAND
• Scan barcodes to add groceries, or type them in. Names and calories fill in from Open Food Facts.
• On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, snap the package, the nutrition label or a receipt, and the details fill themselves in.
• Best-by, opened and frozen dates, and where everything is kept.
• A daily reminder of what to use up, so food gets eaten instead of thrown out.
• A waste log that shows what keeps getting tossed, and why.

RECIPES
• Save your own, bring them in from almost any website or AI chat, or share a page in from your browser.
• Discover: tens of thousands of recipes from well-known cooking sites, credited and linked. Cook one straight away or keep it.
• One search for everything: your recipes and the cooking sites', with meal and time filters.
• Can make now ranks your recipes by what's in stock. Pick for me chooses dinner, with a side when it needs one.
• Cook this walks you through each step, moves on as you go, and reads the steps aloud if you like.
• Timers that ring like the Clock app's, with the countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Calories per serving, and what a recipe costs from the prices you've paid.

PLAN AND SHOP
• A meal plan for the week. Fill the empty dinners in one tap, starting with what you already have.
• What those meals need goes on the shopping list.
• One list for the household, grouped by store section, updated live on every phone.
• Shopping trip keeps what's left on your Lock Screen; tap a line there to tick it off.
• Things you always keep stocked go on the list by themselves when they run low.
• Put the plan in your calendar, and see what you spend on groceries each month.

ON EVERYTHING APPLE
• Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy.
• The shopping list on Apple Watch: tick things off in the store, add by voice.
• Siri and Shortcuts: add to the list, hear what's on it, ask what's for dinner.
• Send a recipe or the list in Messages.

FOR THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD
• Invite the people you live with. Everyone shares one inventory, recipe box, meal plan and shopping list.
• See who added, used, cooked or bought what.
• Made for iPad too, with recipes and steps side by side.

PRIVATE
Your kitchen is shared only with the people you invite. No ads, and nothing is used to track you.

name: Fotone: Photo Soundscapes
description:
Every photo has a sound. Fotone turns your photos into living soundscapes: calm, ambient music made from the colours and light of a moment, with your picture brought to life as pixel art.

TURN ANY PHOTO INTO MUSIC
Take a photo or pick one from your library. Fotone reads its colours and light and creates a soundscape that fits: a rainy café becomes warm jazzhop, a neon street turns into synthwave, a misty lake drifts into soft ambient.

TOUCH THE MUSIC
Your photo becomes animated pixel art. Tap it to scatter the pixels and play a chime that is always in key. Turn on Game Mode and catch the floating notes to build your own melody.

TUNE IT LIVE
Move across the Genre and Mood pads to reshape the sound while it plays. It never stops, never restarts. Want something new? Tap New variation.

SLEEP, FOCUS & RELAX
125 ready-made scenes for sleep, deep work, study, yoga, cooking, road trips and more. Set a sleep timer and let the music fade out gently.

YOUR MEMORIES, AS SOUND
Every soundscape is saved to your Library with the date and place the photo was taken. Browse your memories by timeline, calendar or map, and play a whole collection as one continuous mix.

SHARE THE MOMENT
Send your soundscapes to friends in a tap.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are analysed on your iPhone. No account needed.

FOTONE PREMIUM
Start free with 3 photo soundscapes and a free scene in every category. Premium unlocks unlimited photo soundscapes and all 125 scenes.
