name: FPV DVR Enhancer Pro
description:
Your analog FPV DVR, cleaned up on your iPhone or iPad.

FPV DVR Enhancer Pro removes static, snow, rainbow artifacts and broken frames from analog goggle recordings, fixes the colour and sharpens the image, frame by frame, right on your device. Nothing is uploaded.

• Deep clean: motion-compensated denoise, anti-rainbow, broken-frame rebuild, sharp OSD
• Auto signal and style, or fine-tune everything
• Trim several sections and export them as one clip
• Ready for social: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9 with blurred background, up to 1440p
• Text, stickers and your avatar
• Pilot cam: picture in picture or stacked, synced with your DVR, trimmed to the part you need
• Clean audio: goggle hum removed, loudness for social
• Opens .ts files straight from your goggles
• Digital footage? Use "No changes" and keep the formats, pilot cam and audio tools
• On iPad: a full editor with the preview and tools side by side

One-time purchase. No subscription, no account, no ads, no tracking.

name: FRA Journal
description:
Turn your highest yearly intentions into grounded, daily breakthroughs. 

FRA E-Journal combines the calming aesthetic of physical linen paper with powerful digital tools. Designed to prevent burnout and goal fatigue, FRA E-Journal guides you to break down big yearly dreams across every sphere of life into achievable quarterly milestones, monthly reviews, and weekly execution.

KEY FEATURES:

Intentional Goal Cascading
Never lose sight of the big picture. Connect your Top 3 Yearly Priorities to 8 Life Areas (Personal Growth, Health, Career, Finances, Relationships, Spiritual, Rest, Contribution), and watch them seamlessly cascade into Quarterly Themes, Monthly Milestones, and Weekly Checklists.

Wheel of Life & Harmony Radar
Track your momentum across every life domain with an interactive balance wheel. Discover where you are thriving and identify areas that need love before they cause friction.

AI Goal Decomposition
Stuck on where to start? Let AI analyze your goal statement and automatically construct a quarterly milestone roadmap, support strategy, and weekly micro-habits with one tap.

Guided Reflection Prompts
Overcome blank-page paralysis with curated reflective inquiry prompts. Unpack "Why It Matters To Me," eliminate self-sabotaging roadblocks, and build deep emotional clarity.

Calming Minimalist Aesthetic
Enjoy a distraction-free writing sanctuary. Choose between Pure Minimalist Light, Warm Linen Paper, Midnight Velvet Dark, and Botanical Sage Calm, complete with adjustable font scaling for effortless reading.

Complete Privacy & Biometric Lock
Your personal reflections remain sacred. Secure your journal with Face ID, Touch ID, or Biometric Passcode. 

Printable Annual Keepsakes
Export your completed year into a formatted PDF keepsake journal to print, bind, or archive forever.

Seamless Multi-Device Cloud Sync
Access your reflections anytime across mobile and web with encrypted real-time cloud backup.

--------------------------------------------------
MEMBERSHIP & SUBSCRIPTION:

FRA E-Journal offers a Free Starter tier and an optional Pro Subscription ($6.99/year) that unlocks:
• Unlimited AI goal decompositions
• Real-time multi-device cloud backup & sync
• Unlimited printable annual PDF keepsakes
• Automated weekly and monthly cadence reminders

Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your App Store / Google Play account settings.

name: FreeCell Cascade
description:
FreeCell Cascade is the classic solitaire game where every card is face up and nearly every deal can be won.

Build down the eight columns in alternating colors, park single cards in the four free cells, and send cards home to the foundations from Ace to King. Drag a card or a whole run, tap a card and then where it goes, or double-tap to send it to its best place. Stuck? Tap Hint. Made a mistake? Undo as far back as you like.

When the last card goes up, the table celebrates. Choose fireworks in the night sky or a card cascade across the table.

- Numbered deals: replay any deal, or choose a number yourself
- Moves a run of cards when you have the room, and tells you when you do not
- A How to Play guide with pictures
- Hints, unlimited undo, restart, and a Finish button when the win is certain
- Three portrait card backs, one dealt at random each game
- A win celebration you pick: fireworks or card cascade
- A left-handed layout
- Auto-move to the foundations that you can switch off
- Games played, wins, streaks, best time, and fewest moves
- Light and dark appearance, large text, Reduce Motion, and VoiceOver
- Sound and haptics you can switch off
- Your game is saved when you leave
- No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Works offline.

name: FrostSlide:Penguin Survivor
description:
Belly-slide down a frozen mountain and bowl over an army of snowmen.

Frostslide is a one-thumb survival game. Drag to steer your penguin, find a slope, and let gravity do the rest: the faster you slide, the harder you hit. Survive five minutes and the Snow King comes for you.

ONE THUMB, FULL SPEED
• Drag anywhere to steer, tap to jump
• Waddle uphill, slide downhill, and turn speed into damage
• Play in portrait, in short runs that fit a coffee break

BUILD A DIFFERENT PENGUIN EVERY RUN
• Snowball cannon, icicle halo and frost stomp fire on their own
• Level up and choose from nine upgrades
• Bowl through the crowd above full speed and watch the numbers fly

OUTLAST THE SNOW KING
• The horde grows every minute
• A boss arrives at five minutes
• Beat your best time and your best knockout count

KEEP WHAT YOU EARN
• Bank the fish you catch in every run
• Spend them on four permanent upgrades: health, speed, power and bigger catches

Frostslide is free to play. It shows ads, and most of them are your choice: watch one to get back up after a fall, to reroll your upgrade cards, or to double your fish. One purchase removes the ads between runs and makes the revive, reroll and double free. A second purchase adds a bucket of fish.

name: Fudy Negocios
description:
Fudy Negocios es la app para restaurantes y negocios afiliados a Fudy. Administra tus pedidos y tu tienda desde tu celular o tablet, sin depender de una computadora.

ÓRDENES EN TIEMPO REAL
• Recibe una notificación con sonido en cuanto llega un pedido nuevo.
• Acepta o rechaza órdenes, márcalas como listas y avisa al repartidor.
• En tablet, ve tus órdenes en un tablero por columnas, ideal para la cocina.
• Consulta el historial de órdenes y el detalle de cada pedido.

TU TIENDA BAJO CONTROL
• Abre o cierra tu negocio con un toque, o haz un cierre temporal cuando lo necesites.
• Configura tu horario de atención.
• Revisa el resumen del día desde la pantalla de inicio.

MENÚ
• Crea y edita categorías, productos y complementos.
• Sube fotos de tus platillos.
• Cambia el orden del menú y marca productos como no disponibles al momento.

PROMOCIONES Y CUPONES
• Programa promociones por día de la semana.
• Crea cupones, pausa los que ya no quieras y revisa cuántas veces se han usado.

HISTORIAS
• Publica fotos o videos para que tus clientes vean lo nuevo.
• Prográmalas, archívalas o vuelve a publicarlas.

VENTAS
• Consulta tus ventas actuales y el historial de cortes.

PEDIR FUDY
• Solicita un repartidor de Fudy para tus pedidos propios.

Y ADEMÁS
• Lee los comentarios de tus clientes.
• Revisa los datos de tu restaurante: teléfonos, cuenta bancaria y contrato.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta de negocio activa en Fudy. Si aún no eres socio, contáctanos para afiliar tu restaurante.

name: Fuga: Arrow Escape Puzzle
description:
Riding the subway, bus or train? Fuga turns your commute into a moment to think.

The board is full of arrows. Tap one and it moves where its tip points: if nothing is in the way, it escapes the board; if it hits another arrow, it bounces back and you lose a life. Find the order, clear the board and move on.

• Endless levels: created on the fly, and every one is solvable
• Difficulty that grows with you: bigger boards and longer, twistier arrows
• A daily challenge, the same for everyone and with no hints: share your time and keep your streak
• Go for "Perfect!": not a single crash and no hints
• Hints that point out a free arrow when you're stuck
• Play one-handed and pick up right where you left off
• Works offline and never interrupts your music or podcasts
• Every arrow that escapes plays a note: clearing the board is a melody
• Your progress is saved in iCloud

Fuga is free. It shows ads between some levels and optional ads to earn hints or keep playing. The one-time "No Ads" purchase removes them forever and adds bonus hints.

Train your logic and focus while the ride gets shorter.

name: Furilian
description: Tämä sovellus on suunniteltu päivittäisten tulojen ja menojen seurantaan sekä samanaikaiseen varautumiseen yllättäviä menoja varten. Voit asettaa säästötavoitteita ja vähimmäissaldorajoja näille varauksille, kohdentaa yksittäisiä maksuja eri varauskategorioihin ja seurata samalla, kuinka paljon varoja on vielä kohdentamatta. Kun saat palautuksen, tapahtumamerkintä päivittyy vastaamaan todellista nettokulua; varauksen vajaus pienenee vasta, kun varat siirretään takaisin kyseiseen varaukseen tai kohdennetaan siihen uudelleen. Voit täydentää varauksia ”ensin käytetty, ensin täydennetty” -periaatteen mukaisesti tai tehdä manuaalisia muutoksia samalla, kun seuraat varauksissa olevia summia. Talouskalenterin avulla voit ajastaa laskujen maksut ja varausten täydennykset, jolloin näet arvion kunkin tilin käytettävissä olevista varoista. Lisäksi voit täsmäyttää tiliotteita, kohdistaa saapuvia palautuksia, seurata kuukausittaisia ​​kulutusrajoja sekä tarkastella aiempia tietoja tunnistaaksesi ajanjaksot, jolloin varaus on laskenut sille asetetun vähimmäisrajan alapuolelle.

name: FynxPass: Password Manager
description:
FynxPass keeps your passwords, cards, notes, files and two-factor codes in one private vault that only you can open.

Everything is encrypted on your device with your master password before it syncs. Our servers only ever see sealed data, so not even we can read your vault.

SAFARI EXTENSION, BUILT IN
• The FynxPass extension for Safari ships inside the app: nothing extra to install
• Fill logins in Safari on iPhone, iPad and Mac with one tap
• Save new logins as you sign up; your vault key never leaves the app
• AutoFill in apps too, from the keyboard on iPhone and iPad

EVERYTHING IN ONE VAULT
• Logins, cards, bank accounts, identities, secure notes, Wi-Fi, SSH keys and more
• Built-in authenticator for two-factor codes, with QR scan
• Password generator and Check-up for weak, reused and breached passwords
• Attachments, sealed like everything else
• Shared vaults for family and team, with read-only or full access
• Secure Send: share a secret by a link that expires
• Legacy Handover: choose someone who can reach your vault if something happens to you

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
• Sync between iPhone, iPad and Mac
• Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID
• Designed for English and Arabic, right to left

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Zero-knowledge: your master password never leaves your device
• No ads, no trackers, no third-party analytics
• Your account is your email only

FREE FOR EVERYONE
FynxPass has no paid plans and no locked features. If you like it, you can buy us a coffee inside the app.

Terms of Use: https://ifynx.com/fynxpass/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://ifynx.com/fynxpass/privacy/

name: GachaPhoto: Photo Packs
description:
Your photos. Now in packs.

Thousands of photos. Never enough time to sort them. GachaPhoto turns tidying up into opening packs. Tear open a few each day, flip through your photo cards, keep your favorites, and delete the rest. Before you know it, your library feels lighter—and so does your storage.

■ Open packs
· 30 pack themes: Screenshots, Time Capsule, Bursts, and Twins help you clear the clutter. Cats, Dogs, Food, Scenery, Snow, Concerts, and more bring your memories back.
· Create your own pack: type something like “sunset at the beach” to find the closest matches in your library.
· Press and slide along the seal. Feel every rip with haptics, then watch the light burst out as it opens.

■ Flip cards
· Swipe left to delete, right to add to your Binder. Sort your photos one satisfying flip at a time.
· Every photo has a rarity: N, R, SR, or UR. The more beautiful the shot, the rarer the card. Legendary cards glow with rainbow light.
· Tilt your phone and watch the foil borders catch the light.

■ Fill your Binder
· Ornate foil borders and stamp badges make every photo feel collectible.
· Name your cards and capture how you felt that day.
· Sync photos from your Binder to albums in Photos, organized by rarity.

■ Sticker Gacha
· Earn coins by sorting photos, then spend them on Gacha.
· Turn the star of a photo into a white-bordered sticker and add it to any card.

■ Peace of mind
· Photos never leave your phone. All processing happens on your device. No uploads, no data collection.
· One-time purchase, no subscription, no ads. Coins are never sold.
· Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted in Photos, where you can recover them for 30 days.

支持简体中文、繁體中文、English、日本語、한국어、Español、Português、Français、Deutsch、ไทย、Bahasa Indonesia、Tiếng Việt。

name: Gallery Director: Art Tycoon
description:
Start with six bare walls. Finish with the greatest collection in the world.

Gallery Director is a deep, elegant management game about the art world. Rent a pop-up in Peckham, hang your first prints, and grow into a chain of flagship galleries across London, Paris and New York. Buy smart, curate well, and outmanoeuvre the rival collectors who want the same masterpieces you do.

BID LIVE IN THE SALEROOM
Take your paddle into a live auction every week. Rival foundations, a tech-fortune trust and an anonymous telephone bidder all want the lot. Jump the bidding, hold your nerve at "going once", or borrow against your collection to win. Every eighth week brings an Evening Sale of masterpieces.

SPOT THE FAKES, FIND THE SLEEPERS
Dealers, private sales and leases each have their own risks. Cheap dealers sell more forgeries, so inspect before you buy. Research a "Circle of…" attribution and it might turn out to be the real thing.

MONET TO HOKUSAI
Collect 100 works across 20 movements, from Renaissance panels and Old Masters to Impressionism, Japanese prints, Pop Art and street art. Each one is hand-drawn in the game's own style, and prices move every week as fashions rise and fall.

RUN THE GALLERY
• Rent or buy spaces on real city maps, from pop-ups to museum-scale landmarks
• Upgrade security, climate, lighting, café and shop
• Hire curators, guards, educators, sales directors and conservators
• Stage themed exhibitions, set ticket prices and chase a five-star review
• Play to each city's taste: Old Masters in London, Impressionists in Paris, Pop in New York
• Manage cash, bank loans and the year-end tax bill

34 BADGES TO EARN
From "Open your doors" to "Own a Masterpiece" and "Number one", every career has goals to chase. Climb the collection rankings and become the Gallery Director.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
Patron (relaxed), Dealer (the intended challenge) or Tycoon (tougher rivals). Up to three careers at once, each saved automatically.

OPTIONAL EXPANSIONS
• Artists' Studios: sign living artists and ride their careers from emerging to blue-chip
• Museum Loans: borrow masterpieces from great museums for huge crowds
• Art Fairs: book booths at six international fairs, from Basel to Miami
• The Underworld: plan heists on rival galleries, deal in Mr Grey's back room, and launder hot works
• The Complete Collection: every expansion plus two extra career slots

Every expansion is a one-time purchase. There are no ads, no subscriptions, no timers and no energy systems. Play at your own pace, one week at a time.

name: Gamut: Ear Training & Singing
description:
Gamut trains your ear by doing. Hear an interval, a scale or a chord, then sing it, play it or strum it back. Gamut listens and shows on a circle of tones how close you are, in cents.

For guitar, voice, bass and any other instrument.

WHAT YOU PRACTICE
• Intervals: hear them, name them, sing or play them back, find them over a drone
• Scales and modes over a drone
• Chords: strum them on the guitar or play them on keys, and Gamut hears every note; then see the grip
• Pure or equal: hear the 14 cents between a pure and an equal third, then sing it pure
• After every hit, the notes stand written: staff and guitar or bass tab
• Many tunings: equal, pure, Pythagorean, meantone, Werckmeister, Kirnberger, Vallotti, 19, 22, 24 and 31 notes to the octave, 22 shruti

HANDS FREE
Tap Start and put the phone down. Every card plays, listens, says how it went and goes on.

YOUR SOUND
• Hear yourself in wired headphones, cleaned up, with compressor, echo and room
• A tanpura, organ or shruti box as the drone, when you want one
• A tuner

FREE
The drone, the tuner, hearing yourself with effects, and the first card of every stack.

GAMUT SUBSCRIPTION
Every card of every stack, and a new stack every month.
• Monthly: 4.99 € a month
• Yearly: 34.99 € a year
• The first week is free.

FOR GOOD
No subscription wanted? Buy Gamut once for 79.99 €: every stack, the new ones too.
Prices in other countries are shown in the App Store in your currency. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free week ends, or when you confirm the purchase without one. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; the renewal is charged in the 24 hours before that end. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. "Restore purchases" in the app brings a subscription to a new device. Family Sharing: one subscription for up to six people.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://conradknorr.de/en/apps/privacy

No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing you sing or play is recorded or sent.

name: GarimChak: 1s Face Plate Blur
description:
Are sensitive details in your photos truly protected before sharing?
GarimChak is a 100% on-device optical privacy vault engineered to detect and redact faces, background crowds, car & motorcycle license plates, shipping labels, and personal IDs in one second.

■ Key Security Capabilities:
1. 1-Second Multi-Scale Auto Redaction (Faces, Plates, 9-Class PII & QR)
   Automatically detects foreground & tiny background faces, vehicle and two-line motorcycle license plates, tracking numbers, phone numbers, bank accounts, addresses, passport MRZ lines, and QR codes.

2. Smart Crowd Separation & One-Tap Lock Toggle
   Keep yourself or friends crystal clear while automatically redacting strangers in the background with a single tap on any cybernetic lock frame.

3. 100%–400% Pinch Zoom & 2.5x Optical Reticle Loupe
   Pinch to zoom up to 4x to inspect fine print, and drag with the auto-flipping 2.5x optical reticle loupe so your finger never blocks small numbers or addresses.

4. 5 Professional Redaction Styles & 5-Level Intensity Control
   Choose from Pixel Mosaic, Optical Gaussian Blur, Security Hatch Tape, Solid Blackout, and 3D Security Stamps (Privacy Shield, Plate Guard, Anonymous Avatar, Pixel Lock, Vault Seal) with 5-stage strength adjustment.

5. Zero Forced Watermarks & Permanent EXIF GPS Shredding
   Export crisp high-resolution photos with zero watermarks while permanently stripping EXIF GPS coordinates, camera metadata, and timestamps.

6. 0-Byte Cloud Upload (100% Offline Local Security Enclave)
   No account, no login, and no internet connection required. Every pixel stays strictly inside your device.

name: Gates & Glory
description:
Send your army through the right gates, multiply your numbers and tear down the enemy castle!

In Gates & Glory every shot is a decision: green gates multiply your army, blue gates add soldiers, red gates cut it in half. Choose your path, send in your champion and clash head-on with the enemy horde.

FROM BARE HANDS TO A GOLDEN SWORD
Start the war with nothing but your fists. Earn your way up to clubs, swords, axes and the legendary golden sword.

FORTIFY YOUR CASTLE
Station archers on your castle's side towers and upgrade them in the armory. When the enemy charges, let the arrows rain!

GIANT COMMANDERS & GAME MODES
Campaign, Boss battles, Defense and Raid. A new world every five levels: meadow, desert, glacier, volcano and night.

WAR MACHINES
Unlock the Catapult, Ballista, War Elephant and Griffin. Rain fireballs, trample the enemy and strike from the sky!

POWERS
Bombs, arrow rain, reinforcements and rage — use them at the right moment to turn the battle.

8 LANGUAGES, PLAY OFFLINE
No internet needed.

Free to play; contains optional in-app purchases and ads.

name: Geek Album
description:
Geek Album rassemble les souvenirs de votre famille dans un espace privé, et les fait revivre en albums animés, en musique.

• Des albums qui défilent tout seuls : transitions, mouvement lent sur les photos, légendes, date et lieu.
• Plus de 100 thèmes prêts : mariage, anniversaire avec bougies, naissance, vacances, Noël, diplôme, album d'antan… avec effets d'ambiance, cadres et musiques assorties.
• Collages de 2 à 6 photos, écran titre et générique de fin.
• Mode salon : la tablette ou la télé devient un cadre photo vivant.
• Albums disponibles hors ligne et musique qui continue écran verrouillé.
• Playlists de famille, et musiques à télécharger pour les écouter sans connexion.
• Un lien pour recevoir les photos des invités d'une fête, en pleine qualité, sans qu'ils créent de compte.
• Export de l'album en vidéo MP4 à partager.
• Privé par défaut : chaque album reste à celui qui le crée tant qu'il ne le partage pas (avec le droit Regarder ou Modifier). Trois rôles : administrateur, membre, spectateur (idéal pour les grands-parents).
• Souvenirs du jour, favoris, recherche par personne, année ou étiquette.
• Signaler un contenu ou bloquer une personne, en deux gestes.

Geek Album est réservé aux familles qui ont un espace Geek Album : la connexion se fait avec le compte reçu par invitation.

name: GentleStrength
description:
The app brings market tracking, financial research, and paper trading together in one iPhone app. Keep an eye on the stocks you follow, catch up on market news.

- Follow the market. Build a watchlist and check stock quotes, major indices, and sector performance.
- Research companies. Explore historical charts, technical indicators, financial statements, and upcoming earnings dates.
- Read and save market news. Browse headlines by ticker, open articles from their original sources, and bookmark stories for later.
- Practice trading with virtual funds. Place simulated trades and track your positions and portfolio performance.
- Compare scenarios. Use the position sizing calculator, compound growth projector, and currency converter to explore different assumptions.

name: Geoose
description:
Drop your goose on the map… in the right place!

Geoose is a geography game for kids (and curious parents): where is Brazil? And the capital of Japan? Which country does this flag belong to? Tap the map, the goose flies off and lands… the closer you are, the more points you score.

• 197 countries, their capitals and flags, from "easy" to "expert"
• Big cities, islands, world wonders and animals
• France zone: departments and cities
• A passport to stamp, medals, and a goose to dress up (over 40 accessories!)
• Daily challenge, survival mode, quiz, and two-player games on one device
• Automatic review of mistakes to really improve
• "Did you know?": a fun fact after every answer, read aloud
• 7 map themes, 6 languages

No ads, no purchases, no account, no connection: everything stays on the device.

Dedicated to Milo and Nils, and to all children curious about the world around them.

name: GeoPinion
description:
Convert DD, DMS and geohash coordinates, maintain ordered point sets and export distance and path summaries.

1. Create a named point set or import a CSV and map coordinate columns.
2. Enter DD or DMS coordinates, or decode a geohash center.
3. Inspect alternative coordinate formats and reorder points.
4. Measure a point pair or inspect an ordered path summary.
5. Export CSV/PDF snapshots with the calculation method.

CSV is limited to 2 MiB and 10,000 points. Geohash precision is 1–12. Distances use a spherical Haversine approximation with radius 6,371,008.8 m. This is not surveying, road routing or navigation; no location permission is used.

name: Get BETO!
description:
GET BETO!
- Find The Best Stash Spots Michigan With BETO!
- Explore Michigan’s Licensed Cannabis Businesses On An Interactive Map.
- Find Medical And Recreational Dispensaries.
- View License Details, Hours, Menus, And Directions.
- Discover Deals, Coupons, And Promotions.
- Save Favorites, Share Listings, And Set Reminders.
- Customize Notifications For Deals And Events.
- Personalize Your Profile And Interests.

BETO is an informational cannabis discovery platform. 

Privacy Policy: https://getbeto.app/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://getbeto.app/terms.html

You must be 21 years of age or older (or the legal age permitted in your location) to access and use BETO. By using BETO, you agree to comply with all applicable state and local laws and regulations.

name: GHG calculator: Scope 1, 2 & 3
description:
GHG Calculator helps small and medium-sized companies measure their greenhouse gas emissions across Scope 1, 2 and 3, in line with the GHG Protocol Corporate Standard, and turn the results into a report they can share with clients, lenders and investors.

It is built for companies that need a credible emissions inventory without a dedicated carbon accounting platform. Enter figures from your invoices, utility bills and travel records, and the app applies the appropriate emission factors for you.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Calculate Scope 1 emissions from diesel, petrol, natural gas, biofuels and refrigerants
• Report Scope 2 using both the location-based and market-based methods, including renewable energy certificates (GOs, RECs, I-RECs), PPAs, supplier-specific factors and residual mix
• Include district heating and purchased steam
• Estimate Scope 3 for Category 1 (purchased goods and services), Category 3 (fuel- and energy-related activities), Category 4 (upstream transportation), Category 5 (waste generated in operations), Category 6 (business travel) and Category 7 (employee commuting)
• Apply country-specific grid emission factors automatically
• Report on a 6-month or 12-month period
• Consolidate several sites into one company inventory
• Compare reporting periods and track your emissions over time
• Set reduction targets and test what-if scenarios
• Record the data quality of each input (metered, invoice or estimate) and keep supporting evidence
• Export a PDF report, including a VSME B3 disclosure

TRANSPARENT BY DESIGN
• The emission factor is shown next to every input, so each result can be traced and checked
• A guided three-step workflow takes you from company details to final results
• A built-in learning library explains key GHG accounting concepts and works offline
• Available in 9 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your company data is stored only on your device and is never sent to us. You decide when a report is shared.

name: GitShorts
description:
GitShorts is a technology news app covering artificial intelligence, machine learning, developer tools, frameworks, research, and open-source software.

GitShorts researches primary technical sources—including official repositories, release notes, project documentation, research publications, and company announcements—and publishes GitShorts-written technology articles based on that evidence.

READ THE SHORT, THEN THE FULL STORY
Start with a focused summary in the feed. Open the corresponding full GitShorts article for publication details, context, why the development matters, and links to the primary sources used to prepare it.

KNOW WHO PUBLISHED EACH ARTICLE
Every story identifies GitShorts as publisher, GitShorts Editorial Team as author, and displays its full publication date. Primary sources are labelled separately so a repository, paper, or company page is never confused with the publisher of a GitShorts article.

DISCOVER CURRENT TECHNOLOGY
Browse a regularly refreshed feed across AI, machine learning, research, frameworks, developer tools, Python, and other technology topics. Search by project, language, owner, or topic and filter by category.

SAVE, SHARE, AND SYNC
Save stories for later, share compact GitShorts links, and enable optional push notifications for featured coverage. Sign in with a one-time email code to sync saved and liked stories across your devices—no password required.

EDITORIAL TRANSPARENCY
GitShorts uses automated and AI-assisted tools during research, drafting, summarization, categorization, and image selection. Read our About, Editorial Policy, Contact, Privacy, Terms, and Account Deletion pages in the app Profile tab or at gitshorts.com.

name: Glassoff: Surf Forecast
description:
Glassoff gives every surf spot one number from 0 to 10, worked out for the way your beach faces. Open it, see which spot is worth the drive, and when to paddle out.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
The Spots tab ranks your breaks: score, wave size, wind and the best hours. Your best bet today is at the top.

A FORECAST THAT KNOWS YOUR BEACH
A swell only counts if it can reach the sand. Glassoff checks swell direction and period against which way your beach faces and shows what reaches the beach and what is blocked. Wind is read as offshore, cross or onshore for your spot, not a generic direction.

FOR EVERY SPOT, HOUR BY HOUR
- Wave height as a range, in feet or meters
- Swell height, period and direction, with the second swell
- Wind and gusts, tide chart, nearest buoy readings
- A 7-day outlook with the best window each day

LOG A SESSION IN TWO TAPS
Rate your session with stars. After 5 rated sessions at a spot, Glassoff Pro tunes the score to the days you actually liked.

GLASSOFF PRO (ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION)
- Unlimited spots (free keeps 3)
- Good surf alerts at 6 PM the day before your score hits your bar
- Score tuned by your log
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets for every spot

DATA
Forecasts come from NOAA: National Weather Service, WaveWatch III, GFS, Tides & Currents and the National Data Buoy Center. Best coverage is along US coasts. Elsewhere you get swell and wind forecasts without tides or buoys. Glassoff is not made by NOAA. Surf forecasts are estimates: not for navigation or safety, and always check local conditions.

Privacy: no account, no tracking. Spots and sessions stay on your iPhone.
Questions: support@sanghuynhxuan.com

name: Glint: Phone Cleaner
description:
Glint is a free phone cleaner that respects your privacy. It finds what is filling up your iPhone and helps you keep what matters. Everything runs on your device: no account, no subscription, no ads and no tracking.

PHOTOS
• Swipe Review: go through your photos month by month and swipe to keep or delete
• Similar Photos: groups bursts and near-identical shots and suggests the best one to keep
• Duplicates: finds exact copies, confirmed byte by byte
• Blurry & Dark Photos: spots blurry, dark and accidental shots
• Live Photos: turn Live Photos into stills and save about half the space
• Bursts: keep the best frame of every burst
• Old Screenshots & Recordings: clear out the ones you no longer need

VIDEOS & FILES
• Large Videos: see the videos taking the most space
• Compress Videos: shrink big videos with HEVC while keeping the date and location
• Large Files: find big files in the folders you choose in the Files app

ORGANIZE
• Duplicate Contacts: merge duplicates and remove empty contacts, with a backup first
• Old Calendar Events and Completed Reminders: tidy up years of history

PRIVACY
• Photo Locations: remove the location from photos, including the GPS data inside the file
• Sensitive Screenshots: finds screenshots that show ID numbers, IBANs, card numbers or passwords, using on-device text recognition. Values are always masked.

ALWAYS IN VIEW
• Home screen widget with free space and how much can be cleaned
• Optional monthly reminder

SAFE BY DESIGN
• At least one photo of every group is always kept
• Deleted photos and videos stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days
• Never downloads your iCloud photos without asking and makes no network requests

English and Turkish interface.

name: Glowville
description:
It's the first week of November, and the phone is ringing. The whole street wants their house lit before Christmas, and you're the new light installer in town.

Glowville is a cozy holiday game about running a small Christmas-light business. Visit each house, quote the job, drag strings of glowing C9 bulbs along every roofline, gable and deck rail, then step back and watch the place come alive at dusk.

QUOTE THE JOB
Every homeowner opens the door with a different house and a different budget. Read the hints in the yard, set your price and confirm. Bid too high and they'll hire someone else. Charge too little and you'll be short on supplies for the next one.

HANG THE LIGHTS
Pick your spool and trace each line along the house with your finger. Watch your footage, beat the clock and cover every run. Get it right and the house lights up when the sun goes down.

EARN THE REVIEW
Happy clients leave five-star reviews, and good reviews build your reputation. A rough job? Reply kindly or offer to redo it for free.

GROW YOUR SHOP
Spend what you earn in the catalog: brighter bulbs, extra spools, clips, wreaths, inflatables, tree wraps and more. Every season brings new clients and bigger houses.

TWO FULL SEASONS
Light 8 houses in Season 1, then move up to 12 bigger homes in Season 2, with decks, balconies and two stories. And when New Year's has come and gone, the same clients call you back to take it all down.

MADE TO BE COZY
- Snowy neighborhoods painted with care, from a quiet cape cod to a two-story with a balcony
- A guided first job that teaches you everything in a few minutes
- Plays in landscape on iPhone and iPad
- Short jobs that fit in a coffee break
- Haptics and a reduce-motion option

FREE TO PLAY
Glowville is free with ads. After a job you can watch an optional short video for bonus cash. A single Remove Ads purchase turns off the ads between jobs for good, and you can restore it on any of your devices.

No account. No sign-in. Your progress stays on your device.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you: persueapps@gmail.com

name: GoldSpot: Gold Prospecting Map
description:
Where is gold worth looking for? GoldSpot shows you on a world map: 46,855 zones with potential placer gold and 95,477 known gold mines and occurrences. Every zone has a score from 0 to 100 and the reasons behind it, so you know where to look, and why, before you head out.

IMPORTANT: the score is an estimate that compares sites with each other. It is not a probability or a guarantee of gold. Gold prospecting is regulated: check the permits you need, respect private land and protected areas, and never enter abandoned mines.

GOLD SPOTS, WITH THE WHY
• Zones scored from geology, watercourses, terrain, known mines and occurrences, and prospector clues such as old workings or panning areas.
• Every spot explains its score: source rock upstream, distance to the channel, old terraces, confluences, breaks in slope, nearby mines…
• Scientific spots, prospector spots or both, each with its own symbol.
• Active, abandoned and unknown-status mines, with their source.
• Spots and mines are built into the app, so you can browse them offline.

ANALYZE ANY POINT
• From home: press and hold the map and GoldSpot scores that exact place.
• At the creek: tap the round button, then “Analyse this point” and “My location” to analyse the point where you stand.
• Your iPhone or iPad works it out from the terrain, the channel, height above the stream, terraces, confluences, geology and nearby mines.
• Offline, you get a partial score with low confidence.

GOLD OR PYRITE?
• Snap a rock, a nugget or what’s left in your pan, or pick a photo from your library.
• The AI tells you what mineral it looks like, whether it could be gold rather than a look-alike (pyrite, chalcopyrite, golden mica) and which simple at-home tests can confirm it. If it can’t tell, it says so.

A MAP BUILT FOR READING THE GROUND
• Apple satellite imagery in 3D: tilt the map to see valleys, slopes and gullies.
• Layers you switch on and off: towns and roads, trails and tracks, streams and springs, contour lines with elevations, a score heat map, geology and watercourses.
• Official USGS topo map in the US and IGN topo map in Spain.
• The map crosshair gives you the elevation, slope and aspect of the point (offline, only an approximate elevation).
• Everything sits behind one round button, and the map remembers how you left it.
• Search for a city, a country or a mine, even offline.

YOUR SPOTS AND FINDS, ANONYMOUS IF YOU LIKE
• Save spots with GPS or by marking them on the map. They stay private until you decide otherwise.
• Share them with friends, who you add with a code.
• Post spots and nuggets to the Finds wall with up to 8 photos.
• “Post anonymously” is on by default: others don’t see your name, and photos are stripped of metadata.
• Exact or approximate location (about 1 km), your choice.
• “Go” screen: a map and a compass pointing at the spot, with bearing and distance. Your spots also open offline.

NO EMAIL, NO PASSWORD
To save, identify and post, just pick a name and accept the community rules. An internet connection is needed for the satellite map, the terrain used in point analysis, identifying minerals and posting.

FREE AND PRO
• Free to download, with ads: a banner and a short video before each mineral identification. Every feature is in the free version.
• GoldSpot Pro, a monthly or yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial, removes the banner and the videos. You see the price in the app before paying.
• Up to 40 identifications a day per account, with or without Pro.
• The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends, in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://cdpoma.github.io/goldspot/privacy.html

Download GoldSpot and plan your next trip with the pan.

name: Golf Beat: Tempo Trainer
description:
Find the rhythm behind your best swings. Prop up your phone and hit balls: Golf Beat times every swing hands-free, shows your tempo next to the pros, and tells you in plain English what to change next.

Your tempo is the rhythm of your swing: how long the club takes to go back compared with how long it takes to come down. Most tour players swing at about 3 to 1. Golf Beat measures yours from video, captures every swing hands-free, shows you exactly where the time went, and trains you to repeat your best rhythm.

TIMED FROM YOUR OWN VIDEO
Film a swing with Golf Beat, or import one you already have. Golf Beat finds the three moments that matter on its own:
• Takeaway: the instant the club head leaves the ball
• Top: the moment the club stops going back
• Impact: the strike, heard on the sound track and checked against the ball
Then it shows your backswing, your downswing and your tempo, for example 0.83 s back, 0.29 s down, 2.9 : 1.

KNOW WHAT TO CHANGE
Every swing gets a plain-English coaching note against your target: on target, backswing too long, rushed from the top, and by how much. A hand-speed graph shows where your swing built speed and whether it peaked at the ball.

AUTO CAPTURE
Prop up your phone, tap Start and hit balls. Auto capture waits for you to set up, saves every full swing in slow motion and times it, and ignores practice waggles and walking. No tapping record between shots, no going back to the phone.

TEMPO TONES
Three tones mark takeaway, top and impact at your target tempo, so you can groove the rhythm with or without a ball. Pick a preset, use your own measured tempo, or set your own. Tones can start when you settle over the ball or play on a loop, and a timing setting keeps them in sync with Bluetooth earbuds.

FIND YOUR TEMPO
Record three natural swings and Golf Beat measures your own rhythm, then sets a target that suits you. Compare it with approximate published tour tempos.

SLOW-MOTION REPLAY YOU CAN TRUST
Step frame by frame, see each mark on the timeline, and move any mark yourself if you disagree. If the app is unsure of a mark, it says so and shows you how to check it, instead of guessing.

COMPARE AND TRACK
Put two swings side by side. Stats show your average tempo, how consistent you are and how often you hit your target, by club and over time. Streaks and challenges keep practice going.

SHARE A CLIP
Export a clip for posting: your swing at real speed, then a slow-motion replay with the count, the tempo and a beep at each mark. Or save the full replay with every reading on screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Every swing is measured on your iPhone and never uploaded. Videos leave your phone only when you save or share them.

FREE TO START
Your first 5 swings, recorded or imported, are free and fully measured. To record or import more, subscribe:
• Golf Beat Yearly: $39.99 per year
• Golf Beat Monthly: $7.99 per month
New subscribers get the first 7 days free. After the trial, payment is charged to your Apple Account and the subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Without a subscription you can still watch, compare and export the swings you already have. Prices are for the United States and may differ in other countries; the exact price is shown in the app before you subscribe.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://golfbeatapp.com/privacy

Tour tempo figures are approximate, from published sources. No affiliation with or endorsement by any player, tour or other tempo product.

name: Golf Camera - Auto Swing
description:
Golf Camera records your golf practice and lets you review your swing immediately.

The current app interface is in Japanese. This store page is available in English.

AUTOMATIC SWING CAPTURE
On-device pose detection follows your address and finish positions and shows a replay after your swing. Practice without pressing record for every shot.

REVIEW THE DETAILS
Use slow motion, pause, frame stepping, zoom and a grid to examine your form. Choose right- or left-handed play, front or side views, and the front or rear camera. Adjust pose hold times and replay duration.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save clips manually, automatically or with a gesture. Browse saved videos and export them using sharing.

TWO-DEVICE MODE
Connect two devices to the same Wi-Fi network. Use one as the Camera (カメラ) and the other as the Display (ディスプレイ). Completed swings transfer to the display for replay. Automatic discovery, QR codes and manual connection details are supported.

OPTIONAL PREMIUM
The free version includes ads and up to 30 swings per device per local calendar day. Monthly or yearly Premium removes ads and the daily swing limit. There is no free trial. Check the price shown in the app before purchasing.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically each month or year unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in the App Store. Google Play subscriptions do not transfer to iOS.
Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

GET STARTED
Place the device securely with your entire body visible. Choose your settings and tap スタート (Start). Hold your address pose, swing and hold your finish. Review the replay.

Detection depends on lighting, clothing, background, framing and device performance. Adjust the framing or pose hold times if necessary. Keep the device and surrounding area safe during practice.
Pose processing takes place on the device. Apart from connection mode and sharing actions, videos are not uploaded to the operator's server.

Privacy policy: https://kohshin1977.github.io/golf-camera-privacy/
Contact: onsight.system@gmail.com

name: Good Count: Score Keeper
description:
Good Count keeps score for the games played at the cottage and the kitchen table, and it knows their rules.

CRIBBAGE
• A drawn 121-hole board with front and back pegs and the skunk lines marked
• Big score buttons for pegging, so you can score one-handed while holding your cards
• A hand counter: tap the four cards and the starter, and it shows every fifteen, pair, run, flush and nobs before it adds them to the board
• Counting order prompted each deal, and the game ends the moment someone reaches 121
• Two or three players, or four in partners; 121 or 61
• Skunks counted the kitchen-table way or by tournament rules, and muggins if you play it

EUCHRE
• Tap who called it, then how it went: 3 or 4 tricks, a march, a loner, or euchred
• The deal moves round the table by itself, and trump is noted for each hand
• Play to 5, 7, 10, 11, 15 or 21, or a fixed number of hands
• Stick the dealer, defending alone and the dealer's partner going alone are settings

CROKINOLE
• Count the discs in each ring and the 20s set aside; the round adds itself up
• Singles or doubles
• First to 100, with only the higher side scoring the difference, or rounds worth 2 for a win and 1 for a tie
• 20s kept for each side all game

AND THE REST
• Hearts, spades, gin rummy, Rummy 500, Five Hundred, Up and Down the River, crazy eights, golf, canasta and Mexican Train, each knowing whether high or low wins and when the game ends
• A round-by-round table you can fix after the fact
• A plain scoreboard for anything else

FREE
• Every game above, with no limit on games or players
• Undo and redo on every score
• Games saved as you play, and a full history
• Backup to a file in Files or iCloud Drive

PLUS — ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Records over the years: who leads whom, at which game, since when, with skunks counted as the rules count them
• Your own games, saved with their target, high or low wins and rounds
• Table mode: a score both sides of the table can read
• Board colours: walnut, lake and felt

PRIVATE
No account, no ads and no analytics. Players and games are stored on your iPhone or iPad, and nothing you enter is sent to me.

I'm Colin Robey, and I make Good Count on my own as CR Studios. If a rule doesn't count the way your table plays it, email me at crstudiosdev@gmail.com.

name: GooftPaux
description: GooftPaux is gift cards you received or bought as gifts —not prepaid reload cards, transit passes, or bank wallets. Log the face value, record what you spend, and see what’s still on the shelf.

name: Gorton AI
description:
Gorton AI is the learning app for staff of universities, polytechnics and colleges. Your institution creates your account and assigns your courses; you learn wherever you are.

Learn anywhere
• See every course assigned to you in the Course Library
• Read lessons, watch videos and take quizzes
• Pick up exactly where you left off, on your phone or the website
• See your progress and scores, and know when a course is complete

Stay informed
• Instant notifications when a course is assigned, a ticket is answered or something needs your attention
• An inbox of all your alerts, with read and unread

Get help fast
• Search answers to common questions
• Raise a support ticket, attach a photo or screenshot, and follow the conversation

For administrators
• Manage the people in your institution and turn access on or off
• See your institution's courses and recent activity
• Super Admins can check that every part of the platform is running

Simple and secure
• Sign in with a one-time code sent to your email. No password to remember
• Update your profile and photo, and delete your account at any time

Gorton AI accounts are provided by your institution. If you don't have one yet, contact your institution's Gorton administrator.

name: Goshuin Journal
description:
Give your paper goshuin a journal you can take anywhere.

CAPTURE A PAGE
Take a photo or choose one from Photos. Add the shrine or temple and visit date whenever you like. Crop while keeping the original photo.

FIND A MEMORY
Search by place name or kana, filter by month and pin places on the offline map. Keep a list of pilgrimage stops and see what is next.

SHARE AND BACK UP
Create a keepsake card or send a route code with the names and regions you reviewed. Save originals and records together in a backup.

One journal, capture, search, a route and backups are free. Try all features for 30 days from first launch. Unlock additional books and routes, batch tools and selected-page export with a one-time purchase. No automatic charge. Records are stored on your device.

name: Gramory: Unfollowers Tracker
description:
Follower analysis made simple. See who doesn't follow you back, who unfollowed you and your ghost followers — all in one app.

With Gramory you get:

• Not following back — accounts you follow that don't follow you
• Unfollowers — who unfollowed you, with the date
• Your fans — people who follow you but you don't follow back
• Ghost followers — followers who never engage with your posts
• Engagement ranking — the accounts that interact with you the most
• Accounts that may have blocked you
• Mutual follows
• Notifications for new followers and for people who left
• Select the ones not following back and open their profiles one by one
• Watch stories — without appearing in the viewer list
• Multiple account support

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU

Gramory has no server. Nothing read from your account ever leaves your device. No ads, no data collection. You enter your password on the official login page — the app never sees it.

See the first 3 people who don't follow you back for free. All lists and reports unlock with Gramory Pro.

You confirm every unfollow yourself.

GRAMORY PRO
Gramory Pro is offered as weekly, monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://gramoryapp.com/kosullar/
Privacy Policy: https://gramoryapp.com/gizlilik/

name: Grandma Run™
description:
Make a little time for a big-hearted adventure. Join Jeannie in Grandma Run™, a game from Dew Brook that's fun for all ages.

Explore nine free places: Golf Morning, Sports, Matinee, Game Night, Kitchen, Dinner, Beach Day, Aquarium and Ditch Day. Meet bosses along the way, including the Tunnel Shark, the Runaway Golf Cart and the Flying Corn.

Fancy a change of pace? Try Bounce Up or Dusk Walk, then make the House your own with decorations.

Three Special Outings bring more places to visit: Holiday Table, Amusement Park and Sewing Afternoon. After Matinee, your first visit to each is free. A one-time in-app purchase opens all three. Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers your family. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

Rewarded video ads are your choice, never forced. Choose to watch for an in-game reward, or leave the offer. Coins are never sold.

Plays on iPhone and iPad.

From a morning on the golf course to an afternoon at the aquarium, there's always another little outing ahead.

Made by Dew Brook, a small game studio. Grandma Run™ is a trademark of Dew Brook LLC. © 2026 Dew Brook LLC.
Questions? support@dewbrook.com

name: Grave Crew: Zombie Multiplayer
seller_name: FUTUROMY BILISIM VE YAZILIM DIS TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Grave Crew is a top-down zombie survival shooter for 1 to 4 players. Share a 4-letter room code, pick your crew member and hold the line together while the dead pour in through the breaches, wave after wave.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Online co-op for up to 4 players: create a room, share the code, start in three taps
• No one else around? Fill the empty places with crew bots
• Quick callouts instead of chat
• Friendly fire on or off, the host decides

ENDLESS WAVES
• The waves never stop, and every 5th wave brings a boss
• Seven kinds of undead: Walker, Bilebag, Twitcher, Doorman, Crier, Yuleghoul and the armored giant Ironmaw
• The map shifts every 3 waves
• Chain kills into combos and beat your best score on Easy, Normal or Hard

18 WEAPONS
• Start with a pistol, find the rest in supply drops and gift boxes
• SMG, Shotgun, Sniper, Flamer, Freeze Gun, Shock Gun, Rockets, Minigun and more
• Put down barrels, mines, barriers and sentry turrets
• Weapons level up as you use them

18 ARENAS
• 8 free arenas, from Desert Outpost and Frozen Front to Ash Valley
• 10 themed arenas with cover of their own: Pharaoh's Tomb, Graveyard, Basketball Court, Snowy Christmas, Beach, Laboratory, School, Supermarket, Fast Food and Amusement Park

DRESS YOUR CREW
• Four crew members, each with a small perk: Sarge, Doc, Rook and Tank
• Outfits, undead costumes like Dracula and the Mummy, team jerseys and weapon skins, each with its own look and a small perk
• Some change your shots too: snowballs, confetti, bananas
• Special offers put three matching items together for less

SOLO, ANY TIME
• Solo play is free and works offline
• Twin-stick touch controls
• No ads, no account
• In English, Turkish, German, Portuguese, Spanish and French

ONLINE PLAY SUBSCRIPTION
Creating and joining online rooms needs the Online Play subscription (1 month, renews automatically) for each player. Subscribing also gives you Sarge's Santa outfit, the Snowball Blaster and the Snowy Christmas arena to keep. The price is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before that. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Outfits, weapon skins, themed arenas and special offers are optional one-time purchases.

Terms of Use: https://apps.futuromy.com/grave-crew/terms
Privacy Policy: https://apps.futuromy.com/grave-crew/privacy

name: GRAZE BREAK: Bullet Hell Shmup
description:
Graze the bullets. The closer you get, the stronger you become.
Defeat the mid-boss to BREAK—your firepower doubles again and again.
A one-handed, 3-minute portrait bullet-hell roguelite.

Skim past enemy fire to charge HEAT, take down the mid-boss GATEKEEPER to trigger BREAK, and watch your damage skyrocket until the entire screen erupts in neon explosions.

■ HOW IT PLAYS
1. GRAZE — Skim close to enemy bullets without getting hit
2. HEAT — Grazing fills HEAT, boosting attack speed & score multiplier (up to ×10)
3. BREAK — Defeat the mid-boss GATEKEEPER to trigger BREAK: full HP restore and continuously doubling firepower
4. FUSION — Collect gems to level up and pick 1 of 3 cards. Max a weapon to Lv5 + matching passive Lv2+ (from Lv12) to unleash FUSION

After BREAK, choose between SAFE (+1 HP) or RISK (stronger enemies, ×1.5 score) at RISK GATES.

■ 3 GAME MODES
• BLITZ (3 min) — Fast, intense action for quick sessions
• FULL RUN (10 min) — Deep build-crafting marathon
• DAILY — Same rules, seed, and pilot for everyone, resetting daily at 0:00 JST

■ 4 WEAPONS & 4 FUSIONS
Pulse Laser, Plasma Orb, Homing Missile, and Thunder Chain. Evolve them into Prism Net, Plasma Drill, Cluster Bomb, and Storm Net to blanket the arena in light.

■ 5 SECTORS & HARD PROTOCOL
GRID → SWARM → BARRAGE → OVERHEAT → ABYSS. Clear a sector to unlock the next, then push through 20 stages of HARD (PROTOCOL 0–20) for up to ×3 score.

■ 4 PILOTS
• NOVA — Balanced standard unit (Pulse Laser)
• VEIL — Wider GRAZE range, -1 Max HP (Plasma Orb)
• BOLT — +20% attack speed, faster HEAT decay (Thunder Chain)
• ATLAS — +2 HP & +10% power, heavier handling (Homing Missile)
Choose your first pilot in each stage and unlock the rest with in-game coins.

■ ONE-HANDED PORTRAIT CONTROL
Drag anywhere on the screen to steer—your finger never hides the ship. Only the tiny white core dot is your hitbox.

■ LEADERBOARDS & OFFLINE PLAY
Play offline anytime. Scores save locally and sync automatically to 4 Game Center leaderboards (BLITZ / FULL RUN / DAILY / PROTOCOL).

■ ADS & IN-APP PURCHASE
Displays banner ads on menu/result screens and occasional interstitial ads when leaving results (never during gameplay). A one-time Ad-Free Pack removes all ads, doubles coins earned, and enables ad-free Continue & Reroll (1x per normal run). DAILY rules & rankings are identical for all players.

name: Grow Dragon: Eat & Fly
description:
Hatch as a tiny dragon, eat sparks and smaller dragons to grow, and rule the skies from the valley all the way to the stars!

ARENA
Grow alongside rivals in a huge sky. Reach the top 3 on the live leaderboard and defend first place! When you're online, some rivals may be real players; the others are AI: they get ambitious, grow and ram you, and when you're on top they want your throne. Surprise events like gold rain, spark storms and a giant hunter dragon make every match different. Finish on the podium for a gold, silver or bronze chest.

6 WORLDS, 30 LEVELS AND ENDLESS AGES
Valley, Forest Skies, Mountain Peaks, Storm Belt, Star Sea and Dark Void. Hook arrows from archer towers, spiky drakes, thunder fields and hunter packs are waiting. Each level has one main goal and two bonus goals; complete them all for 3 stars. Finish every level and a new Age begins: the same levels, stronger rivals, bigger rewards.

GIANT BOSSES
Fire Drake, Stone Dragon, Storm Wyvern, Ice Dragon, Ancient Dragon and the Void Beast. They're stronger than you: grow first, then breathe fire, boost and strike!

COMPANIONS
Place free eggs in nests and collect companion cards when they hatch. The companion you take along flies with you and does its own job: collects gold, heals you, takes hits for you or attacks rivals. Collect cards and level up your companions.

SKINS
25 skins from Flame Hatchling to Crystal Dragon, each with its own skill. Lava, Shadow Dragon, Rainbow and Golden Prince are waiting.

UPGRADE AND COME BACK DAILY
Spend gold on health, attack, speed, boost, critical chance and gold bonus. Daily tasks, a weekly chest road and 7-day login rewards.

• Plays offline; when online you may meet real players in the Arena.
• Rewarded ads are optional (continue, double gold, free gold and eggs). An ad is shown occasionally between levels and matches; the No Ads pack removes them.
• Optional in-app purchases: gold packs, egg packs and No Ads. Egg drop rates are shown in the game.
• Turkish and English.

name: GS Ballistic Suite
description: Ballistic Suite offers sports shooters and hunters everything they need to explore the sport.  Ballistic solver, Load development, Wind Effect, Sessions logs and history, converters and more.  In app guidance and support.

name: Guardia — Co-Parenting App
description:
Raising kids across two homes is hard enough. The tense messages, the schedule changes, the expenses, the paperwork — that's the part Guardia carries with you.

MEET JUNE
June keeps your family's board — schedule, messages, expenses, and kids' info — and posts what's new as little bubbles, so nothing slips. Ask her about your own record in English or Spanish: what your parenting plan says (she quotes it word for word), what's coming up, who owes what. She answers only from your family's record, never a guess — and when you ask her to add something to the calendar, she opens the form already filled in for you to review and save.

CALMER MESSAGES
Write the way you feel; send the way you mean. A tone check flags blame and threats before you send. Optional Buffer Mode relays a calmer version while preserving every fact, date, and number exactly — threats and safety issues are never softened. Both versions stay locked side by side in the record, and the rules are identical for both parents. Always.

VOICE AND VIDEO CALLS
Talk face to face right inside the app when a message isn't enough. Calls are never recorded — if you both agree, a short written note after the call can be saved to the record.

ONE SHARED CALENDAR
Exchanges, swaps, school and medical events in one place. Ask for a schedule change and the other parent answers in the app — the record shows who agreed to what, and when.

EXPENSES WITHOUT THE ARGUMENT
Log shared expenses, attach receipts, request reimbursements, and mark them paid. Everyone sees the same numbers.

YOUR KIDS' INFO, ONE BANK
School, doctors, medicines, health visits, and the details both homes need — kept in one Info Bank, with a private journal and check-ins for pickups and drop-offs.

PAPERWORK HELP
Answer plain-language questions and Guardia helps you prepare your court forms and declarations from your own facts. You review everything, and you file it with the court yourself.

ONE RECORD YOU CAN TRUST
Everything above lives in one tamper-evident record with read receipts. Download your Family Record as one file — your whole record in one place, ready to share with a mediator, a guardian ad litem, or your own AI assistant.

SAFETY FIRST
Quick Exit on every screen, location privacy by default, and domestic-violence resources one tap away.

IMPORTANT
Guardia provides legal information and document-preparation help only. It is not a law firm, and it does not give legal advice or predict outcomes.

FREE 10-DAY TRIAL
Try every feature free for 10 days — no card required. Tell us what to fix — every report gets read.

name: Habitome: Book Reading Tracker
description:
Read a little every day, and watch it add up. Habitome keeps your books, your streak and your progress in one calm place, with no social feed and no ads.

TRACK EVERY BOOK
• Add books by searching, scanning the barcode or typing them in
• Shelves for Reading, Want to Read, Finished and Did Not Finish, plus your own tags
• Paper, ebook or audiobook: track pages, percent or minutes
• Series, re-reads, start and finish dates, half-star ratings and notes

BUILD THE HABIT
• Log today's reading in one tap, in the app or from the widget
• Daily streaks, with shields that cover a day you miss
• A gentle reminder at the time you choose
• A reading timer with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• A yearly goal and finish-by dates that tell you if you're on pace

KEEP THE LINES YOU LOVE
• Photograph a page, zoom in and pick the exact sentences to keep as quotes
• Quotes can run across two pages
• Share them as text or as a card

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
• Import your library from Goodreads or StoryGraph
• Export everything to CSV whenever you like
• Syncs across your iPhone and iPad with iCloud; no account to create

FREE FOR GOOD
Unlimited books, streaks and shields, widgets, reminders, import and export are free, with no limits and no ads.

HABITOME PRO
• Stats for every year you've read, not just this one
• Year in Review, a recap of your reading year ready to share
• Reading insights: your favorite authors, how you rate and your reading pace
• App icons for your Home Screen

Pro is available monthly, yearly with a free trial, or as a one-time purchase. If you start a trial, Habitome reminds you two days before it ends.

name: Habitpup: Habit Tracker
description:
Habitpup is the habit tracker that forgives. Miss a day and your progress doesn't crash to zero, so you keep going instead of starting over.

WHY IT FEELS DIFFERENT
• Momentum, not only streaks: a missed day slows your progress instead of wiping it out.
• Shields: a shield covers a missed day for you, so one busy day doesn't break your streak.
• Rest days: on holiday or feeling ill? Pause a habit and nothing counts against you.

YOUR DAY, IN ORDER
• Morning, Afternoon and Evening sections show what's next at a glance.
• Check in with one tap, count glasses of water, or log minutes and pages.
• Flexible goals: every day, chosen weekdays, a few times a week or a few times a month.
• Forgot to check in yesterday? Fill in past days and add notes.

WATCH IT GROW
• Every habit grows a living plant in your Grove. Keep going and it blooms.
• Insights shows your strongest days, your usual check-in time and how this week compares with the last.
• Week, month and year stories celebrate how far you've come.

ALWAYS WITHIN REACH
• Home Screen widgets: check in without opening the app.
• Gentle reminders at the times you choose.
• Light and dark looks, in 20 languages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads. Your habits stay on your phone.
• Daily backups to your own iCloud Drive (iPhone) or Google Drive (Android), plus export and import any time.
• Coming from HabitKit or Loop Habit Tracker? Bring your habits and history over in a minute.

HABITPUP PRO
The free plan includes up to 6 habits, one reminder per habit, basic stats and the Today widget. Pro unlocks unlimited habits, up to 3 reminders per habit, 2 shields a week, Insights stories and the One habit and Last 5 days widgets.
Choose yearly (with a 7-day free trial), monthly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

name: Hanukkah Hippo
description:
Light the menorah one night at a time in Hanukkah Hippo, a retro platform adventure across eight lands inspired by Jewish history and folklore. Collect gelt, find hidden pipes, and face the Goblin King. Grab a latke, power up with a sufganiyah, and see what lies beyond the next brick.

Find secret realms, collect dreidel symbols, and unlock familiar and unexpected heroes. A four-symbol password lets you come back to the start of a night. Designed for iPhone with touch controls, optional auto-run and haptic feedback. Play offline, with no account or ads.

name: Hartig: hartgezond weekmenu
description:
Hartig plant elke week een gevarieerd, hartgezond menu voor ontbijt, middag, avond en tussendoor, en zet de ingrediënten met één tik op je winkellijst.

Gemaakt voor wie bewust wil eten en let op verzadigd vet en vezels, bijvoorbeeld bij een te hoge cholesterol. De recepten volgen gangbare voedingsrichtlijnen: veel groenten, peulvruchten en volle granen, vette vis, noten en olijf- of koolzaadolie in plaats van boter en room.

WEEKMENU
• Automatisch een gevarieerd menu, tot zes weken vooruit
• Ander voorstel nodig? Vervang één maaltijd of de hele week
• Koken met wat je in huis hebt
• Porties aanpasbaar, standaard voor 2 personen

RECEPTEN
• Ruim 100 recepten, gratis
• Geef sterren, voeg opmerkingen toe en maak je eigen recepten
• Duid aan wat je niet lust: Hartig stelt die gerechten niet meer voor
• Vervang een ingrediënt en zie meteen of het een hartgezonde keuze is
• Per persoon een schatting van verzadigd vet, vezels en calorieën

WINKELLIJST
• De ingrediënten van een week in één tik op je lijst, per afdeling
• Wat je al in huis hebt, sla je over

CHECK
• Kijk een ingrediënt of product na op verzadigd vet, transvet en vezels
• Scan de barcode of QR-code, of fotografeer het etiket

SAMEN
• Synchroniseert via iCloud tussen iPhone, iPad en Mac
• Deel je weekmenu en winkellijst met je partner

EXTRA'S (eenmalige aankoop, geen abonnement)
• Seizoensgerechten: per seizoen 30 avondmalen met verse seizoensgroenten, of alle vier samen
• Stap-voor-stapbereiding voor de Thermomix® TM6 en TM7 bij meer dan 100 recepten
• Ook voor je gezin via Gezinsdelen

PRIVACY
Geen account, geen reclame, geen tracking. Je gegevens blijven op je toestellen en in je eigen iCloud.

Hartig geeft algemene voedingsinformatie en vervangt het advies van je arts of diëtist niet. Voedingswaarden: NEVO-online (RIVM) en Open Food Facts.
Thermomix is een merk van Vorwerk; Hartig is er niet aan verbonden.

name: Hear Me: Name & Number Alerts
description:
Headphones on at work? Put the name your coworkers call you in the parentheses, then tap Start Listening. Hear Me alerts you when it recognizes your name in nearby speech or an announcement.

• At work, listen for your name while you keep your headphones on.
• At the counter, enter 168 from your receipt and wait for “order one hundred sixty-eight.”
• On the train, enter your stop and listen for its name in the announcement.

You can enter a word or a whole phrase, like “now boarding.” To listen for several things at once, put one in each pair of parentheses. Hear Me picks a recognition language based on the text in each one and alerts you when it recognizes any of them.

Choose your listening device

Use your iPhone mic, a connected headset with a microphone, or a paired Mac. Pair your iPhone and Mac on the same network to start or stop listening on your Mac from your phone.

Get one alert or keep listening

Use Listen Once for a single call. It stops after the first match. Choose Keep Listening if you want another alert the next time a phrase comes up. On iPhone, you can get system notifications and turn spoken alerts or vibration on as needed.

Once listening starts, you can switch apps or lock your iPhone. On supported iPhones, you can check your listening status in the Dynamic Island when Live Activities are enabled.

Start from a widget and check what you heard

Add a small, medium, or large widget to your iPhone Home Screen or Mac desktop. Check whether Hear Me is listening or start again with a saved phrase. Open History to see what was heard, when, and on which device.

Speech recognition runs on your chosen device. Our servers do not receive or store microphone audio or listening history.

Phrase entry and listening require a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase for lifetime access. If you’re eligible, you’ll get 3 days free when you start the monthly subscription. The subscription then renews and is billed each month unless you cancel before the trial ends. Check the App Store for your local price.

Terms of Use　https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy Policy　https://hear-me-listen.vn9vjcth2g.chatgpt.site/privacy.html

name: Heardy: American Accent Coach
description:
Heardy helps you sound clearer and more natural in American English, a few minutes a day.

Start with a free 2-minute baseline: read five sentences and Heardy scores the sounds that matter for your first language. Choose from 22 first languages, from Hindi and Mandarin to Spanish and Arabic. Your plan starts with the sound that will make the biggest difference.

HOW IT WORKS
• Hear a natural American voice, at normal or slow speed
• Record the phrase and get feedback in seconds
• See the one sound to fix, and what it sounded like instead
• Tap any word to see every sound in it
• Compare your rhythm and pitch with the model

MEET HEARDY
Heardy, the bunny coach, shows what your lips and tongue should do for each sound, right next to the cue.

A COURSE BUILT FOR YOU
Eleven units, from the American R to stress and rhythm, ordered by your baseline. Learn how a sound is made, then practice it in words, sentences and a short passage. Nothing is locked.

PRACTICE ANYTHING
Every American sound in the Sound Library, 24 tricky words like "schedule" and "comfortable", and any sentence you type.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Trends use the median of your last three attempts, so one noisy take won't move them. Training scores track your progress; they don't judge how "native" you sound.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Recordings are never stored on our servers; keep them on your iPhone for 30 days if you like
• No ads, and no tracking across other apps or websites
• Sign in with Apple or Google is optional; we never ask for your name or email

HEARDY PRO
Your baseline, retests and focus unit are always free, with a daily allowance of scored takes elsewhere. Heardy Pro removes the daily limits, billed monthly or yearly; both plans start with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://heardy.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://heardy.app/privacy

Speak clearly. Be understood.

name: Hearthkept: Chore Tracker
description:
Hearthkept is a chore planner for the people who share a home: partners, families and roommates. It turns the housework into a short daily list and puts the same list on everyone's phone.

No account to create, no subscription, and no nagging about who forgot what.

WHAT IT DOES
• Builds a daily plan that fits the minutes you actually have, on weekdays and weekends
• Brings recurring tasks back when they are due: daily, weekly, monthly, certain weekdays, or by season
• Shares one home with everyone in it, so a chore ticked off on one phone is done on all of them
• Keeps it fair: points, a leaderboard, and optional approval before a child's chores count
• Shows the week ahead with a time budget for each day
• Remembers everything: a history of who did what, with one-tap undo
• Starts fast with ready-made rooms and a task library you can edit

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT
Sharing runs on your own iCloud, not on a server of ours. You invite people with Apple's sharing sheet; they tap the link and your home appears on their iPhone or iPad. There is no Hearthkept account, and we cannot see your home. Because sharing costs us nothing to run, we do not charge for it every month.

Everything also works offline. Changes are saved on the device and catch up the next time it is online.

PRICE
Hearthkept is free on one device with every feature and no time limit. Syncing your own iPhone and iPad is free too. To invite other people, the person who owns the home buys the Household unlock once ($9.99 in the US). Joining is free for everyone they invite. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, and it supports Family Sharing.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sharing needs iCloud signed in on each device
• Daily reminders are optional and set per device
• Export a backup file any time from Settings
