name: Heftnote: Gym Workout Log
description:
Heftnote is a gym log for people who lift. Open it, pick your routine, and log each set with weight and reps in a couple of taps. It shows what you did last time, so you start from your real numbers, and it suggests a weight to try next. It works offline, with no account.

Made for lifters who want a fast, quiet log in the gym, not a coach, a feed or a subscription.

LOG A WORKOUT
- Weight, reps and set type (warm-up, working, drop, failure) in one row
- Last time's numbers shown right in the row, one tap to repeat them
- Rest timer that keeps running with the phone locked, with a Live Activity
- Plate calculator: see which plates to load on each side of the bar
- Short on time drops one set per exercise; Feeling beat keeps last time's weights
- About 150 built-in exercises, plus your own

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Charts of estimated one-rep max, heaviest set and volume for each lift
- Personal records marked with a word badge when you finish
- Your week at a glance and your streak of weeks
- History by month, with search, edit and repeat

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
- Works offline; syncs through your own iCloud
- Saves finished workouts to Apple Health as strength training (optional; Heftnote reads nothing)
- Import a CSV from another gym log, export everything any time

HEFTNOTE PRO
Free covers unlimited routines and logging, the rest timer, next-weight suggestions, 12-week charts and the plate calculator. Pro is a one-time purchase, with no subscription: all-time charts, weekly volume per muscle, body weight log, rep range per exercise and gym profiles.

Heftnote does not give medical advice and makes no health or weight-loss claims.

name: Heimdall Uptime Monitoring
description:
Heimdall watches your websites, APIs and servers from several regions and calls the people on duty when something goes down. This app puts the incidents and monitors of your Heimdall organisation in your pocket.

• Incidents: what is open right now, who has acknowledged it, and what was resolved in the last 30 days, with the timeline of alerts and escalations.
• Act where you are: acknowledge an incident to stop the escalation, snooze it, or resolve it — as your role in the organisation allows.
• Monitors: every monitor's state at a glance — up, degraded, down, paused or in maintenance.
• Several organisations: switch between the organisations you belong to.
• Two-step sign-in, in English and Turkish.

The app is for people who already have a Heimdall account: sign in with the e-mail address and password you use on the web. Accounts and organisations are created at heimdall.warewave.tech.

No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your session key stays in the phone's secure storage.

name: HelpMe Online
description:
HelpMe Online is a community platform designed to bring people together, encourage collaboration, and make communication easier.

Connect with other members, discover professionals, participate in discussions, and exchange ideas in an interactive online environment.

**Key Features**

- **Community Networking:** Connect with members and build meaningful relationships.
- **Instant Messaging:** Communicate through private conversations and group discussions.
- **Discussion Rooms:** Join conversations around shared interests and topics.
- **Professional Profiles:** Discover members, their expertise, and their interests.
- **Community Engagement:** Share ideas, ask questions, and contribute to discussions.
- **Real-Time Communication:** Stay connected through messaging and notifications.

Whether you want to exchange knowledge, meet new people, collaborate on projects, or participate in community discussions, HelpMe Online provides a space to connect and interact.

Join HelpMe Online and become part of a growing community.

name: HexJetty
description:
Check Intel HEX and Motorola S-record structure, inspect memory segments and export normalized text or binary ranges.

1. Import or paste Intel HEX or S-record text.
2. Review checksums, record counts, addresses and termination.
3. Inspect memory segments, holes and overlaps.
4. Choose an inclusive binary range and fill byte, or normalize valid data.
5. Export a new HEX, S-record, BIN or PDF file.

Input is limited to 8 MiB and 500,000 records; binary ranges to 32 MiB. Structural validation does not prove firmware authenticity, security or bootability. No flashing or device connection is performed.

name: Hey Basket: Voice Grocery List
description:
Say it — see it in your list.

Tap the microphone and talk the way you talk: "Add two cartons of milk, a pound of ground beef and some bread, and remove the eggs." Hey Basket adds every item with its amount, removes what you asked, and sorts the list by aisle, so you walk the shop once.

SORTED BY AISLE
Fruit and vegetables, bakery, dairy, meat, frozen, household: every item goes to its department with a clear emoji. Say "pillows at IKEA" and the item goes to its own IKEA group.

SETS FOR THE THINGS YOU ALWAYS BUY
Save a set like "Essentials" or "Breakfast" and add it to any list in one tap, or just say "add the essentials". Items already in the list are not added twice.

SHARE WITH YOUR FAMILY
Invite your partner or family with a code. Everyone sees changes at once and can see who added what.

MADE FOR THE SHOP
- Tap an item to check it off; bought items move to the bottom.
- Works without internet in the store and syncs later.
- The screen stays on while the list is open.
- Undo any voice command with one tap. If you say "milk" and there are two kinds, the app asks which one.

FREE AND PRO
Manual input is free with no limits. Voice input is free for your first 100 items. Pro gives you voice input with no limits.

Hey Basket Pro is an auto-renewable subscription (weekly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://shoppinglist.halpindev.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://shoppinglist.halpindev.com/privacy

name: Hifz Rutin: Quran Memorization
description:
Know which verses to revisit today. Hifz Rutin guides you through the final ten short surahs of Juz Amma. Read one ayah, hide it to recall from memory, then decide how soon to practise it again.

Set your session length, adjust Arabic text size and choose a credited translation. Text and practice work offline. Stream and loop Mishary Rashid Alafasy’s recitation with an internet connection. Your practice stays on your device.

The ten starter surahs and their daily review are free. The optional Juz 30 Training pack is a one-time purchase. Set a surah range and a daily new-verse target across all 37 surahs, see your prior Repeat ratings, and revisit difficult verses in one tap.

name: Hip Hops Station
description:
Redwater Bay, 1984. On the banks of the Red River, a biker gang that stands for peace is respected by the whole city: the RPM Dos Hip Hops.

Davi Monteiro arrives to spend his vacation at his aunt and uncle's workshop. He fixes an old motorcycle, pulls off a stunt only the leader could do, and joins the gang. But not everyone in the RPM wants peace…

Hip Hops Station is a match-3 puzzle game with a real story, based on the book RPM Dos Hip Hops.

718 MATCH-3 LEVELS
Match 3 or more pieces, beat levels and earn stars. There are 718 levels across 60 chapters, with crates, cones, oil slicks, mud, padlocks, blackouts, confetti, streamers, whistles, scoreboards and much more. Plus bonus levels to earn extra stars.

RESTORE THE TOWN IN 3D
Every star rebuilds a piece of the story. Restore 60 places in 3D: the workshop, the alleys, the track, the harbor fair, the carnival shed, the school court, the riverboat and, of course, the station.

FOUR SEASONS OF STORY
Comic-book scenes, characters who react to your moves and a memory album to complete. Follow the crew in 1984, 1991, 1992 and 1993: friendship, rivalry, courage and a rival gang on the streets.

NEW: SEASON 4 · TWO CITIES
Davi heads back to the capital and Eddie, 16, takes over the RPM branch in Vila Uirapuru, between Carnival, the classroom and the school futsal tournament. 20 chapters, 240 levels and 19 new mechanics.

SPECIAL PIECES
Create the Exhaust, the Turbo Tire, the Bike and the Golden Bracelet. Combine specials for even bigger effects.

RACES AND MINI-GAMES
Speed up in Socorro's race, pack the cargo in Bira's truck and test your memory with Raíssa. Use the workshop tools: wrench, jack and horn.

GAME CENTER AND iCLOUD
Game Center achievements and iCloud save: switch iPhones without losing anything.

80s AND 90s VIBES
Original synth soundtrack and the roar of motorcycles.

• Free to play, with all four seasons unlocked at no cost
• Ads only when you want a reward, or briefly between levels, never in the middle of a move
• Optional purchase to remove ads
• No paid random loot boxes
• Available in Portuguese, English and Spanish

Based on the book RPM Dos Hip Hops.

name: HoikuNova 保育士 一問一答・模擬試験
description:
HoikuNova（ホイクノバ）は、保育士試験（筆記試験）の対策アプリです。保育原理・教育原理・社会的養護・子ども家庭福祉・社会福祉・保育の心理学・子どもの保健・子どもの食と栄養・保育実習理論の 9 科目を、テキスト・一問一答・模擬試験で一つのアプリで。科目ごとの合格予測と弱点の分析が、次に何をやるかを決めてくれます。法令・保育所保育指針などは 2026 年 4 月 1 日時点の内容です。

■ 今日の学習（弱点の分析と合格予測）
一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。保育士試験は科目ごとに 6 割で合格なので、合格予測も科目ごとに出し、6 割に届いていない科目を知らせます。

■ テキスト（52 本）
全 52 単元に、要点・表（予防接種と出席停止の基準、離乳の目安、保育士の配置基準、コードネームなど）・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。読んだらそのまま単元の問題へ進めます。

■ 一問一答（376 問）
・保育の心理学: 発達の理論、乳児期・幼児期の発達、ことば、愛着、生涯発達、発達の支援
・保育原理: 保育所保育指針（総則・ねらいと内容・計画と評価・子育て支援）、保育の歴史、制度
・子ども家庭福祉: 理念と歴史、児童福祉法と行政、虐待・DV、母子保健と子育て支援、ひとり親と貧困、障害のある子ども、少年非行
・社会福祉: 歴史、制度と実施体制、社会保険、相談援助、権利擁護、生活保護・高齢者・障害者福祉
・教育原理: 教育思想、日本の教育史、教育法規、教育課程と方法、現代の教育課題
・社会的養護: 理念、施設、里親と養子縁組、自立支援、権利擁護
・子どもの保健: 発育と生理機能、感染症と予防接種、病気と症状、事故防止と救急、保健と衛生
・子どもの食と栄養: 栄養素、食事摂取基準（2025 年版）、授乳と離乳、幼児期以降の食、食育、アレルギー
・保育実習理論: 音楽（コード・調・記号・子どもの歌）、造形、言語と児童文化、保育の実践、施設実習
本番と同じ 5 択（「A〜D の正誤の組み合わせ」「語句の組み合わせ」）と、2024 年後期から加わった「正しいものを 2 つ（3 つ）選びなさい」の形式、要点を確かめる ○× で。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・30 回分、各 160 問・計 4,800 問）
9 科目を本番の順で、各科目 20 問 60 分（教育原理・社会的養護は 10 問 30 分）。全科目を通しで解くほか、科目を選んでその科目だけを本番の時間で解けます。自動で採点して科目ごとに 6 割に届いたかを示し、全問の正解と解説で見直せます。
問題冊子・答案用紙（マークシート）・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。
※ 楽譜を使う問題は扱わず、保育実習理論の音楽はコードネーム・調号・記号などを文字で出題しています。

■ 通知

name: HoldON
description:
Тримайся. Ми порахуємо кожну хвилину.

Звичка працює непомітно — і прогрес від відмови теж непомітний: день без снюсу виглядає так само, як звичайний день. HoldON робить невидимий прогрес видимим.

ТАЙМЕР ДЛЯ ВІДМОВИ
Снюс, сигарети, вейп, солодке, соцмережі, алкоголь — створи ціль, і таймер почне рахувати безперервно. Будь-коли бачиш, скільки вже тримаєшся: хвилини, години, дні.

СЕРІЇ ДЛЯ ЗВИЧОК
Зарядка, читання, вода, медитація. Одне підтвердження на день, тиждень чи місяць — і серія росте. Або режим «дні на місяць», якщо поспіль не обовʼязково.

УТРИМУЙ — І СВЯТКУЙ
Утримай кнопку «Тримаюсь», щоб підтвердити. Щоразу на тебе чекає інше святкування — їх 18, і вони яскравішають зі зростанням серії. На рубежах — 24 години, 7 днів, 30 днів, 100 днів — особливе комбо і бейдж.

ТРИМАЙТЕСЯ РАЗОМ
Запроси друзів у свою ціль за посиланням або 6-значним кодом. Кожен відмічається у себе, а всі бачать, хто вже відмітився сьогодні, а хто… провтикав. Рейтинг учасників і особисті рекорди — дружнє змагання, у якому важче зірватися.

ЗРИВ — ЦЕ НЕ КІНЕЦЬ
Відлік почнеться знову, а твій рекорд лишається з тобою. Без осуду і без підрахунку, скільки разів ти починав.

ДІЛИСЯ РЕЗУЛЬТАТОМ
Гарна картка з твоїм результатом і посиланням — в один дотик у будь-який месенджер.

ТВОЄ — ТІЛЬКИ ТВОЄ
• Без реєстрації: ні пошти, ні пароля
• Для спільних цілей — тільки нік і фото
• Друзі бачать лише спільну ціль, а не всі твої
• Без реклами
• Працює без інтернету — відмітки синхронізуються пізніше
• Нагадування, щоб не перервати серію
• Українська та англійська мови

Чому це працює: HoldON спирається на дослідження поведінкової психології — самоспостереження, видимий прогрес, близькість мети й непередбачувану винагороду.

HoldON — інструмент самоспостереження, а не медичний засіб. Якщо тобі важко впоратися із залежністю самостійно, звернись до лікаря або на гарячу лінію психологічної підтримки.

Умови використання: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: HooLacaix
description:
HooLacaix is the name on the App Store. The app is a calm, offline ritual companion for your iPhone—not therapy, diagnosis, or crisis care.

TODAY
See a three-part ring for the current day. Complete a short morning flow and a short evening flow to light each segment. Kindness in the morning can be skipped.

STREAK
Evening completion drives your streak. Open the Streak tab for a month view with dots for mornings, evenings, and care taps.

CARE (RITUALS)
Quick kind-act cards—walk, warm drink, and more—listed under the Care tab. Log them for today; they appear on Today without filling the ring.

REMINDERS
Optional local notification times for morning and evening in More. Notifications are scheduled on-device only when you turn them on and grant permission.

MORE
Morning and evening reminder times, a short notification guide, and Privacy Policy in an in-app browser—the only network use in the app.

name: Hostwick: Wi-Fi Device Scanner
description:
Hostwick lists every device on the Wi-Fi you are connected to, names what it can, and marks the one that is new since your last check.

WHO IS ON YOUR WI-FI
- One tap scans your network and lists each device with its name, address and kind
- A new device shows up marked NEW. Say it is yours, or say you do not know it
- See how Hostwick found each device and which services it has open
- A history of every check, so you see when a device first showed up

ROOM CHECK
- In a rental or hotel room, list the devices on the Wi-Fi that look like cameras
- It looks at names, makers and open video ports of devices on the same Wi-Fi
- A listed device is only a lead: ask your host about it

WHAT IT CANNOT SEE
Hostwick only sees devices on the Wi-Fi you are connected to. It cannot see cameras on another network, cameras that record to a memory card, or devices that use mobile data. It does not prove that a room has no camera.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. The scan runs on your iPhone or iPad and stays on your device.

HOSTWICK PRO
Hostwick Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase. It adds more networks, the full history, unlimited Auto-check with alerts for new devices, and port details with plain-language meaning. Scanning your Wi-Fi and Room check stay available without it.
Hostwick needs permission to find devices on your local network.

name: HTMLable: HTML Viewer
description:
You asked AI to make it, and it came back as an HTML file. Where do you keep it, and how do you open it on your iPhone?
HTMLable saves the HTML files that generative AI creates and opens them instantly. Slides, pages and dashboards look just as they were designed.

SAVE IT, OPEN IT
• Choose HTMLable from the share button in your AI app, and it's saved
• Add files from the Files app, the clipboard or a URL
• Organize with Recents, Pinned, Slides and All. Add your favorite folders as tabs
• Deleted something by mistake? Restore it from Recently Deleted in the app for 30 days

SLIDES THAT BEHAVE LIKE SLIDES
• HTML slide decks are detected automatically and shown one slide at a time
• Tap Play for full screen and swipe to move between slides
• Connect a TV or projector (AirPlay or cable): the big screen shows only the slide, while your device shows the next slide and your presenter notes

READY FOR WORK
• Export to PDF (one slide per page)
• Bundle images and CSS into a single file
• Show a document to people on the same Wi-Fi with a QR code
• Open your usual documents from Home Screen widgets
• Switch between phone and desktop layout, translate, and mark up with Apple Pencil

DON'T TRUST EVERY FILE YOU RECEIVE
• Requests for the camera, microphone and location are refused
• Connections to devices on your home network are blocked
• Unexpected pop-ups, downloads and jumps to other sites wait for your confirmation
• Safe Mode for when you want to be extra careful

NEW TO THIS?
You don't need an HTML file to start. "Have AI Make Slides" inside the app gives you prompts you can paste into your AI app.

PRICE
Free to use, with ads. Extra features such as PDF export are available for 24 hours after you watch one ad.

Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Your documents are never sent to our servers.

name: Hubbub: Pub Quiz and More
description:
Hubbub turns any room into game night. Pick a game, and your group is playing within a minute.

FISHBOWL
Everyone writes words into the bowl. Then the same words come back for four rounds: describe them freely, give one word, act them out, and finally draw them on the screen. By round four the whole room is shouting.

PUB QUIZ
A real pub quiz with 2,500 free questions in general knowledge, history, geography, film and TV, and sports. Pick the topic of each round, or let Hubbub surprise you. Run it as quizmaster from one phone, or let every team answer on their own.

ONE PHONE OR EVERYONE'S
Pass one phone around, or have everyone join from their own phone with a four letter code or a QR code. No accounts, no sign up.

WRITE YOUR OWN QUIZ
Make your own question pack for free and play it as a round.

MORE PACKS
Add themed quiz packs: the 80s, 90s and 2000s, animated films, sci fi, TV series, video games, food, science, and Walk of Shame, a cheeky pack about dating, parties and scandals.

Free to play with ads between games. Remove ads once, or get every pack with no ads in one bundle. No subscription.

Works offline on one phone. Play in English, German, Spanish or French.

name: Huewise: Color Analysis AI
description:
Discover the colors that make you glow. Huewise is a personal color analysis studio in your pocket: one selfie reveals your color season, undertone and face shape, then helps you shop, dress and do your makeup with confidence.

YOUR COLOR SEASON IN SECONDS
Take a selfie in daylight and answer a few quick questions about your natural hair, eyes and skin. Huewise checks your lighting first, then finds your season in the 12-season system: Light, Warm and Bright Spring, Light, Cool and Soft Summer, Soft, Warm and Deep Autumn, and Deep, Cool and Bright Winter.

A PALETTE MADE FOR YOU
• Your best colors to wear near your face
• Neutrals for coats, trousers, bags and shoes
• Lipstick shades and jewelry metals that flatter you
• The colors to keep away from your face
• Save favorites and build a wardrobe that works together

VIRTUAL COLOR DRAPING
See each shade next to your own face, just like a professional draping session. Compare your best and worst colors side by side and see the difference instantly.

"DOES THIS COLOR SUIT ME?"
In the store, point your camera at a top, dress or lipstick. Huewise tells you if it is a wow color, a good match, or one to wear away from your face, and shows the closest shade from your palette. Clothing scans are analyzed on your phone.

FACE SHAPE STYLE GUIDE
Find out if your face is oval, round, square, heart, long, diamond or pear shaped, with tips for hairstyles, glasses, necklines and earrings.

MADE FOR EVERY SKIN TONE
Huewise reads undertone, depth, clarity and contrast, not ethnicity. Fair, olive, brown and deep skin can belong to any season.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your selfie is analyzed over an encrypted connection and is not stored on our servers or used to train AI.

HUEWISE PRO
Start free and see your season and first colors. Upgrade to Huewise Pro for your full palette, unlimited try-on drapes and color scans, the face shape style guide, makeup and metals, and retakes anytime. Choose monthly or yearly; the yearly plan includes a free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase or after the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://jainishah-apps.pages.dev/huewise/terms
Privacy Policy: https://jainishah-apps.pages.dev/huewise/privacy

name: I got sticks!
description:
An enthusiastic little dachshund found its favorite oversized branch—and refuses to leave it behind!

Guide your pup across 15 handcrafted 3D clay dioramas and carry each stick back to the doghouse. Rushing straight at a narrow fence leaves the branch wedged between gateposts. Just like parallel parking, hold behind your pup to reverse, steer at an angle, and slip one end of the branch cleanly through the opening.

FEATURES
- Intuitive Hold-to-Steer & Reverse Physics: Hold ahead or to the sides to guide your pup forward; hold behind your pup to reverse cleanly. Walk up to any stick and tap Bite to carry or drop it.
- 15 Clay Miniature Worlds Across 6 Biomes: Play through flowerpot yards, autumn hay valleys, bouncy beach coves, snowy ice caves, toyblock bowling towns, and ancient red-blue temple ruins.
- Interactive Physics Puzzles: Knock over clay pots, roll giant hay bales clear of doors, time spinning windmills, bounce past springy mushrooms, strike crystals to toggle gates, press boulder switches, and warp through rune portals.
- Puppy Closet & Fun Stick Skins: Earn 3-star points to unlock 11 adorable outfits (Sunny Corgi, Onsen Shiba, Little Chef, Straw Hat Explorer, Rainy Duck Coat, Bumblebee Suit, Royal Cape, and more) plus 6 playful stick skins (French Baguette, Giant Dream Bone, Fresh Bamboo, Candy Cane, and Giant Pencil).

name: ICARO POS - Punto de Venta
description:
Facturación Fiscal
Cumple con todas las regulaciones del SENIAT. Emisión automática de facturas fiscales con validez legal.
Reportes en Tiempo Real
Visualiza tus ventas, inventario y estadísticas al instante. Toma decisiones basadas en datos reales

Control de Inventario
Gestiona tu stock automáticamente. Alertas de productos bajos y reportes de movimientos.

Multi-usuario
Crea usuarios con diferentes permisos. Controla quién puede acceder a cada función.

100% en la Nube
Accede a tu sistema desde cualquier dispositivo con conexión a internet. Sin instalaciones ni actualizaciones manuales.

name: iControl Snap
description:
Film yourself without running back to the tripod.

iControl Snap turns a Bluetooth game controller into a full camera control surface. Start and stop recording, switch cameras, change modes, cycle filters, zoom and lock focus — all from the controller in your hand, while the phone stays on the tripod.

SHOOT YOUR WAY
• Photo, Video, Time-Lapse, Panorama and Slo-Mo modes, plus a dual-camera PiP record mode
• Filters from clean (Vivid, Noir, Sepia) to stylized — including an on-device Anime look
• Long-press to lock exposure and focus (AE/AF lock), self-timer, and Rotate 90°
• A built-in teleprompter with optional burned-in captions that stay in the safe zone

EDIT IN THE SAME APP
• Photo and Video Edit tabs with multi-layer, draggable overlays and a Layers editor
• Overlays are burned into your export, so what you frame is what you post
• Send finished videos straight to YouTube from the app

FREE vs PRO
Free with ads: core shooting, Panorama, and the free filters. Watching a rewarded ad to the end grants a 30-minute Pro trial.
iControl Snap Pro (one-time purchase) unlocks all Pro filters, Time-Lapse, and the Edit tabs for good — no subscription.

No account. No developer server. Your photos and videos stay in your Photos library unless you choose to share them.

name: Image Compressor: Save Space
description:
Image Compressor: Save Space — compress photos, shrink image size, Live Photo & GIF on device

Is your Camera Roll full, are chat uploads over the limit, or are email attachments too large? Image Compressor helps you compress photos, reduce image file size, and shrink pictures fast. Supported formats include JPEG, PNG, HEIC, HEIF, WebP, AVIF, GIF, Live Photos, and camera RAW such as DNG / CR2 / CR3. Everything runs on your iPhone — photos are never uploaded — so you can free up storage.

【Supported formats】
• Stills: JPEG, PNG, HEIC, HEIF, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, BMP
• Motion: GIF, Live Photo
• Camera RAW: DNG, CR2, CR3, NEF, ARW, RAF, ORF, RW2, CRW, NRW
• Import from Photos, Files, or Camera; save results back to Photos, to Files, or share with the system sheet

【Three compression modes · quality vs size】
• Ratio mode: quick photo compression / image shrink for chat, social posts, and backups
• Quality control: balance sharpness and file size
• Target size: aim for a specific KB / MB limit for email, forms, and upload caps
• Output stills as JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC; keep GIF / Live Photo motion when you want, or preserve PNG / WebP containers

【GIF compression · Live Photo compression · RAW compression】
• GIF compression: keep the motion while cutting file size
• Live Photo compression: optimize still + motion together to reclaim storage
• RAW compression: develop and compress supported DNG and camera RAW into shareable sizes
• Also compress HEIC / HEIF / WebP for modern albums and web-friendly formats

【Batch compress · clear progress】
• Select multiple photos or files and compress in a queue with clear progress
• Preview before/after size, then save or share individually
• Try the free tier first; upgrade to Pro for batch select, unlimited daily compressions, and an ad-free experience

【Common use cases】
• Compress photos to reduce size, shrink images for messaging or email
• Free iPhone storage, slim your library, batch-reduce files before backup
• Compress HEIC, WebP, PNG, JPEG; compress Live Photos, GIFs, and RAW

【On-device processing · privacy first】
• Compression stays on your device — photos are not uploaded to our servers
• Photos or Camera access is requested only when you choose to pick, capture, or save
• Built for people who want smaller files without giving up privacy

Whether you need to compress photos, batch compress images, compress GIFs, compress Live Photos, or compress RAW, Image Compressor makes reducing file size and saving storage simple.

——
Privacy Policy: https://compressimg.xiaojiays.workers.dev/PrivacyPolicy.en
Terms of Use (EULA): https://compressimg.xiaojiays.workers.dev/TermsOfUse.en

name: IMERO
description:
IMERO est l'application des adhérents du club IMERO à Le Beausset (83330). Connectez-vous avec les identifiants fournis par votre club.

Fonctionnalités :
• Connexion à votre espace adhérent

• Gestion de votre profil

L'app de votre fitness club

name: IMmigrant - Dunyo bo'ylab!
description:
IMmigrant — гид для тех, кто переезжает за границу на работу, учёбу или к семье. Сейчас приложение подробно охватывает Латвию и Ригу.

ПЕРЕЕЗД ПО ШАГАМ
• Личный план с первого дня: что сделать до вылета, в первые 48 часов, в первую неделю и первый месяц
• Отмечайте шаги и видьте прогресс
• Карточки с понятными инструкциями: документы, жильё, работа, учёба

ВАШ РЕЙС
• Посадочный талон с вашим маршрутом
• Что можно и нельзя везти, как пройти пограничный контроль

КАРТА
• Посольство, вузы, миграционная служба и другие полезные места

SOS
• Экстренные номера в один тап
• Что делать, если потеряли паспорт, заболели или забрали документы

ИГРЫ
• Мини-игры про страну и язык: флаги, столицы, слова
• Миссии дня, опыт, уровни и общий рейтинг топ-100

Приложение работает на русском, узбекском и английском языках. Информация носит справочный характер и не заменяет консультацию официальных служб.

name: inCM — Life in Chiang Mai
description:
Visiting Chiang Mai, staying a while or making it home? inCM brings places to explore and everyday plans together.

Chiang Mai, now
Check local date, time, weather and upcoming official events. Follow source links and published schedules to confirm the details before you go.

Explore nearby
Browse restaurants, cafés, markets, cultural places and outdoor destinations by category, area or map. See available addresses, phone numbers, opening hours and source information.

Plan a day out
Create an itinerary from your preferences, add stops, adjust the route and save it on your device for another day.

Settle into everyday life
Find housing, car, education, healthcare, home repair, food delivery, courier and other service links. Bookings, orders, payments and support for third-party services are handled by the relevant provider.

Keep your favourites
Save places you want to visit, mark where you have been and come back to plan your next outing.

Browse, save places and plan without creating an account. Choose from nine interface languages, with original place names and source links kept within reach.

name: Indanta Ride
description:
With Indanta Ride you book a taxi with your own taxi company. One app for every taxi company on the Indanta platform: choose your taxi company and book directly with them.

CHOOSE YOUR TAXI COMPANY
Search for your taxi company by name or town, or open the link or QR code your taxi company gives you. The app remembers the companies you used before.

BOOK A RIDE
Enter your pickup address, destination and time, and see the price before you book. Airport transfers included.

TRACK YOUR RIDE
See the current status of every ride, from requested to completed. Once your taxi is on its way, the map shows where it is, with your driver's name and the licence plate. Share your ride with a link.

YOUR RIDES
Your upcoming and past rides in one place, per taxi company.

PAYING
You pay securely in the browser, on the payment page of your taxi company.

SIGN IN WITHOUT A PASSWORD
You sign in with a code sent to you by email. No password to remember.

PRIVACY
Indanta Ride does not ask for access to your location, camera or contacts, shows no ads and does not track you. You can delete your account yourself in the app or at indanta.app/r/verwijderen.

Indanta Ride is an app by Indanta, the platform for taxi companies.

name: infj便利贴
description:
INFJ便利贴是一款生活与创作记录工具。用日历回看每一天，用待办记住眼前的小事，用时间线安排日常，用项目节点推进创意。

• 写日记，记录想法和感受
• 分类整理待办，勾选已完成事项
• 用每日时间线安排日常
• 拆分项目步骤，记录进度
• 记录书影音进度
• 导出和恢复 JSON 备份

无需注册。记录保存在设备上，可以手动导出备份。

name: InkSpan
description: InkSpan એ એક ઑફલાઇન એકમ કન્વર્ટર છે. તમે લંબાઈ, ક્ષેત્રફળ, આયતન, વજન, તાપમાન, ગતિ, ડેટા અને કોણ જેવી આઠ શ્રેણીઓમાં કામ કરી શકો છો. એક નંબર લખો, બે એકમ પસંદ કરો અને બંને બાજુ ભરતી રીઅલ ટાઇમમાં અપડેટ થાય છે. મનપસંદ જોડીઓ, તાજી ઇતિહાસ, કસ્ટમ એકમ અને બાજુ-બાજુ સરખામણી મોડ સાથે સૂત્ર, રૂપરેખા અને કોષ્ટક જુઓ. બધું તમારા ફોન પર સાચવાય છે; કોઇ સાઇન-ઇન કે નેટવર્કની જરૂર નથી.

name: Interval Ear Trainer: TwoNote
description:
Listen to two locally synthesized piano notes and choose the interval. Start immediately with five ascending questions, replay freely, and see the note names and semitone distance after each answer.

Practice your misses and see seven days of first-try and review statistics. Import practice sets, export your history, and share a listening challenge as an image with audio or a short video. No account or internet is needed for practice.

Optional Pro adds descending and harmonic drills, custom ranges and intervals, set creation, and scheduled reviews and trends. Try Pro for 30 days from first opening the paid edition. Keep it with one optional purchase. No subscription or automatic charge; existing progress and sets remain accessible.

name: Ironwing: Heli & Jeep Shooter
description:
Ironwing is a retro side-scrolling helicopter and jeep shooter: classic arcade shoot 'em up action in pixel art. Fly an attack helicopter or drive an armored jeep through eleven levels, fight tanks, jets and giant boss machines, and free the commander and the family held in each boss's cage. Play solo or in two-player co-op with a friend.

Family Day at Iron Wing Base. The radio crackles:

"This is IRONWING. The Iron Army has raided the base. They have split our commanders and our families across eleven machines. Bring down every machine, open every cage. Bring us all home... and keep the flag flying."

OPERATION IRON WING
- 11 levels: Sand Ruins, Night Canyon, Storm Ruins, Dawn Headquarters, Snowy Pass, Steel Trench, Launch Base, Steel Deck, Ocean Ramp, Fortress Gate and Iron Core.
- 11 commanders and their families: every commander you rescue takes their place on the achievements screen.

TWO VEHICLES, TWO WAYS TO PLAY
- The jeep stays on the ground, jumps and fires mortars; it can shoot forward, up and back.
- The helicopter flies freely and drops bombs.
- Pick your firing direction with your right thumb, or leave auto-fire on.

ALONG THE WAY
- Laser gates, minefields, artillery barrages and flak.
- Prepare before each level: choose a helper drone, sonic bombs, homing missiles, a spare shield, boss fire or a collector.
- Easy, normal and hard difficulty.

WITH A FRIEND
- Two-player co-op: one in the jeep, one in the helicopter.
- Online with a friend code or random matchmaking, or on the same Wi-Fi network.
- Co-op is gameplay only; there is no chat or messaging.

YOUR FLAG ON YOUR VEHICLE
- Pick one of 20 countries; your flag flies on your jeep, your helicopter and in the corner of the screen.

ALSO
- Touch controls or a virtual joystick.
- Single player works offline.
- No in-app purchases.
- Gameplay events and error reports (no name or email) are sent to help us balance the game; you can turn this off in Settings > Privacy.

The game is currently in Turkish.

name: IronWorks: Gym Tracker
description:
IronWorks is the workout tracker that increases your weights for you.

Build your routines, set a starting weight, an increase, and a rep range for each exercise, then train. IronWorks takes care of the rest:

• Complete every set at the top of your rep range and your weight goes up next time.
• Miss your target for two sessions in a row and your weight goes down so you can get back on track.
• If you’re in between, your weight stays the same until you’re ready.

Progressive overload without spreadsheets, calculations, or guessing what to put on the bar.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Create a routine and choose your exercises.
2. Set the starting weight, increase, and rep range.
3. Log each set as you train.
4. When you finish, the app calculates the weight for your next session.

WHAT’S INCLUDED
• Routines with exercises, weights, increases, and rep ranges.
• Set tracking during your workout.
• Automatic weight progression, up and down.
• A history of your last 40 sessions.
• Haptic feedback when logging sets.
• A simple, dark interface made for use between sets.

YOUR DATA, ON YOUR IPHONE
No accounts, sign-ups, or servers. Everything is stored on your device and works offline.

WHO IT’S FOR
For people who already lift and want a clear way to make progress without wasting time on spreadsheets.

IronWorks grew out of a personal need: no app fit the way I train. So it does a few things, and does them well.

name: ISL Solfege: Ear Training
description:
ISL Solfege is ear training like at music school — built for the self-taught musician.

Instead of a pile of quizzes you get a path: 72 lessons that open one after another, each with a short theory card and a clear goal. Exercises are generated by music-theory rules, so you never run out of new ones.

TRAIN YOUR EAR
• Intervals — up, down and together, with full names on the buttons
• Chords — major, minor, diminished, augmented, sus, inversions and seventh chords
• Scale degrees — a cadence sets the key, then name the note's degree
• Modes, chord progressions and tempo by ear

WRITE WHAT YOU HEAR
• Melodic dictation on piano keys
• Write a melody down in notes: pick the length, tap the key, see it on the staff
• Guitar tab: hear a riff on guitar and find it on the fretboard
• Drums: hear a beat and place kick, snare and hi-hat on a grid

RHYTHM THAT JUDGES YOU FAIRLY
Tap a pattern back, then keep it going without the click. Latency calibration for the speaker, wired and Bluetooth headphones means correct taps count as correct. The report shows whether you rush or drag.

AN INTERACTIVE ABC OF NOTATION
The staff and clefs, note lengths, rests, sharps and flats, key signatures, guitar tab and drum notation — press keys and frets and watch the notes appear. Each topic ends with a short quiz.

DAILY TRAINING
Five minutes a day. The app remembers every interval, degree and chord you miss and brings them back more often until they stick.

FREE AND PRO
Free: the first lessons, the first levels of the core modes, the whole notation guide and up to 15 tasks a day.
ISL Solfege Pro unlocks all 72 lessons and every level, modes, progressions, tempo, guitar tab, drums, the daily training and unlimited practice. Monthly or yearly subscription.

No account, no ads, works offline. Your progress stays on your device.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.ibigcall.com/ear-training/privacy/

name: Ithaca for Plex
description:
Ithaca is a Plex app for Apple TV, iPhone and iPad. It shows what's on your Plex Media Server and plays the original file, with no transcoding unless you ask for it.

PLAYS THE ORIGINAL FILE
Ithaca plays your files straight from the server instead of asking Plex to convert them. MKV, HEVC, Dolby Vision, HDR10+, Dolby Atmos, DTS, PGS and SRT subtitles. Dolby Vision profile 7 is converted on the device so your TV shows it as Dolby Vision. When a file can't play directly, Ithaca falls back to Plex on its own, and you can always pick a quality for one session.

REQUEST WHAT YOU DON'T HAVE
Connect Seerr, Overseerr or Jellyseerr and search shows the movies and shows you don't have yet. Request a movie or a season right from Ithaca, browse what's trending, and on iPhone and iPad get a notice when it lands in Plex.

BUILT FOR APPLE DEVICES
Written in SwiftUI with Apple's own controls and Liquid Glass. On Apple TV: Top Shelf, the focus engine and the Siri Remote as you know them. On iPhone and iPad: AirPlay, downloads for the plane, and Picture in Picture. Ask Siri to play a movie or the next episode. Watch together over SharePlay.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
No ads, no promoted shows, no news, no tracking, no analytics. Watch state, ratings and progress live in your Plex account, so every device picks up where you left off. Several servers? Home merges them into one.

HELP CHOOSING
Rate what you watch and get rows of similar titles. Can't decide? Pick Something chooses from your library. With Ithaca Pro, type what you're in the mood for, like "a heist movie under two hours," and Ithaca picks from your library, on your device. With Seerr, it suggests new titles to request too.

EVERYTHING ELSE
Skip intro and credits, continuous play with Up Next, a check-in when you've fallen asleep, Plex Live TV with the guide, Plex Home profiles, audio and subtitle choices that stick.

FREE TO TRY
Ithaca is free to download. Ithaca Pro is a one-time purchase that covers iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, with a free 7-day trial. No subscription. Family Sharing included.

Ithaca needs a Plex Media Server with your movies and shows. It is an independent app and is not made or endorsed by Plex.

Screenshots show Blender Studio's open movies (Sintel, Tears of Steel, The Daily Dweebs, Coffee Run, Sprite Fright, Wing It!, Spring, Charge, Caminandes), © Blender Foundation, CC BY, and public-domain films.

name: ITWS Chat
seller_name: ssi-ti solucoes e servicos em informatica ltda
description:
O ITWS Chat é a ferramenta interna de comunicação da ITWS Group, feita para quem trabalha na empresa. A conta é criada pelo administrador.

Conversas
• Canais, grupos e mensagens diretas, com menções, respostas em fio, reações e enquetes.
• Arquivos e imagens nas conversas, que só baixam quando você toca.
• Cite um chamado com # e veja a etapa, o responsável e o prazo sem sair do chat.

Salas de voz e reuniões
• Entre numa sala com um toque, com voz, vídeo e a câmera da frente ou de trás.
• Chame alguém para a sala: no iPhone, a chamada toca como uma ligação, mesmo com o celular bloqueado.
• Acompanhe a sala na Ilha Dinâmica enquanto usa outros apps.
• Reuniões agendadas com convite, resposta e o aviso na hora de começar.

Avisos
• Menções, respostas nos fios que você segue, convites de reunião e a reunião começando agora, num lugar só.
• Notificações no iPhone, com o controle do que avisa e o Não perturbe.

Acesso restrito a contas da empresa.

name: Jackdaw: Learn & Remember
description:
Jackdaw helps you learn anything and keep it. It asks you the right question at the right moment, so what you learn today is still there next month.

Learn from packs: vocabulary, history facts, exam questions, interview preparation, or anything else you can ask a question about. Ten minutes a day is enough.

SPACED REPETITION THAT STAYS OUT OF YOUR WAY
• Jackdaw works out what is due and mixes in a few new items
• Easy things come back rarely, hard things come back soon
• A daily goal, a streak and clear stats show how you are doing

SEVEN WAYS TO BE ASKED
• Flashcards, in one or both directions
• Multiple choice and true or false
• Typed answers and fill the gaps
• Ordering
• Open questions with a key point checklist

PRACTICE WITHOUT PRESSURE
Drill a whole pack as a quiz, by typing or all mixed. Practice never changes your schedule.

YOUR CONTENT, IN A FILE YOU OWN
A pack is one plain file in an open, documented format. Open one from Files, paste one from the clipboard, or pick from the built-in sample library. With "Create with AI", Jackdaw gives you a ready-made prompt: tell any chatbot what you want to learn and paste its answer back. Jackdaw checks the pack and shows what will be added. Updating a pack keeps your progress.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics
• Everything is stored on your device
• Optional iCloud sync uses your own private iCloud, which only you can read
• Reviews made offline on two devices are merged, not overwritten

Jackdaw is available in English and German, in light and dark.

name: Jarimel Delitto logico
description:
Una pianta divisa in stanze, qualche sospettato e una manciata di indizi. In ogni riga e in ogni colonna c'è una persona sola: quando ognuno è al suo posto, il colpevole è l'unico sospettato rimasto nella stanza con la vittima.

UNA SOLA SOLUZIONE, E CI ARRIVI RAGIONANDO
Ogni caso è stato verificato: ha una soluzione sola e si chiude a deduzioni, senza mai tirare a indovinare. Niente vite, niente monete, niente timer.

AIUTI CHE SPIEGANO
Se ti blocchi, l'aiuto indica l'indizio e le caselle del passo successivo e ti dice perché. Non piazza nulla al posto tuo. «Controlla» ti avvisa se qualcosa sulla pianta contraddice un indizio.

300 CASI E UNO NUOVO OGNI GIORNO
Quattro livelli, dalla pianta 4×4 alla 8×8: Facile, Medio, Difficile, Esperto. Ogni giorno un caso in più, e un caso guidato per cominciare.

SCRITTI IN ITALIANO
Furti, sonniferi nella tazza e omicidi raccontati senza dettagli violenti, in ville sul lago, treni a vapore, palazzi veneziani, teatri d'opera e trattorie. Dodici casi d'autore hanno una storia scritta a mano e un epilogo che spiega il movente.

48 PERSONAGGI CHE RITORNANO
La cuoca, il pianista, la giornalista: li ritrovi da un caso all'altro, ogni volta con una parte diversa. Lo schedario tiene il conto di chi è stato colpevole, vittima o innocente.

LA SCUOLA DEL DETECTIVE
Le mosse del ragionamento spiegate una per una, con un esempio e un caso in cui provarle. Alla fine di ogni caso vedi quali hai usato.

SI STAMPA SU CARTA
Ogni caso si può stampare, con pianta, persone e indizi, per risolverlo a penna.

PENSATA PER TUTTI
Testo grande fino alle taglie per l'accessibilità, VoiceOver su ogni casella, pianta che si ingrandisce con due dita.

PUBBLICITÀ
La versione gratuita ha tutti i casi e mostra annunci di Google AdMob: un banner nell'elenco dei casi e nelle statistiche, di rado un annuncio dopo un caso risolto, mai mentre giochi. Il primo aiuto di ogni caso è gratuito; per gli altri puoi guardare un breve video. «Senza pubblicità», un acquisto unico, toglie tutti gli annunci e rende illimitati gli aiuti.

PRIVACY
Nessun account e nessun server di Jarimel®. I progressi restano sul telefono e, se usi iCloud, in copia nel tuo iCloud, così li ritrovi dopo una reinstallazione. Gli annunci sono serviti da Google con il consenso che scegli tu.

Personaggi, luoghi e vicende sono inventati.

name: Jewell Master
description:
Jewell Master is an enterprise-grade ERP suite tailored specifically for jewelry retailers, wholesalers, and manufacturers. Designed to streamline jewelry showroom operations and multi-branch enterprises, Jewell Master brings your entire business management suite to your mobile device.

KEY FEATURES:

• Real-Time Inventory & Bullion Management:
Track retail stock, wholesale lots, imitation items, and loose stones with precision. Monitor fine gold weights, metal holdings, purity, and daily bullion rates in real time.

• Intelligent POS & GST Billing:
Generate accurate retail POS invoices, fine bullion invoices, and custom quotations with complete GST compliance, HSN code lookups, and hallmarking (HUID) tracking.

• Business & Sales Intelligence:
Access executive performance dashboards with live updates on gross sales, revenue collection rates, receivables, pending customer dues, and supplier payables.

• Multi-Branch & Multi-Firm Switching:
Manage multiple jewelry stores and legal business entities from a single unified login with instant, secure profile switching.

• Old Gold, Melting & Saving Schemes:
Calculate old gold valuations, melting loss tracking, and manage customer gold saving plans and monthly deposit schemes effortlessly.

• Authenticated Document Download & Sharing:
Download official GST tax invoices, accounting ledgers, and appraisal reports directly to your device as PDFs, and share them instantly via WhatsApp or Email.

• Enterprise-Grade Security:
Protected by end-to-end TLS 1.3 encryption, role-based user access controls, and strict SOC 2 & ISO 27001 compliant enterprise architecture.

Transform your jewelry showroom and wholesale operations with Jewell Master ERP.

name: Job Delivered
description:
Job Delivered is a simple job record for people who do work for clients: handymen, cleaners, technicians, freelancers , small crews and anyone who delivers a service.

Record the job. Get it signed. Share it.

DONE TODAY
Finished the work? Enter the client, what you did and the price. Hand the phone to the client to sign on the screen. You get a PDF with your business details, the signature, the date and time, and a QR code.

PLANNED JOB
Agree first, deliver later. Save the agreement and have the client sign it. When the work is done, record any changes, add before and after photos, and get the handover signed.

SHARE
Send the PDF by WhatsApp, Mail or any app you like. Scan the QR code in the app to open the job again.

KEEP TRACK
See what is paid and what is still unpaid. Record how you were paid, deposits and price adjustments. Keep your clients in one list.

BACKUP
Everything stays on your phone, with no account and no internet needed. Save a backup file whenever you want.

FREE
- Unlimited Done today jobs
- Signing and PDFs with a QR code
- Scan QR codes to find a job
- Clients
- This month's summary
- A backup file
- 5 Planned jobs a month

PRO (one payment, not a subscription)
- Unlimited Planned jobs
- All reports and PDF export
- Promotions and loyalty rewards
- Import clients from a file
- Your logo on PDFs
- Automatic iCloud backup

Jobs you already made stay yours.

IMPORTANT
Records made in the app are signed on the device. They are not a tax invoice and are not guaranteed to be legally binding.

name: JPG Compressor: Photo resizer
description:
Compress, resize, and convert photos on your iPhone. Set a file-size limit in KB or MB when you need to upload an image, or use Quick JPEG for everyday sharing.

• Choose photos from your library or Files.
• Resize by pixel dimensions and compare the result with the original.
• Export a separate JPEG or PNG while keeping the original.
• With Pro, compress multiple photos together and save reusable settings.

Image processing runs on your device.

Terms of Use
https://itspeep.com/jpeg-compressor-terms

name: JPLAY: Learn Japanese
description:
JPLAY teaches you to read Japanese through short, fast rounds of play. A word or sound appears, and you slice the matching character before the orbs fall. Every round is a few minutes long, so practice fits into a coffee break and still adds up.

START WITH A FREE INTRODUCTION
Your first launch plays a short guided introduction: two kana, two practice rounds, a look-alike round, a quick placement check and your starting rank. Then you decide whether JPLAY is for you.

WHAT YOU LEARN
- Hiragana and katakana in seven levels each, from the vowels to dakuten and combined sounds like きゃ and シュ
- Confusing Kana: look-alike drills for シ ツ ソ ン, ぬ ね め, わ れ, る ろ and more
- All 90 kanji of the JLPT N5 level
- Particles: を, で, に, へ, と, の, and は versus が, with a final Particle Challenge
- Verbs: て-form, past and negative
- 1,442 everyday N5 words, each with a picture and audio
- IRL Japan: 207 signs and labels you see around Japan, in stations, shops, ticket machines, streets and more

SMARTCARDS
SmartCards is a spaced-repetition flashcard system that schedules your reviews for you every day. Cards you know come back less often; cards you miss come back sooner. Decks include Kana, Kanji, Core Words, Adjectives, Food and Daily Life, Greetings, Numbers, Time and Days, Money and Shopping, Directions and Emergency.

A CLEAR DAILY PATH
- Today shows a short plan for the day
- Journey lays out every lesson as a path you can follow or jump around
- Weak Spots collects the characters and words you miss most, ready for targeted practice
- Your Brain shows what you know, how fast you recall it and where you are improving
- KotoDex collects clay artwork for every card you master

Optional daily reminders keep your streak going. There is no account and no sign-in. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and JPLAY has no ads and no tracking.

JPLAY PRO
The introduction is free. After it, JPLAY requires JPLAY Pro, and one purchase unlocks every lesson, deck and drill. Choose one of three plans:
- JPLAY Pro Monthly: auto-renewing subscription, billed every month
- JPLAY Pro Yearly: auto-renewing subscription, billed every year
- JPLAY Pro Lifetime: one-time purchase, not a subscription

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time. Restore Purchases is available on the JPLAY Pro screen and in Settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://jordanazzow-cpu.github.io/jplay-site/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://jordanazzow-cpu.github.io/jplay-site/privacy/

name: Justiz Einstellungstest
description:
Hinweis: Diese App ist kein Angebot eines Gerichts, einer Justizvollzugsanstalt, eines Justizministeriums oder einer anderen Behörde und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Behörde. Sie dient ausschließlich der privaten Vorbereitung auf den Einstellungstest.

Offizielle Informationen zum Auswahlverfahren findest du bei der Justiz deines Bundeslandes. In der App sind offizielle Seiten der Länder verlinkt.

Bereite dich gezielt auf den Einstellungstest in der Justiz vor – zum Beispiel für den allgemeinen Vollzugsdienst in einer Justizvollzugsanstalt (JVA), die Ausbildung zur oder zum Justizfachangestellten oder das duale Studium Rechtspflege. Die App trainiert typische Aufgabentypen aus Einstellungstests – wann und wo du möchtest, ganz ohne Konto.

Trainingsbereiche

Justiz-Fachwissen
40 Fragen zu Gerichtsaufbau, Grundgesetz und Rechtsprechung, Strafverfahren, Strafrecht, Justizvollzug, Rechtspflege und Zivilrecht – jeweils mit Erklärung, meist mit Angabe der Rechtsgrundlage.

Mathematik
Dreisatz, Prozent & Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen und Zahlenpuzzle.

Sprache
Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien und alphabetische Reihen.

Logik
Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix und Dominosteine.

Allgemeinwissen
Über 100 Fragen aus Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Geografie, Recht und EU – mit Themenfilter.

Gedächtnis
Zahlen merken und Buchstaben merken.

Testsimulation
30 Aufgaben aus allen Bereichen, auch Justiz-Fachwissen, mit 30 Minuten Zeitlimit und Auswertung nach Bereichen.

Justiz im Überblick (kostenlos)
Ablauf des Einstellungstests, Testinhalte, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Seiten – für die Justiz allgemein, den Justizvollzug und die Rechtspflege.

So funktioniert die App
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Zu den Aufgaben gibt es Lösungen, bei vielen Aufgabentypen mit Lösungsweg oder Erklärung.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen der Justiz.

name: Kakul
description:
Kakul trains your mental math with one calculation a day, the same for every player.
The daily calculation You get 60 seconds and one try. The faster you answer, the more points you earn. Your points raise your level, from Easy to Expert, and the calculations get harder as you improve. After each answer, a tip shows a mental math technique with the real numbers of the calculation: rounding to the nearest ten, × 9 as × 10 − 1, squares, percentages and more. Your history, your streak and your level are saved to your account and follow you to a new phone.
Rooms Create a room and share its six-character code, or join a public room. Up to 20 players get the same questions at the same time, from easy to hard, with 20 seconds per question. A live ranking shows after each question. You can also start a room alone to practice.
Friends and leaderboards Add friends with their friend code and compare your daily points, or see where you stand among all players.
Daily reminder Pick the time of your reminder. It is a notification scheduled on your phone, and the app works without it.
Every calculation can be done in your head, without a calculator. No ads, no tracking.

name: Kalas: Födelsedagar & Julklapp
description:
Kalas hjälper dig att komma ihåg dem som betyder mest – och att alltid ha en bra present redo.

FÖDELSEDAGAR
• Samla familj och vänner med födelsedag, relation och profilbild
• Se direkt vem som fyller år härnäst och hur många dagar det är kvar
• Få påminnelser en vecka innan, dagen innan och på dagen – eller välj själv

PRESENTIDÉER
• Spara idéer till varje person så fort du kommer på dem
• Lägg till pris, länk och anteckningar
• Bocka av det du har köpt och se vad allt kostar

JULKLAPPAR
• Välj vilka som ska få julklappar i år
• Sätt en totalbudget och fördela den mellan personerna
• Se hur mycket du har handlat för och hur mycket som är kvar
• Lägg till tillfälliga personer som bara gäller julen

SKYDDA DINA IDÉER
• Lås personer med en kod så att ingen som lånar telefonen ser vad du planerar
• Lås upp med Face ID

DIN DATA STANNAR HOS DIG
Inget konto, ingen reklam och ingen spårning. Allt du lägger in sparas bara på din telefon.

name: Kanban Calendar
description:
Plan on a board. See it on a calendar.

Most task apps make you choose: a kanban board that forgets about dates, or a calendar that can't show workflow. Kanban Calendar does both, over the same tasks.

KANBAN BOARD
Drag tasks through six stages — Backlog, Ready, In Progress, In Review, Done, and Fix. On desktop the columns sit side by side; on a phone they stack and collapse so you can focus on one stage at a time.

CALENDAR, SAME TASKS
Give a task a start and due date and it appears on the calendar as a bar spanning those days. Switch between month, week, and day. Tasks past their due date turn red. Filter by board with a tap.

BUILT FOR BOTH HANDS AND MICE
Touch and pointer get different gestures on purpose — a mouse drags instantly, a finger has to press and hold, so scrolling a column never drags a card by accident.

EVERYTHING ELSE
• Multiple boards, each with its own color
• Date range filter to narrow what you see
• Undo after deleting a task
• Dark and light themes
• English and Korean
• Syncs in real time across your devices

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No ads. No analytics. No tracking. Your boards and tasks are yours — the database rejects any request from another account, enforced on the server, not just in the app.

Delete your account from inside the app at any time, and your data goes with it.

name: Kariakoo Kiganjani
description:
Kariakoo Kiganjani puts the whole of Kariakoo Market, Dar es Salaam, in your hand. Find shops, stalls, wholesalers and services, see if they are open, and contact them directly: no more walking from street to street asking around.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Search any business by name, product, category or area of Kariakoo
• Browse categories such as fashion, fabrics and kanga, shoes, phones, electronics, computers, hardware, furniture, cosmetics, pharmacies, stationery, supermarkets, restaurants and services
• Filter results: Verified shops only, Open now, 4+ stars, and Near me
• Call, chat on WhatsApp, send an email or open the website with one tap
• Get directions on the map and walk straight to the shop
• See opening hours, photos, the address and how far away a shop is
• Save your favourite shops and find them again in seconds
• Read and write honest reviews and star ratings
• Report a wrong listing or a bad review so we can fix it

VERIFIED BUSINESSES
Shops with the Verified badge have been checked by our team, so you know who you are dealing with.

FOR BUSINESS OWNERS
Own a shop in Kariakoo? Create a free account, list your business with photos, opening hours, contact details and the products you sell, and let new customers find you.

NOT AN ONLINE SHOP
Kariakoo Kiganjani is a directory. You do not buy or pay inside the app: you find the business and deal with them directly, by phone, WhatsApp or in person.

FREE AND SIMPLE
Free to download and use. Works in light and dark mode. Browsing needs no account; sign in only to save favourites, write reviews or list your business.

KWA KISWAHILI
Kariakoo Kiganjani ni mwongozo wa maduka na huduma zote za Soko la Kariakoo, Dar es Salaam. Tafuta duka kwa jina, bidhaa au eneo, angalia kama liko wazi, kisha piga simu, tuma ujumbe WhatsApp au pata maelekezo ya kufika. Hifadhi maduka unayoyapenda na soma maoni ya wateja wengine. Una duka Kariakoo? Jisajili bure na uweke biashara yako ili wateja wapya wakupate.

Questions or ideas? Use Contact in the app's Profile tab, or email kitodigitals@gmail.com.

name: Kartolina
description:
Kartolina je geografska igra na karti Hrvatske – bez ijednog imena.

Svaki dan novo putovanje između dvaju mjesta, isto za sve igrače. Na svakoj od deset stanica spustiš pribadaču na kartu bez imena ili procijeniš brojku: koliko stanovnika ima mjesto, koliko je visok vrh, koliko je velik otok. Što si precizniji, to brže putuješ – od HŽ-a, sporijeg i od trčanja, do ministarskog helikoptera, a do otoka od madraca do kanadera.

• Dnevno putovanje – deset stanica, isto za sve, novo svaki dan u ponoć.
• Županije – igre od deset pitanja unutar jedne županije. Osvoji svih 21.
• Dvoboj – uživo protiv drugog igrača, tko prvi dobije tri partije.
• Vježba – bez sata, koliko god želiš.
• Razglednica – podijeli rezultat bez otkrivanja stanica.
• Liga županija – vidi kako stoji tvoj kraj.

Besplatno, bez oglasa: dnevno putovanje i vježba uvijek, a svaki dan i 3 igre po županijama i 5 dvoboja.

Kartolina+ (1,99 € mjesečno) otključava županije i dvoboje bez dnevnog ograničenja. Pretplata se automatski obnavlja ako je ne otkažeš barem 24 sata prije kraja razdoblja; upravljaš njome u postavkama App Storea.

Uvjeti korištenja: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Pravila privatnosti: https://swiftuivan.com/kartolina/privacy.html

name: KB韓國羽球
description:
KB韓國羽球專賣店官方 App｜台中南屯實體門市

韓國 YONEX 韓版、V-TECHNIST（台灣授權經銷）、韓版 VICTOR、FELET、REDSON、RYDER 羽球衣、羽球拍、羽球鞋、羽球包，韓國正品直送。
