name: KegTruck Bar
description:
KegTruck Bar is the phone app for a licensed bar, hotel, or resort that orders craft beer kegs and cases through KegTruck in Thailand.

This app is for one place with a login. It is not a shop. It does not sell alcohol to the public.

Sign in with this place's email to:

• Order kegs and cases from partner breweries and distilleries
• See kegs on the way
• Pay with PromptPay and upload a slip
• Save the delivery door on the map
• Message the KegTruck desk

Need an account? Open Join as a bar or hotel on https://www.kegtruck.com/join.html?role=bar

Support: https://www.kegtruck.com/support.html
Privacy: https://www.kegtruck.com/privacy.html

name: Kikiri: Challenge Alarm
description:
Kikiri is the alarm that won't let you go back to sleep: to turn it off, you solve a challenge.

CHALLENGES TO WAKE UP
• Math: 1, 3 or 5 problems, easy, medium or hard.
• Scan a QR code or barcode you left far from your bed.
• Shake your phone 30, 60 or 100 times.
• Memory: repeat the sequence.
• Or no challenge, if today you want a simple alarm (it's the default).

YOUR WAY
• 22 sounds: animals, alarm clocks, gentle and loud. The Kikirikí rooster is a favorite.
• Vibration, or vibrate only with "No sound".
• Alarms by day of the week, with a label.
• A day streak to keep your rhythm.
• Accent colors, light mode and dark mode.

YOUR ALARMS, YOURS
• No accounts, no sign-up: your alarms live on your phone.
• Spanish, English and Portuguese.

FREE, FOR REAL
Every alarm and every challenge is free, with ads. You will never see an ad while the alarm rings or during the challenge: only after you wake up. With Kikiri Premium, a one-time payment with no subscription, the ads go away forever.

Kikiri uses the system alarms so it rings even when the app is closed. Requires iOS 26.

name: Kill Word：雅思托福助记词汇
seller_name: Beijing Zhang Liang World Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
每个单词配一张专门画的助记画，词义就藏在画里。

Kill Word 为词书里的每一个词单独画一张图：画面里藏着这个词的意思，看到画就想起词义。再听发音、读例句；不认识的词会按间隔复习的节奏回来找你，直到真正记住。

【词书】
· 雅思核心词汇：4841 词，按常用程度排序
· 托福核心词汇：4510 词
· 日常交流：点餐、问路、购物、酒店、机场、看病等 10 个场景的 300 句常用口语
· 出差英语：入境、交通、酒店、开会、同事寒暄等 7 个场景的 180 句
· 科技职场英语：职场会议常用表达，带例句

【篇章精听跟读】
一段 1–2 分钟的真实英语，分五步走完：先认生词，再精听、听写、对照原文，最后逐句跟读。跟读时录下自己的声音，和原声对着听，听出自己吞掉了哪些音。没听出来的词可以直接送去背。

【复习与进度】
新词和复习按记忆规律排好，每天学了多少、记住多少、哪些词还在学，一眼看清。

【小组件】
桌面和锁屏小组件会轮换显示你正在学的词。

【免费与 Pro】
免费：每天 10 个新词（所有词书合计），复习不限；助记画、发音、例句、小组件全部可用；精听可试 2 段。
Pro：每天新词不限，解锁全部精听课程。
Pro 有月付、年付（新用户可免费试用 7 天）和终身买断三种，权益完全相同。

订阅说明：
· 确认购买时从你的 Apple 账户扣款。
· 订阅会自动续期，除非在当前周期结束前至少 24 小时关闭自动续期；续期费用会在当前周期结束前 24 小时内扣除。
· 可以在 App Store 的账户设置里管理或取消订阅。
· 免费试用期内购买订阅，试用剩余的部分作废。

隐私政策：https://killword.soakout.com/privacy
使用条款：https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
帮助与支持：https://killword.soakout.com/support

name: Kimi Blocks
description:
Drag, fit and clear! Kimi Blocks is a block puzzle with Kimi, the explorer axolotl, and her crew.

Place pieces on the 8×8 board and complete rows or columns to score. Clear lines on back-to-back moves to build combos. Think before you drop: when no piece in the tray fits, the game is over.

RANKED CLASSIC
• Play for points and compete on the all-time and monthly leaderboards
• Your best score is saved on your device, even offline
• Only the nickname you choose appears on the leaderboard. Offensive nicknames are filtered and any player can report a nickname

CREW MODE
• Complete lines to win the match
• Use special powers, like Kimi's Compass, which rotates a piece in the tray
• The lines you clear reveal the crew's mosaics in your collection
• Unlock Bela as a partner, with a power that slides a row of the board

MORE
• Invite a friend and get +1 life
• Out of space? Continue up to 2 times per game with an optional video
• Skip videos subscription (monthly or yearly): continue without watching videos. The banner at the bottom of the game still appears
• Drag with your finger or play with a keyboard, with screen reader labels
• Your game is saved: close the app and pick up where you left off
• In English, Portuguese, Spanish and Chinese
• No sign-up, no login

The Skip videos subscription renews automatically until cancelled in your device Settings › your name › Subscriptions.
Privacy Policy: https://legal.aicontinue.ai/kimiblocks/privacy/
Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kinapod Lab
description:
Record raw sports data with an AirPod as the sensor.

Got an idea for tracking your sport? Kinapod Lab lets you test it today. Mount one AirPod on a racket, golf club, bat, ball, bike wheel, shoe or board, press record, and capture what the motion sensors inside it feel: every swing, spin, kick and impact.

Kinapod Lab does not score or analyze your session. It gives you the raw data, clean and complete, so you, your coach or an AI assistant can find out what is measurable in your sport.

WHAT IT RECORDS
- AirPod motion at about 50 times a second: acceleration, rotation, orientation
- AirPod Bluetooth signal strength, a rough distance hint
- iPhone motion and compass at about 100 times a second
- iPhone GPS for speed and route
- iPhone microphone audio, for the sound of contact
- Heart rate from AirPods Pro 3
- Your own marks: tap once to timestamp a serve, a shot or a rep

IDEAS PEOPLE TRY
- Tennis, pickleball and badminton: swing tempo and racket rotation
- Golf and baseball: swing rhythm and the moment of contact
- Cycling: wheel speed and cadence
- Ball and disc sports: spin rate and flight time
- Boxing, skating, climbing and anything else that moves

BUILT FOR ANALYSIS
- Every recording is a folder of plain CSV, WAV and JSON files
- Export a whole session as a ZIP, a single file, or all sessions at once
- Browse recordings in the Files app
- Each export includes AGENTS.md, a guide that explains every file, column and unit, so you can hand the data straight to Claude or another AI assistant and ask what it sees

SPEED BY SOUND
Play a steady tone from the AirPod while the iPhone microphone records. The pitch shift in the recording reveals how fast the AirPod moves toward or away from the phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Recordings stay on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded. Data leaves the phone only when you export it.

Requires AirPods with motion sensors (AirPods 3rd generation or later, AirPods Pro, AirPods Max). Heart rate requires AirPods Pro 3 and iOS 26.

name: Kinli Keeper
description: ਤੋਹਾਨੂੰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੋਹਾਡੇ ਤੋਫ਼ੇ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹੋ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਇੱਕ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਫਾਈਲ ਬਣਾਓ। ਜਨਮਦਿਨ, ਵਿਸ਼ੇਸ਼ ਦਿਨ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਲਾਨਾ ਤਿਉਹਾਰ ਇੱਕ ਸੂਚੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ; ਤੁਹਾਡੇ ਵਿਚਾਰ, ਕੀਮਤ ਅਤੇ ਖਰਚਾ ਬਜਟ ਇੱਕੇ ਥਾਂ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ। ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਸੋਚੀ ਗਈ ਤੋਫ਼ਾ, ਖਰੀਦੀ ਹੋਈ ਤੋਫ਼ਾ ਅਤੇ ਦੇ ਚੁੱਕੀ ਹੋਈ ਤੋਫ਼ਾ ਦੇ ਵਿਚਾਲੇ ਅੰਤਰ ਸਾਫ਼ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਜਿਵੇਂ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਦਿਨ ਨੇੜੇ ਆਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਪਲਾਨ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਹੀ ਤਿਆਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸਾਰਾ ਡਾਟਾ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਸ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ — ਕੋਈ ਖਾਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ, ਕੋਈ ਲੌਗਇਨ ਨਹੀਂ।

name: Kino: Jellyfin & Plex Player
description:
Kino connects to your own Jellyfin or Plex Media Server and plays what is yours: movies, series, music and photos, on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Fast, light and without ads.

YOU NEED A SERVER
Kino is for people who already have their own library on a Jellyfin or Plex Media Server, at home or in the cloud. It does not sell or rent movies and does not include any content.

WHAT IT DOES
• Native player with hardware decoding; the server only converts when your device cannot play the original file.
• Continue where you stopped, on any device, with the next episode in the queue.
• Subtitles and audio your way: pick the track, adjust size, color and outline, and search for subtitles through your server.
• Download movies and episodes to watch offline (iPhone and iPad); what you watch offline goes back to the server later.
• AirPlay, fast search, and movie and series requests through the Seerr of your server.
• Music with lyrics, photos and live TV with recordings from your server.
• Watch together with Jellyfin SyncPlay.
• A layout made for the Siri Remote on Apple TV.
• 10 languages.

FREE AND PRO
Free to watch, no subscription and no ads, with 2 downloads. Kino Pro is a one-time purchase, the same for Jellyfin and Plex: unlimited downloads, music with the screen off, synced lyrics, photos, live TV and recordings, watch together, and several servers and accounts at once.

PRIVACY
No ads, no analytics, no advertising ID. Kino talks to your server and to nobody you did not choose. There is no Kino account.

Kino is an independent app of the Telario family. Jellyfin and Plex are trademarks of their respective owners; Kino is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Works with Plex Media Server.

Privacy policy: https://kino.telario.com.br/en/privacy.html

name: Kitab Nusantara
description:
Kitab Nusantara adalah perpustakaan digital kitab kuning: teks Arab yang ditahqiq ulang, diberi harakat lengkap, dan diterjemahkan ke bahasa Indonesia paragraf demi paragraf.

Yang bisa Anda lakukan:
• Membaca kitab Arab dengan harakat yang bisa dinyalakan dan dimatikan
• Membandingkan teks Arab dengan terjemah per paragraf
• Mencari kitab berdasarkan judul, pengarang, atau bidang ilmu: hadits, fiqih, tafsir, nahwu dan sharaf, akhlak dan tasawuf, sejarah
• Menyimpan posisi baca, bookmark, sorotan, dan catatan di rak pribadi
• Mencari isi seluruh perpustakaan dan bertanya tentang isi kitab dengan bantuan AI yang menyertakan rujukan
• Membagikan kitab kepada teman lewat WhatsApp dan aplikasi lain

Koleksi kitab dipilih dan disunting oleh tim As-Shafa Publisher, mencakup karya ulama Nusantara seperti Syekh Ihsan bin Dahlan Jampes hingga syarah klasik seperti Syarh Ibnu 'Aqil.

Daftar gratis untuk membaca teks Arabnya. Akun baru mendapat akses harakat, terjemah, dan AI selama 30 hari pertama.

name: KKAstrology 西洋占星
description:
KKAstrology 西洋占星：專業的本命星盤排盤與星盤管理工具。
輸入出生日期、時間與地點，立刻排出精準的本命星盤，適合占星老師、愛好者與想更了解自己的人。

【精準排盤，完全離線】
・陽曆／陰曆（含閏月），也可選「不知道出生時間」
・台灣、港澳、中國、東南亞、日韓、歐美等 79 個城市，或自訂經緯度與時差
・自動套用各地歷史日光節約時間（例：台灣 1945–1979）
・1900–2100 年星曆，所有計算都在手機上完成
・宮位制：普拉西度、整宮、等宮、波菲力、雷吉歐蒙塔納斯；真交點／平均交點

【一眼看懂本命星盤】
・星座環依元素上色，行星、宮位、四軸與相位線清楚呈現
・點一下行星、宮位、星座或相位線，立刻顯示白話解說

【白話解盤】
・總論：太陽・月亮・上升、主導元素與模式、月相、命主星、星盤速讀
・行星：十三顆星逐一解讀（星座、宮位、廟旺落陷、逆行、相位）
・宮位：十二宮宮頭、守護星與宮內行星
・相位：三角相位表、依精準度排序的相位列表

【星盤簿管理】
・家人、朋友、客戶分類、標籤與搜尋
・依太陽、月亮、上升星座與主導元素篩選
・置頂、收藏，每張星盤都能寫解盤筆記

【專業報告與分享】
・一鍵產生 A4 PDF 星盤報告，還能印上你的署名
・星盤圖片與文字版一鍵分享

【學會看星盤】
・12 章圖解占星入門，跟著範例星盤一步步學會看盤
・占星百科：行星、星座、宮位、相位與容許度

【隱私與備份】
・不需註冊帳號、沒有廣告
・所有資料只存在你的手機
・備份與還原，換手機也不遺失
・5 款星羊桌面圖示任你換，支援繁體中文／简体中文

【免費試用，一次買斷】
・免費儲存 2 個星盤，排盤與星盤圖都能先試用
・完整版一次買斷、終身使用，不是訂閱：不限星盤數量、完整白話解說、PDF 報告

星盤是自我覺察的地圖，本 App 內容僅供參考與娛樂。

name: Klasno
description:
Klasno — застосунок для клієнтів і працівників студій йоги, пілатесу, танців, стретчингу та групових тренувань, які ведуть розклад у Klasno.

Входьте за номером телефону — без паролів. Застосунок сам знайде ваші студії.

ДЛЯ КЛІЄНТІВ
• Розклад на два тижні вперед: вільні місця, тренер, зал і тривалість заняття.
• Запис через картку заняття: тренер, зал, вільні місця й що спишеться з абонемента — без несподіваних списань. Скасування з правилами студії перед очима.
• Черга на заняття, якщо всі місця вже зайняті.
• Абонементи: скільки занять залишилося і до якого числа діє.
• Купівля абонемента на захищеній сторінці оплати студії.
• QR-пропуск для відмітки на рецепції — працює навіть без інтернету.
• Нагадування про заняття та зміни в розкладі (за вашим дозволом, без реклами).
• Оплати й чеки.
• Кілька студій в одному акаунті.

ДЛЯ АДМІНІСТРАТОРІВ І ТРЕНЕРІВ
• Режим студії: заняття на сьогодні та списки записаних.
• Відмітка відвідування сканером QR-пропуска або пошуком за ім’ям чи телефоном.
• Запис клієнта на заняття з оплатою на місці прямо з телефону.

Без реклами й без відстеження. Видалити акаунт можна в застосунку: Профіль → «Видалити акаунт».

Питання та допомога: hello@klasnoapp.com

name: Klefa: Learn to Read Notes
description:
Learn to read music notes at a glance. One note appears on the staff, you name it with one tap, and Klefa measures how many notes per minute you read.

Choose how you answer: tap a piano key, tap a note name, or play the note on your real piano, violin or flute and let the microphone listen.

SPRINT AND CALM
- Sprint: 60 seconds, as many notes as you can
- Calm: 20 notes without a clock
- Problem notes: the notes you miss or read slowly come back until they are sure

SEVEN STAGES
Start with the lines, then the spaces, then the whole staff. Sharps, flats and ledger lines follow. A stage opens when you read 90 % right in under 3 seconds per note.

EVERY CLEF
Treble, bass, alto, tenor and the piano grand staff. Pick your instrument and Klefa chooses the clef.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Reading speed per day
- A note map of every staff position
- Your record per clef and a streak calendar with a daily goal

MADE FOR PRACTICE
- Note names as C D E, H or B, or Do Re Mi
- Optional daily reminder
- Works fully offline, no account, nothing recorded

KLEFA PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
Stages 4 to 7 in every clef and the microphone mode from stage 2.

Questions or ideas: support@sanghuynhxuan.com

name: Klik Gate
description:
Klik Gate es la app de control de accesos para el personal de los eventos que venden con Klik.

PARA EL EQUIPO DE PUERTA
El organizador crea los usuarios de su equipo desde el panel de Klik. Con el código del evento, el usuario y la contraseña, eliges tu puerta y empiezas a escanear.

VALIDA AL INSTANTE
Apunta la cámara al QR de la entrada: la app te dice si pasa, si ya ingresó o si no es válida, con color y vibración para no mirar dos veces.

FUNCIONA SIN INTERNET
Antes de abrir puertas, la app descarga la lista del evento cifrada en el teléfono. Si se cae la señal, sigue validando y sincroniza los ingresos cuando vuelve.

CREDENCIALES
También valida credenciales de acceso de Klik (tarjetas con QR) para miembros y personal.

Klik Gate necesita un usuario de staff entregado por el organizador del evento; no sirve para comprar entradas.

name: Klik: Entradas y Eventos
description:
Klik es la app oficial para guardar y usar las entradas que compras en klik.bo.

TUS ENTRADAS EN UN SOLO LUGAR
Entra con la misma cuenta con la que compraste (Google, Apple o tu email) y todas tus entradas aparecen solas, ordenadas por fecha.

ENTRA AL EVENTO CON TU QR
Cada entrada tiene un código QR que cambia cada pocos segundos, así una captura de pantalla no sirve para copiarla. Funciona sin internet: abre la app antes de llegar y listo.

PROTEGIDAS CON TU PIN
Tus entradas se abren con un PIN o con Face ID, para que nadie más pueda usarlas si te prestan el celular.

TRANSFIERE EN SEGUNDOS
¿No puedes ir? Desliza la entrada y transfiérela: por email o mostrándole un QR a la otra persona, que la recibe en su propia app. Tu copia deja de valer en ese momento.

TODO LO DEL EVENTO
Fecha, lugar, sector y asiento, y el estado de cada entrada: lista para usar, ya usada o transferida.

La compra de entradas se hace en klik.bo. La app no vende entradas: las guarda y las muestra en la puerta.

name: Klikku Parents
description:
Klikku Parents est l’application des parents qui accompagne Klikku, des jeux éducatifs pour les enfants de 3 à 6 ans, joués dans le navigateur de l’ordinateur (klikku.app) : la souris, le clavier, les lettres, les nombres, les formes et les couleurs, la logique, le dessin et la musique. Un lapin explique chaque jeu à voix haute.

Avec Klikku Parents, votre téléphone devient la télécommande du parent :
• Reliez le téléphone au jeu en scannant le code affiché sur l’ordinateur.
• Ouvrez la séance de jeu quand vous êtes prêt, et voyez en direct ce que fait votre enfant.
• Réglez la durée de jeu et le temps de repos du lapin ; mettez le jeu en pause à distance.
• Suivez le carnet des progrès : ce que votre enfant sait faire et ce qu’il est en train d’apprendre.
• Choisissez le temps qu’il fait dans le jeu, ou laissez le lapin suivre la météo réelle.
• Gardez la progression dans un compte sans mot de passe (clé d’accès, Face ID).

Votre enfant ne voit jamais de publicité. Dans la version gratuite, une courte vidéo est montrée au parent, sur son téléphone, avant d’ouvrir la séance.

Klikku Premium (abonnement mensuel ou annuel) ouvre tous les exercices, supprime la publicité et complète le carnet des progrès, pour toute la famille. Le paiement est prélevé sur votre compte Apple à la confirmation de l’achat. L’abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement sauf résiliation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période ; vous le gérez dans les réglages de votre compte Apple.

Conditions d’utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://klikku.app/privacy/

name: Knock Shot
description:
Aim, fire the ball and watch the structures come down.
Dozens of levels await you across many different worlds.

Knock Shot is a mobile demolition game where you fire balls at structures. Choose your shot, topple the pieces and bring it all down before you run out of balls. Perfect for a quick break or a longer session.

FEATURES
• Dozens of levels across different worlds, each with its own look and structures.
• Endless Tower: climb floor after floor and see how high you can get.
• Daily level: a new structure every day.
• Weekly tournament: the same levels for everyone, and your best score counts.
• Ranking: see where you stand on the weekly list, add friends by name#code and follow your friends on the map.
• Collection: unlock cannon and ball looks.
• Daily reward, daily quests and star chests.
• Master mode: fewer balls, no power-ups, bigger rewards.
• Play levels offline.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Just open the game and play. Your progress is saved on your device.

RANKING AND PRIVACY
To balance the levels, if you allow it, the game sends short play records to our server: a random player ID, level, mode, result, balls left, stars, version and day. You are asked at first launch, and you can turn it off any time with "Send gameplay record" in Settings. These records contain no email, location or device ID, and there are no ads or tracking. Play records are kept for a limited time. Joining the ranking is optional. If you join, your name, your player code (name#code), the ready-made avatar you pick and your scores are stored on a server; if you add friends or hide a player, those lists are stored too. Friends are added only by name#code; we never access your address book. If you see an inappropriate name, you can report it or hide it. You can delete your data on the server at any time with "Delete my data" in Settings. The ranking needs an internet connection.

name: Know My Planet
description:
Every day, one city on Earth is seen at night from orbit. Can you name it from its lights alone?

Know My Planet is a calm, beautiful daily geography game played on a real night globe. You get six guesses. After each one you see how far away you were and which way to look, the camera pulls further out, and new clues unlock: the region, the population, the first letter, the country. Everyone in the world gets the same city, and a new one appears at midnight.

THE DAILY CITY – FREE
• One new city every day, the same for everyone
• Distance and direction after every guess
• Clues that unlock as you go
• Your streak, stats and a spoiler-free result to share with friends

KNOW MY PLANET PRO – ONE PAYMENT, YOURS FOR LIFE
Unlock everything with a single in-app purchase. No subscription, no adverts.
• Pin It: drop a pin on the night map as close as you can to five cities a day
• Daily Five: five rounds across five different kinds of place
• Leagues: private leagues for family and friends, with daily tables
• Nine themed packs, over 880 places: Countries, World Capitals at Night, Islands, Rivers, Lakes, Straits, Mountains & Volcanoes, Deserts & Wonders, and Seas, Capes & Peninsulas
• Mountains, deserts and seas are played on NASA's daytime Blue Marble imagery
• A passport of every place you've found, with badges to collect

MADE TO ENJOY
• Real NASA imagery of Earth at night and by day
• Plays in 16 languages
• Optional daily reminder at 9am
• No account, no sign-up, no adverts, no tracking

Perfect for geography lovers, travellers, quiz fans, students and anyone who has looked out of a plane window at night and wondered which city was below.

Know My Planet is made in London by Made Easy City Guides.
Support: support@knowmyplanet.com
Terms: https://knowmyplanet.com/terms.html
Privacy: https://knowmyplanet.com/privacy.html

Imagery: NASA (public domain). Coastlines: Natural Earth. City data: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0).

name: KORE Private
description:
Algumas casas não se anunciam. Passam de mão em mão, em privado.

A KORE reúne posições em casas novas ainda em construção: quem já assinou o contrato-promessa cede o seu lugar a quem chega agora, muitas vezes abaixo do preço atual do promotor.

SIMULE ANTES DE DECIDIR
Toque em + nas casas que lhe interessam e veja logo quanto investe agora, quanto paga na escritura, quanto vale à entrega e o retorno, tudo num só círculo.

TODAS AS CASAS, NO MAPA
Filtre por zona, preço, poupança, tipologia, entrega e muito mais. No mapa vê a poupança e o preço de cada casa, e a lista acompanha a zona que está a ver.

A FICHA COMPLETA
Fotos, plantas, vídeo e todos os números da posição: o que já foi pago, o que falta na escritura e a poupança face ao mercado.

PROPONHA O SEU VALOR
Escolha o número e envie. O vendedor tem 48 horas para aceitar, recusar ou contrapropor. Quando há acordo, a casa fica reservada e os contactos das duas partes ficam visíveis.

GUARDE E COMPARE
Guarde casas, compare-as lado a lado e receba um aviso quando uma baixa de preço ou surge uma casa à sua medida.

TEM UMA POSIÇÃO?
Anuncie em minutos, defina o seu preço de saída e o mínimo que aceita, partilhe o link e acompanhe visitas, propostas e mensagens. Veja quanto vale hoje a sua carteira.

PRIVATE
Uma área por convite com projetos na origem, ainda em fase de terreno.

A KORE aproxima pessoas. Não intermedeia vendas.

name: Korea Survival App
description:
New to Korea with USFK? Korea Survival App puts the essentials for life around Camp Humphreys in your pocket.

TAXI CARDS — Show-the-driver cards with big Korean text for the gates, stations, and places you go most: Humphreys walk-in gate (K6), the main gate, Pyeongtaek Station, AK Plaza, Incheon Airport, Seoul Station, and Osan Air Base — plus your own custom cards.

TRANSLATE — Type or speak English and get Korean you can read aloud, hear spoken, or show full-screen. A 33-phrase phrasebook covers taxis, food, shopping, and emergencies, with recorded Korean audio.

MAP & GPS — See how far you are from the gates and other key places, show a driver your location, and hand off to KakaoMap or Naver Map for directions.

ARRIVE — The first-hours playbook: the USFK reception desk at Incheon Terminal 2, the Inter-Garrison Bus to Camp Humphreys, and getting a Korean phone number.

CAR — How SOFA vehicle registration works, what a lease buyout really costs, and the documents you need.

ESSENTIALS — Emergency numbers (112/119), the apps that matter, T-money, and how 050 relay numbers work.

No account. No ads. Your location stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.

name: Kripo & BKA Einstellungstest
description:
Hinweis: Diese App ist kein Angebot des Bundeskriminalamts, einer Polizei oder einer anderen Behörde und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Behörde. Sie dient ausschließlich der privaten Vorbereitung auf den Einstellungstest.

Offizielle Informationen zum Auswahlverfahren findest du beim Bundeskriminalamt und bei der Polizei deines Bundeslandes. In der App sind die offiziellen Karriereseiten verlinkt.

Bereite dich gezielt auf den Einstellungstest beim Bundeskriminalamt (BKA) und bei der Kriminalpolizei vor. Die App trainiert typische Aufgabentypen aus Einstellungstests – wann und wo du möchtest, ganz ohne Konto.

Trainingsbereiche

Kripo-Fachwissen
40 Fragen zu Aufgaben des BKA, Polizei-Organisation, Strafrecht, Strafprozessrecht, Grundgesetz, Kriminaltechnik und Cybercrime – jeweils mit Erklärung.

Mathematik
Dreisatz, Prozent & Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen und Zahlenpuzzle.

Sprache
Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien und alphabetische Reihen.

Logik
Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix und Dominosteine.

Allgemeinwissen
Über 100 Fragen aus Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Geografie, Recht und EU – mit Themenfilter.

Gedächtnis
Zahlen merken und Buchstaben merken.

Testsimulation
30 Aufgaben aus allen Bereichen, auch Kripo-Fachwissen, mit 30 Minuten Zeitlimit und Auswertung nach Bereichen.

BKA und Polizei im Überblick (kostenlos)
Ablauf des Auswahlverfahrens beim BKA und bei der Polizei der Länder, Testinhalte, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Karriereseiten.

So funktioniert die App
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Zu den Aufgaben gibt es Lösungen, bei vielen Aufgabentypen mit Lösungsweg oder Erklärung.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen des BKA oder einer Polizei.

name: Krunify FlashMart
description:
Krunify FlashMart connects shopkeepers, dark stores, field teams and delivery partners so neighbourhood stores can restock FMCG products quickly and reliably.

Shopkeepers can browse the live catalogue from their assigned dark store, add pieces or boxes to a basket, place restock orders, track delivery, and manage payments — all in one app.

Dark store owners can accept incoming orders, manage inventory and prices, assign drivers, and run same-day fulfilment with clear picking and dispatch workflows.

Field employees can onboard shopkeepers and place orders on their behalf. Delivery partners get a clear trip flow from pickup to delivery completion.

Built for real retail operations: live stock, real accounts, and coordinated dispatch across the Krunify FlashMart network.

WHO IT’S FOR • Shopkeepers restocking FMCG inventory
• Dark store owners running fulfilment
• Employees supporting the retail network
• Delivery partners completing assigned trips

HOW TO SIGN IN Shopkeepers sign in with mobile number and OTP.
Staff (store owners, employees, drivers, admins) sign in with the work email and password issued by your FlashMart administrator.

Krunify FlashMart helps local retail stay stocked, organised and ready for every order.

name: Kurodoko: Logic Puzzle
description:
Shade some cells black so that every number sees exactly as many cells as it says.

Kurodoko (also called Kuromasu) is a classic logic puzzle with simple rules. Each number counts the cells it can see up, down, left and right, itself included; a black cell blocks the view. Black cells may never touch side by side, and all the white cells must stay connected. Think of each number as a lamp: decide where the shadows fall so every lamp lights up just enough. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 STAGES, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 5 × 5 at dawn to a 15 × 15 eclipse
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each stage unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 5 × 5 to 20 × 20, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell to shade it, tap again for a dot (a cell you know is white); drag to mark many cells at once
• Black / Dot switch, and optional dots around every black cell
• Tap a number to light up the cells it sees and read "seen / needed"
• Numbers that see just enough fade out; touching black cells, impossible numbers and cut-off white cells turn red
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong marks; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: seven techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Kuwait Fishing
description:
A fishing game made in Kuwait, about Kuwait's sea.
Drop your hook from the boat to the seabed, dodge fish and junk on the way down, then hook fish on the way back up.

• Real Kuwaiti fish: hamour, zubaidi, kanaad, sobaity and more, drawn from real photos.
• Fish Book: every species you land is added with where, how deep, in which season and on which bait.
• Four spots: Kuwait Bay, the south coast, the islands and deep water, each with its own sea and depth.
• Bait, season and day or night change what bites.
• Big fish fight back. Don't go slack, don't pull too hard.
• Daily challenge: the same sea for everyone, one try a day.
• Challenge friends with a link on the same sea.

name: Kuytu: Hidden Local Spots
description:
Tired of the same crowded places? Kuytu finds lesser-known, quiet, non-chain spots near you.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick what you want: café, food, sweets, bar, library, books, boutique, hair & beauty or studio.
• Choose how hidden, how quiet and how far.
• Kuytu gives every place a "hidden score" based on distance from main roads, whether it's a chain and how little known it is.
• See them on the map, read "Why hidden?", and get walking directions.

FEATURES
• Chains and places on main roads are filtered out.
• Hints like side street, garden and opening hours.
• Long-press the map to scan another neighbourhood.
• Save the places you like.
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Saved places stay on your phone.
• Light and dark theme.

Place data comes from OpenStreetMap.

name: Kuzark
description:
İnsan mısın, Canavar mı? Kuzark, iki ırkın kadim savaşını telefonuna taşıyan ücretsiz 3D çok oyunculu PvP MMORPG'dir. Bilgisayardaki oyuncularla aynı sunucuda, aynı dünyada oynarsın.

DÖRT SINIF
• Savaşçı: ağır zırh, kalkan ve kılıçla cephenin önünde.
• Akıncı: hançer ve yayla hızlı, sinsi saldırılar.
• Kara Alp: karanlık güçlerle düşmanı zayıflatır.
• Kam: büyü, iyileştirme ve parti güçlendirmeleri.

GENİŞ BİR DÜNYA
Kut Yurdu'ndan Tengri ve Tamu kalelerine, Boluç Vadisi'nden Ergenekon'a, Közlük Çölü'nden Kurgan Adası'na uzanan bölgeleri keşfet. Albastı İni'nde boss avla, Gök Kule'de kat kat yüksel.

PvP VE SAVAŞLAR
• Kırgın Ovası'nda iki ırkın büyük savaşı ve Savaş Puanı sıralaması
• Er Meydanı'nda bire bir düellolar
• Kurgan Savaşı ve Sınır Savunması etkinlikleri

KLAN VE PARTİ
Klanını kur, amblemini seç, 8 kişilik partiyle zindanlara gir. Dünya, bölge, klan ve parti sohbetiyle oyuncularla konuş.

GELİŞİM
+8'e kadar eşya yükseltme, tılsımlar, meslekler (madencilik, balıkçılık, zanaat), oyuncu pazarı ve kendi pazar tezgâhın. Her şey oyun içinde kazanılır.

ETKİNLİKLER
Hafta sonu Kısmet Çarkı, her akşam Balık Şenliği, Bereket Saati ve takvimli etkinlikler.

Kuzark açık betadadır; geri bildirimlerinizle her hafta güncellenir. Oyun internet bağlantısı gerektirir; ilk açılışta oyun içeriği indirilir.

name: KvdB
description:
KvdB is de app voor medewerkers van Timmerbedrijf Koppens – van den Broek in Deurne. Je houdt er je uren, meerwerk en projecten mee bij, waar je ook aan het werk bent.

UREN SCHRIJVEN
• Kies het project en vul per dag je uren in, voor de hele week in één scherm
• Leg meerwerk apart vast, met omschrijving en foto's, zodat kantoor het direct kan doorberekenen
• Op vrijdag een herinnering als er nog uren openstaan

PROJECTEN
• Al je projecten met adres en contactpersoon
• Met één tik navigeren naar de bouwplaats of de contactpersoon bellen
• Tekeningen, foto's en documenten per project, netjes in mappen
• Zelf foto's en bestanden toevoegen vanaf de bouwplaats

JOUW DOSSIER
• Je contracten bekijken en digitaal ondertekenen
• Je VCA-certificaat, verzekering en andere documenten op één plek
• Je eigen gegevens en wachtwoord aanpassen

IN JOUW TAAL
De app werkt in het Nederlands, Engels, Duits en Pools.

VEILIG
Inloggen met wachtwoord en een dagelijkse code per e-mail. Gevoelige gegevens worden versleuteld opgeslagen. Geen advertenties en geen tracking.

Let op: de app is alleen voor medewerkers en zzp'ers van Koppens – van den Broek. Je account krijg je van kantoor; zelf aanmelden kan niet.

name: La carretera es mía
description:
¡La carretera es tuya… si te dejan!

Ponte al volante de un clásico de los 80 y 90, o súbete a una moto de 750 cc, y recorre las autovías de España esquivando a los conductores que todos conocemos:

• El rey del carril central, que no se mueve ni con agua caliente.
• El dueño del carril izquierdo.
• El que frena porque sí.
• El que cambia de carril sin intermitente.
• El que acelera cuando le adelantas.
• El indeciso, con medio coche en cada carril.

Pítales o hazles ráfagas para que te dejen pasar… aunque alguno se picará y te frenará delante.

PAISAJES DE ESPAÑA
La Mancha con sus molinos, los viñedos de Requena, la sierra, la huerta valenciana con naranjos y barracas, la costa mediterránea, un atardecer junto al mar y los pueblos blancos de Andalucía. Curvas, cuestas y horizonte al estilo de los clásicos de recreativa.

RADARES Y GUARDIA CIVIL
Respeta los 120: los radares hacen foto y te multan con las cuantías reales. Y si pasas como un rayo delante de una patrulla, te perseguirán con la sirena puesta.

PERSONALIZA TU VEHÍCULO
Elige coche o moto, el color y pon tu nombre en la matrícula.

• Controles táctiles sencillos, también en horizontal.
• Funciona sin conexión.
• Gratis y sin anuncios.

Sobrevive al domingo en la A-3. ¿Hasta dónde llegarás?

name: LandMap Lebanon
description:
LandMap Lebanon puts Lebanon's land parcel maps in your pocket.

- Find any parcel: choose a village, type the parcel number and see it on satellite imagery.
- See the details: approximate area, perimeter, boundary points and elevation.
- Parcel reports: create a PDF with the parcel diagram, coordinates and elevations, and share it.
- Works offline: download village maps once and use them in the field without a connection. Maps saved on your phone are encrypted.
- GPS in the field: see where you stand relative to the parcel boundaries.
- Easy sign-in: enter your phone number and we send a code by WhatsApp or SMS. No password needed.

Free trial and subscription
New accounts get a free 24-hour trial of all maps, starting at the first sign-in. A yearly subscription then gives access to all published commercial maps and their updates. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Parcel information is an informational estimate, not an official survey.

Privacy policy: https://landmaplb.com/privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Language Models: Tokenloom
description:
Language Models: Tokenloom is a graduate-level course in how large language models are built, sized and run, designed for your phone. You do not just read equations. Every equation starts as a real situation you can touch: a reader's eye moving across a sentence, a shipping agent packing text into containers, a notebook of past tokens, a budget split between a bigger model and more text.

Eight units, fourteen hands-on labs:
- Tokenisation: train byte-pair merges and watch the token count fall.
- The Transformer block: a reading-eye attention heat map with a causal mask, and a parameter counter.
- Pretraining: a surprise meter for perplexity and a loss landscape you roll a ball down.
- Scaling laws: a compute budget planner and a power-law fitter with held-out extrapolation.
- Distributed training: memory per GPU across ZeRO stages, and utilisation.
- Inference: the key/value cache notebook, speculative decoding, and weight quantisation.
- Decoding: temperature, top-k and top-p as loaded dice.
- Evaluation: an exam-leak probe for contamination and a mixture-of-experts router.

After every lab you answer a question computed from the settings you just chose. A bank of more than 400 questions covers the course; generated answers are re-derived by separate verifier code, and every lesson card and concept question links to its source (papers such as the original Transformer, scaling-law and compute-optimal training papers, open textbook chapters, and public university course pages) with the exact section, in a sheet that opens over your lesson.

Short sessions of a few minutes, a gentle replay queue for missed questions, text size from 85% to 200%, no account, works offline (sources need a connection). Toy scale only: nothing here trains or runs a real language model.

Free with ads at natural breaks, never during a lab or quiz. Optional monthly ad-free subscription with a 7-day free trial; cancel any time in your store account settings, and cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. You can also watch short videos to earn credits.

Written and source-checked by our team; not reviewed by an external expert. Content as of 2026-11-17. Not affiliated with any university or company named in the sources.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-tokenloom.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-tokenloom.html

name: Laudes – Liturgy of the Hours
description:
Laudes brings you the Liturgy of the Hours every day in its official text: the Office of Readings, Morning Prayer (Lauds) and the Gospel of the day, as one prayer to read or to listen to.

• The full text, day by day, following the liturgical calendar
• Audio of the prayer, even with the screen off, with controls on the lock screen
• Optional memorials, when there are any
• Office readings in the one-year or two-year cycle
• Light and dark theme, larger or smaller text
• The week ahead: the coming days at hand
• Nine languages: Italian, English, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Polish, Dutch, Croatian

No ads, no account. No personal data: only anonymous visit statistics.

Also on the website laudes.cc, nothing to install.

name: LeanLab: Dumbbell Fat Loss
description:
Most fitness apps tell you what to do. LeanLab shows you why it works.

LeanLab is a fat loss coach built on published research. It sizes a plan to your body, trains you with just a pair of dumbbells, tracks your walks and runs on a map, and filters the noise out of your scale so you can see real progress.

A PLAN BUILT ON SCIENCE
• Daily calories from the Mifflin–St Jeor equation and your activity level
• A safe deficit for 0.5–1% of body weight a week, never below a healthy floor
• Protein, steps and sleep targets, each with the study behind it
• Recalculated from your trend weight as you go

DUMBBELL WORKOUTS THAT PROTECT MUSCLE
• 2, 3 or 4 full-body workouts a week, at home or in the gym
• Animated form demos for 15 dumbbell exercises, with cues and common mistakes
• Rest timer and set logging
• Automatic progressive overload: LeanLab tells you when to go heavier

WALK & RUN TRACKER
• GPS routes on a map, even with your phone locked
• Distance, pace, splits and calories burned
• Full history of every route

WEIGHT TRACKER WITH A TREND LINE
• Smoothed trend through your daily weigh-ins
• Your true weekly rate compared with your plan
• Goal date forecast based on your real pace

THE FAT LOSS LAB
• Short lessons on calorie deficit, protein, NEAT, sleep, plateaus and more
• Every lesson cites the research it's based on

DAILY MISSION
Weigh in, train, move, learn, hit your protein. One screen, five habits.

LEANLAB PRO
Choose monthly with a 7-day free trial, or go yearly and save 50%. Pro unlocks the full program with progressive overload, every lesson, goal forecasts and your full route history. Weight tracking, walk and run tracking and your first workout are free.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://jainishah-apps.pages.dev/leanlab/terms
Privacy Policy: https://jainishah-apps.pages.dev/leanlab/privacy

LeanLab provides general information for healthy adults and is not medical advice. Consult a doctor before starting a new diet or exercise program.

name: Leaving Cert Economics 2027
description:
Leaving Cert Economics Questions and Answers – Higher Level Flashcard Notes

Prepare for your Leaving Cert Economics Higher Level exam with a comprehensive collection of exam-focused questions and answers covering the key topics, concepts and theories from the Economics syllabus.

With 10 years of past paper topics in your pocket, this app helps you focus your revision on the areas that matter most. Whether you are learning new economic concepts, revising important definitions or testing your understanding of exam topics, these flashcards provide a simple and effective way to study.

The app uses a flashcard format to help you actively test your knowledge, strengthen your understanding and remember important information. Study at your own pace, revisit difficult topics and test yourself anytime, anywhere.

The answers cover the essential economic terminology, definitions, theories, diagrams, calculations and explanations you need to understand the subject and perform well in your Leaving Cert Economics exam. name: Legado: Family Stories

name: Legwork Log: Work Search
description:
Legwork Log is not affiliated with any government agency.

Unemployment comes with a weekly chore: prove you looked for work. We made it easier.

Pick your state. Each time you apply, interview, or contact an employer, log it in a few taps. The app shows how close you are to your state's weekly rule, so you know when the week is done.

What you can do

- Choose your state. The app covers 50 states and DC.
- Log each work search activity in a few taps: the job, the employer, the date, how you applied, and the result.
- See your progress for the week against your state's rule.
- Keep proof. Add photos of confirmation emails or screenshots to any entry.
- Get reminders before your filing day and during the week.
- Export your whole log as a PDF, or copy the text and paste it into your state's form.
- Read your state's rules in plain words: what counts, what an audit can ask for, and how long to keep records where your state says.
- Browse job search tools, with what each costs and what to watch for.
- See statistics on why keeping a log matters.

Your log stays on your phone

No account. No sign-in. Your name and claim ID are optional and only appear on your PDF. Please never enter your Social Security number.

The log, your photos, and your settings are stored on your phone. They are part of your iPhone backup. If you send a PDF, it goes wherever you send it. You can delete everything from the More tab.

What we collect

When you tap a link that leaves the app, the app sends us a count. The count holds the link, the state, the app version, a random ID made on your phone, and the time. It holds no name, no claim ID, and nothing from your log. We share only totals with the services we list. You choose on the welcome screen whether to send it, and you can change that in More > About.

Check your state

Rules change, and each state does it differently. For 39 of the 51 jurisdictions (50 states and DC), the weekly rule is checked against an official source. For the rest, the app tells you it has not verified the rules yet. Always check your state's own site. This app does not file your claim for you and does not log in to any state system.

Sources

The rules in this app come from state agency pages, state law, and official handbooks. Each state's sources are listed inside the app. A few starting points:

Texas: https://www.twc.texas.gov/programs/unemployment-benefits/work-search-requirements
California: https://www.edd.ca.gov/en/unemployment/eligibility
New York: https://dol.ny.gov/ui-claimant-guide-completing-work-search-activities
Pennsylvania: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dli/resources/for-claimants-workers/benefits-information/using-the-uc-system/claimant-faqs/work-search.html
Kentucky: https://kcc.ky.gov/career/individuals/Pages/Work-Search-Requirements.aspx
U.S. Department of Labor, unemployment insurance: https://www.dol.gov/general/topic/unemployment-insurance

HOW IT WORKS

TRUST SCORE

SAFETY FIRST

ANYWHERE

ACTIVITIES
Coffee, cycling, running, walking, breakfast, board games, gym, hiking, cinema, language exchange, photography, tennis, yoga, concerts, coworking.

BUDDY+
The app is free. The optional Buddy+ subscription (monthly or yearly) adds unlimited open plans, travel mode, seeing who viewed your plan and advanced filters. description:

name: LiDAR 3D Scanner 4K
description:
LiDAR 3D Scanner 4K records the raw data a 3D scan is made from, at the best quality your iPhone allows. You take the files to the 3D tool you already use.

RECORD
• 4K video with LiDAR depth: 3840 x 2160 at 30 frames a second on iPhone 17 Pro Max
• If depth and 4K cannot run together, the app keeps depth and says so on screen. Tap to retry 4K.
• Save every frame, or fewer: 30, 15, 7.5, 2.5 or 0.5 frames a second
• Tap the preview to switch between the camera view and a live depth view
• Live count of frames saved and dropped

HANDS FREE
• "Hey Siri, record a 3D scan with LiDAR Scan 4K" opens the scanner and starts recording once depth is ready
• Put "Record a 3D scan" on the Action button, or use it in Shortcuts and Spotlight

HELP WHILE YOU RECORD
• A 15-second guide on first launch
• A speed gauge from tortoise to hare: stay in the green and every frame stays sharp
• Plain-words hints: Slow down, More detail, Lost position, and Turn slower or Walk slower when you would blur the picture
• Look around naturally. The gauge counts turning and walking, and how close things are.

EVERY FRAME SAVES
• 4K video (HEVC)
• A LiDAR depth map in millimetres, with a confidence map
• The camera's position in metres and its rotation
• Lens values for that frame
• Exposure, turn and walking speed, and estimated blur
• Plus motion sensor readings and a summary of the whole scan
All plain CSV, PNG, JSON and MP4 files, lined up frame by frame.

SCAN THE SAME PLACE MORE THAN ONCE
• Continue from your last scan's saved map. Once the phone recognises the place, the new scan uses the same coordinates, so your scans line up.

KEEP AND SHARE
• Scans list with playback and a summary: format, length, metres walked, frames, dropped frames and size
• Export for Nerfstudio in one tap: the sharpest frames, depth and camera poses in transforms.json format
• Share a scan as a ZIP by AirDrop, or save it to Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or iCloud through the Files app
• Or copy scan folders to a Mac in Finder with a cable

USE IT FOR
• Photogrammetry and 3D models
• Gaussian splats and NeRFs
• COLMAP and structure from motion, with ARKit camera positions as a starting point
• RGB-D datasets for SLAM, depth and robotics research
• VFX camera tracking
• Measuring in your own desktop tools, using depth in millimetres and positions in metres
• Documenting rooms, sites, builds and events in real scale
• Reference captures for games, AR and 3D art
• Full-body scans for avatars, characters, fashion, costume and design concepts
• Rooms, renovation, construction, heritage, products and events

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Never connects to the internet
• No account, no cloud, no tracking, no ads
• Your scans stay on your phone until you share them

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
• It does not build or show the 3D model on your phone. It records the data that 3D tools need.
• It has no measuring tool of its own.
• It needs an iPhone with LiDAR: iPhone 12 Pro or a later Pro model.
• 4K with depth has been tested on iPhone 17 Pro Max. Other models record the best format that keeps depth, and the screen says which.
• LiDAR reaches about 5 metres. Glass, mirrors, water and moving things are hard for every 3D method.
• Files are large: about 400 MB per minute at 4K. Share over Wi-Fi.

Made by Highland Willow. Built on the open-source Stray Scanner by Stray Robots (MIT licence).

name: Lightproof Vault
description:
Lightproof keeps your personal photos, videos, documents and notes confidential. Everything lives in an encrypted vault on your iPhone that opens only with your passphrase or Face ID: no account, no cloud, no network connection for your content. And the app has a real camera of its own, so private moments go straight into the vault and never pass through the Photos library.

A REAL CAMERA, NOT A WRAPPER
• Shoots straight into the vault at the full quality of your iPhone: 48 MP photos, 4K HDR video, every lens including telephoto, zoom, tap to focus, exposure, grid and level
• Manual controls when you want them: shutter, ISO, white balance, focus, focus peaking, zebra stripes, histogram
• Time-lapse, slow-motion playback and trimming

ONE VAULT FOR EVERYTHING
• Photos, videos, documents (PDF, Office files, anything iOS can show) and notes
• Albums, favourites, sorting and filters by kind
• Import from Photos, with the option to delete the originals afterwards
• Export to Photos or Files only when you choose; location data is removed unless you keep it

SECURITY YOU CAN CHECK
• AES-256-GCM with a random key per file; the master key is wrapped by the Secure Enclave
• Passphrase, plus optional Face ID with an expiry you choose
• Growing delays after wrong attempts; after a number you set, the vault demands the recovery key or erases itself
• The screen is covered when you switch apps and during screen recording or mirroring
• A recovery key, shown once, is the only way to open the vault on another iPhone
• Nothing of the vault goes into iCloud unless you turn that on yourself

BACKUP WITHOUT A CLOUD ACCOUNT
• Export an encrypted backup package to Files, a NAS or a USB drive
• Optional automatic daily mirror to a folder you choose
• Restore on a new iPhone with the recovery key

Lightproof has no account and sends no content anywhere. Anonymous, rounded usage statistics and crash reports help improve the app; they never contain photos, file names, passphrases or keys.

Lightproof is for keeping your own material private. It must not be used to store or hide material that is illegal to possess.
