name: Living Words Gematria
description:
Gematria Lab turns the old tradition of letter-numbers into a hands-on study space. In Hebrew, Greek and other alphabets, letters have long doubled as numerals, and readers have totaled words to compare them. Gematria Lab lets users try that for themselves and learn where it comes from.

- Your Name: type a name in English or Hebrew. The app offers Hebrew spellings (spelling is a choice, and each spelling gives a different total), adds it up in several traditional counting systems, explains each letter, lists words from its built-in list that share the number, and shows where that number appears in tradition. An optional birthdate adds a modern numerology reflection profile, offered as prompts for reflection, not prediction.
- History: a short, sourced history of letter-numbers, from Greek and Hebrew numerals and Pompeii graffiti to the Talmud, Sefer Yetzirah, the Zohar, Renaissance Christian Kabbalah, Safed, and modern numerology. Where scholars disagree on dates, the app says so, and classic examples can be checked with live Try it boxes.
- Tree of Life: the ten sefirot and twenty-two paths in the layout associated with Isaac Luria's school, the letters of Sefer Yetzirah (three mothers, seven doubles, twelve simples), and the Kabbalistic custom of counting the Omer through the sefirot.
- Calculator and Compare: values in Hebrew, Greek, Arabic and English systems, with the systems that fit a word's alphabet side by side.
- Alphabet Museum, a 12-lesson Academy, a Quiz, Pattern Explorer, a Custom System Builder and a Research Notebook.
- Statistics Lab: a random-letter simulation shows how often matching totals turn up by chance, so curiosity stays honest.
- Four skins: Midnight Sapphire, Lapis & Gold, Daylight Ink and Max Contrast.

What it is, and what it isn't: Gematria Lab presents gematria, Kabbalah and numerology as cultural, religious and symbolic traditions, described as their readers have understood them. It is not science, and it makes no predictions. Names, notes and settings stay on the device; the app has no accounts, no ads and no analytics.

name: Log Everything: Life Tracker
description:
Log Everything is one calm place for everything you want to keep track of. Build a tracker for anything (water, sleep, mood, pain, medication, workouts, coffee, plants, fuel) and log it in a second from the app, a widget, Control Centre or Siri.

TRACK ANYTHING
• Start from a template, or build your own from six kinds of field: number, rating scale, yes/no, counter, choices and notes
• Templates for water, sleep, mood and energy, pain, migraines, medication, caffeine, workouts, plant watering and car fuel
• Units, ranges, steps and your own choices, with an icon and colour for each tracker
• Change a tracker whenever you like; archived trackers keep all their history

LOG IT IN A TAP
• Today shows every tracker with today's total and a one-tap button: +1 glass, "Yes, taken", or the full form when there's more to say
• Home Screen widgets and a Control Centre control that log without opening the app
• "Log water in Log Everything" with Siri, Shortcuts or the Action button
• Reminders for each tracker, at the times and on the days you choose, that can skip themselves once you've logged
• Backdate an entry you missed, or edit and delete any entry

SEE HOW THINGS CHANGE
• A chart for every tracker over 30 days, 90 days, a year or all time
• Daily totals, averages and ranges, worked out the way each tracker needs
• Goals with streaks and how often you hit them
• Insights that compare days with and without a choice, such as pain on days you logged "Back"
• Everything is described as what tended to happen together, never what causes what

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
• No account, and nothing you track is ever sent to the developer
• Everything stays on your iPhone, or syncs through your own private iCloud if you turn it on
• Export any tracker, or everything, as a CSV file for Numbers or Excel
• Eight colour themes and dark mode

FREE, WITH PRO IF YOU WANT MORE
The free version tracks up to five things at once, with every field type, template, widget, reminder and export, and a small banner ad on the Insights and Settings tabs only, never while you log.

Log Everything Pro is a one-off purchase, with no subscription:
• As many trackers as you like
• No ads
• Insights across trackers, such as how your pain tends to be on days after short sleep
• All eight themes

Whatever you choose, everything you've logged stays yours and exportable.

Log Everything is not medical advice. Talk to a health professional about your care.

name: Logistr
description:
Logistr is the phone app for people who go out to do the work: deliveries, cleaning, repairs, visits. Your business plans the day in Logistr; this app shows you yours.

YOUR DAY, ONE TASK AT A TIME
• The next visit first: where, when, the note from the office and the steps to do.
• Slide to start: the customer gets your live arrival time while you drive.
• Directions in your maps app, and the map shows the way.

DO IT, PROVE IT
• Tick each step. Count items, scan codes.
• Finish with a photo or the customer’s signature. Time and place are saved too.

WHEN SOMETHING GOES WRONG
• Tap Problem: nobody home, can’t get in, something broken. The office and the customer hear at once.
• Running late? Say it, and the new time goes to the customer.
• Speak instead of typing: “On my way”, “I’m here”, “Done”.

ALWAYS IN TOUCH
• Chat with the office, and get a notification when your day changes.
• Works with a weak signal: what you do is saved and sent when you’re back online.

Logistr is for teams whose business uses Logistr. Your office gives you a QR code or a link to join; there is nothing to sign up for. Your location is shared only while you’re on the way to a visit.

name: LogWeigh
seller_name: Millennium for Investment and Information Technology
description:
LogWeigh is a mobile weighbridge management application designed to simplify vehicle weighing operations and improve the accuracy of weighing records.

The application enables authorized users to manage weighing tickets, monitor connected weighing scales, and access operational reports directly from their mobile devices.

Key Features:

• First Weight: Create new weighing tickets with vehicle, driver, customer, and load information.

• Second Weight: Record the second measurement, complete weighing tickets, and calculate net weights.

• Live Scale Monitoring: View real-time weighing information from connected weighbridge equipment.

• Ticket Management: Track incoming and outgoing vehicles, review weighing records, and monitor ticket status.

• Multiple Locations: Select branches, sites, and weighing scales.

• Dashboard and Reports: View operational statistics, ticket completion rates, and weighing activities.

• Arabic and English: Switch between supported languages for easier daily operations.

LogWeigh helps businesses streamline weighbridge operations, reduce manual paperwork, and maintain organized weighing records.

An authorized user account is required. Live weighing features depend on compatible weighing equipment and network connectivity.

name: Lollipops: Logic Puzzle
description:
Complete the lollipops and add new ones. Each lollipop is a round candy head with one straight stick in the next cell, and the board has room for exactly one arrangement.

Lollipops is a logic puzzle with three simple rules. Every head and stick on the board belongs to exactly one lollipop. Lollipops never touch, not even by an edge. And two parts of the same kind (two heads, two horizontal sticks, two vertical sticks) may never face each other along a row or column unless a different part stands between them. Start from the given candies, find the cells that must stay empty, and watch the board fill with colour. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 CANDY JARS, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 6 × 6 strawberry jar to a 15 × 15 rainbow
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each jar unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 6 × 6 to 15 × 15, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap a cell for a candy head, drag to a neighbour to make a whole lollipop or attach a missing stick
• Long-press or switch to Dot mode to mark cells that stay empty; dots appear by themselves around finished lollipops
• Finished lollipops get their candy colour; a part that breaks a rule gets a red outline
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong marks; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: six techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Loves Me? - Do They Like You
description:
Do they actually like you? Stop guessing.

Drop in screenshots of your chat and Loves Me? reads between the lines for you:

• Crush score – how into you they really are, from 0 to 100
• What gave it away – the exact messages that tell, and what they really meant
• Next move – one clear piece of advice, plus three replies (flirty, safe, savage) you can copy and send
• Did they reply? – add their new messages and keep reading the same person
• Warmth over time – see if they're warming up or cooling off

More ways to read:
• Brush-off check – are they just being polite?
• Friends or more?
• Is your ex still into you?
• Help me reply
• Who likes you most?

Private by design
• No account, no sign-up.
• Screenshots are only sent to our AI to make the read, and never stored.
• Your results stay on your phone (and your own iCloud, if it's on).

Loves Me Plus
Unlimited reads (fair use: up to 50 a day), our smartest AI and the warmth chart. Monthly or yearly subscription with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers, or a one-time 10-read pack.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Results are AI guesses for fun, not facts about anyone.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sailin.shop/privacy

name: Lucky Digger: +1 Power
description:
DIG. FIND. SELL. LEVEL UP.

Grab your pickaxe and dig your way down! Lucky Digger: +1 Power is a fast, addictive 3D mining simulator where every tap on the screen makes you stronger and every new room hides even rarer treasure.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap the screen to gain power and smash the pit floor to go down. Down below, every room is packed with items: grab everything your backpack can hold, head back to base and sell it at the stall. Use your cash to buy stronger pickaxes, powerful auras and upgrades, then dig even deeper. The deeper the room, the higher your luck, and the rarer your finds!

BUILD YOUR MINING EMPIRE
- Dig through endless rooms across 6 worlds: lava, crystal, ice, jungle, gold and candy
- Collect 100 items in 8 rarities, from Common to the mysterious Secret
- Unlock 34 pickaxes, from the Wood Pickaxe all the way to the legendary Supreme Lucky Pickaxe
- Wear 10 flaming auras that multiply your power
- Drop your finds into the Loot Upgrader and watch them come out multiplied and rarer
- Train on the rocks in the Training Area to keep your power climbing
- Rebirth at level 100 for permanent power and cash bonuses
- Upgrade your speed and backpack to carry more and more
- Customize your digger with shirts, pants, hair, accessories and colors
- Claim daily rewards for 7 days in a row, with a legendary chest at the end
- Play online with other diggers and fight for the top of the Bosses leaderboard

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
Simple one-finger controls, progress that never stops and the thrill of spotting a rare item glowing at the bottom of the room. Whether you're hunting Secret treasures or just love watching your power grow without limits, Lucky Digger keeps the loop short, fast and addictive.

Download now and start digging: the next rare treasure could be right under your feet!

name: Lumera: Future Self
description:
Hear the life you're calling in.

Lumera turns your dreams into personalized audio stories. Tell it about the life you want: the home, the work, the people, the feeling. Every day it writes new visualizations in which you already live that life, and reads them to you in a calm, soothing voice.

PERSONALIZED FUTURE-SELF STORIES
• New stories every day, written around your own goals
• Read aloud in a calm voice over soft ocean, rain or forest sounds
• Follow along with captions, or simply close your eyes and listen

DAILY AFFIRMATIONS
• A fresh set every morning, shaped by your intentions
• Swipe to keep the ones that resonate and listen back anytime

YOUR WHOLE RITUAL IN ONE PLACE
• Gratitude and intention journaling with gentle prompts
• Vision boards made from your own photos
• Intentions with progress tracking and streaks
• A library for abundance, love, focus and sleep
• A gentle AI coach when you need a nudge

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your journal is private and never used to train AI. You choose exactly what Lumera knows about you, and you can export or delete your data at any time.

LUMERA PREMIUM
Start with a 7-day free trial, then $5.99 per week. Local prices may vary.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the free trial ends.
• The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
• Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID account settings.

Without a subscription you can still listen to the day's recommended story and a few daily affirmations.

Lumera is a wellbeing and visualization tool and does not replace medical, psychological or financial advice.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://lumera.vybo.ro/privacy

name: Lumi: Mood & Self-care
description:
Lumi is a gentle self-care companion. Instead of rating your mood with numbers, you check in with your inner weather: Stormy, Rainy, Cloudy, Bright or Sunny. No grades, no red warnings — just skies that change.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Inner-weather check-in in under a minute, with your energy level and what's shaping your day
• A small daily plan built from your own goals
• 4-7-8 breathing with a calming animated circle
• Calm mode: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding for hard moments, with one-tap helplines
• Reframe a thought: spot common thinking traps and find a kinder view (inspired by CBT ideas)
• Journal with daily prompts and "three good things"
• Insights: a monthly inner-weather calendar, streaks and gentle patterns
• Your sky: every check-in lights a new star

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Your check-ins and journal stay on your iPhone
• Optional app lock with Face ID or passcode
• Export or delete all your data any time

LUMI PLUS (OPTIONAL)
Lumi is free with one small banner ad. Lumi Plus removes the ad and supports a small independent app. Monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions are available. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Lumi is a self-care tool, not a medical device and not a substitute for professional care. If you are in crisis, please contact your local emergency number.

name: Lunifest: Manifest Journal 369
description:
Lunifest turns manifestation into a monthly rhythm: one wish, one lunar cycle.

Plant a wish on the new moon, or any night. Write it every day with the 369 method. Script the life you asked for. On the full moon, celebrate what arrived and release what you are done carrying. When the cycle closes, mark the wish as come true or renew it.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Wishes with their own lunar timeline, from planting to the next new moon
• 369 method: 3 lines in the morning, 6 in the afternoon, 9 at night, with a counter and reminders
• Manifestation journal: scripting prompts, gratitude, full moon release
• Vision board made from your own photos and words
• Affirmations written for this app: abundance, love, confidence, career, health, calm and lines for each moon phase, plus your own
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen
• Moon phase calculated on your iPhone, with new and full moon reminders

PRIVATE
No account, no ads. Wishes, journal and photos stay on your iPhone; the app sends only anonymous usage statistics.

LUNIFEST PLUS
Free: one wish at a time, the 369 method, gratitude, release, two affirmation themes, a six-tile board and widgets. Plus adds unlimited wishes, scripting, all themes, unlimited own lines and an unlimited board with its widget.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Lunifest is a tool for reflection and focus. It does not promise outcomes and does not replace professional advice.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://somefork2.github.io/lunifest/privacy.html

name: Lurbel B2B
description:
Lurbel B2B es la app de pedidos de Lurbel para tiendas y distribuidores. Consulta el catálogo de calcetines, ropa técnica y accesorios deportivos, comprueba la disponibilidad y prepara la reposición de tu tienda desde el iPhone o el iPad.

• Explora el catálogo o utiliza el buscador para encontrar un producto.
• Escanea un código de barras para localizar un artículo.
• Consulta precios y disponibilidad por talla y color.
• Añade los productos al carrito y revisa las cantidades antes de enviar el pedido.
• Consulta tus pedidos y comparte el justificante en PDF.

Para acceder al catálogo necesitas una cuenta profesional de Lurbel. Si aún no tienes acceso, ponte en contacto con el equipo comercial de la marca.

name: Machine Learning Teens: Datamo
description:
Machine learning is easier to understand when you can touch it. Datamo gives you eight benches, one idea at each, and every number on screen is computed by code on your phone.

HOW A BENCH WORKS
1. Story: a real situation in a few short cards.
2. Guess: predict the answer before anything runs. Guessing earns prediction points and is never a "wrong answer".
3. Try: drag, slide and step an experiment.
4. Equation: see the equation that describes what you just watched. Tap any symbol to find it in the picture, with its live value.
5. Check: two questions built from your own settings, two true-or-false myths, and an optional 8-question unit check.

THE EIGHT BENCHES
- Fruit stall: rows, columns, features and labels.
- Friends map: guess a new student's favourite sport with nearest neighbours, and see why scaling matters.
- 20 questions: a decision tree plays the guessing game and measures how mixed a pile is.
- Bus stop: fit a line and predict the wait.
- Pop quiz: memorising versus understanding, training versus test error, cross-validation.
- Spam filter: precision, recall, F1 and the cost of a miss.
- Pizza kitchens: k-means clustering, step by step.
- Data detective: biased samples, leaks, wrong labels, and choosing between a line, a tree and nearest neighbours.

MADE FOR TEENS
- Ages 13 and up. No account, no chat window, no data leaves your device.
- Ads are never personalised for teens and no tracking prompt is shown.
- Short sessions of 4 to 7 minutes, a gentle replay shelf for missed questions, no streak pressure, and a "good place to stop" at the end of each bench.
- Text size from 85% to 200%, labels for screen readers, and shapes as well as colours on every chart.

SOURCES YOU CAN OPEN
Every bench cites textbooks, university courses and primary papers. Tap a source to read it in a window that covers most of the screen; close it and you are back exactly where you were. Offline, you still see the full reference.

Content as of 2026-11-17. Not expert reviewed. Every claim is source-checked and the numbers are computed by code.

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL AD-FREE MONTHLY
Datamo is free with ads at natural breaks, never in the middle of an experiment or a question. Ad-Free Monthly removes the ads and nothing else. It starts with a 7-day free trial and renews monthly until you cancel. Cancel anytime in your store account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use are linked in the app.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-datamo.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-datamo.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-datamo.html

name: Maharnia: Undangan Pernikahan
description:
Maharnia adalah app untuk membuat undangan pernikahan digital sendiri, dari HP. Pilih tema, isi nama mempelai dan acara, tambahkan foto, lalu bagikan satu tautan ke semua tamu. Jawaban dan ucapan tamu masuk ke app yang sama.

TEMA YANG BENAR-BENAR BERBEDA
Ada 13 tema, dan tiap tema punya tata letak, pembuka, dan geraknya sendiri. Bedanya bukan hanya warna dan huruf.
• Kalender Sobek: tamu menyobek lembar kalender sampai tiba di tanggal kalian.
• Kiriman Pos: undangan datang sebagai amplop yang dibuka dan kartu pos yang dibalik.
• Koran Pagi: kabar bahagia di halaman depan, lengkap dengan kupon kehadiran yang digunting.
• Pasar Malam: tamu menarik tali genset, lalu lampu dan bianglala menyala.
• Benang: satu benang tergambar mengikuti guliran dan mengikat setiap bagian.
Juga ada Album Tempel, Batik Tulis, Wayang Kertas, Kaset Pita, Layar Lebar, Cetak Riso, Rumah Hajatan, dan Resep Keluarga. Lima tema bisa dipakai gratis. Semua tema bisa dicoba dengan nama kalian sebelum memilih.

DIISI SENDIRI, TANPA MENUNGGU ADMIN
• Nama mempelai dan orang tua, foto masing-masing, akun Instagram.
• Akad, resepsi, atau acara lain, dengan tautan peta dan tombol simpan ke kalender.
• Galeri foto, cerita singkat, dan momen perjalanan kalian.
• Kata pembuka dan kutipan atau doa: tulis sendiri atau pilih dari yang tersedia.
• Musik latar: pilih dari lagu bawaan atau unggah lagu sendiri (mulai paket Lite).
• Undangan bisa tampil dalam bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris.
• Perubahan bisa dilihat dulu lewat pratinjau, dan riwayat perubahannya tersimpan.

SATU TAUTAN UNTUK SEMUA TAMU
Undangan terbit di alamat maharnia.id/u/nama-kalian. Bagikan lewat WhatsApp atau aplikasi apa pun. Tamu membukanya di peramban, tanpa memasang app.

TAMU DAN RSVP
• Tambah tamu satu per satu, impor dari kontak, atau dari berkas Excel/CSV.
• Kirim pesan undangan ke banyak tamu lewat WhatsApp, dengan teks yang bisa kamu ubah.
• Tamu menjawab hadir atau berhalangan langsung dari undangan, beserta jumlah orangnya.
• Lihat jumlah yang hadir, berhalangan, dan belum menjawab, lalu ingatkan yang belum.
• Ucapan dan doa dari tamu terkumpul di satu tempat. Kamu bisa menyembunyikan yang tidak ingin ditampilkan.

SIAP SAMPAI HARI-H (paket Lengkap)
• Penerima tamu: pindai QR undangan tamu, cari nama, atau catat tamu di luar daftar.
• Layar sapa: tamu yang baru datang disapa namanya di TV atau tablet di venue.
• Buku tamu digital dan laporan acara setelah selesai.
• Undang keluarga atau panitia sebagai petugas penerima tamu, dan hingga 5 kolaborator untuk mengelola undangan bersama.

HARGA
Membuat dan menerbitkan undangan dengan tema gratis tidak dipungut biaya. Paket berbayar dibeli sekali per undangan, bukan langganan:
• Lite Rp49.000: tanpa tanda "Dibuat dengan Maharnia", musik pilihan sendiri, lebih banyak foto.
• Plus Rp149.000: semua tema termasuk premium, ganti alamat setelah terbit, ekspor tamu dan RSVP.
• Lengkap Rp249.000: kolaborator, penerima tamu hari-H, buku tamu digital, hingga 150 foto.
Tema premium juga bisa dibeli satuan seharga Rp49.000. Harga yang berlaku adalah yang tampil di app.

Ada pertanyaan? Buka menu Bantuan di app atau kunjungi maharnia.id.

name: MamiTa Moments
description:
MamiTa Moments to ciepłe miejsce tylko dla Was: mamy i córki. Każdego dnia losujecie jedną kartę z małym rytuałem, który zajmuje kilka minut, a zostaje w pamięci na długo.

Co na was czeka:
• Karta dnia: wylosujcie wspólną chwilę na dziś
• Rytuały do zrobienia razem: pytania do rozmowy, prosty gest, wspólne zamknięcie
• Talie na różne nastroje: bliskość, emocje, wspólna kreatywność i inne
• Księga Chwil: dziennik, w którym zapiszecie to, co dla Was ważne
• Cytat dnia: krótka myśl na dobry początek

Dla kogo?
Dla mam i córek, które chcą częściej być blisko, bez pośpiechu i bez presji. Rytuały są krótkie, proste i nie wymagają żadnych przygotowań.

Inspiracja do wspólnego czasu. Nie jest terapią ani poradą psychologiczną.

name: MandalaChartWisdomKing
description:
"Mandala Chart: Wisdom Kings" combines the traditional Mandala Chart method with a streamlined 5-block × 5-cell structure inspired by the Five Wisdom Kings (Godai Myoo) of Japanese esoteric Buddhism.

It is famously known for having been used by MLB player Shohei Ohtani during his teenage years to help realize his dream of succeeding in the world of baseball.

Cast aside hesitation and focus on the actions essential for achieving your goals.

While a traditional 9x9 (81-cell) Mandala Chart can feel overwhelming, this focused 5x5 framework breaks your vision down into 1 Core Goal, 4 Supporting Elements, and 16 Concrete Actions—helping you build momentum without losing sight of the big picture.

■ A 5x5 Mandala Guided by the Five Wisdom Kings
Place your Core Goal at the center with Fudo Myoo, surrounded by four Wisdom Kings representing the pillars of your journey:
• Center: Fudo Myoo (White) — Your immovable Core Goal
• Top-Left: Daiitoku Myoo (Red) — Breakthrough & Wisdom (Element 1)
• Top-Right: Kongoyasha Myoo (Purple) — Discipline & Clarity (Element 2)
• Bottom-Left: Gundari Myoo (Yellow) — Harmony & Vitality (Element 3)
• Bottom-Right: Gozanze Myoo (Blue) — Perspective & Overcoming (Element 4)

Tap any block on the overview map to zoom in for detailed editing, and swipe left or right to move seamlessly between all five blocks.

■ Intuitive Progress Tracking & Visual Feedback
Rate each of your 16 action items from 0% to 100% with quick presets or a smooth slider. Your ratings automatically roll up into each element's progress and your overall completion rate, enriching each Wisdom King's theme colors as you advance.

■ AI Guidance from the Five Wisdom Kings (Ad-Supported)
Stuck brainstorming? Watch a short rewarded ad to seek guidance from Fudo Myoo or any of the four surrounding Wisdom Kings. Powered by AI, each Wisdom King reviews your current chart, delivers encouraging feedback in a distinct voice, and suggests 4 tailored elements or actions that you can apply directly to empty slots with a single tap.

■ Multi-Goal Management & Image Export
• Manage up to 5 separate Mandala Charts and switch between them anytime (unlock additional charts by watching a short ad).
• Export your complete 5x5 Mandala Chart as a crisp, shareable image to save to your Photos or share with others.

Set your immovable resolve at the center and take decisive action every day.

name: Manflow – Beautyflow for Men
description:
The official booking app of Manflow – Beautyflow for Men, a men's grooming and beauty salon in Budapest (District XIII).

Pick your treatment, see the price and duration, and book an appointment in a few taps – no phone calls needed.

• Laser hair removal: tap the areas you want treated on the body figure; the app shows the price, the duration and whether a package is better value.
• Tattoo removal, men's skincare treatments and waxing.
• Weekly calendar with the available time slots.
• Your account: upcoming and past bookings, passes, cancelling and rescheduling in one place.
• Free laser test treatment booking.
• Gift cards.
• Available in Hungarian and English.

You can pay at the salon or, if you prefer, online by card.

Address: Reitter Ferenc utca 90, 1135 Budapest, Hungary.

name: Marbble Games Master
description:
FIVE MARBLE GAMES. ONE BIG ADVENTURE!

Welcome to Marble Games Master! Discover five exciting games in one colorful collection. Shoot rolling marbles, merge sparkling gems, solve tricky mazes, hop across spinning rings and enjoy classic Chinese Checkers.

Meet Glim, your cheerful jewel firefly companion, and explore beautiful temple worlds filled with challenges, powerful boosters and satisfying rewards.

GEM SHOOTER – AIM, MATCH & BLAST!

Fire colorful marbles into moving chains and match three or more of the same color to clear them before they reach the guardian.

Create spectacular chain reactions, build combo multipliers and enjoy dazzling explosions!

• Match marbles and trigger snap-back combos.
• Rescue baby creatures trapped in bubbles.
• Break stone pillars and tackle two-chain challenges.
• Discover Lightning, Ice, Fire and other special marbles.
• Earn treasure chests every five wins.

MARBLE MERGE – DROP & COMBINE!

Drop colorful gems into a glass jar and merge matching pairs into bigger gems.

Discover nine gem stages as you work toward the crowned Amethyst. Enjoy realistic physics, satisfying merge effects and endless high-score challenges.

Use Hammer, Shake and Swap boosters to keep the jar below the danger line!

CHINESE CHECKERS – THINK & JUMP!

Enjoy a classic strategy game on a beautiful 121-hole star board.

Challenge Glim in Easy, Medium or Hard mode, plan clever moves and create exciting chain jumps.

Choose from nine board skins, follow highlighted legal moves and track your victories.
MARBLE MAZE – ROLL TO THE EXIT!

Tilt your device or use touch controls to guide a marble through winding labyrinths.

Avoid dangerous pits, slide across icy paths, collect coins and unlock gates to reach the glowing exit portal.

Discover fresh mazes as you progress, use helpful boosters and aim for three stars!

ORBIT HOP – TIME YOUR JUMPS!

Guide a glowing gem across spinning temple rings and land on the matching color.

Explore hundreds of levels across themed worlds, face challenging boss stages and master your timing.

Use Slow Time, Stone Shield, Wild Gem and Guide power-ups to overcome tricky jumps.

**REWARDS & BEAUTIFUL WORLDS**

Collect daily gifts, earn coins and unlock useful boosters, board skins and new worlds.

Explore ten painted temple environments, from ancient sandstone and mossy ruins to icy temples and glowing lava.

Watch Glim cheer, celebrate and accompany you throughout your adventure!

GAME FEATURES

• Five unique games in one app.
• Exciting marble shooting and chain reactions.

name: Mắt AI - Trợ Lý Thị Giác
description:
Mắt AI là người bạn đồng hành thị giác thông minh ứng dụng công nghệ Trí Tuệ Nhân Tạo (AI Vision) tiên tiến, được thiết kế riêng cho người Việt và kiều bào trên toàn thế giới. Chỉ với một cú chạm hoặc khẩu lệnh rảnh tay, Mắt AI sẽ "nhìn, hiểu và trò chuyện" cùng bạn bằng giọng đọc tiếng Việt tự nhiên, ấm áp.

TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT:

1. NHẬN DIỆN THUỐC & ĐỒ DÙNG TRÊN KỆ HÀNG
• Chụp ảnh kệ thuốc hoặc bàn đồ dùng: AI lập tức chỉ rõ vị trí vật lý cụ thể (tầng mấy, bên trái/phải, màu sắc vỏ chai).
• Đọc to tên thuốc, công dụng chính và hướng dẫn liều lượng tham khảo.
• Tự động khoanh vùng xanh lá nổi bật trên màn hình giúp người lớn tuổi hoặc người mắt kém dễ dàng xác định đồ vật.

2. TRỢ LÝ CANH BẾP RẢNH TAY & CHỐNG TRÀO NƯỚC
• Bạn đang nấu canh, luộc đồ hoặc đun nước sôi? Chỉ cần dựng điện thoại hướng vào bếp và nói: "Canh nước sôi giùm tôi".
• Mắt AI sẽ định kỳ quan sát mực nước, phát hiện sủi tăm, sôi bùng hoặc nguy cơ sôi trào thức ăn.
• Bật còi báo động âm thanh và rung khẩn cấp kịp thời để bạn vào tắt bếp an toàn.

3. TRA CỨU GIÁ CẢ & SO SÁNH MUA SẮM 1 CHẠM
• Tự động nhận diện thương hiệu sản phẩm và ước tính mức giá tham khảo tại Mỹ.
• Tích hợp thanh cuộn nhanh kết nối trực tiếp đến 5 hệ thống bán lẻ hàng đầu: Walmart, Best Buy, Amazon, CVS và Walgreens.

4. GIỌNG NÓI TỰ NHIÊN & TÙY BIẾN DANH XƯNG
• Tùy chọn xưng hô gần gũi như người trong nhà: "Con - Bác", "Cháu - Cô/Chú", "Em - Anh/Chị".
• Chế độ trả lời ngắn gọn 1 câu súc tích hoặc phân tích chi tiết.
• Khả năng phóng to ảnh (Pinch-to-zoom đến 5x) để đọc rõ hạn sử dụng và nhãn phụ in nhỏ.

QUYỀN RIÊNG TƯ & AN TOÀN:
Mắt AI cam kết bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân theo tiêu chuẩn khắt khe nhất của Apple. Hình ảnh camera chỉ được xử lý tạm thời theo thời gian thực để phục vụ yêu cầu của bạn, tuyệt đối không lưu trữ vĩnh viễn trên máy chủ công cộng hay bán cho bên thứ ba.

KHUYẾN CÁO MIỄN TRỪ TRÁCH NHIỆM:
Mắt AI là công cụ hỗ trợ thị giác tham khảo. Mọi thông tin về thuốc men chỉ mang tính chất tham khảo, không thay thế cho chẩn đoán y khoa của bác sĩ hoặc dược sĩ chuyên môn. Vui lòng luôn cẩn trọng khi sử dụng các thiết bị nhiệt và lửa trong gian bếp.

name: Mathesis – Understand Math
description:
Math isn't a burden on our journey of growth. It's a treasure we find along the way.
Mathesis is a tool for adults who want to understand mathematics. It does not do your sums. It helps you see one idea clearly.

· Interactive labs: 47 of them. Drag a secant until it becomes a tangent, tilt a plane through a cone and watch the ellipse turn into a parabola, pile up a hundred sample means into a bell curve.
· A map of mathematics: 120 concepts in 11 branches. Arrows point upward and foundations sit below. Tap a concept to see the shortest path to it, and where it turns out to be the same thing as something in another branch.
· Three layers: each concept starts with intuition, moves to the formula and ends at the axioms. Tap the underlined parts of a formula to ask why, again and again.
· One question: each concept ends with a question that tests understanding rather than memory.
· Modeling: describe a real question and get a mathematical model, the principles it rests on, and round after round of revision.
· The people and the uses: every historical claim carries a source rating and disputes are stated as disputes; every application comes with a diagram.

All explanations are originally written, with references for definitions and theorems listed on each concept page. Every diagram is drawn in code.

Concepts, labs and guided problems work offline. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Free: 3 labs, 15 concepts in full, and the intuition layer of every other concept.
Unlocked: all 47 labs, all three layers of 120 concepts, 19 guided problems, and cloud rounds for Modeling (60 a month; on devices with Apple Intelligence it runs on the device with no limit).

Subscriptions: Monthly and Yearly renew automatically. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at the price shown; the subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be cancelled any time in your App Store account settings. name: MELLNI
description:
MELLNI это приложение для знакомств, общения и встреч, которых хочется ждать. Находите взаимную симпатию, открывайте интересные места и планируйте свидания в одном приложении.

Кофе после работы, прогулка по любимым улицам или вечер в месте, куда давно хотелось заглянуть. Иногда в привычных планах не хватает человека, с которым хочется их разделить. В MELLNI можно познакомиться, узнать друг друга ближе и придумать, где пройдёт ваша первая встреча.

Знакомьтесь и рассказывайте о себе

Ваша анкета помогает сделать первый шаг. Добавьте фотографии, расскажите об увлечениях и о том, что для вас важно в знакомстве. Покажите свой характер, чувство юмора и интересы. А в анкетах других людей ищите то, что откликается именно вам: общие увлечения, близкие взгляды или желание попробовать что-то новое вместе.

Находите взаимную симпатию

Смотрите профили и отправляйте лайки тем, кто привлёк ваше внимание. Когда симпатия взаимна, открывается чат. Можно начать с вопроса об интересах, обсудить любимое место в городе или сразу поделиться идеей для свидания. У каждого знакомства свой ритм, и вы сами решаете, как его продолжить.

Общайтесь и узнавайте друг друга

Первый разговор помогает понять, насколько вам интересно вместе. Делитесь мыслями, задавайте вопросы, обсуждайте планы и возвращайтесь к переписке, когда вам удобно. В разделе чатов можно продолжать начатое общение и постепенно переходить от первых сообщений к встрече.

Выбирайте место для вашей истории

У хорошего свидания есть настроение и место. Открывайте карту MELLNI, изучайте карточки мест и находите идеи для совместного вечера. Предложите любимое кафе или откройте что-то новое вдвоём. Так у разговора появляется конкретное продолжение, а у свидания своя атмосфера.

Сохраняйте то, что понравилось

Добавляйте места в избранное, чтобы вернуться к ним, когда появится повод встретиться. Соберите собственную подборку для первого кофе, неспешной прогулки или следующего свидания. Интересная идея может появиться заранее, а подходящий человек чуть позже.

Планируйте встречи прямо в чате

Выберите место, предложите время и согласуйте встречу с собеседником. Анкеты, переписка и планы собраны в MELLNI, поэтому договориться о свидании можно там же, где началось знакомство. Обсудите, куда вам обоим хочется пойти, и выберите вечер, которого вам обоим захочется ждать.

Знакомьтесь через любимые места

Иногда общий интерес начинается с простого желания пойти в одно и то же место. Отмечайте места, которые вам интересны. С Premium можно открывать анкеты людей в разделе «Хотят пойти». Возможно, вы уже выбрали одинаковую идею для встречи и осталось познакомиться.

Больше возможностей с Premium

Настройте знакомства под свои предпочтения и добавьте к первому впечатлению несколько слов о себе. В Premium доступны:

• Расширенные фильтры поиска по интересам и другим параметрам.

• Текстовые, аудио- и видеосообщения к лайкам.

• История недавно просмотренных анкет с возможностью вернуться к пропущенному профилю.

• Отмена отправленного лайка до взаимной симпатии.

• Просмотр анкет людей, которые хотят пойти в выбранное место.

• Настройки видимости времени последнего посещения и дополнительные иконки приложения.

Выбирайте комфортное общение

Вы сами решаете, кому отвечать и с кем продолжать знакомство. Если общение вам не подходит, его можно завершить. В приложении также доступны блокировка пользователя и отправка жалобы. Встречайтесь тогда, когда оба готовы, и выбирайте подходящий вам темп.

Начните с интереса друг к другу

Для знакомства бывает достаточно заметить что-то общее: любимую музыку, увлечение или место, куда вам обоим хочется пойти. Создайте анкету, проявите симпатию и дайте разговору начаться. А когда захочется увидеться, MELLNI поможет выбрать место и договориться о встрече.

Скачайте MELLNI. Ваши следующие планы могут стать общими.

После регистрации нужна видеоверификация. Разделы откроются после одобрения модератора.

Приложение предназначено для пользователей от 18 лет.

name: MendTap
description:
MendTap is an English keyboard that fixes your grammar right where you type, in apps that support third-party keyboards.

Type as you normally would. When you're ready, tap Fix grammar and MendTap shows the corrected version with every change highlighted. Apply all of it, pick single changes, or dismiss it. Nothing is sent or changed without your tap.

WHAT IT DOES
- Fixes grammar, spelling and punctuation in the text before your cursor
- Make clearer rewrites a message so it reads more naturally
- Shows each change in green and red before you apply it
- Suggests spelling fixes and word completions as you type, on your iPhone
- Light vibration and key click sounds, each with its own on/off switch

YOU CONTROL YOUR TEXT
- Text is sent only when you tap Fix grammar or Make clearer, never while you type
- No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking
- Our server does not store your text or the corrections
- Submitted text is processed by Anthropic's Claude; review the in-app disclosure before enabling corrections
- Password fields always use the system keyboard

FREE
Every install gets up to 30 AI fixes a day, subject to service limits. Basic typing, spelling suggestions and completions work without a cloud correction request.

GETTING STARTED
1. Open MendTap and review the AI-sharing disclosure. Enable corrections if you agree.
2. Open Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard and choose MendTap.
3. Tap MendTap and turn on Allow Full Access. iOS requires this before a keyboard can reach the internet; MendTap uses it to send the text you choose to fix.
4. In a supported app, switch to MendTap with the globe key and start typing.

Cloud corrections require an internet connection. Some apps block third-party keyboards, and iOS limits how much text a keyboard can access around the cursor. Long drafts may need to be corrected in smaller sections. AI suggestions can make mistakes; review them before applying.

MARKDOWN & FILES READY
