description:
Mexican is het klassieke dobbelspel vol bluf, nu op één telefoon die rondgaat.

Gooi twee stenen onder de beker, kijk stiekem en zeg wat je gooide. Of lieg. De volgende speler gelooft je, of roept bluf. Wie betrapt wordt, verliest een leven. Wie als laatste overblijft, wint.

HOE HET WERKT
• Geef de telefoon door: alleen jij ziet je worp
• Houd de beker vast om stiekem te kijken
• Kies wat je zegt, van 31 tot dubbel 66, of Mexican: de hoogste worp
• Geloven of bluf? De stenen liegen niet

WAAROM JE HET WILT
• Gratis met 2 tot 4 spelers, op één telefoon
• Maak een selfie als spelersfoto of kies een luchador-masker
• Tik of schud je telefoon om te gooien
• Geen account, geen reclame, geen tracking

FIESTA-PAKKET (eenmalige aankoop)
• Speel met tot 10 spelers
• Huisregel: Mexican verliezen kost 2 levens
• 2 extra bekers

Perfect voor verjaardagen, het studentenhuis of een avond met vrienden. ¡Salud!

name: Mihrap: Prayer Times & Adhan
description:
Mihrap shows prayer times on a clean, easy-to-read screen and alerts you as each prayer time begins.

PRAYER TIMES AND ALERTS
• Diyanet times for cities in Türkiye and Europe; without a connection, times are calculated on the device
• Countdown to the next prayer, a monthly timetable and a Ramadan timetable
• A separate alert for each prayer: off, silent or with adhan
• Reminders before prayer time and a gentle Fajr wake-up that starts quietly and grows louder
• Travel mode: switches the city based on your location
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets

PRAYER TRACKING
• Prayer log: what you prayed today, the last 7 days and your streak
• Dhikr counter for the tasbih after prayer
• Family circle: share a code with your family and see each other's daily prayer count (via iCloud)

QIBLA AND MORE
• Compass Qibla direction and distance to the Kaaba
• Open nearby mosques on the map
• Hadith of the day, plus share cards for hadith, Friday and holy night messages
• Home screen with a photo of your city
• Turkish, English and Arabic

FREE AND PREMIUM
Mihrap is free and contains ads. The free version gives silent alerts at every prayer time and plays the adhan at 2 prayer times. Watch a short ad to unlock the adhan at every prayer, the missed-prayer log and share themes for 24 hours.

With Mihrap Premium:
• No ads at all
• Adhan at every prayer time, plus a second adhan voice
• Missed-prayer (qada) log
• Special themes for share cards

Premium options: weekly, monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions (7-day free trial on your first subscription) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://cevogames.com/mihrap-gizlilik.html

name: Mikiwame: Japan Web Test Prep
description:
Mikiwame trains the part of Japan's graduate-hiring web tests that most people miss: how many seconds you spend on each question. Japanese-language app.

PACE METER
See your seconds per question next to the pace the real test expects, and how many questions behind or ahead you are.

IDENTIFY THE FORMAT
Enter the time limit and number of questions on the test you received and the app tells you which format it is, then lets you practise it.

LANGUAGE
Logical reading (A/B/C) and main-point questions. Tap the sentences that support your answer, then choose. Explanations included, all questions are original.

NUMERICAL
Inverse arithmetic, reading tables and charts, estimating blank cells. Questions are generated on the spot and every answer is exact. A calculator is built in.

TEST LIST AND MOCK MODE
Add each company's test date and format, get a reminder the day before and a countdown on the home screen and widget. Run a full mock with the real time limit.

No account. Your data stays on this device. No ads. A free daily set is included; all questions and mock mode are one in-app purchase.

Not affiliated with SHL Japan. Original questions only. Format information is based on public sources and may differ from the real test.

name: MILBET
description:
MILBET keeps a renovation or construction project in one place: measurements, works, materials, purchases, payments, budget and progress — all on your iPhone.

Measure a room once and the numbers flow on: into material quantities, the budget and a clear report you can share.

PROJECTS AND ZONES
• Renovation, new construction or specialized projects with dates, currency and units
• Rooms, walls, floors, ceilings, facades and custom zones
• Doors and windows are subtracted from wall areas automatically

MATERIAL CALCULATORS
• Paint, tile, flooring, drywall, plaster, insulation, concrete and custom materials
• Every result shows its formula, inputs, waste and rounding
• Add results to your materials list in one tap

WORK PLAN AND START READINESS
• Start from 18 templates or add your own works with dates, status and checklists
• Start Readiness shows what still needs to be bought, the remaining cost and deliveries due after the planned start
• Readiness updates as materials are received

PURCHASES AND PAYMENTS
• Record each purchase batch with quantity, unit price and expected delivery
• Log the amount paid, payment date and an optional receipt photo
• Payments update actual material costs in the budget and reports

BUDGET AND TIMELINE
• Planned and actual costs by category, including labor and other expenses
• Upcoming and overdue works across all projects
• Optional reminders for works, purchases and deliveries

REPORTS
• Project Summary, Materials List, Budget Summary and Work Plan as PDF; materials also as CSV
• Share, save to Files or print

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, works offline
• Projects stay on your iPhone; nothing is sent automatically

Available in English, French, Arabic and Polish, with light and dark themes.

Calculations are planning estimates based on the values you enter. They are not engineering, structural or accounting documents. Check quantities with your supplier before buying.

name: Milepost: Run, Hike, Walk
description:
Run, walk or hike with Milepost on your Apple Watch. Some days you want every number. Other days you just want to go, and glance at your wrist when something changes. Milepost has a view for each, and you can switch at any time, even mid-run. Free, with optional tips.

CARDS: JUST WHAT MATTERS, WHEN IT MATTERS
A few cards, and the one you need comes up on its own. You don't have to go looking.
• Running uphill? Elevation comes up, with how far you've climbed.
• Working hard on a walk? Your heart rate zones come up.
• Hiking near sunset? Sunset comes up, with the minutes left. Rain on the way does the same.
• A new mile, halfway round your usual loop, or turning for home.
• Cards move only while your wrist is down, so nothing shifts while you look. A tap on your wrist for each mile, each pause, and heads-ups like rain.
Walks and hikes get calmer cards: pace changes on a trail aren't news, so they stay put.

SCREENS: EVERY NUMBER, YOUR WAY
Build your own watch screens on the iPhone, row by row, and see each one take shape as you go.
• One big number, or two or three side by side.
• Graphs of heart rate, pace and elevation.
• Time in each heart rate zone.
• A map you can pan, with your numbers along the bottom.
Swipe between your screens as you go. Four simple ones are ready to start with.

AFTER EVERY WORKOUT
Every run, walk and hike in Apple Health shows up, from Milepost or any other app, with its map, splits and heart rate zones. And for weather nerds, the weather at the start and the end, side by side: conditions, temperature, feels like, humidity, dew point, wind and gusts, rain, cloud cover, UV, pressure and visibility. Plus the sun and moon that day.
See your last week, month or year at a glance, with your records: longest, fastest, coldest, hottest.

FOR LONG DAYS OUT
• A Battery card with about how many hours are left, which comes up at 30% and 15%.
• Auto pause tuned to walking speeds on walks and hikes.
• The forecast on the way out: rain coming, and the next few hours in a few words.

EITHER WAY
• Wrist taps and spoken updates, set up the way you like in one place. Voice is off until you turn it on.
• Start with the Action button on Apple Watch Ultra: Outdoor Run, Walk or Hike.
• Your workout on the iPhone's Lock Screen while you go.
• Saved to Apple Health as a run, walk or hike, with route, heart rate and weather.

NO WATCH? THE IPHONE CAN RECORD TOO
Start on the iPhone and lock it. Your numbers stay on the Lock Screen, with a Pause button. Heart rate comes from AirPods Pro 3 or Powerbeats Pro 2.

name: Mills Nine Men's Morris
description:
Mills, also known as Nine Men's Morris, is one of the oldest strategy games in the world. This edition brings it to your table in quiet, beautiful 3D: polished marble and onyx stones, a hand-inlaid walnut board, candlelight and soft music.

Place your nine stones, form a row of three — a mill — and take one of your opponent's stones. Then move along the lines, block, and outthink. With three stones left you may fly. It takes a minute to learn and a lifetime to master.

FEATURES
• A calm, realistic 3D tabletop with lifelike materials and lighting
• A computer opponent with four levels, from relaxed to Master
• Two players on one device
• Undo, move hints and a clear rules guide
• Your game is saved automatically
• Touch, mouse, keyboard, game controller and Siri Remote
• Available in 13 languages

Free forever. No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking.

name: Mine Deeper: Pickaxe Digger
description:
How deep can YOU dig?

Grab your pickaxe and smash your way down through an endless mine full of ores, explosions, treasure and giant bosses. Every swing breaks a block, every block pays Ore Scraps, and every run takes you deeper than the last!

SMASH, BLAST, DIG
• Steer your bouncing pickaxe with one finger and carve your own path down
• Chain massive combos for huge rewards
• Light TNT and watch the chain reactions tear the mine apart
• Crack open chests, dodge lava, break through obsidian and find rare gem ore

12 EPIC DEPTH ZONES
Dig from the sunny Topsoil through Dirt, Clay and Stone, the glowing Crystal Caves, burning Magma, the dark Abyss and the Celestial Core... then keep going into the Frozen Depths, the Fungal Hollow, the Sunken Ruins and the mysterious Aether Rift. Every zone has its own look, its own music and richer ores.

9 GIANT BOSSES
The deep is guarded by bosses buried in the rock:
• GRAVEJAW, King of Bones
• VITREA, the Glass Queen
• IGNAROTH, the Molten Wyrm
• MORVOTH, the Hollow Eye
• HELIARCH, the Last Star
• KRYOS, the Frozen Titan
• MYCORA, the Spore Mother
• OBELON, the Ancient Warden
• AEON, the Clockwork God
Every boss fights its own way. Dodge their attacks, learn their secret and smash them for huge loot!

9 BOSS ABILITIES
Beat a boss for the first time and claim its power: GRAVE HAND, GLASS AEGIS, MOLTEN CORE, VOID RIFT, SUPERNOVA, DEEP FREEZE, SPORE BLOOM, RUNE QUAKE and REWIND. Equip one and unleash it in the middle of a run.

16 PICKAXES TO FORGE
Discover new ores, from coal, copper and iron to diamond, starite, cryonite, lumenite, orichalcum and aetherium, and forge a stronger pickaxe from each one. The best ones come with special powers of their own.

8 UPGRADES FOR EVERY PICKAXE
Power, Durability, Speed, Fortune, Critical, Sturdy, Combo and Treasure. Build each pickaxe your way and break your records.

WILD POWER-UPS
Drill straight through the rock, pull ores in with the Magnet, block damage with the Shield, repair on the go and double everything in Golden Hour.

LEGENDARY CHESTS & TRAILS
Open chests and collect dazzling pickaxe trails, from simple dust to the blazing Phoenix Wake and the Solar Crown. And somewhere in the chests hides one trail so rare that nobody knows what it looks like...

QUESTS EVERY HOUR
New quests every hour, plus an endless quest that never runs out. Complete them for gems!

Easy to pick up, hard to put down. One more run... and you will dig deeper!

Download Mine Deeper now and see how deep you can go!

name: MinusReels - Work Mode
description:
Keep your friends. Lose the endless scroll.

MinusReels opens Instagram and YouTube without the parts built to keep you watching. No Reels feed, no Shorts, no feed ads and no suggested posts. Just the people and videos you came for.

Sign in once, open what you need, and leave when you're done.

INSTAGRAM WITHOUT THE NOISE (FREE)
• Removes the Reels feed and Reels in your home feed
• Removes feed ads and suggested posts and accounts
• Hides the Explore grid, while search still works
• Keeps your friends' posts, Stories and DMs

A REEL FROM A FRIEND STILL PLAYS
When a friend sends you a Reel in DMs, you can watch it. The Reels queued up after it are removed, so one video doesn't turn into an hour.

YOUTUBE WITHOUT SHORTS (PRO)
• Removes Shorts shelves, the Shorts tab and Shorts in search results
• Removes ads from your feed
• Opens a shared Short in the normal video player
• Keeps your subscriptions, search and regular videos

YOU CHOOSE WHAT GOES
Turn each filter on or off: Reels and Shorts, Reels from friends, the Explore grid, suggested posts and ads.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Check how much was blocked today, your time in filtered apps, your daily streak and your week at a glance.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No MinusReels account needed
• You sign in on Instagram's or Google's own page, and MinusReels doesn't read or store your password
• Your settings and stats stay on your device
• No analytics or advertising SDKs in MinusReels

GOOD TO KNOW
• Ads inside the YouTube video player are not blocked.
• Instagram and YouTube change their sites often, so something may occasionally slip through until the filters are updated.
• MinusReels is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Instagram, Meta, YouTube or Google.

SUBSCRIPTION
Instagram filtering is free. YouTube filtering requires MinusReels Pro, available as a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm your purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://minusreels.netlify.app/privacy

name: MiseFlow
description:
Το MiseFlow είναι ένας εστιασμένος χώρος διαχείρισης κουζίνας για τις στιγμές που κρίνουν το σέρβις: την παράδοση βάρδιας, την ουρά prep, τη μέτρηση par και την αναγγελία 86.

Σχεδιασμένο για τον ρυθμό μιας επαγγελματικής κουζίνας, το MiseFlow κρατά τα κινούμενα μέρη ορατά χωρίς να μετατρέπει το πάσο σε ένα ακόμη spreadsheet. Ξεκίνα από την ετοιμότητα της ημέρας, κλείσε το prep πόστο-πόστο, μέτρησε τι υπάρχει πραγματικά, δήλωσε την παρουσία της ομάδας και τρέξε μια δομημένη ενημέρωση πριν το σέρβις. Μετά το σέρβις, διάβασε τα νούμερα ως επόμενη πρακτική κίνηση, όχι ως αναφορά για αύριο.

**Πιο καθαρό σέρβις**
• Προβολή Σήμερα με ετοιμότητα, επόμενο σέρβις, λίστα προσοχής και παράδοση βάρδιας
• Ζωντανός πίνακας 86 κοινός σε όλη την εργασιακή προβολή
• Lineup πριν το σέρβις για αλλεργιογόνα, προτάσεις, ελλείψεις, σημειώσεις και ασφάλεια

**Prep που περνάει σωστά**
• Ουρά prep ανά πόστο, με σειρά επείγοντος και ώρας σέρβις
• Άγγιγμα για ολοκλήρωση, απλά χρονόμετρα και ορατή ετοιμότητα
• Νέα εργασία με ποσότητα, πόστο, προτεραιότητα και εκτιμώμενο χρόνο

**Απόθεμα με πλαίσιο**
• Ενεργές παρτίδες με par levels, θέση, κωδικό παρτίδας και λήξη
• Φυσικές μετρήσεις, γρήγορες προσαρμογές και καταγραφή φύρας
• Προβολή προσοχής για κρίσιμο, χαμηλό και ληγμένο απόθεμα

**Ομάδα που ξεκινά μαζί**
• Βάρδιες με άφιξη, ρόλο και κάλυψη πόστων
• Λίστα lineup και ανακοίνωση που εμφανίζεται στην παράδοση βάρδιας
• Σύνδεση αλλεργιογόνων για τελικό προφορικό έλεγχο πριν το σέρβις

**Χρήσιμος παλμός**
• Ημερήσια, εβδομαδιαία και μηνιαία εικόνα καλυμμάτων, καθαρών πωλήσεων, εργατικών, κόστους τροφίμων και φύρας
• Ρυθμός εσόδων και μηχανική μενού
• Μείγμα πιάτων, σήματα περιθωρίου και καθαρή υπενθύμιση κόστους
• Κοινοποίηση συμπαγούς σύνοψης σέρβις στην ομάδα

**Ιδιωτικότητα από σχεδιασμό**
Το MiseFlow λειτουργεί στο iPhone σου. Δεν υπάρχει λογαριασμός, διαφήμιση, SDK analytics ή σύνδεση διακομιστή για το περιεχόμενο της κουζίνας. Εργασίες prep, μετρήσεις, αφίξεις και σημειώσεις αποθηκεύονται τοπικά στη συσκευή. Περιλαμβάνεται πλήρης λειτουργική κουζίνα, ώστε να δοκιμάσεις κάθε ροή πριν το σέρβις.

name: mjAuth Admin
description:
mjAuth is a licensing system that software brands use in their own software. Brands give the users of their software license keys bound to their computer, and the program checks the license every time it starts. mjAuth Admin puts your brand's panel on your phone.

HAND OUT LICENSES
• Give a user a license key for their computer in seconds: subscription, lifetime or trial plans
• Extend, suspend, ban, move to a new device or revoke, with a reason
• Search by key, device ID or Discord, filter by status and plan
• Each license's history, statistics and system report: operating system, processor, memory and graphics

FOLLOW LIVE SESSIONS
• See every running copy of your software in real time
• Send a message that appears in the program, or close it

TRACK YOUR STATISTICS
• Active, expiring and new licenses at a glance
• Usage time and devices online over 7, 30, 90 or 365 days
• Countries and cities your users connect from

RUN YOUR PRODUCTS
• One application per product, each with its own plans, releases, configs and gateway status
• Per-license JSON configs, device blacklist and user roles
• Maintenance mode, Discord notifications and API keys for your website and bots
• See which of your users follow their licenses in the mjAuth app

YOUR TEAM, SAFELY
• Team members with roles and access to only the products they need
• Two-step verification with an authenticator app or email code, optional Face ID lock
• Every change logged with the values before and after
• No ads, no tracking, no third-party analytics

mjAuth works with software brands through an agreement. Your panel account is set up by mjAuth or by your brand owner; there is no sign-up and nothing is sold in the app. Learn more at auth.majdev.cloud.

name: Moment Drill
description:
Moment Drill is a drill for structural mechanics: you draw shear force diagrams (Q diagrams) and bending moment diagrams (M diagrams) with your finger, and the app checks them on the spot. It focuses on the topic many students find hardest in the structures part of the Japanese architect licensing exam.

With a paper workbook it is hard to tell whether the diagram you drew is right. Moment Drill checks your diagram immediately and highlights only the segments that are off, so you learn why the diagram takes its shape instead of memorizing answers.

How each problem works
1. Reactions: look at the beam and its loads and enter the support reactions.
2. Draw: place points at the key positions of the Q and M diagrams, such as load points and supports. Values snap to a grid, and you can draw jumps and curves.
3. Check: the app tells you which segments do not match. Fix them and try again.
4. Explanation: see the rule behind your mistake. Drag the load with your finger and watch the reactions, the Q and M diagrams and the deflected beam change together.

Each problem takes about one to three minutes, so you can practice one at a time during a commute.

Practice mode (6 chapters)
- Chapter 1 Equilibrium: finding reactions, the idea of moments
- Chapter 2 Simple beams with point loads: Q jumps and M bends at each load
- Chapter 3 Cantilevers: a reaction moment appears at the fixed end
- Chapter 4 Distributed loads: Q slopes and M curves; M is largest where Q = 0
- Chapter 5 Overhanging beams and applied moments: segments where M changes sign, jumps in M
- Chapter 6 Statically determinate frames: draw member by member and join them at the corners
Problems are generated with new numbers each time, so you can repeat a stage as often as you like. Every answer is computed with exact fractions and checked for equilibrium.

Daily problem
One problem every day, with a record of your streak. You get one check, so make it count.

Review
Solve the same types of problems whose answers you viewed again, with new numbers. Once you solve them, they are marked as mastered later.

Exam mode
Solve exam-style problems back to back against the clock. Your results are saved.

Earthquake lab
Build a one- to three-story building and shake it. Compare a conventional building with a base-isolated one side by side, and see resonance: the building sways much more when the shaking period matches its natural period.

Notation
M diagrams are drawn on the tension side, as is common in Japanese architecture exams. You can switch to drawing positive moments upward in Settings.

Free features and Full Unlock
Free: Practice chapters 1 and 2, the daily problem and the earthquake lab.
Full Unlock (one-time in-app purchase): Practice chapters 3 to 6 and exam mode.
It is not a subscription and supports Family Sharing. If you have already bought it, use Restore Purchases in Settings. There are no ads.

Privacy
No account is needed. Your progress is stored only on this device and is never sent to the developer. The app contains no advertising or analytics tools.

name: MomenttiKiristin
description: MomenttiKiristin is a torque-tightening calculator for bolt preload, turn angle, thread friction, wrench geometry and audit tolerance. Apply a repeatable torque without snapping the bolt or leaving a loose joint.

name: Money Sweep: Coin Collector
description:
Fill your bag with in-game silver coins and gold bars, then deposit your haul to upgrade your gear. Drag across the floor to guide the collector and find an efficient route through tight passages.

Visit the station on the left to deposit your haul automatically. Pick up the processed coins at the center station, then head to the equipment shop on the right.

Try eight tools and improve movement, reach, capacity, processing, or supply. Explore six areas with different layouts and coin values as you complete the crew's next goal. Your equipment and progress stay on your device.

name: Monthweave
description: ଏହି ଆପ୍ ପରିବାର ଓ ସାଥୀମାନଙ୍କ ମିଶ୍ରିତ ଖର୍ଚ୍ଚ ରେକର୍ଡ କରିଥାଏ। ସmotionାମିଲ୍ଲୀ ଅଂଶ, ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ମାସର ନିଷ୍କଳନ, ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଗତ ପ୍ରଦେୟ ସାରାଂଶ ଓ ଇତିହାସ ସହିତ PDF ରପ୍ତାନି ସମ୍ଭବ। ସମସ୍ତ ତଥ୍ୟ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫୋନରେ ସୁରକ୍ଷିତ ଭାବେ ରହିଥାଏ।

name: Mood Calendar: Daily Tiles
description:
One tap to log your mood. A calendar to see how your month felt.

Choose one of five levels. Log more than once a day, add a short note, or tap yesterday to fill in a missed day. There are no streaks to lose.

Make a monthly card or celebrate 7 or 30 days logged. Cards hide dates by default and never include notes. Export your history as CSV and a full backup whenever you want. No account, ads or analytics.

Try month comparisons, custom palettes and three-month cards for 30 days from first launch. After that, unlock Pro with a one-time purchase. There is no subscription or automatic charge. Core logging, editing, the calendar, basic cards and backups stay free.

name: Morah Kaplan
description:
Morah Kaplan taught fourth-grade girls for nine years. Along the way she wrote songs, painted pictures and made classroom materials, because "the right tune or the right picture has a way of making a Torah idea stay in a child's heart forever."

This app brings her songs to your iPhone and iPad, for the classroom, the car and the kitchen table.

SING ALONG
• The words light up line by line, in time with the music.
• Tap any line and the song jumps straight there, so a class can practice one line again and again.
• A slower practice speed helps little voices learn a new song.

THE RIGHT SONG AT THE RIGHT TIME
• A different song in the spotlight each week.
• Songs for an upcoming Yom Tov appear as it draws near.
• When this week's parsha is in her Parshiyos song, Home shows it and opens the sing-along right at that line.

FOR THE CLASSROOM AND HOME
• Printable song sheets with the words.
• Save songs to your device and play them with no internet.
• New songs and changes from Morah Kaplan's website arrive by themselves.
• Your favorites, and where you stopped, are kept on your device.

SAFE FOR CHILDREN
• No account, no ads and nothing to buy.
• Anything that leaves the app sits behind a quick grown-ups check.
• Nothing about you or your child is collected.

Songs in the app: Aseres Hadibros, Avraham's Family Tree, Gematria Song, Parshiyos of the Torah, Names of Rosh Hashanah, Rosh Hashana Song, The Four Pesukim of Megilas Esther and Abraham Joseph's Shavuos Song.

name: Morph Lite
description:
Morph Lite turns a simple note into a mind-reading reveal.

Type, doodle, or hand your phone over. The screen looks like an ordinary note. Then, on your cue, a field of random letters fills the page, slowly fades away, and leaves only the name your spectator was thinking of, lining up as if it had been typed all along. Or have a drawing sketch itself onto the note, stroke by stroke, as if drawn by an invisible hand.

THE TEXT EFFECT
• Letters fill the note and the hidden name emerges in three phases: the extra letters vanish, the name lines up on the first line, then it can vanish completely.
• Every phase has its own trigger its own delay and its own speed.
• Black-screen mode: the screen goes dark like the phone is off, while the routine keeps running underneath.

THE DRAWING EFFECT
• Save as many drawings as you like and have any of them draw itself on the note.
• Or have the spectator's name handwritten on the note.
• Set the trigger, delay, drawing speed and accuracy, from a perfect copy to a slightly wobbly, hand-drawn look.

WHERE THE NAME COMES FROM
• Type it in secretly during the performance.
• Clipboard.
• Inject and SvenWeb, using your own ID.
• Your own Custom API links, as many as you need, each with its own name.
• Optional: send the name to Glyphs through its Local Portal.

LOOKS LIKE A NOTE
• Three looks: Minimalistic, Retro and Realistic, in light or dark.
• Change the colour of the done button to match.
• A back button that instantly wipes everything.

Morph Lite is a tool for magicians and mentalists Visually reveal your predictions..

name: Morphweft
description: એક સ્રોતથી લખાણ લખો, પછી લાંબા લેખ, ન્યૂઝલેટર, ટૂંકી પોસ્ટ, કેરોસલ, સ્ક્રિપ્ટ, નોટ્સ, કોટ અને શ્રેણી જેવા સ્વરૂપો પસંદ કરો. દરેક માટે ચૅનલ અને નોંધ ટ્રૅક કરો, ટેમ્પલેટ લગાવો, આંકડા જુઓ અને ટેક્સ્ટ તરીકે નિકાસ કરો. તમારો ડેટા આ ફોન પર સંગ્રહાય છે—એપ બંધ કરીને ફરી ખોલો ત્યારે પણ રહે છે. નેટવર્ક વિના કામ કરે છે; ફક્ત «વિશે» કડી બ્રાઉઝરમાં ખૂલે છે.

name: Mosslight Aquarium
description:
Turn your desk or nightstand into a little freshwater aquarium. A neon tetra flashes blue as it turns. Down on the sand, a panda cory noses around a half-buried treasure chest. Look closely at the chest and you’ll see the time and date.

Start free with ten fish across five freshwater species. Drag to turn the tank and watch it from any side. Watch a celestial pearl danio dart between the leaves, a rummy-nose tetra cross the open water, and a striped otocinclus graze on driftwood. Choose flakes or sinking pellets, then tap the water to feed your fish. Double-tap the glass to see which ones scatter. Turn on tilt controls to sway the plants and send light rippling across the sand.

Mosslight opens in landscape the first time, with the aquarium filling the screen. Turn your device upright to see the whole tank. The controls fade as you watch. The aquarium runs offline and saves automatically. Choose Natural, Pixel, or Low graphics to suit your screen.

Mosslight Pro is a one-time purchase. Enjoy larger schools of fish, switch to dusk or moonlight, or explore Spring Run, where the current carries food downstream. Tap a fish to follow it with the camera, see the time and date, and open its species profile. We’ll keep adding more fish and new species. Future habitats and activities are included with Pro, too.

name: MoveReady: Moving Checklist
description:
Make moving day easier to plan. Pick a date to set up a checklist of tasks for before and after the move. Add your own tasks, check off what is done, and see how far along you are. If moving day changes, unfinished tasks tied to it can move with the date while completed tasks keep their history.

The one-time App Store download includes the full app, including plan export. Your plans work offline, and you can make an optional backup through Files.

name: MPP Gantt Viewer & Editor
description:
Open your project schedules on your iPhone or iPad, update them on site and send them back. Everything works offline.

MPP Gantt opens .mpp and XML schedule files and shows them as a clear Gantt chart, with the critical path, progress and baseline at a glance. Change what you need and save it again as .mpp, ready to open on your computer.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Open .mpp and XML schedules from Mail, Files or any app
• Gantt chart by week, month or the whole plan, with pinch to zoom and the critical path highlighted
• Edit tasks: name, duration, start, finish, progress and notes
• Link tasks (finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish) with lag or lead
• Indent and outdent to build the outline, and move or duplicate tasks
• Milestones, constraints, deadlines, priority, task type and manual scheduling
• Resource sheet with work, material and cost resources, their rates and base calendars
• Task and plan costs, calculated from resource rates and fixed costs
• Baseline (and baselines 1 to 10) and S-curve to compare planned and actual progress
• Earned value, variance against the baseline, resource usage by week and a monthly view
• Working calendars: work weeks, shifts and holidays
• Update progress to a status date
• Overallocation alerts for each resource
• Task sheet with sorting, grouping and CSV export
• Export the Gantt chart to PDF and share it
• Search and filters: critical, late, in progress, milestones
• Create a new plan from scratch, or explore the sample plan
• Undo and redo
• Save as .mpp or XML and share it

FREE TO VIEW, PRO TO EDIT
Viewing any plan is free. Editing and saving your own plans is part of Pro: a 3-day or 7-day pass, a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase. You get 3 free saves to try it, and the sample plan can be edited freely.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your files never leave your device. No account, no sign-in, no uploads, no ads. The app only sends anonymous usage statistics and crash reports.

Five styles and three color palettes, light or dark. Available in 19 languages.

MPP Gantt is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. Microsoft Project is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Muver
description:
O Muver reúne num só sítio tudo o que precisa de saber sobre filmes, séries e actores.

DESCUBRA
• Filmes e séries populares, em tendência do dia e da semana, com maior pontuação, em cartaz e a estrear.
• Explore por género, serviço de streaming, país, idioma, produtora ou palavra-chave, com filtros por ano, nota e ordenação.

SAIBA TUDO SOBRE CADA TÍTULO
• Sinopse, pontuação, classificação etária e géneros.
• Trailers e vídeos.
• Onde assistir: streaming, aluguer e compra.
• Temporadas e episódios das séries.
• Elenco e equipa técnica completos.
• Galeria de imagens em ecrã inteiro.
• Críticas, títulos semelhantes e recomendações.

ACTORES
• Biografia, fotografias e toda a filmografia em filmes e séries.

PESQUISA
• Procure filmes, séries, pessoas, colecções e produtoras enquanto escreve.

FEITO PARA SI
• Em português e em inglês.
• Tema claro, escuro ou igual ao do sistema.
• Sem conta e sem registo.

O Muver é um projecto de código aberto.

Este produto usa a API da TMDB, mas não é endossado nem certificado pela TMDB. A informação sobre onde assistir é fornecida pela JustWatch.

name: My Anime Atlas
description:
My Anime Atlas is your personal anime universe — built to track every series and season, map your unique 5D Anime Taste DNA, and help you decide what to watch next.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Personal Library & Season Scoring — Track watching, completed, paused, dropped, and planned anime with per-season ratings, episode progress, and personal notes.
• 5D Anime Taste DNA & Wrapped Recaps — Turn your real watch history into a 5-axis taste radar (Action, Emotion, Complexity, Whimsy, Darkness), Top 5 Podiums, and Seasonal/Yearly Anime Wrapped cards.
• Atlas Arcana Quiz — Draw your collectible anime archetype card and compare synergy with friends.
• Live Airing Calendar & Native Episode Alerts — Follow upcoming episodes in your local timezone, subscribe via .ics calendar feeds, and schedule native iOS & iPadOS Episode-Drop Alerts and Planned-Watch Reminders.
• Friends, Taste Blends & Shared Watch Plans — Connect via Friend Pass QR codes, generate 5D Duo Taste Blends, and organize private watch plans together.
• AI Anime Companions — Chat with distinct anime companions grounded in your high-level taste profile for tailored picks when you are stuck choosing what to watch.
• Instant Native Card Sharing — Export crisp 9:16 and 16:9 Wrapped, Podium, Taste DNA, and Arcana PNG cards straight to Photos or the iOS Share Sheet.
• Seamless Sync & Portability — Sign in with Apple, Google, or email to sync across iPhone, iPad, and web, import your existing anime lists, or export portable JSON backups anytime.

NOTE: My Anime Atlas is a tracking, discovery, and scheduling companion. It does not host or stream video; official streaming links open licensed services.

name: MY SYNDIC : Copropriété
description:
MY SYNDIC, l'application de votre copropriété.

Éditée par SYNDIC TUNISIE PRO, elle relie les résidents et le bureau du syndic, et donne une vue claire sur la vie de la résidence.

POUR LES COPROPRIÉTAIRES
• Suivre vos finances : montant restant à payer, appels de fonds, paiements et reçus.
• Signaler un problème en quelques secondes, avec photos, et suivre son avancement.
• Échanger directement avec le bureau du syndic par messagerie.
• Recevoir une notification dès qu'il y a du nouveau (réponse, message, appel de fonds).
• Retrouver les consignes de paiement de votre résidence.

SIMPLE ET SÉCURISÉ
• Connexion avec les identifiants remis par votre syndic.
• Déverrouillage par Face ID / Touch ID (optionnel).
• Consultation hors ligne des dernières informations.
• Aucune publicité, aucun suivi marketing.

Les gestionnaires et administrateurs retrouvent leur espace complet sur syndic-tunisie.pro.

Un service FE SYNDIC PRO — syndic-tunisie.pro

name: Nakupka
description:
Nákupka je jednoduchý nákupní seznam, který ti umí plnit i ChatGPT.

- Položky přidáš ručně nebo hlasem přes ChatGPT ("přidej na nákup mléko a rohlíky").
- V obchodě položku odškrtneš a po 2 sekundách zmizí. Omylem odškrtnutou vrátíš dalším klepnutím.
- Seřazení podle uliček v obchodě: nastav si pořadí kategorií (předvyplněný Albert) a appka položky zařadí sama.
- Jeden seznam pro celou rodinu – pozvi blízké e-mailem, změny vidí všichni okamžitě.
- Přihlášení přes Apple, propojení s ChatGPT pomocí párovacího kódu, žádná hesla.

Bez reklam a bez sledování. Účet i všechna data můžeš kdykoli smazat přímo v aplikaci.

name: NASwing
description:
NASwing is the dedicated NAS monitor for UGREEN NASync devices running UGOS. See your storage, drive health and system load in one native dashboard—even when you manage more than one NAS.

• See which devices are reachable, how much space is free and when each measurement was last updated.
• Check volumes, storage pools, RAID, drive temperatures and SMART details. Set storage and temperature alerts for each NAS.
• Follow CPU and memory usage, network activity, temperatures and fan speeds where your device reports them.
• Put status, storage, individual volumes, drives, performance or a multi-NAS overview on your Home Screen.
• Browse and search NAS files, preview supported formats, and inspect UGOS processes, services and Docker containers where supported.

NASwing connects directly to your NAS over HTTPS. You can find compatible devices on your local network or enter the address yourself. Features vary by NAS model, firmware and account permissions.

NASwing is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by UGREEN. A compatible NAS and NAS account are required for live data.

name: Neon Pulse Runner
description:
Find the beat. Make the jump. Keep moving.

Neon Pulse Runner is a fast-paced rhythm platformer where every obstacle is a chance to sharpen your timing. Dash through neon worlds, dodge hazards, and learn each sequence one attempt at a time.

• Take on 21 levels, from your first jumps to demanding DEMON challenges.
• Tap to jump, hold for consecutive jumps, flip gravity, and fly through tight passages.
• Collect energy cores, earn stars, and track your best progress.
• Learn the basics with an interactive first-level tutorial.
• Retry quickly and master each run from start to finish.
• Play with original synthesized electronic music and neon visuals.

Neon Pulse Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription. It unlocks checkpoint Practice Mode, DEMON levels, all neon skins, and an ad-free experience. Subscription prices and available offers appear before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple account settings.

The game can be played offline. Purchases, restoring purchases, and ads require an internet connection.

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://github.com/Yonhou/Privacy-Policy/wiki/PRIVACY-POLICY-FOR-NEON-PULSE-RUNNER

name: NFC Max
description:
NFC Max puts everything you need for NFC tags and cards in one app.

READ
• Chip model and manufacturer, serial number (UID), technologies and standard
• Memory size and usage, whether the tag is writable
• All NDEF records: links, text, contacts, Wi-Fi and more
• Works with NTAG, MIFARE Ultralight, DESFire, ICODE and FeliCa

WRITE
• 15 record types: text, link, custom URI, search, social profile, email, contact, phone, SMS, map location, address, Wi-Fi network, Bluetooth, app, custom data
• Several records on one tag in a single tap
• Field checks before writing and message size up front

TOOLS
• Copy a tag, including to several tags in a row
• Erase and format
• Permanent lock with confirmation

No sign-up and no server of our own: tag data stays on your device.
Requires an iPhone with NFC.

name: NIFDTB Academy
description:
NIFDTB Academy is the official app for students of the International Institute of Perfumery, the Institute of Cosmetic Science and NIFDTB Academy, Hosur.

• Your courses in one place – see only the courses you joined, continue where you stopped.
• Video lessons, step-by-step text lessons and e-books, in Tamil and English.
• Short quizzes after lessons – try as many times as you like.
• Ask questions and get answers from the academy team; join the student community.
• Share photos of the perfumes and cosmetics you make, earn points and appear on the top students list.
• Tools for makers: formula calculator, ingredient dictionary, supplier list and your own batch diary.
• Get your e-certificate in the app when you complete a course.
• Hosur classroom students: tomorrow's class, attendance, test marks, fees and receipts.

The app is for enrolled students. Log in with the WhatsApp number or email you used when you joined – we send you a one-time code.

name: Nihon Quiz – Japan Trivia
description:
Nihon Quiz is the great Japan quiz: 5,880 questions across 23 themes and 588 levels, from sushi to samurai, kanji to anime. After every answer, a short explanation teaches you a little more, so you learn as you play.

A JOURNEY THAT LASTS
• 23 themes, from Easy all the way to Legend.
• Up to three stars per level: go for a perfect score.
• 12 ranks to climb, from Tourist to Legend, and 36 trophies to earn.

SEVEN WAYS TO ANSWER
Multiple choice, multiple answers, true or false, ordering, matching, typed answers and estimates. Many questions come with photos: temples, landscapes, dishes, woodblock prints.

A MODE FOR EVERY MOOD
• Daily Challenge: 10 questions from Easy to Legend, and your day streak.
• Time Attack and Survival, to beat your records.
• Random Mix: your themes, your difficulty.
• Review: missed questions come back until you know them.
• Duo: two players on one device, taking turns or face to face on a split screen.

ALL OF JAPAN
• Culture & Society: general knowledge, etiquette, festivals and traditions, religions and myths, traditional arts.
• History & Land: history, geography, the 47 prefectures, nature and wildlife, travel.
• Language & Writing: the Japanese language, hiragana, katakana, 100 essential kanji, vocabulary.
• Pop Culture & Arts: manga and anime, video games, music, cinema, literature.
• Food, Sports & Science: cuisine, sports and martial arts, science and technology.
And every day, a Japanese proverb explained.

SIMPLE AND LOW-KEY
• No account needed, and it plays offline.
• On iPhone and iPad, with dark mode, in English and French.
• Your progress stays on your device.

Free with ads, shown only between games. Videos that unlock a lifeline are always your choice. A one-time purchase removes the ads and makes lifelines available without videos.

name: NLP and LLMs: Tokora
description:
NLP and LLMs: Tokora is a university-level course in natural language processing and language-model foundations that runs entirely on your phone. Learn by doing: every idea starts with a real situation, then a hands-on lab, and only then the equation that describes what you just saw.

Eleven units take you from counting words to a Transformer:
1. Language as data: tokens, n-grams, smoothing and perplexity
2. Tokenisation: byte-pair encoding, vocabulary size, token counts
3. Word embeddings: cosine similarity and vector analogies on a meaning map
4. Neural language models: cross-entropy loss and gradient descent
5. Attention: queries, keys, values and a reading heat map
6. The Transformer: counting weights by width, depth and context
7. Pretraining and fine-tuning: masked and causal objectives
8. Decoding: temperature, top-k, top-p and a seeded die
9. Evaluation: BLEU, brevity penalty and what overlap misses
10. Scaling laws, hallucination, bias and privacy
11. Build a tiny language model: train it, sample from it, judge it on unseen text

What makes it different
- Eleven on-device labs: autocomplete from real counts, a keyboard-style tokeniser, an embedding map, an attention heat map, a dice-and-menu decoder, a Transformer weight counter, a scaling-law fit and a trainable tiny language model.
- Every lab ends with questions computed from what you built, with a worked reason for every answer option.
- Every number in the app comes from the equation shown, and every numeric answer is recomputed by independent code.
- Over 440 practice questions, short sessions, a gentle replay queue for missed questions, and a good-place-to-stop screen. No streak pressure.
- Sources are cited on every unit (university course pages and primary papers) and open in an in-app window that keeps your place.
- Text size A-/A+ from 85% to 200%, screen-reader labels, and colour-independent correct and incorrect cues.
- Works offline. No account. No chat window: the tutor is rule-based and on-device.

Free with ads at natural breaks (never inside a lab or a quiz). Watch a short video to earn credits, or choose the optional monthly ad-free plan ($3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial). Cancel any time in your account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Not expert reviewed: every claim is source-checked against public university course pages, standards and papers, and numbers are computed by code. Not affiliated with any university. Facts about specific AI systems change quickly, so the app dates them.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-tokora.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-tokora.html

Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-tokora.html

name: Nocturnal: Sun & Moon
description:
Nocturnal draws tonight's sky over where you stand.

The moon hangs on a paper wire at its real height and direction, lit on the side that faces the sun. Stars appear as the sky darkens. Below it lies a cut-paper horizon: open sea with moonlight on the water, or rolling hills. Swipe to switch.

FIND THE MOON
Hold up your iPhone and follow the arrow. Haptic ticks quicken as you close in, and a firm tap tells you when you're on it. It uses the compass and motion sensors, not the camera.

GOLDEN HOUR ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
Follow the next golden hour as a Live Activity: a countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, then a bar through golden and blue hour.

ALERTS, COMPUTED ON YOUR IPHONE
Choose an alert 30 minutes before evening golden hour, and one before the full moon rises, with where to look.

EVERY EVENT OF YOUR DAY
• Sunrise and sunset
• Civil, nautical, and astronomical twilight
• Golden hour and blue hour
• Moonrise and moonset
• The moon's phase and how much of it is lit

The sun and moon times are computed on your iPhone and checked against the US Naval Observatory to within a minute, from the equator to the polar night.

Widgets show today's sunset on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no analytics, and no network connections. Your location is read to about a kilometer and never leaves your iPhone.

Reduce Motion holds one still, complete sky that updates every minute.

name: NOD: Nod. Shake. Learn
description:
Know it? Nod it. Not so sure? Shake it.

NOD is a true or false quiz you can play without touching the screen. Put in your AirPods, read the statement and nod for true or shake your head for false. No AirPods? Just tap your answer.

It's quick to learn, fun to play together and made for curious minds of every age, from kids to grandparents.

HOW IT WORKS
Read a statement, decide if it's true or false and answer before the timer runs out. After every answer you get a short explanation, so you learn something new each time, even when you get it wrong.

10 CATEGORIES
General Knowledge, Science, Space, Nature, Human Body, Geography, History, Sports, Entertainment and Technology. Play one, a few or all of them.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
Challenge: you have three lives. How far can you go?
Freeplay: no lives and no pressure. Play until you run out of questions or decide to stop.

YOUR PACE
Adaptive difficulty starts easy and gets harder as you get answers right. Or pick Easy, Medium or Hard yourself.

POINTS AND STREAKS
Harder questions are worth more, quick answers earn a bonus and five correct in a row doubles your points.

BADGES TO COLLECT
Earn badges for streaks, for each category and for special feats. Some badges are secret. Keep playing to find them all.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
Clean design with light and dark themes, sound effects or spoken feedback, and haptics you can turn off.

FREE TO START
Play 15 General Knowledge questions for free. One purchase unlocks the full game with every category and every question, yours to keep. No ads and no subscriptions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
NOD collects no data. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

HEAD GESTURES
Head gestures work with AirPods (3rd generation or later), AirPods Pro, AirPods Max and Beats Fit Pro. You can test your gestures and adjust the sensitivity in Settings. Every other device can play with touch.

Questions or ideas? Write to ivkoroni@gmail.com. We'd love to hear from you.

name: Noriba: Japan Taxi Meter
description:
Noriba is a taxi fare guide for passengers in Japan. Estimate the fare before you ride, then run a GPS meter that counts the way a real Japanese taxi meter does.

- Time and distance combined: time below 10 km/h is charged like on a real meter
- Late-night surcharge (10 pm to 5 am, +20%) applied the meter's way
- Countdown to the next fare step, expressway mode, tolls, pickup fee
- Official fares for 25 areas (Tokyo 23 wards, Yokohama, Osaka, Nagoya, Kyoto, Kobe, Sapporo, Fukuoka, Sendai, Hiroshima and more) with source and effective date
- Area picked from your location, works offline
- Pre-trip estimate from the car route: light, normal and heavy traffic
- Fare on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
- Log what you paid, split by people, monthly total widget

Free: meter, estimates, every area, last 10 rides. Noriba Pro (one-time purchase): unlimited history, CSV export for expenses, 6-month chart and stats. No subscription, no ads.

The amount shown is a guide only. The taxi's own meter decides the fare. Not a legal taxi meter and not affiliated with any transport bureau.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://noriba.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy

name: Notfallsanitäter Eignungstest
description:
Hinweis: Diese App ist kein Angebot einer Rettungsdienstschule, eines Rettungsdienstes oder einer Behörde und steht in keiner Verbindung zu ihnen. Sie dient ausschließlich der privaten Vorbereitung auf den Einstellungstest.

Offizielle Informationen zum Auswahlverfahren findest du bei der Schule oder dem Rettungsdienst, bei dem du dich bewirbst. In der App sind offizielle Seiten verlinkt.

Bereite dich gezielt auf den Eignungstest für die Ausbildung zur Notfallsanitäterin oder zum Notfallsanitäter vor. Die App trainiert typische Aufgabentypen aus Eignungstests – wann und wo du möchtest, ganz ohne Konto.

Trainingsbereiche

Medizin & Rettungsdienst
40 Fragen zu Ausbildung und Beruf, Rettungsdienst-Organisation, Erster Hilfe und Wiederbelebung nach den aktuellen Leitlinien, Anatomie und Physiologie, Vitalwerten, Glasgow Coma Scale und Hygiene – jeweils mit Erklärung. Die App ersetzt keine Ausbildung in Erster Hilfe.

Mathematik
Dreisatz, Prozent & Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen und Zahlenpuzzle.

Sprache
Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien und alphabetische Reihen.

Logik
Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix und Dominosteine.

Allgemeinwissen
Über 100 Fragen aus Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Geografie, Recht und EU – mit Themenfilter.

Gedächtnis
Zahlen merken und Buchstaben merken.

Testsimulation
30 Aufgaben aus allen Bereichen, auch Medizin & Rettungsdienst, mit 30 Minuten Zeitlimit und Auswertung nach Bereichen.

Ausbildung im Überblick (kostenlos)
Ablauf des Auswahlverfahrens, Testinhalte, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu offiziellen Seiten für die Ausbildung zur Notfallsanitäterin oder zum Notfallsanitäter.

So funktioniert die App
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Zu den Aufgaben gibt es Lösungen, bei vielen Aufgabentypen mit Lösungsweg oder Erklärung.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen einer Schule oder eines Rettungsdienstes.

name: NoTyDrive
description: NoTyDrive is a fast and secure cloud storage and file management app. Safely upload, organize, and access your photos, videos, and documents anytime, anywhere. Enjoy smooth media streaming and effortless file sharing with friends.

name: Nourilio
description:
Bottles, nursing, naps, nappies, routines and memories: Nourilio gathers everything that matters in your baby's life.

Log the important moments in a few taps and share the essentials with everyone who looks after your child.

HAND OVER IN ONE TAP
Taking over? See the latest events, the instructions and what comes next, instantly.

SIMPLER NIGHTS
Organise night shifts, log wake-ups and read the night summary in the morning.

A WELL-ORGANISED FAMILY
Create routines, prepare the nanny hand-off and share clear handover sheets.

ALWAYS AT HAND
iPhone widgets, reminders and Siri shortcuts keep the essentials one tap away.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
Nourilio works offline. Your data is saved in your iCloud, for free, so you get it back on a new iPhone. No Nourilio server, no ads, no account.

ONE PURCHASE. FOREVER.
Unlock Premium for a one-time price, no subscription: sharing with your relatives, several children, full history. The relatives you invite have nothing to buy.

Nourilio. Together, every little moment counts.

name: Novo POS
description:
Novo is a fast, simple point-of-sale app built for night-market and event stalls in Malaysia. Take orders, record how each customer paid, and see your day’s takings at a glance, all from one iPhone or iPad.

TAKE ORDERS FAST
• Tap items, pick options such as sugar level or add-ons, and check out in seconds
• Search your menu or browse by category
• Mark an item sold out with one tap
• On iPad, the product grid and cart sit side by side

RECORD EVERY PAYMENT
• Record how the customer paid: cash, QR, e-wallet, card or other, and choose which methods to show
• Cash checkout with quick-tender buttons, change calculation and Malaysian 5-sen rounding
• Novo only records payments. It does not process payments or hold your money.

KEEP SELLING WITHOUT SIGNAL
• Your menu is saved on the device and every order is saved locally first
• Orders sync automatically when you are back online, so a weak signal does not stop the queue

KNOW YOUR NUMBERS
• Today: revenue, number of orders, average order and a breakdown by payment method
• Report: today, week and month, sales by hour, top sellers and gross profit
• Order history with full details, and void an order with a reason

MENU AND STOCK SETUP
• Set up your menu, options and ingredient recipes on novopos.my, and stock is deducted automatically with every sale

name: Number Catcher: Physics
description:
Number Catcher is a physics-based game where numbered particles bounce around an arena and a mouth catches them one by one.

Your goal: define a TARGET sequence of numbers and try to capture as many numbers of that sequence as you can.

Every particle follows real collision and reflection dynamics.

HOW IT WORKS
‚Ä¢ Numbered particles start from fixed positions and speeds and keep colliding with each other and with the walls.
‚Ä¢ The catcher waits at the middle of the bottom edge, jaws open flat. Press Mouth: the jaws close, the catcher spins three turns and sets off with its own steady note until it captures exactly one particle, then returns home.
‚Ä¢ Choose your TARGET by typing it, or tap Set to fill it from the physics of the particles. Target numbers are outlined on the grid.
‚Ä¢ The grid shows which numbers have been captured (yellow) and which are still in play. Numbers that match your TARGET turn pink and burst into stars.
‚Ä¢ Define a TARGET sequence and try to capture as many of its numbers as you can.

FEATURES
‚Ä¢ Adjustable number of particles (N) and number of captures (K)
‚Ä¢ Ten speed levels for the particles and for the catcher
‚Ä¢ Shuffle to stir up the motion
‚Ä¢ Mouth to send the catcher after one particle at a time
‚Ä¢ Arrows on the top and left edges of the grid restrict a whole column or row at once
‚Ä¢ Tap a grid cell to cycle it: restricted (red X, the particle stays out of the arena), pre-selected (yellow, counted as already captured) or normal
‚Ä¢ Both: send the missile and the catcher at once and capture two particles
‚Ä¢ Fire missiles to capture other particles. Catcher captures and missiles count toward the same K captures
‚Ä¢ Rule R (N = 25, K from 10 to 16): the numbers are split into five groups of five, and every group must end up with 2 to 4 selected numbers, with at most one group holding 4
‚Ä¢ Lit buttons show at a glance which of TARGET, Mouth, Fire and R are active
‚Ä¢ Result screen with your best captured sequence, ready to copy
‚Ä¢ Every sound is a note of the blues scale, so collisions and captures play a little improvised tune
‚Ä¢ Dark, clean interface for iPhone, iPad and Mac, adapting to different screen sizes, including foldable layouts

TRY EVERYTHING FIRST
Number Catcher is free to download, and you can adjust the number of particles (N) from 5 to 100 during your first 60 launches of the app. After that, a single one-time purchase keeps custom N unlocked; without it, N stays at 25. No subscriptions, no ads.

Number Catcher is a simulation made for study and entertainment.

description:
Every rider deserves feedback made for them.

OctaneLab analyzes your riding after every session on track and shows you what to work on next — in plain words, at your level.

AFTER EVERY SESSION • Where the time goes: braking, corner speed, the exit — and in which corners. • Your goals for the next session: the one or two things worth the most. • Your line against the Reference, corner by corner, on a map of the track. • The whole lap in 3D: your lap and the Reference, ridden side by side. • Rider score for braking, cornering, throttle and line, followed session after session.

LESSONS THAT SHOW HOW Short lessons from the Academy explain the why behind each goal — braking, corners, gearing, rider position — and appear next to the point in your own analysis they help with.

FOR RIDERS WITH SENSORS With a logger that records the bike's data, OctaneLab reads every channel: findings on suspension, braking, traction control, engine braking and grip, and what to change on the bike — the tracksheet, the crew chief's plan and progress over the event.

STRAIGHT FROM YOUR LAPTIMER Download sessions from a RaceBox Mini S over Bluetooth, right in the paddock. The upload carries on with the phone locked, and the analysis is ready within seconds of the file landing. Logs from other laptimers and data loggers, such as AiM, can be uploaded on octanelab.io.

The Reference lap is a simulation of your class on your track, built from the physics of the bike — never another rider's data. Your logs are yours: they are never shared with other riders, and you can download your own raw files at any time.

Sign in with your OctaneLab account. What you see depends on your account and on what your logger records.

RaceBox and AiM are trademarks of their respective owners. OctaneLab is not affiliated with them.
