name: Omook
description:
Omook은 사람과 AI가 번갈아 돌을 놓는 오목입니다. 나무색 판의 교차점 위에 흑과 백이 한 수씩 두고, 가로·세로·대각선 어느 방향이든 자기 돌이 정확히 다섯 개 이어지면 그 대국이 끝납니다. 앱을 열면 별도의 회원가입 없이 바로 대국을 시작할 수 있습니다. 당신은 언제나 흑이고, 상대는 백입니다. 첫 수는 당신부터입니다.

한 수는 두 번으로 이루어집니다. 먼저 놓고 싶은 빈 교차점을 누르면 그 자리에 아직 확정되지 않은 돌이 나타납니다. 위치가 맞으면 아래의 「착수」를 눌러 그 수를 확정합니다. 다른 곳이 더 나아 보이면 「취소」를 누르고 다시 고릅니다. 이미 돌이 있는 자리에는 겹쳐 놓을 수 없습니다. 수를 확정하면 방금 둔 돌에 표식이 남아, 마지막 수가 어디였는지 바로 알 수 있습니다. 상대 차례에는 「생각 중」이 표시되고, 그 동안에는 착수할 수 없습니다. 응수가 끝나면 다시 흑 차례가 됩니다.

판을 돌리거나 확대하지 않아도 교차점이 손가락에 맞습니다. 한 번 누르면 후보가 보이고, 「착수」로 확정합니다. 옆 칸을 잘못 눌렀다면 「취소」한 뒤 다시 누르면 됩니다. 확정된 돌은 그 자리에서 움직이지 않습니다. 오목은 말을 옮겨 잡는 게임이 아니라, 빈 교차점에 새 돌을 더하는 게임입니다.

승리 조건은 정확히 다섯입니다. 여섯 개 이상 길게 늘어나는 수는 장목이라 승리로 치지 않으며, 그 자리에는 둘 수도 없습니다. 열린 삼이 한 수에 두 방향으로 동시에 생기면 삼삼 금수입니다. 금수인 자리는 판 위에 표시되어, 두기 전에 피할 수 있습니다. 다만 그 수로 정확히 다섯을 만들어 이기는 수는 금수보다 우선합니다. 판이 가득 차도록 어느 쪽도 다섯을 만들지 못하면 무승부입니다. 백도 흑과 같은 기준으로 장목과 삼삼을 두지 않습니다.

줄은 네 방향입니다. 가로로 잇는 수, 세로로 내려가는 수, 오른쪽 아래로 가는 대각선, 왼쪽 아래로 가는 대각선이 서로 만납니다. 한 돌이 두 줄에 동시에 속할 수 있으므로, 막은 것처럼 보여도 다른 방향이 열려 있는 경우가 있습니다. 양쪽이 열린 네 개는 다음 수에 끝나므로 반드시 막아야 합니다. 한쪽만 열린 네 개도 그 열린 끝을 두지 않으면 다음 차례에 위험합니다. 삼은 아직 승리가 아니지만, 상대가 막기 전에 네 개로 자라납니다. 두 개의 삼을 한 수로 동시에 열면 그 자리는 금수이므로, 이기고 싶은 줄과 금수가 되는 줄을 구분해야 합니다.

수가 꼬이는 자리는 대부분 같은 모양입니다. 내 돌이 세 개이고 양쪽이 비어 있으면, 다음 수는 네 개가 되어 상대가 막아야 합니다. 그 네 개의 양쪽이 모두 비어 있으면 한 곳만 막아서는 끝이 나지 않습니다. 그래서 양쪽이 열린 네 개를 만들기 전에, 상대에게 같은 모양이 있는지 먼저 살핍니다. 내가 이기려는 수와 상대가 끝내는 수가 같은 차례에 겹치면 막는 쪽이 우선입니다. 다섯이 되는 내 수가 있으면 그 수를 두고, 없으면 상대의 열린 끝을 막습니다.

금수 표시가 갑자기 늘어나는 때도 있습니다. 돌을 하나 두었을 뿐인데 주변 빈 자리가 삼삼으로 막히는 것은, 그 돌이 두 개의 열린 삼에 동시에 걸렸기 때문입니다. 표시된 자리는 이번 차례에 둘 수 없습니다. 다섯을 만드는 자리만 표시 없이 남아 있으면 그 수가 승리입니다. 여섯 칸이 한 줄로 비어 있어도, 여섯 개를 잇는 수는 장목이라 착수되지 않습니다. 다섯에서 멈추는 끝을 고르십시오.

이 구분이 오목의 중반을 만듭니다. 상대의 열린 끝을 막으면서 내 돌을 같은 방향으로 하나 더 붙이는 수가 가장 효율적입니다. 구석에 붙여 두는 수는 한쪽이 이미 막혀 있어 느리게 자라고, 중앙의 화점 근처에서 시작하는 수는 네 방향으로 뻗을 자리가 남습니다. 판의 작은 점들은 그 방향을 가늠하는 자리입니다. 15줄 판은 수가 빨리 중앙에서 만나고, 19줄 판은 같은 규칙으로 더 넓게 포석할 수 있습니다. 판 크기는 대국이 시작되기 전에 고릅니다. 한 수라도 두고 나면 그 판의 크기는 바뀌지 않습니다.

상대는 두 가지입니다. 기본은 로컬 AI입니다. 다섯이 되는 수를 가장 먼저 보고, 그다음으로 양쪽이 열린 네 개, 막아야 하는 네 개, 삼과 두 개의 모양을 읽어 잇거나 막습니다. 응수가 빨라 한 판을 짧게 두기 좋습니다. 다른 상대는 VLM입니다. 같은 규칙 안에서 수를 고르되, 생각하는 데 시간이 더 걸릴 수 있습니다. 화면 위의 상대 선택을 바꾸면 다음 응수부터 그 방식으로 둡니다. 어느 쪽이든 금수 자리에는 두지 않고, 이길 수 있는 다섯을 우선합니다. 착수되지 않는 자리는 이미 돌이 있거나, 이번 수에 삼삼·장목이 되는 자리입니다.

화면 위에는 지금 몇 수인지, 누구 차례인지가 표시됩니다. 「당신=흑 · 로컬 AI=백」처럼 색과 역할이 함께 나와, 복기 중에도 헷갈리지 않습니다. 아래에는 「새 대국」, 「착수」, 「취소」가 있고, 그 다음 줄에 기보를 보는 버튼이 있습니다. 홈에서는 「대국 시작」으로 이 판에 들어오고, 대국 화면의 아래에는 홈과 대국을 오가는 이동이 있습니다.

「이전」과 「이후」는 이미 둔 수를 한 수씩 되돌리거나 다시 앞으로 보냅니다. 열람 중에는 그 시점의 판과 마지막 수가 다시 그려지고, 상태에는 지금 보는 수가 몇 번째인지 나옵니다. 보고만 있을 때는 새 돌을 확정할 수 없습니다. 「다시 두기」는 맨 마지막 수로 돌아가 이어서 둡니다. 「이어두기」는 지금 보고 있는 수 이후의 기보를 버리고, 그 자리부터 새로 둡니다. 잘못된 응수를 공부할 때, 또는 한 수만 다른 선택을 시험할 때 씁니다. 이후 수를 지우므로, 남기고 싶은 기보라면 마지막까지 본 뒤에 이어 두십시오.

끝난 뒤에는 결과 창에 「흑 승리」, 「백 승리」 또는 「무승부」와 함께 몇 수 만에 끝났는지가 나옵니다. 흑이 다섯을 이으면 당신의 승리고, 백이 다섯을 이으면 상대의 승리입니다. 창 안의 「이전」으로 승리가 나기 직전의 수를 다시 볼 수 있습니다. 그 수에서 「이어두기」를 누르면, 끝나기 전에 다른 선택이 있었는지 같은 판으로 시험해 볼 수 있습니다.

대국은 저장됩니다. 앱을 나갔다가 다시 열면 진행 중이던 판과 기보를 불러옵니다. 끝난 판은 결과와 함께 열리고, 이전·이후로 처음부터 다시 볼 수 있습니다. 새 판을 시작하려면 「새 대국」을 누릅니다. 크기를 바꾸어 새 대국을 시작하면 그 크기와 상대 설정으로 다시 첫 수부터입니다. 저장은 이 기기의 대국을 이어 하기 위한 것이고, 실명이나 별도의 계정을 요구하지 않습니다.

첫 판은 이렇게 두어 보십시오. 15×15와 로컬 AI를 고르고, 중앙 근처의 교차점을 누른 뒤 「착수」를 누릅니다. 백이 응수하면, 내 돌이 두 개 이상 이어질 수 있는 방향을 하나 정합니다. 상대가 그 끝을 막으면 다른 방향으로 한 칸을 더합니다. 네 개가 되기 전에 상대의 열린 줄이 생기면 그 줄을 먼저 막습니다. 삼을 둘 때 금수 표시가 보이면 그 자리는 피하고, 다섯이 되는 자리만 남으면 그 수를 착수합니다. 결과가 나온 뒤에는 「이전」으로 막히기 직전의 수를 찾아 보고, 「이어두기」로 그 수만 바꾸어 다시 두어 봅니다.

같은 오프닝을 두 번 두어 보는 것도 좋습니다. 첫 판에서는 중앙에 두고, 다음 판에서는 화점보다 한 칸 옆에서 시작합니다. 로컬 AI의 응수가 달라지면, 내 첫 수가 어느 방향을 열어 주었는지가 보입니다. 19줄로 바꾸면 같은 첫 수라도 양쪽 끝이 더 멀리 남습니다. 넓은 판에서는 한 줄을 서두르기보다, 상대가 한쪽에 돌을 모으는 동안 반대편에 작은 줄 하나를 더 만들어 두는 편이 낫습니다.

Omook은 긴 설명 없이 한 판을 두면서 익히게 되어 있습니다. 규칙은 단순합니다. 정확히 다섯을 먼저 잇는 쪽이 이깁니다. 어려운 부분은 어느 끝을 막고 어느 끝을 늘릴지, 그리고 삼삼과 장목을 피하면서도 다음 다섯을 준비하는 순서입니다. 로컬 AI와 짧은 판을 여러 번 두고, 막힌 기보를 되돌려 보면 그 순서가 보이기 시작합니다. 서두르지 마십시오. 한 수, 그리고 그 수를 확정하는 「착수」가 다섯 개로 가는 길입니다.

name: On All Fronts
description:
Führe deine Armee an allen Fronten. On All Fronts ist ein Echtzeit-Strategiespiel auf einer echten Landkarte: Du hebst Truppen aus, baust deine Gebiete aus und schickst deine Armeen auf den Marsch – mit realen Marschzeiten von Ort zu Ort.

DREI KARTEN, EIN ZIEL
• Schweiz: 26 Kantone und Liechtenstein, 457 Gebiete. Wer hält am Ende die Schweiz?
• Balkan: 11 Länder von Slowenien bis Griechenland, 286 Gebiete.
• Welt: 170 Länder mit ihren Provinzen, 754 Gebiete.

SCHLAG UNENTDECKT ZU
Deine Truppen greifen bei der Ankunft nicht blind an. Sie schlagen ein Lager vor dem Gebiet auf. Hat dein Gegner keine Aufklärer, bleibst du unentdeckt und schlägst mit Überraschungsbonus zu. Mit Aufklärern kann er sich rechtzeitig verteidigen.

DU ENTSCHEIDEST AN DER FRONT
An der Front wählst du selbst, wie viele Infanteristen, Spezialkräfte, Artillerie und Panzer angreifen und wer in Reserve bleibt. Oder du kämpfst selbst mit: Im Frontgefecht steuerst du einen Soldaten mitten im Geschehen.

ALLEIN ODER GEGEN ECHTE GENERÄLE
Spiel allein gegen Computergegner oder im Mehrspieler live gegen andere Personen. Verhandle per Funk, schliesse Bündnisse oder fordere andere im Live-Duell heraus.

DEIN GENERAL, DEINE ARMEE
Gib deinem General und deiner Armee einen Namen, wähle eine Uniform mit eigenem Vorteil und baue Kaserne, Zeughaus und Fabriken aus.

Das Spiel ist kostenlos. Im Shop kannst du optional Gold und Pässe kaufen. Mit Gold kommst du schneller voran, zum Beispiel mit zusätzlichen Rohstoffen, Einheiten und Beschleunigungen. Pässe gelten 30 Tage und verlängern sich nicht automatisch.

Alle Ereignisse, Kriege und Bündnisse im Spiel sind frei erfunden. Namen von Kantonen, Ländern und Orten dienen nur als Spielkarte.

name: One Life, One Fist
description:
Once, there was a fist that couldn't even tear a sheet of paper.
One Life, One Fist is a vertical pixel-art idle game about a fighter who spends a whole lifetime training a single straight punch.

■ One tap, one punch
Your fist strikes on its own, and every tap makes the next punch come faster. Aim for a Crit to deal big damage, and when your Ki gauge is full, Awaken and smash the target with a flurry of punches.

■ From paper to stone
Paper, logs, bamboo bundles, bluestone, iron ingots, falls rock… Learn new targets, break them and earn taels. Upgrade Power, Tempo, Crit and Reach to punch harder and faster.

■ 16 training places beyond the wall
Leave the Persimmon Yard behind for the Bamboo Grove, the Reed Flats, the Red Canyon, Below the Falls and the Snowy Pass. Every place has its own first-person Trial, where one Perfect strike is all you need.

■ From eighteen to seventy-eight
Your fighter ages while training, and every life has an end. Retire, and your Insight and Journal pass to your Heir, so the next life reaches a step further.

■ One Journal
Fill your Journal with photos from each place, records, achievements, gis and belts. Daily Training is waiting every day.

■ A fist that grows while you're away
Training keeps adding up while you're away (up to 8 hours by default).

■ Ads and purchases
No forced ads and no banner ads. There are only rewarded ads that you choose when you want a reward.
With the Lifetime Pass (one-time purchase), you get the same rewards without ads, up to +4 hours of away rewards, +1 learning slot and an exclusive gi.

■ No account needed
No sign-up or login. Progress is saved only on your device, so keep that in mind before deleting the app or changing devices.

name: One Tile Away
description:
Slide the tiles to bring a picture back together. One Tile Away is a classic sliding puzzle with 20 illustrated pictures, from a sailboat to a butterfly.

Choose a 3 × 3, 4 × 4, or 5 × 5 board. Tap a tile in the gap’s row or column to slide the line, or drag an adjacent tile into the gap. Open the reference picture whenever you like.

Pause and pick up where you left off, or try to beat your own time and move count. When the last tile lands, the seams fade and the finished picture stays in its frame.

Play offline, with no ads, accounts, or in-app purchases.

name: Onfra Stage
description:
Onfra Stage – Your Complete Event Experience Platform
Onfra Stage brings event management, attendee engagement and networking together in one platform. Whether you are attending a conference, exhibition, seminar, workshop or corporate event, Onfra Stage makes every event more connected, organised and engaging.
For Attendees
Make the most of every event with tools designed to enhance your experience.
Connect & Network: Discover and connect with fellow attendees, speakers and industry professionals.
Communicate: Interact with other participants and build meaningful connections.
Explore Exhibitors: Discover exhibitors, explore their offerings and connect with businesses.
Discover Sponsors: Learn about event sponsors and explore their products and services.
Event Information: Access event details, schedules, sessions and important announcements.
Stay Updated: Receive notifications and updates to stay informed throughout the event.
For Event Organisers
Simplify event operations with powerful event management tools.
Registration Management: Manage attendee registrations and participant information.
Smart Check-in: Streamline reception and entry with digital check-in facilities.
Attendee Management: Access and manage participant information efficiently.
Exhibitor Management: Add exhibitors, showcase their profiles and manage exhibitor participation.
Sponsor Management: Feature sponsors, highlight their brands and provide visibility.
Event Communication: Share announcements and important updates with attendees.
Networking: Enable attendees to interact, communicate and build professional relationships.
One Platform. Every Event. Better Connections.
From registration to check-in, from exhibitor showcases to attendee networking, Onfra Stage helps organisers deliver seamless event experiences while giving attendees more opportunities to connect, collaborate and discover.
Download Onfra Stage and make every event more engaging!
Powered by ONFRA.

name: OnPlan: Meal Timer & Tracker
description:
OnPlan keeps a structured eating plan on schedule: something small every 2 to 3 hours, one or two full meals a day, water, and a regular weigh-in. It tells you when the next one is due, lets you log it in a tap, and shows how the weeks add up.

It was built for people following the Trilivy™ program (formerly OPTAVIA®), and works for any plan built on small, frequent meals.

THE CLOCK
• A countdown from the last thing you ate to the next one due. You choose the gap, from 2 to 3 hours.
• Reminders when it is time, with a gentle follow-up if you have not logged. Never after bedtime.
• Skip one, or switch reminders off for the rest of today, without losing your place.
• The same countdown on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island, in widgets and on Apple Watch.

LOGGING
• One tap for "I ate".
• The current product list is built in, with label nutrition, so you can log by name.
• Scan a barcode on a box or a single sachet. If OnPlan does not know it, tell it once and it remembers.
• A Lean & Green builder that follows the program guide's portions.
• Your own foods, favorites, and entries for any earlier time.

PLAN AND PREPARE
• Lay out today or tomorrow in the order you will eat. OnPlan shows what is next and reminds you by name.
• Step-by-step directions from the sachet, with a timer on every timed step.
• Rate each food from 1 to 10 and keep a note, so you remember what to reorder.
• Optional stock count: know how many of each you have left, and what is running low.

PROGRESS
• Weight trend with your goal line and a projected goal date.
• Streaks, days on plan, how well you kept to the 2–3 hour window, water, and when you tend to eat.
• A journal of every day, editable.
• Export everything as a CSV file.

APPLE WATCH
• The clock on your wrist and on your watch face.
• Log a meal or water without taking out your phone.

APPLE HEALTH
OnPlan works with the Health app if you turn it on in Settings. It can save your weight, waist measurement, water and nutrition (calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat) to Health, and read weight from Health so readings from a smart scale appear in your trend.

YOUR DATA
There is no account and nothing to sign up for. Your log stays on your iPhone and Apple Watch and in your own iCloud, so it is backed up and follows you to a new iPhone. Weight and body measurements never leave your iPhone unless you choose to save them to Apple Health. OnPlan has no server, no ads and no tracking.

OnPlan is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Medifast, Inc. Trilivy™, OPTAVIA® and Lean & Green are trademarks of their owner, used here only to describe the program the app helps you follow. OnPlan does not give medical or nutrition advice; follow your program guide, your coach and your healthcare provider.

name: OonaBuilder
description:
Build and publish live websites and apps straight from your iPhone using an AI architect and your own isolated cloud workspace.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with Apple or Google (every new account receives a one-time $10.00 welcome credit to start building right away).
2. Tap Create New Project, describe what you want to build, and optionally attach reference photos or design files.
3. Watch the AI Architect plan your project, write code inside your private Linux cloud sandbox, stream live progress in the Build Console, and publish your website live at your custom subdomain (yourname.tooyn.io).
4. Reopen any project anytime to request changes, rename titles or subdomains with live availability checks, wake your cloud workspace, and manage storage and notifications.

PLANS & IN-APP PURCHASES
• Free Plan: 300 MB isolated workspace storage + pay-as-you-go AI builds and hosting from your account balance.
• OonaBuilder Pro ($4.99/month, auto-renewable): Upgrades your isolated workspace to 1 GB (3.3× Free) and includes $5.00 in monthly account credit.
• One-Time Balance Top-Ups: Optional consumable credit packs ($5, $10, $20, $50) to fund additional AI builds and website hosting.

Subscriptions are billed monthly to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in iOS Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

PRIVACY & DATA CONTROL
• Zero ads and zero third-party tracking SDKs.
• Every user runs inside a private isolated cloud container.
• Tap Settings → Delete Account & Data anytime to permanently erase your account, cloud container, projects, hosted websites, and stored email immediately.

Privacy Policy: https://oonabuilder.oonak.ai/privacy
Terms of Service: https://oonabuilder.oonak.ai/terms
Standard Apple EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: hello@oonak.ai

name: OpenWire: AI News & Research
description:
OpenWire is a daily AI briefing for engineers and AI practitioners. It brings news, research and engineering posts from 26 primary sources into one calm, fast reader — and gives every story a summary, key points and why it matters, so you can catch up in minutes and open the original when it's worth it.

DAILY BRIEFING
• Ten must-reads every day: top news, enterprise AI and one deep-dive 
• Read them all to check in and keep your streak going
• An optional daily reminder at the time you choose

KEY POINTS, NOT CLICKBAIT
• Each story comes with a summary, key points and "why it matters"
• Extracted on your iPhone from the original article — nothing is rewritten or made up
• The original is always one tap away, opened right inside the app

THREE TABS
• News — the AI stories engineers are talking about, filtered by topic
• Tech — engineering blogs, trending papers from Hugging Face and arXiv, and AI repos on GitHub, sorted into Agents, Memory & RAG, AI Coding, Infra, Safety, Open Source and more
• Enterprise AI — real deployments, platforms, governance and deals, by industry

ENGLISH & 中文
• Read in English, Chinese, or side-by-side bilingual
• Translated on device with Apple's Translation framework
• Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and German with Pro

DESIGNED FOR READING
• Amber Dark with Serif White, Classic, Dark and Sepia reading themes — or Signal, a clean white look
• Search across everything, save stories, and pick up where you left off

SOURCES
Anthropic, OpenAI, Hacker News, InfoQ, Google DeepMind, Google Research, Hugging Face, Microsoft Research, arXiv, Hugging Face Papers, GitHub, DEV Community, Simon Willison, Lil'Log, Latent Space, Interconnects, TechCrunch, The Verge, VentureBeat, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and CIO.com. OpenWire is independent and not affiliated with these publishers.

OPENWIRE PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Add your own RSS sources — any blog or company feed
• Keyword alerts — get notified when Claude, MCP, RAG or any topic you follow shows up
• Saved stories kept forever with their full summary, synced via iCloud
• The full archive beyond the last 14 days
• Five more reading languages
• Family Sharing supported

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Stories are fetched and summarized on your device — we don't run servers and never see what you read.

Privacy Policy: https://thevsxtech.github.io/openwire/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Optical Center Ap
description:
Optical Center AP es la app de cobranza para el equipo de Optical Center. Con ella, cada vendedor organiza su día, registra cobros y entrega su corte de caja sin papeles.

INICIO
• Resumen del día: clientes asignados, lo cobrado hoy y pagos pendientes.
• Lista de próximos clientes con su saldo y estado (al corriente o atrasado).

CLIENTES
• Busca por nombre, número de contrato o teléfono.
• Filtra por ciudad y por clientes de hoy, pendientes o todos.
• Consulta lo que resta por pagar, el abono acordado y la frecuencia de pago.

RUTA Y CHECK-INS
• Visualiza tu ruta de cobro del día.
• Registra tus visitas con check-in por ubicación para un mejor seguimiento.

CORTE DE CAJA
• Totales del día por forma de pago: efectivo, transferencia y tarjeta.
• Tarjetas cobradas y no cobradas del día.
• Cierra tu corte con un solo toque.

PERFIL Y SEGURIDAD
• Acceso con tu usuario y contraseña de siempre.
• Cada perfil ve solo las herramientas que le corresponden.

Esta app es de uso exclusivo para el personal autorizado de Optical Center AP. Para obtener acceso, contacta al administrador.

name: Optimization for ML: Gradvale
description:
Optimization for machine learning, taught by simulations you can move.

Every equation in this course is first a real situation. Roll marbles on a bowl and on a mountain range. Send a hiker down a foggy hillside with different strides, momentum and adaptive boots. Ask a handful of villagers for directions. Shop with a budget and discover that the Lagrange multiplier is the price of the budget. Switch weak sensors off with an L1 penalty. Only after you have moved the world does the equation appear, with every symbol tappable so you can see what it is in the picture.

EIGHT TRAILS (about 36 hours in short sessions of 3 to 8 minutes)
1. Reading the slope: gradients, curvature, flat spots
2. Bowl or mountain range: convexity, condition number
3. The hiker's stride: gradient descent and step sizes
4. Asking a few villagers: stochastic gradients, mini-batches, schedules
5. Gear for the hiker: momentum, Nesterov, RMSProp, Adam
6. Shopping with a budget: constraints, Lagrange prices, KKT, penalties
7. Keeping only strong signals: L1, subgradients, proximal steps, lasso
8. Valleys, passes and plateaus: saddles, sharp and flat minima, Newton

WHAT YOU GET
- 16 interactive labs with a flat map and a GPU 3D landscape view
- Every checkpoint is computed from the settings you just chose
- More than 170 unit-check questions, each with a worked reason
- An optimiser bench: plain, heavy-ball, look-ahead and Adam on canyons of growing difficulty
- Build threads: the small program you would write for each trail
- Sources you can open inside the app: textbook sections, courses from CMU and Berkeley, and the original papers (Adam, large-scale optimization methods, saddle points and more)
- Text size from 85% to 200%, screen-reader descriptions of every simulation
- Works offline. No account. Your progress stays on your device.

HONEST NOTES
Written and source-checked by our team; not reviewed by an external expert. Every number and answer is recomputed by separate verifier code. Content as of 2026-11-17.

FREE WITH ADS, OR AD-FREE
Free with ads at natural breaks only (never inside a lab or a question). An optional monthly subscription removes ads: 7-day free trial, then billed monthly. It only removes ads. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-gradvale.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-gradvale.html

Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-gradvale.html

name: Orchestr: Fly-by-Code
description:
The codable, tweakable flight simulator.

Orchestr Saturnia: Flight Sim puts the whole simulator in your hands. Every aircraft is a Orchestr Script you can read and change while it flies: lift and drag tables, engines and thrust, mass and inertia, landing gear, control laws and autopilots. Save, and the change hot-reloads mid-flight.

SATURNIA SCRIPT
A small, readable scripting language (Lua 5.4) with a flight-simulation API. Write forces and moments, aero coefficient tables, fly-by-wire laws, failures, weather, lighting events and your own HUD widgets. Scripts run in a sandbox with a time slice, so a runaway loop can never freeze the simulator. Clear errors with line numbers appear in the built-in editor and console.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE CODING
Describe a change in plain words ("add an engine fire at 2000 ft") and the on-device model writes the script. Every proposal is compiled first and shown as a diff before anything runs. Explain a script or fix an error from the console in one click. Available on devices with Apple Intelligence.

LABS
Design airfoils from NACA codes, a Bezier canvas or imported coordinate files and analyse them with a panel method and boundary layer: lift, drag and moment polars, pressure distribution, transition and stall. Build a wing, pick an engine (piston, turboprop, turbojet, turbofan, electric or rocket), and fly the result in test scenarios: stall entry, crosswind landing, gusts, icing, engine-out climb, STOL and climb challenges, with telemetry plots to compare versions. Results are engineering estimates.

THE WORLD
A real-time Metal renderer streams satellite imagery and elevation for the whole globe. Airports come with runway markings and full approach, runway and taxiway lighting, PAPI that changes colour with your glide path, and rotating beacons. Time of day uses real sun, moon and star positions, with haze, fog by RVR, cloud layers, rain and wet runway reflections.

FOR SIMULATOR BUILDERS (PRO)
Drive Orchestr Saturnia: Flight Sim from your own flight model over CIGI 3.3 and 4.0, X-Plane UDP or JSON. Configure multiple display channels, sync several Macs, connect joysticks, yokes, cockpit panels and motion platforms, and measure transport delay with the built-in test mode. Orchestr Saturnia: Flight Sim is not a qualified training device; qualification remains the operator's responsibility with their authority.

ORCHESTR PRO
Optional subscription (monthly or yearly with a free trial) or one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your account settings.

name: OrderCare – Jewellery Orders
description:
Welcome to OrderCare, the ultimate order management solution designed to streamline your business operations. Whether you are running a jewellery business or any custom order service, OrderCare provides a seamless, dual-role experience to keep everything organized.

Tailored for Both Admins and Clients
OrderCare features a secure login system that adapts to your role. Access your personalized dashboard instantly based on your credentials.

name: Otosashi: Noise Meter & dB
description:
Otosashi measures how loud it is (dB) with your iPhone microphone. It starts measuring as soon as you open it. In a long recording it catches loud moments such as footsteps and doors with the time they happened, and turns them into a report you can show your building manager or landlord.

INSTANT SOUND LEVEL METER
- A-weighting dB(A) and C-weighting dB(C), Fast and Slow
- Max, average (LAeq) and min
- Everyday examples for the current level, such as "a quiet office"
- Octave bands from 63 Hz to 8 kHz show when low sounds dominate

RECORD THROUGH THE NIGHT
- Keeps measuring with the screen locked
- Current level and event count on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
- Loud moments above the background are saved as events (automatic or fixed threshold)
- Short sound clips around each event to listen to later (Pro)

REVIEW YOUR RECORDS
- Noise calendar: weekday by hour, see when it gets loud
- LAeq, LAFmax, L5, L50, L90 and the event list
- Move the threshold and events are counted again
- Compare day and night levels with Japan's environmental quality standard for noise
- Share an image with date and time, PDF report, CSV (Pro)

CALIBRATION
Match a sound level meter or the Apple Watch Noise app with a plus or minus offset.

PRICING
Measuring, recordings up to 30 minutes and every saved record are free, plus 3 trial long recordings. Otosashi Pro (one-time purchase) adds recordings up to 12 hours, event clips and PDF and CSV reports. Not a subscription. No ads.

PRIVACY
No account. Sound and levels stay on this iPhone and are never sent anywhere.

NOTE
A simple reference measurement, not a certified sound level meter. The environmental standard is for outdoor noise; indoor values are for reference.

Privacy Policy: https://otosashi.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy

name: oTraveler: Visited Countries
description:
oTraveler turns your trips into a passport.

Mark the countries you have visited and watch your world map fill with green. Add the places you dream about to Want to go and they turn yellow. One tap on a country, and it's yours.

YOUR PASSPORT
• A passport card with your count, your next milestone (10 → 25 → 50 → 100 → the whole world) and the map of your trips
• Choose the list: 193 UN members or 197 (UN + Vatican, Palestine, Taiwan, Kosovo)
• Share your passport as a picture ready for Stories

COLLECT STAMPS
• 30 stamps in three levels: Starter, Traveler and Legend
• Island nation, Land of fjords, Tropical Asia, All continents and more

DISCOVER EVERY COUNTRY
• A photo, a short story and key facts for all 197 countries
• Capital, population, language, currency, area, GDP, UNESCO sites

PLANS

PRIVATE AND FREE

• Your travels stay on your device

Available in English, Ukrainian, Portuguese, Spanish, French and German.

name: Ovaleaf: Vegan PCOS Tracker
description:
Ovaleaf is a calm, plant-powered companion for life with PCOS. Track your cycle, symptoms, habits and weight in one place, and eat well with 100% vegan meal plans built around fibre and plant protein.

TRACK YOUR CYCLE, EVEN WHEN IT'S IRREGULAR
• See your cycle day, phase and an estimated next period on a living cycle ring
• Calendar with logged and estimated periods and an estimated fertile window
• Estimates learn from your own history, including long or irregular cycles

LOG YOUR DAY IN SECONDS
• Period flow, PCOS symptoms (acne, unwanted hair, hair thinning, bloating, cravings, fatigue, brain fog and more) with intensity
• Mood, energy, sleep, movement, water and your own supplement checklist
• Optional weight tracking in kg or lb, plus a private note

100% VEGAN MEAL PLANS FOR PCOS
• Four weekly plans: Steady Energy, Plant Protein, Cosy & Calm and a 15-Minute Week
• Breakfast, lunch, dinner and a snack every day, with protein and fibre totals
• Every recipe is free from meat, fish, eggs, dairy and honey
• Auto-generated grocery list for the week

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
• Top symptoms over the last 30 days
• Symptoms by cycle phase, so you can see what shows up when
• Weight trend, habit averages and how sleep lines up with your energy

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your health logs stay on your phone. No account, no sign-up. We only collect anonymous app usage events to improve Ovaleaf.

OVALEAF PRO
Cycle, symptom, habit and weight tracking are free. Ovaleaf Pro unlocks every meal plan, the full recipe library, grocery lists and advanced insights. Start with a 1-week free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage them in your App Store settings.

Terms: https://jainishah-apps.pages.dev/ovaleaf/terms
Privacy: https://jainishah-apps.pages.dev/ovaleaf/privacy

Ovaleaf is for general wellness and self-tracking. It does not diagnose, treat or prevent any condition, and cycle estimates must not be used as contraception. Talk to a qualified health professional about PCOS, medication and supplements.

name: Overphoria: Ragdoll Combat
description:
Every punch is physics.

Overphoria is a brawler where every fighter is an active ragdoll. There are no canned hit animations. Hits land where they land, people trip over the furniture, and nobody goes down the same way twice.

GAUNTLET
Fight through the city one room at a time: alleys, streets, a restaurant, an office tower, the rooftops. Open a door, step in, and it locks behind you until everyone inside is knocked out. Each room is a bit harder than the last, and every stage ends with a boss in a helmet and armor, holding the best weapon around. The run never ends. It just keeps getting worse until you give up.

Between stages a merchant sells weapons, armor, helmets, vitamins and cheeseburgers for the cash you earn fighting. Your run, cash and gear are saved, so you can stop and pick it up later.

HORDE
Endless waves in a walled arena. Wave 1 is one guy. It does not stay that way.

SANDBOX
A playground with stairs, ramps, a balance beam, a rack of weapons and three sparring dummies who are peaceful until you hit them.

ONLINE CO-OP
Up to 4 players in any mode. Host a game, send your friends the join code and clear rooms together.

THE FIGHTING
• Jabs, crosses, push kicks and roundhouses, aimed at the head, chest or legs
• Block, lock on and circle your target
• Over 25 melee weapons: katana, baseball bat, crowbar, fire axe, sledgehammer. Also a wok, a keyboard and a stop sign
• Pistols, uzis and shotguns. Dual wield them. They can't be reloaded, so an empty gun is a club
• Double tap jump to dive and shoot on the way down
• Holster a weapon for later, or throw it at someone
• Enemies that circle, take turns, block, back off and grab weapons
• Slow motion knockouts

CONTROLS
Touch controls made for phones and tablets. Drag every button where you want it in the layout editor, and set the look sensitivity to taste.

All three modes are included. Tokens are an optional purchase: use them to get back up where you fell, pick any item at the merchant, or top up your cash.

name: OwlEbooks: Learn Korean
description:
Learn Korean by reading stories. Open a Korean classic or add your own reading material. Tap a Korean word for its English meaning, save it, and see it highlighted when you meet it again.

• Start with 20 Korean classics in the original Hangul, including Kim Yu-jeong’s Camellias. The built-in library has 40 classics in all, including 20 English originals such as Alice’s Adventures in Wonderland and Pride and Prejudice. Look up words in either direction, Korean to English or English to Korean.

• Bring your own books. Add a folder or choose a file from Files. Read your Korean TXT stories, study notes, image folders, or CBZ and ZIP comics. Adjust type, spacing, and colors, search the text, and pick up where you left off.

• Build Korean vocabulary as you read. Save words and definitions, find them in your list, and see saved words highlighted in the book. Use Definition Quiz to choose the right meaning or Match Cards to pair words with definitions.

• Practice listening at your own pace. Hear your saved words and definitions read aloud. Set how many times each entry is spoken and how many times the whole list repeats.

• See how Korean works in a sentence. On supported devices with iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and Apple Intelligence enabled, ask for an English translation of a Korean sentence and an explanation of how a word is used. When Apple Intelligence is unavailable, Apple Translate provides word lookup. You may need to download English and Korean the first time.

No account required. All reading and study features are free. An optional in-app tip supports the developer.

name: PaceCanvas: Run & Walk Art
description:
**PaceCanvas — Move Together. Create Together.**

Every step tells a story. Turn your walks and runs into beautiful artwork, connect with friends in real time, and make every journey worth sharing.

PaceCanvas combines GPS activity tracking, creative route art, and social walking and running in one unique experience. Whether you're enjoying a peaceful solo walk, going for a morning run, or exploring with friends, your movement becomes something beautiful.

**WALK & RUN — YOUR WAY**
- Track your walks and runs with GPS.
- See your distance, duration, average pace, and speed.
- Watch your route transform into artwork as you move.
- Pause, resume, and review your activities.
- Explore your activity history and progress.

**MOVE TOGETHER — GROUP WALK & RUN**
- Create or join group walking and running sessions.
- Watch friends' routes develop live, wherever they are.
- See individual routes come together as shared artwork.
- Chat, send emojis, and encourage each other.
- Share invitations through messages, links, or room codes.
- Friends can watch or participate through a web browser without installing the app.

**PLAN AHEAD — SCHEDULE GROUP ACTIVITIES**
- Schedule walks and runs with friends.
- Invite participants and track their responses.
- Receive reminders before activities begin.
- Add scheduled sessions to your calendar.
- Organize casual walks, group runs, and social activities.

**TURN YOUR ROUTES INTO ART**
Choose from six creative styles:
- Flow — colourful, flowing ribbons.
- Neon — glowing, energetic lines.
- Ink — expressive ink-inspired artwork.
- Threads — layered, colourful strands.
- Glow — sparkling light trails.
- Pencil — elegant hand-drawn lines.

Make your routes as unique as your journey.

**CREATE, SAVE & SHARE**
- Turn routes into beautiful images.
- Create animated route replay videos.
- Choose different layouts and backgrounds.
- Add activity details to your creations.
- Save your artwork or share it on social media.
- Control the visibility of your route's starting and ending points.

**TRACK YOUR PROGRESS**
- View weekly, monthly, and all-time activity summaries.
- Browse your walking and running history.
- Review distance, duration, pace, and activity details.
- See your journeys come together in colourful route artwork.

**DESIGNED FOR EVERYONE**

You don't need to be a serious runner or a fitness expert. PaceCanvas is for anyone who loves moving, creating, and connecting.

Walk alone. Run with friends. Plan a group activity. Create something beautiful.

**Your Pace. Your Art.**
**Move Together. Create Together.**

Download PaceCanvas and start turning everyday movement into memorable art.

name: PAI by Signalytix
description:
Performance Athlete Intelligence, powered by Signalytix.

Build your athlete profile with evidence.

PAI by Signalytix helps existing members prepare performance tests, preserve original videos, and connect their work to a review process. Explore testing instructions, record or import private video drafts, and upload evidence through your Signalytix account.

• Prepare with clear testing steps, equipment guidance, and safety information.
• Keep original video drafts privately on your iPhone.

Human review determines verified measurements. AI observations do not verify a result or make recruiting decisions. Uploading a video does not request human review or grant AI consent. name: Pallet Studio Pro
description:
Pallet Studio Pro works out the best way to arrange boxes on a pallet and gives you a pallet pattern ready for production or the warehouse. It is built for the phone, to use even standing in front of the pallet, in three steps.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter the length, width, height and weight of the box.
2. Pick the pallet: Euro EPAL, Industrial, CHEP UK, CHEP US or custom. Set maximum height, payload, overhang, gap and layer pads.
3. Compare the patterns: ten packing algorithms propose the possible layouts, ranked by number of cases; at equal count, interlocked layers come first, because they hold the load better.

Every pattern can be viewed in isometric 3D, from above layer by layer and in elevation, with cases per layer, number of layers, total cases, weight, height and pallet coverage.

FREE
• Calculation in box mode, with standard and custom pallets
• Tolerances, load limits and layer pads
• The best pattern, with 3D stack, top view and elevations
• Metric and imperial units

PRO UNLOCK
A single in-app purchase, no subscription, unlocks:
• Every proposed pattern, not just the first
• Bundles of cartons, bottles and jars, in a grid or staggered, with shrink film
• Manual layer editor: move, rotate, add or remove a case, with “Compact”, “Optimise”, undo and redo
• Load analysis: stability, centre of gravity and compression check for corrugated board (BCT/ECT) or for the load rating of bottles and jars
• Vector PDF report, with your company letterhead and logo
• Pattern archive, printable spec sheet with QR code, export and import
• Libraries of boxes, bundles and pallets

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• On iPad, two-column pages and keyboard shortcuts
• Archive and presets synced through iCloud across your devices
• Light and dark theme, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver
• Full manual inside the app, with figures drawn by the calculation engine
• In English, Italian, French, Spanish and German

PRIVACY
No account, no analytics, no ads. The calculation runs on your device and works offline. Your data stays on your device and in your own private iCloud space.

name: Pan AI: AI Cooking Assistant
description:
Cook something you're proud of tonight. Pan AI is an AI cooking assistant that watches your pan through your phone camera and guides you through every recipe, step by step, out loud. It's like having a personal chef and kitchen helper next to you at the stove. Just learning how to cook? Pan's got you. Already love cooking? Pan helps you level up.

Prop your phone up, point the camera at the stove and say hi. Pan says it first: "Hey! What are we cooking today?" From there, it's like cooking next to a friend who knows their way around a kitchen.

WHAT PAN DOES
• Hands-free cooking with a voice cooking guide. No scrolling a recipe app with messy fingers. Just talk, and interrupt any time.
• Meal ideas from your fridge. Point the camera at your fridge or counter and Pan suggests an easy meal you can cook with what you already have.
• Tells you exactly when to flip, stir or plate. Pan watches the color, the bubbles and the steam, so you know the moment it's ready. It's like a cooking timer that can actually see your food.
• Perfect steak, your way. Pan watches the sear and helps you judge steak doneness, from rare to well done.
• Speaks up when something needs you. Too hot, about to bubble over, ready to flip: Pan lets you know right when it matters.
• Cook mode keeps your screen awake while you cook, so Pan is always there.
• Cheers you on, every dish. Golden crust? Perfect egg? Pan notices, and so will you.

MADE FOR
• Cooking for beginners: anyone who wants to learn to cook, one dish at a time
• Busy parents with full hands
• People who want healthy home cooking and quick dinners instead of takeout
• Curious cooks who want step by step cooking help to get even better
• Anyone who'd like some company in the kitchen

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Pan AI and allow camera and microphone.
2. Point your phone at your pan, pot or fridge.
3. Cook together. Your cooking assistant watches, listens and talks back in a warm, natural voice.

FREE AND PRO
Your first full dish with Pan is on us: every feature, start to finish.
After that, Pan Free is yours every day:
• 3 quick questions to Pan
• 1 fridge idea
• Heat and safety alerts, always on

Pan AI Pro adds live cooking together. Pan watches your pan the whole way and speaks up on its own: when to flip, stir or plate.
• Weekly: $4.99 per week
• Yearly: $29.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
Prices may vary by country and are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel any time in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

PRIVACY
We never store video, audio or photos of your kitchen. Camera frames and your words are sent to our AI provider only to answer you, and are never used to train AI models. No account is needed.
Privacy Policy: https://panai.app/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://panai.app/terms/
Questions or ideas: support@panai.app

Pan AI can make mistakes. Always use your own judgment with heat, knives and food safety.

name: Pancake Dragon: Stack Tower
description:
A sleepy baby dragon lives above the clouds, and it LOVES pancakes.

Toss pancakes from your pan, stack them into a wobbly tower and climb higher and higher. The closer you get, the more the dragon wakes up... until it swoops down for a big CHOMP!

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap to toss a pancake
- Land it in the middle for a PERFECT drop
- Three perfects in a row straighten your tower
- Lean too far and the whole thing comes crashing down!

FEATURES
- One-tap play: easy to learn, hard to put down
- A cute dragon that reacts as your tower grows
- Climb from a cozy kitchen to the sky, sunset, night and outer space
- Fireworks, confetti and golden pancakes
- Unlock pancakes: chocolate, strawberry, blueberry, matcha and rainbow
- Dress up your dragon: party hat, chef hat, sunglasses, wizard hat and crown
- Short rounds, perfect for a quick break
- Plays offline

Free to play with optional ads. A one-time purchase removes all interruption ads.

name: ParleNote — voice notes
description:
ParleNote turns your meetings, classes and conferences into clear notes.

Put your phone in the middle of the table or in the front row: its long-range capture brings distant voices closer and removes room noise. The transcript appears live, then ParleNote separates the speakers and you name them (“Speaker A” becomes “Mrs Mbuyi”), with each person’s speaking time.

In one tap, the assistant formats the note, summarises it (key points, decisions, who does what), fixes the spelling or translates it (English, French, Portuguese, Swahili, Lingala…). Export to PDF, Markdown, subtitles or audio.

• Up to 3 hours of recording, pause and “key moment” markers
• Meeting room and lecture hall profiles, microphone choice
• Transcription in 17 languages and variants, including Nigerian and Kenyan English and African French
• App available in English, French, Spanish and Portuguese
• Notes and audio kept on your phone, usable offline
• Free to start

Respect privacy: always tell people they are being recorded.

https://parlenote.app

name: PassCase: Parola Kasası
description:
PassCase, kendi sunucunuzda barındırılan parola kasasının iPhone ve iPad uygulamasıdır. Parolalarınız üçüncü taraf bir bulutta değil, PassCase sunucusunda ve orada bile yalnızca şifreli hâlde durur.

UÇTAN UCA ŞİFRELEME
• Parolalar ve notlar cihazınızda AES-256-GCM ile şifrelenir; anahtar ana parolanızdan PBKDF2-SHA256 (100.000 tur) ile türetilir.

• Web arayüzü ve Firefox eklentisiyle aynı şifreleme biçimi: tüm cihazlarınızda aynı kasa.

HIZLI VE GÜVENLİ ERİŞİM
• Face ID / Touch ID ile hızlı kilit açma (isteğe bağlı).
• Arka plana geçince otomatik kilit.

KULLANIŞLI
• Türkçe karakter duyarlı arama, favoriler, kategori ve klasör süzgeçleri.
• Kayıt ekleme, düzenleme ve silme; başka cihazdaki değişiklikler algılanır.
• Güçlü parola üreteci.
• İki adımlı doğrulama (TOTP) ve kurtarma kodu ile giriş.

GEREKSİNİM
PassCase'i kullanmak için bir PassCase sunucusu hesabı gerekir; hesaplar sunucu yöneticisi tarafından açılır.

Destek: passwordcase@balkay.net

name: Patch Panic
description:
Two new starters, two PCs and one little switch still in its box. Get them talking.

Patch Panic is a puzzle game about building small office networks. Every job is a work order from somebody in the office. Drag the parts onto your desk, run the cables, open each box and set it up, then press Test and watch the packets travel. If one gets stuck, the game tells you where and why.

THE JOBS
• 29 work orders that start with a single cable and build up one idea at a time
• Switches, VLANs and trunks
• Routers, gateways, static and dynamic routes
• Getting the office on the internet, sharing one address, port forwarding
• Handing out addresses automatically, and names instead of numbers
• Wi-Fi access points, passwords, channels and range
• Firewall rules, port security, spare paths and bundled links

description:
PAX Karaoke TV turns your iPad or iPhone into the karaoke player for the party. Everyone picks songs from their own phone with the free PAX Karaoke Remote app, all songs go into one shared queue, and the player calls each singer up in turn.

name: Peace Be Still
description:
A great calm, every night.
Peace Be Still is one quiet place for the end of the day and the start of the next: whispered sessions to fall asleep to, a word for the morning, and someone to talk things through with.
Choose your way in: God's Word, or mindset & imagination. Each one is its own space, and you can switch any time in Settings.

Your first sleep night, then one a week. A word for each morning. Basic 7-day plans, saved verses, a journal, a streak that never scolds, and cards to share.

Unlimited Bible chat, kept private. Your private chats are never used to train AI. Private for up to 50 messages a day. After that you can choose free chat, which isn't private; we always ask first.

name: PerkPlate: Fast Food Deals
description:
Hungry, and wondering which restaurant has a deal today? The offers are spread across a dozen apps, each with its own sign-in, loading screen and location prompt.

PerkPlate puts the in-app offers from restaurant chains into one list for your region, so you can see what each chain is offering, choose, and jump straight into that chain's app to order.

• No account. Open the app and you're looking at deals. No sign-up, no password, no email.

• Straight to the restaurant's app. One tap opens the chain's own app, where you redeem and order. A short guide says where each app keeps its offers.
• Save your go-to spots. Bookmark restaurants to see only their deals.
• Share a deal from a screenshot. Saw an offer PerkPlate doesn't list? Choose a screenshot of it and PerkPlate reads the offer on your phone, so you can check it and share it with everyone in your region.

Covers the big burger, chicken, pizza and coffee chains across Canada and the United States, checked every day.

Deals can end early or differ by store and account, so check the restaurant's app before you order.

name: Perlotti: Family Chores
description:
Share the chores without the fights. No more “Did you already …?”

Perlotti is the chore app for the whole family. Everyone shares the chores on one board. Each finished chore adds beads to the family bracelet, and when it’s full, you get the reward you picked together. Pizza night, for example.

And sometimes a house elf does the work. Whoever does a chore for someone else in secret becomes the family’s elf. The other person only sees that an elf was here, not who.

NO COMPETITION
There are no leaderboards and no comparing. All beads go on the same bracelet. Helping is rewarded, not winning.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pin the chores: ready-made ones like dishes, laundry or walking the dog, or your own. Repeating chores take turns all by themselves.
• Take over: do someone else’s chore and get half its beads on top.
• Do it together: one extra bead.
• Ask for help with one tap, and hearts instead of comments.

FOR THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD
• One shared shopping list that suggests things you bought before. The family gets a nudge when someone is at the store.
• Bin calendar: “Put the bins out” shows up on the board the evening before.
• Sick day and vacation mode: chores politely ask for help or pause.
• Family meeting to share out the week.

FOR EVERYONE IN THE FAMILY
• Kids without a device of their own get a child profile. On a shared iPad, the app asks who is using it.

• Widgets, Apple Watch app with complications, Siri, Shortcuts and NFC tags.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no password, no ads, no tracking. Perlotti uses the iCloud you already have. There is no server of our own.

PRICING
Perlotti is free for 14 days, no payment details needed. After that, one subscription covers the whole family:

name: Pest Quote: Estimates & Bids
description:
You lose jobs when the quote shows up tomorrow.
Typing prices into a generic invoice app on a customer's driveway is slow and looks it.
And you can't tell which quotes you're winning or what they're worth.

Pest Quote builds a clean, branded quote in about two minutes and sends it before you leave.

name: Pet Park Patrol
description:
The Grime Gang has invaded the park! Muddy slimes, sneaky rats, buzzing bugs and a whole crew of silly monsters are coming in waves, and only the bravest little pets can stop them.

MOVE, DODGE, LEVEL UP
Slide your finger to move: your pet attacks all by itself. Collect treats to level up and choose a card each time. Will you take more bones, a faster bark or a brand new weapon?

RARE AND LEGENDARY CARDS
Every level up is a surprise: common, rare, super rare and LEGENDARY cards. Legendaries heal you completely and give an amazing power, like a Mega Woof that hits every monster around you or a giant pet that knocks everything over.

10 VILLAINS (AND THEY COME BACK STRONGER)
Each wave has a mission: defeat the monsters, survive a tougher second phase... then the villain shows up! Face the Grime Queen, the Rat King, Baron Toad, the Mega Vac and more. Beat all 10 and they return even stronger. How far can you go?

RESCUE YOUR FRIENDS
Lost pets are trapped in cages around the park. Free them and they join your team, following you and fighting by your side.

MANY PETS TO PLAY
Start with Biscuit the pup and unlock Mochi the cat, Clover the bunny and Ember the fox, each with their own attack. Premium pets Frost the wolf and Bao the panda bring exclusive powers.

GET STRONGER
Spend your coins on permanent upgrades: power, health, speed, armor, magnet and luck. The higher waves are tough: you will need upgrades and good dodging!

- Simple one-finger controls
- Cute pets and hand-made cartoon art
- 12 monsters and 10 boss villains
- English and Portuguese

Pet Park Patrol is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases (No Ads, coins and premium pets).

name: Pet Wrapped – Dog & Cat Recap
description:
Your pet had a big year. Now see it, wrapped.

Pet Wrapped looks through this year's photos on your iPhone, finds your dog or cat, and turns their year into story slides made for sharing:

• How many photos you took of them (and what % of your camera roll that is)
• Their busiest month and prime-time hour
• The most photographed day and their longest streak
• Every place they went
• How many photos you took together
• Their top 5 shots of the year

• Their personality type: Midnight Menace? Jet-Setter? Velcro Buddy?

More than one pet? Pick a few photos of each one and Pet Wrapped counts only that pet, so everyone gets their own recap.

100% private: everything happens on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded, and we collect no data.

The first slides are free. Unlock the full recap with a one-time purchase. No subscription, no ads, and it's shared with your family.

name: Photo Gallery by UZYTAK
description:
Photo Gallery by UZYTAK is a fast gallery for your photos and videos that also gives you your storage back. No ads, no account, nothing uploaded — your photos stay on your iPhone or iPad.

FREE UP SPACE

• exact copies of the same photo — one copy always stays
• look-alike series — the sharpest shot of each series stays

A CALM, PREMIUM GALLERY
• timeline by day, albums, videos, favourites

• free photo editor: crop, straighten, light and colour, filters, text

• your signature or logo on photos

• albums by year and month
• private folder under PIN and Face ID
• editor extras: curves, healing brush, premium filters

Pro is one in-app purchase, yours forever — no subscription, no ads. Want to try first? Start the free 7-day trial inside the app: nothing is charged automatically, and after 7 days the Pro tools simply lock again. Viewing photos and videos and the space check stay free.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your device. The app needs no account and sends no photos anywhere. The map loads only map pictures from OpenStreetMap.

21 languages. Questions and wishes: support@uzytak.com — we fix bugs fast and add new features.

name: PIGEON+ Pedigree & Loft Book
description:
PIGEON+ is a loft book for racing pigeon fanciers. Pigeons, pedigrees, pairs, eggs and races in one place, even without internet.

Pedigree from a photo
Take a photo of a paper pedigree or load a PDF. AI reads the ring numbers, names and notes, and the app adds the ancestors to your loft. You check and correct the result before saving.

What is in the app:
- Home screen for every day: next race, 7-day weather for your loft, today's tasks.
- Pigeon list and a card for every bird: ring, sex, colour, eye, line, photos, notes, offspring and results.
- Pedigree as a family tree with colour-coded ancestors. Print on A4 or save as PDF, PNG or JPG. You can print the pedigree in another language.
- Lofts split into cocks and hens, with breeding cells.
- Pairs, eggs, hatchings and young birds, linked to the pigeon card.
- Races, training tosses and results. Best pigeons of the season.

- Loft and race statistics.
- AI chat about your loft. It can suggest a change to your data, but saves it only after you confirm.

- Breeders: rankings and a breeder profile, only if you turn it on.
- Data backup to a file, CSV export, automatic backups before bigger changes.
- Light and dark theme, high contrast mode, larger text, 21 languages.

No account needed
You can use the app without an account. Sign in with Apple or Google and your loft data is saved in the cloud. You will see it on a second phone and in the browser, and nothing is lost when you change phones. Pedigree scanning and the AI chat require sign-in.

Privacy
- Without signing in, your data stays on your phone.
- After signing in, your loft data is stored on our server in the European Union.

- Weather: with your permission the app reads your location to show the forecast for your loft.
- No ads and no tracking. We do not sell data.

name: Pingerer
description:
Pingerer watches your website, its security certificate, domain renewal, DNS and email setup, day and night. When something breaks, you hear about it on your phone in plain words, with what usually fixes it, before your customers notice.

This app is for Pingerer accounts. Sign in with your email, Apple or Google, or create a free account at pingerer.com.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See at a glance whether every site is fine, with a calm daily briefing
• Get an alert the moment a site goes down, and acknowledge or snooze it right from the notification
• Read what Pingerer thinks happened: what changed on the site the day before, and the one thing to do next
• See what's worth doing: email settings that are missing, alerts that reach nobody, sites getting slower
• Pause a site while you work on it, with Undo
• Post an update to your status page, and show its QR code at the counter
• Check that your backups and scheduled jobs ran
• Manage alert channels, quiet hours, on call, your team and client workspaces
• Keep an eye on things from the home-screen widget

MADE FOR SMALL BUSINESSES
No technical words needed. Every alert says what broke, since when, and whether your hosting company is having a bad day too. Developers and agencies get plenty underneath: keyword, ping and port checks, heartbeats, multi-step checks and a timing breakdown of every visit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking and no analytics in the app.

Pingerer is made by Synergia Solutions, a Canadian company. In English, German, French and Spanish.

name: Pinwheel Music Box

name: Pipes: Connect Logic Puzzle
description:
Turn the tiles until every pipe joins one network and water from the source reaches every tile.

Pipes is a classic logic puzzle. Every tile holds a piece of pipe: a dead end, a straight, a corner or a T. Tap a tile to turn it. When no pipe end is left open and there is no closed loop, the water flows through the whole board. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

A JOURNEY ACROSS 12 DISTRICTS
• 360 levels, from a quiet 5 × 5 spring to a 15 × 15 ocean
• Four Wrap districts, where pipes leaving one edge come back on the other
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each district unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone (Wrap at weekends), with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 5 × 5 to 20 × 20, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), classic or Wrap, endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a website

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Tap to turn, long-press (or Lock mode) to lock a tile you are sure of
• Water lights up every pipe joined to the source; closed loops turn red, sealed groups orange
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong tiles in the water flow; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: eight techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: PixelCorgi: Lick the Pixels
description:
Meet the hungriest pack in pixel land!

Every corgi loves one color. Tap a corgi, tap a side of the picture, and watch it walk along the edge licking up every tasty pixel of its color it can reach. Pick the right corgi and the right side, and the whole picture disappears in a burst of hearts.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a corgi, then tap a side: top, bottom, left or right
• Corgis lick their own color from the edge inward
• Pups lick one pixel per row. Long Tongue corgis lick deep!
• Corgis with licks left over wait in a spot, so plan ahead
• Clear the whole picture before the timer runs out

FEATURES
• More than 200 hand-made and generated pixel-art levels: cookies, donuts, ice cream, rainbows, burgers and more
• SUPER SLURP: fill the bar and every corgi licks deep for a few seconds
• Grey stones that can't be licked, so the side you choose matters
• Boosters: Extra Spot, Corgi Shuffle and Slurp Fill
• A corgi park that grows with every level you clear
• A treat collection of every picture you've licked clean
• A daily gift with free treats and boosters
• Calm background music and satisfying, tasty effects
• Easy to learn, with a gentle tutorial

Relaxing, cute and just tricky enough. Your corgis are waiting for their next snack!

name: PixLofi
description:
Choose a pixel scene and press play. PixLofi generates lo-fi music on your device while rain falls outside a café, a sailboat crosses the water, or northern lights move across the sky.

Each of the 16 scenes has its own instruments and ambience. In Study, felt piano plays alongside pencil strokes and turning pages. Adjust five layers independently, mute a channel, or choose a mix preset. Save favorite tracks, revisit your listening history, and export a mix as an MP3.

Listen for 30 minutes each day with no account required. An optional one-time Lifetime purchase removes the daily playback limit. Connect your Pixilus account to use your pass across linked players.

name: PlantHug: Plant Care & Journal
description:
Did you water the fern on Sunday or Monday? When did that little leaf start to unfurl? PlantHug gives you a place to keep those details, from the first plant you bring home to the collection that slowly takes over your windowsills. Organize your plants, set reminders for watering and fertilizing, and keep a photo diary of how they grow.

Make a garden that feels like home

Start with a plant you already have. Find it in the plant encyclopedia, open its profile, and add it to your garden. Give it a name you’ll recognize and choose where it lives. Use the room names you already know or add places of your own, like the kitchen window or the shelf above your desk. When a plant moves, update its location and keep its history together.

Add two plants of the same kind as separate plants. Give each its own name, location, reminders and diary, so you can tell what you did for the pothos in the kitchen and the one in your bedroom.

Find a rhythm for everyday care

Set recurring reminders for watering and fertilizing for each plant. Choose the next date and repeat interval, then check upcoming care in the app. Feel the soil when a watering reminder comes up. If it’s still damp, choose a later date or skip the current reminder when that option is available.

Open a plant to check when you last watered or fed it. Log those actions with the date they happened. If you watered yesterday and remembered today, save yesterday’s date.

Keep the little things worth remembering

The first new leaf. The flower bud you noticed on your way out. The day you moved a plant and wanted to see how it would settle in. Add a dated entry to the growth diary with a few words, photos, and tags that fit the moment. One entry can hold several photos, so you can keep a full view of the plant and a close-up of the detail you wanted to capture together.

Tag what you did, from watering to repotting, and what you saw, from a new leaf to a first bloom. Read entries for your whole garden or filter to one plant. Open any diary photo for a closer look.

Get to know what you’re growing

Look up a plant by its common or scientific name, or browse categories when you’re curious about what else you might grow. In the encyclopedia, read plant profiles and explore care topics such as watering, light, soil, and repotting where information is available. It’s a place to look up the plant on your shelf as well as the one you’ve been thinking about bringing home.

Save a profile to your favorites or return to it from your browsing history. When a nursery tag uses a different name, try a listed alias. You can add the plant directly from its encyclopedia entry.

Get started as a guest.

Membership, billing and cancellation

Basic garden, diary, reminder settings and encyclopedia features are free to use. If a PlantHug membership is available in your region, review the benefits, billing period, first charge and full renewal price in your local currency before you confirm. Apple charges the Apple Account used for purchase. Your membership renews automatically each billing period until canceled. Apple may charge for renewal in the 24 hours before a new period starts. Cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends to avoid the next charge.

On iPhone or iPad, open Settings, tap your name, then go to Subscriptions. Select PlantHug and tap Cancel Subscription. Paid access generally continues through the current billing period. After uninstalling, cancel in your original Apple Account to stop renewal. To restore an eligible membership, use the original Apple Account and tap Restore Purchases in PlantHug.

Privacy Policy: https://plant.healx.com.cn/privacy.html

name: Platinum Driver

WORK FOR THE STORES YOU CHOOSE
- Find stores that take freelance drivers and ask to join, or scan the store's QR code to join at once.

NEVER MISS AN ORDER
- When a store offers you an order, your phone rings with the sound you choose, even when the app is closed.

EVERYTHING FOR THE TRIP

TRACK WHAT YOU EARN
- Every delivery in your history, settled or still to hand over.
- The cash you hold and the pay you earned, store by store.

Sign in with Apple or Google and verify your phone number. Platinum Driver is free.

name: Play Camera: Photo Game Coach
description:
Play Camera teaches composition like a game. Pick what you want to shoot, line it up as a mission, and earn XP for every photo.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a kind of shot: portrait, café and food, travel, trend shots, landscape, night and city, group or ID photo
• The mission camera shows four checks, a white dot on your subject and a pin where it belongs. Move the dot to the pin
• AI lines up zoom, level and focus and tells you when it is time. You press the shutter, or turn on auto click and it shoots for you
• Each photo comes back as a polaroid with a score out of 10 and XP. Level up as your framing improves
• Swipe through six AI edits, fine-tune, save
• A recorded voice reads the guide in 8 languages, no network needed
• Photo and video

PLUS AND PRO
• Plus (AI Guide): scene detection, one direction at a time with the reason, AI mode with auto zoom, focus and exposure and an automatic shot, pose and light hints, a review after each shot, 6 AI auto edits, all films and 41 presets
• Pro (AI Director): everything in Plus and every editing tool: light, colour, curves, 8-colour mixer, colour grading, effects, detail, person, sky and background masks, 21 looks and 41 presets. Also a spot map with where to stand, spoken pose direction, next-shot ideas, background extend and background blur

PRIVACY
• Scene reading, scoring and editing run on your iPhone. Photos are never uploaded
• No account, no ads. Location is used only for the spot map
• Anonymous usage statistics (Firebase) contain no photos; in the EU, EEA, UK and Switzerland they are off until you turn them on

PRICE
Everything is open for the first 7 days, with nothing to buy. After that, shooting by hand with composition guides stays free. Plus and Pro each come as a weekly or yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions: Play Camera Plus (Weekly), 1 week; Play Camera Plus (Yearly), 1 year; Play Camera Pro (Weekly), 1 week; Play Camera Pro (Yearly), 1 year. Each renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://playcamera.honeyground.com/privacy

name: Player 1: Diamond Setup
description:
Set up baseball and softball fields in seconds with your phone.

Open the app, point at the ground, and drop home plate and the pitching rubber exactly where they belong. No tape measure. No memorizing distances. No pacing it off and hoping.

What it does:
- AR field layout for baseball and softball
- Instant home plate to pitching rubber placement for bullpen
- Guides you to 1st, 2nd, and 3rd base positions
- Remembers your preferences
- Accurate to a few inches - perfect for bullpens, practices, and backyard sessions

Leave the tape measure at home. This is built for coaches who need the field ready now and parents who practice with their kids. Pull out your phone, snap it to the ground, and go.

Practice-ready setup. Player 1: Diamond Layout - the field, ready when you are.

https://beplayer1.com

name: PleatGlyph
description: PleatGlyph એ તમારા iPhone પર સ્થાનિક રીતે ચાલતું ટેક્સ્ટ એનકોડ અને ડિકોડ વર્કબેન્ચ છે. એક જ ડ્રાફ્ટ પર URL, HTML એન્ટિટી, Unicode, JSON, Base64, Base32, હેક્સ, બાઇનરી, Quoted-Printable અને દશાંક કોડપૉઇન્ટ જેવી દસ પદ્ધતિઓની ડિકોડ અને એનકોડ પંક્તિઓ એકસાથે દેખાય છે. પંક્તિ-દર-પંક્તિ બેચ, ઇસ્કેપ હાઇલાઇટ અને પહેલાં-પછીની તુલના ટૂલબારમાં જ છે. ડ્રાફ્ટ અને ઇતિહાસ આ ડિવાઇસ પર સંગ્રહાય છે; વિષયવસ્તુ સર્વર પર મોકલવામાં આવતી નથી.

name: Pleats: Hinge Accordion
description:
Pleats turns iPhone Duo into an accordion. Hold it like a book, half open: the fold is the bellows. Open and close the hinge to pump air, press the buttons, and the reeds sing.

A REAL INSTRUMENT
• Pressure comes from how fast you move the bellows: a slow pull is soft, a quick push is loud. Both directions sound, as on a real accordion.
• Treble buttons on one half, Stradella bass and chord buttons on the other. Play melody, bass notes and chords together with as many fingers as you like.
• Chromatic five-row button board, or a diatonic G/C push–pull board where every button plays a different note on the push and on the pull.

REEDS, NOT SAMPLES
Every note is synthesized live from detuned reeds, with a natural attack, breath and a warm room. Switch registers like on a real instrument: Clarinet, Bandoneon and the wet, shimmering Musette.

LEARN SONGS
Pick a song and the next button lights up. Play it with air and the song moves on, at your own pace. Or choose Listen and Pleats plays it for you first. Earn up to three stars per song. From Ode to Joy and a sea shanty to Üsküdar'a Gider İken, plus an original musette waltz.

RECORD
Record a clip of your playing and listen back.

CRAFTED
Black lacquer or ivory finish, mother-of-pearl buttons, brass trim and pleated bellows that open with the hinge. Haptics follow the air and every button.

ON EVERY IPHONE AND IPAD
No hinge? Drag the bellows strip in the middle like real bellows, or turn on Easy air and just press the buttons.

FAIR
The instrument, three registers and nine songs are free, with no ads and no account. One optional purchase, Pleats Pro, adds five more registers, three more voices, ten more songs and sharing of recordings. No subscription, and it works with Family Sharing.

name: PlistTide - Property Lists
description:
Inspect property lists without flattening their types. PlistTide opens XML and binary plist files as a browsable tree, with clear labels for strings, integers, real numbers, booleans, dates and data.

Work on an independent copy. Add values, edit scalar fields, rename dictionary keys, browse nested containers and remove only the values you choose. Dates use ISO-8601 and data uses Base64.

Compare two saved documents by path. Review added, removed and changed values, including changes of type. Arrays are compared by position so the result remains explicit and easy to inspect.

Export a new XML or binary property list, or a PDF structure summary. Saved exports can be previewed, shared and deleted from the app. External source files stay intact.

Supports dictionary and array roots, inputs up to 4 MiB, up to 64 nesting levels and 20,000 nodes. A labeled sample is included. There is no app account, advertising SDK or analytics SDK.

name: PlugPH: EV Charging Map
description:
PlugPH is a free, community-run map of EV charging stations in the Philippines. Find a charger that fits your car, see whether it's working right now, and plan road trips with charging stops.

FIND A CHARGER
• Every listed charger from Luzon to Mindanao, with plug types, power, price, hours and access rules
• Live status from drivers' check-ins: working, busy or broken, and how many cars are charging now
• Filter by your car's plugs, fast DC, free chargers or open 24/7
• Search a mall, resort or town, or paste a Google Maps link
• Save your usual chargers: they get a heart on the map, and you get an alert if one goes down

PLAN A ROAD TRIP
• Charging stops worked out for your car's real-world range, with mountain climbs and a safety margin
• Warnings on ferry crossings, and a guide to which shipping lines carry EVs and plug-in hybrids
• Route guides and road trip stories from other drivers

CHOOSE AND COMPARE EVS
• Compare up to 3 cars: real-world range, charging times, size, seats and how many chargers fit each one
• Will it fit my parking? Check a car's size against your space
• Monthly cost calculator: car loan, charging and fuel together, next to a gasoline car, with a Grab/TNVS driver preset
• EV vs gasoline savings and your Meralco bill

HELP OTHER DRIVERS
• Check in after charging in one tap, or report "Couldn't charge" with the reason
• Add a missing charger, fix wrong info, and write reviews
• Earn points and badges

FAIR AND NEUTRAL
PlugPH doesn't rank or promote any car brand or charging network, and no one pays to be shown first. Chargers are added only once they're confirmed open.

Cost figures are estimates. Always check a charger's status before you rely on it.

PlugPH is independent and isn't affiliated with any carmaker or charging network.

name: Pocket Dungeon Crawler
description:
The Black Die talks. And it wants you at the bottom.

Roll it, pick a direction and go: you can't turn until you hit a wall. Every coin, heart, web and monster in your path is yours to deal with. Think a little, hope a little, and get up when you fall. Dying doesn't end your run.

• One die, a hundred decisions. Odd moves you diagonally, even moves you straight.
• 45 floors down, with locked stairs, portals and keys along the way.
• Daily Run: the same dungeon for everyone, every day.
• 9 safe rooms with Chip, a shopkeeper who knows more than he says.
• A dark story told in milestones, cinematics and 12 hidden inscriptions.
• Hand-inked art, one-thumb play and short sessions.

Free to try: play floors 1 to 6, Daily Run included. One purchase unlocks the whole dungeon. No ads, no energy, no subscriptions.

name: PoliPair: politický profil
description:
PoliPair vám pomôže zorientovať sa v politike bez kampaní a sľubov. Odpovedzte na 32 jednoduchých tvrdení o tom, čo sa deje na Slovensku, a uvidíte, s ktorou z 12 strán sa zhodujete najviac. Trvá to asi 7 minút.

Čo v appke nájdete:
1. Zhodu so stranami v percentách.
2. Svoj politický profil: krátky popis vašich hodnôt a radar v 8 témach (ekonomika, sociálna politika, Európska únia, príroda, zahraničie, právny štát, migrácia, digitalizácia).
3. Postoje všetkých strán vedľa seba pri každej téme.
4. Volebné prieskumy na jednom mieste: medián agentúr s odkazmi na zdroje. Pred voľbami podľa zákona nezverejňujeme nové prieskumy.
5. Porovnanie s priateľom: pošlete odkaz a uvidíte, v čom sa zhodujete. Vaša zhoda so stranami ostane súkromná.
6. Hodinky Apple Watch a Wear OS: otázka dňa, prieskumy a vaša zhoda na zápästí.

Ako to funguje: postoje strán vychádzajú z ich programov, verejných vyjadrení a hlasovaní. Pri každom postoji evidujeme zdroj a dátum overenia. Vaše odpovede porovnáme rovnakou škálou pre všetky strany. Výsledok ukazuje hodnotovú blízkosť, nie odporúčanie, koho voliť.

Nestranne a anonymne: nepatríme žiadnej strane a žiadna strana nám neplatí. Nepotrebujete účet ani meno. Vek, pohlavie a kraj sú dobrovoľné a slúžia len na súhrnné štatistiky. Svoj výsledok môžete kedykoľvek zmazať.

Prevádzkovateľ: FioArt s. r. o., Kežmarok. Otázky a pripomienky: info@polipair.sk

name: Polizei Bayern Eignungstest
description:
Hinweis: Diese App ist kein Angebot der Bayerischen Polizei oder einer anderen Behörde und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Behörde. Sie dient ausschließlich der privaten Vorbereitung auf den Einstellungstest.

Offizielle Informationen zum Auswahlverfahren findest du bei der Bayerischen Polizei und beim Landespersonalausschuss. In der App sind offizielle Seiten verlinkt.

Bereite dich gezielt auf den Eignungstest der Bayerischen Polizei vor – für die Ausbildung in der 2. Qualifikationsebene oder das Studium in der 3. Qualifikationsebene. Die App trainiert typische Aufgabentypen aus Einstellungstests – wann und wo du möchtest, ganz ohne Konto.

Trainingsbereiche

Polizei-Fachwissen Bayern
40 Fragen zu Polizeiaufgabengesetz (PAG) und Polizeiorganisationsgesetz, Bayerischer Verfassung, Grundgesetz, Strafrecht sowie Ausbildung und Studium bei der Bayerischen Polizei – jeweils mit Erklärung.

Mathematik
Dreisatz, Prozent & Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen und Zahlenpuzzle.

Sprache
Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien und alphabetische Reihen.

Logik
Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix und Dominosteine.

Allgemeinwissen
Über 100 Fragen aus Politik, Geschichte, Wirtschaft, Geografie, Recht und EU – mit Themenfilter.

Gedächtnis
Zahlen merken und Buchstaben merken.

Testsimulation
30 Aufgaben aus allen Bereichen, auch Polizei-Fachwissen Bayern, mit 30 Minuten Zeitlimit und Auswertung nach Bereichen.

Polizei Bayern im Überblick (kostenlos)
Ablauf des Eignungstests, Testinhalte, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Seiten.

So funktioniert die App
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Zu den Aufgaben gibt es Lösungen, bei vielen Aufgabentypen mit Lösungsweg oder Erklärung.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen der Bayerischen Polizei.

name: Polizei Eignungstest Trainer
description:
Diese App ist kein Angebot einer Polizei oder einer anderen Behörde. Sie dient der privaten Vorbereitung auf das Auswahlverfahren.

Die App ist für Bewerberinnen und Bewerber bei der Polizei gemacht: für alle 16 Landespolizeien und die Bundespolizei.

POLIZEI IN DEINEM BUNDESLAND (KOSTENLOS)
Für jedes Land und die Bundespolizei: Ablauf des Auswahlverfahrens, Testteile, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Karriereseiten.

27 Fragen zu Organisation der Polizei, Laufbahnen, Grundgesetz und Recht sowie Verkehr und Alltag, jeweils mit Erklärung.

TESTSIMULATION
30 Aufgaben in 30 Minuten mit Polizei-Fachwissen, Mathematik, Sprache, Logik und Allgemeinwissen, danach eine Auswertung nach Bereichen.

• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen. „Polizei in deinem Bundesland“ ist immer kostenlos.

name: Polizei NRW Eignungstest
description:
Hinweis: Diese App ist kein Angebot der Polizei Nordrhein-Westfalen oder einer anderen Behörde und steht in keiner Verbindung zu einer Behörde. Sie dient ausschließlich der privaten Vorbereitung auf den Einstellungstest.
