name: Portide: File Transfer
description:
Portide moves photos, videos, files, folders and text between your own devices: iPhone, iPad, Mac, Windows and Linux. No account, no sign-in, no cloud storage in between.

PAIR ONCE, THEN JUST SEND
Pair a new device with an 8-digit code. From then on your devices find each other on the same Wi-Fi automatically. Each device gets its own conversation, so sending a photo to your laptop feels like sending a message.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• End-to-end encrypted. Only your own devices can decrypt what you send.
• No account and no tracking. Portide doesn't collect any data.
• Lose a phone? Remove it from your devices on another one, and it's locked out.

SEND EVEN WHEN A DEVICE IS OFFLINE
Items for a device that isn't reachable wait on the sending device and are delivered as soon as it's back.

ACROSS NETWORKS WITH A RELAY
On different networks, devices can connect through a relay server you run yourself (the server is free and open source). The relay only passes encrypted data along and can't see your files.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY USE
• Share from Photos, Files or any app with the share sheet
• Save received photos and videos straight to Photos
• Progress, pause and resume for large transfers
• Search your history
• English and Chinese

GOOD TO KNOW
iOS only lets apps stay connected while they're open. Your iPhone receives while Portide is open or just moved to the background; anything sent meanwhile waits on the other device and arrives the next time you open Portide.

The desktop apps, command line and relay are open source: https://github.com/e7coding/portide

name: PowderOwl
description:
PowderOwl blends six weather models into one snow forecast for your mountain, at the summit and at the base, hour by hour.

No more guessing which app to trust. PowderOwl shows where the models agree, where they don't, and what actually fell.

SIX MODELS, ONE BLEND
ECMWF, ECMWF AI, GFS, ICON, GEM and HRRR, blended for each mountain's summit and base, with the range across models so you can see the uncertainty.

SUMMIT AND BASE, HOUR BY HOUR
Snow, temperature, wind and snow level at both elevations, so you know whether it's snowing at the lodge or raining.

LIGHT OR DENSE
Snow-to-liquid ratios from each storm's temperatures tell you whether it's blower, good or heavy before you drive up.

WHAT ACTUALLY FELL
Measured new snow and depth from the nearest USDA SNOTEL station, next to what the models said.

THE DAILY SNOW
Every morning at 5am, a short write-up for the Sierra with a powder pick, from the models, the stations and the National Weather Service.

ANY MOUNTAIN
Search about 4,300 ski areas worldwide. Star your home mountain and it opens first, and keep it on your Home Screen with a widget.

FREE, WITH PRO FOR STORM CHASERS
The full forecast for 3 mountains, the Daily Snow and the home-mountain widget are free. PowderOwl Pro adds:
• Unlimited mountains
• Storm alerts when a mountain you follow is about to get hit
• Bigger widgets, for any mountain you follow
• Your mountains synced with powderowl.com

Pro is one subscription for the iPhone app and the web: $19.99 a year in the US, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, and the subscription renews each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://powderowl.com/privacy.html

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Snow measurements from USDA NRCS SNOTEL. Ski area data © OpenStreetMap contributors, via OpenSkiMap.

name: PredictionComp
description:
PredictionComp is a free Premier League prediction game. Predict the score of every match, beat your friends in your own private leagues, and take on five levels of computer players.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick a score for each Premier League match before it kicks off. You can change your picks until kick-off.
- 5 points for the exact score, 3 points for the right result.
- Climb your leagues by season, month or matchweek, and the global table.

MADE FOR YOUR IPHONE
- A Home Screen widget with your next deadline, how many picks are missing and your place in your league
- Your points and league place sent to you as soon as each matchweek's results are in
- Reminders before your picks lock, 24 hours and 2 hours before kick-off
- Sign in with Apple or Google
- Share league invites and your matchweek with the iPhone Share sheet

LEAGUES WITH FRIENDS
Start a league in seconds and invite friends with a link or a join code. Every prediction counts in every league you're in, with season, month and matchweek tables.

BEAT THE BOTS
Computer players, clearly marked SIM1 to SIM5, keep every table competitive. Can you finish above the best of them?

PredictionComp is free, with no adverts and no in-app purchases. It is a prediction game for fun: there is no betting and no prizes. You can delete your account at any time in Account & profile.

name: PrintScan for 3D Printing
description:
Turn physical objects into 3D models for 3D printing.

PrintScan guides you around an object, reconstructs it on your iPhone or iPad, and exports an STL you can open in a slicer. Preview your models, set the longest side in millimeters, and keep your scans in an on-device library.

Live capture requires iOS or iPadOS 18 or later and a LiDAR-equipped device that supports Apple Object Capture. Open the included Twist Vase sample to try the 3D preview, sizing, and export.

Start new scans during the free three-day trial. After the trial, a one-time in-app purchase unlocks new scans. The trial never bills automatically. Saved scans remain available to preview and export.

Check mesh integrity, dimensions, and orientation in your slicer before printing.

name: Printwise: Printer & Scanner
description:
Print PDFs and photos, scan searchable documents, and check reported ink levels before printing. No ads. No account required.

PRINT PHOTOS & DOCUMENTS
• Photos from your library, several at once
• PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, Numbers and Keynote files
• Web pages converted into paginated PDFs you can preview before printing
• Notes, text and anything you copied to the clipboard
• From supported share menus: tap Share and choose Printwise for a file, photo or web link

SEE YOUR PRINTER'S REAL STATUS
• Live ink and toner levels when reported by your printer
• Low-ink warnings before you hit Print
• Alerts for paper jams, empty trays and open covers
• Paper size loaded, color and two-sided support at a glance

ONE-TAP PRINTING
• Your printer is remembered — no picking it every time
• Copies, color or black & white, Letter / A4 / Legal, portrait or landscape
• Paper size is matched to what's loaded in your printer
• Full system print options whenever you need them

CHECK BEFORE YOU PRINT
• Run real connection and IPP checks without sending a print job
• Copy or share a printer diagnostic report
• Review document size, reported paper, supply warnings and a PDF preview
• Fit PDF pages to your chosen paper or keep original page sizes
• Arrange photos 1, 2 or 4 per page
• Save named print settings for everyday jobs

SCAN TO PDF
• Scan receipts, forms and contracts with automatic edge detection
• Print scans or share them as PDF
• Read text on your device and copy the recognized text
• Create searchable PDFs and rotate or reorder scanned pages
Recognition accuracy depends on image quality and language. Review extracted text for errors.

KEEP A LOCAL PRINT HISTORY
• View submitted jobs and their print settings
• Optionally keep PDFs on your device for preview and reprinting
• Delete individual entries or clear all history
PDF storage is off by default. Up to 100 history entries are kept. "Sent" means submitted, not confirmed on paper.

WORKS WITH YOUR PRINTER
Printwise works with compatible AirPrint-enabled printers reachable on your local network. No drivers, no cables, no accounts. You can also add a printer by its IP address. Connection checks and a step-by-step guide help when your printer doesn't show up. Ink levels, alerts and available print options depend on what your printer reports. Document formatting may vary by file or website.

Printwise is an independent app and is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any printer manufacturer.

PRINTWISE PRO
Try Printwise with free prints first — no payment needed. Upgrade to Pro for unlimited printing, PDF sharing of scans and all features. With notification permission, Printwise can remind you the day before your trial ends.
• Weekly subscription with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers
• Yearly subscription
Current prices and trial eligibility are shown before purchase.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase (after the free trial, if one applies). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings.

Choose a file, check your printer, and prepare your next print with Printwise.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kustasoft.com/uygulamalar/printwise-smart-printer-app/gizlilik-politikasi

name: Prism Charades
description:
Hold the phone to your forehead. Everyone else gives clues. Guess the card, tip the phone down, and get through as many as you can before the time runs out.

Prism Charades is the forehead guessing game for family nights, parties and long car trips, with no ads and no account.

HOW IT WORKS
• One player holds the phone to their forehead, on its side, so the room can read the card and they cannot.
• Tip the phone down when you get it. Tip it up to pass.
• Every answer has its own sound and its own tap, so you always know which one it took.
• When the time is up, see every card and what happened to it.

20 DECKS, 1,000 CARDS
Animals, food, jobs, sports, places, history, science, fairy tales, music and more. Every card was written for this game and is suitable for all ages. No card comes round again until the deck is done.

FOUR WAYS TO GIVE CLUES
Say Anything, No Talking, One Word, or Sounds Only. The same deck becomes a different game.

GAME NIGHT
Play in 2 to 6 teams. The app keeps the turns and the scoreboard and names the winner.

FILM THE ROUND AND SHARE IT
With your permission, the front camera films the room giving clues. Watch it back in a party frame with every card written over the moment it was played, then share it or save it. The video stays on your device unless you share it.

DECKS OF YOUR OWN
Write decks about your family, your class or the people at the party. Mix several decks into one round, and share a deck with friends as plain text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no account, no sign-in, no tracking. Scores, your decks and your videos stay on your device.

PLANS
Free: 4 decks (200 cards), one-minute rounds as often as you like, tilt or tap, the recap, and the video of the round.
Pro ($2.99 a month or $29.99 a year): all 20 decks, rounds of 30 seconds to 3 minutes, any clue style on any deck, and Game Night.
Unlimited ($4.99 a month or $47.99 a year): everything in Pro, plus writing your own decks, mixing decks, and sharing decks as text.

Pro and Unlimited are auto-renewing subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed or cancelled in your Apple Account settings. Prices are in US dollars and may vary by country.

Good to know: tilting needs a device with motion sensors held on its side; on a table, use the Pass and Got It buttons. Filming needs your permission for the camera and microphone. One video is kept at a time and is deleted when the next round starts. The app is in English.

name: Proportio: Guess the Size
description:
Proportio is a game for iPhone about guessing real sizes by eye. A familiar thing stands on the ground in true scale: a person, a giraffe, a blue whale. You stretch a second object next to it until it looks as big as it really is, and the game shows the real size and how far off you were. A game takes about two minutes. It takes the place of scrolling through size comparison pictures. Today's puzzle and the animals set are open to everyone, with ads between games. Proportio Pro is a subscription that opens every set and removes the ads. No account.

HOW A ROUND GOES
• A familiar object stands in true scale beside a yellow tape measure
• Pinch or drag the slider to stretch the second object
• Lock in your answer: the object grows or shrinks to its real size, and a dashed outline marks your guess
• Each round gives an accuracy from 0 to 100%

TODAY'S PUZZLE
• Five rounds a day, the same for everyone
• One try a day; if you leave, the puzzle continues from the same round
• A streak counts your days in a row
• A result card to share: your accuracy and five bars

SETS
• Three sets: animals, buildings and landmarks, transport
• Without a subscription: the animals set as often as you like, and one game of another set for each video you choose to watch

PROPORTIO PRO
• A subscription, monthly or yearly; new subscribers start the yearly plan with a trial
• Opens every set, and new sets as they are added
• Removes the ads
• Without it an ad may appear between games, never during a round

INSIDE
• 96 objects, from a painting 79 cm tall to a waterfall 979 m high
• Every size comes from a public source: museums, official sites, encyclopedias
• Animals are shown at the size of a typical adult
• One flat drawing style, light and dark themes
• Meters or feet, following your region
• English, Russian and Polish
• Optimized for iPhone Duo: the game on one half, your week or the current game on the other
• Larger text and Reduce Motion are supported

DATA
• Your results are stored on your iPhone
• Purchases go through the App Store
• Without Proportio Pro the app shows ads from an ad network; if you allow tracking, the network uses the device's advertising identifier
• The subscription service receives launches and purchases with a random identifier and the device's vendor identifier: no name, no email, no game results

name: Puffer: Reef Dive
description:
Puffer is a fast one-finger arcade dive. Guide a little pufferfish up through the reef: stay small to slip through tight gaps in the coral, then puff up to scare off hungry sharks and pull in glowing pearls.

Every day there is a new reef, and it's the same course for every player in the world. That makes every score directly comparable: climb the daily leaderboard, see yesterday's champion and come back tomorrow to defend your spot.

FEATURES

Never touch the reef or the jellyfish. How deep can you go?

name: Pulso · Mecanografía
description:
En los últimos cinco niveles, lo que cae por la pantalla no se puede leer en ningún idioma. Y sin embargo, al teclearlo, suena el Himno a la alegría.

Cada letra tiene una nota. Las canciones están traducidas a letras, así que escribirlas es tocarlas. Y como el ritmo lo pones tú, la melodía solo suena bien si tecleas con pulso parejo: el oído te corrige antes que cualquier estadística.

Eso es el final del camino. El principio son dos teclas.

VEINTE NIVELES, DE DOS TECLAS A TOCAR BEETHOVEN
Del primer día —solo la F y la J, sin mover las manos— hasta frases enteras y las cinco melodías. Cada nivel se abre por precisión, nunca por puntos: la velocidad llega sola, lo que no llega solo es dejar de fallar.

PENSADO EN ESPAÑOL, NO TRADUCIDO
La eñe tiene su propio nivel. Las tildes se escriben como se escriben de verdad, con la tecla muerta y luego la vocal. Y puedes elegir distribución de España o de Latinoamérica.

CADA LETRA CAE POR SU DEDO
Las letras no caen por donde quieran: cada una baja por el carril del dedo que le toca. La posición en la pantalla y el movimiento del dedo son la misma cosa, así que aprendes mirando al centro y no al teclado.

EMPIEZA POR DONDE TE TOCA
Si ya sabes escribir, una prueba de dos fases te coloca en tu nivel: primero un texto a toda velocidad, luego una ronda con el juego. Al acabar te dice qué fila, qué dedo y qué teclas concretas te están frenando.

SE FIJA EN LO QUE FALLAS
El juego apunta los aciertos, los fallos y los milisegundos de cada tecla, y insiste en las que se te resisten. También te dice tu techo: a cuántas pulsaciones irías si todas tus teclas fueran tan rápidas como la que mejor se te da. Y puedes entrenar solo esas.

EN EL IPHONE, LO HONESTO
En un móvil no se aprende mecanografía a diez dedos: es otra habilidad. Por eso tiene un modo de pulgares aparte, con su propio camino y su propio récord, que entrena lo que sí se puede entrenar ahí: saber dónde está cada tecla sin leerla y repartir el trabajo entre las dos manos.

SIN LETRA PEQUEÑA
Sin anuncios. Sin cuentas. Sin compras dentro de la aplicación. Sin conexión: funciona en modo avión. Y sin recoger un solo dato: todo se queda en tu dispositivo.

name: Pumfrey
description:
Pumfrey is a collection of small puzzle games for on the go. Ten games, clean design, quick rounds and completely offline.

TEN GAMES
• Light Path – Turn the tiles and light up the path. Free.
• Signal Switch – Hit moving symbols at the right moment.
• Island Post – Plan short routes and deliver letters.
• Sum Grid – Select numbers to reach every row and column total.
• Cargo Depot – Plan ahead and push crates onto the marked destinations.
• Sequence Lab – Memorise a sequence and replay it forwards, backwards or mirrored.
• Code Breaker – Crack the colour code in as few tries as you can.
• Colour Flow – Connect matching symbols without crossing lines.
• Pixel Puzzle – Use number clues to uncover a hidden picture.
• Sink the Fleet – Sink the computer’s fleet on three levels or play against a friend.

PLAY TOGETHER
Island Post with two or three iPhones, Code Breaker and Sink the Fleet with two iPhones. Devices connect directly over the local network, no internet needed. Only the host needs the full collection. Guests join with the free app.

FAIR
• Buy once, play forever. No subscription.
• No ads, no account, no data collection.
• Every game works in airplane mode.
• Unfinished games are saved.
• Available in English, German and Spanish.

Light Path is free. The one-time purchase “Pumfrey Full Collection” unlocks every game and hosting your own multiplayer rounds. Purchases can be restored at any time.

name: Pump Digital Book
description:
ポンプを、はじめて学ぶ人のための教科書です。
化学・食品・医薬などのプラントで働き始めた人が、ポンプが液を送るしくみ、形と部品、選び方、動かし方、性能の見張り方、トラブル、保全、安全までを、順に学べます。

■ 読むだけでなく、動かして分かる
・3D：渦巻ポンプを回し、ケーシングを切って中の羽根車と軸封を見る。羽根車の入口のキャビテーション、マグネットポンプ、キャンドモータポンプ、歯車ポンプ、ダイヤフラムポンプなども
・シミュレーター：弁の開き、回転数、液面の高さなどを動かし、運転点、軸動力、NPSH の余裕がどう変わるかを確かめる
・アニメ：始動の手順、弁を急に閉めたときの圧力の波（ウォーターハンマ）、歯車ポンプの中の液の動きを、順を追って見る
・図解：式の意味、部品の名前、漏れや摩耗の起きる場所などを1枚ずつ

■ 1台のポンプで、最初から最後まで
この本の主役は、油を送る渦巻ポンプ P-101 です。同じ1台を使って、全揚程、性能曲線、運転点、NPSH、軸封、始動と停止、点検、分解整備、安全、省エネまでを説明します。数値がつながるので、章が進んでも迷いません。

■ 電卓なしで解ける練習問題
節ごとに練習問題があります。計算問題は、数の札を式の空欄に置くと、途中の式と答えが出ます。どこに何を入れるかを考えることに集中できます。

■ 本のように読み、書き込める
・ページをめくって読む。横向きの iPad では見開き
・マーカー、メモ、「分かりにくい」の印。Apple Pencil の手書き
・目次の検索で、言葉からページを探す
・SI 単位と US 単位の切り替え、文字の大きさの変更
・用語と記号は、押すと説明が出る

■ 内容
第0章 はじめに／第1章 液はどう送られる／第2章 形と部品／第3章 選ぶ・仕様を読む／第4章 動かす／第5章 性能を見張る／第6章 トラブルを見抜く／第7章 保全する／第8章 安全／第9章 もっと先へ／付録（用語の一覧、記号と単位の一覧）

■ 読める範囲
第0章（はじめに）と付録は、そのまま読めます。第1章から第9章は、アプリの中の「全ページを開く」（買い切り）で読めます。定期購読や広告はありません。

■ ご注意
この本の数値と式は、本の中で設定した機器についての例です。実際の設計・運転・保全では、機器の仕様書と、事業所の基準・手順に従ってください。

name: Python for ML: Arrayo
description:
Learn the Python that machine learning is built on, by writing and running it on your phone.

Arrayo is a hands-on course for undergraduates and self-taught learners. Every idea starts from a real situation, you move a slider or run a few lines, and only then do you meet the equation that describes what you just saw. Nothing needs an account, a server or a connection: an interpreter for a teaching subset of Python and NumPy-style arrays runs inside the app.

NINE UNITS, BUILT UP IN ORDER
1. Python core refresher: types, loops, functions, lists and dictionaries
2. Arrays and shapes: ndarray, axes, slicing, masks, views and copies
3. Vectorisation and broadcasting: replace loops, line up shapes
4. Linear algebra in code: dot products, X @ w, matrix products, distance tables
5. Tables and data cleaning: missing values, split-apply-combine
6. Plotting and evaluation: scatter, line, bar and histogram figures, MSE and R squared
7. Reproducible experiments: seeds, splits, configs
8. From scratch: linear regression with gradient descent
9. Performance and structure: counting work, defensive checks, moving averages

HOW YOU LEARN
- Run it: every idea has a short program you can edit and run
- See it: a simulation of a real situation (grades, house prices, sensor columns, a forecaster) with sliders; tap any symbol of the equation to see what it is in the picture
- Build it: 27 coding exercises checked by running your code against real expected output, with hints and worked answers
- Four real projects: clean a sensor log, summarise and curve grades, treat a picture as an array, and predict ratings in a tiny recommender
- Labs: a slice explorer that highlights exactly which cells you picked, a broadcasting checker, a matrix product lab and a timing lab that measures loop against vector on your own device
- Checks: short, optional quizzes with a reason for every answer, computed from what you built

BUILT TO BE TRUSTED
Every expected output in the course was produced by running the same program in real CPython and NumPy, and a test suite replays hundreds of programs through both apps. Every claim lists its sources (NumPy and Python documentation, Stanford, Berkeley and CMU course pages, open textbooks and papers). Tap a source to read it in a full-width window without leaving your place. Offline, the source details are still there.

BEFORE YOU START
Arrayo teaches a subset of Python and NumPy and is not a replacement for a full installation. Random numbers come from Arrayo's own documented generator, so a seed gives the same numbers on every device. The course is original; it is not affiliated with NumPy, pandas, matplotlib or any university it cites.

Free to use. Optional ads appear only between activities, never inside an exercise or a quiz. Remove ads with a monthly subscription (7 days free), or watch a short video to earn credits.

Text size can be changed with A- and A+ at any time.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-arrayo.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-arrayo.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-arrayo.html

Premium schaltet die komplette Gesundheits-Timeline, den KI-Coach, Widgets, Auswertungen, unbegrenzte Gewohnheiten und dein komplettes Tagebuch frei. EVERY STATION, EVERY COUNTRY
