name: Rage Room: Smash Everything
description:
Bad day? Take it out on a room.

Rage Room: Smash Everything puts a hammer in your hand and a room full of breakables in front of you. Tap to smash, swipe to wreck a whole shelf, hold to wind up a massive charged hit. Glass shatters, plates explode, TVs spark and crates splinter, every material breaking its own way, with crunchy sound and punchy haptics to match.

16 ROOMS TO WRECK
Start in a cluttered garage and smash your way up to a billionaire's gold vault. Trash an office, an electronics store, a busy restaurant, a luxury penthouse, an industrial warehouse, a secret lab and a neon arcade. Then go further: a grand ballroom full of champagne towers, an art museum of marble statues, a supercar showroom, a high-roller casino, a humming data center, an orbital space station and a royal throne room. Every room has its own layout, backdrop, objectives and payouts.

WAVES OF DESTRUCTION
Clear the room and a fresh wave drops in, tougher and worth more. Keep going until the clock runs out. Chain hits into huge combos, set off explosive canisters for chain reactions, and crack prize capsules and gold bars for jackpot cash.

13 WEAPONS, ENDLESS UPGRADES
Begin with the Glass Hammer and work up through the Baseball Bat, Crowbar, Sledgehammer, Fire Axe, Electric Hammer and Industrial Crusher. Then unlock the Jackhammer, Wrecking Ball, Thunder Maul and the Singularity Hammer. Each weapon has its own speed, crit chance and material bonuses, and some splash damage or arc lightning between objects. Upgrade every weapon through 25 levels.

POWERS AND PROGRESSION
Unlock and level up five abilities: Power Smash, Shockwave, Frenzy, Cash Rush and Chain Reaction. Spend cash in the Workshop for more time, more cash and longer combos. Hire a Salvage Crew that earns cash and scrap while you're away.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO CHASE
- Room objectives with gem rewards
- Daily and weekly challenges
- 38 achievements
- A 7-day login streak
- S-rank ratings to master in every room
- Detailed lifetime stats

SMASH WITH A FRIEND
Team up in online co-op: create a lobby, share the code with a friend and wreck the place together. Works between iPhone and Android.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Rooms last about a minute, so they fit in a coffee break. No account needed, and your progress stays on your device. Every room and weapon can be earned just by playing. Weapon skins are cosmetic only.

Rage Room: Smash Everything is free to download and play. It contains ads and offers optional in-app purchases. You can remove the automatic ads between rooms with a one-time purchase. Optional rewarded ads, such as doubling your room cash, are always your choice.

Grab a hammer. Everything must go.

name: Rahi: Travel Log
description:
Rahi is a travel log for people who love knowing where they have been.

Add your flights, train rides and road trips, and watch your map fill up. See how far you have travelled, how many countries you have visited, and what your next milestone is.

SCAN A BOARDING PASS
Point your camera at a boarding pass or ticket, or choose a picture of it, and Rahi fills in the trip for you: airports, airline, flight number, date and seat. Reading happens on your phone. You can also share a ticket from Photos or Files straight into Rahi.

YOUR TRAVEL MAP
Every journey is drawn on the map. Switch the map style, tap a route to see its details, and add photos to the places you have been.

PASSPORT
Each country you visit earns a stamp. Turn a stamp over to see your trips there, and get ideas for where to go next.

STATS AND BADGES
Distance, time in the air, cities, countries and streaks. Collect badges as you reach new milestones.

SHARE YOUR STORY
Make a share card of your travels or a single trip, and save it or send it to friends. Create a public page of your journeys with a short link, and choose exactly what it shows. Ticket details are never shown.

BRING YOUR PAST FLIGHTS
Import a CSV file, for example a My Flightradar24 export, and see what will be added before anything is saved.

YOURS TO CONTROL
Sign in with Apple, Google or email. You can turn usage analytics off, and delete your account and data from Settings at any time.

Rahi is free, with no ads and no tracking.

name: Railnap: Missed Stop Alarm
description:
Fall asleep on the train and still get off at the right station.

Pick where you board and where you get off, tap "Start ride", and put your phone in your pocket. The alarm plays only in your earphones, so nobody around you hears it. No earphones? It vibrates instead.

■ 7 commuter railroads, 879 stations
- Caltrain (San Francisco Bay Area)
- MBTA Commuter Rail (Boston)
- Metra (Chicago)
- SEPTA Regional Rail (Philadelphia)
- Long Island Rail Road (New York)
- Metro-North Railroad (New York)
- Metrolink (Los Angeles)

■ No timetable lookups
You don't need to check when the train arrives. The app watches your location and wakes you about 0.6 miles before your stop. Tap on the platform and it starts counting once the train moves.

■ Works through tunnels and GPS gaps
When location drops out, the app falls back to a timer based on the timetable, set to the fastest train so it doesn't ring late. Tap "I got off" when you arrive and it learns your real ride time.

■ Saved trips in one tap
Save your commute and start it in one tap, in either direction. The app suggests the direction from where you are.

■ Lock Screen and widgets
While you ride, the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island show your stop, the time left, and the distance to go.

■ Choose your sound
Several alarm sounds, from soft to loud, with volume and a gradual fade-in.

■ Pricing
Try it free for 10 rides. Like it? Unlock unlimited rides with a one-time purchase of $4.99. No subscription.

■ Privacy
Your location is used only on your iPhone during the ride and is never sent anywhere.

Schedule data: Caltrain GTFS; MassDOT (MBTA Commuter Rail GTFS); Metra GTFS; SEPTA Regional Rail GTFS; MTA (Long Island Rail Road GTFS); MTA (Metro-North Railroad GTFS); Metrolink GTFS. Railnap is not sponsored by, affiliated with, or operated by any of these agencies.

name: RateCon Check
description:
Know what you're signing.

RateCon Check looks inside a rate confirmation before you take the load. It shows whether the PDF was changed after the broker sent it, and lists every fee, fine and deduction written into the fine print.

Catches the edit
A white box over the rate. A new number typed on top. A file saved again after it was sent. RateCon Check takes the PDF apart and runs seven checks on every page:
• File type: a real PDF or just a picture
• Edit history: saved once or changed later
• Covered text: white boxes and erased numbers
• Signature: changed after signing
• Made with: the program that saved the file
• Dates: created, then saved again
• Fine print: fees, fines and deductions

Reads the fine print
Late pickup, missed check calls, tracking updates, PODs, removed stops, unreported breakdowns. Every term that can cost you money, with the exact quote from the rate con.

Shows the original
When an edit is found, open the rate con as it looked before the change.

Keeps your proof
Export a report you can send to the broker. Your checks stay in your history.

Knows who sent it
Tag the dispatcher on each check and spot the ones who send edited rate cons again.

Three taps, no typing
Open the PDF from Mail, Files or a messenger and share it to RateCon Check. You get a clear answer in seconds: green, yellow or red.

Speaks your language
English, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Serbian and Lithuanian.

Pricing
Your first 3 checks are free, no card needed. After that, pay per check, buy a pack of 15 checks, or subscribe monthly or yearly for unlimited checks. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy
Sign in with your US phone number. Your files are encrypted and kept for your history. We never sell your data and we don't use ad trackers.

Good to know
RateCon Check reads the structure of a file. It shows what changed inside it, not who made the change. Results are information, not proof, and no check catches every edit. If the rate looks wrong, confirm it with the broker.

Made for drivers and owner-operators in the United States.

Terms of Use: https://rateconcheck.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://rateconcheck.app/privacy/

name: RaumPlan – Floor Plan & Scan
description:
RaumPlan turns a LiDAR scan into a floor plan you can correct and edit. Scan your flat or house with your iPhone Pro, edit the plan on iPhone or Mac, and explore it on Apple Vision Pro.

Free, no account, no ads. Your data stays on your device or in your own iCloud Drive.

SCAN
• Room by room with the LiDAR sensor. Several rooms are merged into one floor.
• The coverage map shows in red what is still missing.
• Guidance while scanning, plus glass edge markers for glass walls that LiDAR struggles with.
• Viewpoints with 360° panoramas for the tour.
• Continue scanning later and check the loop closure error.
• With photos or LiDAR only. Photos can be removed from a project later with one tap.

EDIT THE PLAN
• The scan stays untouched. Your changes live in a separate layer on top and can be undone.
• Draw walls and glass walls, snapping to end points and right angles.
• Snap doors and windows to walls, place objects from the library.
• Tell existing from planned: new elements are highlighted.
• Correct lengths with a laser measurement.
• The check list shows open wall ends, uncertain elements and doors without a wall.

3D AND POINT CLOUD
• The plan as a 3D model with transparent front walls.
• The scanned mesh and your photos at their position in the room.
• Raw or processed point cloud, colored by photo, type or height.

ON THE MAC
• Edit the plan on a big screen.
• Compute a floor image and high-resolution panoramas from your photos.
• Export as SVG (1:50 or 1:100), DXF, JSON, PLY and OBJ.

ON APPLE VISION PRO
• Dollhouse: the floor as a model in your space.
• Tour: jump from viewpoint to viewpoint through the panoramas.
• On site: the plan at full scale over the real room.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
Projects in iCloud Drive appear automatically on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Vision Pro. One device edits, the others see the changes within seconds. Without iCloud you can move projects via AirDrop or the Files app.

PRIVACY
RaumPlan sends nothing to the developer. There is no account and no usage tracking.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Scanning requires an iPhone Pro or iPad Pro with a LiDAR sensor. Viewing and editing plans also works on other iPhones and iPads.
• Measurements are a good working basis, not a certified survey. Please check important lengths with a laser distance meter.

RaumPlan is a private, non-commercial project. Questions and ideas are welcome: kontakt@raumplan-app.de

name: Ravora Play
description:
Your media, your way.

Ravora Play brings together the media you choose in one clean and convenient application.

What you can do:

Explore public TV channel listings and import authorized IPTV/M3U playlists.

Discover internet radio stations and save your favorites.

Play supported local media files.

Connect compatible Plex, Jellyfin and Emby servers.

Browse websites with the built-in browser.

Use AirPlay and Google Cast on supported devices.

Organize and access your preferred media in one place.

Ravora Play is a media player and organizer. It does not host or license third-party television broadcasts or provide paid channel subscriptions. Users are responsible for ensuring that their media sources are legally authorized.

name: ReachLead: B2B Prospects
description:
Every morning, ReachLead prepares new prospects chosen for your offer, with a verified address and a message already written for each one.

It starts from your website. From there it understands what you sell and to whom, looks for matching companies in public business registers, finds their website and keeps only the people who can actually decide.

In the app you read each message over, change what you want, validate the ones you like and set aside the others. Nothing leaves without you. Validated messages go out from your own mailbox at a careful pace, never from a server you do not know.

Replies are sorted for you, refusals are respected for good and an address in error is never written to again.

If you already use Hunter, Snov.io, Skrapp or Anymail Finder, connect your key and ReachLead asks your account for the addresses it cannot find on the websites.

ReachLead uses the Lead account shared by the Lead apps. Create it in the app or sign in with yours, and delete it from the app whenever you like. The app sells nothing.

name: Read Carefully
description:
Tap the biggest number. Turn off the light. Don't press the button.

Every level of Read Carefully is one simple instruction, and the obvious answer is almost always wrong. The real one could be hiding in the instruction's own words, in the settings menu, in the level counter, or in your phone itself.

• 58 hand-made trick levels, each with its own twist
• Drag the words, flip the settings, move the moon
• Some levels need the whole phone: shake it, tilt it, turn it upside down
• A sarcastic fail screen for every wrong move (there will be many)
• Stuck? The first hint is a joke. The second one is real.
• Pick any level you've reached from the level grid

Free to play with occasional ads between levels. One purchase, No Ads + Free Hints, removes the ads and makes every real hint free.

No accounts, no chat, no personal data. Made by The Weekend Companies.

name: Red Leaf Field
description:
Red Leaf Field is the work app for the field crews of Red Leaf Environmental. It is only for Red Leaf employees: the office gives each worker an invitation code and a sign-in.

- Job photos: take photos and videos and file them to the right job, even without signal.
- Customer calls: answer and make the company's calls on your phone.
- Chat: messages, photos, voice and video calls with the office and the crew.
- Phone: the company's contacts and your phone's own contacts in one place.
- English and Spanish.

name: RedKnot AI: Private Memory
description:
RedKnot AI is a private assistant that lives on your iPhone and remembers your life for you. It runs offline, and your words never leave the phone.

TELL IT ONCE
Say "my sister's birthday is 4 March" and it's kept. Notes, chats, scanned documents, photos and voice notes become memories you can read, edit or delete.

ASK YOUR OWN LIFE
Questions are answered from your memories, and the notes it used appear right under the answer.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR IPHONE
The AI model runs on the phone itself, so it answers even in airplane mode. No account, no server, no analytics, no ads.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Chat with an AI model that runs on your iPhone. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, it can also use Apple's on-device model.
• Save memories from chats, notes, the share sheet, photos, PDFs and the document scanner.
• Pin facts about yourself so every chat knows them.
• Voice mode: talk to it and hear the answer spoken aloud.
• Live interpreter between two languages, with no connection.
• Record a lecture or a meeting: get a transcript, key points and to-dos for Reminders.
• See your memories grouped by topic on a memory map.
• Bring over what other AI assistants know about you.
• Read answers aloud, see tables and charts, export a chat as a PDF.
• Lock it with Face ID. Back up to a file encrypted with your own password.
• Use it from Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight and a Home Screen widget.

REQUIREMENTS
iPhone 12 or later. A one-time download of about 2.4 GB on Wi-Fi. The recommended model needs 6 GB of memory (iPhone 12 Pro, 13 Pro, iPhone 14 and later); other iPhones get a smaller model.

PRIVACY
RedKnot AI collects no data. Your memories, chats and voice are processed and stored on your iPhone only. The only connection the app makes is downloading the AI models you choose.

name: ReentryRipplez
description: ಸ್ವಿಚ್ ಲೆವಿ — ಕೆಲಸದ ಸಂದರ್ಭ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸುವ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದನ್ನೂ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ. ಎತ್ತ ಹೋದಿದ್ದೀರಿ, ಏನ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಂದಿದ್ದೀರಿ, ಯಾಕೆ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಿದ್ದೀರಿ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ಕಾರಣದೊಂದಿಗೆ ಗುರುತಿಸಿ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಬದಲಾವಣೆಗೆ ನಷ್ಟದ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್‌ (೧ ಬ್ಲಾಕ್ = ೧೫ ನಿಮಿಷ) ಅಂದಾಜಿಸಿ. ದೈನಂದಿನ ಮತ್ತು ವಾರದ ಅಂಕಿಅಂಶ, ಟ್ರೆಂಡ್ ನೋಟ, ಒಂದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಧಾರಣಾ ಪ್ರಯೋಗ — ಹಿಂದಿನ ಅವಧಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಕೆ. ಪಠ್ಯ, CSV ಮತ್ತು JSON ಬ್ಯಾಕಪ್. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಡೇಟಾ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಐಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ; ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.

name: Reino Conecta
description:
REINO CONECTA reúne en un solo lugar lo que tu iglesia o ministerio necesita para servir: profesionales cristianos, solicitudes de servicio, eventos, mensajería y herramientas útiles para tu viaje.

¿Qué puedes hacer?

• Dar a conocer tu ministerio
Regístralo con su nombre, categoría (iglesia, predicador, cantante, músico o ministerio de danza), ciudad, país, descripción, redes o sitio web y un contacto. El registro queda pendiente de revisión antes de publicarse.

• Solicitar un servicio
Pide un pianista, músicos, cantantes, predicadores, sonido, fotografía, video o manejo de redes sociales. Indica la fecha, la ciudad, el lugar y un contacto para que te respondan.

• Buscar profesionales
Encuentra músicos, cantantes, predicadores, técnicos de sonido, foto y video, iluminación, logística, redes sociales y más. Filtra por especialidad, ciudad, país, idioma, modalidad (presencial o remoto), disponibilidad y presupuesto.

• Ver y publicar eventos cristianos
Consulta conciertos, vigilias, congresos, retiros, campañas y otras actividades. Publica tus propios eventos (la publicación básica es gratuita) y destaca los que quieras promover.

• Asistente e-Ticket dominicano
Te oriento para entrar o salir de República Dominicana, con lo que publica la Dirección General de Migración. El trámite se completa en el portal oficial (eticket.migracion.gob.do). Tú escribes tu número de pasaporte y tus datos directamente allí, no en esta app.

• Enviar dinero
Accede a Western Union, Remitly y Sendwave desde su sitio oficial. Reino Conecta no mueve dinero, no procesa pagos y no cobra el envío. Las tasas y comisiones las confirma el servicio que elijas.

• Vuelos baratos
Compara precios hacia Santo Domingo y Santiago en Google Flights, Kayak, Expedia y Aviasales. Reino Conecta no vende boletos ni procesa el pago.

• Anuncios patrocinados
Promociona tu negocio, servicio o actividad dentro de la comunidad. Los anuncios pagados se identifican claramente como «Patrocinado».

• Mensajería
Habla directamente con iglesias y profesionales para coordinar servicios y propuestas.

• Calendario de disponibilidad
Si ofreces servicios, marca tus fechas disponibles y administra tus reservas. Esas fechas aparecen en tu perfil público.

• Perfiles, opiniones y favoritos
Crea tu perfil (iglesia, profesional, empresa u organizador), guarda favoritos, deja opiniones y reporta contenido si hace falta. Algunos perfiles pueden mostrar la marca de verificado.

Categorías incluidas
Ministerios y predicadores · Músicos · Cantantes y adoración · Redes sociales y marketing · Sonido · Foto y video · Iluminación y producción · Organización y logística · Educación.

Para quién es
Iglesias y ministerios que buscan ayuda · Profesionales cristianos que ofrecen servicios · Empresas y organizadores de eventos cristianos.

REINO CONECTA es una plataforma de conexión. Las condiciones de cada servicio las acuerdan las partes. Algunos datos pueden aparecer marcados como «Ejemplo» mientras la comunidad crece.

Contacto: elhalconpiano@gmail.com
Sitio web: https://reinoconecta.netlify.app
Política de privacidad: https://reinoconecta.netlify.app/privacidad.html

name: RemindThis
description:
When a link or a small task crosses your mind, save it before it gets lost. Write a note, paste a link, or send something to RemindThis from the Share Sheet. Give it a date, snooze it if your plans change, or check it off when you are done.

Start with one reminder for free. The optional one-time Lifetime purchase adds more reminders, additional repeat options, and access to reminder history.

Your reminders are stored on your device. RemindThis can send local notifications if you allow them, and you can save an optional backup through Files.

name: Remorse Chess
description:
Chess, except the pieces have feelings about capturing.

Remorse Chess plays exactly like the chess you know: same moves, castling, en passant, promotion, check and checkmate. The difference comes after a capture. Every time a piece takes another, you roll a die to see how it copes.

• Devastated: the piece is frozen with grief. A bishop has three turns to reach it, or it removes itself from the board. If it's your king, you lose.
• Guilt-ridden: it becomes a pacifist. It still moves, but won't capture anything (or give check) until it's forgiven.
• Unaffected: it shrugs it off, for now. Its next capture means another roll.
• Sadist: it may move again after a capture.
• Bloodlust: a sadist with three captures can only move to capture, and will take its own side's pieces to do it.

Bishops can absolve troubled pieces by standing beside them. Your opponent gets one turn to break it up.

Every piece shows how it feels right on the board. Tap any piece to see its captures, its state and what it means.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Pass & Play on one iPhone or iPad
• Online with friends or random opponents through Game Center
• Against the computer, from Easy to Hard

Free to play: one game at a time and the Easy computer. A one-time unlock ($2.99) adds unlimited games at once, the Medium and Hard computer, and every cosmetic pack, including future ones. No ads and no subscription.

Based on the tabletop variants "Remorse Chess" and "Remorse Chess: Psychos & Devastation" by @bardelo_bardalini

name: Remy: Gather, Prep, Cook
description:
Remy turns any recipe into something you can actually cook from.

Add a recipe from a link, by pasting its text, or by taking a photo of a cookbook page or a handwritten card. Remy reads it and lays it out the way you cook:

GATHER: everything you need, sorted by where it is in the shop, to tick off as you go.
PREP: the chopping, dicing and measuring to do before the heat goes on, so nothing catches you mid-step.
COOK: one step at a time, with temperatures, what goes in now, and the step you're on shown on the lock screen.

Make it yours
• Set how many you're cooking for and every amount follows, with sensible rounding (never 1.5 eggs).
• Switch between US cups and metric weights, °F and °C.
• Edit your own version of a recipe and keep private notes before, during and after cooking.
• Keep favourites, and see what you cooked last.
• Plan a few dishes at once: Cooking soon merges their ingredients into one shopping list, and can send it to Reminders.

Cook together
Remy is a shared recipe box for a small group. Discover shows every recipe the group has added, who cooked it and how they rated it. Leave a comment, and rate a recipe after you cook it.

Remy is invite-only for now: you need an invite code from someone already using it.

Terms of Use: https://remy-valko.web.app/terms

name: RepBell
description:
RepBell is a workout timer for HIIT, Tabata and hybrid race training.

INTERVAL TIMER
Set work time, rest time, rounds and an optional warm-up. Or tap Tabata for 20 seconds on, 10 seconds off, 8 rounds. The app moves between work and rest by itself. A huge countdown and clear WORK / REST screens are easy to read from arm's length, with big buttons for Pause, Resume, Skip and End.

AMRAP AND FOR TIME
AMRAP: set the time, then tap +1 ROUND after every round and see your total at the end. For Time: the clock counts up until you tap FINISH, with a time cap that stops it for you. Repeat a workout to see if you beat your last result.

RACE SIMULATION
Practise a hybrid race with alternating runs and workout stations. Tap Next when you finish each one: RepBell saves the split and starts the next straight away. Edit the Hybrid Race template, rename or reorder steps, or build your own session with optional distance or rep targets. Pause stops the clock for both your total and your current split.

SEE HOW YOU IMPROVE
After a Race Simulation you get your total time and every run and station split. Repeat the same workout and RepBell shows the change from your previous completed attempt: runs against runs, stations against stations.

HISTORY AND SAVED WORKOUTS
Every finished workout is saved on your phone with the date, duration and results. Repeat any past workout with the same settings. Save your own interval workouts and start them in one tap.

BUILT FOR TRAINING
- Cues for work, rest and finish, with an optional 3-second countdown, played over your music
- See the countdown, the round and what comes next on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with a bar that fills in the colour of the current phase
- Haptics and keep-screen-awake options
- Four colour themes: the original lime, plus Glacier, Lagoon and Aurora
- Timing stays accurate when you lock the screen or switch apps
- No account, no subscription, no cloud: your data stays on your iPhone

name: RepBot
description:
RepBot is a small-sets logger. Do a few squats while the kettle boils, tap once, and it is counted. No workouts to schedule, no streaks to break, no guilt.

One tap to log
Each exercise is a card on the home screen. Tap "Log 25 reps" and the set is recorded. Tapped by mistake? Undo it, or remove a single set later.

Coach Bot
Your robot companion does the exercise with you: squats, curls, calf raises, presses. He grows as your sets add up, gaining muscle and new parts along the way. Tap him and he jumps. Rub his belly and he giggles.

Counted like marks on paper
Sets are shown as tally marks, the way you would count them on a notepad. Each exercise earns its own medals at 500, 1,000, 2,000 reps and beyond.

Yours to shape
Start from a library of bodyweight exercises or make your own, with your name and your amount. When a set feels easy, RepBot offers one more rep. You decide.

Gentle by design
Reminders are off unless you turn them on, and they never mention streaks. Set a daily limit, mark an area as resting, and take a breather with Coach Bot between sets.

Private
There are no accounts, no ads and no tracking. Everything you log stays on your iPhone.

RepBot is not medical advice. Use good technique, stop if anything hurts, and check with a professional when in doubt.

name: Rewindly: Reverse Singing Game
description:
Sing it backwards. Flip it. Laugh.
Rewindly is the reverse singing game: record any line, hear it played backwards, try to copy that strange sound, then flip your attempt forwards and find out how close you got.
Free to play. No weekly subscription. No account.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Record: sing, hum or say anything, up to 30 seconds. Or import an audio file.
2. Listen: play it backwards as often as you like.
3. Imitate: sing the backwards sound as closely as you can.
4. Reveal: Rewindly flips your take forwards. Same line, or pure gibberish?

PARTY MODE: PASS THE PHONE
2 to 8 players, one iPhone. One player records a line, everyone else tries it backwards, then the group hears every take flipped forwards and votes for the winner. No random scores: your friends are the judges. Pick 3, 5 or 10 rounds and see who tops the final ranking.

ALSO
• Every challenge is saved in History. Replay any clip or share the flipped result as an audio file.
• Works offline. Your recordings stay on your iPhone.
• In English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Turkish, Arabic and Indonesian.

FREE AND FAIR
Rewindly is free and shows light ads: a small banner on two quiet screens and an occasional ad between challenges, never while you record or listen. Rather have none? One single purchase removes every ad for good.

name: Rijksradar: Live Kaart NL
description:
BELANGRIJKE MEDEDELING: Rijksradar is een onafhankelijke app ontwikkeld door Mudaflow en is GEEN officiële overheidsapp en niet verbonden aan de Rijksoverheid, Rijkswaterstaat, het KNMI of de hulpdiensten. De app bundelt uitsluitend openbare Nederlandse open-databronnen op één interactieve kaart.

Bekijk Nederland live in realtime met 13 interactieve kaartlagen:
• OV & Spoor: live treinen, bussen, trams, metro’s en stations
• Verkeer & Snelwegen: files, wegwerkzaamheden, matrixborden en slimme verkeerslichten
• 112 & Hulpdiensten: actuele openbare P2000-meldingen, kazernes en SEH-locaties
• Scheepvaart: live AIS-schepen, bruggen, sluizen en havens
• Luchtvaart: live vliegtuigen en helikopters boven Nederland
• Water & Keringen: actuele waterstanden, gemalen en stormvloedkeringen
• Weer, Energie & Milieu: buienradar, KNMI-waarschuwingen, stroomnet, luchtkwaliteit en zendmasten
• EV Laadpalen, OV-fiets & Parkeren: beschikbaarheid in realtime

Extra functies in Rijksradar:
• Slimme AI Kaart-assistent: stel vragen over live situaties op de kaart
• Mijn Plekken & Spotter Collectie: leg favoriete plekken en gespotte treinen, schepen of vliegtuigen vast met eigen foto’s

Openbare gegevensbronnen:
• Rijkswaterstaat (https://rijkswaterstaat.nl)
• NDW Verkeersdata (https://ndw.nu)
• KNMI Weerdata (https://knmi.nl)
• RIVM Luchtmeetnet (https://luchtmeetnet.nl)
• NS & NDOV Openbaar Vervoer (https://ndovloket.nl)
• PDOK & Kadaster (https://pdok.nl)

Abonnementen (optioneel):
Rijksradar PRO (€ 4,99/maand, automatisch verlengend) en de 24-Uurs Dagpas (€ 2,49, eenmalig) geven onbeperkte toegang tot alle PRO-lagen en de AI-assistent. Betaling verloopt via je Apple ID-account en kan op elk moment worden beheerd of opgezegd via je App Store-instellingen.

Gebruiksvoorwaarden (EULA): https://rijksradar.nl/voorwaarden
Privacybeleid: https://rijksradar.nl/privacy
Account verwijderen: https://rijksradar.nl/account-verwijderen

name: Rimtell: Coin Value Checker
description:
Type the year on your coin and see every version at once. Rimtell shows each mint mark as a round cell with how many were made, what it is worth in metal today and a plain verdict: spend it, keep it for the metal, look closer, or key date.

CHECK A COIN IN SECONDS
- Type 4 digits, pick the denomination, and every mint for that year appears together
- Verdicts with the reason in plain words: how many were made, silver content, known varieties
- Silver and copper value updated from today's metal prices, or set your own price
- Key dates and semi-keys flagged with rough prices for worn examples
- Works offline. No account, no sign in

KNOW WHAT TO LOOK FOR
- Where the mint mark sits on each series, and what each letter means
- Known varieties like doubled dies and repunched mint marks, with what to look at
- Common mint errors for any coin, filtered by denomination
- Browse 29 US series from Indian Head cents to Presidential dollars, even when the date is worn off

ROLL HUNTING
- Start a hunt for penny, nickel, dime, quarter, half or dollar rolls
- Count each roll with one tap, log the coins you keep, and see the metal you pulled out
- Look back at past hunts and your weekly total

MY COINS AND ALBUMS
- Save the coins you keep with quantity, condition, price paid and your own value
- Fill a series album cell by cell and watch the ring grow
- The Check screen tells you when a coin fills a hole in your album
- Swipe to delete with Undo, search and sort

RIMTELL PRO, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Looking up coins, verdicts, metal values and errors stay free. Pro adds unlimited saved coins (free keeps 25), every album (free has 1), full hunt history (free shows the last 3) and CSV export. Family Sharing is on.

Mintages come from US Mint records and standard references. Prices are rough guides for circulated coins, not an appraisal: condition changes everything. Melting US cents and nickels is illegal; metal value is shown for information only.

name: Rizzceptionist
description:
Rizzceptionist answers your business phone 24/7 with a warm, natural voice, books the appointment into your calendar, and sends you a summary when the call ends. Nights, weekends, the lunch rush, while you're with a client: no call goes unanswered.

This app is for businesses that use Rizzceptionist. Log in to:

- See every call with its summary, transcript and recording
- Get a notification when a call or voicemail comes in
- Read the messages your receptionist took for you and your team
- Call customers back from your business number
- Change your greeting, hours and FAQs
- See who's on your team and who's available

Every call starts by telling the caller they're talking with a virtual assistant and that the call may be recorded.

name: RL Fundamentals: Rewardwell
description:
A university-level reinforcement learning course for your phone. Eight units take you from the Markov decision process to bandits, dynamic programming, Monte Carlo and temporal-difference learning, SARSA and Q-learning, function approximation, policy gradients and reward design.

Every equation comes alive as a simulation of a real situation. Steer a delivery robot through a city grid and watch discounting turn rewards into a return. Watch rumours of a bonus spread backwards, one street per sweep, as value iteration. Choose between lunch counters you cannot see inside to feel exploration and regret. Play many commutes to compare learning at the end of a trip with learning at every junction. Walk a cliff edge and see why Q-learning and SARSA disagree. Coach a thrower toward a basket with a policy gradient, and catch a maze robot gaming its reward.

Learn by doing first. Move a slider, tap a symbol in the equation to see what it means in the picture, then answer a question computed from what you just built. Quizzes are short, wrong answers return gently in a replay queue, and every session ends with a good place to stop.

Build your own city in the World tab: paint walls, goals, traps and a loophole bonus, then let the robot plan, learn, and export an experiment log.

Features
- 8 units, 40 short lesson cards, 8 interactive labs, 600+ questions, each with a worked reason
- Every numeric answer is recomputed by independent code; the labs use the same equations you see on screen
- Every claim lists at least two sources (textbook sections, university lecture pages, original papers) that open in a sheet inside the app, with Back, Forward and Reload
- A-/A+ text size, screen-reader descriptions, no flashing, works offline, no account
- Free with ads at natural breaks. Optional monthly ad-free subscription ($3.99, 7-day free trial). Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings; cancellation takes effect at the next billing cycle. Or watch short videos to earn credits for optional mock tests.

How it is checked: no expert has reviewed this app. It is source-checked: sections, lecture titles and paper records were verified against the live sources, and the examples, questions and figures are original. Content as of 2026-11-17. Not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any university or publisher.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-rewardwell.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-rewardwell.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-rewardwell.html

name: RoadWise: Teen Driver Safety
description:
Safer driving is easier with friends.

RoadWise is a free driving app for new drivers. It scores every drive and shows how you compare with friends.

Set location to Always and RoadWise records your drives on its own, even with the app closed. You can also swipe Start drive before you go.

After each drive you see your score out of 100 and a map of the trip. Hard brakes, hard starts, sharp turns, speeding and phone pickups are pinned where they happened. If RoadWise got one wrong, report it. Riding as a passenger? Tap "Not driving?" and the drive won't count.

Your Safety Rating is one number from 0 to 100 for your last 90 days. It compares your slips with your chances to slip, so extra miles alone don't raise it. Add friends by username or QR code, and the Friends tab ranks you by Safety Rating. You choose what friends see.

Weekly goals, achievements, driving analytics, spots to watch, and a monthly recap to keep your habits on track.

While you drive, RoadWise alerts you with sounds and haptics, only while it's on screen. Your speed and the limit show on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. RoadWise warns you about dangerous weather and pairs with the DashPal dashcam.

Learning to drive? Permit mode logs your practice hours, day and night.

RoadWise is a coaching aid and can miss or misreport events. Keep your eyes on the road.

Terms of Service: https://getroadwise.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://getroadwise.app/privacy

name: RonoxScanner
description:
RonoxScanner turns your iPhone into a pocket scanner. Point the camera at a letter, a receipt, a form or an ID card: the edges are found for you, the page is straightened and cleaned up, and the pages are kept together as one document, ready to share as a PDF.

Your documents stay on your iPhone. There is no account to create and no cloud to upload to. Nothing leaves the device unless you share it.

SCAN
• Multi-page scanning with automatic edge detection, auto-capture and perspective correction
• ID Card mode: scan the front and the back, and get both on one page
• Import photos from Photos or images from Files as new pages

EDIT WITHOUT LOSING THE ORIGINAL
• Looks: Document, Black & White, Grayscale or Photo, with a strength slider
• Brightness and contrast
• Sign a page with a drawn signature, saved for next time
• Add text and today's date to fill in forms
• Add, reorder, rotate and delete pages at any time

ORGANISE
• Recents for what you worked on lately
• A Library with folders, search, sorting and grid or list view
• Select several documents to share, move or delete them together
• A Trash that keeps deleted documents for 30 days

KEEP IT PRIVATE
• The Safe: documents that only open with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• App Lock: lock the whole app with the same check
• No account, no cloud, no ads

SHARE
• Send any document as a PDF through Mail, Messages, Files or any app on your iPhone

RONOXSCANNER PRO
Scanning, importing and editing need RonoxScanner Pro, a monthly auto-renewing subscription through the App Store that starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. You won't be charged before the trial ends, and you can cancel at any time in your App Store settings. Documents you already have can always be opened, organised and shared, with or without a subscription.

RonoxScanner is made by Appronox Ltd.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appronox.com/en/privacy-policy
Terms of Use (Apple's standard licence agreement): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Room 39: Bletchley Park
description:
You never move a ship. You are the duty analyst in the Admiralty's Operational Intelligence Centre, and every day the war arrives as paper: decrypts, sighting reports, agents of uncertain loyalty. You decide what is true, say how sure you are, and send it upstairs to people who will act on your word — exactly as far as they have learned to trust it.

TWO HISTORICAL CAMPAIGNS
THE ATLANTIC, MAY 1941: is BISMARCK preparing, when does she sail, which passage does she take. THE ARCTIC, JULY 1942: TIRPITZ, convoy PQ17, and the scatter order — the worst intelligence decision of the naval war, yours to make better or repeat.

CONFIDENCE IS THE GAME
Western Approaches routes tonight's convoy on your call. Home Fleet raises steam or doesn't. Downing Street will ask you two hard questions and remember the answers. Confidently wrong burns your standing; even odds keeps it but earns nothing, and slowly they stop reading your assessments. Sources have track records you learn from the tally marks. At least one of them may be working for the other side.

THE DESK
• Allocate bombe shifts each day between naval, Luftwaffe and Abwehr ciphers — you cannot read everything
• Work four items properly; skim the rest by headline
• Concur with Commander D., your section head, and share the blame — or overrule him and own the call
• Raise a flag nobody asked for when the evidence says you must
• Request a reconnaissance sortie or put a question to an agent, and pay for it in time
• Read the overnight bulletin: what the enemy actually did, what your assessment caused, and what a different confidence would have cost

THE DAILY SIGNAL
One shared four-day case per day, the same for everyone on Earth, alternating desks. One play, a streak, and a result block to share. Nothing is explained. Work it out from the paper.

ALSO
• Three levels: Probationer, Watchkeeper, Duty Officer
• A three-day Induction that teaches the desk without a manual
• Chronology: your war day by day beside the real timeline
• A 71-second prologue film, original score and fourteen period sound effects
• Poster-style art after the Ministry of Information school, on paper you can almost feel
• Autosave — leave the desk and come back tomorrow

Plays fully offline. No adverts, no tracking, no in-app purchases, no account required.

Design, writing and code: Mark Strong. Art plates via Midjourney; motion via Kling; music via Suno; voice and effects via ElevenLabs — all directed, cut and mixed for this game.

name: Room Check: Hotel Privacy Scan
description:
Check your room in minutes: scan the Wi-Fi, look at nearby Bluetooth, and follow a guided inspection.

Room Check gives you three practical tools for a hotel, rental or any place you stay, plus a report for each stay.

WHAT YOU GET
• Wi-Fi scan: lists devices on the network your phone is joined to, with offline vendor lookup, and checks common camera ports (554, 80, 8000, 8080, 3702) and mDNS/ONVIF responses
• Bluetooth scan: nearby Bluetooth LE devices with signal strength and advertised names
• Guided inspection of 6 areas of the room, with a flashlight lens-glint helper and a magnetometer helper
• Stay privacy reports: log findings and photos, and copy a summary for each trip

HONEST LIMITS
Room Check cannot guarantee it finds every hidden camera. Devices that are offline, on a separate network, on cellular, recording to a memory card, or not advertising over Bluetooth cannot be seen, and the light and magnet helpers also react to ordinary objects. Always look with your own eyes. Scans run on your device and results stay on it.

SUBSCRIPTION
Room Check needs a subscription: weekly with a 3-day free trial, yearly, or a 72-hour trip pass that does not renew. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID account settings.

LEGAL
• Terms of Use (EULA): https://roomcheck.reworked.dev/terms
• Privacy Policy: https://roomcheck.reworked.dev/privacy
• Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ROSWAR: Robot Battle Arena
description:
Enter the arena. Fight. Evolve.

In ROSWAR, 13 robots clash in a 5-minute free-for-all across a city arena. Defeat rival mechs, collect fallen scrap and upgrade your robot while the battle is still raging.

• Shared online arena: fight real players and robots in the same match (real players are marked with a green dot ●)
• 3v3 team mode
• Jump with your jets, climb rooftops, aim and fire
• Collect scrap to level up: your mech grows and unlocks new weapons
• Pick one of 3 powers every 3 levels: a different build every match
• 6 forms: finish the upgrades in the garage and EVOLVE your mech; unlock a minigun, auto rockets, a shield, a plasma cannon and a rocket barrage
• Survive the giant Titan that hunts the arena leader, or take it down

No internet? The game continues instantly against AI opponents. No account needed, no ads.

Start small. Grow stronger. Rule the arena!

name: Rotate 2x2
description:
Rotate 2x2 is a fresh take on number-merging puzzles.

The 4×4 board is split into four 2×2 regions. Hold a region, drag your finger in a circle to twist it, and release to drop it. When two equal tiles end up side by side, they merge into a tile one level higher. A new 1 or 2 fills the empty spot — and if it lines up with another tile, the chain keeps going for a combo.

HOW TO PLAY
• Hold any of the four regions to lift it
• Drag in a circle to rotate it — clockwise or counter-clockwise
• Release to drop it; matching neighbours merge
• Twist back to where you started to cancel for free
• The game ends when no rotation can create a pair

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• A unique twist-to-merge mechanic, easy to learn and hard to put down
• Merges flow toward each region's outer corner, so every turn rewards planning
• Combos multiply your score
• Smooth animations, satisfying sounds and haptic feedback
• Your best score and unfinished game are saved automatically
• Hints when you're stuck
• Plays fully offline — no ads, no account, no data collected
• Available in English, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Thai, Spanish, Japanese, Korean and Chinese

How high can you climb?

name: RoundInk
description: ఈ యాప్‌తో గేమ్ నైట్, ట్రివియా, టోర్నమెంట్ లాంటి ఏ ఆటకైనా సులభంగా స్కోర్ కeep చేయవచ్చు. ఆటగాళ్లను నిర్వహించండి, ప్రతి రౌండ్‌కు కాలమ్ జోడించండి, కస్టమ్ +/− స్టెప్‌లతో వేగంగా స్కోర్ వేయండి. తప్పు స్కోర్ మార్చడం, రద్దు, రౌండ్ వారీ సారాంశం, క్యూములేటివ్ ట్రెండ్ చార్ట్ మరియు ముగిసిన మ్యాచ్‌లను చరిత్రలో చూడండి. అన్ని డేటా ఈ ఇంటర్నెట్ లేకుండా, మీ ఫోన్‌లో భద్రంగా నిల్వ అవుతుంది.

name: Rounds: Pre-Med Hours
description:
Rounds is a clean, simple logbook for the road to medical school.

Add the places and people you spend time with: a clinical job, a hospital volunteer role, a physician you shadow. Then log each shift in a few taps, with a note while it's fresh. Rounds adds it all up, charts your progress toward your goals, and exports a tidy record you can share or keep.

• Log a shift in seconds: pick the experience, the date and the time, and write what you did, saw or learned
• Shift clock: start it when you arrive, stop it when you leave, and the time fills itself in
• Star meaningful moments to find them again for essays and interviews
• Experiences hold what an application asks for: category, paid or unpaid, organization, dates, a contact, and a description with a 700-character counter
• See the matching AMCAS experience type for each experience
• Progress toward your hour goals for clinical work, shadowing and volunteering
• Charts of your running total and your hours per week or month
• Export as Markdown, CSV, JSON or plain text; send it with Mail, Messages or AirDrop, or save it to Files
• The JSON export is a complete backup you can restore
• Light and dark mode
• Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your log never leaves your iPhone unless you export it.

Rounds is a personal logbook, not a clinical record. Keep patient names and other identifiers out of your notes.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the AAMC. AMCAS is a registered trademark of the Association of American Medical Colleges.

name: Route Due: Pest Scheduler
description:
Your recurring schedule lives in your head.
Quarterly accounts, termite stations, mosquito season and that callback you promised last Tuesday, all held together by memory and a paper calendar.
Route Due puts every recurring pest service on one calm board, so you always know who's due.

DUE BOARD
• Overdue, this week and next 30 days at a glance
• Swipe or tap Done to log a service. The next due date sets itself

PEST PLANS THAT MATCH YOUR WORK
• Quarterly general pest, monthly, bi-monthly
• Termite bait monitoring and rodent stations on your cycle
• Mosquito season: pick the months you treat
• Initial + follow-up in X days, or custom every X weeks

CALLBACKS AND RE-TREATS
• Schedule a free one-off re-service without touching the plan
• Call or map a customer in one tap

CALENDAR AND REVENUE
• Month view with services due per day
• Monthly and yearly recurring revenue (Pro)

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• No account, no signup, no server
• Import customers from CSV; export anytime with Pro

Free for up to 25 customers. Route Due Pro ($4.99/month, auto-renews) unlocks unlimited customers, CSV export and Revenue.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Made by the team behind PestShift.

name: Rowcycle
description:
Rowcycle
ಸಸ್ಯ ಸಂಗ್ರಹ, ಪ್ರದೇಶ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಘಟನಾ ದಿನಚರಿಯನ್ನು ಒಟ್ಟುಗೂಡಿಸುವ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಉಪಕರಣ. ಕ್ಯಾಲೆಂಡರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಜ್ಞಾಪನೆಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಮತ್ತು ತಪಾಸಣೆಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಬೇಡಿ; ಸಮಸ್ಯೆ ಎದ್ದರೆ ಟಿಪ್ಪಣಿ ಮತ್ತು ಚಿತ್ರ ಬಿಡಿ. ಫೈಲ್ ರಫ್ತು ಮಾಡಿ ಬ್ಯಾಕಪ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹದಿನಲ್ಲೇ.

name: RS Automation
description:
Con RS Automation puoi controllare dal tuo iPhone le centraline Afrodite per incubatrici associate al tuo account. Seleziona una centralina per leggere temperatura e umidità, confrontarle con i valori impostati e consultarne l’andamento nei grafici.

Gli avvisi push su iPhone sono attualmente disponibili per gli account abilitati da RS Automation. Per questi account, in caso di temperatura alta o bassa, umidità alta o bassa o perdita di connessione, il servizio invia un promemoria ogni minuto finché l’allarme resta attivo. I promemoria terminano quando la condizione rientra.

Per utilizzare l’app servono una centralina Afrodite compatibile, il codice fornito con la centralina, un account e una connessione Internet.

name: Rune Slide
description:
Entre em uma masmorra arcana onde cada movimento conta. Em Rune Slide, você guia um pequeno mago por câmaras cheias de obstáculos, mecanismos e inimigos.

Deslize em quatro direções, observe as ameaças e escolha o momento certo para agir. Use Pedra para criar paradas e bloquear caminhos, Gelo para congelar ameaças e Raio para abrir passagem. Cada ação faz os inimigos avançarem: planeje seus movimentos para alcançar a runa.

• Resolva puzzles por turnos em uma campanha de câmaras conectadas.
• Descubra magias e combine seus efeitos com mecanismos da masmorra.
• Enfrente inimigos e procure caminhos melhores para conquistar estrelas.
• Revise câmaras concluídas e tente superar suas próprias marcas.
• Jogue offline, com interface em português e inglês.

name: Runehewn: Viking Dice Duels
description:
Runehewn is a single-player tactical dice game inspired by Norse runes. Roll six dice, keep the faces you need, and reroll the rest. Watch which faces your opponent keeps before you commit to attack, guard, or charge.

Arrange matching symbols side by side to build stronger chains. Set each Prism to the symbol that fits your plan, and spend saved energy on an ability when the moment is right.

CLASSIC DUEL
Take on aggressive or defensive opponents in offline duels. After each round, see how both plans played out and use what you learned in the next round.

THREE-BATTLE CAMPAIGN
Win a fight to visit the forge. Replace a face on one of your dice and take your upgraded set into the next battle. Campaign progress is saved on your device.

LEARN BY PLAYING
Follow the interactive tutorial through your first round, or open the rules to look up a symbol or an ability.

Play offline on iPhone. No account is required.

name: RutaLente
description:
Documentá un recorrido de campo con fotos, videos y ubicación GPS. Iniciá un recorrido, tocá para enfocar y elegí una lente o ajustá el zoom con dos dedos. Las opciones de resolución, lentes y formatos dependen de tu iPhone.

Revisá tus tomas en la galería, agregá observaciones y abrí cada ubicación en el mapa. Las fotos exportadas incluyen las coordenadas visibles y un código QR. Seleccioná hasta 50 tomas para compartir un ZIP con los archivos, las observaciones en CSV y el recorrido en GPX para trabajar en tu Mac.

Los primeros tres días desde la obtención de la app son gratuitos. Después, para iniciar recorridos y capturar nuevas tomas necesitás un plan mensual o anual. Podés seguir consultando y exportando los recorridos guardados. Apple muestra el precio de tu tienda antes de confirmar y gestiona la renovación automática. Podés cancelar en tu cuenta de Apple.

Condiciones de uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacidad: https://rutalente.paolinho17.chatgpt.site/privacidad.html

name: Saju Chart: BaZi Four Pillars
description:
A BaZi (Four Pillars / Korean saju) calculator that shows why every character is what it is.
Works offline. Your birth data never leaves your phone.

■ Tap any character to see where it came from
· Month pillar: which solar term (exact time) you were born after, and how the month stem follows from the year stem
· Hour pillar: your clock corrected for the longitude of your birthplace (Seoul ≈ −32 min), and which double-hour that lands in
· Day pillar: for births after 23:00, whether the day changes under the midnight rule
· Years when Korea changed its standard time, and daylight-saving years, use the legal time of that day

■ School switch — the disputed rules are out in the open
Midnight rule (unified / split Zi hour), time correction (longitude / true solar time / none), luck-start rounding, luck direction, hidden-stem table, twelve stages.
Change one and the characters that change in your chart turn red.

■ Luck pillars with their reasons
"Yang year, male → forward; 25.44 days to the next solar term ÷ 3 = luck starts at 8", and you can flip the direction to compare side by side.

■ Accuracy log
How many cases we checked against Korea Astronomy and Space Science Institute data, two public manse calendars and two calculation libraries, and why results differ where they do.

■ Free and PRO
Free: one chart, every explanation, the school switch, the accuracy log, the first 3 luck pillars.
PRO (one-time purchase, not a subscription): all 10 luck pillars, the year/month/day pillar calendar for 1900–2100 (free shows this year and month). Never renews.
Payment goes through your App Store / Google Play account; refunds follow each store's process. Use "Restore Purchases" on another device.

■ Please note
Readings are only what the calculation rules produce. Nothing here predicts the future. For entertainment and reference; talk to a professional about health, money or legal matters.
No sign-up, no login. Birth data stays on the device.
Privacy policy: https://saju.jayjay.co.kr/privacy-en

name: Santi Treinos
description:
O app da Santi Treinos reúne natação, ciclismo, corrida e força num plano só. A semana que o seu treinador montou chega no celular com cada sessão detalhada, e o que você fez volta para ele já analisado.

No pedal e na corrida, o treino estruturado vai para o relógio ou para o ciclocomputador, com os alvos de potência, ritmo ou frequência cardíaca de cada etapa. A atividade volta com zonas, carga e o quanto você cumpriu do que estava no plano. Na natação, a série chega com as distâncias, os intervalos e o ritmo por 100 metros.

No app:
- Natação, ciclismo, corrida e força prescritos pelos treinadores da Santi Treinos
- Treino enviado para o Garmin, com as atividades voltando sozinhas
- Apple Watch e outros relógios entram pelo app Saúde do iPhone
- Carga, fadiga, forma e zonas calculadas a partir dos seus próprios treinos
- Sono, prontidão e check-in do dia
- Calendário com as suas provas, das curtas ao Ironman
- Conversa direta com o treinador
- Feed da equipe, com curtidas e comentários

Feito para os atletas da Santi Treinos.

Powered by Metrycs.

AVISO IMPORTANTE
O Santi Treinos é um aplicativo de treinamento esportivo e não é um dispositivo médico. Os números, gráficos, alertas e sugestões do app existem para orientar treino e descanso: eles não se destinam a diagnosticar, tratar, curar nem prevenir qualquer doença ou condição médica, e não substituem a avaliação de um médico ou profissional de saúde. Antes de começar ou mudar um programa de treinos, procure orientação profissional. Se sentir dor, falta de ar, tontura ou qualquer sintoma incomum, interrompa o exercício e busque atendimento médico.

name: SavveKey
description:
SavveKey keeps your team's passwords, logins and authenticator codes in one encrypted vault, and this app puts that vault on your iPhone.

Your vault is locked and unlocked on your device. Your master password and Secret Key never leave your iPhone, and the SavveKey server only stores data it cannot read.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Sign in to your organization's SavveKey server with your email, master password and Secret Key.
- See every login, card and note you can open, in your own vault and in the shared folders your team gives you.
- Copy a username, password or code with one tap. Copied secrets clear from the clipboard after 90 seconds.
- Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID after the first sign-in, and lock again with one tap.
- Authenticator codes: add a two-step sign-in key by scanning the website's QR code or pasting it, and see the current six-digit code with the seconds left.
- Ask before showing: items your team marks as sensitive, and your codes if you choose, stay hidden until Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode confirms it's you.
- Two-step sign-in to SavveKey itself with a code sent to your email.

BUILT FOR TEAMS
SavveKey is made for businesses and the IT teams that look after them. Administrators decide who sees which folders, and people who leave lose access to new keys.

HOW YOUR DATA IS PROTECTED
- End-to-end encryption: items are encrypted and decrypted only on your devices.
- Your Secret Key adds a second, long random key to your master password, so a guessed password alone is not enough.
- The app keeps its unlock key in the iPhone keychain, released only by Face ID or Touch ID on this device.
- No ads, no tracking and no analytics.

You need a SavveKey account to use this app. Sign up or ask your administrator at savvekey.com.

name: Scaffold Dash: Climb & Dodge
description:
Meet Dash, the bravest builder on site. Climb the scaffold, dodge everything the site throws at you and top out every job!

ONE TAP TO PLAY
Dash climbs automatically. Tap anywhere to jump to the other side of the scaffold. Hammers, spanners, bricks and paint pots rain down from above, so pick your side and grab the coins on the way up.

10 SITES, 100 LEVELS
Start on a housing estate and work your way up an office block, a railway bridge, a hospital wing, a stadium, a skyscraper, a cathedral, a crane yard and an oil rig, all the way to a space elevator. Every site brings a new twist: pigeons, wind, wet paint, the night shift, loose planks, swinging girders, storms and zero gravity.

TOPPING OUT
Every tenth level is a big boss climb to finish the building. Reach the top to earn stars, coins and gems.

DAILY CLIMB
A brand-new challenge every day, the same for every player. Keep your streak going for bonus rewards, plus a daily login reward.

ENDLESS MODE
How high can you go? Beat your best and share your climb with friends.

POWER-UPS AND OUTFITS
Hard Hat, Magnet and Jetpack get you out of trouble. Dress Dash in Hi-Vis Yellow, Camo, Black Tie, Solid Gold, Astronaut, Superhero and more.

STUCK?
Use a Lift Pass to ride past any level and come back for the stars later.

name: Scaleway ControlRoom
description:
Every hour an idle Scaleway instance runs, you pay for it. ControlRoom puts all your instances in your pocket, so stopping one takes two taps instead of a laptop.

ALL YOUR INSTANCES IN ONE LIST
Every zone, every project, running instances first, with their price per hour. Search by name or tag, or show only what is running.

START, STOP AND REBOOT
Stop the staging server you forgot, start it again when you need it, or reboot a stuck machine. Stopping asks first, so nothing goes down by accident.

LOGS AND METRICS
See the logs and metrics of your serverless containers, functions and jobs straight from Cockpit, as charts and log lines, for the last 15 minutes, hour or day. For instances, the app shows how to start sending both.

EVERYTHING ELSE
Databases, Redis, volumes, load balancers, IPs, domains, transactional email, secrets and more, in one searchable list grouped by type, location or project.

SEE WHAT IT COSTS
Your organization's costs so far this month, straight from Scaleway billing, with a breakdown by category and by project and the months before.

SEVERAL ORGANIZATIONS
Add an API key for each organization or project. When two keys can see the same instance, it is shown once.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Your API keys are stored in the iPhone keychain
- The app talks only to Scaleway's own API: there is no ControlRoom server
- No account, no analytics, no tracking
- Use a key with only the permissions you want the app to have

CONTROLROOM PRO
Free: your instances, starting, stopping and rebooting them, and this month's total cost. Pro adds serverless containers, functions and jobs, every other resource, logs and metrics, cost details by category and project with the months before, and more than one API key.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly; the price in your currency is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and the subscription renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

TRY IT WITHOUT A KEY
The built-in demo shows the whole app with made-up servers and costs.

ControlRoom is an independent app. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Scaleway.

name: Scherelle Paper Play
description:
The same folded outline can hide a different order of paper.

Scherelle Paper Play asks you to work from the original sheet through the folded stack and back to the final unfolding. Existing openings and protected gold make the depth of a cut matter as much as its position.

FOLLOW THE SOURCE LAYERS
Choose from the request's permitted seams and fold directions. A moving stack turns over and lands above the stationary paper, changing the order beneath the blade. Inspect the original coordinates from top to bottom to understand which parts of the unfolded sheet occupy that position. Each axis can be folded once; beginning to cut locks the folds.

CHOOSE HOW FAR THE BLADE GOES
Depth counts remaining paper. An existing opening contributes no paper, so the blade skips it and can reach a lower source layer. A protected gold region anywhere within the selected reach rejects the entire cut without spending the cut allowance. Read the stack before committing: the visible top alone cannot tell you which original cells will be removed.

UNFOLD TO CHECK THE REQUEST
The task is to produce the requested openings while preserving the protected paper within the available cuts. Compare the actual unfolded source with the target. The result distinguishes openings that were already present from newly removed layers, making the consequence of your chosen depth visible.

FOURTEEN PRIMARY REQUESTS
Work with 4x4 and 6x6 sheets, central and offset seams, unequal stacks and budgets of one to four cuts. Later requests explore buried openings, gold at different layer ranks and folds whose visible footprints agree while their safe source layers differ. Seven earlier depth studies remain separately accessible, alongside the original 40-work folio and its existing progress.

REHEARSE A FOLD BEFORE CUTTING
A separate rehearsal copies your current work. Try legal folds, choose a stack and vary the blade depth. Source-cell outlines and the ordered layer list show the paper reached, skipped openings and any gold that blocks the whole cut. Compare the current sheet with its projected unfolding, then close to return to your unchanged formal work. Rehearsal does not apply a cut to the saved request.

A five-step hands-on lesson introduces folding, source inspection and blade depth using temporary paper. Formal work can be resumed later; undo restores paper and cut allowance while the unfinished request retains recorded assistance and retry costs.

Core paper work runs offline with local progress. English and Russian text are available, with English as the default.

name: SchoolPocket

name: Seed Batch Calendar
description:
Know your next sowing date from your own seed packet.
Enter a plant name and the packet timing, such as 6 weeks before a reference date you choose, and the sowing date appears right away.
One calm calendar for every seed batch, from sowing to transplant. No account needed.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Type what you're sowing.
2. Pick your reference date (for example the last frost date from your own notes) and the weeks before or after from the packet, or simply choose a sowing date.
3. See the calculated sowing date and save the batch.

PLAN FROM YOUR PACKET NOTES
- Weeks and days before or after a reference date that you enter. The app never looks up weather or forecasts.
- Optional germination window, such as 7 to 14 days after sowing.
- Optional transplant date: a fixed date you choose, or a number of days after sowing.
- Clear messages when a number doesn't add up, like an earliest day after the latest.

TRACK EACH SEED BATCH
- Mark Sown, Germinated, Transplanted and Complete with the real date.
- Planned and actual dates side by side, and which one the estimates count from.
- When you record the actual sowing day, the app shows exactly which estimates would move before anything changes. Fixed dates and recorded steps stay put.
- Today shows what is overdue, due today and coming up. A compact calendar marks only the dates from your own batches.

SPACE OUT SUCCESSIVE SOWINGS (PRO)
- Choose the first sowing date, the gap in days and how many batches (2 to 24), preview every date, then create them all at once.

KEEP PLANTING REMINDERS TOGETHER
- Optional local reminders for sowing, checking for seedlings and transplanting, at a time you choose.
- The app asks for notification permission only when you turn a reminder on. Everything else works without it.
- Reminder text is generic by default, because notifications can appear on the lock screen. Plant names are optional.
- One list shows every reminder and the exact day and time it is scheduled. The nearest 50 are kept scheduled; opening the app refreshes later ones.

FREE
- Up to three active batches; completing a batch frees a slot and keeps its history
- Reference-date and sowing-date planning, germination and transplant dates
- Local reminders
- Completed batch history
- JSON backup export and import

PRO
- More active batches
- Reusable templates of your own packet timing
- Succession sowing
- Calendar file (.ics) export of the batches you choose, through the share sheet

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Every batch stays readable and exportable, active batches can still be progressed and completed, and reminders you set up stay scheduled.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your batches, dates, notes and reminder settings are stored on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. The app doesn't access your location, calendar, photos or contacts.

A personal planning tool based on the dates, intervals and notes you supply. It doesn't provide weather, frost forecasts, crop-specific planting advice or guarantees of germination or harvest. Dates are estimates; check your seed packet and local conditions.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

Meet the dogs around you with SeeName Dog, a simple educational breed companion for dog lovers, families, students and curious explorers.

name: Seeno: Offline Party Games
description:
Turn one iPhone or iPad into game night. Pass it around the table, or set it down where everyone can reach.

Start with three free games
• Funny Face. Place the eyes and mouth without seeing where the other pieces went. Reveal your creation together.
• Perfect Timing. When the clock disappears, count in your head. Who can stop closest to the target?
• Pack & Recall. Remember everything already in the suitcase, add an item of your own, and pass it on.

On iPhone Duo, pass the closed phone to the next player or prop it half-open on the table. In Funny Face, place each piece on the near half and let everyone see the finished face together.

One purchase unlocks every other game supported on your device. That’s 91 more on iPhone or 99 more on iPad. Draw, act, bluff, solve a mystery, or challenge a friend to a two-player duel. iPad adds tabletop games that put the larger screen to work.

Choose by group size or mood. Check the rules before you start or tap the book during a round. Games that call for paper, playing cards, or other supplies tell you what to bring.

Play offline in English or Japanese. No ads, player accounts, or subscriptions. An App Store connection is required to purchase or restore.

name: SelfieBuddy – Selfie Coach
description:
The back camera on your iPhone takes far better photos than the front one. The only problem: you can't see the screen. SelfieBuddy fixes that. It watches the camera for you, tells you how to aim with voice tips, smart beeps and haptics, waits until everything looks right, then takes the photo automatically.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Prop up your phone or hold it out with the back camera facing you.
2. Tap Start. The button shows your guidance mode.
3. Follow the voice and beeps: "Tip the phone up." "Turn the phone to your left." "Give us a smile."
4. When you're in position, hold still. SelfieBuddy takes the shot with a shutter sound and saves it to your library.

CHOOSE HOW YOU'RE GUIDED
• Voice & Beep Guide: spoken tips plus beeps.
• Voice Guide: just the spoken tips.
• Beep Guide: just the beeps, no talking.
• Auto Pilot: no sound until the shutter. Tap Start and the photo is taken the moment you're in position.
• Haptics: gentle taps as you get closer, a buzz when you're locked in, and a snap when the photo is taken.
• Position Judgment: Easy for quick, forgiving framing, Medium for everyday selfies, or Hard for precise composition.

BEEPS THAT TELL YOU WHAT TO DO
Like a parking sensor, the beeps speed up as you get closer to the perfect position, then go silent when you're there. Each adjustment has its own sound:
• Plain beeps: turn the phone left or right. With headphones, they come from the side to turn toward.
• Rising tone: tip the phone up.
• Falling tone: tip the phone down.
• Double beep: move closer or take a step back.
Works even with the silent switch on.

CAPTURE YOUR WAY
• Timer: a quick 1-second hold, or a 3- or 5-second countdown with a big on-screen count and a spoken "3, 2, 1".
• Single Shot: one perfect photo.
• 5-Shot Rapid Burst and 10-Shot Action Burst: never miss the moment.
• 3-Pose Photo Booth: three photos in a row, with a reminder to switch poses between each.
• Flash blink: a soft blink of the rear light right before the shot, so you know exactly when it's taken.

WAITS FOR THE GOOD SHOT
Turn on the checks you care about, and auto-capture waits until they pass:
• Light: your face isn't too dark or washed out, even with a bright window behind you.
• Focus: your face is sharp and the camera has finished focusing.
• Eyes: no more photos caught mid-blink.
• Smile: waits for a smile, or switch it off for a more serious look.

ZOOM AND PHOTO SHAPE
• Zoom buttons for ultra-wide 0.5×, 1×, 2× and your iPhone's telephoto lens.
• Photo shapes: classic 4:3, square 1:1, widescreen 16:9, or Full screen to match your display. The area outside your photo is dimmed, and the framing tips follow your shape.
• Your zoom, shape, timer and photo mode are remembered.

A VOICE YOU LIKE
Pick any voice installed on your iPhone and hear a sample. SelfieBuddy automatically uses the best one, including the natural-sounding Premium and Enhanced voices.

DESIGNED FOR REAL LIFE
• Full-screen camera in portrait or landscape, with photos always saved upright.
• Full-quality photos saved straight to your Photos library, with their date and location.
• Flashlight button to brighten your face.
• Recovers smoothly from phone calls and other interruptions.
• Built-in How to Use guide.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The camera view is analyzed on your device and is never recorded, stored or uploaded.
• Add-only photo access: SelfieBuddy can save new photos but can't see your existing library.
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.

SIMPLE PRICING
Try every feature free for your first 50 photos. Unlock SelfieBuddy Pro with a one-time purchase for unlimited photos on all your devices. No subscription.

Questions or ideas? Visit our support page or email hx_tang@hotmail.com.

name: Senso – Sensori di casa
description:
Senso raccoglie tutti i sensori della tua casa in un posto solo, e li mostra come non li hai mai visti.

Il cielo cambia con l'ora del giorno, dall'alba alla notte, e sopra ci sono le informazioni che contano: la temperatura fuori, com'è in casa, cosa c'è da guardare.

FUORI E DENTRO
• Temperatura fuori in grande, con minima, massima e la giornata ora per ora
• Niente sensore fuori? Accendi il meteo della zona: previsioni per le prossime ore, sostituite dal dato vero man mano che arriva
• Ogni stanza con temperatura, umidità, CO₂, qualità dell'aria e luce
• Porte e finestre, movimento, presenza, perdite d'acqua, fumo e monossido
• «Cose da guardare»: finestra aperta da troppo, pila scarica, garage aperto, serratura bloccata, sensore che non risponde

COMANDI A PORTATA DI DITO
• Luci, prese e interruttori: accendi, spegni, regola la luminosità
• Tende e tapparelle, porta del garage, serrature
• Termostati e condizionatori: temperatura e modo
• Purificatori, ventilatori, umidificatori, valvole e allarme
• Per le cose importanti (aprire, spegnere, disinserire) Senso chiede sempre conferma

WIDGET
• Piccolo, medio e grande per la schermata Home, e widget per la schermata di blocco
• Più case? Ogni widget può mostrare la sua

TUTTE LE MARCHE
• Qualunque sensore collegato all'app Casa di Apple, anche Matter
• Shelly, SwitchBot e Philips Hue anche se non sono nell'app Casa: Senso li trova in rete o si collega con un tocco
• Dai sensori di movimento Hue anche la temperatura, che l'app Casa non mostra

SU MISURA
• Scegli il sensore di fuori, i nomi, l'ordine delle stanze, cosa nascondere
• Soglie di freddo, caldo, umidità e CO₂ per i colori
• °C o °F

Privacy: nessun account, nessun server nostro, nessuna pubblicità. I dati della casa restano sul tuo iPhone. Se accendi il meteo, al servizio meteo arriva solo la zona, non l'indirizzo.

Richiede una casa configurata nell'app Casa di Apple, oppure apparecchi Shelly, SwitchBot o Philips Hue.

name: SeoLead: SEO for WordPress
description:

You answer yes or no. That is all. SeoLead applies only the changes you said yes to, through its WordPress plugin, and you can undo each one from the History.

Four weeks after each change, SeoLead measures what moved on the page in Google, in Bing and in your visit figures, and compares it with the rest of your site. The figures show what changed, not why, and SeoLead says so.

Connect Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools with no password to share. The app shows short videos for each connection.

SeoLead uses the Lead account shared by the Lead apps. Create it in the app or sign in with yours, and delete it from the app whenever you like. The app sells nothing.

name: Sepeda Onthel Simulator
description:
The streetlights come on. Spectators line the road. Two BMX bikes roll up to a chalk line and the starter raises his cap. When it drops, pedal!

By day, ride your grandfather’s old onthel bicycle through a small Indonesian town, delivering iced tea, bakso, and parcels. Save up for your first BMX. By night, head to the straightaway near the stadium and find out who’s quickest.

NIGHT RACING
• Watch the cap. Jump the start and it’s a false start. Hesitate and your rival gets away.
• Alternate left and right pedal strokes, manage your stamina, and tuck low for the finish.
• Race 100, 150, or 200 metres, head-to-head or with up to four riders. Ride Stadium Road at night or the village lane at dusk.
• Read your time slip after each race: reaction time, the first 30 metres, top speed, and the gap at the line. Choose Casual or Rhythm controls and switch between three camera angles.

RIDE WITH FRIENDS
• Create a room and share its code. Explore town with up to eight players, or line up for a drag race with up to four. AI riders can fill empty lanes.
• Look for your friends’ coloured name tags in town and on the track.

MEET THE LOCAL RIVALS
• Take on eight rivals and two champions. Some are quick off the line, others come alive at the finish. They can jump the start or lose their nerve when you pass, and they remember your last race.
• Agree on a distance, a single race or best of three, and a head start for the slower rider. Climb each venue’s rankings and earn reputation through daily challenges.

BUILD YOUR BMX
• Swap the gearing, rims, tyres, handlebars, saddle, cranks, and pedals. Adjust saddle height and bar position, pick your colours, and finish the bike with liveries and stickers.
• Try parts on the test track before you buy. Save up to three setups per bike and choose your rider and outfit colour.

AT THE BMX PARK
• Hit the ramps, quarter pipe, and tabletop jump beside the town square. Pull a tabletop, X-up, no-hander, no-footer, or 360. Ride freely or challenge a local rider to a trick contest.

AROUND TOWN
• Hop off and deliver orders to the door. As afternoon turns to night, pedestrians, cyclists, becak pedicabs, and motorbikes share the streets. Visit the bike shop and food stalls, pick up daily jobs, or watch rivals race.
• Chase weekly online times by distance and bike class. The Sidomulyo board keeps your personal records against local rivals, even offline.

Once installed, you can play solo offline. Multiplayer and weekly online leaderboards need an internet connection. Race wins earn in-game coins with no cash value. The game includes ads and optional coin purchases. You can earn bikes and parts by playing.
