name: SHAMS.
description:
SHAMS. is the all-in-one companion for students: plan your day, stay focused, keep your prayers and Quran on track, and know where your grades stand.

TODOS, ROUTINES AND DEADLINES
Capture tasks in lists, set due dates, and build daily or weekly routines so the important things happen without you having to remember them.

FOCUS TIMER AND STREAKS
Start a focus session, stay in the zone, and build a study streak you will not want to break.

PRAYER, QIBLA AND QURAN
Accurate prayer times for where you are, a Qibla compass, and the Quran to read at your own pace. Your location is used only when you tap Use my location, is rounded to about 1 km, and is never shared.

GPA AND COURSES
Track your courses and see your GPA as your semester unfolds.

FRIENDS
Add friends to keep each other motivated.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
Sign in with Google or GitHub. SHAMS. has no ads and no tracking, and you can delete your account and data at any time from Settings.

name: SHAPPU
description:
SHAPPU is a cocktail and mocktail guide with a Kerala soul. Browse 124 recipes, step through each one in a guided mixing mode, and keep a bar inventory so the app shows exactly what you can make right now.

• Free: 18 classics including Old Fashioned, Negroni, Margarita and Mojito
• Premium (one-time purchase, no subscription): all 124 drinks
• My Bar and "What can I make?" matching, shopping list, favourites, journal, and your own recipes
• Mocktails and zero-proof drinks
• Dark, light or automatic appearance
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device.

Intended for adults of legal drinking age. Please drink responsibly.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.nillavu.com/shappu/privacy/

name: Sheafledger
description: Sheafledger ಒಂದು ಸರಳ ಹಾಗೂ ಸ್ಥಳೀಯ ಖರ್ಚು ನೋಟ್ಬುಕ್. ನೀವು ಆದಾಯ, ವೆಚ್ಚ ಮತ್ತು ಹಣವರ್ಗಾಟುಗಳನ್ನು ದಿನವಾರ ನೋಂದಣಿ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು; ವರ್ಗಗಳು, ಐಕಾನ್ಗಳು, ಬಹು ಖಾತೆಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಮಾಸಿಕ ಬಜೆಟ್ ಒಂದೇ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ. ಮಾಸಿಕ ವರದಿಗೆ ಸ್ವಯಂ-ಆಕೃತ ಪೈ ಚಾರ್ಟ್ ಲಭ್ಯ. ಅನೇಕ ಫಿಲ್ಟರ್‌ಗಳಿಂದ ಹುಡುಕಿ, ಟೇಬಲ್ ಪಠ್ಯವಾಗಿ ರಫ್ತು ಮಾಡಿ. ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಡೇಟಾ ಈ ಫೋನ್ನಲ್ಲೇ ಸಂಗ್ರಹಣೆ—ಇಂಟರ್ನೆಟ್ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ (ಕುರಿತು ನಮ್ಮ ಲಿಂಕ್ ತೆರೆಯುವ ಹೊರತು).

name: Shift Calendar: Work Shifts
description:
Shift Calendar helps shift workers track their rotating work schedules with ease.

Whether you work 2-2-3, 4-on 4-off, or any custom rotation, Shift Calendar: Work Shifts keeps you organized so you always know when you're working next.

KEY FEATURES:
• Visual monthly calendar showing all your shifts at a glance
• Flexible shift rotation setup — daily, weekly, or custom cycles
• Multiple shift types with custom names and colors
• Day detail view: see exact hours for any day
• Works fully offline — no account required
• Privacy-first: all data stays on your device

Perfect for nurses, firefighters, police officers, factory workers, security guards, and anyone with a rotating or irregular work schedule.

name: Shiftgem: Rota & Clock In
description:
Shiftgem is the app for staff who work on site. See your rota, clock in and out at the job site, and keep track of your hours.

• See today's and upcoming shifts, with the job site on a map
• Clock in and out with one tap — it works without signal and sends when you're back online
• Ask for time off and see what's booked
• Swap shifts with a colleague and claim open shifts
• Set when you can and can't work
• Read announcements from your manager
• Get a reminder before your shift starts

Your company may also turn on tasks for each shift, forms and incident reports, expenses and mileage, qualifications, selfie checks and your pay and holiday balance.

Your location is used only while you're clocked in — to confirm you're at the job site and show your route to your manager. Nothing is collected before you clock in or after you clock out, and you can always see when it's on.

Your company creates your account on shiftgem.com — ask your manager for your sign-in details.

name: Shikaku: Rectangle Puzzles
description:
Divide the grid into rectangles – one number in each, and the number tells its size!

Shikaku (also known as Rectangles or Divide by Box) is a classic Japanese logic puzzle. Split the board into rectangles so that every rectangle contains exactly one number, and that number equals its area. Simple rules, deep logic – no guessing needed.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 16,000 free levels in 16 board sizes, from 5×5 to 12×12
• A smooth difficulty curve: easy puzzles first, harder ones mixed in step by step
• Daily puzzle: a new challenge every day – keep your streak alive
• Game Center: best-time leaderboards for every board size and 12 achievements
• Every puzzle is checked by a solver: exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone
• Unlimited puzzles: a generator creates new puzzles on your device, in the size and difficulty you choose
• Smart hints: shows a correct rectangle or marks the wrong ones
• Colourful rectangles – or the classic look, your choice
• Undo, redo and restart; your progress is saved automatically
• Statistics, timer and best times for every board size
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, with full-screen mode for big boards
• Light and dark mode, sounds and gentle vibration
• Plays offline – no account, no internet needed
• 8 languages: English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Português, Nederlands, Български

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag across the grid to draw a rectangle
• Each rectangle must contain exactly one number
• The number shows how many cells the rectangle covers
• Rectangles cannot overlap and must cover the whole board
• Tap a rectangle to remove it

All levels are free. Ads may appear between puzzles (at most once every 4 minutes). A one-time "Remove Ads" purchase removes them forever.

Love Sudoku, Nonograms, Kakuro or other brain teasers? Shikaku is your new favourite logic game.

name: Shimi: AI Photo Enhancer
description:
Shimi is a private AI photo and video studio for iPhone. It sharpens, cleans and upscales your pictures right on your device, with no account and no uploads.

ENHANCE
• Upscale photos 2× and 4× for free
• Choose a scene look, or let Shimi suggest one
• Compare before and after

CREATE AND CLEAN UP
• Make wallpapers that fit your iPhone
• Remove backgrounds
• Erase marks, objects and text

SHIMI PRO
• 8× and 12× upscaling, up to 8192 pixels on the long side
• Batch up to 20 photos
• Video upscaling to 4K

Shimi Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://haafisw.github.io/shimi/privacy.html

name: Shooting Kitty
description:
Shooting Kitty is a bubble shooter starring cats.

A cat spins its wheel to aim, then launches a bubble with a fish inside. Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them and drop the fish to the floor. Another cat runs in and carries the fish away.

■ How to play
• Aim with the joystick on the left and shoot with the FIRE button on the right.
• Match 3 or more bubbles of the same color to pop them.
• The ceiling drops one row every 8 shots.
• If the bubbles cross the dotted line, it's game over!

■ Features
• Fish bubbles in 7 colors
• Endless rounds that get harder as you go
• Score and fish count
• Continue from the round you left
• Retry the round you failed right away
• iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad support
• English and Korean

■ Ads and purchases
Free to play, with ads that may appear between rounds. Buy "Remove Ads" once in Settings to play without ads.

name: ShotClean: Delete Screenshots
description:
Your camera roll is full of screenshots you'll never look at again: boarding passes, recipes, directions, receipts, the same screen captured three times. ShotClean finds them all and lets you clear them out in minutes.

SWIPE TO CLEAN
Every screenshot appears as a card. Swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. Changed your mind? Undo.

DUPLICATES FIRST
ShotClean spots screenshots that are nearly identical and shows them first, keeping the sharpest copy. One tap marks every duplicate.

SEE WHAT YOU SAVE
Before anything is deleted you see exactly how much space you'll get back. Nothing is removed until you confirm.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your iPhone. No account, no uploads, no analytics, no ads.

GOOD TO KNOW
iOS keeps deleted photos in Recently Deleted for 30 days. Empty that album in Photos to free the space right away.

SHOTCLEAN PRO
Your first 10 deletions are free. ShotClean Pro unlocks unlimited deletions as a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://aliosmanunaldi.github.io/shotclean/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://aliosmanunaldi.github.io/shotclean/privacy.html

name: Signet – Bible et classiques
description:
Signet est une liseuse pensée pour les grands textes : la Bible, les Pères de l’Église, Pascal, saint Augustin et les philosophes. Une page de papier, une belle typographie, des pages qui tournent sous le doigt, et rien qui distraie de la lecture.

LA BIBLE EN ENTIER
• Les 66 livres de la Bible Louis Segond 1910
• Lecture chapitre par chapitre, en mode livre
• Recherche dans tout le texte
• Un verset du jour sur l’accueil
• Reprendre là où vous vous étiez arrêté

LES GRANDS TEXTES, DANS LE DOMAINE PUBLIC
• Pascal, Pensées
• Saint Augustin, Les Confessions
• L’Imitation de Jésus-Christ
• John Bunyan, Le Voyage du pèlerin
• Les Pères apostoliques : la Didachè, Clément de Rome, Ignace d’Antioche, Polycarpe de Smyrne, Justin Martyr
• Les philosophes : Platon (Apologie de Socrate, Criton), Marc Aurèle, Épictète, Descartes
Chaque texte indique sa traduction et son édition d’origine.

CE QU’EN DISAIENT LES PÈRES
Choisissez un thème (la Trinité, le baptême, la Cène, la grâce, l’Église…) et lisez ce qu’en ont écrit les premiers chrétiens, dans l’ordre des années.

DEMANDER AU LIVRE
Touchez l’étoile en haut de la page pendant la lecture :
• un résumé du chapitre,
• l’explication d’un passage,
• une question sur ce que vous lisez.
La réponse s’appuie sur le texte ouvert devant vous.

DÉBATTRE
Chaque jour, un grand sujet ou un paradoxe : le bateau de Thésée, l’âne de Buridan, la justice et la miséricorde… Débattez avec l’IA, qui défend l’autre camp et conclut par une synthèse, ou envoyez le sujet à vos amis.

VOS PROPRES LIVRES
Importez vos fichiers EPUB et PDF, et lisez-les avec la même mise en page.

NOTES ET SURLIGNAGES
Surlignez un passage, ajoutez une note, retrouvez tout au même endroit.

VOTRE PAGE, VOTRE LUMIÈRE
Papier, sépia ou nuit, taille du texte réglable, sur iPhone comme sur iPad.

SUR TOUS VOS APPAREILS, SI VOUS LE SOUHAITEZ
Un compte est facultatif. Avec un compte Apple ou une adresse e-mail, vos notes, surlignages et pages en cours vous suivent de l’iPad à l’iPhone. Sans compte, tout reste sur votre appareil.

Signet ne contient aucune publicité.

name: Siteo Tööaeg
description:
Siteo Tööaeg is time tracking for construction sites.

Workers clock in and out with one tap, see their hours and use the app in Estonian, Russian, Ukrainian or English.
Site managers and owners see who is on site, approve hours (corrections keep the reason and the original time) and download the monthly timesheet to Excel. Hours flow into the Siteo site diary and KuluFlow site costs.

Location is used only during working time: when starting and finishing work and to record leaving and returning to the site. With "Always" permission the phone records leaving the site even when the app is closed. No continuous route is stored. No location is collected outside working time.

A Siteo account is required. The employer invites workers by e-mail or gives them a code.

Support: info@normrise.ee

name: SizePocket
description:
Remember the measurements you actually use when shopping or sewing. Make a profile for yourself or someone you shop for, record a measurement with its date, and switch between inches and centimeters when you need to compare.

Start with one profile and one measurement for free. The optional one-time Lifetime purchase adds more profiles and measurements, custom measurement categories, fit notes, and summary export.

SizePocket works offline. You can keep an optional backup in Files, including iCloud Drive when available.

name: SlamZ (e1b4dc)
description:
Create a slambook that feels like your circle.

Start with a template, make it your own, and choose the friends you want to invite. They can answer your questions and share memories with text, photos, video, or voice where supported. Revisit the responses together whenever you want.

With SlamZ you can:

• Create and personalize slambooks with themed templates. 
• Invite selected friends and collect their answers. 
• Add photos and other supported media to your memories. 
• Continue the conversation in Tea Room. 
• Report content or block accounts when needed.

SlamZ is built for the people and moments you want to remember.

name: Sling Duel: Slingshot Battle
description:
Welcome to SLING DUEL — the ultimate 1v1 arcade slingshot showdown! Pull back, calculate wind and gravity, and launch explosive projectiles to defeat your rival duelist!

Whether you want to challenge nearby friends, pass the phone on the couch, or conquer solo campaign worlds, Sling Duel offers fast-paced, high-stakes tactical battles.

 EXCITING GAME MODES:
• 40 CAMPAIGN LEVELS: Journey across 4 distinct worlds (Sky Meadow, Magma Peaks, Frost Glacier, and Cyber Grid) featuring kinetic bumpers, destructible walls, and moving portals.
• SAME-DEVICE PASS & PLAY: Duel a friend anywhere on a single iPhone or iPad — no internet, Wi-Fi, or Bluetooth needed!
• LOCAL WIRELESS DUEL: Connect seamlessly with nearby players over direct peer-to-peer Wi-Fi or Bluetooth without router setup.
• GAME CENTER 1v1: Challenge players worldwide through instant online matchmaking.

 TACTICAL POWER-UP ARSENAL:
• Standard Rock: Reliable high-velocity kinetic strike.
• Bomb Blast: High-explosive round with devastating shockwave radius.
• Iron Boulder: Heavy mass projectile that smashes through obstacles.
• Lightning Zap: Blazing electric arc that shocks rivals upon contact.
• Frost Shard: Freezing crystal projectile that slows down the arena.

 REWARDS & CUSTOMIZATION:
• 100% EARNED VIA PLAY: No pay-to-win! Earn coins in every match and level to unlock character skins, custom slingshot throwers, and battle arenas.
• UNIQUE CHARACTERS: Unlock Cobalt, Crimson, Golden Outlaw, Cyber Ronin, and more!
• REAL-TIME SYNC: Both players see each other's custom skins, slingshots, and avatars in live multiplayer matches.

Do you have the precision and strategy to claim victory? Download Sling Duel and test your aim today!

name: Slot Racing: Mini Track
description:
Slot car racing in your pocket. One button: hold to accelerate and let go before the corner. Take it too fast and your car flies off the rail.

41 TRACKS TO MASTER
- From easy ovals to mazes of tight hairpins.
- Upside-down loops: hit them fast or fall off.
- Jump shortcuts, tunnels, hills, banked curves, oil slicks and lane changers.
- Rain, snow and night tracks with neon rails.
- Layouts inspired by legendary circuits around the world.

RACE RIVALS WITH PERSONALITY
- Max, Lola, Bruno and Kiki each drive their own way: aggressive, steady, defensive or unpredictable.
- Multi-race cups, time trials against your ghost and daily challenges.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE
- 8 cars with different speed, acceleration, grip and magnet.
- 5 upgrade levels and paint jobs for every car.
- Everything is earned by playing: no ads and no purchases.

COMPETE ON GAME CENTER
- Best-lap leaderboards for every track and a total-stars leaderboard.
- Achievements for the best drivers.

name: SmallTip
description:
SmallTip is the iPhone app for SmallTipAI, where small companies hire SmallTips: AI teammates for marketing, bookkeeping, customer support, sales and more.

Chat with your SmallTips • See every SmallTip of your company with its latest message and what's unread. • Ask for work, get answers as they're written, and pick up the same conversation on smalltip.com. • Start a new chat with a tap on a suggested question.

See your team • Who reports to whom, as a clear list: you, your SmallTips and the SmallTips they manage. • Open any SmallTip to see its status and start a chat.

Switch between companies • If you run more than one company, switch with a tap on its name. The app opens the company you used last.

Stay in charge • Get a notification when a SmallTip messages you or needs your approval; tap it to open the chat. • See how much of today's free usage you and your company have used. • SmallTips that are paused or not active say so, and tell you what to do next. • Report any answer you think is wrong or offensive with a long press.

You need a SmallTipAI account to use the app. Create one for free at smalltip.com, set up your company and hire your first SmallTips there, then chat with them here.

name: Smogfall™ Tower Defense
description:
Smogfall™ is a tower defense game from Dew Brook where the enemy is the air itself. Alien ships land and pour out purple gas that flows downhill, pools in the valleys and creeps toward your land. Read the ground, build in the right places and hold the line.

GAS THAT REALLY FLOWS
The gas follows the shape of every map. It fills the low ground first, spills over ridges and finds every gap you leave. Barriers turn it, Siphons drain it and Burners clear it. Shoot the ships down with Flak to fill the Retreat meter and send them home.

52 DEFENSE MAPS
Five chapters, from farms and orchards to frozen fjords, signal towers and nightmare foundries, then a two-map finale against the Star Empress.

8 TURRETS
• Siphon: pulls the gas out of the ground
• Burner: burns away the gas around it
• Barrier: a wall that turns the flow
• Flak: shoots ships down before they land
• Mortar, Aegis, Frostbite and Thunder Spire: unlock as you earn stars

TURN THE TABLES: ATTACK MODE
40 missions where you launch the ships and gas their alien bases. Grab supply crates, dodge patrol fighters, unlock 8 ships from Gas Landers to Carriers, and break through gold elite turrets.

SHOWDOWNS
Defend your colony on one side of the map while you attack theirs on the other.

ENDLESS, DAILY AND EVENTS
• Endless: how many waves can you hold? Four looks, including holiday ones
• A Daily challenge and weekly missions
• Seasonal events with their own twists

EARN AS YOU PLAY
• Credits from every win buy turret upgrades, ship upgrades and Hangar skins
• Stars, platinum stars and 52 mastery badges
• 29 trophies and lifetime records
• Plays on iPhone and iPad

WHAT'S FREE AND WHAT ISN'T
• Free: all 52 Defense maps, Endless, the Daily challenge, the Defense events and Attack mission 1
• Paid: Attack Mode, a one-time in-app purchase for Attack missions 2 to 40, the Showdowns, Daily Attack and the Christmas Showdown event. Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers your family
• Optional ads: watch one for a bonus, like a revive or a supply drop. You never have to.
• Credits are earned by playing, never sold. No subscriptions.
• Restore Purchases is in Settings and on the unlock screen

Made by Dew Brook, a small game studio.
Questions? support@dewbrook.com

Smogfall™ is a trademark of Dew Brook LLC. © 2026 Dew Brook LLC. All rights reserved.

name: Sniffly - Perfume Journal
description:
Sniffly is your personal scent journal. Keep track of every perfume you try, rate it and build your own collection – from the first test strip to your all-time favourites.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Search a global catalogue of over 37,000 fragrances
• Log every test – on skin, on a blotter or on clothes
• Rate perfumes with stars and see community ratings
• Organise your shelves: Sniffed, Want to sniff, Want to buy, Own, Had and Favourites
• Pick your scent of the day and keep your streak going
• Create "My 4 seasons" – one perfume for every season – and share it as an image
• Watch your scent atlas grow and unlock achievements

TOGETHER WITH FRIENDS
• Get your own nickname and follow friends
• See what your friends are wearing today and react with an emoji
• Compare your taste with a match score
• Vote in the duel of the week – a new pair every Monday

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
• Use Sniffly as a guest, or sign in with Apple or Google to sync between your phone and sniffly.app
• Your notes stay private, and you decide whether your profile is visible
• Available in English, German, Polish, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Turkish and Swedish

SNIFFLY PRO (OPTIONAL)
Sniffly is free and supported by ads. With the optional Sniffly Pro subscription (monthly or yearly) you get no ads, your taste profile "My Nose", Year in Scents, smart lists, shelf filters, side-by-side compare, journal export and colour themes. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://sniffly.app/legal/terms.php
Privacy Policy: https://sniffly.app/legal/privacy.php

name: Snitch: Phones Down Game
description:
Phones down. First to touch pays.

Snitch turns the classic phone-stack game into a loud, ruthless party game. Everyone opens Snitch, joins the same table and puts their phone face down. The moment someone picks theirs up, every phone at the table blasts a siren and a sassy voice calls them out: "Busted! Hands off the phone!"

No more scrolling at dinner. Just friends, food – and one person who's about to pay.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Everyone opens Snitch and joins your table – iPhone and Android. Phones nearby show up by themselves, or type the 4-letter table code. No accounts.
2. Pick the stakes: pays the bill, does the dishes, gets the next coffees, plans the next hangout.
3. All phones face down – the game starts automatically.
4. First to touch their phone gets snitched. Leaving the app counts too.

FEATURES
• Table mode for 2–8 phones – iPhones connect over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, even without internet; Android friends join with the table code
• Solo challenge: how long can you NOT touch your phone? Beat your personal best.
• Stake packs: Classic (free), Date Night, Family Dinner, Friends, Study & Office – or write your own
• Hall of Shame: who got snitched the most?
• Share cards for your stories: "We lasted 47:12 phone-free. Max got snitched."
• Goal mode: set 30, 60 or 90 minutes – if nobody flinches, everyone wins

PERFECT FOR
Christmas dinner, New Year's Eve, date night, family meals, restaurant nights, study sessions and meetings that should have been an email.

SNITCH+
Free: tables up to 4 phones, Classic stakes and Solo mode.
Snitch+: up to 8 phones, all stake packs, custom stakes and the full Hall of Shame.
Host pays: one Snitch+ member unlocks Plus for the whole table. Friends join for free.

Snitch+ is an auto-renewing subscription, billed weekly or yearly. The yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial; if you don't cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, the yearly price is charged. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVACY
No accounts. No tracking. No ads. Your games and records stay on your phone – only your name and emoji are passed to the other phones at your table while you play.

Terms of Use: https://playsnitch.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://playsnitch.app/privacy.html

Put your phones down. Snitch is watching.

name: Snoozz
description:
Comandă băutura preferată direct din aplicația Snoozz!

Cu aplicația Snoozz, ai acces rapid la toate băuturile tale preferate, exact când ai nevoie de ele. După instalare, creează-ți contul în câțiva pași simpli, folosind adresa ta de email. Alege modul de livrare: îți trimitem comanda direct la ușă sau o poți ridica personal, în drum spre birou sau plimbare. Adaugă adresa, selectează băuturile preferate și pune-le în coș. Finalizează comanda cu metoda de plată dorită — totul e rapid, intuitiv și fără bătăi de cap. Bucură-te de aroma Snoozz, livrată cu un singur tap.

name: Snow Globe: Tiny Worlds
description:
Remember shaking a snow globe and waiting for the snow to settle? Give your Apple Watch a little shake and watch snow lift from the bottom, swirl around the cabin and slowly fall again. Tilt your wrist for a slightly different view. Swipe to visit a cherry blossom garden or spend a moment at a campsite under the northern lights.

Got a photo you love looking at? Pick it on your iPhone and turn it into a little scene with depth inside the globe. Your iPhone processes the photo. When it’s ready, you can send the scene to your paired Apple Watch.

The three included scenes are free. Create and view your own photo scenes with a monthly subscription or a one-time purchase for lifetime access. The subscription renews monthly unless canceled in your Apple Account.

Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Snow Ski '86
description:
Ride the gondola, click into your skis and push off.

Snow Ski '86 is a calm skiing game in big, warm pixels. Steer with a touch on the left or right of the screen, carve between the trees and follow the piste all the way down to the village.

A DAY ON THE MOUNTAIN
• 24 pistes in four chapters: the nursery slopes, the woods, the high mountain and the last run of the day
• Five real runs of Madonna di Campiglio in the Dolomites: Pradalago, Amazzonia, Graffer, 3-Tre and Spinale Direttissima, with their huts, lakes and lifts where they really are
• Morning sun, noon, soft evening light, dusk and passing snowfalls
• Ride T-bar lifts and see the mountain through the skier's eyes
• Choose your way at forks: an easy blue, a red or an ungroomed black, through narrow woods or past icy caves

REAL SNOW, IN PIXELS
• Fresh corduroy, powder at the edges, moguls, old tracks and your own lines in the snow
• Ice that rattles under your edges, gusts of wind that push you sideways
• Jumps, crests and dips on the black pistes

LIFE ON THE SLOPES
• Other skiers, beginners in a snowplough and ski schools in a tidy line
• A snow groomer, squirrels, chamois, marmots by their burrows, an eagle overhead and bears waiting at the edge of the wood
• Skiers stopped to admire the view and stones in the snow: more to steer round as you climb the levels

GENTLE BY DESIGN
• Falls are soft: you tumble into the snow, get up and carry on
• No timers, no lives, no game over
• Original chiptune music that turns dramatic in the wind and on the black runs, with a switch to turn it off

FAIR AND SIMPLE
The first three pistes are free. A single purchase opens the whole mountain, forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no data collected.

At the end of the last run, a warm hut, a Christmas tree and a hot chocolate are waiting.

See you at the top.

name: Snowdial: Snow Day Predictor
description:
Will school close tomorrow?

Snowdial reads the night ahead for your school district: how much snow falls before the buses roll, ice, wind chill at 7 AM and National Weather Service warnings. It turns all of it into one honest number, shows you why, and learns your district's snow line from every storm.

ONE NUMBER, WITH THE REASONS
• Snow day chance and 2-hour delay chance for the next school day
• The reasons behind it: overnight snow, peak hours, ice, wind chill, warnings
• "How we calculate" breaks the number down point by point
• Weekends are skipped; Friday night shows Monday

TUNED TO YOUR DISTRICT
• A school in Georgia closes for an inch. Yours probably doesn't.
• Start from your area's usual snowfall
• Each morning after a storm, one tap: Closed, Delay or Open
• Snowdial moves your district's snow line to match, and keeps your season record

THE STORM NIGHT, HOUR BY HOUR
• Snow per hour from 6 PM to 9 AM, with the 5–8 AM commute window
• How much is on the ground at 6 AM
• National Weather Service winter storm, ice and wind chill warnings

ALERTS THAT MATTER
• An 8 PM heads-up when the chance is 40% or more (you pick the time and the bar)
• A note as soon as a winter warning is issued
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets

SHARE THE ODDS
• A snow day card for your story or group chat

EVERY U.S. SCHOOL DISTRICT
• Search more than 19,000 districts by name, city or ZIP, or use your location once
• Not listed? Add any school by name and town

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your schools and answers stay on your iPhone. Snowdial has no server; it only asks Apple Weather and the National Weather Service about your school's location.

SNOWDIAL PRO
Tomorrow's chance, alerts, widgets and the morning question are free. Pro adds up to five schools, the 3-day outlook, a 5:30 AM morning update, a Live Activity on your Lock Screen all storm night, your full season record and every share style without the Snowdial mark. Choose yearly with a free one-week trial, or unlock Pro once, for life.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aquatic-alto-bc9.notion.site/Snowdial-Privacy-Policy-41f5ee35e47980b0a008dae87a2306e2

Snowdial estimates closures from weather data and is not affiliated with any school district. Always check your school's official announcement. Weather: Apple Weather and the National Weather Service. School districts: NCES.

name: Snowpine Lane: Merge & Story
description:
A quiet lane at the edge of a snowy harbor town has seen better days. Its cozy homes and little shops sit dusty and shuttered, waiting for someone to care about them again. When a mother and her daughter arrive looking for a fresh start, they decide that someone will be them.

MERGE TO RESTORE
• Drag two matching items together to merge them into something new.
• Climb longer merge chains and discover new items as you go.
• Use what you make to fill orders and bring each home and shop back to life.

A STORY TO FOLLOW
• Follow a mother and daughter as they settle into a new home and a new beginning.
• Get to know the people who live on the lane and the stories they carry.
• New chapters open up as the lane comes back to life.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Short, satisfying sessions that fit into any break.
• Seasonal events and limited-time activities with extra rewards.

Snowpine Lane: Merge & Story is free to play. It offers optional in-app purchases.

Privacy Policy: https://www.topgamesinc.com/PrivacyPolicy.html

name: SNPD
description:
The AI names something. You find it in real life and snap it before the timer runs out.

Every accepted photo becomes a collectible card. You have three hearts, the levels get harder, and you get one dispute per run if you think the judge got it wrong.

Play the daily challenge with everyone, then share the level you reached.

Real things only: no people, no screens.

name: Sober House Manager
description:
Sober House Manager runs your recovery residence from intake to discharge.

Manage every part of a sober living operation in one place:

- Digital intake: send a link, collect applications, review and approve from your phone
- Houses, rooms and beds with live occupancy
- Resident ledger, payment charges and balances
- Chore rotations with resident check-off and staff sign-off
- Curfews, passes, sign-out sheets and overnight approvals
- Demerits, warnings, restrictions and discharge workflows
- UA scheduling and result tracking
- Meeting attendance and bulletin board
- Document vault for house paperwork
- Built-in support and bug reporting

Built for house managers, directors and operators of sober living homes, halfway houses and recovery residences.

name: Sofa Squeeze
description:
Ever heard of the "Moving Sofa Problem"? Back in 1966, a mathematician asked a weirdly relatable question: what is the largest rigid 2D shape that can actually make it around a unit-width L-shaped hallway corner? Chasing that "sofa constant" kept mathematicians busy for nearly 60 years, working their way from a simple semicircle (π/2 ≈ 1.57) up to Gerver's 18-curve sofa at roughly 2.2195 square units.

Sofa Squeeze was born right out of that idea. No calculus required, though. We turned it into a calm, clever 2.5D spatial puzzle game where you can just take your time and test the geometry yourself.

You control two movers at once with two circular wheels at the bottom of the screen, one for the front and one for the back. Push together to glide straight, or steer against each other to pivot neatly around tight corners. No timers and no twitchy reflexes, just that great little moment when a couch that looked completely impossible somehow slides right through.

Across 90 puzzles spanning 6 miniature cities (from cozy walk-ups to cloud-high hotel suites), things get delightfully tricky. You'll deal with swinging doors, rolling carts, floor switches, turntables, two-sofa traffic jams, and cramming into freight elevators to finish the job on another floor. Oh, and there are cats and dogs wandering around who could not care less that you're holding a sofa, so try not to bump them. For the record, every single one of our 90 levels was checked with a pathfinding solver to confirm a zero-bump solution exists, so if you feel stuck, trust the math: it really does fit.

You get 5 hearts per level, so please don't treat someone's living room like a bumper-car arena. Make it in with zero scratches for 3 stars. If you do use up all 5 hearts, you can restart fresh or choose to watch a short ad for 5 more hearts and keep going.

We built this game out of a love for tiny architectural dioramas, clean ink lines, warm light, and chill Lo-Fi music. Even when you're stuck thinking about your next turn, it's still a nice place to hang out.

It's free to play, and there are no surprise pop-up ads interrupting you mid-move. Ads only show up if you ask for a hint, an early unlock, or extra hearts. Or if you'd rather skip ads altogether, a single one-time purchase removes them forever and unlocks all 90 levels with unlimited hints.

Playable in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Pop in your headphones, and good luck with the corner.

name: Sonap
description:
Sonap is a private voice recorder with on-device speech-to-text transcription for iPhone. Record meetings, lectures, interviews and voice notes, and convert speech into readable transcripts. All audio processing runs locally on your device; nothing is uploaded to the cloud.
Review, search and manage your transcripts anytime offline. No account required. Keep your sensitive conversations fully private.
Perfect for meetings, classes, interviews and personal voice memos.

name: Sonaria : Microtonal Keys
description:
Sonaria is an expressive microtonal synthesizer and 88-key performance piano designed for traditional world music, microtonal exploration, and Turkish makam theory.

Whether performing authentic Middle Eastern melodies, studying quarter-tone temperaments, or performing on stage with an external MIDI keyboard, Sonaria delivers low-latency studio-quality audio shaping.

AUTHENTIC INSTRUMENT LIBRARY
• Concert Grand Piano: Dynamic multi-velocity acoustic piano.
• Ottoman Classical Ney: Expressive reed flute sampled with traditional timbre.
• Sonaria Strings: Rich orchestral string section.
• Traditional Turkish Kanun: Crisp plucked zither with natural decay.

MICROTONAL & MAKAM TUNINGS
• Turkish Makam Presets: Arap Rast,Bayati,Hicaz,Saba,Segah,Acem,Nihavend,Kürdi,Hicazkâr
• Quarter-Tone & Comma Precision: Authentic microtonal pitch offsets accurately rendered across all 88 keys.
• Hold Scale & Transposition: Lock tuning to root keys or transpose on the fly.
• Scala (.scl) Import & Export: Load custom equal and non-equal temperaments or share your own tuning scales.

88-KEY PERFORMANCE KEYBOARD & MINIMAP
• Fluid Multi-Touch Engine: Low-latency keyboard with polyphonic voice management.
• Interactive Minimap: Instant navigation across all 7+ octaves with visible viewport indicator.
• Visual Microtone Notation: Note badges indicate flat, sharp, half-flat (bakiye/koma), and quarter-tone intervals directly on keys.
• Computer Keyboard Mapping: Play chords and melodies using iPad Magic Keyboard or external QWERTY keyboards.

SYNTHESIZER CONTROLS & AUDIO FX
• ADSR Envelope Generator: Precise Attack, Decay, Sustain, and Release controls.
• Digital Reverb & Delay: Add space, depth, and tempo-synced echoes.
• Performance Controls: Spring-loaded Pitch Bend wheel and latching Sustain pedal.

PROFESSIONAL MIDI CONNECTIVITY
• USB MIDI: Plug and play with USB MIDI keyboards via Lightning/USB-C adapters.
• Bluetooth LE MIDI: Wireless connectivity with low-latency Bluetooth controllers.
• Universal MIDI Packet (UMP) Architecture: Smooth velocity response and MIDI CC integration.

NATIVE IPAD EXPERIENCE
• Tailored iPadOS Layout: Fully responsive design supporting Split View, Slide Over, and Stage Manager.
• Left-Side Performance Dock: Ergonomic vertical dock placing Pitch Bend and Sustain comfortably under the left hand while performing.

CLEAN & AD-FREE OPTION
• Play freely with non-intrusive banner placement.
• Permanent "Remove Ads" in-app purchase available to unlock an ad-free workspace and support future development.

name: Sony a6700 Camera Academy
description:
Get to know your Sony a6700 with your camera in your hands. Work through 15 beginner-friendly lessons at your own pace, starting with the buttons and dials you’ll use to take your first photograph.

Find your way around the camera
Choose a front, rear or top view, then tap a control on the photograph to see what it does. Listen to the explanation and try it on your own a6700. Start with a half-press of the shutter button to focus, then press the rest of the way to take the shot.

See what a setting changes
In the Exposure Lab, explore shutter speed, aperture and ISO. Adjust the shutter speed and compare the wing tips of a kingfisher in flight to see how the setting affects motion blur.

Practise one step at a time
Follow the exercises on your own camera and tick off each step as you go. Return to a lesson or revisit a control whenever you need a refresher.

An independent photography guide by Alan Boyle for Sony a6700 owners.

name: SOS Sauve Moi
description:
SOS Sauve Moi lets you alert your loved ones in seconds when you are in danger: assault, accident, sudden illness, or a trip home that goes wrong.

ONE GESTURE IS ENOUGH
Press and hold the big SOS button for one second. A 3-second countdown gives you time to cancel a mistake. Then an alert SMS with your GPS location is prepared for your emergency contacts: all you have to do is tap Send.

THE SMS WORKS WITHOUT INTERNET
The alert goes out by SMS, using your regular phone plan. You don't need mobile data to warn your loved ones, and your contacts don't need the app to receive the message with the link to your location.

AN ALARM ON YOUR LOVED ONES' PHONES
If one of your emergency contacts also uses SOS Sauve Moi, their phone receives a notification and plays an alarm as soon as you trigger an SOS.

"GOING HOME" MODE
Heading home alone at night, taking a taxi or a motorbike taxi? Turn on "Going home" mode: an "I need help" button stays within reach for the whole trip and sends the alert immediately. Your location is not tracked during the trip.

YOUR EMERGENCY CONTACTS
Add up to 10 trusted people: family, friends, neighbors. They all receive the same alert message, in a single send.

ALERT HISTORY
Find your past alerts with their date, time and status, and export them if needed.

YOUR ACCOUNT, PROTECTED
Your account is linked to your phone number and protected by a 6-digit PIN. Changing phones? Sign back in with your number and PIN to get your contacts and history back.

YOUR PRIVACY COMES FIRST
• Your location is read only when you trigger an SOS. Never in the background.
• Your location is never stored on our servers: it only goes into the SMS you send.
• Your data is never sold or shared for advertising.
• You can delete your account at any time, directly from the app.

EASY TO USE
A help button on each screen explains every feature. The app is available in French and English. Service announcements from our team (new version, maintenance, safety tips) appear in Settings > Announcements, and you can turn them off.

FREE
SOS Sauve Moi is entirely free. The app shows ads from local businesses, never during an alert and without any tracking.

AVAILABLE IN CAMEROON
The app is designed for Cameroon: your account and emergency contacts use Cameroonian phone numbers (+237). Text messages are charged by your carrier according to your plan.

IMPORTANT
SOS Sauve Moi is not an emergency service. In case of serious danger, also call the police (117), the fire brigade (118) or emergency medical services (119).

DESIGNED BY LIGWE-PULSE

www.ligwe-pulse.com
contact@ligwe-pulse.com

name: Soul Lottery: Animal Rebirth
description:
A new life awaits… but nature picks it at random, based on how many animals really live on Earth. And more than 8 in 10 are microscopic worms. Good luck!

• 273 illustrated species, from the nematode to the blue whale, each with its own card, odds and a funny line.
• Real odds: a giant panda? A 1 in 350 quadrillion shot.
• Be reborn once, ×100, ×1,000… or keep going until you land on a species you've never seen.
• Complete your collection, family by family.
• Unlock achievements and keep your daily streak.
• 13 themes, 10 card frames and 7 outfits for your ghost.
• Share your reincarnation as an image, in your theme's colors.
• Figures taken from scientific studies, with sources.
• In English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, German and Italian.

One-time purchases, no subscription: they never change your odds.

What would you come back as?

name: SphereHarness
description:
SphereHarness brings the CAD on your own PC to your phone.

Send a message and the SphereHarness desktop agent on your PC does the work in your CAD software: open and change models, check masses and dimensions, run studies, make drawings, export files and more. Replies come back with tables, charts, pictures and files.

- Chat with your PC: the conversation continues where you left it on the PC
- Pick which of your PCs does the work and see which CAD sessions are open
- Answer the PC's questions from anywhere, with push notifications
- Unattended mode lets long jobs run on their own
- Open, share and save the pictures and files your PC sends back
- Send photos and files from your phone to the PC, if your organisation allows it

SphereHarness needs a SphereHarness account and the SphereHarness desktop agent running on your Windows PC. Your models stay on your PC.

name: Spring Design
description:
Spring Design is an engineering calculator for spring design, mechanical calculations and geometric analysis. It provides practical calculation tools, clear engineering diagrams and material reference data for engineers, designers, students and technicians.

**Spring Calculators**

The app includes 10 spring types:

- Compression springs
- Extension springs
- Torsion springs
- Disc springs
- Disc spring stacks
- Slotted disc springs
- Wave springs
- Flat spiral springs
- Leaf springs
- Annular springs

Calculate spring dimensions, stiffness, loads, deflections, stresses and other engineering parameters according to the selected spring model.

**Design and Analysis**

- Forward calculations and inverse design methods
- Material properties and engineering references
- Load-deflection curves and calculation diagrams
- Strength and stability checks where applicable
- Excel calculation reports
- Saved input parameters for convenient reuse

**Geometry Calculators**

Spring Design also includes a collection of 2D and 3D geometry calculators for common shapes, including triangles, circles, polygons and solid geometry.

**Free and Premium Features**

Selected spring and geometry calculators are available free of charge.

A single, one-time in-app purchase unlocks all premium spring and geometry calculation features within Spring Design. No subscription is required.

**Engineering Reference**

Calculation results depend on the selected models, input parameters and material properties. Results should be verified against applicable engineering standards and actual operating conditions before production use.

name: Sqlance: SQLite Viewer, Editor
description:
Sqlance opens SQLite databases on your iPhone: .sqlite, .db and .sqlite3 files from the Files app, right where they are. No copy, no computer, no account.

Made for developers checking the database of the app they build, analysts with an export, and anyone curious about a backup.

OPEN IN PLACE
• Pick a file in Files: On My iPhone, iCloud Drive or another provider
• Reads the -wal file next to it, so you see the latest changes
• Share a file to Sqlance from another app or AirDrop to keep a copy
• Recent databases stay on the home screen
• Browsing opens the file read-only: nothing is written until you edit

BROWSE, FREE
• Every table and view, with its row count
• A native grid that scrolls 100,000 rows smoothly, with sticky headers and adjustable columns
• Sort by any column, filter one column or all of them
• NULL shown apart from empty text, BLOBs shown with their size
• Row details: tap a value to copy it
• The schema of each table: columns, types, primary key, indexes, foreign keys and the CREATE statement
• A built-in sample database (100,000 orders) to try it all without a file of your own

SQLANCE PRO, ONE PURCHASE
• SQL editor: run any query, results in the same grid, history of your queries for each database
• Edit a cell, add or delete a row: saved straight into the original file
• A statement that changes the file asks you to run it again to confirm
• Safety first: a copy is made before the first edit, and Restore earlier version brings it back for 7 days
• When a file can't be written where it is, edit a copy and save it to Files
• Export a table or a query result as CSV
• Share the database as one file, -wal included, without touching the original

PRIVATE
• Your databases never leave your iPhone unless you share them
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Anonymous usage counts, never a file name, table or value, which you can turn off in Settings

Sqlance Pro is a one-time purchase, with no subscription. The interface is in English, French, German, Spanish and Italian.

name: Square Jam: Logic Puzzle
description:
Fill the whole grid with squares. Every number is the side of the square it sits in, and four squares may never meet at one point.

Square Jam is a logic puzzle with three simple rules. A 3 lives in a 3 × 3 square, several equal numbers can share one square, and some squares have no number at all. The twist: square borders can never cross in a "+". Find the squares that must be there, and watch the board fill with colour, one size at a time. Every level, daily and quick-play puzzle has exactly one solution, reachable by logic alone.

12 JARS, 360 LEVELS
• From a small 6 × 6 apple jar to a 15 × 15 marmalade
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level; each jar unlocks the next

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Daily puzzle: one 10 × 10 puzzle a day for everyone, with a streak and a month calendar
• Quick play: 6 × 6 to 20 × 20, four levels (Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert), endless new puzzles
• Enter a puzzle code to play a puzzle from a friend or a book

HELPFUL, NOT INTRUSIVE
• Drag from a cell to draw a square; a label shows "3×3" as you drag
• Tap an empty cell for a 1 × 1 square, tap a square to remove it, or switch to two taps instead of a drag
• Squares are tinted by size; a square with the wrong number gets a red outline, and a red dot marks four squares meeting at a point
• 3 hints per game (watch an ad for more when they run out); each hint names the technique and explains why
• "Check" points out wrong squares; stuck? Show the solution (that game gets no stars)
• Solving tips: six techniques with worked examples, plus an interactive tutorial
• Undo and redo without limit; pinch to zoom on big boards

STARS AND PROGRESS
• 3 stars: solved without hints and under the target time
• Statistics for every board size and level, 12 achievements

ON EVERY SCREEN
• Phones and tablets, with layouts made for each: tab bar on phones, sidebar and side panel on tablets and desktop
• Keyboard and right click on Mac
• Dark design, English and Vietnamese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed
• Never an ad while you solve. Remove ads for good with a one-time purchase, no subscription (the Mac version has no ads)
• Works fully offline; your progress stays on your device

name: Stammkaterl – Stempelkarte
description:
Stammkaterl ist die digitale Stempelkarte für Cafés, Bäckereien, Friseure, Döner und andere Betriebe in deiner Nähe.

SO EINFACH GEHT'S
• Beim Bezahlen das iPhone an den Stammkaterl-Aufsteller halten
• Deine Stempelkarte öffnet sich sofort, auch ohne App
• Mit einem Tipp in Apple Wallet legen
• Bei jedem Besuch gibt es einen Stempel, ist die Karte voll, wartet deine Prämie

DIE APP
• Karten: alle Stempelkarten auf einen Blick, mit Fortschritt und „Prämie bereit“
• Stempeln: Aufsteller antippen oder den QR-Code scannen
• So geht's: kurze Anleitung mit Beispielkarte zum Ausprobieren
• Herunterziehen holt den neuesten Stand vom Betrieb

OHNE KONTO, OHNE DATENSAMMELN
Du brauchst keine Anmeldung, keine E-Mail und keinen Namen. Gespeichert werden nur eine zufällige Kartennummer und deine Stempel. Keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

Du hast selbst einen Betrieb? Alle Infos auf stammkaterl.at

name: Star Fleets
description:
Star Fleets is the classic game of hidden ships, moved to deep space. Deploy your fleet on a 10×10 grid, target sectors on the enemy radar and destroy every enemy ship before your opponent finds yours.

RULES YOU KNOW
• Ten ships: one four-cell ship, two three-cell, three two-cell and four one-cell ships.
• Ships may not touch, not even at the corners.
• A hit gives you another shot. A miss passes the turn.
• Cells around a destroyed ship are marked automatically.

THREE OPPONENTS
• Recruit fires at random: a good first mission.
• Captain follows hits and finishes off damaged ships.
• Admiral weighs every possible position of your fleet and the direction of hits.
The computer never peeks at your ships. It only knows the results of its own shots.

COMMANDERS' DUEL
Two people, one phone, no internet. A privacy screen between turns hides each fleet until the phone reaches the right commander.

EASY DEPLOYMENT
Tap a cell and the ship runs right or down from it. Near an edge it slides into place, and you rotate the last ship by tapping it again. Or deploy the whole fleet at random.

MISSIONS THAT WAIT
Park a mission at the base and finish it later, even after closing the app. After the computer's turn the game returns to the enemy radar on its own.

NO CATCHES
No ads, no account and no internet. The whole game is free, and optional support in three amounts unlocks nothing. Your saved game stays on the device.
Game languages: English, Polish, German, Spanish, French and Portuguese.

name: Star Path: Actor Life Sim
description:
Every star starts somewhere. Yours starts serving tables with a head full of dreams.

Star Path is a life simulation about becoming a movie star — and living with everything that comes with it. Sign with an agency, nail auditions, land roles in commercials, TV series and blockbusters, and climb from Nobody to Legend. But fame has a price: paparazzi, scandals, rivals, love, family… and the choices are all yours.

• LIVE A WHOLE LIFE — from age 18 to your final curtain call. Age, fall in love, marry, raise kids, and pass your legacy to the next generation.
• HUNDREDS OF DECISIONS — 180+ story cards: on-set drama, tabloid scandals, secret romances, crazy fans, police trouble, health scares and rare legendary moments.
• BUILD A CAREER — auditions, contracts, sponsorships, premieres and critics. Choose your roles wisely.
• AWARD SEASON — get nominated, pick your outfit, open the envelope… and give the speech of your life.
• YOUR DREAM HOME — move from a shared room to a hilltop mansion, buy cars, pets and luxury items, and decorate your place.
• DYNASTY — when your story ends, your child carries the name. Earn Legacy Points, unlock traits, cities and permanent upgrades.
• PLAY YOUR WAY — time flows on its own; speed it up or pause and think. Daily rewards, quests and the Scene of the Day mini-game.

Will you become a legend… or a cautionary tale?

Star Path is free to play with optional in-app purchases and ads. A game by B2 Studio.

name: Statika: reakce nosníků
description:
Statika: reakce nosníků je trenažér pro studenty průmyslovek a technických oborů. Na náhodně vygenerovaných nosnících spočítáš reakce podpor stejným postupem, jaký píšeš do sešitu – a aplikace tě v každém kroku zkontroluje.

Pět kroků jako na papíře
• Uvolnění: u každé podpory vybereš, jaké reakce v ní vznikají.
• Zatížení: šikmou sílu rozložíš na složky, spojité zatížení nahradíš výslednicí.
• Rovnice: napíšeš rovnice rovnováhy ΣFx = 0, ΣFy = 0 a ΣM = 0 – z palety symbolů nebo klávesnicí.
• Výpočet: dosadíš a spočítáš reakce.
• Hotovo: výkres ukáže skutečné směry reakcí a kontrolu výsledku.

Chyba není konec
• Aplikace nehlásí jen „špatně“ – ukáže, kde je problém: chybějící člen, opačné znaménko, špatné rameno.
• Nápověda napovídá postupně, vždy jen tolik, kolik potřebuješ.
• U typických chyb nabídne odkaz na příslušnou lekci výkladu.

Základy statiky
Krátký interaktivní výklad v 9 lekcích: síla jako šipka, rovnováha sil, složky síly, moment, rovnováha momentů, podpory a vazby, uvolnění, spojité zatížení a kloub. Každá karta má úkol, který si vyzkoušíš přímo na obrázku – je vhodný i pro ty, kdo fyziku nemají v malíčku.

Základy trigonometrie
Odkud se berou sin, cos a tg, jednotková kružnice, hodnoty pro 30°, 45° a 60°, které si snadno zapamatuješ, a hlavně jak s nimi rozložit sílu na složky. 8 krátkých lekcí a procvičování: 7 sérií s okamžitou kontrolou a rozborem typických chyb.

Úlohy podle tebe
• Čtyři typy nosníků: prostý, s převislým koncem, vetknutý a Gerberův nosník s kloubem.
• Tři obtížnosti.
• Oblíbené úlohy si uložíš hvězdičkou a kdykoli se k nim vrátíš.
• Každá úloha má číslo – pošli ho spolužákovi nebo otevři úlohu podle čísla od učitele.
• Čeština a ruština, světlé i tmavé téma, telefon i tablet.

Úloha jako PDF
Zadání úlohy s výkresem uložíš jako PDF zdarma – k tisku nebo do sešitu. PDF se zadáním a celým řešením (uvolnění, rovnice, výsledky) je placené za každé stažení.

Aplikace je zdarma s reklamou. Reklamu můžeš natrvalo odstranit jednorázovým nákupem.

name: Stillpond: Koi Puzzle
description:
Stillpond is a calm puzzle game about koi, water and patience.

Tap a koi and it glides straight ahead, the way it faces. If the way is clear, it swims out of the pond. If another koi is in the path, it rests in the last free spot before it. Every glide changes the pond. Clear them all.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One tap, one glide, one move
• Find the quiet order that frees every koi
• Three stars for a perfect clear, and you can always replay a pond to improve
• Undo as many moves as you like, restart any time, and ask for a gentle hint when you want one

CALM BY DESIGN
• No timer, no lives, no pressure
• Soft water sounds and haptics, with an optional quiet pond ambience
• Two looks: Morning Mist and Dusk Pond
• Works fully offline, with no account and no ads
• Respects Reduce Motion, VoiceOver, large text and colour blind patterns

120 PONDS
Five chapters take you from first water to twilight, from small still ponds to wider ones with more koi to untangle. Six koi varieties, each with its own pattern, swim through lily pads, reeds and stones.

Your progress stays on your device. Stillpond collects no data.

More quiet things are planned for later, but this first release is simply the puzzle, done gently.

name: STL Viewer: 3D Print Files
description:
STL Viewer opens 3D print files on your iPhone and iPad and shows them in clear, smooth 3D. Check a model's size, volume and filament before you print it, wherever you are and without internet. Your files are read on your device and are never uploaded.

Open models from the Files app, from the share sheet, or with "Open in" from Mail, Safari and cloud storage apps. Models inside a ZIP archive open too.

INCLUDED FOR EVERYONE
• Open STL (binary and ASCII), OBJ with MTL colors, 3MF and PLY files, also from ZIP archives
• Solid, wireframe and x-ray views, a print bed grid and XYZ axes
• One finger rotates, two fingers pan, pinch zooms, double-tap resets the view
• Model info: width × depth × height in mm or inches, triangles, volume, surface area and a closed (watertight) mesh check
• Filament estimate: approximate weight and length for PLA, PETG, ABS or TPU, 1.75 or 2.85 mm, with an infill slider
• Your choice of model color, or the colors saved in the file
• Your 10 most recent files with previews, and six original sample models to try right away
• Large files load with progress and a Cancel button
• Dark mode, an iPad layout with a side panel, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support

PREMIUM ADDS
• Measure: tap two points on the surface to get the distance and the X, Y and Z differences
• Section: cut along X, Y or Z with a solid cut face, plus the section's width, height and area
• Scale & export: scale by percent or to a target size, convert inches to millimeters and save as binary STL
• Compare: open a second model next to the first and compare dimensions, volume and triangles
• Save image: save the current view as a PNG image
• Unlimited recent files and no ads
Without Premium, you can choose to watch a short ad to measure once.

WHO IT IS FOR
• Makers and hobbyists: see whether a downloaded model fits your print bed and how much filament it needs.
• Students: open class projects anywhere and look inside parts with cross-sections.
• Sellers of 3D models: preview files and confirm dimensions and scale before you send or list them.
• Engineers and designers: review parts on the shop floor and compare two versions.

QUESTIONS
Does the STL viewer work offline?
Yes. Viewing, model info and the filament estimate need no internet. A connection is used only for ads and purchases.

Which files can I open?
STL, OBJ (select the MTL file too for colors), 3MF, PLY and ZIP archives that contain one of them. For STEP, glTF and other formats, export the model as STL, OBJ or 3MF from your design software first. G-code is not supported.

Which units are used?
STL, OBJ and PLY files store no unit, so millimeters are assumed; switch a file to inches if it was drawn in inches. 3MF files declare their unit. Sizes are shown in mm or inches, as you prefer.

Why is the filament amount an estimate?
It assumes a 0.8 mm solid shell (about two 0.4 mm lines) and your infill inside. Supports, brims and slicer settings change the real amount.

What about privacy?
No account and no sign-in. STL Viewer processes your models on your device and never uploads them.

PREMIUM PURCHASE AND SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is available as a one-time Lifetime purchase or as a Yearly subscription. The price is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The Yearly subscription renews automatically for one year at a time unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions. Use Restore Purchases in the app to unlock Premium on your other devices with the same Apple Account.

name: Storm Mania
description:
Become the storm.
Draw fast circles with your finger to spin up a tornado. The faster you circle, the stronger it gets. Then steer it across the map and lift everything in its path.
HOW IT PLAYS
• Draw circles to charge your storm.
• Drag to steer. Hold the tornado over things to lift them.
• Start small with hay bales and fences, then grow until you can lift houses, trucks and windmills.
• Sweep up crop fields and drain the pond on your way.
• Reach the score goal before time or energy runs out.
TWO WORLDS, 60 FREE LEVELS
• Tornado: three lands, from Breezy Hollow to Frostfall Night.
• Whirlpool: dive under the sea and pull boats, barrels and treasure into the vortex.
• Every level has a new layout, so no two runs look the same.
BEAT THE BLACK GALE A rival storm hunts you in the harder levels. Stay away while you are small, grow, then swallow it. Later up to three come at once.
LUCKY SPIN Watch a short ad to spin the wheel for extra seconds, double score or a special storm for your next level. Ads never make a level easier to pass by themselves, and you never have to watch one to play.
MORE TO UNLOCK
• Mars Pack: 30 extra levels on the red planet with rovers, habitats and a rocket to lift.
• Storm Pack: three special storms, Inferno, Aurora and Golden.
• Any purchase removes the ads between levels.
Plays in English, Turkish, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Russian, on iPhone and iPad. No account needed.

name: Stretch Routine Timer
description:
Time each hold, rest and side of the stretch routine you already do.
Add your stretches once with your own hold and rest times, press Start, and the timer counts every left side, right side and rest for you.
Set it up in a minute. No account needed.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Name your routine.
2. Add the stretches you already do: a name, a hold time, one side or left and right, and optional rests.
3. See the total time before you start.
4. Press Start. A big countdown shows the stretch, the side and what comes next.

TIME BOTH SIDES
- Left and right holds run one after the other, with an optional rest between sides.
- A clear LEFT / RIGHT marker shows which side you are on.
- Rest between stretches is timed only when another stretch follows. There is never a rest after the last one.

SET HOLDS AND REST
- Holds from 1 second to 60 minutes, rests from 0 to 10 minutes, in whole seconds.
- Reorder, edit or remove stretches at any time. Changes are saved right away.

PREDICTABLE FOREGROUND TIMING
- The countdown is calculated from elapsed time, so it stays accurate through pauses.
- Pause, resume, skip a segment or end early. Skipped segments are recorded as skipped.
- The timer pauses when you leave the app, lock the phone or get a call, and waits for you to tap Resume.
- The screen stays awake only while a segment is running.
- If the app is closed mid-routine, it comes back paused where you left off.

CUES YOU CONTROL
- Optional sound, spoken cues (stretch name and side, using a voice already on your iPhone) and haptics, each with its own switch.
- Works alongside your music.
- VoiceOver announces each new segment, not every second.

HISTORY
- Every finished or ended-early session, with its date and active time.
- Editing a routine never changes past sessions.

FREE
- One editable routine with the full timer: sides, rests, cues, pause and skip
- Session history
- Backup export and import as one JSON file

PRO
- More routines
- Duplicate routines
- Reusable stretch presets you save yourself
- History summaries for the last 7 and 30 days and by routine

If Pro ends, nothing is deleted. Every routine and session stays readable and exportable, and you choose one routine to keep editing and running for free.

A TIMER FOR YOUR OWN ROUTINE
This app keeps time for stretches you choose. It does not suggest exercises or durations, assess fitness, or give medical advice. Choose movements and times that suit you and stop if something hurts. Timing runs only while the app is open on screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your routines and history are stored on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is optional: weekly with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers, or annual, billed in full once a year. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in Settings.

name: Strikk: Knitting Row Counter
description:
Strikk turns any knitting pattern into a calm, row-by-row guide. Open a PDF or snap a photo of a printed pattern, pick your size, and knit with a big row counter that always shows exactly what to do next.

12 PATTERNS TO KNIT TODAY
• Original patterns written row by row: dishcloth, scarf, ribbed hat, cowl, fingerless mitts, raglan sweater, baby blanket, baby hat, socks, lace shawlette, striped pillow and headband
• Beginner to intermediate, with sizes, yarn and needle amounts
• Tap "Start knitting" and the row counter takes you through it

LEARN TO KNIT, STITCH BY STITCH
• 15 short lessons with animated needles: cast on, knit, purl, bind off, ribbing, seed stitch, k2tog, ssk, yarn overs, make one, knitting in the round, stripes, gauge, fixing a dropped stitch and reading patterns
• Steps light up in time with the animation
• Every lesson links to a pattern to practise it

HANDY KNITTING TOOLS
• Gauge calculator: resize a cast on to your own gauge
• Increase or decrease evenly, worked out for you
• Needle and yarn size charts for US, UK and metric

OPEN ANY PATTERN
• Import knitting patterns from PDF, photos or pasted text
• Text recognition runs on your phone
• Pick your size once and every number in the pattern is highlighted for you

EVERY ROW IN PLAIN WORDS
• Tap any row to read it in plain language: "k2tog" becomes "knit 2 stitches together"
• Repeats like *k2, p2* to end are spelled out
• A glossary for every abbreviation, with how-to tips

US, UK AND SCANDINAVIAN TERMS
• Translate between US, UK, Norwegian, Danish, Swedish and German knitting terms
• Yarn weight chart across systems
• Perfect for Nordic and European patterns

A ROW COUNTER THAT KEEPS UP
• Huge tap target, works with the phone in your lap
• Haptic feedback and screen stays awake while you knit
• Remembers where you are in every project

YOUR PROJECTS NEVER VANISH

• Export a backup any time

description:

Stud Finder Pro uses your phone's magnetic sensor to find the metal screws and nails that hold drywall to the studs. Calibrate on a clear patch of wall, slide the phone slowly, and follow the beep, vibration and colour meter.

• Project log with photos and marks for every wall
• A short guide built for what you are hanging and your wall type

Phone sensors detect metal, not wood. Results depend on your wall and your phone. Take off magnetic cases first. Always double-check before you drill, and never rely on the app alone near wiring or pipes.

name: StudyBuddy: Notes to Memory
description:
StudyBuddy turns your own notes into memory.

Add your notes as a PDF, a photo, or pasted text. Write your own flashcards, or let StudyBuddy draft cards from your notes for you to approve, edit or throw away. Then review a few minutes a day. StudyBuddy schedules each card for the moment you are about to forget it, and tightens the schedule as your exam gets closer.

FREE
- As many courses and cards as you like
- Scheduled daily reviews that adapt to how well you know each card
- Exam dates: reviews pull in as the exam approaches
- Practice mode for extra rounds that do not change your schedule
- Progress for every course
- One daily reminder, only when cards are due

PLUS AND PRO (optional subscriptions)
- Cards drafted from your notes, each with the passage it came from, for you to approve
- Typed answers checked against your card, with what you missed
- Photos and scanned pages read into text

How it works
StudyBuddy is built on retrieval practice and spaced repetition: recalling an answer from memory, at growing intervals, is one of the best-supported ways to remember what you study. Nothing is graded for a teacher. It is your notes, your cards and your pace.

Subscriptions
StudyBuddy Plus: $5.99 a month or $39.99 a year. Each month: 150 pages drafted, 150 answer checks, 25 photo pages.
StudyBuddy Pro: $9.99 a month, $26.99 every 3 months, or $69.99 a year. Each month: 300 pages drafted, 500 answer checks, 50 photo pages.

name: Sugar Draw 3
description:
Sugar Draw 3 is a relaxing physics puzzle with a twist: you don't move the sugar, you draw the way for it.

Sugar pours from the top of the screen. Draw lines with your finger to build ramps, funnels and bridges, and steer every grain into the right cup. Watch the counter on each cup: when it hits zero, the level is solved.

It sounds simple until the cups want different colours. Some want plain white sugar, others want red, green or blue. Send the sugar through the right colour filters first, and keep the colours from getting mixed up!

FEATURES
• 30 hand-made levels that get trickier and trickier
• Colour filters that turn white sugar red, green, blue and more
• Upside-down cups that catch sugar from below
• Gravity buttons that flip the direction the sugar falls
• Levels where the sugar wraps around the screen
• Your best time is kept for every level: can you beat it?
• Simple one-finger controls, made for iPhone and iPad
• Available in 8 languages

FREE TO PLAY
Sugar Draw 3 is free, with ads. You get a number of replays every day and can watch an ad for more. A one-time Pro purchase removes all ads and gives you unlimited replays.

name: Sumbreak
description:
Two 2s make a 4. The tricky part is deciding where to leave it. Drag one tile onto its neighbor and watch them merge. The starting square stays empty. Can you bring the whole board down to one number?

Play 3,000 original puzzles in 100 blocks. Start on a 3×3 board, then take on larger grids and tiles that add, subtract or multiply. Undo freely. A hint previews a move on a route to a solution.

Earn Sumbreakcoins by solving puzzles and collecting daily bonuses. Spend them on hints, fresh attempts or early block unlocks. Every level can be reached through play. Optional coin packs use the App Store.

Track your times and progress offline. With iCloud, take your game and wallet to another iPhone. Opt in to compare completed attempts on the level and global leaderboards. You can delete your ranking profile in the app.

name: Sumgem
description:
A relaxing puzzle: pick a sum, tap the matching tiles, and watch a picture appear.
Only tiles whose numbers add up to the chosen color can be painted. Clear each 3×3 group fast to score more, and keep a no-mistake streak to grow your multiplier.

- 60 pictures to complete, in 3 difficulty levels
- A dot-art picture reveals itself when you finish
- Satisfying tap feel with haptics
- Japanese / English / Simplified Chinese / Korean
- Light, medium, and dark themes

Ads appear only after finishing a picture, every other time — never while you paint.
Remove ads forever with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

name: Suna: Falling Sand
description:
Suna is a falling-sand sandbox: pick a material, draw with your finger, and watch the world react. Every grain falls, flows, burns, melts, freezes, grows or explodes on its own.

POUR AND BUILD
Sand piles into dunes, water finds its level, lava creeps and cools into stone, cement sets hard. Build walls, bowls, dams and machines, then see what happens when you add fire.

FIRE, HEAT AND WIND
Heat really spreads: a torch warms the air above it, ice melts at a distance, popcorn pops in hot air. Wind carries smoke, snow and sand; fans push the air whichever way you draw them. Switch to the heat view or the wind view to see the air itself.

CHEMISTRY AND CHAOS
Gunpowder, C4, nitro, thermite, bombs and fireworks. Acid eats metal, salt melts ice, electricity runs through wires, water and iron filings and sets things off. Magnets pull iron out of sand. Ink blooms through water in eight colours.

LITTLE LIVES
Seeds sprout and flower in wet soil, vines creep up walls, ants tunnel through dirt, fish swim, birds flock, and bees visit flowers and make honey.

49 elements and four air tools:
Powder, Salt, Snow, Stone, Gunpowder, Thermite, Seeds, Water, Oil, Acid, Nitro, Mercury, Cement, Lava, Fire, Gas, Cloud, Bolt, Battery, Fuse, Clone, Wood, Plant, Ice, Glass, Metal, Wall, Void, Coal, Fireworks, Fish, Cryo, Wax, Torch, C4, Ants, Birds, Vine, Popcorn, Sponge, Virus, Bomb, Dirt, Honey, Bees, Iron, Magnet, Ink, Poison, Wind, Fan, Heat and Chill.

Suna is free, with a small banner ad. A one-time purchase removes the ads for good; everything else is free either way. No account, no sign-in, works offline.

name: Survival 72+ Emergency Guide
description:
Survival 72+ helps you get through the first 72 hours of an emergency – earthquake, fire, flood, heatwave, blackout or war. All content is inside the app and works WITHOUT internet. Completely free, with no ads and no account.

• EMERGENCY – NOW: what to do step by step for each danger, in plain words with drawings.
• FIRST AID: CPR with rhythm, bleeding, choking, burns, shock, panic attack.
• PANIC BUTTON: one tap prepares an SMS with your location for your people – for a lost child or an adult in danger (discreet mode, fake call, "walk me home").
• WEATHER & BAROMETER: 7-day forecast with warnings, plus the iPhone's own barometer with a 3-hour trend – it alerts you when pressure drops. "Barometer watch" all night.
• NO NETWORK: messages by QR, by sound, Morse with light, SMS with location.
• SOS: screen light, whistle, Morse.
• MY KIT: what is in your bag and when medicines, food, water and batteries expire.
• COMPASS & GPS, sun, moon, track recording to find your way back.
• MY CARD: health info, emergency contacts, family plan.
• SCAMS & CYBERATTACK: how to protect yourself.
• GRANDPA DIAMANTIS' SKILLS: 135 old skills for life without power or shops, with drawings.
• A PDF guide to print and keep on paper.

Greek and English. Your data stays ONLY on your phone.

Kindly sponsored by George Barbaris – because the things that save lives are priceless.

Note: The app gives general information and does not replace 112, a doctor, the authorities or training. The panic button and SMS do not alert the authorities automatically.

name: Sutra: Ancient Wisdom
description:
Sutra brings the timeless teachings of the Vedas, Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita and Puranas into short, guided audio programs for everyday life — for stress, sleep, focus, relationships and finding your purpose.

Life's questions are old. So are some of the best answers. Anxiety before a big decision, nights you can't switch off, feeling lost at work or in a relationship — India's sages reflected on these thousands of years ago. Sutra takes that wisdom out of dense scripture and into a few calm minutes a day, explained in plain language and paired with a practice you can actually use. No Sanskrit or prior study needed.

WHY SUTRA
• Rooted in the texts — every program draws on a real verse, story or teaching.
• Minutes, not hours — short chapters fit a commute, a lunch break or the moments before sleep.
• Made for real life — browse by what you're going through, not by chapter and verse.
• A practice, not a lecture — chapters end with a meditation or reflection to carry into your day.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick what you need — explore programs by life area such as sleep, stress or focus.
2. Listen chapter by chapter — each program unfolds in short audio chapters.
3. Carry it with you — save favorites, download sessions for offline listening and pick up where you left off.

INSIDE THE APP
• Guided meditations, soundscapes and multi-chapter courses
• A calm player with background and lock-screen playback
• Continue listening right where you paused
• Favorite whole programs or single chapters
• Offline downloads for flights, retreats and places without signal
• Playback speed and quick skip controls
• Sign in with Apple or Google

Designed to feel like a quiet room — warm, unhurried and free of noise — so the only thing asking for your attention is the practice.

New programs are added regularly.

name: SvenClip
description:
Sven Clip is the bridge between SvenGallery and Sven Web, and a must-have for magicians and mentalists who use the Sven apps.

With Sven Clip, a photo can be captured and sent straight to your SvenGallery and Sven Web, ready for your magic performance. One Clip ID connects everything, so your whole Sven setup works together.

HOW IT WORKS
• Get your own Clip ID with a personal QR code and NFC card
• A spectator scans your QR code or taps your NFC card with their iPhone
• A simple camera opens, and the photo they take goes straight to your SvenGallery and Sven Web

FEATURES
• Connects SvenGallery and Sven Web with one Clip ID
• Show your QR code full screen
• Load your link onto an NFC card
• Use the built-in camera on your own phone

A photo is only sent when the spectator takes a picture, and each Clip ID belongs to one performer.

Unlock Sven Clip with a one-time in-app purchase.

Made for performers. Not for laymen.

name: Tabbo
description:
One tap in the widget, done: Tabbo is the medication reminder you operate straight from your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

THE WIDGET IS THE HEART OF IT
• Check off each medication with one tap right in the widget, without opening the app
• Large tap targets that are easy to hit
• Widgets for the Home Screen (small, medium, large) and the Lock Screen
• See at a glance what is still open today

A REMINDER THAT THINKS AHEAD
• Set a time for each medication by which you can check it off
• After that, the app reminds you every hour until 8 PM until you do
• As soon as you check off, the reminder is cancelled automatically
• You can also check off right from the notification with “Taken”

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• All data stays on your iPhone
• Available in German, English, French, Spanish and Italian

NOTE
Tabbo only reminds you to take your medication. It is not medical advice and does not recommend dosages.

name: Tabfolio
description:
A little like paper. A lot more possibilities.

Tabfolio brings PDFs, notebooks and keepsakes together in colourful digital binders. Find your place with page tabs, highlight useful passages and keep thoughts close with sticky notes.

MAKE ROOM FOR YOUR IDEAS
Create notebooks with ruled, dotted, grid or plain paper, handwriting-style fonts and gentle decorative details. Write headings, lists and checkboxes, or add freehand ink to PDFs and notebook pages. Read in single-page, facing-page or continuous views.

KEEP LITTLE MOMENTS
With Tabfolio Plus, add images to your notebook pages, crop and rotate them, and choose taped, torn, rounded or photo-style edges. Start a fresh page with a photo journal, little collection or recipe keepsake template.

A PRIVATE PLACE TO WRITE
Plus lets you protect individual notebooks or whole binders with a password. Choose separate passwords or your local default password, decide whether locked titles stay visible, and lock your private pages when you leave the app. Protected exports require your password. Keep the recovery key somewhere safe.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose stationery collections, mix your favourite packs and collect their colours for tabs, notes, highlights and ink. Customise your notebook's desk, cover, paper, ink, underline and rule colours.

TAKE YOUR WORK WITH YOU
