Export a combined PDF or an editable .tabfolio archive to back up or transfer your work between compatible Tabfolio versions on Windows, Mac and iPad. Your library is stored locally. No Tabfolio account is required, and automatic cloud synchronisation is not included. Archives transfer documents and artwork, not purchase ownership.

START FREE
Free includes up to 3 binders and 10 documents in total, unlimited notebook pages, Classic, Pastel and Botanical stationery, editing, annotations and PDF/Tabfolio exports.

An optional one-time Tabfolio Plus purchase unlocks unlimited binders and documents, all 10 core stationery collections, private binders and notebooks, and scrapbook images and templates. No subscription.

Four optional holiday packs — Cozy Christmas, Little Halloween, Spring Easter and Valentine Letters — are sold separately. Each works with Free or Plus and does not change binder or document limits.

Internet access and an Apple Account are needed to purchase or restore purchases through the App Store.

MADE FOR IPAD
Use Apple Pencil to draw or sweep over text for neat highlights. Use touch to navigate, rotate between portrait and landscape, and type with the onscreen or an external keyboard. Apple Scribble can turn handwriting into typed text in supported editable fields. Freehand ink remains drawn strokes; PDF OCR is not included.

name: Tablelight: Night Camera
description:
Someone says “one more” as everyone gets up from the table. Tablelight is an iPhone camera for that photo, for birthdays, and for the soft light at the end of a long dinner.

Set up the Tablelight Lock Screen control on a supported iPhone to open the viewfinder when you pick up your phone. After the moment has passed, try a warmer tone or keep the colors close to what you saw. The original stays in your gallery, and you can save or share the finished photo at full size. Use High detail when the lens and light allow, for small things like the writing on a cake.

The camera and the Warm, Natural, and Candlelight tones are included in the free download. A one-time Tablelight Plus purchase adds three more tones, lets you apply one look to several photos, and makes a shareable strip out of two to four shots.

name: Tabletop Minutes: AI Notes
description:
Stop writing up meetings. Put your iPhone on the table, talk, and leave with minutes you can send.

Tabletop Minutes records the meeting, transcribes it on your iPhone, and turns the transcript into
real minutes: what was discussed, what was decided, who does what by when. Not a wall of quotes.
The discussion is restated, repetition is merged, and numbers and dates are kept exact.

MINUTES THAT READ LIKE SOMEONE WROTE THEM
• An overview of the meeting in a few sentences
• Decisions, separated from discussion
• Action items with owner and due date, linked to the moment they came up
• Open questions and next steps
• Notes under each agenda item when you set an agenda
• Six formats: regular meeting, sales call, 1-on-1, interview, staff meeting, class or lecture
• Write the minutes in English, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Chinese or Korean, whatever
  language the meeting was in
• Export to Word (.docx), PDF (A4 or Letter), Markdown or plain text, or copy it ready for email

RUN THE MEETING, NOT THE APP
• Agenda mode: time each item, see the current item and time left, tap "Next item" to move on
• One tap to mark a remark as important or as an action item while people talk
• Live translation subtitles under the transcript, translated on device
• Speakers are told apart automatically by voice, on device; name them once, see talk time
• Custom vocabulary for names, products and jargon
• Keeps recording when the screen locks; pauses for calls and resumes

AFTER THE MEETING
• Every action item from every meeting in one tracker, with due dates and an overdue badge
• Send action items to Reminders
• Follow-up email drafted from the minutes
• Ask a meeting, or all of them: "What did we decide about pricing?" Answers cite the meeting
  and the exact moment
• Import recordings from Files, Voice Memos or another app and get minutes for those too
• Search every transcript; folders, tags, Face ID lock

BUILT FOR THE FOLD
On a folding iPhone the app follows the hinge:
• Half open on the table: live transcript and the current agenda item above the fold, large
  controls below
• Fully open: transcript on one side; summary, minutes and questions on the other
• Closed: one big record button and a timer on the outer display
On an iPhone that does not fold, everything works in a single-column layout.

YOUR AUDIO STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• Recording and transcription happen on device, using Apple's speech recognition. Audio is never
  uploaded.
• The free plan is fully on device: transcripts and summaries from the on-device Apple Intelligence
  model, nothing sent anywhere.
• High-accuracy minutes (Pro) send the transcript text, never the audio, to our server, where a
  large AI model writes the minutes. The text is not saved on our server. The app asks before the
  first time, and you can turn this off in Settings and stay fully on device.
• No account, no ads, no analytics.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 3 meetings a month, up to 30 minutes each. On-device transcripts and summaries, speaker
names, talk time, the action tracker, Siri shortcuts, and Markdown, text and audio export.

Tabletop Minutes Pro (subscription): high-accuracy AI minutes, unlimited meetings, and every
feature above.

• Monthly or yearly, with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers.
• Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you
  cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your
  Apple Account settings.
• High-accuracy minutes include a generous monthly allowance (40 hours of meetings).

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://takawmd2524-boop.github.io/tabletop-minutes-legal/privacy.html

Languages depend on what iOS supports on your device. On-device summaries need Apple Intelligence.
High-accuracy minutes need an internet connection. Tell people in the room that you are recording.

name: Tadabbur : comprendre le Coran
description:
Tu sais lire le Coran, mais tu ne comprends pas toujours ce que tu récites ? Tadabbur t’apprend à le comprendre directement en arabe, mot après mot, puis verset après verset.

LES MOTS DU CORAN, PAR ORDRE DE FRÉQUENCE
Les mots qui reviennent le plus d’abord : quelques centaines suffisent pour reconnaître une grande partie du texte. Chaque mot est montré dans l’écriture du mushaf, avec son sens, sa racine et un exemple tiré d’un vrai verset. Une carte à retourner, puis « Je savais » ou « À revoir » : la répétition espacée te les remontre juste avant que tu ne les oublies.

UN SEUL CHIFFRE, VRAI
La part du texte coranique que tu comprends, mesurée sur les vrais mots du Coran. Pas de points inventés : quand le chiffre monte, c’est que tu comprends réellement davantage.

LES EXPRESSIONS QUI REVIENNENT
Les tournures que l’on entend sans cesse dans la prière s’ouvrent quand tu connais leurs mots.

TROUVER LE SENS D’UN VRAI VERSET
Les versets dont tu connais déjà les mots s’ouvrent. Tu écris leur sens en français, même avec des fautes d’orthographe, et chaque idée est corrigée : trouvée, partielle, manquante ou contresens. Les versets longs se travaillent bloc par bloc. Puis l’analyse du verset t’explique sa construction.

UNE CORRECTION SANS INTELLIGENCE ARTIFICIELLE
Chaque correction est rédigée et vérifiée à l’avance, verset par verset. Elle reste cohérente, fonctionne sans réseau, et le texte coranique n’est jamais généré ni modifié.

À TON RYTHME
5, 10 ou 20 minutes par jour. Une série de jours pour garder l’habitude, sans notification culpabilisante.

TA PROGRESSION TE SUIT
Sans compte, tout reste sur ton iPhone. Avec un compte (Apple, Google ou email), ta progression est gardée et tu la retrouves sur un autre appareil.

GRATUIT
Tadabbur est gratuit et sans publicité. Un soutien facultatif, ponctuel ou mensuel, aide à rédiger de nouveaux versets. Le soutien mensuel se renouvelle automatiquement, payé par ton compte Apple, résiliable à tout moment dans les réglages de ce compte au moins 24 heures avant l’échéance. Rien n’est réservé à ceux qui soutiennent.

Conditions d’utilisation (EULA) : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://tadabbur.aksmustafa32.workers.dev/confidentialite
Conditions : https://tadabbur.aksmustafa32.workers.dev/conditions

name: Tagscope: Web Inspector
description:
Tagscope brings the web inspector to iPhone. Open any page in Safari, tap the Tagscope extension, and a panel opens at the bottom of the page: no Mac, no cable, no account.

The page stays visible above the panel. Drag the handle to resize it, minimize it to a floating button, or close it without reloading the page.

ELEMENTS
• The DOM tree of the page, loaded as you open it, even on heavy pages
• Tap Select, then tap the page to find any element, highlighted with its margins
• Edit text, attributes and styles live, and cancel to put everything back
• The box model and the CSS rules that apply, with their file and line
• Copy the HTML of a node or its selector

CONSOLE
• Messages and errors since the page started loading, with file and line
• Run JavaScript in the page, with history; $0 is the selected element
• Expand objects, copy any line

SOURCE
• The original HTML, fetched again with your session, so signed-in pages show what you see
• Syntax colors, line numbers, search, line wrap, copy and share as a file
• The current DOM, after scripts ran

NETWORK
• Every address the page loaded
• Fetch and XHR with status, size, time and headers
• In the Tagscope browser: status, size, type and time of every request, filters, search, sort by size and a HAR export

STORAGE AND INFO
• Cookies readable by scripts, localStorage and sessionStorage: edit or delete
• Address, user agent, screen size, meta tags, links and images of the page

THE TAGSCOPE BROWSER
Open any address in the app with the same inspector and the full Network tab, plus favorites and history on your iPhone. It works even if you don't turn the extension on.

Every text in the inspector can be selected and copied. The interface is in English, French and German.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The pages you inspect stay on your iPhone: their content, source and requests are never sent to us
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Anonymous usage statistics, which you can turn off in Settings

FREE, THEN ONE PURCHASE
Free: 3 inspected pages, with every tool. Our demo page never counts.
Tagscope Unlock is a one-time purchase, with no subscription: every page, every tool, in Safari and in the app.

The extension needs your permission in Settings (4 steps, about a minute: the app guides you). Safari doesn't run extensions on a few pages, such as its own pages and some Apple sites.

name: TakkenNova 宅建 一問一答・模擬試験
description:
TakkenNova（タッケンノバ）は、宅地建物取引士資格試験（宅建）の対策アプリです。権利関係・法令上の制限・税・宅建業法・免除科目の 5 分野を、テキスト・一問一答・模擬試験で一つのアプリで。弱点の分析と合格予測が、次に何をやるかを決めてくれます。法令は 2026 年 4 月 1 日時点の内容です。

■ 今日の学習（弱点の分析と合格予測）
一問一答の正誤と模擬試験の採点結果を単元ごとに集め、正答率の低い単元を弱点として出します。復習の期限が来た問題（忘却曲線: 1 → 3 → 7 → 14 → 30 日）、弱点の単元、まだ解いていない問題を 20 問に組んだ「今日の学習」をホームに用意します。本番の配点（権利関係 14・法令上の制限 8・税 3・宅建業法 20・免除科目 5）に出来を当てはめた合格予測の点も毎日更新されます。

■ テキスト（50 本）
単元ごとに、要点・数字の表（建蔽率の緩和・開発許可の面積・報酬の計算・保全措置の基準など）・「ここが出る」を短くまとめました。読んだらそのまま単元の問題へ進めます。

■ 一問一答（502 問）
・権利関係（164 問・16 単元）: 意思表示、制限行為能力者、代理、時効、物権変動、共有・相隣関係、抵当権、保証・連帯債務・債権譲渡、債務不履行・解除、売買・請負、不法行為、相続、借家、借地、区分所有法、不動産登記法
・法令上の制限（88 問・9 単元）: 都市計画、開発許可、用途制限・建蔽率・容積率、道路・高さ・防火・建築確認、国土利用計画法、農地法、盛土規制法、土地区画整理法、その他の法令
・税・価格の評定（53 問・7 単元）: 不動産取得税、固定資産税、登録免許税、印紙税、譲渡所得と贈与税の特例、地価公示法、不動産鑑定評価基準
・宅建業法（164 問・14 単元）: 宅建業の定義、免許、宅地建物取引士、営業保証金、保証協会、事務所・案内所、広告と契約の時期、媒介契約、重要事項の説明、37 条書面、自ら売主の制限（8 種制限）、報酬、監督処分と罰則、住宅瑕疵担保履行法
・免除科目（33 問・4 単元）: 住宅金融支援機構、景品表示法と表示規約、土地、建物
本番と同じ 4 択（「正しいものはいくつあるか」の個数問題を含む）と、要点を確かめる ○× で。間違えた問題とブックマークで、苦手なところだけを繰り返せます。

■ 模擬試験（本番形式・10 回分）
権利関係 14 問・法令上の制限 8 問・税・価格 3 問・宅建業法 20 問・免除科目 5 問の 50 問、120 分。本番と同じ順番・同じ配分で、個数問題も入っています。自動で採点して分野ごとの点を出し、全問の正解と解説で見直せます。その回で落とした単元はテキストにつながります。
問題冊子・答案用紙（マークシート）・採点表を印刷して紙で解き、答えを入れて採点することもできます。
※ 本番の問 48（統計）は毎年数字が変わるため扱わず、模擬試験では土地・建物などの問題にしています。

■ 通知
毎日のリマインダー（時刻を選べます）は、その日の復習の数と弱点の単元を本文にします。本番の日を入れると、ホームに残り日数が出て、1 週間前・3 日前・前日・当日にも知らせます。

■ 記録
合格予測（分野ごと）、弱点の単元、分野ごとの正答率、模擬試験の点の推移、日ごとの学習量を残します。

■ 料金
無料: 各分野の最初の 20 問と最初の単元のテキスト、模擬試験の第1回（印刷・紙の採点を含む）。弱点の分析・合格予測・通知は無料で使えます。
すべての問題（買い切り ¥980、1 回払い）: すべての一問一答・テキスト・模擬試験。今後の版で増える問題も追加料金なしで使えます。
・サブスクリプションではありません。自動更新はなく、お支払いは 1 回だけです。
・機種を変えたときは、同じ Apple ID で「購入を復元」を押すと引き継げます。

■ 安心してお使いいただくために
通信は一切しません。アカウントも広告もありません。記録はこの iPhone の中だけに残り、通知もこの iPhone の中で組みます。

■ 問題について
問題と解説はすべて当社の書き下ろしで、実際の試験の過去問ではありません。法令は 2026 年 4 月 1 日時点の民法・借地借家法・区分所有法・不動産登記法・都市計画法・建築基準法・宅地建物取引業法などにもとづいています（2026 年 4 月施行の改正区分所有法、2025 年 4 月の建築確認の見直し、2024 年 7 月の空家の報酬の特例を含みます）。改正があれば更新します。合格点は年ごとに変わるため、アプリでは 35 点を目安にしています。誤りに気づかれた場合は、サポートページからお知らせください。

宅地建物取引士資格試験は一般財団法人不動産適正取引推進機構が実施する国家試験です。本アプリは同機構の公式アプリではなく、承認や推奨を受けたものではありません。

利用規約（EULA）: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
プライバシーポリシー: https://ars-sys.github.io/takkennova-legal/

name: Tallyfax: Send Fax from iPhone
description:
Need to fax something today? Tallyfax turns your iPhone into a fax machine. Scan the pages, type the number, send. You get proof it arrived.

PAY FOR THE FAX YOU SEND
• $4.99 sends one fax, any number of pages. One charge, nothing renews.
• Sending a lot? Unlimited is $14.99 a month or $99.99 a year, clearly labelled, cancel anytime. It includes your own fax number.
• No free trial that quietly becomes a weekly charge.

DELIVERED, OR YOUR SEND IS RETURNED
• Busy lines are retried automatically, up to 3 times.
• If a fax still can't be delivered, your prepaid send goes back to you, so you can fix the number and try again.

PROOF IT ARRIVED
• Watch each page go through, live.
• Get a delivery receipt (PDF) with the recipient, number, page count, and the times it was submitted and delivered.

RECEIVE FAXES TOO (UNLIMITED)
• Get your own US fax number, included with Unlimited.
• Faxes sent to it arrive in the app as PDFs to read, save, print or forward, with an alert when one comes in.

SIGN AND FAX BACK
• Sign forms and fill them in with Apple's Markup, right on the page.
• Got a form by fax? Tap Sign & Fax Back to sign it and send it straight back.

EVERYTHING A FAX NEEDS
• Scan paper documents with the camera, or add photos and PDF files.
• Add a cover page in seconds: to, from, subject, a short note, urgent and confidential flags.
• Reorder or remove pages before you send.
• Pick the number from your contacts.
• Every fax and receipt is kept on your device. Works on iPhone and iPad.

Sends to the US, Canada and 60+ other countries, including the UK, Ireland, most of Europe, Mexico, Brazil, Japan, Australia and India, at the same price. Mobile and premium-rate numbers aren't supported.

Terms of Use: https://tallyfax.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://tallyfax.app/privacy

name: Tập Thở - Tập lặn tự do
description:
Tập Thở is a breath-hold trainer for dry land. It guides you through relaxed breathing, times your personal best, and builds CO2 and O2 tables from that record so you can improve step by step.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Breathe-up: slow belly breathing (4-second inhale, long exhale) with an animated guide.
• Personal best test: time your longest hold and see your progress on a chart.
• CO2 table: holds stay at half your record while rest periods get shorter.
• O2 table: rest stays at 2:00 while holds grow up to 5/6 of your record.
• Sound cues and vibration, so you can train with your eyes closed.
• The screen stays on during a session.
• Step-by-step guide: the full inhale, getting through diaphragm contractions, recovery breathing.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no internet needed. Your history is stored only on your phone.

SAFETY FIRST
• Train only on land, lying on your back on a bed or mat.
• Never practise in or near water (pools, bathtubs), while standing, driving or operating machinery.
• If you feel dizzy, numb, have blurred vision or chest pain, breathe normally right away.
• If you have a heart, blood pressure or lung condition, epilepsy, or are pregnant, ask a doctor before training.
Tập Thở is a training timer, not a medical device, and does not give medical advice.

The app interface is in Vietnamese.

name: Tasu: Manifest & Affirmations
description:
Write your intentions down, then forget them a week later?
Tasu brings your intention back to you every day: personal affirmation cards, writing three times a day, recordings in your own voice and a streak that grows. A few calm minutes a day.
No ads, and the daily rhythm is free. What you write and record is backed up to your account and comes with you to a new phone.

FREE AT THE CORE
Today's rhythm, 369 writing, your evidence journal, 1 card a day, 2 active intentions and 1 voice recording are free, every day. More practices open day by day as you keep coming back.

TODAY'S RHYTHM
A short rhythm every day: finish today's lesson, write your intention 3, 6 and 9 times through the day, add a piece of evidence. When it's done, your streak grows by one stone.

TODAY'S CARDS
Affirmation cards made for you arrive one by one: read them aloud, favorite them, rewrite them or share them as an image.

IN YOUR OWN VOICE
Record your affirmations in your own voice and listen with rain, ocean or a crystal bowl. In sleep mode the sound fades out on its own.

369, 55×5 AND SCRIPTING
Popular writing methods in one place: 3-6-9 through the day, 55 times a day for 5 days, your future told in the present tense.

SIGN OF THE DAY AND YOUR EVIDENCE JOURNAL
Every day brings a small sign to look out for. Note the signs, chances and grateful moments you notice, add photos and build your own archive of evidence.

A LETTER TO YOUR FUTURE SELF
Write what you're dreaming of today, seal it and pick the day it opens. You get a reminder when it's ready.

A BREATHING BREAK AND GUIDED SESSIONS
A short box-breathing break, a three-minute visualization of your intention as if it's already real, and Stone Stack, a small balancing game. Premium adds guided breathing and meditation.

CLOSE THE WEEK AND MOON RITUALS
Every Sunday, three short questions and one small step for the week ahead. Add an intention at the new moon; let something go at the full moon.

WIDGETS, SHORTCUTS AND REMINDERS
Today's card on your home and lock screen. Press and hold the app icon to write your sign, take a breathing break or play Stone Stack. Set reminders for your own schedule.

STREAKS, BADGES AND REPORTS
Miss a day and a rest day keeps your streak. Collect badges, see your weekly summary, monthly report and your journey since day one.

YOUR COLORS
Terracotta, rose, plum, pine or sea, light or dark. Your companion Filiz, a little tower of three stones, walks with you.

BACKED UP TO YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with Google or Apple. Your intentions, journal, photos and voice recordings are backed up and come back when you sign in on a new phone. Delete your account and data in the app at any time.

TASU PREMIUM
Premium unlocks whispers through the day (your own sentences as notifications at hours you choose), insights into your rhythm (your strongest hours, mood and intentions), 21-day paths on 7 themes, a lock screen wallpaper, 5 cards a day, unlimited intentions and recordings, the 55×5 and scripting methods, and the sleep timer.
• Monthly and yearly subscriptions (3-day free trial on yearly), or a one-time lifetime purchase that never renews.
• If you allow notifications, we'll remind you 1 day before your trial ends.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase.
• The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; renewal is charged within the last 24 hours of the period.
• You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings, or tap "Manage subscription" in Profile. "Request a refund" is right next to it.
• Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Tasu is a focus and habit tool; it does not guarantee any result and is not a substitute for professional support.

Privacy Policy: https://febroine.com/apps/manifest/privacy
Terms of Use: https://febroine.com/apps/manifest/terms

name: Teamora: Motorsport Jobs
description:
Teamora is the recruitment and collaboration platform for motorsport. Teams, racing outfits, championships and organizers find the right professionals. Mechanics, engineers, photographers, coordinators and hospitality specialists find their next mission.

FOR TEAMS
• Publish public jobs or share them through a private link, for one event, a race weekend or a whole season
• Find talent by role, discipline, skills and championship
• Follow every application and talk directly with candidates
• Prepare and sign your contracts, then follow them until the end of the mission
• Launch an urgent request when a position opens at the last minute

FOR PROFESSIONALS
• Build your Motorsport Passport: experience, skills, championships, languages and availability
• Browse jobs month by month and see the ones that match your profile
• Apply in a few taps and follow the progress of your applications
• Chat with Teams and sign your contracts from your iPhone

TRUST AND PRIVACY
• Structured profiles, company verification and content moderation
• Your CVs, documents and contracts stay private: only the people involved can access them
• Teamora is available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese

name: teamSafe Academy
description:
TeamSafe Academy is the recipe and drinks book for restaurants, canteens, catering and bars – with automatic allergen labelling, hygiene and safety notes and a learning mode for your team.

RECIPES AND DRINKS
• Soups, starters, main courses, desserts and drinks, clearly organised
• Ingredients, quantities, steps, final image and an image for every step
• Take photos directly with the camera
• Category recognised automatically from the name

ALLERGENS (EU 14)
• The 14 major allergens are calculated automatically from the ingredients
• Over 400 ingredients included, more than 120 of them spices and herbs
• Check status for every ingredient – unchecked information is clearly flagged
• Allergen overview of all dishes as a PDF for guests or display

SAFETY AND HYGIENE
• Symbols for cross-contamination, raw food, raw egg, cold chain, heat, hot fat, open flame, knives and youth protection
• Colour code for chopping boards: red, yellow, blue, green, brown, white
• Notes shown directly at the affected step
• Tap a symbol – its meaning appears instantly

SURPRISE MEAL
• Take photos of your groceries – the AI recognises the products
• Get 3 suggestions or a full menu: starter, soup, main course, dessert
• Tap a course and the complete recipe is created

LEARNING MODE
• Quizzes on allergens, ingredients, steps, symbols and board colours
• Questions generated from your own recipes
• Results with name and date stored on the device

PRINT AND SHARE
• Print any recipe or share it as an A4 PDF
• Including symbols, board colours and allergens

AI – OPTIONAL
• Recipe suggestion from the name, ingredients from free text, images for the final dish and every step
• Apple Intelligence on-device or ChatGPT / Claude with your own API key
• Data is only sent after your consent
• The app works fully without AI

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• All recipes stay on your iPad

Note: Allergen and safety information does not replace a HACCP plan or staff training. Always check the information against product labels.

Developed in Germany by TeamSafe.

TERMS AND LICENCE
Apple's Standard End User License Agreement (EULA) applies, supplemented by the TeamSafe terms of use:
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms of use: https://www.team-safe.com/Documents/academy/agb.html
Privacy: https://www.team-safe.com/datenschutz.html

name: Tell Santa: Christmas List
description:
"Tell Santa" is what our family says in a store. The kids see something they want, and instead of asking for it now, they take a picture for Santa. This app is that ritual, made for small hands.

FOR KIDS
• One big red button. Take a picture, and Santa comes up from behind his workbench, reads it, winks and puts it on his shelf.
• Every wish is a photo card on the shelves of Santa's workshop, with a count of the sleeps left until Christmas.
• The toys on the wall answer a press: the robot marches, the duck quacks, and the string of lights plays a tune.
• Three gold stars to give to the wishes that matter most. Gold-star wishes stand first on the top shelf.
• "Which do you want more?": two wishes side by side, tap one.
• No prices, no ads, no store links and no purchases on the kids' side.

FOR GROWN-UPS, BEHIND FACE ID
• The list: every picture named, with the best price we could read off a store's own page and links to the stores that carry it.
• Mark a wish Planned, Bought or Wrapped, and note what you paid.
• One link for grandparents and relatives. They open the list in a browser, with no account, and mark what they are getting, so nobody buys the same thing twice. The kids never see it.
• Invite the other parent, and sign in on a computer at tellsanta.app.
• No signal in the aisle? The app still opens at once and takes the picture. The wish is kept on the phone and sent when it is back online.

TELL SANTA PLUS: $4.99 FOR ONE CHRISTMAS, AND IT DOES NOT RENEW
• Price watch: each wish's best price is checked every day and its history is kept.
• Budget: what is spent and planned for each kid, against the number you set.
• What they want most: the ranking that comes out of the kids' own choices.
• A third kid and more, and past Christmases.
Without Plus you still get every wish named, the best price with store links, the relatives' link and two kids.

PRIVACY
• Kids have no accounts. A kid is a first name and a character.
• Each picture goes to our server and to an AI service (Anthropic's Claude) to work out what the item is and to find it in stores. No name, age or email goes with it, and location is removed from every picture.
• No third-party analytics and no advertising.
• Delete your account, and every picture with it, from the Family screen at any time.

Store links are affiliate links: if you buy through one, we may earn a commission. That never changes which price is shown.

Terms: https://tellsanta.app/terms
Privacy: https://tellsanta.app/privacy

name: Temy & Pumky: Castle Escape
description:
Temy and Pumky woke up in the dungeon of a spooky castle. Time to escape together!

Temy & Pumky is a colorful pixel-art platformer made for young children. It's a not-too-scary Halloween adventure you can play all year round, with shy ghosts, silly zombies, bats and lots of candy to collect! Simple controls and a new surprise in every level.

Temy glides with her cape and turns into a bat to fly through narrow tunnels. Pumky smashes cracked walls with his super punch and makes huge long jumps. Switch between them at any time and use the right power for every obstacle!

• 10 worlds, 100 levels: dungeon, graveyard crypt, haunted hallway, wizard tower, dragon lair and more
• 10 bosses: vampire, zombie, giant ghost, three-headed dog, werewolf, giant frog, dragon and Dracula
• Tower climbs, rising-lava escapes and chase levels
• Easy joystick for little hands, or classic arrow buttons
• Kids and Challenge difficulty modes, 4 game speeds
• 8 languages: English, Turkish, German, French, Japanese, Chinese, Russian, Korean
• Music for every world

For kids who love Halloween: no need to wait for October! This castle full of vampires, ghosts and candy feels like Halloween every day.

The first 2 worlds (20 levels) are free. Unlock all the other worlds with a single one-time purchase – no subscriptions. Purchases are protected by a parent check.

For parents: no ads, no personal data collection and no internet needed to play. Progress is stored only on the device.

name: Ternweave
description: ଆଶାବାଦୀ, ସର୍ବାଧିକ ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ଏବଂ ନିରାଶାବାଦୀ—ତିନି ବିନ୍ଦୁରେ ସମୟ ଅନୁମାନ କରନ୍ତୁ। କାମ ସାରିଲା ପରେ ପ୍ରକୃତ ସମୟ ଲେଖି ତୁଳନା କରନ୍ତୁ; ସମାନ ପ୍ରକାରର ପୂର୍ବ କାମ ଅନୁଯାୟୀ ଅନୁମାନ ସଠିକ୍ ହୁଏ। ବିତରଣ ଚିତ୍ର, ଇତିହାସ ଓ ରପ୍ତାନି—ସବୁ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫୋନରେ ରହେ, ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ଲାଗି ନାହିଁ।

name: Tesis UCM
description:
Consulta en tu iPhone un catálogo de 15.419 tesis doctorales de la Universidad Complutense de Madrid. Busca por título, autor, director, materia o palabras del resumen. Combina los filtros por año de defensa y materia para localizar los trabajos que te interesan.
- Consulta la ficha de cada tesis con sus datos y resumen, cuando estén disponibles.
- Abre los PDF desde la app y descárgalos para leerlos sin conexión.
- Guarda tus tesis favoritas, añade notas y marca páginas.
- Retoma la lectura en la página donde la dejaste.
El catálogo está incluido en la app y puedes consultarlo sin conexión desde el primer uso. Para leer un PDF sin conexión, descárgalo previamente.

name: TETHER: Swing!
description:
Two orbs share a rod. One sits on a dot while the other swings around it, and you tap when the swinging orb passes over the next dot to swap them. You only ever tap, but the courses get hard quick.

CAMPAIGN
78 levels across 13 worlds. Each world brings its own trick: dots that drift, reverse your swing, vanish, pulse, pull you in, warp you ahead or bounce you off walls. The last level of a world mixes in everything before it, with checkpoints for when you need them. Land perfect swings to earn up to 3 stars.

ENDLESS AND DAILY
Endless keeps building new courses and speeds up the longer you last. The daily run gives everyone the same 30 second course, so you can race the ghosts of that day's best players.

BUILD AND SHARE
Make your own levels in the editor, publish them and send friends the 6 letter code. You can find levels by code or name, like the ones you enjoy, and play featured levels for stars and gems.

FRIENDS AND BOARDS
Add friends with a friend code, compare scores, race their ghosts and check the global boards for endless and the daily.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock pairs that play differently, rod mods that change the rules, trails, orb skins, rod colors, menu themes and 22 custom songs.

name: Thanked
description:
After a gathering, it can be hard to remember every gift and every thank-you. Create an event, record each gift and its giver, and mark the thank-you when you send it. An event overview shows what still needs a note.

Start with one event and one gift for free. The optional one-time Lifetime purchase adds more events and gifts, totals grouped by currency, and CSV export.

Thanked works offline. Your event records stay on your device, and you can save an optional backup through Files.

name: Thawlet
description:
Somewhere on a winter night, a snowman in a tall black hat is waiting for you to find his word. Pick letters one at a time: the right ones drop into place, the wrong ones nudge the sun higher. Seven wrong letters and he melts away — carrot, scarf, twig arms and all — into a puddle on the snow.

HOW A ROUND WORKS
• A hidden word, a category and an on-screen A–Z keyboard.
• Correct letters turn green and fill every matching slot.
• Each wrong letter turns red and uses one of seven warm-ups.
• Stuck? Two hints per round reveal the most common hidden letter, at a cost of 20 points.
• Score: 10 points per letter plus 15 for every warm-up you still have.
• Three snowflakes for a word with at most one wrong letter and no hints.

THE WINTER TRAIL
48 words across eight categories — Animals, Fruit & veg, Weather & sky, Music, Travel, Kitchen, Sports and Around the house — six per category, shorter words first. Clear a word to open the next one and come back to raise your snowflakes. Nearly 200 words in total feed the trail and the daily puzzle.

WORD OF THE DAY
One fresh word each day, the same for everyone on that date. A little row of seven circles shows how your week went: green for a word found, red for a melt.

FIRESIDE · PASS AND PLAY
Type a secret word of 3 to 12 letters while a friend looks away (it stays hidden as you type), add an optional clue of up to 30 characters, then hand over the device and watch them try to keep the snowman standing.

YOUR WINTER SO FAR
Words played, share guessed, current and longest streak, and a bar chart of how many wrong letters each solved word took. Eight badges to collect, from First flake and Cold streak to Winter scholar for clearing the whole trail and Bare hands for ten trail words without a hint.

CALM BY DESIGN
• Drifting snow, a swaying green aurora and pine silhouettes — or a still frame if you switch the animation off.
• Optional soft haptics on every letter.
• Works on phone and tablet, in portrait or landscape.
• No account, no adverts, no purchases, no internet needed — your progress stays on the device.

Put the kettle on, pick a letter and see how long your snowman lasts.

name: The Guide for FF Resonance
description:
The unofficial walkthrough for FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE: your next step, every boss's weakness before you scan it, and all 99 Tablet Shards, 26 Visions and 9 Espers placed on your way.

Your next step
- The eight chapters and After the Story: 403 numbered steps to tick as you play, and 32 side quests with a way back to your step.
- Tablet Shards, chests and tips in boxes under each step. Continue opens the step you stopped at.
- Before each point of no return: what you can still miss, each thing opening its step.

Bosses and the Bestiary
- 52 boss pages: their elements first, then the plan, then the Visions you have that help.
- 362 enemies by place, with what they are weak to before you scan them, what they resist and absorb, what to steal and what they drop.
- 32 optional fights: the caves, the Colosseum's leagues, the Chamber of Arms and Ultima Weapon.

Stuck?
- A nudge first, then a hint, then the solution: you choose how much you are told.
- Ask a question about where you are: it is answered on your device, from the guide's pages up to your chapter. Nothing leaves the device (Apple Intelligence, iOS 26).

Visions and Espers
- The 26 Visions and the 9 Espers: where to find each one, and the Sanctum of Light's questions, answered one tap at a time.

100 %
- The 99 Tablet Shards, 188 chests, 12 Legendary Arms and 40 achievements, with what you can get now.

On iPad, a sidebar beside the steps and the page you open.

Chapter 1 is free, like the game's demo, with every list and count, search and Ask. The rest of the book, chapter 2 to After the Story, is one purchase: The complete guide. No ads, no account, no subscription. Chapters and bosses ahead keep their names until you reach them.

An unofficial guide, written by us in our own words from facts cross-checked between several sources. It was not checked in the game. The game's screenshots and icons belong to Square Enix. The screenshots come from the game's Steam page and Final Fantasy Wiki, the Vision and party icons from Final Fantasy Wiki. FINAL FANTASY is a registered trademark of Square Enix Holdings Co., Ltd. This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.

name: The R.A.D. Method
description:
Is that microbrand watch actually quality? Or just good marketing?

The RAD Method scores a watch on the three things that matter:

R - Reliability: the movement, and the brand standing behind it
A - Assembly: the materials, and the workmanship
D - Design: does it hang together, and does it have the vibes?

Twelve checks, each scored in quarter points, for a total out of 12.

- 10.0 or higher earns the RAD WATCH stamp -  a Rad Watch can only afford to drop two points
- Reliability + Assembly at 7.0 or higher earns the QUALITY WATCH stamp  -  a genuinely quality watch, even if the design isn't for you

HOW IT WORKS
Type in the make and model, and the app fills in the specs - movement, case material, crystal, price -  from a built-in catalog of 4,300+ microbrand watches, every one verified against the brand's own store. It even checks the movement against the RAD Movement Price List and suggests a score for "appropriate to the price," with the reasoning shown. Every suggestion is overridable. Your wrist, your call.

When you're done, you get a branded scorecard image with all 12 scores, the verdict, and the stamps. Save it, share it, post it.

COMMUNITY
Make a free account and your ratings join the Community: the latest ratings from everyone, the top rated watches this month, and a Leaderboard of the most active raters. Rad's own ratings live in their own section, so you can see exactly what Rad scores and how. Rather stay a guest? Your saved scores stay on your device.

GUIDES BUILT IN
How the scoring works, the Movement Price List, and the Case Material Cheat Sheet - the same cheat sheets from the free R.A.D. Pack, right in the app.

THE RAD METHOD CHALLENGE - DECEMBER
All December, score a Dufrane in the app, film your rating, and post it for a shot at winning a Dufrane Travis MkII. The app is the Challenge's scoring companion - full details are in the app and on Rad's TikTok and Instagram. 18+, U.S. residents.

No snobbery, no bought opinions: the RAD Method takes no affiliate or paid deals from watch manufacturers, so a score is a score.

Free, with no in-app purchases. Made by Rad (@radwatchman), for new and novice collectors learning microbrands.

name: The Tab: Group Drink Counter
description:
The Tab is a shared drink log for you and your friends. Start a group, invite your crew with a six-character code, and keep a running count together over weeks, months, or years.
GROUPS
• Create a group, set a goal, and choose which drinks count
• Tap +1 to log a drink and watch the group total update for everyone
• See the group's progress on a chart and in the activity feed
• Celebrate milestones together
SOCIAL
• Share posts and photos with your groups or on your profile
• Like, comment, and reply
• Follow friends and find new people on the Discover tab
• Message friends directly, or talk in each group's chat
YOU'RE IN CONTROL
• Make your profile public or private
• Block or report anyone, from any profile, post, comment, or message
• Delete your posts, messages, or your whole account at any time
• A friendly pace check if you log a lot in a short time
The Tab is for adults 21 and over. Please drink responsibly and never drink and drive.

name: TheBCHEY
description:
HEY is the members' app for The Business Culture Hull and East Yorkshire.

Membership is by invitation, so you need an invite from The Business Culture to sign in.

FIND THE RIGHT PEOPLE
Tell HEY what your business does and what it needs help with. The app matches you with members who can help, and with businesses you can team up with to reach new customers.

TALK TO MEMBERS
Message any member straight from their profile, and keep every conversation together in your inbox.

STAY IN THE LOOP
TBCHEY events, Good News from members, Know How articles and member offers, all in one place.

A WEEKLY INSIGHT
A short insight each week to help you get more from the network.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR WAY
Keep your business details, what you offer and what you are looking for up to date, so the right members find you.

name: Thermometer : Home Temperature
description:
Turn your iPhone and iPad into an intelligent indoor thermometer and complete home climate companion.

Whether you want to check the comfort level of your living room, balance the climate of a baby nursery, calibrate active heating and cooling appliances, or track local outdoor weather, Home Thermometer brings a sleek, high-precision climate tracking suite right to your screen. By combining our multi-zone thermodynamic & psychrometric climate engine with live local meteorological data, Home Thermometer delivers instant room-by-room temperature, humidity, and comfort insights.

THE ULTIMATE HOME CLIMATE TOOLKIT

1. Room-by-Room Indoor Climate & Humidity
- 8 Dedicated Home Zones: Switch effortlessly between Living Room, Bedroom, Kitchen, Bathroom, Kids Room, Study, Hallway, and Balcony—each modeled with its own thermal profile.
- Comfort & Humidity Tracking: Monitor indoor relative humidity (%RH), daily High/Low ranges, and real-time comfort status (Cool, Ideal Comfort, Warm) in °C or °F.
- Manual Fine-Tuning: Apply custom per-room temperature offsets to match your exact room layout or reference thermometer.

2. Smart Device & HVAC Calibration
- Active Appliance Profiling: Calibrate indoor temperature and moisture balance dynamically for Air Conditioners, Radiators, Fans, Electric Heaters, Underfloor Heating, and Humidifiers.
- Live Calibration Preview: Toggle your home's active systems and watch temperature and humidity respond in real time across every room and widget.

3. Real-Time Outdoor Weather & 7-Day Forecast
- Local Meteorology: Track live outdoor temperature, feels-like temperature, humidity, wind speed, and sky conditions for your exact location.
- Hourly & Weekly Outlook: Plan ahead with a 24-hour hourly forecast strip and a 7-day temperature range bar to compare indoor and outdoor trends at a glance.

DESIGNED FOR EVERY SCREEN & STYLE

- 7 Signature Color Themes: Personalize your experience with handcrafted palettes including Classic Studio, Warm Amber, Nordic Blue, Pure Dark, Cyber Matrix, Quartz Rose, and Monochrome.
- Home & Lock Screen Widgets: View live room temperature, humidity, comfort status, and gauges directly on your iPhone and iPad Home Screen and Lock Screen.
- Universal iPhone & iPad Experience: Responsively crafted for every iPhone and iPad screen in both Portrait and Landscape orientations.
- 20 Languages Supported: Fully localized in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Simplified & Traditional Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, and Indonesian.

SUBSCRIPTIONS & IN-APP PURCHASES

Home Thermometer offers full access to all rooms, calibration tools, color themes, and live widgets through an auto-renewable Weekly Subscription or a one-time Lifetime purchase.
- Plan Options: Choose between a flexible Weekly Subscription or a single One-Time Lifetime unlock.
- Payment & Renewal: Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- Manage Subscriptions: You can manage and cancel subscriptions anytime in your App Store account settings after purchase. Technical Note: Because mobile devices do not contain dedicated ambient room air sensors, indoor temperature and humidity values are algorithmic estimations computed by our thermodynamic and psychrometric climate model using local weather metadata, thermal building dynamics, and your selected appliance calibration.

Privacy Policy: https://doc-hosting.flycricket.io/thermometer-home-temperature/e3793a83-6edc-489a-b75f-ab5fb1b1a210/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Thock Calc
description:
Thock Calc is a calculator that feels like typing on a vintage platinum keyboard.

KEYS YOU CAN FEEL — TWO-STAGE MECHANICAL FEEL
- Touch to type, then slide down to press deeper: a two-stage key feel like a real mechanical keyboard
- Sculpted retro keycaps that sink as you press
- A deep, cushioned key sound recorded from a real keyboard, tuned for speakers and AirPods
- Rapid Trigger types again as you rock your finger up and down
- Haptics on every keystroke

TALK TO IT — VOICE (STT) MATH
- Speech-to-text turns what you say into a formula, then the app calculates it
- Tap MIC and say the problem: "5 apples at 500 each, I pay 5,000 — change?"
- It writes the formula on a green CRT, then the app does the math
- Speech recognition runs on your iPhone; works in 12 languages

CURRENCY IN ONE SENTENCE
- "How much is 50 rubles in won?" — 160+ currencies
- Rates update up to twice a day and are saved for offline use

BIG NUMBERS, EXACT ANSWERS
- Up to 50 digits with exact decimal math (no floating-point surprises)
- Long numbers shrink and wrap so every digit stays visible

TRY EVERYTHING FREE FOR 7 DAYS
- Start a free 7-day trial of every feature
- Then keep Pro with a one-time $0.99 purchase (no subscription), or stay on the free basic calculator with key sounds

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Your voice and history never leave your iPhone

Exchange rates by Exchange Rate API (exchangerate-api.com).

name: Thread: People Notes
description:
Thread is a private notebook for remembering what matters about the people in your life. Save a note after a conversation, leave yourself a detail to pick up, and revisit a few threads in a short weekly review.

- Keep a small circle of people and the details you want to remember.
- Review up to three threads at a time and decide which one to pick up.
- Write your own message and open your device’s message composer when you choose.
- Use an optional app lock and make an encrypted backup you can keep or restore.

Your notebook is stored on your device. You can start with five active people for free. A one-time purchase expands your circle to 50 active people. The store shows the local price before purchase.

name: Tidepane: Tide Charts
description:
Every US tide, in a pane of glass.

Tidepane shows the water at your beach right now: the screen fills to today's tide height and rises and falls with it. Every high and low for 3,398 NOAA stations is worked out on your iPhone, so it keeps working on the beach, on the boat and anywhere without a signal. Widgets are free. There are no ads, ever.

THE WATER, RIGHT NOW
• Live water level, rising or falling, and how fast
• Countdown to the next high or low
• Today's curve with every high and low, sunrise and sunset
• Drag across the curve to see any hour: the water and the sky move with you
• Wind, air and water temperature, and the moon

PLAN AHEAD
• The week at a glance, with the lowest water of each day
• Negative lows and king tides called out
• A full year of tides in the calendar (Pro)
• Low Tide Finder: the best daylight lows for tidepooling, clamming and beach walks, 90 days out

ALERTS
• A heads-up before a low tide, a high tide or a water level you pick
• Only in daylight, only on weekends, 30 minutes to the night before
• See exactly when you'll hear before you save

WIDGETS AND LOCK SCREEN, FREE
• Water level, next low, today's curve and three days on your Home Screen
• The next tide on your Lock Screen
• A Live Activity that counts down to the next tide (Pro)

3,398 NOAA STATIONS, OFFLINE
• Every US tide prediction station, from Maine to Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico and Guam
• Search by name, town or station number, or use your location
• Datums, harmonic constituents and live NOAA sensors for each station

SHARE THE LOW
• A tide card for your story or group chat: "Negative low −1.4 ft · Tue 4:05 PM"

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your stations and alerts stay on your iPhone. Tidepane has no server.

TIDEPANE PRO
Today's tides, the week, widgets, offline tides and one alert are free, forever. Pro adds a full year of tides with king tides marked, the complete Low Tide Finder, unlimited stations and alerts, the Live Activity, a 10-day weather outlook and every share style without the Tidepane mark. Choose yearly with a free one-week trial, or unlock Pro once, for life.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aquatic-alto-bc9.notion.site/Tidepane-Privacy-Policy-4205ee35e47980e09615e798210623c7

Tide predictions come from NOAA's published harmonic constants and are estimates. Not for navigation. Always check local conditions. Weather: Apple Weather.

name: Tidy Little Life
description:
Tidy up one cozy room through a whole life.

Tidy Little Life is a gentle logic puzzle game about the little things we keep. Start in a five-year-old's bedroom and follow one life through six chapters, all the way to the golden years. Every object tells a small story, and the teddy bear is always there.

A WHOLE LIFE, ONE LITTLE ROOM
Kindergarten · Elementary School · High School · University · Parenthood · Golden Years

REAL PUZZLES, NO GUESSING
Read the clue cards, think it through and put everything in its place. Each puzzle has one logical solution, and every chapter is a little trickier than the last.

FEATURES
• 24 handcrafted puzzles across 6 chapters of life
• Clue cards you can tap to take a closer look
• Gentle hints when you get stuck
• Relaxing music and soft, cozy art
• Play at your own pace, there are no timers
• Plays offline
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collection
• English, Deutsch, Français, Español, Magyar

Made with love by a solo indie developer.

name: Tiệm Của Tui
description:
Tiệm Của Tui giúp chủ tiệm nail, spa thay sổ tay và Excel bằng một ứng dụng gọn nhẹ trên điện thoại.

TÍNH NĂNG CHÍNH
• Tạo đơn nhanh: chọn dịch vụ, thợ thực hiện, giảm giá, ghi chú.
• Thanh toán VietQR: tạo mã QR chuyển khoản theo từng đơn, chụp ảnh chứng từ khi cần.
• Đơn thiếu tiền: tự đánh dấu, nhắc thu thêm và giải phóng hoa hồng khi thu đủ.
• Chia tip: tự chia đều cho thợ tham gia, chủ tiệm có thể chỉnh lại.
• Hoa hồng: tính tự động theo dịch vụ, chủ tiệm có thể điều chỉnh từng đơn.
• Chốt sổ cuối ngày: đối chiếu tiền mặt, chuyển khoản, thu nhập từng người.
• Báo cáo: doanh thu, số đơn, biểu đồ theo ngày và theo chi nhánh.
• Lịch hẹn: nhận lịch từ trang đặt lịch của tiệm, chuyển thành đơn chỉ với một chạm.
• Thu nhập của thợ: mỗi thợ chỉ xem được hoa hồng và tip của chính mình.
• Nhiều chi nhánh, nhiều vai trò: chủ tiệm, thu ngân, thợ.
• Thông báo đẩy, Face ID / vân tay, tiếng Việt và tiếng Anh.

Ứng dụng dành cho tiệm đã có tài khoản Tiệm Của Tui. Truy cập tiemcuatui.vn để đăng ký dùng thử và xem bảng giá.

name: Tify Décor Messagerie
description:
Tify Décor Messagerie est l'application officielle de Tify Décor pour échanger avec nos conseillers en décoration d'intérieur.

• Discutez en direct avec votre conseiller dédié
• Envoyez des photos de vos pièces, de vos meubles et de vos inspirations
• Enregistrez des messages vocaux pour décrire votre projet
• Partagez des documents : plans, devis, PDF
• Recevez une notification dès qu'un conseiller vous répond
• Prenez rendez-vous et suivez vos demandes

Connexion simple et sécurisée par e-mail, WhatsApp, Google ou Apple.

Pour les équipes Tify Décor, l'application permet aussi de gérer les conversations clients, les groupes internes et les demandes de rendez-vous.

name: Tilely: Magnetic Tile Builds
description:
Staring at a pile of magnetic tiles and wondering what to build next? Tilely turns the tiles already in your playroom into 1,000+ interactive 3D step-by-step building guides—matched to the exact pieces you own.

Built for parents and kids ages 3–8 to build side by side, Tilely gets kids off passive videos and back onto hands-on spatial play with real physical tiles.

INTERACTIVE 3D STEP-BY-STEP GUIDES
• Orbit 360°, pinch to zoom, and inspect every joint from any angle
• Move forward or back one layer at a time at your child's own pace
• Crisp 3D lighting and subtle snap cues make each next piece unmistakable

MATCH THE TILES IN YOUR BOX
• Track 24 real-world magnetic tile shapes—squares, right/isosceles/equilateral triangles, arches, windows, ramps, fences, car bases, and ball-run tubes
• Pick a quick starter set preset or tap any shape to enter your exact piece counts in seconds
• Filter the entire library by "Build Now" so you only see models your box can actually finish

1,000+ REAL-WORLD BUILDS ACROSS EVERY INTEREST
• Ball Runs & Marble Tracks: spiral towers, zigzag chutes, and gravity drops
• Toy Car Ramps & Garages: speed ramps, multi-level parking towers, and stunt bridges
• Castles, Houses & Landmarks: fairy gazebos, lighthouses, barns, and tall towers
• Animals & Dinosaurs: elephants, giraffes, brachiosaurus, and playful pets
• Mandalas & STEM Games: symmetry patterns, bowling alleys, sorting trays, and bridge load tests

1:1 AR TABLETOP PREVIEW
• Place any model at true life-size on your floor or table before placing the first tile
• Check real footprint and height so big builds fit your play space

PARENT PLAY PROMPTS & BUILD JOURNAL
• Every guide includes practical parent prompts—simple questions about balance, triangles, gravity, and symmetry that turn play into real STEM learning
• Snap real-world photos of finished creations and save them to your private family Build Journal

WORKS WITH STANDARD MAGNETIC TILES
• Designed for all standard 7.5 cm (3-inch) magnetic building tile sets
• Works offline on iPhone and iPad, in English, Turkish & German and zero third-party ads

SUBSCRIPTION & PRICING
Tilely is free to download with starter 3D builds, full 24-piece box inventory tracking, and your Build Journal. Upgrade to Tilely Pro (Monthly or Yearly with a 7-day free trial) to unlock all 1,000+ 3D guides, new builds, and unlimited 1:1 AR previews.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase (or after your free trial ends). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your iOS Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://cenkgundev.github.io/tilely-privacy/
Terms of Use: https://cenkgundev.github.io/tilely-privacy/terms.html

name: Tint Bar
description:
Welcome to Tint Bar, the salon where you mix every color yourself!

Clients take their seats and show the shade they want. Squeeze paint tubes into mixing bowls, combine two colors and create exactly the tone they ordered. Red and yellow make orange, yellow and blue make green, red and blue make purple, and red with white makes a soft pink. Pick the wrong pair and your bowl turns into muddy brown.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a column to squeeze its top tube into the bowl you selected
• Mix two colors to create the shade a client is waiting for
• Watch their patience: every client waits only a limited number of moves
• Plan the order of your tubes, since only the top one is available

500+ LEVELS AND COUNTING
• Every level is checked to be solvable without boosters
• Calm levels, tricky ones and a "hard day" every 10 levels
• New tubes, colors and clients keep coming after level 500

GROW YOUR SALON
• Hair coloring from the very first levels
• Manicure: pure colors go straight onto the nails
• Face masks in soft cream and sky-blue shades
• Clients who order two services at once

HELP FOR TRICKY LEVELS
• Undo a move, clean a spoiled bowl or give a client +3 patience moves
• Daily gift with free coins

WHY TINT BAR
• A fresh mechanic: real color mixing instead of sorting
• Bright cartoon art and lively animations
• Short levels that fit any spare minute
• No sign-up, no accounts
• Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, Italian, Ukrainian and Russian

Open your salon and become a master of color!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Tiny Days: Cozy Diary
description:
Some days don't need a whole page. They need one line.

Tiny Days is a cozy diary where you write a single sentence about today, choose the weather and where you were, and your day becomes a little hand-drawn animation, complete with its own music.

WRITE ONE LINE
"Rain on the window. Tea's still warm." That's all it takes. Up to 60 characters, so there's no pressure to write a lot. Just enough to remember the day.

PICK THE WEATHER AND THE PLACE
Rainy, sunny, foggy, first snow or late night. By the window, a street corner, a bus stop, the corner store, a park bench or a rooftop. Every combination draws a different scene.

WATCH IT COME ALIVE
Your line appears in handwriting above an 8-second animated scene: falling rain, drifting clouds, a little person with a warm cup of tea. Each kind of weather has its own gentle music. Turn the sound off anytime with one tap.

LOOK BACK ON YOUR DAYS
Every line you save goes into My days, grouped by month, so you can scroll back through the small moments of your year.

SHARE IT AS A VIDEO
Turn any day into a short vertical video with music, ready to share or save to Photos.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your diary syncs through your own iCloud account. We don't run servers, don't collect your data and don't show ads.

FREE TO START, ONE PAYMENT TO UNLOCK
"Rain by the window" is free forever. A single one-time purchase unlocks all 6 places and 5 kinds of weather, and removes the small watermark from your videos. No subscription.

name: Title Cup: Soccer Manager
description:
You're the manager. Start a club in the bottom division and take it all the way to the Title League.

BUILD YOUR SQUAD
Sign players on the transfer market, make offers to other clubs, propose trades with real managers and send scouts to find young talent. Every player has his own position, age, form and potential.

PICK THE TEAM
Choose your formation, set your tactics and name your eleven. Train your players, keep them fit and bring your best prospects through.

WATCH EVERY MATCH
Matches are played out on the pitch in front of you, with goals, chances and a full match report. Play friendlies to try new ideas before the games that count.

CLIMB THE LEAGUES
Ten divisions with promotion and relegation every season. Win your league, lift cups and build a trophy cabinet your club can be proud of.

GROW THE CLUB
Spend your club funds on players and facilities, hire staff, design your kit and make the club your own.

PLAY THE WORLD
Your league is full of clubs run by real managers. Play for your country, vote for the national team and chase the World Cup. Join a friend's league with their code, or challenge a friend's club to a match.

Title Cup is free to play. Title Tokens can be earned in the game or bought as in-app purchases. Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian and Arabic.

name: Tơ Hồng
description:
Tơ Hồng is a couple-match app made just for Vietnam. You and your person take the same personality quiz, compare birthdays by Vietnamese tradition, then ask Bé Tơ more about your own result. No account needed.

16-group personality match: take it together
• Bé Tơ asks you 20 questions like a chat, about 3 minutes, and places you in one of 16 personality groups
• Send your person a link. They answer the same 20 questions in the app or right on a web page, with nothing to install
• You both see the pair result: a score out of 10, where you fit, where you may clash and a few tips for the two of you
• Gift invites: with the full unlock, you invite your person to the quiz and pay for them (10 a month). They see the whole pair result without paying, on the web page too
• My invites: see whether your person has finished
• Works for every couple, same-sex couples included

Ask Bé Tơ about your own result
• After a birthday match, a love or year reading or a personality match, ask what you still wonder about. Bé Tơ answers from that exact result
• Included in the full unlock: 30 questions a month. The free version shows a locked card with one sample question and answer
• Answers are written by AI: OpenAI GPT, with Anthropic Claude as backup. AI also writes the detailed verdict of your personality match
• The AI receives only your question and a summary of the result, never your name, birth date or birth year. You agree on a separate screen before your first question and can withdraw in "Cá nhân" (Personal)
• Bé Tơ gives no health, legal or money advice and does not foretell bad events

Made for Vietnam
• Enter birth dates in the lunar or the solar calendar
• "Lịch hôm nay" (Today's calendar) on the home screen: the lunar date, whether the day is hoàng đạo or hắc đạo, good hours, clashing ages and how today suits your age
• Tap it for the details: the can chi of the day, month and year, giờ hoàng đạo, trực, things to do and to avoid, and the good days of the month
• The Vietnamese zodiac, with the Buffalo and the Cat instead of the Ox and the Rabbit

Birthday match
• Enter both birthdays and get a score out of 10 with a grade
• Five elements (ngũ hành), heavenly stems (thiên can), earthly branches (địa chi) and "cung phi" of you both, side by side
• Computed on your phone, works offline

Love 2027 and your year of Đinh Mùi
• A love score, months that favour meeting someone, zodiac animals that suit you, love stars
• A year score, the year's star and cycle, tam tai, Thái Tuế, four areas (love, wealth, work, health) and a 12-month outlook
• Tết 2027 falls on 6 February 2027

Every day and tools for couples
• Today's luck, lucky numbers, and the coin oracle: toss three coins six times to get one of 64 hexagrams, with a short reading
• Name match, western zodiac match, wedding year, wedding days, a good year to have a child
• Save a result card to your phone, or send it to your person with your messaging app

Free, with no ads
See the basic results for free, with no ads in the app. Each day you can open one detailed reading, or one detailed verdict for an invite, for free. To open more and to ask Bé Tơ, make one optional one-time purchase, "Unlock everything 2027", with no account and no subscription: every detailed 2027 reading, unlimited birthday-match details, 30 Bé Tơ questions a month and 10 gift invites a month. The price is shown in the store.

Privacy
Your name and birthday stay on your phone. Invites and Ask Bé Tơ need a connection: an invite keeps the 20 answers, with no name or birthday, on the Tơ Hồng server for at most 90 days; a question to Bé Tơ carries no name or birthday either. Apart from the pair result the two people in one invite share, no one sees your content.

Tơ Hồng is made by VNTYPHOON CO., LTD and our mascot is Bé Tơ.
For entertainment and reference only.
Chỉ mang tính giải trí, tham khảo.

name: TodoExport: Move to Reminders
description:
Microsoft To Do closes on June 30, 2027. TodoExport gets your lists and tasks out:

• Free backup to a file: every list and task as a CSV you can open in Excel or Numbers, or a complete JSON copy.
• Export to Apple Reminders: lists, due dates, alerts and repeats, on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. One-time purchase of $3.99, not a subscription.

WHAT MOVES TO REMINDERS
• List names, task titles and notes
• Due dates and alert times
• Repeats: daily, chosen weekdays, a date each month, the last Friday of the month, yearly
• Important tasks, as high priority
• Optionally, completed tasks with their completion dates
• Steps are written into the notes, marked done or not done
• Attachments can't move; the preview names the tasks that have them

COME BACK ANYTIME
While you still use To Do, export again for new tasks. Tasks you already exported are skipped.

QUESTIONS
• Will it change my To Do? No. You sign in on Microsoft's own page and TodoExport only reads.
• Who can see my tasks? Only you. Tasks go straight from Microsoft to your iPhone. No account, no tracking.
• I use Windows at work. Reminders works on iCloud.com in any browser.
• What about lists I share with family? Tasks move, members don't. Share the list again in Reminders.
• Work or school account? It works, though some organizations require admin approval for apps.
• Will I get two alerts? Until you stop using To Do, yes. Turn off To Do notifications after you export.

TodoExport is not affiliated with Microsoft. Microsoft and Microsoft To Do are trademarks of Microsoft Corporation.

name: TOEIC® Part1 2000問演習
description:
TOEIC満点陰キャが作った、Part 1(写真描写問題)専用の演習アプリです。

広告なし。ログインしなくても、インストールしてすぐに2,000問のオリジナル問題を解き始められます。

【特徴】
・Part 1 形式の写真描写問題を2,000問収録(写真590枚。写真・問題・音声はすべてオリジナルで、写真はAIで生成、音声は音声合成です)
・本番と同じく、写真を見ながら4つの英文を聞いて、写真に合うものを選ぶ形式。英文を隠して、耳だけで解けます
・1枚の写真から2〜4問。同じ写真でも、問われるポイント(人の動作・物の位置・状態など)が変わります
・難易度、正解の型(人の動作/人の状態/物の位置・配置/物の状態)、話者のアクセント(米・英・カナダ・オーストラリア)、話す速さで絞り込み可能
・本番でつまずきやすい「進行中の動作(is being 〜)」と「完了した状態(has been 〜)」の区別も多数収録
・解答後は英文・和訳・ポイント・解説つき。4つの英文を1つずつ聞き直せます
・選択肢の並びは毎回入れ替わるので、答えの位置を覚えてしまうことがありません
・間違えた問題は自動で「復習リスト」に貯まり、あとからまとめて見直せます
・「学習統計」で、正解の型別・難易度別・速さ別・アクセント別の正答率がひと目で分かります
・「レート戦」では、本番と同じく音声1回きり・英文なしの5問勝負。正解数に応じてレーティングと段級位が変わり、ランキングで他の学習者と競えます
・写真はアプリに入っていて、音声もまとめて端末にダウンロードしておけば、オフラインでも解けます(Wi-Fi接続時のみダウンロードする設定も可能)
・GoogleまたはAppleでログインすると、復習リストや学習統計を複数の端末で共有できます(ログインは任意。アカウントは「TOEIC Part 5 7000問演習」「TOEIC Part 2 2,000問演習」と共通です)

すきま時間にサクッと1問、写真を見ながら10問、など好きなペースでどうぞ。

【対象者】
TOEIC L&Rのスコアアップを目指している方、Part 1の写真描写問題で取りこぼしをなくしたい方、リスニングを毎日少しずつ鍛えたい方におすすめです。

※TOEICはETSの登録商標です。このアプリは、ETSの検定を受けたり、ETSに承認されたりしたものではありません。

name: Tomato War: Kids Battle
description:
Grow it. Throw it. SPLAT!

Tomato War! is a cartoon tomato fight on a floating-island village. Every round starts on the farm and ends in a giant food fight.

FARM TIME
Plant, water and harvest your own four plots. Fertilizer doubles your harvest. Every tomato you grow is ammo for the war.

TOMATO WAR
Three hits send a kid flipping through the air. Run over a splatted kid to grab half their tomatoes and some of their coins. Grab glowing lightning bolts to run faster, hide splat traps by your shed door, and bonk anyone who gets too close with a foam noodle.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Host a room on your Wi-Fi and up to 8 kids can join from their own iPhone, iPad or Mac. Empty seats are filled by computer kids, so you can also play on your own any time.

- 11 maps: village streets, snow, desert oasis, savanna, rainforest and more
- 12 kids to pick from
- Easy touch controls, and game controllers work too
- Lock-on aiming helps young players hit their throws

KID-FRIENDLY
No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no chat. Nothing you do in the game is collected. Multiplayer stays on your own Wi-Fi.

Made by Kapzure Studio.

name: Took It: Pill Reminder
description:
• An alarm that rings even on silent. Every dose gets its own alarm (AlarmKit), which sounds even when your iPhone is on silent and rings again as many times as you choose.
• Tap Took It and you are done. Tap it right from the alarm, the notification, the widget or the app. If you tapped by mistake, undo it.
• No account and no internet. All your data stays on your device. The app does not collect, send or share any data.

YOUR MEDICINES
• Name, strength, form and amount per dose.
• A shape and color, or a photo of the box, to tell them apart at a glance.
• Notes, like “with food”.

SCHEDULES
• Every day at the times you choose, certain days of the week, or every X hours.
• An optional end: for N days or until a date.
• If you do not answer, the reminder rings again as many times, and as far apart, as you choose.
• Snooze or skip a dose, and record the exact time if you took it earlier.

HISTORY
• Today shows what you took and what is still ahead.
• A month calendar with a mark for each day. Tap a day to see or correct its doses.
• A widget for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

YOUR DATA, IN YOUR HANDS
• Back up everything to one ZIP file, with your medicines, history and photos, and restore from it.
• A test alarm in Settings, so you can hear how it will ring.

This app reminds you and records what you enter. It does not give medical advice. Ask your doctor or pharmacist about dosage.

English and Greek. Light or dark theme. Large text and VoiceOver. Free, with no ads, purchases or subscription.

name: TOPBBD
seller_name: Chengdu Lingshi PoXiao Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
TOPBBD is the dispatch app for drivers of TOP BBD TRUCKING CORPORATION, a container drayage and trucking company serving the ports of New York / New Jersey and Savannah.

The app is for our own drivers. Your account is opened by dispatch, or you sign up in the app and sign in once the company approves it.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Get your jobs: a notification with a voice alert when a container is dispatched to you, reassigned or cancelled
• Work through each job step by step: accept, arrive, pick up, deliver or transfer, return the empty
• Take proof photos with the camera or pick them from your library: container number, seal, delivery, empty return
• Report a problem at the terminal (congestion, damaged container, cannot pick up) with photos
• Clock in and out, ask for a correction, and confirm your weekly timesheet and payslip
• Send receipts for expenses you paid
• Use the app in English or Chinese

LOCATION
Only if you agree, and only from clock-in to clock-out, the app shares your location with dispatch so jobs can be planned near you. It stops when you clock out and you can turn it off at any time under Me › Location sharing.

YOUR ACCOUNT
You can delete your account in the app under Me › Delete account.

name: TopX Partners
description:
Соберите короткое представление о себе и делитесь им за пару касаний. TopX Partners объединяет контакты и ссылки на соцсети в персональной карточке.

Настройте имя, роль и короткое описание. Добавьте профили и контакты, затем поделитесь карточкой изображением, покажите QR-код или отправьте контакт vCard через меню iPhone.

Показатели аудитории можно добавить вручную. Они будут отмечены как указанные владельцем и датированы. TopX не подключается к аккаунтам соцсетей и не проверяет цифры.

Профиль хранится на устройстве. Для создания и передачи карточки не нужны аккаунт или публичная страница.

name: TorqDecibel: dB Sound Meter
description:
TorqDecibel turns your iPhone into a sound level meter, spectrum analyzer and noise dose estimator, in one dark, glare-free instrument interface. Everything runs on your device.

SOUND LEVEL METER
• Frequency weightings: dBA, dBC and dBZ (flat), using A- and C-weighting filters designed to the IEC 61672-1 weighting curves.
• Time weightings: FAST (125 ms), SLOW (1 s) and IMPULSE.
• Live readout to 0.1 dB, plus Leq (average), Min, Max and Peak.
• Tap the readout for a full-screen, high-visibility display.
• Optional loud-noise threshold indicator (70 to 120 dB).

SPECTRUM AND TIME ANALYZER
• FFT spectrum: 4096-point Hann-windowed spectrum with peak hold, peak-frequency readout and touch crosshair.
• 1/3-octave: 31 bands from 20 Hz to 20 kHz with peak-hold caps.
• Waterfall: a scrolling time-frequency heat map for spotting hums, tones and transients.
• History: a rolling level trace with live Leq and your alert threshold.

NOISE DOSE ESTIMATE
• Choose NIOSH (85 dBA criterion, 3 dB exchange rate) or OSHA 29 CFR 1910.95 (90 dBA criterion, 5 dB exchange rate) parameters.
• See accumulated dose %, projected 8-hour dose %, 8-hour TWA, allowed exposure time at the current level, and a breakdown of time spent in each level bracket.

CALIBRATION, SESSIONS AND EXPORT
• Broadband calibration offset from -50.0 to +50.0 dB in 0.1 dB steps.
• If you own an external 94 dB or 114 dB (1 kHz) acoustic calibrator, match it in one tap.
• Save named microphone calibration profiles.
• Save measurement sessions with field notes, then export CSV data or a PNG summary report through the iOS share sheet.
• Built-in synthetic demo signal for trying the app without a live sound source.
• Dark, Classic and Light themes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no ads, no uploads. Microphone audio is processed in memory on your device and is never stored as audio or sent anywhere.

IMPORTANT
TorqDecibel is not a certified, type-approved or factory-calibrated sound level meter or noise dosimeter. Readings depend on your iPhone's built-in microphone, which is designed for voice and varies between models and units, so absolute levels can be off by several decibels unless you calibrate against a reference. NIOSH and OSHA figures are informational estimates only. They are not a substitute for a professional noise survey, a calibrated instrument, an OSHA compliance assessment, or medical or hearing-health advice. If you are concerned about noise exposure or your hearing, consult a qualified professional.

name: Trena – mots encreuats
description:
Trena és un joc de mots encreuats en català per a cada dia. Llisca el dit per la roda de lletres, forma paraules i omple la quadrícula. Partides curtes, un repte nou cada dia i ni un sol anunci.

COM ES JUGA
• Uneix les lletres de la roda sense aixecar el dit i forma una paraula.
• Si és a la quadrícula, s’hi col·loca sola. Quan l’omples, has resolt el nivell.
• Les paraules vàlides que no hi són també compten: cada paraula extra et dona un fil.
• Si prefereixes no lliscar, toca les lletres una a una i envia la paraula.

CADA DIA, UNA TRENA
• La Trena del dia és igual per a tothom i canvia cada dia a mitjanit.
• Resol-la cada dia i allarga la ratxa. Si un dia no pots jugar, un congelador de ratxa la protegeix: en guanyes un cada set dies de ratxa i també en pots obtenir amb fils.
• Comparteix el resultat amb caselles de colors, sense desvelar cap paraula.
• Cada setmana, un repte nou i la Trena llampec: tres trenes seguides contra rellotge, iguals per a tothom.
• Per Nadal, un repte de temporada amb insígnies pròpies.
• Amb el giny de la pantalla d’inici, veus la ratxa i quant falta per a la Trena nova.

EL TEU CAMÍ
• 480 nivells repartits en 16 madeixes que es compliquen a poc a poc, amb nivells difícils i molt difícils que et posen a prova.
• Cada nivell té tres estrelles: completa’l, fes-lo amb poca ajuda i troba paraules extres.
• Gairebé tots els nivells amaguen una paraula daurada per guardar al Mostrari.
• A les últimes madeixes, nivells amb truc: «Fitxa amagada» i «A les fosques».
• 8 temàtiques de 20 nivells que s’obren a mesura que avances: Cuina, Mar, Bosc i muntanya, Animals, Hort i camp, Casa, Música i festa i Oficis.
• Contrarellotge: torna a jugar els nivells que ja has completat i guanya medalles d’or, de plata i de bronze.
• Calendari, estadístiques i 23 assoliments per veure com avances.

FET PER AL CATALÀ
• Totes les paraules surten del diccionari de Softcatalà, que segueix la normativa de l’IEC: cap paraula inventada.
• Accents, ce trencada i ela geminada: la L·L és una sola fitxa, la Ç té fitxa pròpia i, quan resols una paraula, la veus escrita amb els accents.
• Si t’encalles, demana una pista: una definició breu, del Viquidiccionari o de redacció pròpia.
• «Has après»: en acabar una partida, descobreix què volen dir les paraules menys conegudes i repassa-les a «El meu diccionari».

AJUDES I ESTILS AMB FILS
• Guanyes fils jugant i els fas servir per revelar una lletra, una casella o una paraula, o per demanar una pista.
• Al Taller, 20 estils per a les fitxes, l’estela, el so i les celebracions: uns es compren amb fils i d’altres es guanyen jugant. Cap no dona avantatge.
• Els fils només es guanyen jugant: no es compren.

SENSE TRAMPES
• Gratuït, sense anuncis i sense compres.
• Sense comptes ni registre.
• Funciona sense connexió i no recull cap dada.
• Recordatori diari opcional, programat al mateix telèfon.

PER A TOTHOM
• Mode fosc, text gran i compatibilitat amb VoiceOver.
• Vibració, sons i animacions que pots desactivar, i més temps a la contrarellotge si el necessites.

Trena: una paraula rere l’altra, cada dia.

name: Trick Cup: Marble Puzzles
description:
Touch an empty spot on the board, pull away from the cup, and release. Your angle sets the direction and your drag sets the power.

Play 80 puzzles across eight chapters with bounce walls, wind, switches, and moving platforms. Start by getting the marble in, then come back to finish in three shots, collect the bonus star, or settle in the center for a precision medal.

Follow your caddie's next challenge. Collect stars, medals, and pins to change your marble and trail, then replay a board to try a different shot.

name: Tropiqo
description:
Welcome to Tropiqo, your own colorful fruit fusion laboratory. Rotate three independent ingredient drums, hold the fruits you need, and bring creative recipes to life in a glowing fusion reactor.

Every turn matters. Plan your route through fixed ingredient arrangements, balance sweetness and acidity, and save enough energy for the next formula. There are no random spins, bets, purchases, or cash prizes—just satisfying puzzles and delicious discoveries.

EXPLORE FOUR LABORATORIES
Take on 60 experiments across Citrus Station, Berry Reactor, Mango Circuit, and Rainbow Lab. Discover ordered recipes, special ingredients, and multi-stage challenges.

EXPERIMENT WITH FRUIT POWERS
Substitute a rainbow mango, double your fusion score with a golden pineapple, thaw a frozen grape, manage a sour lemon, or transform a magic cherry.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose Easy, Medium, or Hard. Learn by doing in the interactive training lab. Use hints, hold ingredients, undo an action, and resume your saved experiment.

MAKE A DAILY DISCOVERY
Try a fresh deterministic challenge each local calendar day. Improve your score and build your daily streak.

BUILD YOUR RESEARCH JOURNAL
Discover formulas, earn stars, unlock 12 achievements, and follow your laboratory statistics.

No account required. Progress and preferences are stored on your device.

name: TroutStocking
description:
TroutStocking puts official trout stocking reports and schedules from state wildlife agencies in one place, and tells you when the waters you fish are stocked.

FOLLOW YOUR WATERS
Pick the lakes, ponds and streams you fish. When the agency reports a stocking or posts a planned date, you get a notification and the details are waiting in the app.

EVERY STOCKING IN ONE PLACE
- 12,000+ waters across 49 states
- Stocking dates, species and fish counts when the agency publishes them
- Planned stockings, so you can plan a trip around the truck
- What's New: the latest reports and upcoming stockings in the states you fish
- Browse by state and county, or search any water by name
- Works offline once data is downloaded

FREE
- Follow up to 3 waters
- Stocked alerts for the waters you follow

TROUTSTOCKING PRO
- Follow unlimited waters
- Whole-county and area alerts
- Planned-stocking alerts as soon as agencies publish them
- Alerts when a stocking is postponed, cancelled or moved

HONEST ABOUT THE DATA
TroutStocking is independent and not affiliated with any government agency. Alerts arrive when agencies publish their information, which can be days after fish are released, and some stockings are never published. Plans change, so always check the agency's own page before you travel. Every record links to its official source.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
TroutStocking Pro is available as a monthly ($3.99) or yearly ($19.99) auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions.

Privacy: https://troutstocking.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TuneTrip: Music Around World
description:
What happens to one song when it takes on another country's scales, rhythms and instruments?

TuneTrip sends a single melody around the world — China, Japan, India, Egypt, Russia, Austria, Spain, Ireland, the USA and Brazil. At every stop it changes scale, rhythm and instruments, and the scene changes with it. Then the whole world plays together. No music theory needed: you simply hear why something sounds "Japanese" or "flamenco".

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Tour — one song, 10 countries, 4 bars per stop.
• Free — stay in any country and swap the lead instrument.
