• Guess — guess the country or the instrument, or play Layers: parts come in one by one, and the earlier you guess, the more you score.
• Play — tap the glowing keys. Every note fits, so anyone can sound like a local in seconds.

REAL INSTRUMENTS
Erhu, guzheng, shakuhachi, shamisen, sitar, tabla, accordion, balalaika, flamenco guitar, banjo, samba drums and many more — real recorded samples. Hear each one in the Gallery.

40+ PUBLIC-DOMAIN TUNES
Twinkle Twinkle, Ode to Joy, Canon, Für Elise, Swan Lake, Greensleeves, Sakura, Silent Night… or import your own MIDI files and numbered notation.

ALSO
• Two art styles: Jelly and Vinyl
• Collect 6 stamp designs
• iPhone, iPad with Split View and Stage Manager, and foldable iPhone
• 17 languages

PRIVACY
No sign-up, no ads, no data collected, works offline. Imported songs stay on your device.

For music lovers, teachers, parents and kids — the most fun way to hear the world's music.

name: Tycoon Motor Industries
description:
Start a small car company in 1950 and grow it into a motor industry giant.

Design your own cars from bodies, engines, chassis and interiors, and match them to what buyers want: cheap city cars, family sedans, sports cars, trucks and more. Build factories and showrooms in a living 3D city, deliver cars by truck and watch them drive in the traffic.

• Design cars part by part and see how well they fit each market segment
• Build factories, showrooms, research centres and transport depots
• Research new parts through the decades, from the 1950s to the future
• Win fleet orders for taxis, police and the post office
• Export cars by rail to foreign markets
• Manage loans and finances, and outgrow your rivals
• A living world: city traffic, farms and forests that change with the seasons
• Works offline, with no ads and no account

name: Undertone Collage: Color Mix
description:
Every picture in Undertone is made of colored tissue paper. Each color has been cut into shaped pieces. Lay every piece where it belongs, and where tissue overlaps, the colors
mix: blue over yellow makes green, pink over yellow makes orange, and all three make a dark olive. Lay the last piece and the picture is yours.

There are no timers, no move limits and nothing to guess. Every puzzle has exactly one answer, and every move can be undone.

- Well over a hundred pictures in themed sets, from a garden tulip to a Ferris wheel at the carnival, with more sets along the way
- Make each picture five ways: in big, small or tiny pieces, or with pieces that come turned around
- Tap a stack to choose the piece you want, and pin a piece down once it's right
- Look at the little picture up close, with what its colors make, in words
- Every set has its own scrapbook page, with the day you made each picture
- The picture you're making can sit on your Home Screen, and your progress follows you to your other devices through iCloud
- See-Through Tissue, patterns on tissue, Mark Mistakes and a one-color hint, each with its own switch
- Calm music and soft paper sounds, each with its own switch
- On iPhone, iPad and the iPhone Duo, upright or turned

Start free with the first four sets. Every Picture, one purchase, opens every set, every bigger paper, every way to play and every picture still to come.

Music: “Cool Vibes” by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0.

name: Unit Converter: Metric & More
description:
Unit Converter: Metric & More is the ultimate conversion tool for everyday life and professional use. With a clean, intuitive interface, convert between units instantly across a wide range of categories.

CATEGORIES INCLUDED:
• Length — meters, feet, inches, miles, kilometers, yards, and more
• Weight — kilograms, pounds, ounces, grams, tons, and more
• Temperature — Celsius, Fahrenheit, Kelvin
• Volume — liters, gallons, fluid ounces, cups, pints, and more
• Speed — km/h, mph, knots, m/s
• Area — square meters, square feet, acres, hectares, and more
• Pressure — pascal, bar, psi, atm, and more
• Data Storage — bytes, KB, MB, GB, TB, and more
• Cooking — tablespoons, teaspoons, cups, ml (perfect for recipes)
• Energy — joules, calories, kilowatt-hours
• Fuel Efficiency — mpg, L/100km, km/L

FEATURES:
• Instant results as you type
• Works fully offline — no internet required
• Supports both metric and imperial systems
• Clean, distraction-free design

Perfect for students, travelers, chefs, engineers, and DIY enthusiasts.

name: UrvashiKelmio
description: Thermal oxidiser calculator: flow, temperature, residence time, fuel and costs.

name: Vaarbewijs Coach
description:
Haal je Klein Vaarbewijs 1 in één keer.

Vaarbewijs Coach legt de vaarregels uit in korte animaties en laat je daarna oefenen tot je het zeker weet. Elke vraag heeft een uitleg en verwijst naar het artikel in het BPR of RPR waar het antwoord op staat.

WAT JE KRIJGT
• 25 korte videolessen, één per examenonderwerp, met ondertiteling die je aan en uit zet
• 230 oefenvragen met uitleg en bron, veel met een afbeelding van de situatie
• Proefexamens met dezelfde verdeling over de onderwerpen en dezelfde puntenweging als het echte examen
• Een examenklaar-score: je ziet per onderwerp waar je nog punten laat liggen
• Fouten en bladwijzers als aparte lijsten
• Dagelijkse herhaling van vragen die je moeilijk vond; geef bij elk antwoord aan of je gokte, twijfelde of het zeker wist
• Een dagelijkse herinnering en een aftelling tot je examendatum
• Werkt zonder internet, ook op het water

HOE HET WERKT
1. Kijk de korte les over een onderwerp.
2. Oefen de vragen. Na elk antwoord zie je meteen waarom het goed of fout is.
3. Doe een proefexamen. Je uitslag laat per onderwerp zien wat je nog moet oefenen.

GRATIS EN VOLLEDIG
Je begint gratis met twee lessen, vijf vragen per onderwerp en één proefexamen. Met één eenmalige aankoop ontgrendel je alles. Geen abonnement.

GOED OM TE WETEN
Vaarbewijs Coach is geen app van het CBR of de overheid. De vragen zijn zelf geschreven en vraag voor vraag gecontroleerd aan de hand van het Binnenvaartpolitiereglement (BPR), het Rijnvaartpolitiereglement (RPR) en Varen doe je Samen. Het echte examen gebruikt andere vragen.

Vragen of een fout gevonden? Mail ons via de app: in elke uitleg zit een knop om een fout te melden.

name: VANEX VALVE
description:
VANEX VALVE uygulaması, endüstriyel vana ve akış kontrol ekipmanlarını mobilde kolayca incelemenizi sağlar. Küresel vanalardan sürgülü vanalara, doğalgaz vanalarından yangın hidrantlarına kadar farklı tesisat ve endüstriyel uygulamalara yönelik ürünleri tek yerden keşfedebilirsiniz.

VANEX VALVE; su, doğalgaz, yangın güvenliği, altyapı, enerji, HVAC ve endüstriyel tesislerin ihtiyaçlarına yönelik vana ve akış kontrol çözümleri sunar.

Ürün Kategorileri
Endüstriyel Vanalar: Endüstriyel tesisat ve akış kontrol sistemlerinde kullanılan vana çeşitleri
Küresel Vanalar: PN 6, PN 10-16 ve PN 16 tam geçişli flanşlı küresel vana seçenekleri
Sürgülü Vanalar: PN 16 elastomer sitli sürgülü vanalar ve yükselen milli OS&Y sürgülü vana modelleri
Kelebek Vanalar: PN 6-10-16 wafer tip kelebek vanalar ve döküm gövdeli vana seçenekleri
Pislik Tutucular: PN 16 Y tipi flanşlı pislik tutucular ve tesisat filtreleme ekipmanları
Doğalgaz Vanaları: PN 16-25 doğalgaz küresel vanaları, kısa tip ve uzun tip flanşlı vana modelleri
Yangın Grubu Ürünleri: Yangın tesisatlarında kullanılan vanalar, hidrantlar ve bağlantı ekipmanları
Yangın Hidrantları: PN 16 yer üstü yangın hidrantları ve yangın suyu hatlarına yönelik ürünler
Hidrant Aksesuarları: Hidrant dirseği, hidrant anahtarı ve tamamlayıcı bağlantı ürünleri
Markalar: VANEX ve YUSAL-ETM marka ürünlerini inceleme alanı
Kataloglar: Ürün grupları ve teknik özellikler hakkında bilgi edinme alanı
Vana Rehberi ve Blog: Vana seçimi, tesisat uygulamaları, ürün özellikleri ve bakım konularındaki bilgilendirici içerikler

Uygulama üzerinden ürün kategorilerini inceleyebilir, ürün detaylarına ulaşabilir ve farklı teknik özelliklere sahip vana seçeneklerini değerlendirebilirsiniz.

Ürünlerin DN ölçülerini, PN basınç sınıflarını, bağlantı özelliklerini ve teknik çizimlerini inceleyerek projenizin ihtiyaçlarına uygun ürünleri belirleyebilirsiniz.

Sepetinizi oluşturabilir, sipariş işlemlerinizi gerçekleştirebilir ve hesabınız üzerinden sipariş durumunuzu takip edebilirsiniz.

Proje bazlı toplu alımlar, özel ölçü talepleri ve ürün seçimi konularında VANEX VALVE ekibiyle iletişime geçebilirsiniz. WhatsApp destek ve iletişim kanallarına mobilde kolayca erişebilirsiniz.

VANEX VALVE ile endüstriyel vana, doğalgaz ve yangın tesisatı ekipmanlarını mobilde daha düzenli ve pratik şekilde keşfedebilirsiniz.

name: Veltro - Ski Stunt Race
description:
Click into your skis, grab your poles and race seven rivals down runs that stretch from snowy peaks to lava mountains, glacier seas and above the clouds!

• Easy controls: your skier goes by itself. Swipe sideways to change lanes, double-tap on the road to hop, swipe down to brake.
• Launch off ramps and double-tap in the air to flip. Match your skis to the slope for a PERFECT landing, a burst of speed and coins; perfect landings in a row multiply the reward.
• Swipe out from an edge lane to kick off the wall, fly and flip.
• Grab a turbo and swipe up to fire it: while it burns you smash straight through obstacles.
• Jump cliffs, lava lakes and ice crevasses; find shortcuts across tunnel roofs.
• 6 worlds, 60 levels: Snowy Peaks, Sunset Canyon, Star Road, Fire Mountain, Glacier Sea and Cloud Summit. A champion waits at the end of each world: beat it to win its trophy.
• 24 pairs of skis in 4 tiers: standard, rare, epic and legendary. Epic and legendary skis have special powers; upgrade speed, acceleration, handling and flips one by one.
• 11 riders, 12 backpacks and 35 looks: ski designs, glowing trails, hats and finish dances.
• New missions every day, login rewards and star chests; collect coins and keys on the tracks and open treasure chests.
• Snow Pass: climb its tiers as you race and win new rewards every season.
• Race your own ghost and beat your record.
• No internet connection needed, no ads.

In-app purchases: the game is free; gem packs, bundles, the Gold Pass and the VIP Club can be bought with real money. A grown-up check appears before every purchase.

The VIP Club is a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage the subscription and turn off auto-renewal in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://dizayn16.github.io/veltro/terms.html

name: Verdure – Plant & Garden Care
description:
Snap a leaf and Verdure tells you which plant it is, right on your phone, even without a connection.

Verdure is your houseplants' companion. It recognizes them, explains how to care for them and reminds you at the right time.

• Offline recognition by photo: about 240 houseplants and balcony plants, analyzed on your device. When Verdure is unsure, it says so and offers several choices instead of confidently guessing wrong
• 282 care sheets: light, seasonal watering, temperature, humidity, potting mix, propagation, common problems, and toxicity for cats, dogs and humans
• Clear reminders: a single one a day, at the time you choose, with all of the day's care
• The plant doctor: yellow leaves, spots, little critters… describe what you see and Verdure gives you the most likely causes and what to do, step by step
• A photo journal to follow each plant's growth
• No account, no ads, no data collected: your plants and photos stay on your device
• French and English, iPhone and iPad

THE VEGETABLE GARDEN. Pick your climate: Verdure tells you what to sow under cover, sow outdoors, plant out and harvest each month, based on average frost dates. Lay out your beds in 30 cm squares and place your vegetables: Verdure points out neighbours that hold each other back and families coming back to the same spot too soon (tips, never rules). 56 guides to vegetables, soft fruit and herbs: sowing, spacing, watering, harvest, good neighbours, common problems. Garden tasks (sow, plant out, harvest, water) show up in the tab every day and, with Verdure+, join your plants' care in the daily reminder.

FREE: 3 recognitions a month, 2 tracked plants with watering reminders, every care sheet; in the garden, the calendar, the vegetable guides and one bed.

VERDURE+ (monthly subscription, 7-day free trial): unlimited recognitions and plants, plant doctor, fertilizing, repotting and misting reminders, photo journal; in the garden, unlimited beds, rotation over several years and sowing, planting, harvest and watering reminders.

The subscription renews automatically every month at €4.99 unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple account; you can manage or cancel the subscription at any time in your Apple account settings.

name: Verse Feed
description:
Every day your thumb scrolls on autopilot. Verse Feed points that habit at Scripture.

Swipe through the Bible one verse at a time in a calm, full-screen feed built for the way you already use your phone. Pick up where you left off, jump to any book or chapter, or let auto-scroll carry you.

READ
• The whole Bible, one verse per swipe
• King James Version and Bible in Basic English, available offline
• Verse of the day, daily devotionals and reading plans
• Likes, notes and bookmarks
• Compare translations side by side
• Share any verse as an image
• A Home Screen widget with a verse for the day

STUDY (PREMIUM)
• Explain Easier: any verse in plain English
• Original Language: key Hebrew, Greek and Aramaic words, with transliteration and meaning
• Deeper Study: historical context, cross-references and reflection questions
• Related Verses: passages that connect to the one you're reading

Study aids are written with AI and clearly labelled. They're a help for reading, not a replacement for Scripture, your church or trusted teachers.

YOUR ACCOUNT
You never need an account to read. Sign in with Apple to back up and sync your likes, notes and plans. You can delete your account at any time in Settings.

VERSE FEED PREMIUM
Premium unlocks every study tool. Choose yearly, with a 7-day free trial, or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

name: Verwaltung Einstellungstest
description:
Diese App ist kein Angebot einer Behörde, einer Kommune, eines Landes oder des Bundes. Sie dient der privaten Vorbereitung auf das Auswahlverfahren.

Die App ist für Bewerberinnen und Bewerber im öffentlichen Dienst gemacht, zum Beispiel für die Ausbildung zur oder zum Verwaltungsfachangestellten, die Beamtenausbildung, das Finanzamt oder die Justiz.

STAAT & VERWALTUNG
40 Fragen zu Staatsaufbau, Grundgesetz, Gesetzgebung, Kommunen, Verwaltung, öffentlichem Dienst und Justiz, jeweils mit Erklärung.

BEHÖRDEN IM ÜBERBLICK (KOSTENLOS)
Ablauf des Einstellungstests, Testinhalte, wichtige Voraussetzungen und Links zu den offiziellen Seiten: öffentlicher Dienst allgemein, Verwaltungsfachangestellte, Stadtverwaltung, Bezirksamt Berlin, Ordnungsamt, öffentlicher Dienst in Bayern, Finanzamt, Justiz und Rechtspflege.

TESTSIMULATION
30 Aufgaben in 30 Minuten mit Fragen zu Staat und Verwaltung, Mathematik, Sprache, Logik und Allgemeinwissen, danach eine Auswertung nach Bereichen.

DIE GRUNDLAGEN DES TESTS
Mathematik: Dreisatz, Prozent und Brüche, Kopfrechnen, Zahlenreihen, Zahlenmatrix, Schätzen, Zahlenpuzzle
Sprache: Kommasetzung, Groß- und Kleinschreibung, Wortanalogien, alphabetische Reihen
Logik: Figurenanalogien, Figurenreihen, Figurenmatrix, Dominosteine
Gedächtnis: Zahlen merken, Buchstaben merken
Allgemeinwissen mit Themenfilter

SO FUNKTIONIERT DIE APP
• 3 Aufgaben kannst du kostenlos lösen. „Behörden im Überblick“ ist immer kostenlos.
• Mit der Vollversion (einmaliger In-App-Kauf) übst du alle Aufgaben ohne Limit und nutzt die Testsimulation.
• Kein Konto nötig, keine Werbung.

Die Aufgaben sind Übungsaufgaben und keine Original-Testfragen einer Behörde.

name: Vespera: Natal Astrology
description:
Vespera is a modern Western astrology studio built on Swiss Ephemeris astronomical precision and literary psychological synthesis.

• NATAL CHART STUDIO
Generate exact birth charts using Swiss Ephemeris with Placidus or Whole Sign houses. Explore an interactive natal wheel with exact ecliptic longitudes, planetary dignities, aspects, and elemental balance.

Go beyond generic horoscopes. Read structured five-chapter natal monographs crafted around your exact planetary geometry, houses, and major aspect configurations.

Track real-time planetary positions and see exact orbs activating your natal chart today, with optional daily sky alerts.

Have transit-aware consultations grounded directly in your natal ephemeris, and archive unlimited birth profiles and readings securely across devices with Sign in with Apple or email sign-in.

Vespera Pro ($8.99/month, auto-renewable) unlocks unlimited 5-chapter natal monographs, 4-chapter synastry readings, unlimited Ask Your Chart consultations, and permanent Cloud Vault sync. name: VICUS Condomini
description:
VICUS è l'app per i condòmini il cui amministratore usa il gestionale VICUS. Con l'invito che riceve dall'amministratore entra e ha il suo condominio sul telefono.

COSA PUÒ FARE

• Rate e saldo: quanto ha da pagare, che cosa è scaduto, le rate dell'anno e i versamenti registrati.
• Pagare con bonifico: l'app compila il bonifico verso il conto del condominio, con l'IBAN, la causale e il codice QR da inquadrare con l'app della sua banca. I soldi vanno dalla sua banca al conto del condominio: non passano dall'app.
• Documenti: i documenti che l'amministratore mette a disposizione, da aprire quando servono.
• Segnalare un guasto: scrive che cosa non va, aggiunge fino a tre foto e segue la risposta dello studio.
• Lettura dell'acqua: quando lo studio raccoglie le letture, scrive il numero del suo contatore e, se vuole, lo fotografa.
• Assemblee: la convocazione e l'ordine del giorno; la delega dal telefono; nelle assemblee in videoconferenza, il collegamento e il voto sui punti aperti.
• Avvisi sul telefono: una rata in scadenza, un avviso in bacheca, la risposta a una segnalazione, l'apertura di un voto.

Alcune funzioni ci sono se il suo amministratore le ha attivate per il condominio.

COME SI ENTRA

Non ci si registra da soli: l'accesso lo crea l'amministratore, che le manda un'email di invito da cui sceglie la password. Se non l'ha ricevuta, la chieda al suo amministratore.

I SUOI DATI

L'app non mostra pubblicità, non usa strumenti di statistica o di tracciamento e non legge la sua posizione. Fotocamera, foto e notifiche sono facoltative. L'informativa completa è su vicuscondomini.it/privacy-app.html.

VICUS è sviluppato da iMediaTop.

name: Video Compressor - Reduce Size
description:
Video Compressor: compress video, reduce video size, shrink 4K, offline on-device compression

Need to compress video, reduce video file size, shrink video, compress 4K video, or make MP4 smaller? Storage full, share failed, upload too slow? Video Compressor is built for video compression and video size reduction: compress 4K, downscale HD, reduce MP4 size, compress MOV, compress MKV, compress AVI, compress WebM. Offline compression on your iPhone — videos are never uploaded. Free up storage, clean your library, save space.

【Video compression · Formats】
• Formats: MP4, MOV, M4V, MKV, AVI, WebM
• Common codecs: H.264, H.265 / HEVC
• Import from Photos, Files, or Camera; save back to Photos, export to Files, or share
• Great for: compress video to share, compress video to upload, compress video for backup, compress video for cloud

【Reduce size · Three controls】
• Quality / ratio mode: one-tap video shrink, reduce file size, compress large videos
• Target size mode: set a target MB, control final size, aim for the size you need

description:
Vindial is a calm, private tasting journal for the bottles you open.

SCAN THE LABEL

GET IN FAST

name: VisitLead: Website Visitors
description:
VisitLead shows which companies visit your website. Nobody is spied on.

You see the identified companies, their city, the pages they read and the time they spent. When a contact you already know comes back, from your newsletter, a form on your site or an import, VisitLead alerts you, only where the law of the visitor's country allows it.

The Monday digest sums up the week, and the app lets you check your visits and alerts wherever you are.

name: Voice Memo to Notes – Tidy
description:
Talk for a minute and Tidy turns your voice memo into a clean note: a title, a one-line summary, the key points and a to-do list.
Words appear on screen while you speak. Everything is processed right on your iPhone. The audio is never uploaded and never saved.
No account, no sign-in. Copy any note into mail, chat or your docs with one tap.

HOW IT WORKS

• Tap the record button and talk, up to five minutes. A live transcript fills the screen as you go.
• Tap Done. In a few seconds the memo becomes a note with a title, a short summary, 3 to 5 key points and the to-dos you mentioned.
• Check off to-dos, open the full transcript, or copy the whole note.
• Your notes stay in a simple list on your iPhone, newest first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Transcription and tidying run on your iPhone. Tidy has no servers and no accounts, and it does not keep your audio. On iPhones that cannot transcribe on-device, the app tells you instead of sending your voice anywhere.

SUBSCRIPTION
Tidy is a subscription app. After the quiz and your result, you choose a weekly, monthly or annual plan to unlock recording and notes. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

name: VoiceTel Fax

VoiceTel Fax lets you send faxes from your iPhone using your VoiceTel fax number.

name: Vrancea Alert – Quake Alarm
description:
When a deep earthquake starts in Vrancea, Vrancea Alert rings your phone before the shaking gets to you, and counts down the seconds.

Deep Vrancea quakes are felt from Bucharest to Chișinău and far beyond. Their shaking needs time to travel from deep underground to where you are. Our detection network notices the quake in its first seconds, and the app works out what it means for your place: how strong it may feel and how many seconds you have.

BEFORE, NOT AFTER
Most earthquake apps notify you once the quake has been located, usually minutes later: useful information, but the shaking has already passed. Vrancea Alert rings within seconds of the start, before the shaking reaches you, with a countdown, a voice and clear steps.
• Measured on replays of past deep Vrancea quakes: every deep Vrancea quake of M 5+ since 2014 would have been alerted 17–24 seconds after it started (median ≈ 21 s)
• Estimated warning: about 35–44 seconds before the strong shaking in Chișinău, about 24 seconds in Cahul; near the focus there is less time or none
• Magnitude from the first seconds, with a typical error of ±0.3 for M 4–5.6; for the largest quakes the first estimate is a lower bound and is updated
Tens of seconds for you and your family to take cover in time.

WHEN IT MATTERS
• A loud alarm with a big countdown to the shaking at your place
• Estimated magnitude and expected intensity, in plain words
• Clear steps on the alert screen: drop, cover, hold on, stay away from windows
• Satelit's voice reads the magnitude, your place and the seconds in English, so you can act without looking
• A Home Screen widget shows that protection is on

FOR THE PLACES YOU CARE ABOUT
• Your current location plus up to five saved places: home, work, the kindergarten, your parents' town
• Living abroad? Save your family's town and know when it is hit
• You choose from which level you want to be alerted

EVERY DAY
• Recent earthquakes in the region, with depth and the intensity at your places
• A live 3D view of the Vrancea zone, deep under the Carpathians
• Drills with the real sound, marked DRILL, and a short guide on what to do
• A system check that shows what could stop an alert and how to fix it
• An example alert any time, free and marked EXAMPLE: the wave in 3D, the phone ringing, what to do

HOW MUCH TIME YOU GET
It depends on your distance from the focus. The farther you are from Vrancea, the more time you get; close to the focus there may be none.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your exact location stays on the phone: to receive alerts, the app only shares a broad area of about 100 km with the push service.

SUBSCRIPTION
Free to download. The early-warning alarms need the Vrancea Alert subscription: a 3-day free trial for new subscribers, then 0.99 USD per month. It renews automatically every month until you cancel; cancel anytime in your App Store account settings, at least 24 hours before it renews. Or choose lifetime access: 11.99 USD, paid once, no subscription. Example alerts, the quake list, the 3D view and the guide stay free.
Terms: https://vrancea-alert.satelit.md/en/terms/ · Privacy: https://vrancea-alert.satelit.md/en/privacy/

WHAT TO KNOW
• An alert is a preliminary estimate from the quake's first seconds.
• Only deep Vrancea quakes are alerted ahead. Other quakes appear in the list once they are located.
• An alert can be late or missing (phone, network, push service).
• Vrancea Alert is not an official warning system and does not replace RO-ALERT or the authorities. Always follow the authorities' instructions.

Made in Moldova by Satelit.

name: Vride

Vride turns your iPhone into a big, clear dashboard for your ride. Connect your Bluetooth heart rate monitor, power meter and speed or cadence sensors and see your numbers in real time, coloured by training zone so you can read your effort at a glance.

LIVE DATA

BUILT FOR RIDING

name: Vtypes
description:
Vtypes is a keyboard you talk to. Switch to it in any app, tap the microphone, say the sentence, and the finished text appears where you were typing: a message, a note, a search box, an email.

It works with your own API key. Every dictation goes straight from your iPhone to the provider you chose, free of charge from us and unmetered. There is no Vtypes account and no Vtypes server in the path.

WHAT IT DOES

• Dictates into any app that accepts text, as an iOS keyboard.
• Writes it properly: punctuation, capitalisation, and the ums and false starts taken out.
• Styles to switch between: polished prose, an email, a chat message, notes to self, a commit message, a bug report, a prompt for an AI, or exactly what you said.
• A vocabulary list for the names and terms speech models keep mangling, with replacements.
• A hundred dictation languages, or auto-detect.
• Recent dictations kept on the phone, clearable whenever you like.

AN API KEY IS REQUIRED

Vtypes carries no speech model of its own, so it cannot dictate until you add a key. It works with:

• Speech to text: Groq, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
• Tidying the text afterwards: Groq, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Anthropic, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Groq's free tier covers ordinary daily use, and one Groq key does both steps. Setup is one screen: paste the key, press Test, start dictating. Leave the second key out and Vtypes types the raw transcript instead.

HOW IT WORKS ON IPHONE

iOS does not let a keyboard use the microphone, so the Vtypes app records for it. The first time you tap the microphone, the keyboard opens Vtypes, which starts a listening session; go back to your app and dictate. While the session is on, iOS shows its microphone indicator. It ends on its own after a few idle minutes, or when you end it.

The keyboard asks for Full Access because iOS allows a keyboard to share nothing with its own app without it. The keyboard itself makes no network requests and never sees your API keys.

PRIVACY

Your audio and your text go to the provider you configured, authenticated with your key, and nowhere else. We operate nothing in that path.

No account, no telemetry, no analytics, no ads, no tracking. Keys stay in the iPhone's Keychain; settings and history stay on the phone.

Reading the text around your cursor, which lets the model finish a half-written sentence sensibly, stays off until you turn it on. Card-shaped numbers and lines labelled as secrets are stripped out on the phone before anything is sent.

Privacy policy: https://vtypes.com/privacy/

WORTH KNOWING

Vtypes has no letter keys. It is a dictation keyboard rather than a replacement for the one you have, so keep your usual keyboard and switch between the two with the globe key.

Vtypes is also a desktop application for Windows and macOS, and an Android keyboard: https://vtypes.com

name: Warranty Reader
description:
Photograph the receipt, warranty card or model label of anything you buy and Warranty Reader keeps track of the warranty for you — and reminds you before it runs out.
Everything is read and stored on your iPhone. No server, no account, no ads.

SNAP TO ADD
• Attach as many photos as you like to one item: receipt, warranty card, model label, the product itself — or a PDF

• If something is off, tap a suggestion or tap any recognized line to put it in a field. Model numbers are never "auto-corrected" (O stays O, 0 stays 0)

WARRANTY DATES AND REMINDERS

• The list is sorted by the nearest end date; expired items move to their own section

YOUR MANUALS, KEPT BY YOU

FIND AND SHARE
• Search by name, model, serial, store, storage place, notes and recognized text — hyphens, case and accents don't matter
• Create one PDF with the purchase details and receipt photos for a repair or support request
• Note where you keep the paper warranty card

REGIONAL DEFAULTS
In the EU/EEA the 2-year legal guarantee is offered as the default with a short explanation; elsewhere the default is a 1-year manufacturer warranty. Dates and amounts follow your region and the receipt (1.234,56 € or $1,234.56).

PRICING
Free for up to 3 items with every feature. To add more, buy "Unlimited Unlock" once. No subscription. Family Sharing supported.

PRIVACY
Photos, documents and recognized text never leave your device. Text recognition uses Apple Vision on-device. The only connection is the App Store when you purchase.

NOTE
Dates and the "legal guarantee" information are general guidance, not legal advice. Whether a repair is covered depends on the maker, the seller and the law where you live.

Requires iOS 26 or later on iPhone.

name: Waymeter: Country Days
description:
Waymeter counts your days per country by the rule that applies (Schengen 90/180, UK tax year, US presence test, 183 days) for nomads, expats and long-stay travellers.
No account, no ads, no subscription: your trips stay on your phone, and you pay once for Pro.

EVERY RULE COUNTS ITS OWN WAY
Schengen counts entry and exit days. The UK counts midnights. The US Substantial Presence Test weights the two prior years. Waymeter counts each trip by each rule's own definition, so a travel day in two countries, a night at sea or a day in transit lands where it should. Tap any counter and "Why this number" shows it day by day.

PLAN YOUR NEXT ENTRY
Pick an entry date and see the latest exit date and the days left for every counter at once. Ask for the earliest date you can stay 30 days. Add planned trips as a what-if: they show dashed on the map, the calendar and every window.

YOUR MAP, INKED
The home screen is a world map drawn on your phone. Every country you were in is shaded by the days it costs you in the selected window. Tap a country to see its days, trips and the counters it affects.

RULES WITH SOURCES
Schengen 90/180, the UK Statutory Residence Test day count and UK visitor stays, the US Substantial Presence Test, 183-day rules by calendar year, tax year or any 12 months, the German 183-day rule and habitual abode, visitor rules for popular destinations by the passport you hold, and your own custom counters. Every rule shows its source and when it was last checked. Rule updates ship free with app updates, for everyone.

WARNINGS AND AT A GLANCE
Set warnings per counter (10 days left, 7 days before your latest exit) and get a heads-up when a planned trip breaks a counter. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Shortcuts ("Log today", "Days left") and a Live Activity for your current stay.

SUGGESTIONS YOU CONFIRM
Find past trips from your photos' date and place, or turn on an optional daily check-in. The country lookup runs on your phone, and a suggested day only counts after you confirm it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up, no account, no ads.
• Your trips, places and photos never leave your device.
• Analytics events never carry trips, countries, dates or locations.
• Notifications only for warnings and trips you set up.
• CSV export and a full backup file are free.

FREE VS PRO
Free, with no trial clock: unlimited trips and your full history, up to 3 counters with every calculation, the planner, warnings, widgets, CSV and backup.
Waymeter Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription: unlimited counters, photo import, daily check-in, the PDF evidence report and the Live Activity.

Waymeter counts days and shows rule thresholds with their sources. It is not legal or tax advice.

Terms: https://apps.kpix.eu/waymeter/terms
Privacy: https://apps.kpix.eu/waymeter/privacy

name: What If Me: Retouch & New Look

WHAT YOU CAN TRY
