Tap a verse or study a whole chapter. Get plain-language explanations and cultural context, explore original-language words, or ask an optional AI-assisted question about the passage. Keep your own notes alongside the text.

Explore 100 devotionals with three reflection questions each. Write in your private prayer journal, memorize a new verse each week, and follow your reading streak. Share a weekly verse or save an Identity in Christ card to Photos.

No account is needed. Your journal, passage notes, and devotional answers stay on your device. An internet connection is required for online study tools.

name: BioRxiv Go
description:
BioRxiv Go is an independent bioRxiv preprint reader for iPhone and iPad.

DISCOVER BY INTEREST
Create research interests, filter by keywords and dates, and keep a growing list of matching preprints. Choose daily, weekly, monthly or custom refresh intervals. iOS controls background scheduling; updates may be delayed and are checked again when you reopen the app.

READ AND ANNOTATE
Read titles, author lists and abstracts. Download available official PDFs into the built-in reader. Select and copy text, add highlights, underlines and notes, and undo or remove annotations. Compatible iPads support Apple Pencil handwriting, highlighting and erasing. Annotations are saved in the local PDF.

ORGANIZE YOUR LIBRARY
Mark papers into interest collections. Rename, pin and reorder collection cards. Optionally export marked public papers and annotated PDF attachments to your personal Zotero library. PDF uploads use your Zotero Storage quota.

OPTIONAL AI TOOLS
Use Smart Search to interpret a research request and rank retrieved candidates. Translate paper titles and abstracts into Chinese, or view AI summaries of reported contributions. These functions require your own supported provider API key, permission to share content, and may incur separate provider charges. Private manuscript titles and abstracts require additional permission. AI output may be inaccurate; check the original paper. Relevance scores do not measure research quality or statistical probability.

OPTIONAL MY SUBMISSIONS
Sign in through the official bioRxiv submission website to view accessible manuscript records. Source website access and verification requirements apply. The app does not create a separate BioRxiv Go account.

PERSONALIZE
Chinese and English interface, system or manual light/dark appearance, adjustable text size, accent colors and iPad layouts.

Ordinary public browsing, reading and marking require no model API key or submission account. BioRxiv Go is free, with no advertising, in-app purchases or subscriptions. Third-party services may charge separately. Full-text availability depends on the source and your access.

This is an independent, unofficial tool with no affiliation to bioRxiv, openRxiv, Zotero or AI providers. Papers and full texts belong to their respective rights holders. Preprints have not been peer reviewed. The app provides research information, not medical advice.

Support: lvtsing@gmail.com

name: Birdie Academy
description: Birdie Academy is the junior golf app for your club. It gives families and club organisers one simple place to follow handicaps, enter scores, play league and match play competitions, and celebrate every young golfer's progress.

name: Bitting File
description: Bitting File keeps six spaces on one key. Each space is empty or holds a depth from 1 to 6. File writes the first empty space from the left. When all six are filed, there is no seventh. Drag a filled space to snap it to another depth. Swap exchanges that space with the next one, and the last space wraps to the first. Lift clears the last filled space from the right. The sentence says which space to file next, or that six spaces are filed. Names and depths stay on this iPhone. Share writes the six depths as text.

name: Bizzefy
description:
Bizzefy is the app for Bizzefy customers: local business owners whose website, Google profile, reviews and social posts are looked after by the Bizzefy team.

Open the app and see one short list of what needs you today. Everything else is already being handled.

TODAY
• New leads, with one tap to call or text back
• Posts and review replies waiting for your OK
• Your own to-do list, with reminders on your phone

APPROVE BEFORE ANYTHING GOES OUT
• Read each post or reply, then Approve, Skip or ask for a change
• Nothing is published without your tap

INBOX
• Website forms, calls and website chats in one place

REVIEWS
• Your reviews and rating, with replies drafted for you to approve

MY BUSINESS
• Tools made for your kind of business: restaurants, salons, trades, dental and medical, real estate, shops and auto
• Tap what you need and your team takes it from there

BIZZY
• Ask in plain words: "What needs me today?" or "Remind me to order napkins Friday at nine"

A Bizzefy account is required. New businesses can sign up in the app in about two minutes.

name: Blue Core Inc
description:
Blue Core Inc on verstas kahdella penkillä. Indigossa säädät pelkistystä, upotuksia, hapetusta ja huuhtelua, ja luet syvyyden ja tasaisuuden. Koboltissa säädät frittiä, uunia, pitoa ja paksuutta, ja luet sävyn ja kiillon.

Yksi askel kerrallaan. Ei elämiä, ei ajastinta, ei mainoksia eikä tiliä. Mitä kirjoitat, pysyy tällä laitteella.

• 64 indigoaskelta — upota ja lue syvyys
• 78 kobolttiaskelta — polta lasite ja lue kiilto
• Kirja säilyttää vain sen, minkä itse jätät
• Polku aukeaa järjestyksessä; pidä ikkuna, niin seuraava aukeaa
• Etusivun palaute jää laitteelle

Blue Core Inc ei kerää eikä lähetä mitään. Ei analytiikkaa eikä mainoksia. Jos poistat sovelluksen, verstas katoaa.

name: Boğa Güreşi: Kafkasör
description:
Kafkasör, Artvin'den Aydın ve Muğla'ya Türkiye'nin geleneksel boğa güreşlerini anlatan bir ahır ve yetiştirme oyunudur. Kendi ahırını kur, danandan şampiyon boğa yetiştir, köy şenliklerinden büyük festivallere kadar meydanı al.

AHIRINI KUR
• Saman, yonca, silaj, arpa, buğday ve kepekle rasyon hazırla; enerji, protein ve kaba yemi dengele
• Depo, havalandırma, antrenman sahası, revir ve ağıl geliştir
• Bakıcı ve antrenör tut, boğalarını yaylaya çıkar

DANADAN ŞAMPİYONA
• Pazardan dana, boğa ve inek al; boğaların güç, dayanıklılık, yürek ve tekniğiyle büyür
• Damızlık boğa kirala ya da kendi şampiyonunu damızlığa ver, buzağı yetiştir
• Yaralanan boğanı veterinere götür, dinlendir

GÜREŞE SEN KARIŞ
• Güreş sırasında bastır, dayan, boynuz vur ya da soluklan: rakibin hamlesini oku
• Kilo kategorilerinde köy şenlikleri ve Kafkasör, Söke, Milas gibi festivaller
• Doping kontrolü var: temiz boğa kazanır

İNTERNETSİZ DE OYNA
• Tek oyunculu modda 5 yapay zekâ ahırına karşı oyna, oyunun telefonunda kaydedilir
• Online dünyada gerçek oyuncularla aynı festivallerde yarış, meydan okuma gönder

Boğa güreşi, iki boğanın başlarıyla birbirini ittiği geleneksel bir yarıştır: geri çekilen boğa kaybeder. Oyunda kan, ölüm ya da hayvana eziyet yoktur.

Oyunda diğer oyuncularla sohbet vardır; rahatsız eden mesajları şikâyet edebilirsin.
Boğa ve inek modelleri: "Bulls" (valangdance) ve "Farm Cow" (Rukh3D), CC BY 4.0, değiştirilerek kullanıldı.

Gizlilik: https://eminstudios.com/gizlilik/
Kurallar: https://eminstudios.com/kurallar/

name: Bolt Rope
description: Four stations sit on the sail. A stroke bites a station only when it crosses both the rope and the cloth. One band leaves that station open. When all four are bitten, the sentence says the bolt rope is on. Pulling a station open changes only that station. Names and a note stay on this iPhone.

name: Bone Buddies
description:
Bone Buddies

Welcome to a sunny woodland pet camp packed with colorful dens and hungry little dogs. Read the hint, spot the right doghouse, and feed your fluffy friends—one bone at a time.

How to play • Study the parchment clue and find the matching den
• Open the door, tap a bone, and watch it arc into the house
• Meet the dog, then pet it to finish the task
• Pick the wrong den and a playful chase begins—then jump right back in

What’s inside • 120 handcrafted camp levels with unique answers
• Cozy dens, breed albums, den collections, and camp badges
• Soft cartoon art, light puzzles, and feel-good pet moments

Warm grass underfoot. Doors that swing open. Tails that wag.
Find the den. Feed the friend. Become the camp’s favorite buddy.

name: Borinquen 1006
description:
Borinquen 1006 is the remote control for a self-hosted smart home. It talks directly to your house's own home gateway — no cloud account, no third-party servers.

• Rooms and devices — switch lights, set fan speeds, run any device's actions
• Scenes — dial in a lighting level and send it, or turn the whole house off
• Climate — thermostat mode, target temperature and the A/C unit
• Voice — say what you want; the house's own assistant does it
• Music — what's playing, transport, volume and search
• Metrics and activity — temperature history, A/C runtime and a log of everything that happened
• House settings — timezone, units and vacation mode
• People — the house owner approves every new phone

Borinquen 1006 needs a compatible home gateway on your network (or reachable over Tailscale). Not set up yet? Tap “Explore the demo house” to try every screen with a made-up home.

name: BoxGauge
description:
Compare a rectangular item with the usable inside dimensions of a box.

Save reusable box measurements, or enter a box manually. Enter one item size in the same unit and compare all six axis-aligned rotations. See the count on each axis, the total item count and the corresponding volume utilization.

Use millimeters, centimeters or inches. When selecting a saved box, its dimensions are converted to the currently selected calculation unit. Save comparison snapshots, reopen them later and share the measurements and six results. Editing or deleting a box does not change an already saved snapshot.

BoxGauge compares identical cuboids in a uniform grid. It does not optimize mixed orientations, account for clearance or irregular shapes, or assess weight limits or physical safety. Verify measurements and real-world fit before relying on a result.

Core records are stored locally, with no app account, advertising SDK or analytics SDK. Settings can export or delete local records. The app includes a read-only online-destination configuration feature. At launch and each return to the foreground, a valid enabled HTTPS destination may open automatically through the system. When unavailable, the app restores local features. About provides the current status, refresh and manual-open controls. External websites have their own data practices.

name: Breathe 478: Calm & Sleep
description:
Calm your mind with guided 4-7-8 breathing. Relax, focus, and unwind.

Your pocket-sized natural tranquilizer. Practice 4-7-8 breathing to calm your mind, slow your body, and create space between you and stress. Relax before sleep or anytime.

HOW IT WORKS
Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 7, breathe out for 8. A soft glowing orb swells as you inhale, holds steady, and settles as you exhale, with a gentle count at every step.

DESIGNED FOR BEDTIME
A quiet, dark midnight palette that is easy on half-open eyes. No bright white screens. When your session ends, a near-black Sleep Well mode helps you drift off.

FEATURES
• Guided 4-7-8 breathing with a glowing orb, countdown and phase cues
• Gentle haptic tap at every phase transition
• Soft chime in three tones — bell, glass or wood — playing at each phase transition, with its own volume and an easy off switch
• Choose 2 to 8 cycles, from about 40 seconds to over 2 minutes
• Session history, weekly totals and a nightly streak, kept privately on your device
• Good Night mode that fades to darkness, a tap to wake

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking, and no internet connection needed. Everything stays on your device.

Breathe in calm tonight. Download Breathe 478 and take your first slow breath.

name: Brewm–PourOver Timer&Bluetooth
description:
Brew your favorites again
Time each pour and track water and flow rate with a Bluetooth scale
Save your favorite brews as cards so you can make them again

name: Brick Pop Rally
description:
Bank shots through 200 steel mazes in a colorful arcade brick breaker. Guide the ball into tight passages, find the angle that opens each gate, and clear the colored bricks.

• Explore ten worlds with different routes and progressively tighter shots.
• Catch multiball, wide paddles, floor shields, and elemental boosts.
• Discover 30 collectible gems and spend the gems you earn on new ball colors and trails.
• Play offline with adjustable sound and reduced motion.

No ads, accounts, or in-app purchases.

Drag to move the paddle and tap Launch to serve.

name: Cabinet Quote - Carpenter
description:
Cabinet Quote is a measuring, sketching and quoting app for carpenters and cabinet makers. Kitchen cabinets, bathroom vanities, wardrobes, TV units… Take the measurements at the customer’s home and prepare the quote right there.

SKETCH THE ROOM, PLACE THE CABINETS
• Enter the room’s width, length and height; the plan draws itself
• Place cabinets wall by wall, to size: base, wall and tall cabinets, countertops, wardrobes
• Add columns, niches, doors and windows in a few taps
• The app warns you when a cabinet hits a column, door or window, and shows the free space to the centimeter

PRICES DONE FOR YOU
• Price per linear meter, per m² or per piece
• Compare prices by material (melamine, MDF, thermofoil, acrylic, lacquer…) in one tap
• Extras like drawers, LED lighting, glass doors, removal and installation
• Discount, VAT and deposit

PROFESSIONAL QUOTES
• PDF quote with your company details, room plans and line-by-line prices
• Send it over WhatsApp or email in one tap
• Visit, measure, quote, approve, build, deliver: see every job’s status at a glance

EVERY HOME, ONE FILE
• Customer details, call, WhatsApp and directions
• Photos of walls, sockets, water and gas lines taken while measuring
• Notes and the finishes your customer picked

CATALOG
• Add photos of your past work and door colors in folders
• Show them full screen and add the customer’s pick to the quote

YOUR PRICES
Set your own product types, unit prices, material factors and extras in Settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no internet needed, no tracking. All data stays on your phone; share a backup any time to move to a new phone.

Available in Turkish and English.

name: Cairn Tasks
description:
Cairn für iPhone, iPad und Mac ist die App zu einem Cairn-Konto. Sie zeigt Aufgaben, Projekte und Notizen und gleicht sie mit dem Server ab.

- Heute, Eingang, Demnächst und Markiert
- Projekte als Liste, Board, Kalender und Zeitachse
- Notizen und Notizblock in Markdown, Listen lassen sich einrücken
- Ohne Verbindung geht die Arbeit weiter, Änderungen gehen beim nächsten Abgleich an den Server
- Widgets für den Notizblock und die nächsten Aufgaben
- Ein Kurzbefehl schreibt eine Zeile in den Notizblock, auch über Siri und die Aktionstaste
- Zeiterfassung, wenn das Konto sie hat
- Mehrere Konten, auch auf einem eigenen Cairn-Server

Die App braucht ein bestehendes Cairn-Konto.

name: CalBox: Call Centre Dialer
description:
CalBox is the phone app for teams that run their outbound calling on CalBox (calbox.in). Your company admin creates your account: sign in with the email and password they give you.

FOR CALLERS
• Your next number is ready: CalBox shows who to call next from your campaign, and one tap places the call through your iPhone.
• Log the outcome in one tap: Interested, Callback, Not Interested, Not Reachable, Wrong Number or Do Not Call.
• Callbacks: pick a time and CalBox reminds you when it is due.
• Leads: see each lead's pipeline stage, notes and call history, and send your company's approved WhatsApp or SMS messages.
• Clock in and out, take breaks and apply for leave.

FOR MANAGERS
• Live team view: who is on a call, in a session, on a break or idle, with today's calls, leads and talk time.
• Leaderboard for today, this week and this month.
• Approve leave and attendance requests.
• Pause, resume or close campaigns, and give callbacks or leads to another caller.

BUILT FOR INDIAN TEAMS
• English and 22 Indian languages, including Hindi, Telugu, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati, Punjabi, Odia, Assamese and Urdu.
• Numbers on your Do Not Call list are never dialled.
• Works on iPhone and iPad.

PRIVACY
Your data goes only to CalBox, over HTTPS, and is never sold. Privacy policy: https://calbox.in/privacy
Delete your account: https://calbox.in/delete-account

A CalBox company account is needed. Learn more at https://calbox.in

name: CamePrism
description:
CamePrism is a stained glass design studio for composing patterns and studying the colored light they cast.

Shape a panel by moving shared junctions, splitting panes, and joining adjacent pieces. Choose a glass color and grain for each pane, or mix your own. Set the panel dimensions, seam width, and grid spacing to match the drawing you have in mind.

Switch to Light and move the source to see the projection shift. Explore different temperatures, surfaces, and levels of diffusion. Sample a projected pane to see how its color changes.

Save versions as you work and compare their patterns or light studies side by side. Export a PNG image, a dimensioned SVG pattern, a PDF pane schedule, or an editable project file. Start with an original pattern or build on a blank panel. Your projects are stored on your device.

name: CANOPY PACT: Plant Journal
description:
CANOPY PACT is a field journal for the plants you live with. It keeps your plants, their care plans and their growth history together on your iPhone — and it works with no internet connection at all.

CHECK BEFORE YOU WATER
Every care plan is a gentle check, not a rigid watering timer. When a check is due, open it, look at the soil and record what you found: Watered or No water needed. The next check is set from the day you actually did it, so the plan follows your plant instead of the calendar.

TODAY, ON ONE PAGE
• A calendar leaf for today with the coming week at a glance
• Overdue and due checks numbered in order, with one button to check each plant
• Snooze a check to another day, or skip it this time — nothing piles up
• When everything is done, the day is sealed: All caught up

YOUR COLLECTION
• Add a plant with just a name; species, room, date and a cover photo are optional
• Sort and filter by room, search by name or species, view as cards or a list
• Each plant keeps its own rhythm: check soil, inspect leaves, rotate, or your own task, every N days
• Archive a plant you no longer have without losing its history

A JOURNAL THAT GROWS WITH THEM
• Every check and every care step becomes a journal entry automatically
• Add observations with notes and photos from your library
• Filter by plant, type of entry, photos or dates
• Compare two photos side by side to see how a plant has changed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works fully offline. No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking
• Your collection stays on this iPhone and is excluded from iCloud backups
• Photos are copied into the app and their location data and other metadata are removed
• Export a single backup file whenever you like and restore it on another phone

ONE QUIET REMINDER
Turn on one daily reminder at a time that suits you. It only invites you to open your care list; it never counts or nags.

SHORT GUIDES
Eight short built-in articles on starting a collection, care plans, journaling and backups.

CANOPY PACT does not identify plants or prescribe exact amounts of water. It helps you notice, record and keep a steady rhythm — the pact is between you and your plants.

name: Car Bingo: Road Trip Games
description:
Are we there yet? Not with Car Bingo.

Car Bingo turns the back seat into a game. Pick a theme, get a fresh bingo board, and tap each thing you spot out the window: a red car, a tractor, a camper van, a cow. Get a line and shout BINGO!

FREE, NO ADS, NO TRACKING
Everything is free. There are no ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking. Made by a parent, for families.

23 BINGO THEMES
• Car bingo for kids, for adults, and car color bingo
• Camping, cabin, airplane, boat and hiking bingo
• Fall break bingo and nature bingo for summer, fall and winter
• Christmas, New Year's Eve, Easter and summer road trips

THREE BOARD SIZES
3×3 for the youngest, 4×4 for the classic game, 5×5 with a free space for the long drives. Every board is new, so siblings never get the same one.

PLAY TOGETHER
Start a shared game and share the code with everyone in the car. Each player gets their own board, and you see live who has one line, two lines or a full house.

ACTIVITY BOOKS AND COLORING
Nine activity books with mazes, find and count, dot to dot, word search, picture sudoku, secret codes and games for two. Coloring pages with color by number. Save them as PDF and print them, or play many of the puzzles right on the screen.

GAMES FOR THE LITTLE ONES
Simple games for ages 2–5: trace the line, find and count, match and patterns. No reading needed.

WORKS OFFLINE
Everything except shared games works without internet, so it's ready for the mountain pass, the ferry and airplane mode.

No account needed. If you want to save your results across devices, you can create one with just a username, and delete it again in the app at any time.

name: CarPül
description:
Find your next rental and keep your trip organized with CarPül.

Explore vehicles from participating local fleets in Metro Atlanta. Review rental options, request dates, and follow your booking from application to return.

• Create your renter account and submit driver documents for review.
• Request a vehicle for the dates and permitted use you need.
• Upload insurance evidence for fleet review and accept your rental agreement.
• Complete rental checkout and keep your trip details together.
• Message your fleet and receive rental updates and reminders.
• Record pickup and return inspections and photos.

Fleet owners can apply, prepare vehicle listings, manage availability, review requests, and coordinate rentals.

Rental eligibility requires approval, current driver documentation, accepted insurance, availability, and payment. Renters must be at least 21. Individual fleet terms and approved uses apply. Enabling notifications is optional.

CarPül currently serves Metro Atlanta.

name: Caso Fácil
description:
Caso Fácil te ayuda a no perder ninguna fecha importante de tu caso de inmigración ni del de tu familia.

Agrega a cada persona de tu familia con sus fechas y la app calcula los plazos y te avisa a tiempo:
• Plazo de 1 año para pedir asilo.
• Cuándo se puede pedir el permiso de trabajo con el asilo pendiente.
• Cuándo renovar el permiso de trabajo antes de que se venza.
• Recordatorio de cada audiencia en la corte, con lo que tienes que llevar.
• Plazo para avisar a la corte cuando te mudas (EOIR-33).
• Plazo para apelar a la BIA y para pedir reabrir el caso.

Avisos 7 días antes, 1 día antes y el mismo día.

SI DETIENEN A ALGUIEN
Qué hacer en las primeras 24 horas, los números A de tu familia listos para copiar, quién cuida a los niños y acceso a las apps Habeas Fácil, Contacto Detenido y Fianza Fácil.

AYUDA
Pide por WhatsApp la preparación de tus documentos a Libertad Legal Group, y abre los sitios oficiales de la corte de inmigración, ICE y USCIS.

PRIVACIDAD
No necesitas cuenta. Tus datos se guardan solo en tu teléfono.

Los plazos se actualizan cuando cambian las reglas.

Información general, no es asesoría legal. Cada caso es distinto: confirma siempre con los papeles de la corte o de USCIS. Libertad Legal Group LLC prepara documentos y no es un bufete de abogados. No está afiliada al gobierno.

name: Cassarola
description:
One phone. Three rounds. Total chaos.

   Cassarola is a pass-and-play party word game for 2 to 16 teams of two. Each player writes five words. Pass the phone around. Give clues. Beat the timer. Take the podium.

   HOW TO PLAY

   1. Split into teams of two. You can field 2 to 16 teams.
   2. Every player writes 5 words — one for each chosen category.
   3. Pass the phone. One teammate sees the word and gives clues. The other teammate guesses.
   4. Every correct word is one point. The timer does not wait.
   5. Three rounds. All words return to the deck, reshuffled. Rounds get harder.
   6. The final podium shows the full standings. Ties share the win.

   WHY YOUR GROUP WILL LOVE IT

   • One device, everyone plays. Made for parties, family nights, and trips.
   • Up to 32 players (16 teams of two) on a single phone.
   • Your words make the game. Every match is different because you write the deck.
   • Prefer ready-made chaos? Play the curated party packs with over 1,000 words.
   • Set your pace: turns from 15 to 60 seconds.
   • 32 avatars and 16 team colors. Pick your look.

   NO FUSS. JUST PLAY.

   • No account. No sign-up. No personal questions.
   • Your own-words games run fully offline. Play on a plane, in a cabin, anywhere.

   Grab your friends. Grab one phone. Let the chaos begin.

name: CatNav – Catamaran Guide
description:
Buying a cruising catamaran is one of the biggest purchases you'll ever make. CatNav keeps the whole search in one place, from the first "which model?" to your first 100 days as an owner.

EXPLORE 39 POPULAR CATAMARANS
• Lagoon, Leopard, Fountaine Pajot, Bali, Excess, Nautitech, Outremer and Catana
• Length, beam, draft, air draft, displacement, engines, tanks and sail area in metric and imperial
• A dimensioned profile drawing for every model
• Cabin and head layouts, including owner's versions
• Known weak points to check, where reliable sources report them

TRACK THE BOATS YOU'RE WATCHING
• Save each boat with its year, location, listing link and broker
• Log every price change and see the trend on a chart
• Add your own photos, choose the cover, and tap any photo to see it full screen
• Follow each boat's status, from watching and contacting the broker to offer made, under survey and bought
• See where the boat is on a map
• Work through online and in-person checklists, plus the weak points for that model

BUY & OWN
• Step-by-step buying guide: offer, deposit, survey, sea trial, closing, registration and insurance
• Find a marine surveyor near the boat: SAMS, NAMS, IIMS and YDSA association searches, ordered by where the boat is
• Keep your own surveyor list with quotes, ratings and notes
• Shared directory: surveyors other CatNav buyers have recommended, with business details only
• The questions to ask a surveyor before you hire one
• A first-100-days checklist for new owners

LEARN
Straight-talking videos about buying a catamaran from the Vitamin Sea channel, plus a few favourites from other sailors.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your boats, prices, notes and photos stay on your device.

CatNav is a buyer's guide. It is not a survey, legal or financial advice. Always use a qualified marine surveyor.

name: Celestial Songs
description:
Play any song with its chords.

Search a song or paste a YouTube link. Celestial Songs listens to it and shows the chords, the melody and the beat, synced with the official YouTube player, so you can play along on guitar, piano or any instrument.

- Chords that follow the song as it plays, with what comes next.
- The melody, note by note, and the lyrics on songs that have them (with a free account).
- Sing: the microphone tells you if you're in tune while you sing. Nothing is recorded or sent; the sound is analysed on your phone.
- The screen stays on while a song plays.
- Save your songs with a free account.

Free, and you don't need an account to start. Headphones recommended when you sing.

name: Cell Saver: Pool Control Help
description:
Pool controller acting up? COMMUNICATION ERROR, buttons that don't respond, a pump that won't start, or a salt cell that stopped making chlorine? Cell Saver finds the cause and walks you through the fix, step by step, even with no signal by the pool.

Works with Hayward Pro Logic, OmniLogic, OmniPL, Aqua Logic / Aqua Plus, OnCommand and Aqua Rite / Trol, and with their T-3, T-5, T-9 and T-15 salt cells. Written by the technicians who repair these control boards.

POOL CONTROLLER PROBLEMS
• COMMUNICATION ERROR or a flashing display
• Buttons that don't work
• Pump that won't turn on, or never turns off
• Valves, relays, heater, lights or aux outputs that don't respond
• Clock that doesn't keep the time
• PCB, No Cell Power, HOT or COLD messages

SALT SYSTEM LIGHTS AND MESSAGES
• Check Salt, High Salt, Inspect Cell and No Flow lights
• Power or Generating light off, or nothing lights up
• Salt reading that doesn't match the pool store test
• Wrong cell type setting after a new cell
• Cell not making chlorine, or too much chlorine
• Green or cloudy water: what to do first
• Camera check (beta): take or pick a photo of an Aqua Rite / Trol panel; it reads the display and the lights, and you confirm with a tap

SET YOUR CELL RIGHT
Most pools run their salt cell far too high, and that wears out a cell that costs hundreds of dollars to replace.
• See how much chlorine your cell really makes, in lb or kg per day
• Get the lowest setting that keeps your water safe, for your pool size and pump hours
• Salt, pH and stabilizer taken into account
• See how many dollars and seasons of cell life a too-high setting costs you
• Log your chlorine tests and get a follow-up after each change

WATER BALANCE MADE SIMPLE
• Salt: why 3,000 to 3,200 ppm works best, and how much salt to add
• pH: what to do when it's high
• Stabilizer (CYA) calculator
• Pool volume estimator, in feet or metres

BOARD PROBLEM? WE REPAIR IT
When the guide points to the control board, request a repair quote right from the app: your answers and photos are included. Repairing a board costs a fraction of a new one, and Pro Logic, Aqua Logic and OmniLogic boards are our specialty.

• Free, no account, no ads
• The whole guide works offline
• English and French
• Pool or hot tub, gallons or litres, pounds or kilograms

Results are estimates based on balanced water and normal use. Always confirm with a water test.

Hayward, Aqua Rite, Aqua Trol, Swim Pure, Pro Logic, Aqua Logic, Aqua Plus, OmniLogic, OmniPL, OnCommand and T-CELL are trademarks of Hayward Industries, Inc. Cell Saver is an independent app by Services NTIC Inc., not affiliated with or endorsed by Hayward.

name: CenKen
description:
CenKen, matematik ile mantığı aynı bulmacada buluşturan bir Calcudoku oyunudur.

Kurallar çok basit:
• N×N'lik ızgaraya 1'den N'e kadar rakamları yerleştir.
• Her satırda ve her sütunda her rakam yalnızca bir kez kullanılır.
• Kalın çizgilerle çevrili bloklardaki rakamlar, köşede yazan işlemi (toplama, çıkarma, çarpma veya bölme) ve hedef sayıyı sağlamalıdır.

Öne çıkanlar:
• 3 zorluk: Kolay (3×3), Orta (4×4) ve Zor (5×5)
• Her zorlukta 50, toplamda 150 bölüm
• Bölümler kolaydan zora düzenli olarak zorlaşır
• Tahmin yok: Her bulmacanın tek bir çözümü vardır ve yalnızca mantıkla çözülür
• Not modu ile olası rakamları hücrelere işaretle
• Geri al, sil ve takıldığında ipucu kullan
• Satır ve sütunda tekrar eden rakamlar anında vurgulanır
• Süreni ve en iyi derecelerini takip et
• Uygulama içinde "Nasıl Oynanır?" rehberi
• İnternet gerekmez, reklam yok, hiçbir veri toplanmaz

Sudoku ve Kakuro gibi mantık bulmacalarını seviyorsan CenKen'i de seveceksin!

name: Censor Faces
description:
Censor Faces hides the faces in your photos before you share them: with a mosaic, a single colour or black, in an ellipse or a rectangle. It finds the faces for you, lets you check and correct every box, and saves clean copies.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE • Faces are found with Apple's on-device face detection. Photos are never uploaded, and the app contains no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. It works in Airplane Mode. • Saved photos contain only the picture: no location, no camera data, no embedded preview of the original. Depth maps, portrait mattes and HDR gain maps, which can show the faces too, are removed as well. • Uncensored previews are kept in memory only, never in a cache on disk.

HOW IT WORKS

Choose a folder in Files (On My iPhone, iCloud Drive, an external drive) or an album in Photos.
Tap the photos you want to share. They are scanned for faces right away, and the thumbnails show the result.
Review: swipe through the selected photos, zoom in, and fix the boxes. Tap a box to select it, drag it to move it, drag its corners to resize it, add a box for a face that was missed, remove one that isn't a face.
Save: as copies in a "censored" subfolder, over the originals, as new photos in a "Censored" album in Photos, to any folder in Files, or straight to the share sheet.
MADE FOR CROWDS An extra pass over the photo in tiles finds small faces in group photos, crowds and wide shots.

YOUR CHOICE OF MASK • Mosaic, average colour or black • Ellipse or rectangle, with adjustable size • Coarser mosaics are harder to reverse The preview updates as you change the settings.

ALSO • Works with Live Photos (only the still image is used, never the video) and with your edits from the Photos app • Keyboard shortcuts with a hardware keyboard • VoiceOver and large text supported • Works on iPad too

Please check every photo before sharing: automatic face detection can miss faces, especially very small, turned-away or covered ones. HDR photos are saved as standard (SDR) photos.

name: Chain Hop
description:
Tap a log and the front frog hops to the log below. If that log is full, its front frog hops too, and the chain rolls on. Swipe a log up or down to choose the way the frogs hop. Gather one color on a log to clear it.

A calm waterfall puzzle. No ads, no purchases, no timers.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap a log: the front frog hops down. Swipe a log up or down to hop in that direction. A full log passes its front frog along, so one move can start a chain.
- Frogs of one color on a log clear it. Clear every frog to finish a wave.
- Press and hold a log to preview the result. Let go to hop, or slide away to cancel.
- From level 4, each wave has a move limit.
- Stuck? Undo, take a hint or reset the wave. Undo and hints are limited.
- Each level ends with your frog on a lily pad. Ten levels fill the pond.

WHAT IS INSIDE
- 50 levels of one to three waves, then fresh boards without end.
- A short tutorial teaches the tap and the swipe.
- Sound, vibration and analytics can be switched off in the info (i) panel.
- English and Turkish, following your device language.

PRIVACY
Chain Hop sends gameplay data, such as levels played and won, to Unity Analytics to fix bugs and balance levels, tied to a random install code, not your name. Where the law requires it, the game asks first. You can turn it off anytime in the info panel. No ads, no tracking.

Made for iPhone.

name: Chaos Arcade
description:
Play eight built-in mini-games offline. Use blocks to fill rows and columns in Block Fit 10x10, sort liquids by color in Water Color Sort, or break waves of bricks in Brick Buster Neon.

Swipe up or down to browse game cards, then tap Play. You can also search for a game in Gallery. Play as a guest and find your favorites in My Games. Game progress stays on this device.

Grouped Dispatch has Simplified Chinese gameplay text.

name: Charge Band
description:
Charge Band names a refrigerant-circuit fault from one visit’s four manifold readings.

Superheat and subcooling are read together against that circuit’s own target band. Undercharge, overcharge, restriction, and low airflow appear only when both sides agree. A visit stays on the circuit. Share an English summary or a CSV.

The saturation table is a field approximation. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: CheaperDrinks
description:
CheaperDrinks is a hand-drawn map of Toronto's happy hours.

See what's on now, what's near you, or plan ahead by day and time. Every venue shows its happy-hour schedule, the drinks and food on the menu with prices, daily specials and regular hours, with links to call, book or get directions.

- On now: active happy hours with the time left on each.
- Filters: day and time, distance, patios and rooftops, food, neighbourhood and bar vibe.
- Spin: can't decide? Let the wheel pick a spot from whatever matches your filters.
- Unhappy Hours: a map of shots for $5 or less. At least something in this city is still cheap.
- Contribute: tell us about a happy hour we're missing, share an idea, or claim your venue.

Listings are reviewed and updated regularly. Prices and times can change — check with the venue before you go. Please drink responsibly.

name: ChromaPair: Contrast Lab
description:
Inspect the text contrast between opaque sRGB colors and keep useful combinations together.

Enter foreground and background colors as six-digit hexadecimal values. Compare contrast shows a real color preview, the ratio and separate AA/AAA checks for normal and large text. Checks use the unrounded ratio, while the displayed ratio is rounded to two decimals.

Save named color pairs, search by name or hex value, edit either color and share the current result. Create a palette with 2 to 12 unique colors to see every unordered combination and its normal-text AA result. Edit, share or delete a palette independently of saved pairs.

ChromaPair supports opaque six-digit sRGB values only. It does not sample photos or the screen, handle transparency or certify an interface as accessible. Text size, rendering, non-text elements and other accessibility requirements need separate checks.

Core records stay locally on this iPhone. There is no app account, purchase, advertising or analytics SDK. More > Settings can export the local JSON or delete business data after confirmation. Device backups and copies you deliberately share are managed separately.

Online destination: at launch and every return to the foreground, the app reads its dedicated public CloudKit configuration while a white cover is shown. A valid enabled HTTPS destination opens automatically through the system. Disabled, missing, invalid, failed or timed-out reads (maximum 2.5 seconds), or a system-open failure, restore the local interface and existing edits. More > About shows status, Refresh configuration (updates status without opening) and Open website (manual, enabled only for a valid current destination). The initial Development and Production configuration is off (enabled=0) with an empty URL. There is no active business website or reviewer login. Local business data is never synchronized to CloudKit. External sites have their own data practices. This behavior is the same for all users.

name: Chrono 777 Slot
description:
Amber filament light spills across brushed brass bezels, hand-hammered copper rivets, and beveled glass gauges. Behind the heavy vault doors of Chrono 777 Slot, a faint plume of warm steam rises around interlocking escapement wheels, while the steady, crisp tick of bronze teeth sets the rhythm for five distinct mechanical chambers.

At the center of the hall stands Mega 7 Sevens, a five-by-four cabinet framed in oil-rubbed bronze and wired across twenty-five paylines. A single press sets the five vertical drums spinning with a low, velvety hum. Faceted ruby triple sevens, burnished golden bells, emerald-cut clovers, and jewel-toned fruits blur into ribbons of color before locking into place with a weighted mechanical snap. Where special emblems land, gilded collector frames ignite around the cells, their warm filaments pulsing until the overhead Frame Bonus wheel turns in a shower of copper sparks and cascading multipliers.

To the side, beneath a curved crystal dome, Brass Pinball gleams with mirror-polished steel and inclined bronze rails. The coiled spring plunger releases a heavy silver orb that skims across the engraved playfield with tangible momentum. Twin brass flippers respond with a sharp metallic clack, driving the sphere into pressurized bumper rings that shudder and chime on impact. Passing through the whirling x10 gate sets the upper indicator needles trembling; lighting all three arched 777 windows along the crest unlocks the vault chutes, sending a chorus of multi-ball spheres ricocheting across the table.

High in the foundry gallery of Clockwork Stack, a pendulum crane swings like an oversized metronome above a cast-iron anvil. Suspended from its brass hook, a solid block of stamped gold bullion catches the lamplight as it arcs left and right. At the exact instant of alignment, the latch releases. Gold meets gold with a clear, resonant ring—each flush edge locking into a rising column of bullion while the pressure gauge beside the tower climbs through higher streak multipliers.

Within the shadowy armory of Gear Blade Strike, emerald spotlights cut across a massive chamfered boss cog turning with deliberate torque. Along its outer rim, cabochon rubies and sapphires glint between revolving teeth. With each tap, a balanced golden dagger streaks upward, biting cleanly into a narrow gap of the spinning wheel with a crisp metallic thud. Threading blade after blade without grazing an existing hilt—while slicing through the rim jewels—splits the master gear apart in a burst of golden shivers.

At the far end of the atrium, Steam Claw Vault hums with the soft pneumatic sigh of copper pistons. Along twin overhead rails, a geared trolley glides above a velvet-lined pit heaped with royal treasure chests, glowing ruby cores, and brass multiplier capsules. Braided steel cable pays out from the winch drum, lowering hinged golden jaws that close around a heavy chest with a firm mechanical grip before hoisting it smoothly to the delivery chute.

Every chamber inside Chrono 777 Slot is crafted as a tactile clockwork retreat. All FUN points, gold bullion, gemstones, and multiplier tiers exist purely as virtual entertainment elements for leisure play, carrying no real-world monetary value and involving no real-money wagering, gambling, or cash payouts.

name: Classical Masterpieces Player
description:
A player for classical masterpieces, with no ads. Choose from about 500 pieces published as free material by the CMSL Classical Masterpieces Sound Library, and stream them by genre or composer.

HOW IT WORKS
- Tap "Shuffle everything" and start listening right away
- Pick from new arrivals on the home screen, or from the genres: symphonies, orchestral, concertos, piano, chamber & instrumental, and vocal & opera
- Go from genre to composer to work, and play a whole work movement by movement
- Search by title or composer

FEATURES
- No ads, no account, no data collection
- Background playback, with controls on the lock screen
- Queue, shuffle and repeat
- Favorites and history (kept only on your device)
- Download pieces and listen offline (Wi-Fi only by default)
- Sleep timer (15 to 90 minutes, or the end of the current piece; it fades out before stopping)
- Composer portraits (public domain and freely licensed images)
- The catalog is updated monthly and the app picks up new pieces automatically
- Light and dark mode, Japanese and English
- Most piece titles are shown in Japanese, as published by the library

PRICE
All pieces and features are free.

ABOUT THE RECORDINGS
The recordings are MP3 files from the CMSL Classical Masterpieces Sound Library (by ANDO TOWA), published under the Creative Commons Attribution 2.1 Japan license. The app streams them directly from the CMSL servers. This is not an official CMSL app.

name: Clearvista
description: Clearvista is a quiet studio for capturing soft light. Seal vista specimens with solar height, color temperature, and true solar time. Explore a gallery, star map, light workshop, seasonal calendar, and place sandbox. Export recipes, create shareable letters, and keep everything on your device. No ads. No social feed. Just light, time, and place.

name: Cleitext
description:
Cleitext keeps your site with you. Add your Cleitext sites, sign in with your account and stay on top of everything from your phone.

WRITE WHEN THE IDEA COMES
A title, some text and a few photos taken on the spot: save a draft or publish right away. Bold, italic, headings and lists are there when you need them, and you can polish everything later on your computer.

CHRISS, YOUR SITE'S ASSISTANT
Tap Chriss's bubble and ask in your own words: "write a draft about the holiday opening hours", "which comments are waiting for a reply?". Chriss works on your site with your account and leaves everything as a draft until you decide.

COMMENTS IN ONE TAP
Approve, reply, mark as spam or trash the comments waiting for you, wherever you are.

MESSAGES AND ORDERS
Read the messages sent through your site's forms and answer by email or phone in one tap. If your site has a shop, follow new orders, see their details and change their status when you ship them.

PHOTOS AND MEDIA
Snap a photo and upload it to your site's library in seconds.

NOTIFICATIONS YOU CHOOSE
An alert when a comment waits for approval, a message arrives or an order comes in. Choose site by site what to receive.

MANY SITES, ONE APP
Switch between your sites with a tap. For everything else there is "Open the full admin".

THEMES AND PLUGINS FOR YOUR SITE
The Shop section lists Cleitext's paid themes and plugins with clear prices. The purchase is completed on cleitext.com and the licence is used on your website. You can also create your Cleitext account.

RESPECT FOR YOUR DATA
No ads, no tracking. The app talks only to the sites you add; your sign-in is stored securely on the phone and you can remove it at any time.

Cleitext is an open-source CMS, and this app is free software too.

name: Codelivly
description:
Learn cybersecurity through guided rooms, structured learning paths and hands-on practice. Start with the fundamentals or explore a topic you want to improve. Work through lessons and exercises at your own pace, then pick up where you left off.

Browse learning paths, read lessons and track your progress using your Codelivly account. You can continue on your iPhone or at codelivly.com.

name: COHESTAPRT
description:
COHESTAPRT is a private desk for one household . It opens on the numbers. There is no sign-in and no introductory tour.

The house book is net worth: five sleeves, a euro pocket, a dollar pocket, and a metal card. Tap the donut to read a slice. Drag the portfolio line to read a month. Cash is held flat on the chart so the line does not pretend to know yesterday's pocket.

The practice book is the other life of the same desk. Flow shows retainers in and costs out for the month, the prior month, or ninety days. Clients, the funnel, and mandates stay out of household net worth on purpose.

Receive, pay, and exchange use preset amounts. An exchange uses the desk rate, 1 euro to 1.08 dollars, and posts both sides. The concierge is a scripted night book: approve a fare to hold it on the euro pocket, decline it, or release the hold. There is nowhere to type.

Reserve is a cash floor for the household. The monthly aim watches practice inflows. Filing a month stores a local snapshot on this iPhone. Reset, in Settings, returns the sample book.

name: Collet
description:
Η Collet χρησιμοποιείται σε εργαστήρια προσθήκης, συναρμολόγησης και επιθεώρησης μηχανημάτων για να αποσύρει τις συσκευές, τα εργαλεία και τα εργαλεία επιθεώρησης από το σχεδιασμό των σωλήνων μέχρι τη συνταξιοδότηση. Χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς σύνδεση στο διαδίκτυο.
Όταν ανοίξετε, μπορείτε να δείτε πώς είναι σήμερα: πόσα είναι σε λειτουργία, ποια πρέπει να γίνουν προληπτική συντήρηση, ποιες βαθμοκρασίες είναι κοντά στην λήξη, και μερικές ακόμα εντολές που δεν έχουν ολοκληρωθεί.
Πέντε ετικέτες σελίδων: • Αρχική σελίδα: Πίνακες και γρήγορη είσοδος για εξαγωγή CSV
 • Υλικό: δημιουργία αρχείων για κάθε κομμάτι (αριθμός, τύπος, θέση, υπεύθυνος, διάρκεια ζωής σχεδιασμού), υποστήριξη αναζήτησης. Δάνεια, επιστροφή θα συσσωρευτεί ο αριθμός των χρησιμοποίησης, πλησίασε τη διάρκεια ζωής θα ζητήσει την αντικατάσταση
 • Εντάγμα εργασίας: αυτόματη ουρά εισαγωγής συντήρησης λήξης. Μπορεί επίσης να ανοίξει το πρόγραμμα αποτυχίας. Κάντε το μισό σημείο "σε εξέλιξη", μετά το κλείσιμο, θα γράψει την επόμενη ημέρα συντήρησης
 • Μετρήσεις: αριθμός πιστοποιητικού καταχώρισης, οργανισμός, αβεβαιότητα, διάρκεια ισχύος. Η απόσταση λήξης βαθμολογείται κατά πράσινο / κίτρινο / κόκκινο, η λήξη είναι ορατή με μια ματιά
 • Κύκλος: Επτά στάδια - Σχεδιασμός → Προμηθεύσεις → Λειτουργία → Χρονολόγηση → Συντήρηση → Αποθήκευση → Αποστολή. Προώθηση ή πίσω πρέπει να γράψει το λόγο, η χρονική γραμμή δεν μπορεί να αλλάξει

name: ColorBoxSlide
description:
Slide smart, beat the timer, and master colorful sliding-block puzzles!

In this brain-teasing puzzle game, your goal is to maneuver arrow-marked blocks across the grid toward matching colored walls and slots before time runs out. Plan each move carefully so blocks don’t trap one another, clear the board, and earn coins as you advance through challenging levels.

name: Companion for HomeBox
description:
Companion for HomeBox is an unofficial iPhone and iPad app for HomeBox, the open-source home inventory server you run yourself. It is not made by or affiliated with the HomeBox project.

KEEP WORKING WITH NO SIGNAL
Add, edit and move items in the basement, the garage or a storage unit. Each change waits in a queue on the device and is sent to your server in order when the connection returns. The app shows what is still waiting.

RUN THE WHOLE INVENTORY FROM THE PHONE
- Collections: switch between inventories and create new ones.
- People: invite family members, manage members and API keys.
- Data: create and download server exports through the share sheet, and import items from CSV.
- Maintenance: schedule tasks, mark them done and see the cost.
- Catalog: manage item types and templates.
- Tags: create, rename and delete tags.

EVERYDAY INVENTORY
- Browse, search, sort and filter items by location, tag, photo and type.
- See every detail: photos, purchase price, serial number, warranty, notes, and attached receipts and manuals.
- Add items with photos from the camera or the photo library.
- Browse the location tree room by room.
- Scan a barcode, QR code or asset label with the camera, or type an asset ID or barcode, to find an item or look up a product.
- Print or share item labels.
- See the total value and statistics of your inventory.

WORKS WITH YOUR SETUP
Connects to your own server address, also behind Cloudflare Access or another proxy that needs extra headers.

PRIVACY
The app talks only to the server you enter. Your sign-in token and proxy headers stay in the iOS Keychain, and your password is not stored. No account with the app maker, no analytics, no ads, no tracking.

WHAT YOU NEED
A running HomeBox server and an account on it. The app does not create a server for you.

name: Compare Now
description:
Compare Now tells you instantly which product is the best value by calculating the price per unit for you. No more calculator in the supermarket aisle. Packed with handy shopping tools for smart shoppers.

Compare anything
• Compare up to 20 products at once
• Automatic unit conversion, such as ml and liters, grams and kilograms, pieces and packs
• See the best value and the difference in percent and in baht
• Yearly mode shows how much you save when you buy regularly
• Work out how many items to buy to reach a budget or a target amount

Scan price tags (On-Device OCR)
• Take or pick a photo of a price tag and Compare Now fills in the price and size for you. Review and edit before confirming
• Text is recognized locally on your device via Apple Vision — fast, private, and works completely offline

Shopping & Value Calculators
• Discount & Promo Calculator: Calculate % off, stacked coupons, card discounts, and popular supermarket promotions (Buy 1 Get 1, 2nd item 1 baht, 2nd item 50% off, Buy 2 Get 1). Transfer results straight into the comparison table.
• Dining ++ & Bill Splitter: Add 10% Service Charge + 7% VAT + tip, and split the bill across 1 to 10 people with convenient integer rounding.
• Fresh Food Yield Compare: Compare true 100% edible meat cost between whole raw items and prepped items (shrimp, crab, fish, durian, pork ribs, watermelon).

Easy to use
• Ready-made categories such as water, milk, rice, coffee and tissue
• Recent comparisons are saved automatically so you can reopen them
• Share results as a clean image or a link
• Touch and hold the app icon to start a new comparison (Quick Actions)
• Native haptic feedback
• Dark mode support
• Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait and landscape, with a two-column layout on larger screens
• Thai and English, following your device language or chosen in Settings

Private by design
• No account and no ads
• All your data stays on your device and is never sent to a server

Made by CodeX Studio

name: Compose Fox: Dictate & Reply
description:
Compose Fox: AI Dictate & Reply

Speak naturally. Write clearly. Reply confidently.

Whisper Fox brings voice dictation and AI-assisted writing together in one easy-to-use iPhone app. Turn your speech into text, shape your words into polished messages, and draft replies without starting from a blank page.

VOICE TO TEXT
Capture thoughts, messages, notes, and drafts by speaking. Whisper Fox uses on-device speech transcription powered by WhisperKit, so your voice can be processed on your iPhone.

SMART AI REPLIES
Paste or share a message and create a thoughtful response. Choose how you want to sound, from concise and friendly to polished and professional, then review and edit the result before sending.

REWRITE IN YOUR OWN STYLE
Refine text for clarity, tone, and readability. Turn a quick thought into a message that feels ready to send.

FOX KEYBOARD
Access Whisper Fox from a custom keyboard. Start the dictation workflow from supported apps and return to insert or paste your transcribed text. Some steps may require opening Whisper Fox because iOS limits microphone access from keyboard extensions.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY
Whisper Fox is designed around on-device processing using supported Apple Intelligence and local AI models. Available capabilities depend on your device, iOS version, and downloaded models. An internet connection may be required to download models.

Whether you're replying to emails, drafting messages, or capturing an idea on the move, Whisper Fox helps you go from thought to text in less time.

name: Connect – CRM, ERP, AI
description:
Connect brings your company's CRM and ERP (Odoo 20 with the “WK Mobile” module) to iPhone as a native app – together with your company's AI assistant.

Your business at a glance:
• CRM: leads and opportunities with stage, expected revenue and contact; next stage, won or lost with one tap, quotation straight from the opportunity
• Sales: view and create quotations and orders, change lines, confirm and invoice
• Invoices: open and overdue invoices, post, register payment
• Purchase: requests and orders, confirm, create the vendor bill
• Inventory: complete receipts and deliveries with done quantities, look up stock levels
• Notes and messages on every document; everything else opens right in Odoo

Teamwork:
• Team chat with push notifications, voice messages, photos and files
• My tasks and calendar
• Several CRM accounts signed in at once

AI assistant:
• Sign in to your company's chat server (Open WebUI) with address, user and password – or connect to an agent server with an access key or QR code
• Answers with formatting and tables, send photos and files, voice input
• Before first use the app explains which data goes to which AI service and asks for your consent

Secure and data-saving:
• The app talks only to your company's server; credentials stay in the keychain of your device
• Your CRM permissions apply: you see only what you may see in the browser
• Light and dark appearance in calm, warm colours

Requirement: access to your company's CRM (Odoo 20 with “WK Mobile”), for example via W&K Connect. More at wkconnect.de. The app is in German and Russian.

name: Construction Team Scrum
description:
Team Scrum is the board, the morning standup, and the week's points for an ICM Construction job site.

One team is one job site. A person can be on several. The board is one column at a time: Backlog, Sprint Backlog, Doing Now, and Done. Cards carry a title, notes, assignee, due date, priority, Fibonacci points, and comments.

A sprint is one week. The header shows the dates, the points the crew committed, and a capacity bar. Ending a sprint moves unfinished cards forward and keeps the committed and completed points.

The standup asks three questions: what you did yesterday, what you will do today, and what is blocking you. The reminder follows the job site's time, weekdays, and timezone. Answers post to the shared feed. A blocker is highlighted.

Moving a card to Done plays the job site's sound, an air horn or a hammer hit, and shows a short burst. The team can turn teammate Done alerts on or off. Each person can mute those alerts without muting their own celebration.

The field report shows weekly points, velocity, committed versus completed, the crew leaderboard, and velocity for every job site you belong to.

Sign in with your email and a password. There are no ads, no tracking, and no sale of data. A project manager can delete a job site from Settings. To delete the account itself, use the contact on the privacy policy.

name: CoolPeek: Slide Preview
description:
Preview PowerPoint (.pptx) slides directly on NTU COOL file pages in Safari. Enable "CoolPeek: Slide Preview" in Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions, open a .pptx file page on NTU COOL, and tap "Preview Slides". Swipe or tap to navigate slides, or download the original file.

Slides are parsed locally in your browser. Requires an NTU COOL account and access to the file. Built by an independent developer.

name: Copilot: GTA 6 Companion
description:
Copilote is the game guide that tells you plainly what is certain — and what is not.

Guides contradict each other, especially days after a launch. Copilote cross-checks several sources and shows a reliability level on every single entry:
• CONFIRMED: at least 2 independent sources saying the same thing
• LIKELY: a single source, untested in game
• UNVERIFIED: unknown, or claimed by one weak source
• DISPUTED: sources contradict each other, and you get both versions

THE DISPUTE WALL
Every point the guides disagree on, with both versions side by side. No other guide admits it can be wrong.

WHAT NOW?
Tell the app where you are in the story, and it tells you what to do: what you lose by moving on, which missions still matter in your chapter, and how to make money right now. No website can do this, because no website knows where you are.

THE COMBO TRAINER
Cheat codes are 7 to 10 button sequences. Practise them on the app's own D-pad, with haptic feedback, until your thumbs know them. A video cannot do that.

COUCH MODE
The combo shown huge, readable from across the room, screen kept awake. Phone down, controller in hand.

WHERE IT IS
The official map's grid, columns 1 to 9 and rows A to M, with 25 locations placed at their real square. Looking for Key Lento? The app answers K6. And one button opens Rockstar's own official map, free and printable.

A SAVE REMINDER
The game's autosave has a single slot and overwrites it every time. Lost progress has been reported since launch. Leave your phone beside the controller and it reminds you to save manually.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 55 trophies with conditions, missable warnings and unknown triggers flagged
• 61 cheat codes with unlock conditions and the save/trophy warning
• 94 missions by chapter (the exact count is disputed, and we say so)
• 34 mission notes: choices, missables, heists, points of no return
• 9 ways to make money and 8 collectibles with their 100% thresholds
• 9 alerts: saving, money lost in chapter 1, the missable meditation, timed missions
• 33 locations across the state of Leonida
• A platinum roadmap
• French and English, following your phone's language
• Data collected on 22 November 2026, refreshed online as things are confirmed: the app shows you what changed since your last visit
• Tested a code in game? One button says so. Players are what moves an entry from "likely" to "confirmed"

NO SPOILERS
Tell the app which chapter you are in, and it hides mission and trophy names beyond your progress.

YOUR PROGRESS, YOUR DEVICE
Tick trophies and missions, write your own notes, follow your completion. No account, no ads, no tracking: everything stays on your phone. Works offline.

An unofficial app, made by a player for players of GTA VI. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Names are cited only to identify the game in question.

name: Cosa ho nel frigo: ricette
description:
Apri il frigo, segna cosa c'è e scopri subito cosa puoi cucinare. Senza fare la spesa e senza sprecare niente.

Cosa ho nel frigo è l'app svuotafrigo pensata per la cucina di tutti i giorni: inserisci gli ingredienti che hai e ti propone le ricette che puoi preparare adesso, mettendo per prime quelle che usano ciò che sta per scadere.

IL TUO FRIGO
• Aggiungi gli ingredienti con un tocco, scegliendoli per categoria, oppure cercali e scrivili
• Segna la data di scadenza: gli ingredienti da usare presto finiscono in cima
• Sale, olio, pepe e gli altri ingredienti di base li consideriamo sempre in casa

LO CHEF CON APPLE INTELLIGENCE
• Lo Chef inventa ricette nuove proprio con i tuoi ingredienti
• Scegli il tipo di piatto, il numero di persone e se usare solo quello che hai
• Funziona direttamente sul tuo iPhone, senza internet
(Richiede un iPhone compatibile con Apple Intelligence e la funzione attiva)

LE RICETTE
• Un ricettario di cucina italiana già dentro l'app: primi, secondi, contorni, piatti unici, dolci e colazioni
• Vedi subito quali ricette puoi fare con quello che hai e quali ti mancano di un solo ingrediente
• Per ogni ricetta: ingredienti con le quantità, cosa hai già e cosa ti manca, preparazione passo passo
• Quando hai cucinato, tocca "L'ho cucinata!" e il frigo si aggiorna da solo

PREFERITE
• Salva le ricette che ti piacciono, anche quelle inventate dallo Chef

PRIVACY
Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun dato raccolto: tutto resta sul tuo iPhone.

Meno sprechi, più idee in cucina.

name: CotaSpan: DWG DXF Viewer
description:
CotaSpan is a DWG and DXF viewer and measuring tool for iPad. Open your CAD plans offline, snap to exact points, measure distances and compare them with what you measure on site — for one small, fair price, with no subscription, no account and no ads.

On site, the plan says one thing and the laser says another. CotaSpan puts both side by side.

Open your own DWG or DXF drawing on the iPad, snap to the exact points on the plan, place a dimension and type in what you measured. The difference appears straight away, for example −7.8 mm, tied to the drawing, the revision and the two points it was measured between.

OPEN YOUR OWN PLANS
• DWG and ASCII DXF from Files, AirDrop or any app
• A local copy is kept, so plans open offline, even if the original has moved
• Revisions of the same plan stay together, each with its own measurements and notes

MEASURE WHAT THE DRAWING SAYS
• Snap to endpoints, midpoints, centres and nearest points on lines, arcs and circles
• A magnifier names the point and its layer, so you know exactly what you measured
• Distance, horizontal and vertical dimensions with a clear dimension line
• Set the unit from the file, by hand, or by calibrating on a known length

COMPARE WITH THE SITE
• Enter the size you measured with a large keypad made for site work
• See the signed difference in millimetres, plan and site values always kept apart

NOTES WHERE THEY BELONG
• Drop a pin on the plan, link it to a measurement and add one photo
• Mark notes Open or Resolved, search the register, and carry open notes over to a new revision

A REPORT THE ARCHITECT CAN READ
• Share a PDF with the plan, every measurement and note, the units and their source
• Choose English, Dutch, French or German for the report

FAIR PRICE, EVERYTHING INCLUDED
• A small one-time purchase: no subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads
• Viewing, measuring, notes, photos and PDF reports are all included

BUILT FOR THE SITE
• Works fully offline, with Apple Pencil, day and night mode, VoiceOver and large text
• Optional app lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode
• Available in English, Dutch, French and German

PRIVACY
No account and no cloud. Your plans, measurements, notes and photos stay on your iPad until you share a report. Optional anonymous usage statistics and error reports can be switched off at any time in the app.

CotaSpan is made for viewing and measuring; it does not edit drawings. It reads DWG and ASCII DXF files (binary DXF files need to be exported as ASCII DXF first) and shows the plan in 2D top view, measuring in the model space.

name: CouponKeeper
description:
兑换码管家（CouponKeeper）是一款专为个人开发者、电商卖家、数码博主以及数字资产持有者打造的原生卡密管理与核销工具。

无论是软件激活码、游戏礼包码、会员卡密，还是包含参数的长链接，兑换码管家都能助您告别凌乱的备忘录与电子表格，实现万级卡密的高效归档、防呆核销与自动对账。

核心功能特性：

1. 智能导入，万级数据秒级解析
支持从纯文本（TXT）、表格（CSV）或系统剪贴板一键批量导入。内置高性能解析引擎，针对万级卡密做了底层多线程深度优化，不卡死、不掉帧、内存占用极低。

2. 链接智能嗅探与纯码解构
面对复杂的长网址或兑换链接，系统可自动识别并从 URL 路径或参数中提取出核心兑换码。支持双轨提取，您既可以一键复制纯码，也可以随时复制完整原始链接。

3. 有效期管控与临期优先出库
支持为卡密批次设置有效截止日期，系统在取码出库时自动执行临期优先（FEFO）分发策略，并自动拦截过滤已过期卡密，杜绝发错码、发废码的风险。

4. 极速取码与分发流水记录
单枚快速取码、多枚批量分发一键完成，取码后自动标记为已核销，彻底消除重复发码隐患。支持在取码时记录客户备注与分发对象，每一笔出库都有据可查。

5. 完善对账与数据离线导出
内置独立的对账记录视图，按时间线清晰呈现所有核销流水。支持随时导出标准 CSV 对账清单，方便导入 Excel 或 Numbers 进行财务与销售归档。

6. 专属 iPad 大屏生产力工作台
全面适配 iPadOS 与外接妙控键盘。采用 NavigationSplitView 双栏联动架构，左侧即时监控各分类库存红绿灯状态，右侧直观管理明细。支持多列自适应网格与常用的快捷键操作（Command + N 新建、Command + D 取码、Command + I 导入）。

7. 本地优先与私有 iCloud 跨端同步
坚持 Local-First 设计理念。所有数据默认基于 SwiftData 存储在您的设备本地沙盒中。开启 iCloud 同步后，数据仅通过您个人的 Apple ID 私有 CloudKit 容器进行端到端加密流转，无任何中心服务器，无任何第三方追踪埋点或广告，安全私密。

适用场景：
- 个人开发者与独立创作者管理自研软件的 License 与激活序列号
- 电商商家管理各平台会员充值卡密与卡券库存
- 游戏玩家集中收集保存各类礼包码、CDKEY 与兑换链接
- 社群运营人员进行批量卡密抽奖与分发核销

name: CourtMaster Tournament
description:
With CourtMaster Tournament you follow tournaments live – as a player, team captain, fan or spectator.

• All public tournaments at a glance
• Schedule by division, time, court or team
• Live scores and up-to-date standings
• Bracket view of the knockout phase
• Favorites: your teams and tournaments always at hand
• Messages from the organizer to registered teams
• Captain area: manage the player list and confirm results – via your team's invitation link

For organizers: tournaments are created in CourtMaster (app or courtmaster.io) and appear here automatically.

5 languages: German, English, French, Italian, Spanish.
No ads, no tracking.

More at https://courtmaster.io

name: Courtside with Malik
description:
Courtside with Malik is the scores app built for the watch party.

Check tonight's games, follow live scores, and know the moment Malik goes live. When a watch party starts, Courtside lights up the game he's covering with a gold "Watch with Malik" badge and takes you straight to the stream.

LIVE SCORES, CLEAN AND FAST
• Pro and college basketball, plus football, hockey, baseball and soccer
• Live scores that refresh on their own during games
• Quarter-by-quarter scoring, game leaders, venue, TV channel and more
• Swipe through the week: yesterday's finals, tonight's slate, tomorrow's schedule

WATCH WITH MALIK
• A gold "Malik is LIVE" bar the second the watch party starts
• The game he's covering is marked so you never miss it
• One tap opens the live stream

LIVE ALERTS
• Turn on alerts and get one notification when Malik goes live
• No spam: one alert per watch party

YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• Follow any game on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Score, quarter and clock at a glance, without opening the app

WIDGETS
• Home Screen widgets in three sizes with tonight's games
• Lock Screen widgets showing who's playing or that Malik is live

MY TEAMS
• Follow your teams and see only their games in one tap

Free, with no account and no ads. Your followed teams stay on your phone.

Courtside with Malik is an independent fan app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any league or team.

name: Crate Grade
description: Crate Grade sorts one lot by fork length. Short is under 20 cm, Market is 20 to 28 cm, and Long is over 28 cm. Each grade crate holds four fish. A fifth fish in a full grade goes to juice, and that grade count stays at four. Remeasuring a fish takes it out of the old crate first, then applies the same rule, so both counts change. The sentence names the first grade that still has room, or says the fish went to juice. Names, notes, and counts stay on this iPhone.

name: Creatica Chess Analyzer
description:
Chess Analyzer finds the mistakes in your games. A strong chess engine runs on your iPhone or iPad, marks every inaccuracy, mistake and blunder, and shows you the move you should have played. Bring games in from PGN, from printed pages, and positions from diagrams or a board on the table.

ANALYSE YOUR GAMES
• Analyze Game searches every position and marks each move by what it loses against the engine's best move
• An arrow on the board shows the better move; play through the engine's line
• Evaluation graph across the game, and a summary per player with average loss
• Your own limits for inaccuracies, mistakes and blunders, and how long the engine thinks
• Share the game as annotated PGN: evaluations, symbols, and the better moves as variations

ANALYSE ANY POSITION
• Set up a position, paste a FEN, or jump in from any move of a game
• Score, best move and the main line, updating as the engine searches deeper

BRING GAMES AND POSITIONS IN
• Open PGN files from Files, Mail or the share sheet, or paste or type a game
• Printed games: scan a book or magazine page, or use a photo or screenshot. The moves are found by their numbers and checked against the rules, so two columns and commentary don't get in the way; any guess is shown for you to confirm
• Diagrams: photograph or screenshot a diagram and the position appears on the board
• Real boards: take a photo of a board on the table, or use the live camera

Printed games and diagrams read reliably. Reading a real board is newer and its results vary with the chess set, the light and the angle: it works best with a Staunton set seen from White's side and from above. Every square can be corrected and the board's corners set by hand, and it improves with each update.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. The app doesn't use the internet: your games and photos stay on your device.

FREE SOFTWARE
The engine, Creatica AB, uses Stockfish's NNUE evaluation. The app is licensed under the GNU GPL v3, and its source code is public.

name: Crochet.Digital
description:
Crochet Digital is a pattern reader and project companion for crocheters and knitters.

READ YOUR PATTERNS
• Sign in with your Crochet Digital account to open the patterns in your library
• Import any PDF pattern from Files and read it offline
• Zoom, night mode and page thumbnails for long patterns
• Draw, highlight and add notes on any page

COUNT AS YOU GO
• Round counter with stitch count and repeat tracker
• Separate counters for each piece of a project
• Keep the screen awake while you work
• US and UK stitch abbreviation keys

DISCOVER PATTERNS
• Browse amigurumi, clothing, home décor and more from independent designers
• Save favourites to your wishlist

FOR DESIGNERS
• Follow your shop's patterns and listings in Vendor Studio

Your PDFs, notes and progress stay on your device.

name: Crownvow
description:
Crownvow is a medieval battle strategy game where every victory is earned on the battlefield.

DEPLOY YOUR ARMY
Place infantry, spearmen, archers, cavalry and your commander on the field before each battle. Hide in the forest for an ambush, hold the bridges, take the high ground and build fences and traps.

COMMAND THE BATTLE
Once the fighting starts, react in real time: target enemies, order a charge, raise a shield wall or call down a rain of arrows with your tactic cards. Watch out — the enemy has a deck of its own.

CONQUER THE KINGDOMS
March across the campaign map city by city. Before every battle, the Cards of Fate offer you a choice: free troops, better gear, a spy in the enemy camp, and more. Defeat each kingdom's ruler to lift the mist from the next land.

EVERY BATTLE IS DIFFERENT
Rivers, forests, swamps, deserts and mountain passes. Rain, fog and night. Siege castles with catapults and battering rams, escort caravans, capture flags and hold the line.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Endless Campaign — how far can you go?
• Daily Battle — the same challenge for everyone, every day
• Commander skills, upgrades and 23 achievements to unlock

PLAY ANYWHERE
• Fully offline, no account needed
• Your progress stays on your device
• English and Turkish

Crownvow is free to play with ads. Watching rewarded ads is always optional. You can remove banner and between-battle ads with a one-time "Remove Ads" purchase.

name: CSMTx: Auto Chord and Strum
seller_name: CLEAR SKY MUSIC AND SOUND THERAPEUTICS, LLC
description:
CSMTx: Auto Chord and Strum turns your iPad, iPhone, and Mac into an expressive, harmonically locked string instrument, wireless Bluetooth MIDI instrument, accessible adaptive performance tool, and professional AUv3 workstation.

Designed for musicians, producers, educators, and clinicians, CSMTx: Auto Chord and Strum makes it effortless to perform lush chords, scales, and custom tunings without wrong notes—whether you are strumming directly on screen, sculpting pitch and expression with Apple Pencil, tilting your iPad or iPhone with Gyro Tilt modulation, or playing external synths and DAWs over Bluetooth MIDI.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY (INCLUDED IN ONE UNIVERSAL ONE TIME PURCHASE)
• Standalone Instrument & Bluetooth MIDI Controller (iPhone, iPad, Mac): Play immediately with zero setup using the built-in low-latency sound engine, Device Gyro Tilt modulation (iPhone/iPad), Camera Hand Motion (Mac), and wireless Bluetooth MIDI / USB / Virtual MIDI output.
• AUv3 Instrument Plug-in (CSMTx: Auto Chord Instrument): Load directly onto a Software Instrument track in Logic Pro, GarageBand, or any AUv3 host to play and record built-in sounds and MIDI with full DAW project state recall.
• AUv3 MIDI Plug-in (CSMTx: Auto Chord MIDI): Load into a MIDI FX slot to strum your favorite third-party synths, pianos, orchestral libraries, and samplers.

12 EXPRESSIVE BUILT-IN VOICES & ANALOG SYNTHESIS
• Harp (10-String)
• Folk Guitar, Nylon Guitar, Steel Guitar, Electric Guitar
• Banjo, Sitar, 5-String Bass, Electric Piano
• Classic Analog Synth (with dual-oscillator presets: Warm Brass, Classic Lead, Soft Pad, Round Bass, Folk Reed), Spring Synth, and Synth Lead
• Voice-tailored expression macros, delay, reverb, and real-time 2D XY filter pad.

ACCESSIBLE & EXPRESSIVE PERFORMANCE CONTROLS
• Touch & Multi-Touch Strumming: Responsive 2-to-10 string harp surface with velocity and vertical position sensitivity.
• Device Gyro Tilt Control (iPhone & iPad): Automatically locks screen orientation while active so you can tilt your device to sweep the 2D XY filter cutoff and resonance hands-free while strumming.
• Apple Pencil Expression (iPad): Use pressure, tilt, roll, and slide for expressive pitch bend and timbral shaping.
• Contactless Camera Hand Motion (Mac): Strum strings in mid-air using your Mac's camera and on-device hand tracking.

WIRELESS BLUETOOTH MIDI INSTRUMENT & DAW ROUTING
• Turn your iPad or iPhone into a wireless Bluetooth LE MIDI strumming instrument for hardware synths, Mac, Windows PC, iOS, or Android DAWs.
• Also supports Virtual MIDI, USB MIDI, and Network MIDI.
• Built-in Setup & Routing Guides for iOS/iPadOS, macOS, Windows, and Android DAWs.

DEEP HARMONIC CONTROL & CUSTOMIZATION
• Any Key & Scale: Instant harmonic locking across Major, Minor, Dorian, Mixolydian, Pentatonic, and more.
• 6 String Pitch Layouts: Chord, Full Scale, Fourths, Fifths, Fret, and Custom.
• Custom Chord Bank & Custom String Tunings: Build and save up to 10 custom chord progressions and 10 custom string MIDI mappings (includes Standard Guitar, DADGAD, Open G, Open D, C Pentatonic, and 5-String Bass templates).

100% PRIVATE & ON-DEVICE
• No subscriptions, no ads, no accounts, and no data collection. All audio, motion, and MIDI processing run 100% locally on your device.

name: CTH Crew
description:
CTH Crew is the in-house app for CTH Homes, LLC employees in Stillwater, Oklahoma. It is for CTH staff only; you need a PIN from CTH to sign in.

- Clock in and out
- See the job schedule and what's due today
- Mark scheduled work done, or report an issue, with a photo
- Request time off
- Upload receipt photos
- Get reminders before scheduled work

Job tracking (company policy, with your agreement): during work hours only, Monday to Friday, 6 AM to 6 PM Central, the app records when you arrive at and leave a job site, supply store or home, so job hours and labor costs are correct. It does not follow your route or record anything outside work hours. You can say no and still use the app.

name: Cue Clash: 3D Pool Duel
description:
Remember hanging out at the pool hall after school, settling everything with one last shot? Cue Clash brings that rush back to your phone: true 3D pool with both nine-ball and snooker.

No internet, no mobile data and no ads. Sit down with a friend, turn on Bluetooth or a Wi-Fi hotspot and play one-on-one: on the train, camping, anywhere without a signal. One purchase gets you the whole game, with no in-app purchases.

REAL 3D PHYSICS
Top and back spin, side spin, swerve, jump shots and massé all follow real physics, down to cut angles, cushion rebounds and balls rattling in the jaws.

NINE-BALL AND SNOOKER
Nine-ball with international rules: legal breaks, push-outs, ball in hand and three-foul loss. Snooker with reds and colours, penalties, free ball and the miss rule.

PLAY YOUR FRIENDS
Play one-on-one over Bluetooth or a Wi-Fi hotspot. The host picks the rules, match length and table, and you can run it back right from the room. Lost the connection? Pick the match up where you left off.

TEN AI LEVELS
From someone holding a cue for the first time to a near-flawless pro: pick any strength from 1 to 10.

LESSONS AND PRACTICE
Ten interactive lessons, from straight shots and cuts to spin, jumps, massé and snooker skills. Practice mode shows the AI's suggested shot, lets you undo and re-rack, and has slow-motion replays.

ALSO
- 14 achievements and full stats
- Your own player look, nickname and motto
- English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean

name: Cuete Teleprompter
description:
Cuete is a teleprompter that records in 4K. Your script scrolls beside the lens while you record, so you look at the camera and say what you meant.

It’s free. No ads, no watermark, no account and no subscription.

• Record in HD or 4K. Tap 4K for the sharpest your phone records.
• Your takes save to Photos like any other video.
• Tap the words to stop them and type. Changes save to the script.
• Set the speed, text size, text weight and a countdown.
• Swipe between your scripts and the camera.
• Use the front or back camera, upright or sideways.
• Record sound from a Bluetooth microphone.
• Archive the scripts you’re done with.

Your scripts stay on your phone. Cuete makes no network calls of its own.

Say it like “cute.” The name is a cue, as in cue card, made cute.

name: Cup Oracle: Coffee Reading
description:
Coffee Reading brings the centuries-old tradition of Turkish coffee cup reading (tasseography) into a quiet, modern ritual.
