HOW IT WORKS
1. Finish your cup, swirl the remaining grounds, and turn the cup onto its saucer to cool.
2. Upload a clear photo of the inside of your cup.
3. Choose your focus — General, Love, Work, or Money — and add an optional question.
4. Receive a structured reading covering Past, Present, and Future, along with key symbols spotted in the grounds.

FEATURES
- Structured Cup Readings: Clear sections for Past, Present, and Future with thoughtful, grounded guidance.
- Personal Journal: Every reading is saved privately so you can revisit predictions and track how accurately they unfolded.
- Four Languages: Full interface and readings in English, Korean, Turkish, and Greek.
- Calm Night Design: Distraction-free dark atmosphere crafted for evening reflection.
- Privacy First: Manage your data anytime with in-app account deletion.

For entertainment and personal reflection.

name: Curd Lane
description: Curd Lane keeps four lanes on one vat. A new lane dragged to the bottom opens one more piece and becomes the lift target. A cut that stops short, or a cut on a lane that is already through, comes back: the lanes and the piece count stay. Lift restores only the last accepted lane, then clears it. The sentence names the first lane that still needs a cut, says the vat is cut, or says the cut came back. Names, notes, and the four lanes stay on this iPhone.

name: CutLedger Board
description:
Turn measured stock and required cuts into a clear workshop plan with CutLedger Board.

Create projects with a consistent length unit and saw kerf, add available stock pieces, and enter the cuts you need. Build a longest-first, first-fit plan to see how cuts can fit into your stock and how much material remains.

• Organize separate projects with names, notes, units and kerf.
• Enter stock lengths and quantities alongside required cuts.
• Review allocations and remaining lengths in a readable plan.
• Save useful remainders as offcut records and mark them used or available.
• Share a plan through the system share sheet.
• Export local records as JSON or clear them with confirmation.

The planner is a deterministic estimating tool, not a guarantee of optimal nesting. Check measurements and practical cutting requirements before working with material.

Core records are stored on your device. No app account is required. An optional online destination can be controlled by a public configuration lookup; enabled destinations open through the system, and unavailable configuration returns you to local features. External websites have their own policies.

name: Dada Gourmet
seller_name: DADA IST AJANS HIZMETLERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Dada Gourmet is a discovery guide that leaves Turkey's good tables to no chance. Places are curated by our editors and shown on the map; when you hit the road, the food stops along your route are right in front of you.

DISCOVER
• Places by concept: boutique, historic, rooftop, seaside, chef's table and more.
• Upcoming events and Gourmet Flavours stories in one feed.
• Find places, events and stories with a single search.

PLACES
• Filter by location, cuisine, price, setting and services; see what is open right now.
• Each place page shows opening hours, menu, allergen information, the editor's note, photos and member reviews.
• Save favourites, build your own lists and mark the places you have been with "I’ve Been".

VENUE FINDER
• Location and budget, setting, cuisine and extras: four short steps, and the places that fit your choices are ranked by match.

RESERVATIONS
• At places that take reservations, pick the day, time and party size and send your request. Get a notification when the place confirms.
• Follow all your reservations in one place, add them to your calendar and cancel if you need to.

DADA ROUTE
• Enter where you start and where you are going, add stops in between and choose your vehicle (fuel or electric); your route is drawn on the map.
• Along the way: What to Eat? (places on and near your route), What to Buy? (regional products with a geographical indication), the cities you pass and Road Essentials (fuel or charging, places of worship, breaks).
• Add stops, save and share your route, or pick one of the ready-made routes.
• Trip tracking: while you travel, see the distance and time to your next stop and get an alert as you approach it. For turn-by-turn directions, send your route to Apple Maps, Google Maps, Yandex Navigator or Waze.
• Your location is used only while you use the app; when trip tracking is on, stop alerts continue with the screen locked and you see this in the status bar.

GOURMET FLAVOURS
• Food stories written by our editors: regional specialities, world cuisines, chefs, ingredient stories and kitchen terms.
• Filter stories by category and save the ones you like.

EVENTS
• See food festivals, tastings and city events on a calendar, in a list or on the map.
• Tap "Going", add events to your calendar, set a reminder and keep them all in your profile.

DADA POINTS
• Earn Dada Points for visits, reviews and suggestions, move up the ranks and collect badges.
• Suggest a place or an event you know; it goes live once an editor approves it.

COMMUNITY
• Place reviews are checked by an editor before they are published.
• Report an inappropriate review with one tap, and block a member whose content you do not want to see.

ACCOUNT, NOTIFICATIONS AND PRIVACY
• Sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail. No account is needed to browse.
• Turn notifications (reservations, reviews, events) on or off in Account settings.
• No ad tracking: your advertising identifier is not read and your data is not shared with third parties for advertising.
• Write to our support team from the Help Centre and continue the conversation in the app.
• Delete your account in the app: My Profile › Account settings › Delete my account. The request waits 30 days; signing in during that time cancels it.

Interface languages: Turkish and English. Some content is available in Turkish only.

Place details (hours, menu, prices, allergens) come from the businesses and our editors; please confirm with the place before you go. Do not handle the app while driving; follow traffic rules.

Privacy policy: https://dadagourmet.com/en/legal/gizlilik
Terms of use: https://dadagourmet.com/en/legal/kullanim-kosullari

name: Daily Plan: Firm Plans
description:
Daily Plan is a simple planner for the plans you have already decided on. No idea lists, no drafts, no clutter: only your firm plans.

• Day-by-day firm plans
Add what you will do each day and tick it off as you go.

• One notification each morning
At the time you choose (09:00 by default), a single notification reminds you of the day's plans. It shows your first few items and summarizes the rest as "+K more". If you prefer, turn off notifications for days with no plans.

• Monthly and weekly goals
Keep the bigger picture in view. Define your goals separately and track them.

• No account, no sign-in
Start right away. There is no email, password or sign-up screen.

• Your data stays on your device
Your plans and goals are stored only on this iPhone. The app does not send your data to any server and does not use analytics or advertising SDKs. Deleting the app deletes your data.

• Works offline
Adding plans and receiving notifications does not require an internet connection.

• Turkish and English
The language follows your system language. You can change it in Settings.

• Free and Pro
Daily Plan is free to start, with 3 plans and 1 goal. Daily Plan Pro unlocks unlimited plans and goals. Choose a monthly, yearly or one-time purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Manage or cancel your subscription in Settings, under your Apple ID.

Privacy policy: https://plan.koraydev.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: https://plan.koraydev.com/support

name: Dare Duo: Truth or Dare
description:
The party game that actually works in Arabic AND English.

Spin the wheel to see who's next, then face a Truth — or take the Dare. Dare Duo gives your group 1,000 prompts (500 truths and 500 dares) in both languages, with full right-to-left Arabic.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add 2–12 players and spin the wheel
• The chosen player gets a Truth
• Can't answer? Take a Dare instead
• Score points: Truth +1, Dare +2, chicken out 0
• End the game any time and crown the winner

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• A spin wheel with haptic feedback picks every turn
• Live scoreboard and a winner screen
• Family mode hides crush and dating questions for family gatherings
• My Cards: write your own truths and dares — inside jokes welcome
• Full English and Arabic — switch with one tap
• No repeats until the whole deck has been played
• 100% offline. No ads, no sign-up, no data collected

Perfect for family gatherings, Ramadan nights, sleepovers, road trips, and icebreakers with new friends.

صراحة أو تحدي — لعبة السهرات بالعربي والإنجليزي: عجلة تختار اللاعب، نقاط وفائز، وضع العائلة، وبطاقاتك الخاصة.

name: DataTrackers
description:
DataTrackers junta las reseñas de Google, Tripadvisor, Uber Eats y tus encuestas, de todas tus sedes, en una sola bandeja.

• Bandeja: lo que falta responder, primero. Filtra por sede o por grupo.
• Responde en segundos con respuestas sugeridas, en el idioma de cada cliente y con el tono de tu marca.
• Métricas: calificación, reseñas, tasa y tiempo de respuesta, y el puntaje de cada sede.
• Sedes: descubre cuál necesita atención, mira su ficha y comparte su QR para pedir reseñas.
• Avisos al instante cuando llega una reseña nueva o te asignan una.
• Asigna reseñas a tu equipo y deja notas privadas.
• Modo claro y oscuro.

Para usar la app necesitas una cuenta de DataTrackers. Competidores, palabras clave y reportes siguen en la versión web.

name: DateSpan: Working Days
description:
Compare dates, count custom working days and move a date forward or backward.

DateSpan separates calendar days, weekends and manually excluded dates. Choose whether to include the end date, or shift a date by a signed number of calendar or working days. Set your own weekend weekdays and excluded dates instead of relying on a fixed holiday calendar.

Save a named result with the exact inputs and work-calendar snapshot. Search, rename, share or delete saved results. A later change to the work calendar does not rewrite a saved calculation.

Dates use the Gregorian calendar from 1900 through 2100. The starting day is excluded from date shifts. No public-holiday feed, calendar synchronization, background reminders or legal-deadline advice is provided.

Core records stay locally on this iPhone. There is no app account, purchase, advertising or analytics SDK. More > Settings can export the local JSON or delete business data after confirmation. Device backups and copies you deliberately share are managed separately.

Online destination: at launch and every return to the foreground, the app reads its dedicated public CloudKit configuration while a white cover is shown. A valid enabled HTTPS destination opens automatically through the system. Disabled, missing, invalid, failed or timed-out reads (maximum 2.5 seconds), or a system-open failure, restore the local interface and existing edits. More > About shows status, Refresh configuration (updates status without opening) and Open website (manual, enabled only for a valid current destination). The initial Development and Production configuration is off (enabled=0) with an empty URL. There is no active business website or reviewer login. Local business data is never synchronized to CloudKit. External sites have their own data practices. This behavior is the same for all users.

name: DeepForest Starlight Quest
description:
DeepForest is a 3D puzzle adventure with 100 levels and 100 different kinds of puzzle. A strange wind has scattered the lights of the ancient Starlight Tree. Pick one of four travellers and follow a firefly through ten forest chapters to bring the lights back.

Explore mazes, stone-pushing puzzles, river crossings, nonograms, mini sudoku, mirrors, and memory games. In more than thirty levels, your traveller takes part by hopping across mushrooms, rowing a raft, or leading ducklings. Drag to rotate the view and pinch to zoom.

A guardian explains each puzzle. Tap Hint for a clue and tap again for the next move. There is no time limit, and completed levels can be replayed. Music and sound effects have separate controls.

Play offline in landscape on iPhone or iPad. No ads, accounts, or in-app purchases. Progress stays on your device.

Available in 18 interface languages, including English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Dutch, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Thai, Hindi, and Arabic. Change the language at any time from the game menu.

name: Deepwork: Focus & Tasks
description:
Deepwork helps you do your most important work, one focused session at a time.

FOCUS TIMER
• Focus sessions with short and long breaks, at the lengths you choose
• See the countdown in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen
• Get a gentle alert when a session or break ends

PROJECTS & TASKS
• Organise work into projects with start and end dates, or make them repeat daily, weekly or monthly
• Add tasks with a due date, time and priority
• Break tasks into subtasks
• Track every task and subtask as Not Started, In Progress or Done
• Pick a colour and icon — or any emoji — for each project

CALENDAR & REMINDERS
• See tasks and project dates in a monthly calendar
• Get reminders when tasks are due
• Optionally add your tasks and projects to Apple Calendar

REPORTS & BADGES
• Charts of your focus time by day, week and project
• Unlock badges as you build a focus habit

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: DevOpsCode Lab
description:
Practise IT certification topics with timed tests, answer reviews and progress tracking.

DevOpsCode Lab helps you build a regular study routine:
• Browse and search practice exams.
• Try free mini exams.
• Save answers and resume a practice session.
• Flag questions for review.
• Read explanations and review results by topic.
• Track your practice history from your account.

Sign in to access the practice tests included in your account. The app does not offer purchases.

DevOpsCode Lab is an independent study tool. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by certification providers. Practice results do not guarantee performance on a certification exam.

Support: support@devopscodelab.com

name: DiamondLore
description:
Trace baseball history through more than 241,000 game records from 1871 to 2025. Explore the seasons that shaped the sport, revisit famous World Series games, and follow the players and teams behind the scores.

• Discover milestones and featured stories in Today, including On This Day when a historical moment matches the date. • Move through eras, decades, seasons, and dates on the interactive Timeline. • Explore game scores, venues, and inning-by-inning recaps where line scores are available. Turn on spoiler-free viewing to reveal the result at your own pace. • Search for players, teams, games, ballparks, and historical moments, or browse the archive by season. • Bookmark discoveries in your Library and return to recently viewed pages.

The archive is included in the app for offline browsing on iPhone and iPad. No account required. Historical coverage varies by era.

name: DiceCheck: Roll Lab
description:
Run a classroom probability experiment with physical dice. Pick the number of faces, tap the result of each roll, and undo an accidental entry. The frequency chart shows observed counts and the equal-frequency expectation. After enough rolls, see the chi-square statistic and an approximate probability under the equal-face model.

Keep the two samples separate, compare their frequency distributions, and save named trials with a shareable report. Load a fictional example to explore the chart before entering your own observations.

A statistical observation tool for education. There are no wagers, virtual dice, games, accounts, or external services. A high p-value does not certify fairness.

name: Diecast Car Scanner
description:
Found a 1:64 car on the pegs or at the bottom of the toy box? Snap a photo and Diecast Car Scanner tells you what it is.

HIGHLIGHTS
• About this car: series, year, scale, rarity and every version of the casting in our catalog
• Meet the real car: history, specs and fun facts, with a credited photo when one is available
• Share any car as a branded card

WHAT YOU GET
• The casting name, year, series and collector number
• The colour variant you're holding
• Treasure Hunt check: we look for the circle-flame logo, Spectraflame paint and rubber tires, and tell you how sure we are
• An estimated value range, with links to current and sold listings so you can check real prices
• Tips on what to check (base, wheels, card) when a car is hard to tell apart

YOUR GARAGE
Save every car to your Garage with its photo, see how many Treasure Hunts you've found and your collection's estimated total. Your Garage stays on your phone: no account needed.

HONEST ESTIMATES
Values are estimates, not appraisals. We show how confident we are and where the number comes from, and we link to listings so you can see what cars actually sell for. You can share what you paid to help our team improve estimates for everyone.

HOW IT WORKS
Your photo is sent to our server, where AI identifies the car and checks it against our catalog of recent releases (catalog text from the Hot Wheels Wiki, CC BY-SA). We don't keep your photo after identifying it.

META GLASSES ON IPHONE
Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses connect to the iPhone app for voice and audio: say "hey diecast, scan this" and hear the answer in your glasses. The photo is taken with your iPhone camera. The glasses camera and Display features are not available on iOS yet.

FREE TO USE
Scan 5 cars a day for free.

Works with Hot Wheels® and Matchbox® cars. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Mattel. Hot Wheels and Matchbox are trademarks of Mattel, Inc.

Questions or feedback? Our team reads every message: hello@artisanreality.com

name: Dionix Client
description:
Dionix Client is the companion app for clients of Dionix, the web agency. It shows you where your website or app project stands and keeps everything we need from each other in one place.

You need an invitation from Dionix to sign in. If you're a Dionix client and haven't had one, ask your project manager.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• See your project at a glance: which step it's on, what happens next and when we expect it to go live.
• Send us your logo, photos, documents and videos straight from your phone, or share a link to them. See the files we've shared with you.
• See what we still need from you, and send it in a couple of taps.
• Check work we've shared for your approval, and tell us what to change.
• Ask us anything: report a problem, request a change or ask a question, and follow our replies in one conversation.
• Ask for a call back at a time that suits you, or message us on WhatsApp.
• Ask for an update when something is taking longer than we said, and see when we'll reply.
• Get an email when we reply or need something from you, and choose which emails you get.
• Once your website is live, see how many people visit it each week and which pages they look at (for websites we host and measure).

MADE TO BE EASY TO USE

• Large, clear text, with a choice of text sizes and a stronger-contrast mode.
• Works with screen readers and your phone's own text size.
• Sign in with a code sent to your email. There's no password to remember.

YOUR DATA

We only use your information to run your project with you. We don't show ads and we don't sell or share your data. You can delete your account in the app at any time. Our privacy policy explains what we collect and why.

Terms of use: https://www.dionix.ai/terms/app
Privacy policy: https://www.dionix.ai/privacy/app

name: Discover the World Atlas+Quiz
description:
Discover the World is an atlas you explore by tapping. From the globe, one tap takes you to a continent, then a country, a region and – in Austria, Germany, Switzerland and the UK – down to the district. Every level has its own card with the essentials at a glance.

COUNTRIES AND REGIONS
• Every country in the world with flag, capital, population, area, languages, currency and local time
• Regions worldwide: states, provinces, cantons, départements
• Districts in Austria, Germany and Switzerland, with number plate codes
• England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland with their council areas
• Accurate borders and neighbouring countries

WATER
• Thousands of rivers with source, length, drainage basin and discharge
• Whole river systems: where a river flows into, its tributaries, the lakes along the way
• Lakes and seas

MOUNTAINS AND LANDSCAPES
• Mountain ranges with their highest peaks
• Deserts and major landscapes

QUIZ
• Countries, capitals, neighbours, rivers and mountains
• Easy, medium or hard – for children, students and adults
• The whole world or the continents you choose, ten questions per round
• After every answer the map shows where it is

AND ALSO
• Day and night in real time: where the sun is straight overhead, the moon's phase and moonlight
• Search for countries, capitals, regions, rivers, lakes and peaks
• Globe or flat map, light or dark
• In English, German and Spanish
• For iPhone and iPad

NO STRINGS ATTACHED
• Works completely offline
• No ads, no subscription, no in-app purchases
• No accounts, no data leaves your device

Map data: OpenStreetMap (ODbL), Natural Earth, Wikidata.

name: Dockvella
description:
Dockvella is a cozy single-player ship repair game set in a sunny harbor workshop.

Every day, damaged boats arrive at your dock. Study each repair order, inspect broken parts, choose the right tools, and complete hands-on repair steps before delivering the ship back to sea.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pick a repair order from your harbor
• Inspect the ship and find every fault point
• Disassemble damaged parts with the correct tools
• Patch hull cracks, install new parts, and assemble systems in order
• Finish with a short sea trial, then collect coins and stars

FEATURES
• 30 repair missions across fishing boats, speedboats, sailboats, yachts, cargo ships, and ferries
• Interactive repair gameplay: tap, drag, install, polish, weld, and test
• Tool unlocks and workshop upgrades
• Achievements, star ratings, and local progress saving
• Offline play — no account, no login, no internet required

Grow a tiny dockside shop into a full harbor flagship repair center. Calm pacing, clear goals, and satisfying repair loops make Dockvella easy to pick up and fun to master.

Perfect for players who enjoy casual simulation, workshop puzzles, and light management games.

name: Dog Breed Wiki: Quiz & Finder
description:
364 dog breeds, with facts you can check. Facts come from cited sources, numbered at the end of each page, and breed pages, Match, Compare and Food all work offline.

FIND YOUR MATCH
Answer nine quick questions about your home, your days and what you want from a dog. Match shows the breeds that fit, what each one asks of you and where it falls short.

COMPARE BREEDS
Put up to three breeds side by side: size, lifespan, exercise, grooming, shedding, training, health tests and costs in the UK and the US. Turn on "Show only differences" to see where they differ.

CAN DOGS EAT IT?
Look up common foods before you share a bite. Each food has a verdict, from "Usually fine in small amounts" to "Toxic to dogs", with the reasons, and sources at the end of each page.

EVERY BREED IN DEPTH
Each breed page covers temperament and training, exercise and home life, grooming and care, health and lifespan, the cost of owning one, history and origin, similar breeds and common questions.

SAVE YOUR FAVOURITES
Bookmark breeds to come back to. No account needed.

FREE, NO ADS
Dog Breed Wiki is free, has no ads and doesn't ask you to sign up. Its content comes from dogbreedwiki.com, an independent dog breed encyclopedia.

Dog Breed Wiki gives general information, not veterinary advice. If you're worried about a dog's health, talk to your vet.

name: Domix - Маркетплейс
description:
Domix — карта магазинов строительных материалов Узбекистана.

Откройте карту и увидите магазины рядом с вами. Выберите магазин, чтобы посмотреть его товары и цены: цемент, кирпич, сухие смеси, краски, инструмент и многое другое.

Что умеет Domix:
• Карта магазинов. Находите ближайшие магазины и стройплощадки без долгих поисков.
• Поиск товаров. Введите название и сразу увидите, где оно продаётся и по какой цене.
• Категории. Все стройматериалы разложены по разделам, чтобы быстро найти нужное.
• Избранное. Сохраняйте магазины и товары, чтобы вернуться к ним позже.
• Корзина. Составьте список нужных материалов, при желании добавьте фото и отправьте его в Domix — мы передадим список магазинам.
• Для владельцев магазинов. Создайте свой магазин, выберите товары из каталога и укажите цены — покупатели увидят вас на карте.

Domix помогает быстрее находить материалы и сравнивать цены, чтобы вы тратили на ремонт меньше времени и денег.

name: DPX-Pro
description:
DPX-Pro is the job-site companion for DirectPX project teams. Record direct costs as they happen, attach the receipt, and keep every project's spending up to date in Procore without paperwork piling up at the office.

RECORD DIRECT COSTS
• Costs are filed to your company's Procore projects as Direct Costs, with the receipt attached
• Expenses, invoices and payroll, each filed to the right project
• Company Expense for overhead: cell phone, fuel, supplies and fees
• Vendor, employee, description, date and amount in one short form
• Payment method with card last 4 digits, plus purchases and returns/credits

ATTACH RECEIPTS
• Take a photo with the camera, choose from Photos, or attach a file
• Share a receipt or invoice from any app straight into DPX-Pro

REPORTS
• Filter by project, dates, payment method, employee and vendor
• See totals at a glance and every cost with its receipt
• Export a PDF report or a CSV for your accounting

SECURE SIGN-IN
• Sign in with your company email and a 6-digit code: no passwords to remember
• You see only the projects your company gives you access to

DPX-Pro is for invited users of DirectPX and works with your company's Procore account. An account from your company is required to sign in. Procore is a trademark of Procore Technologies, Inc.; DPX-Pro is not affiliated with or endorsed by Procore.

name: DramaKnot
description:
Drama Knot is a local craft notebook for short-drama writers and editors. Capture how a series opens, where tension peaks, and how rhythm is arranged—using cover-led cards you can browse, tag, and compare.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Shelf — Collect short dramas with poster covers, genres, tags, loglines, and craft scores
• Hooks — Log opening hooks by type, timing, potency, and technique notes
• Beats — Map plot nodes on a vertical rhythm spine with tension, pace, and cliff buttons
• Lens — Compare two titles, review workspace stats, and keep craft reference cards
BUILT FOR CRAFT STUDY
Score opening hooks, rhythm, and cliff density. Filter by genre, search titles and tags, pin key references, and keep everything on device for private rewrite sessions.
OFFLINE & PRIVATE
No account. No tracking. Covers and notes you add stay on your iPhone. Sample entries are fictional craft references for study—not affiliated with any streaming platform.
Whether you are rewriting a cold open, tightening an episode button, or comparing hook density across titles, Drama Knot keeps your short-drama rhythm research in one place.

name: Dron Kargom
seller_name: NAYNX TEKNOLOJI YAZILIM BILISIM ROBOTIK SISTEMLERI SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Dron Kargom is a delivery service that will carry small parcels across the city by unmanned aerial vehicle. We are preparing to launch in Türkiye: commercial delivery flights will start region by region as the required regulatory approvals are completed.

In this version the app runs with sample flights. You can see how the service will work from start to finish and join the waitlist to hear when it starts in your area. No payment is collected; payment will be enabled when the service opens in your area.

EXPLORE THE APP
Tap "Explore the app" on the sign-in screen and pick one of the ready-made sample accounts to sign in with a single tap: personal sender, recipient, business team and operations roles.

HOW IT WILL WORK
- Choose the pickup address, the recipient and the parcel size.
- See the price and estimated arrival time for Standard and Express before you confirm.
- Follow the drone's position, stage and remaining time on the map.
- Send the tracking link and delivery code to your recipient in one tap. The parcel is released when the recipient enters the code; the recipient doesn't need the app.

LIVE TRACKING
- With Live Activities, the remaining time appears on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
- You get a notification when the shipment status changes.

ADDRESS AND RECIPIENT BOOK
- Save the addresses and recipients you use often.
- If you allow location access, the pickup address is filled in from your location. You can also choose the address manually.

BUSINESS ACCOUNTS
- Invite teammates and assign roles: owner, manager, sender, accounting.
- Create bulk shipments from one origin to several recipients.
- View the account statement and manage API keys for integrations.

SAFETY PRINCIPLES
- Routes are planned around no-fly areas.
- No new flight starts when the weather is unsuitable.
- The parcel is released only with the correct delivery code.

WAITLIST
Leave your province and district and we'll e-mail you when the service starts in your area. Consent to marketing messages is asked separately and is optional.

ALSO
- Turkish, English, Arabic and German.
- Light and dark themes.
- You can delete your account from within the app.

Dron Kargom is developed by NAYNX Teknoloji Ltd. Şti.

Privacy Policy: https://dronkargom.com/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://dronkargom.com/legal/terms

name: DuMail
description:
DuMail is the work email app for teams on DuWorks. Read, reply and stay on top of your company inbox from your iPhone.

• A fast inbox with Primary, Updates, Promotions and Social tabs
• Swipe to archive, delete or mark as read; long-press for more
• New-mail alerts with the sender, subject and a preview
• Snooze until later today, tomorrow, the weekend or next week
• Schedule send, undo send, templates and read receipts
• DuWorks Assistant: summarize long emails and help write replies
• Calendar invitations with Yes / Maybe / No, plus your month and week
• Your organization's directory and your own contacts
• Switch between your mailboxes and shared mailboxes in one tap
• Face ID lock, light and dark mode

DuMail needs a DuWorks workspace with DuMail turned on. Your admin can set it up at duworks.xyz.

name: Duo Translate: Face to Face
description:
Speak face to face, each in your own language.

Duo Translate helps you have a conversation without passing the phone back and forth after every sentence. Choose your two languages, tap the button for the person speaking, and follow the translation on screen.

READ EACH OTHER’S TRANSLATION
On a compatible iPhone Duo, the outer display shows your translated words to the person facing you. When they reply, read their translated response on the inner display. Translations update during the conversation and may be refined as you speak.

SHARE A SCREEN ON THE TABLE
Lay the phone flat between you. Two reading areas face opposite directions so each person can read from their own side.

READ IT OR HEAR IT
Keep your conversation text-only or turn on spoken translations. Replay the last translated sentence and adjust the speaking rate.

POWERED BY APPLE TECHNOLOGY
Duo Translate uses Apple frameworks for speech recognition, translation, and spoken output. Available languages and voices depend on your device and compatible Apple models. An internet connection may be needed to download them before use.

YOUR CONVERSATION STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads, and no conversation history stored by the app. Your words are used for the current conversation. You choose whether to send a bug report or suggestion to the developer.

BEFORE YOU START
Microphone access is required to transcribe your voice. On iPhone Duo, the outer display requires an active camera capture session. iOS camera permission and the camera indicator are therefore required, even though the app does not display or save video. Outer-display availability depends on device and iOS compatibility.

Translations may contain errors. Confirm important information with the person you are speaking to.

name: DuoFramer - Photo Frames
description:
Every photo has a story. DuoFramer frames it.

Pick a photo and DuoFramer reads it for you: the camera and lens, aperture, shutter speed, ISO, the date, and where you took it. 
Choose a frame and get a polished image in seconds, ready to share.

66 FRAMES FOR EVERY MOMENT 
• Camera: clean white borders, minimal-style info bars, cinematic black frames, blurred backdrops and gallery mats 
• Film: 35mm negative strips with sprocket holes, and square medium-format 120 film 
• Location: postcards, passport stamps, map pins, boarding passes and ticket stubs that turn your camera into the flight, and coordinate readouts, with real place names 
• Weather: forecast bars, big temperatures and sky-tinted borders, from sunny to stormy, summer to winter (with hemisphere detection, not just date)
• Holiday: Christmas, New Year, Lunar New Year, Valentine's Day, Easter, Halloween, Diwali, Hanukkah, Thanksgiving and birthdays 
• iPhone Duo: frames sized for the inner and outer displays that fill the screen whatever the shape of your photo

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO 
Fold your iPhone Duo into tent mode and DuoFramer becomes a photo frame. 
Your chosen collection plays full screen on the outer display, cross-fading from one frame to the next.

YOUR FRAME, YOUR WAY 
• Pinch to zoom and drag to reposition your photo 
• Show or hide the logo, camera, settings, date and location 
• Show a place name, GPS coordinates, or both, and edit either 
• Add the weather and temperature in °C or °F 
• Give any frame a custom title

PIXEL-PERFECT EXPORT 
What you see is what you get. Frames export at full resolution and look exactly like the preview. Save to Photos or share anywhere.

CREATIONS AND COLLECTIONS 
Every frame you make is kept in Creations. Browse them in a clean grid, each frame at its natural shape. Group favourites into collections for slideshows and carousels.

FREE, WITH NOTHING HELD BACK 
Every template, Collections and tent mode are included. No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no watermarks.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN 
Your photos are processed on your iPhone. No account, no tracking, no ads. DuoFramer hides the frames it has made from its photo browser, so your library stays tidy.

name: DuoMe: Daily Utilities
description:
Bring your everyday tools together with DuoMe. Create photos, keep track of daily routines, record ideas, and see your progress in one simple app.

PHOTO EDITOR & COLLAGE
Personalize photos with frames, text, emoji, and color effects. Arrange multiple photos in a collage, adjust the images, and save projects to continue editing later. Save or share your finished images.

DAILY WATER TRACKER
Log drinks with quick-add sizes or a custom amount. Set your daily water goal, choose reminders, and review your drinking history.

POSTURE TRACKER
Manually track time spent sitting, standing, and lying down. Start a timer or add a session, review your timeline, and set reminders to take a break from sitting.

GOAL SETTING
Organize goals around amounts, habits, or milestones. Set deadlines, record updates, and follow your progress over time.

DAILY BRAIN WORKOUT
Take on a daily set of three short games, or choose a game for a quick break. Play Color Clash, Memory Matrix, Number Hunt, and Quick Math, with difficulty options and personal progress statistics.

RANDOM UTILITIES
Pick numbers, roll dice, flip a coin, generate colors, or choose from a list. Save your own lists to use again.

NOTES & STATISTICS
Write notes, add a mood, and use an optional PIN lock. Explore activity summaries and trends across your daily tools.

Available in English and Vietnamese. No account is required.

Water, posture, and brain-game features are for general wellbeing and entertainment. They do not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

name: Duraqexpct
description:
Our app is the ledger you keep on this phone. Open it and a month is already in the book: what came in, what went out, and what is left.

The home page is this month’s balance — income minus expense — with a calendar of the days that have ink. Safe to spend is what you can use each day until payday, after the bills that are still due. The next 30 days shows payday and the bills that repeat, so the month does not surprise you.

Wallet is net worth. Cash, a card, a travel pocket in its own currency, savings you are holding back, and anything you still owe. Move money between pockets and it is not counted as spending. Pay down what you owe and both the cash and the debt go down. 

Budgets are standing plans. Give the whole month a ceiling, then give the noisy shelves their own. A single month can override the plan. Goals keep a target and the transfers you tag. Bills remember what repeats, and you mark them paid when the money leaves. Insights draws the shape of the month.

name: Earprint - Headphone Archive
description:
Every hour in your headphones has a story. Earprint turns your Apple Health Headphone Audio Levels into interactive 3D collectible trading cards, a collector-grade Device Dossier, 28-day acoustic Earprint Rings, and native widgets — processed 100% on your iPhone.

INTERACTIVE 3D COLLECTIBLE CARDS
• Real-time 3D RealityKit models float above custom foil surfaces: drag to spin with momentum, pinch to zoom, long-press to twirl with haptics, and tilt your iPhone for prismatic foil shimmer and parallax.
• Tap or swipe to flip any card for lifetime hours, sessions, average loudness (dB(A)), and tier progress.
• Automatic Bluetooth product ID matching for Apple and Beats hardware, retail finish customization for AirPods Max and Beats models, Light/Dark/System themes, and custom App Icons in Settings.

6 COLLECTOR RARITY TIERS (0H → 2,000H)
Your cards evolve automatically as your lifetime listening hours grow, with a clean multi-device Collector Binder showing when each tier unlocked:
• 0h+ — BRONZE SLATE (Matte Anodized Foil)
• 25h+ — SILVER ALUMINUM (Brushed Alloy)
• 120h+ — FJORD TEAL (Brushed Slate)
• 400h+ — DEEP PURPLE (Satin Glaze)
• 1,000h+ — MIDNIGHT CARBON (Machined Carbon Weave)
• 2,000h+ — LIQUID HOLO (Prismatic Alloy)

PSA-STYLE DEVICE DOSSIER & SHARE POSTERS
• Flip any card and open its Device Dossier — styled as an acrylic grading slab with a transparent Ear Grade (1.0–10.0) scored from loudness, weekly WHO dose, loud-session share, and late-night listening.
• Explore Week / Month / Year / All views, a scrubbable 30-day trend chart, a 24-hour radial Day Clock, a Habits & Hearing bento, monthly career ledger, milestone timeline with ETA, and a guilloché hardware provenance certificate.
• Export high-res Light or Dark PNG posters via Share Dossier in Simple (1-page) or Long (4-page carousel) 3:4 feed layouts, plus 3:4 and 9:16 Earprint Rings share posters.

28-DAY EARPRINT RINGS & WHO HEARING BUDGET
• See the last 28 days × 24 hours plotted as a concentric acoustic dial colored by energy-averaged loudness (Leq), alongside your listening persona (Night Owl, Commute Soundtracker, Early Bird, or All-Day Listener).
• Compare all pairs together or filter by individual headphones, and track your weekly safe-listening budget based on WHO / ITU H.870 guidelines (80 dB(A) for 40 hours/week, halving every +3 dB).

HOME & LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
• Home Screen widgets: Today (interactive card cycler), Card Shelf (up to 3 cards with deep links), and Large Earprint Ring + 28-day heatmap + WHO budget.
• Lock Screen gauges: Circular WHO Budget, Rectangular Today Summary, and Inline status.

100% PRIVATE ON YOUR IPHONE
• Read-only Apple Health access (Headphone Audio Levels only).
• Zero accounts, zero backend servers, zero analytics or ad SDKs. All processing stays encrypted on your device.

Note: Earprint is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Apple Inc. Apple, Apple Health, AirPods, AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, and Beats are trademarks of Apple Inc. Earprint is for informational and entertainment purposes only and is not a medical device.

name: EarsMixer
description:
Mix your own in-ears from your phone. Pick your AUX on the DiGiCo desk and you get a fader for every channel in it, so you can turn your vocal up or the click down without waving at the engineer.

You can also pan channels, mute them, or turn everything off at once. Lock the faders before the set starts and a stray thumb won't change anything.

On iPhone the faders run across the screen. Turn it sideways and you get vertical faders with more channels showing. iPad fits more of the band on screen at once.

If you're on a lot of channels, put them in groups (all the vocals, say, or the whole drum kit) and move each group with one fader. You can also reorder channels and hide the ones you never touch. Your layout and levels stay on your phone, or you can start from a template your engineer has set up.

To connect, pick the mixer from the list, scan the QR code on the engineer's screen, or type in the address. Enter the PIN if there is one, and add a nickname so the engineer can see whose mix is whose. You can send them a quick message too, like "more click please", and it shows up on their dashboard with your name and mix.

Demo mode works without a desk, so you can try it out first.

What you need: EarsMixer works with DiGiCo SD and Quantum consoles (not S-Series). Your engineer runs the EarsMixer server on a Windows or Mac computer that can reach the desk, and your phone or iPad needs to be on the same network.

EarsMixer is made independently and isn't affiliated with or endorsed by DiGiCo.

name: Edge True
description: Edge True keeps three blanks on one block. Each blank starts with runout 4. A high-side grind, with the mark still inside, lowers that blank by one and becomes the lift target. A low-side grind, or a stroke through the mark, bounces: runout and the mark stay, and the last accepted target stays too. When runout is already 0, that blank bounces and the other two do not change. Lift restores only the last accepted grind, then clears it. The sentence names the first blank that can still take a grind, says which blank just centered, or says the grind came back. Names, notes, and the three runout numbers stay on this iPhone.

name: Edios Read & Spell
description:
Edios Read & Spell is a calm, 100% offline reading, phonics, and spelling studio designed for learners of all ages on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Tap color-coded Elkonin sound boxes to hear crisp isolated vowels, digraphs, and consonant phonemes spoken natively on your device, then glide smoothly from slow segmented sounds into natural blended words.

SIX HANDS-ON MODULES

1. Quick Vowel & Digraph IPA Sound Check
Tap short vowels (a, e, i, o, u), long vowels (long a, e, i, o, u), digraphs (sh, ch, th), and r-controlled teams (ar, or, er) to hear authentic isolated phoneme pronunciation with mouth-placement cues.

2. Elkonin Sound & Blending Lab
Explore 6 structured levels - Short Vowel CVC, Digraphs (sh, ch, th, wh, ck, ng), Consonant Blends, Silent-E, Vowel Pairs (ai, ea, oa, ee, oi), and Multi-Syllable Words - complete with a continuous blending slider and finger-tapping guides.

3. Word Families Chaining
Swap one letter tile at a time (CAT to HAT to HOT) to see how changing a beginning sound, vowel, or ending builds new words.

4. Spelling & Writing Pad
Listen to words and sentences, map phonemes into letter boxes with instant feedback, and trace letters directly on the tactile handwriting board.

5. Decodable "I CAN READ" Arena
Read across 20 progressive decodable stories. Tap any individual word to hear it spoken clearly, switch between Storybook Midnight, Pastel, and Warm Paper comfort palettes, and answer built-in story check questions.

6. 60-Second Phoneme Blitz & Printable Practice Sheets
Build decoding speed in a 60-second timed fluency round, export mastery progress locally, or print custom sound-box worksheets via AirPrint and macOS Print.

PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DESIGN
- 100% offline with zero internet dependency
- Zero accounts, zero ads, and zero tracking
- Zero microphone, camera, or location permissions
- All progress stays privately on your device

name: EdiosCardioCore
description:
Edios Cardio Core turns cardiovascular anatomy and physiology into a fast, tactile, 100% offline 3D laboratory for students, educators, pre-health learners, and anatomy enthusiasts across iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Explore how blood, electrical impulses, and ventricular pressures work together across every cardiac cycle—with zero accounts, zero internet dependencies, and zero subscriptions.

INTERACTIVE STUDY MODULES INCLUDED

1. 3D Volumetric Beating Heart Atlas
• Orbit, zoom, and tap directly on anatomical chambers (Left Ventricle, Right Ventricle, Left Atrium, Right Atrium, and Aorta & Arch) to inspect pressures, wall physiology, and mechanical roles.
• Toggle Chamber Cutaway wireframe view to reveal the internal SA/AV conduction nodes and Purkinje network, or toggle Coronary Arteries with moving perfusion markers along the LAD, RCA, and LCx branches.
• Adjust Heart Rate (40–180 BPM) in real time to observe atrial-to-ventricular contraction pacing and live Cardiac Output updates.

2. Cardiac Conduction Axis & Live Lead II Waveform
• Step sequentially from the SA Node through AV Node Delay, Bundle of His, and Purkinje Fibers.
• Watch an animated educational Lead II P-QRS-T trace scale dynamically with your selected heart rate alongside R-R, systole, and diastole interval metrics.

3. Wiggers Diagram, Valve Mechanics & Frank-Starling Curve
• Inspect synchronized Aortic, Left Ventricular, and Left Atrial pressure tracings paired with Left Ventricular volume and S1 ("Lub") / S2 ("Dub") valve closure markers.
• Drag the Frank-Starling Preload Stretch (50%–150%) slider to compute End-Diastolic Volume (EDV), End-Systolic Volume (ESV), Stroke Volume (SV), Ejection Fraction (EF%), Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP), and Cardiac Output (L/min).

4. Educational Rhythm Pattern Study Lab
• Compare Normal Sinus Rhythm, Sinus Bradycardia, Sinus Tachycardia, Atrial Fibrillation study strips, and anterior ST-segment morphology side by side with clear P-wave, R-R regularity, and physiological notes.

5. 0.1 Hz Resonant Breathing Pacer & S1/S2 Sound Synth
• Practice baroreflex coupling at 0.10 Hz (5s inhale / 5s exhale) to observe respiratory sinus arrhythmia.
• Enable the built-in Web Audio S1 ("Lub") / S2 ("Dub") acoustic synthesizer (muted by default) or audition mitral, tricuspid, aortic, and pulmonary valve sounds on demand.

6. Cardio-Master Study Quiz + Native PDF Print & Export
• Check your mastery across 6 cardiovascular physiology scenarios with immediate rationales and progress tracking.
• Export a study summary via the native Share Sheet or generate a printable Hemodynamics Study Sheet PDF directly from iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

EDUCATIONAL & SAFETY NOTICE
Educational cardiovascular anatomy, cardiac cycle, and rhythm-pattern reference simulator for students and learners. Not a medical device, ECG monitor, diagnostic tool, or clinical emergency protocol — do not use for patient diagnosis or clinical decisions.

name: EdiosPlanCheck
description:
Edios PlanCheck is a fast, 100% offline architectural pre-submittal studio for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Review floorplan geometry for accessibility and life-safety compliance in the first 10 seconds—with zero cloud uploads, zero accounts, and zero subscriptions.

BUILT FOR FIELD WALKTHROUGHS & PRE-SUBMITTAL REVIEWS
• 4 Built-In Commercial & Institutional Sample Plans: Explore interactive vector plans across Outpatient Clinic (BP-MED-101), Academic Lab (BP-STEM-204), Assembly Dining Hall (BP-HOSP-309), and Industrial Warehouse (BP-IND-412).
• On-Device Floorplan Image Import (PNG / JPG): Load local floorplan sheets directly from Photos or Files with zero network transmission.
• 2-Point Scale Calibration (px/inch): Pick two points across a known doorway or scale bar before measuring imported drawings so uncalibrated drawings never produce guessed dimensions.
• Deterministic 2010 ADA & IBC Chapter 10 Overlays: 60" wheelchair 360° turning circles (§304.3.1), 32" minimum clear doorway openings (§404.2.3), 18" pull-side latch clearances (§404.2.4), and 44"/36" accessible corridor widths (§403.5.1 / IBC §1020.2).
• NFPA 101 Life Safety & Egress Pathfinder: Visualize Manhattan egress routes, exit discharge capacity (IBC §1005.3.2), common path of travel, dead-end corridor pockets, and automatic NFPA 13 sprinkler limit transitions.
• Live What-If Remediation & Auto-Remediate: Adjust turning circles, doors, corridors, travel distances, and sprinkler status in real time—or reset to plan baseline in one tap.
• On-Device Title-Block Metadata Privacy Scrubber: Strip client names, street parcels, phone numbers, emails, and security room tags locally prior to sharing.
• Native Export & Capsule Workflow: Print or Save-to-PDF redline punchlists, share AutoCAD-compatible .DXF redline layers, share JSON compliance snapshots, and reopen saved snapshot capsules from Files.

PRE-SUBMITTAL PLANNING DISCLAIMER
Pre-submittal planning reference only — not a licensed architectural seal, municipal permit approval, or Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) determination. Verify all dimensions against adopted local building codes with a licensed Architect (AIA) or Professional Engineer (PE).

name: EdiosStepFree
description:
Edios StepFree is a sunlit, 100% offline accessible city day planner designed for travelers who want clear step-free routes, realistic pedestrian leg distances, strict budget control, and reliable dietary filtering without accounts, tracking, or internet access.

WHAT YOU CAN PLAN OFFLINE IN SECONDS

• 4 Curated Day-to-Night City Corridors: Explore walkable accessible itineraries across Tokyo (Shimokitazawa & Daikanyama), New York City (Lower East Side & Dimes Square), Paris (Canal Saint-Martin & Haut-Marais), and Mexico City (Roma Norte & Condesa).
• Hard-Constraint Accessible Route Solver:
  - Wheelchair Step-Free Access Toggle: Automatically excludes stairs-only historic stops when enabled.
  - Max Walk / Roll Distance per Leg: Adjust your per-leg distance limit from 0.4 km to 5.0 km using great-circle Haversine street-grid distances.
  - Hard Day Budget Ceiling: Set a total daily ceiling ($60 – $350) and watch the planner automatically swap stops when needed to stay within budget.
  - Strict Dietary Filters: Filter every stop by Vegan, Gluten-Free, Halal, Kosher, or Zero-Proof readiness.
• Interactive Corridor Map & Custom Trip Notes: Inspect each stop along the SVG route atlas, shift arrival windows (-15m / +15m), reorder or skip stops, pick alternates, and add personal stop reminders stored strictly on your device.
• Native Apple Exports & Backups:
  - Add Day to Apple Calendar (.ics) via the system Share Sheet
  - Print Accessible Day Pass / Save to PDF via AirPrint / macOS Print
  - Export Route GeoJSON (.geojson) & Markdown Day Pass (.md)
  - Save & Reopen Trip Capsules (.json) through Files or Finder

PRIVACY & PLANNING REFERENCE

• 100% Offline & Private: Zero location permissions, zero camera permissions, zero network calls, zero analytics, and zero ads.
• Offline itinerary planning reference. Venue step-free access, dietary accommodations, pricing, and operating hours should be confirmed directly with each venue before arrival. Zero location tracking or personal data leaves your device.

name: EdT365 Chemistry
description:
EdT365 Chemistry is a periodic table with a set of chemistry calculators and review games, for middle and high school students, university students and anyone who needs a quick chemistry reference. Designed by Edtech365 in Vietnam, in English and Vietnamese, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

THE PERIODIC TABLE, ALL 118 ELEMENTS
- Color by category (alkali metals, halogens, noble gases…), by s, p, d, f block, by state at 25 °C, by electronegativity or by discovery date.
- Tap a legend entry to highlight a family.
- On iPhone it fits the screen and you can pinch to zoom; on iPad you get the full table with names and atomic weights.
- Search by symbol, name or atomic number.

A PAGE FOR EVERY ELEMENT
- Atomic number, IUPAC 2024 standard atomic weight, group, period and block.
- Full and short electron configuration, with notes on special cases such as Cr and Cu, and an electron shell diagram.
- Electronegativity, common oxidation states, state, melting and boiling points, density, discovery year and discoverers.
- A short note on what each element is used for.

TOOLS
- Molar mass from a formula: brackets, complexes and hydrates such as CuSO4·5H2O, with the mass percent of each element; textbook-rounded or IUPAC atomic weights.
- Chemical equation balancer using linear algebra with exact fractions, including redox and ionic equations, with an atom check for both sides.
- Convert between moles, mass, gas volume (24.79 L/mol at 25 °C and 1 bar, or 22.4 L/mol at 0 °C and 1 atm) and number of particles.
- pH of strong acid and strong base solutions from their concentration.

LEARN AND REVIEW
- Five games: Symbol to Name, Name to Symbol, Table Position, Electron Configuration and Fill the Table.
- Play with the first 20 elements, the common textbook set or all 118.
- Spaced review: elements you miss come back soon; the ones you know are spaced out.
- Quick reference: valences, common oxidation states, a solubility table and the metal activity series.

CLEAR DATA SOURCES
- Element data from PubChem (US National Library of Medicine), standard atomic weights from CIAAW/IUPAC, configurations per NIST.

COMFORTABLE TO USE
- Light, dark or automatic appearance; sounds and haptics you can turn off.
- English and Vietnamese.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: EdT365 Lunar Calendar
description:
EdT365 Lunar Calendar is a clean Vietnamese lunar-solar calendar that looks like a paper tear-off calendar: see lunar dates, convert between lunar and solar dates, check holidays and leap months, and keep your family's lunar anniversaries and birthdays. Designed by Edtech365 in Vietnam, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

MONTH VIEW AND TODAY'S PAGE
- A large calendar page: solar and lunar date, weekday, the stem-branch (can chi) of the day, month and year, the current solar term and holidays.
- A month grid with the lunar date under every day, marks for the 1st and 15th of each lunar month, public holidays and your own events.
- Swipe to change month, tap a day for details; weeks can start on Monday or Sunday.

EVERY DAY IN DETAIL
- Lunar date, long or short month, zodiac animal, stems and branches of the year, month, day and hour.
- The current and next solar term, with the exact time in Vietnam.
- Previous and next day in one tap.

WHOLE YEAR AND CONVERTER
- All 12 months on one screen, the date of Tết, the leap month and the length of the lunar year.
- Solar to lunar and lunar to solar, including leap months (for example the leap 6th month of 2025); it tells you when a date does not exist (short months have no 30th).
- Range 1900–2100.

EVENTS AND HOLIDAYS
- A countdown to the Lunar New Year (Tết).
- Add death anniversaries (giỗ), birthdays and anniversaries on the lunar or solar calendar, repeating every year; the app finds this year's solar date and the age or the count. A lunar 30th in a short month moves to the last day of that month.
- Public holidays, days off and traditional days: the Lantern Festival, Thanh Minh, Hung Kings' Day, Vesak, Double Fifth, Vu Lan, Mid-Autumn, Kitchen Gods' Day, New Year's Eve and more.

HOW IT IS CALCULATED
- New moons and solar terms are computed with astronomical algorithms (Jean Meeus) for Vietnam time, UTC+7, following the Vietnamese lunar calendar rules.
- Tết dates and leap months for 1900–2100 are checked against published tables (Hong Kong Observatory, Ho Ngoc Duc, Wikipedia). Sources and method are listed under About.

FOLK ALMANAC NOTES (SECONDARY)
For reference only, as traditional Vietnamese beliefs, with sources and method shown; not advice and not a prediction:
- Auspicious and inauspicious days and hours by the 12 spirits, the 12 day officers (trực) and traditional days to avoid.
- Birth year notes: nạp âm element, cung mệnh, compatible and clashing years.
- Suggested days for an activity (wedding, opening a shop, groundbreaking, travel and more) from those rules.
- A five-elements breakdown of the digits of a phone number or licence plate, with a transparent formula shown step by step.

COMFORTABLE TO USE
- Light, dark or automatic appearance; gentle haptics and sounds you can turn off.
- A layout made for iPad.
- English and Vietnamese interface.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your events stay on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: EdT365 Quiz Ladder
description:
EdT365 Quiz Ladder is a general-knowledge game in Vietnamese: climb a ladder of 15 questions, each harder than the last, from things everyone knows to questions for real enthusiasts. Designed by Edtech365 in Vietnam, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

Questions are written in Vietnamese; the interface is available in English and Vietnamese.

CLIMB THE LADDER
- Every rung has its own points; the top is 1,000 points.
- Two safe milestones: pass question 5 and 100 points are yours; pass question 10 and 400 are yours.
- Not sure? Stop at any time and keep your points.
- Three lifelines, once per round each: Drop 2 wrong answers, Swap to another question of the same level, or show a Hint. Reach the top with lifelines left and earn bonus points.
- Optional timer: 30, 45 or 60 seconds per question depending on the level.

TODAY'S CHALLENGE
- Everyone plays the same 15 questions each day, one try each.
- Keep your daily streak and share your result as text or as an image.

TOPIC PRACTICE
- Eight topics: Vietnamese History, Geography, Literature & Language, Science, Math & Logic, Sports, Culture & Life, World.
- Choose Easy, Medium or Hard; 10 questions with no timer.
- After every question: a short explanation and a reference (textbooks, encyclopedias, official sites).

900+ ORIGINAL QUESTIONS
- Four options, one correct answer, an explanation and a source for every question.
- Questions are picked so they do not repeat between recent rounds.
- Found a mistake? Tell us right from Settings.

STATS
- Best score, rounds played, times you reached the top, accuracy per topic and your daily streak.
- Review every question after a round with the correct answer and explanation.

COMFORTABLE TO USE
- Light, dark or automatic appearance; sounds and haptics you can turn off.
- A layout made for iPad with the points ladder always beside the question.
- English and Vietnamese interface.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your stats stay on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: EdT365 Riddles
description:
EdT365 Riddles is a Vietnamese riddle game with three modes: rhyming riddles, trick riddles and picture words. Read the riddle, then spell the answer with letter tiles or type it in. Designed by Edtech365 in Vietnam, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

Riddles are written in Vietnamese; the interface is available in English and Vietnamese.

RHYMING RIDDLES
- 260+ rhyming riddles about objects, animals, plants, nature and letters.
- Short, rhyming and easy to read aloud together.

TRICK RIDDLES
- Almost 190 trick riddles, wordplay, logic and number tricks written by Edtech365.
- Each one comes with a short explanation of why the answer works.

PICTURE WORDS
- 100+ puzzles: read the drawings side by side and guess the compound word or idiom.
- Every picture is drawn by Edtech365 and stays sharp on iPhone and iPad.

TILES OR TYPING
- The tiles include a few decoy letters; tap to place a letter, tap again to remove it.
- Prefer typing? Case and spaces do not matter, and if only the accents are off you are told you are close.
- Several ways of saying the same answer are accepted.

STEP-BY-STEP HINTS
- Empty slots show how many words and letters the answer has.
- Hints: first letter, remove decoy tiles, one more letter at a time, or show the answer.
- Paid with bulbs that you earn by solving riddles. Nothing to buy.

PACKS AND TODAY'S RIDDLE
- Riddles come in packs of 20, from easy to hard; solve 10 to open the next pack.
- One shared riddle a day for everyone, with bonus bulbs and a daily streak.
- Save favourites and share a riddle as text or as an image to quiz your friends.

COMFORTABLE TO USE
- Light, dark or automatic appearance; sounds and haptics you can turn off.
- Large text and tiles, and a layout made for iPad.
- English and Vietnamese interface.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: EdT365 Vietnam History
description:
EdT365 Vietnam History puts the whole history of Vietnam on one timeline, from the Văn Lang state to 1975, plus a few later milestones (1976, Đổi Mới in 1986, joining ASEAN in 1995 and the WTO in 2007). Written by Edtech365, with no ads and no account, and it works fully offline.

Event summaries and biographies are written in Vietnamese; titles, eras and roles are also in English, and the interface is available in English and Vietnamese.

A ZOOMABLE TIMELINE
- Four views: key events only, every event, cards with a summary, or spacing true to the passing of time.
- Pinch or use the plus and minus buttons; coloured bands along the spine show dynasties and parallel realms such as Champa, Funan and the southern lords.
- Filter by type (war, uprising, state, reform, economy, culture, diplomacy, movement), by period and by school grade.
- Search events, people and places, with or without Vietnamese accents.

A PAGE FOR EVERY EVENT
- Date, place (with today's province names), a summary and a "Why it matters" note.
- Traditional or debated dates are clearly marked.
- Related people and references (classic chronicles and school textbooks).
- Save events, show them on the map, step to the previous or next event.

DYNASTIES AND PEOPLE
- 30 dynasties and eras with capitals, lists of rulers and reign years.
- 88 people with their years, role, a short biography and related events.

MAP
- Capitals through the ages, battles and uprisings, and other events.
- Tap a point to open its event; filter by period.

LIGHT PRACTICE
- Put four events in order.
- Match people with events.
- Slide to the right year, with a tolerance that depends on how long ago it was.
- Two-sided flashcards and a quick quiz.
- What you miss comes back on a spaced schedule (after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days).
- Choose the scope by period or by grade.

CAREFUL CONTENT
- Everything is written by Edtech365 in its own words and checked against historical sources and textbooks; every event lists its sources.
- A neutral, textbook tone.
- Found a mistake? Tell us right from Settings.

COMFORTABLE TO USE
- Light, dark or automatic appearance; sounds and haptics you can turn off.
- A wide layout for iPad.
- English and Vietnamese interface.

No data collected. No ads. No in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

With EdT365, you'll never learn & grow alone!

name: Elsewhere: Travel Social
description:
Elsewhere is the social app for travel. Share your trips with friends, see where they are headed next, and build your own trip from plans real travelers actually took instead of trusting a search result you can't verify.

SHARE TRIPS WITH FRIENDS
Find friends who are already on Elsewhere (optional, you choose) and invite the ones who aren't. Post a trip, a place or a tip from the road and follow the people whose travel you trust. Like, save and comment, keep your account public or make it private so only approved followers see your posts.

PLAN A TRIP IN MINUTES
Pick a destination, your dates, group size and travel style, and Elsewhere builds a complete day-by-day itinerary: named restaurants, real places to stay, and things worth doing. It's free to generate and view.

BUILD FROM PLANS PEOPLE REALLY TOOK
Browse trips other travelers shared, save the ones you love to My Saved, and use them as the starting point for your own.

TIPS FROM THE ROAD
Insider tips from travelers: where to eat, when to go, what to skip. Save tips and see them on your trip.

PLACES ON A MAP
Keep a list of places you want to go and places you've been, explore cities on the map, and see your friends' favorites.

YOUR TRAVEL MAP
Every country you share lights up on your profile map.

BUILT TO BE A KIND PLACE
Report any post, comment or account and block anyone, right from the "..." menu. Reports are reviewed by our team. You can delete your account and its data at any time from My Account.

Free to join. Optional paid customization (drag-and-drop editing, an AI assistant that edits your trip, photo uploads and revision history) is unlocked on our website.

Elsewhere. Go somewhere worth talking about.

name: EmberWatt
description:
Το EmberWatt εκτιμά πόσο καλά μια μονάδα ORC ανάκτησης θερμότητας καλύπτει το ηλεκτρικό φορτίο του εργοστασίου.

Δίνετε θερμοκρασίες καυσαερίων, μαζική ροή, πίεση εξατμιστή, θερμοκρασία συμπυκνωτή και βαθμό απόδοσης. Υπολογίζει ανακτώμενη θερμότητα, θεωρητική ισχύ, βαθμό αντιστοίχισης και θερμική απόδοση, και σχεδιάζει την καμπύλη ισχύος απέναντι στο φορτίο.

Πώς να το χρησιμοποιήσετε
1. Προσθέστε μονάδα στις Μονάδες και επιλέξτε την.
2. Ανοίξτε την Αντιστοίχιση. Συμπληρώστε παραμέτρους θερμότητας και φορτίου, ή συνεχίστε από την τελευταία βάρδια.
3. Πατήστε Υπολογισμός. Δείτε δακτύλιο αντιστοίχισης, καμπύλες και προτάσεις ρύθμισης.
4. Αποθηκεύστε τη συνεδρία. Η Επισκόπηση και το Ιστορικό ενημερώνονται στη συσκευή.
5. Στις Ρυθμίσεις ορίστε κατώφλια συναγερμού και °C/°F.

name: Endless Staff
description:
Endless Staff gives local businesses a team of AI employees: a receptionist that answers every call 24/7, plus AI help with ads, social media, reviews, follow-ups and your website. This app is your window into that team.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See every call your AI answered, with a short summary, the full transcript and the recording
- Get a notification the moment a new call comes in, or when something needs your OK
- Approve, edit or skip social posts and review replies in one tap. Nothing goes out without your OK
- Track this week's call minutes, texts, ad spend, leads, reviews and more, by AI employee
- Request website changes and see when they go live
- Manage your billing and invoices
- Lock the app with Face ID

The Endless Staff app is for Endless Staff clients. To get your AI team, visit EndlessStaff.com.

name: Enduro Radar
description:
Enduro Radar is an app for enduro riders who want to ride together. Open it and you instantly see a map with hills and key places — and everyone who is riding right now.

INVITATION ONLY
This is a closed community: you can join only with a personal code from a member. Good hills don't turn into a public map, and sharing your position feels safe — only your crew sees it.

LIVE MAP
• Tap "Riding" and your crew sees you on the city map. Your position updates once a minute to save battery.
• Under every hill — how many people are riding there right now.
• On a hill you're shown only in the "at the hill" counter, without a point. Away from hills — as a point, so you're easy to find.
• Riding mode switches off by itself after an hour without movement.
• See your own path on the map and, after "Stop", a ride summary: distance, time, speed, elevation gain, hills. Only you see your tracks and you delete them yourself; share a picture with the track and hills if you like.

HILLS AND PLACES
• Hills, meeting points, repair shops, fuel stations, shops, fords, dangerous spots, places where rangers or police are on duty.
• Every place has a description, difficulty, directions, parking, a rating and a photo and video gallery.
• Fresh condition marks: "dry", "mud", "closed", "forester" — with author and time.
• Suggest a new place or an edit — an admin reviews and publishes it.
• Get directions in your favourite navigation app.

CHATS
• Every hill has its own room: text, photos, videos up to 60 seconds and voice messages up to 2 minutes.
• Replies and mentions, follow your favourite hills.
• Direct messages to any member.

SOS
• Crashed, broke down, got stuck — hold SOS for 3 seconds and pick a reason.
• Everyone in your city gets an urgent notification, the nearest first, with the distance.
• See who responded "On my way". Without network, SOS is sent as soon as you're back online.
• The app does not replace emergency services: if you're injured, call 112.

CITIES
Minsk, Brest, Vitebsk, Gomel, Grodno, Mogilev — each together with its district. Not near any of them? "Other" shows everything within 100 km around you.

PRIVACY
• Only your crew sees your position, and only in Riding mode. Ride tracks — only you.
• Blocked users don't see each other.
• Reports on messages, photos or people go to the admin.
• Delete your account in the app with one button.

Sign in with Telegram, and on iPhone also with Apple. Russian and English, light and dark theme.

name: English Speaking for Adults
description:
Practise English speaking and conversation in the situations adults really face.

English Speaking for Adults puts you inside short animated episodes: passport control, a hotel check-in, a job interview, a doctor's appointment, a first date, a parents' evening. People talk to you, and you choose what to say. Natural, polite answers move the story on; rude or broken ones show you why they don't work. Every line is voiced, so you train listening and speaking at the same time.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 46 animated conversation episodes, one for every topic, with branching choices
• 11 real-life worlds: travel, city, transport, food, services, home, work, health, people, family, technology
• Find it: hear an English word and find it in a detailed scene
• Which is right: fix the common mistakes adults make
• What do you say: pick the natural reply to everyday English phrases
• Say it: speaking practice with speech recognition
• Vocabulary, listening and phrases for every topic
• A level test to find where to start, and My path to track your progress
• Daily review of your words with spaced repetition

ENGLISH FOR REAL LIFE
Travel English for airports, hotels and taxis. Business English for meetings, interviews and calls. Everyday English for shops, banks, doctors and neighbours. Learn the phrases native speakers actually use.

MADE FOR ADULTS
A calm, clean design without childish cartoons. Short lessons that fit into a coffee break.

name: English Words - Cyber 英単語帳
description:
English Words は、英単語を日本語で調べて覚えるための単語帳アプリです。中学レベルの基本語からビジネス英語まで、公開されている 5 つの単語リストを収録し、コンソール風の画面ですばやく引けます。

■ 5 つの単語帳を切り替え
・CEFR-J Wordlist：A1〜B2 のレベル別 6,865 語。日本の英語学習者向けに作られたリストです
・NGSL：一般的な英文によく出る基本語 2,809 語（頻度順）
・NGSL-Spoken：英会話によく出る 721 語（頻度順）
・TSL：TOEIC Service List。NGSL の次に学ぶ 1,250 語（頻度順）
・BSL：ビジネス英語によく出る 1,744 語（頻度順）
・あわせて 8,000 語以上。設定からいつでも切り替えられます

■ 調べる
・すべての単語に、日本語の意味とくわしい語義を収録
・ほとんどの単語に発音記号を表示。端末の音声で読み上げもできます
・A–Z のインデックスのほか、レベル別・頻度順のグループから探せます
・英単語でも、日本語の意味でも検索できます
・詳細画面を左右にスワイプすると、一覧に戻らずに前後の単語へ進めます

■ 覚える
・単語カード：タップで意味を表示。右にスワイプで「覚えた」、左にスワイプで「まだ」
・4 択クイズ：1 回 10 問。間違えた単語は、終わったあとに見直せます
・グループごとに単語リストを見てから、カードとクイズで確認できます
・「覚えた」単語の数を、単語帳全体とグループごとに表示します
・毎日 1 語の「今日の単語」

■ 自分用に使う
・お気に入り、最近見た単語、単語ごとのメモ
・「覚えた」の記録は、1 語ずつでも、まとめてでも消せます

■ プライバシー
・完全にオフラインで動作します
・アカウント登録、広告、トラッキングはありません。アプリがインターネットに接続することはありません

■ 収録データの出典
・『CEFR-J Wordlist Version 1.6』東京外国語大学 投野由紀夫研究室
・New General Service List 1.2、New General Service List-Spoken 1.2、TOEIC Service List 1.2、Business Service List 1.2（Browne, C., Culligan, B., Phillips, J.／CC BY-SA 4.0）
・日本語の意味：EJDict-hand（パブリックドメイン）ほか
・発音記号：The CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
くわしいクレジットとライセンスは、アプリの「設定」→「出典とライセンス」に表示しています。

TOEIC は ETS の登録商標です。本アプリは ETS の承認や推奨を受けたものではありません。

name: Enhanced Youtube Playlist Play
description:
Repeat Playlist Player for YouTube is a Safari extension that plays a list of YouTube videos in the order you choose, with your own repeat count and speed for each video.
Practising a song, learning a language, studying a lecture or doing a workout? Pick the videos, drag them into order, and tell each one how many times to play and how fast. The extension does the rest, one video after another.

HOW IT WORKS
- Paste a public YouTube playlist link, or pick playlists from a channel, and tick the videos you want.
- Drag videos into your own order.
- Set repeats (1 to 999) and speed (0.25x to 4x) for each video, in a compact table.
- Optionally set a start and end time to play only part of a video.
- Press Play. A small bar on the YouTube page shows progress and has previous, pause, next, stop and full screen buttons.

FEATURES
- Per-video repeats, speed and start/end times
- Several saved lists, each with its own order and settings
- Load a playlist by link, or browse a channel and save several playlists at once
- Full screen that stays on from one video to the next
- Loop the whole list
- Your lists sync between your iPhone, iPad and Mac through iCloud
- Backup and restore

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Playback uses YouTube's own player in Safari, with your own account, so features such as YouTube Premium work as they normally do. The extension never hides, skips or changes ads. It has no analytics, no ads and no server of its own. Your lists stay on your devices and in your iCloud.

TO TURN IT ON
iPhone and iPad: Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions > Repeat Playlist Player, switch it on and allow youtube.com.
Mac: Safari > Settings > Extensions, tick Repeat Playlist Player and allow youtube.com.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube or Google. YouTube is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: EnterCar
description:
EnterCar helps you find a car in China and estimate its total cost with delivery to Moscow.

Browse vehicle listings and photos, search by make and model, and filter by year, mileage, engine power and your budget in rubles. View the estimated landed price and expand the cost breakdown. Save favourites and searches, submit an enquiry and follow its status.

Browsing is available without registration. Vehicle availability and the final purchase price are confirmed before purchase.

name: Enterprise Phone Book
description:
Enterprise Phone Book shows who is calling from your own list of names and numbers, without putting them in Contacts.

Import a CSV or JSON file with your company, club or customer contacts. When someone from the list calls, iPhone shows their name and company on the call screen and in Recents. Your Contacts stay personal: nothing is added to them, so nothing syncs to other accounts or devices.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Import a CSV or JSON file: open it from Files, Mail or AirDrop and choose Enterprise Phone Book, or use Import File in the app.
2. Check the import report: people imported, rows skipped, invalid and shared numbers, with the reason for each problem.
3. Turn on Caller ID: Settings > Apps > Phone > Call Blocking & Identification. Then open the app once, so iOS loads the list.
4. That's it. Calls from numbers on your list show the label you chose.

FEATURES
- CSV import, including files saved from Excel (comma, semicolon or tab; UTF-8 or Windows-1250).
- JSON import in a documented format.
- Sample CSV and JSON files to start from.
- Phone numbers in national or international format, with a default country you can change.
- Caller ID label: choose the fields (first name, last name, company, department, job title) and see a preview of the call screen, the banner and Recents.
- Directory: an A–Z list with search by name, company or part of a number.
- Person card: call, copy a number, or write an email with one tap.
- Lookup: type a number and see what iPhone will show for it.
- Delete All Data: one button removes the phone book from the app and asks iOS to clear the Caller ID list.

PRIVACY
- No account, no sign-in.
- No network access, no analytics, no ads.
- No access to your Contacts.
- Your phone book stays on your iPhone. The app itself doesn't send it over the internet.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Contacts come first: if a number is saved in Contacts, iPhone shows the Contacts name, not the label from this app.
- Caller ID works only after you turn it on in Settings and open the app.
- The list is stored on the iPhone. To update it, import a newer file.
- Works for regular phone calls. Calls in messaging and video calling apps are not identified.
- The app is in English.

name: ESG Capstone Studio: SG Coach
description:
ESG Capstone Studio walks you through a complete ESG integration project in five sessions, from the first problem statement to a Board-ready presentation. It is built for professional learners in Singapore: sustainability course participants, career switchers and managers preparing a capstone, case study or assessment.

Every number comes from fixed, explainable rules that run on your device. There is no AI and no account, so you can show an assessor exactly how each score was reached.

HOW IT WORKS
• Case company: roll a fictional case company by sector and listing, enter the company you were assigned, or load the worked example (Meridian Precision Components, a fictional SGX-listed manufacturer) to see a finished capstone first.
• Session 1, Problem definition: organisation profile, ESG baseline with data gaps marked honestly, stakeholder map and SMART objectives.
• Session 2, Double materiality: impact and financial scores start from sector priors and you adjust each one with a rationale. A live matrix shows which topics are double material at your threshold.
• Session 3, Framework selection: a weighted decision matrix across ISSB (IFRS S1/S2), GRI, SASB, TCFD, ESRS, SBTi, CDP, TNFD and Integrated Reporting, with a ranking, a suggested reporting architecture and a topic-to-disclosure map.
• Session 4, Implementation plan: Gantt roadmap, KPIs with quality checks, RACI, budget, risk list and a business case with NPV, IRR and payback under a rising Singapore carbon price.
• Session 5, Presentation: a greenwashing screen across your whole portfolio, a competency self-assessment and a deck checklist.

DELIVERABLES
• Slide deck built from your sessions, with live charts, speaker notes and presenter mode. Export to PowerPoint.
• Q&A rehearsal: questions a Board chair, a CFO and an ESG assessor are likely to ask, with space to draft your answers.
• Final portfolio that pulls every session into one document. Save it as Word or Markdown.

SINGAPORE CONTEXT
