SGX Listing Rules 711A/711B, ISSB-based climate reporting, the carbon tax and the Singapore Green Plan 2030 are built into the priors, prompts and examples.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your project stays on your device. No sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Save file creates a project copy you can move to another device or hand in, and Open file restores it.
• Only the PowerPoint export needs an internet connection, to load the open-source library that builds the file.

PLEASE NOTE
ESG Capstone Studio is a learning and practice tool, not professional, legal or investment advice. Carbon prices and financial results come from the assumptions you enter. Check current rules before using any figure in real reporting.

Support: esg-capstone-studio.floot.app/support

name: Esunsl
description: EsunslThis tool is designed for recording personal income, expenses, transfers, and refunds. You can enter amounts, select categories and accounts, and—when necessary—split a single transaction across multiple categories. If you record transactions on two separate devices, you can import the ledger files, review the consolidated account balances, and then verify any potential duplicates, conflicting amounts, or related entries. Confirmed items can be saved, while unresolved entries can be set aside for later handling. Transfers retain their respective actual dates, and refunds can be linked back to the original payments. When back-dating historical entries, you can monitor changes in month-end balances and reconciliation discrepancies. The history of merged ledgers preserves the details of each submission, with support for previewing and undoing changes by group. Additionally, charts allow you to visualize monthly income and expenses, the composition of your spending, balance trends, and the destination of refunds.

name: Event Media Tech Backstage
description:
Backstage is the crew app for Event Media Tech technicians.

• My Schedule. See every shift you're booked on, with the venue, address, notes and one-tap directions.
• Open Shifts. Browse open shifts in your markets and positions. Pick one up instantly or request it, depending on the shift.
• Your pay. See your rate and the pay breakdown for each shift: regular, overtime, double time and extras.
• Shift alerts. If a shift you're booked on changes or is canceled, you'll know right away.
• Messages. Get announcements and updates from the office, with a notification so you don't miss them.
• Questions about a shift? Call or text the office straight from the shift.

Backstage is for technicians on the Event Media Tech roster. Sign in with the mobile number we have on file for you. Office staff sign in with their Event Media Tech email to build and publish the schedule.

There's no public sign-up. Questions? Call (888) 577-9955 or email info@eventmediatech.com.

name: Fabivo
description:
Fabivo is a woodshop planner for iPhone and iPad with an AI assistant that does the work for you. Talk to it or type to it like a shop partner: "build me a closet, eighty inches wide", "add twelve parts, 23 by 15 inches, in white melamine", "quote this, a sheet costs 65 dollars". The assistant changes the model and the cut list, and you can undo each change.

ASK WITH YOUR VOICE
Tap the microphone and speak. Fabivo writes what you said into the message field; you check it and send it. Use it to describe a piece of furniture, dictate a parts list or give the price of your sheets.

FROM A PHOTO TO FURNITURE
Take a photo or pick a picture of a piece of furniture and say what you want: "copy this closet, 95 inches wide, 106 high and 20 deep" or "build this unit without the table in the middle". The assistant builds the model from real boards and tells you which sizes it estimated from the photo, so you can check them.

DESIGN IN 2D AND 3D
Check the piece on the dimensioned drawing and in 3D, open the doors and drawers, and change any board by hand or with a sentence. Fabivo checks that the piece is joined and supported, and tells you when something does not fit.

CUT LIST AND OPTIMIZED SHEETS
Make the cut list from the model, or type or dictate your parts. Fabivo lays the parts out on your sheets with the saw kerf and edge trim you set, and tells you how many sheets you need and how much is left over. Results depend on your parts, material and settings.

A QUOTE FOR YOUR CUSTOMER
Give the assistant your sheet prices and it works out the material cost. In Quotation, add labor, delivery, margin and tax, and make a PDF with your business details to send to your customer. Only you see the costs and the margin.

GUIDED CUTTING
Follow the cut order sheet by sheet: the size of each cut, the part it releases and what is left. Mark each cut as done and pick up where you stopped.

STEP-BY-STEP ASSEMBLY
For supported models, follow the assembly steps with diagrams, placement dimensions and the hardware list, and print the instructions or save them as a PDF.

YOUR PROJECTS STAY ON YOUR DEVICE
Projects are saved on your iPhone or iPad. Save a copy to Files or send it with the iOS share sheet. After the first launch, Fabivo opens without a connection; the AI assistant needs the internet.

UNITS AND LANGUAGES
Millimeters, centimeters or inches. English, Spanish and Dutch.

ABOUT THE AI ASSISTANT
The assistant sends your messages, the open model, the cut list and the photos you attach to our server and to OpenAI to answer. Before the first use it explains this and asks for your consent. The assistant has a daily usage limit.

Check sizes, materials, joints and hardware before you build. Fabivo's guidance does not replace your own judgment or shop safety practice.

name: Face-Off Arcade: Table Duels
description:
Face-Off Arcade: Table Duels app turns one phone into a tabletop game for two. Lay the phone flat between you, one player at each end, and play three original games built for sharing a single screen. Each player gets their own big touch pads, score and rules, and the top half is turned 180° so it reads the right way up from both sides.

THREE GAMES, THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Heat Tug (Versus): tap PUSH to shove a glowing core into your opponent's end. Every tap adds heat; keep your meter in the green sweet spot for double power, but hit the red and you overheat and are locked out for 1.5 seconds. First to 3 rounds wins.
• Brain Snap (Fast fun): a colour word appears in a different ink. Read the rule, then be first to tap the right colour, either the ink or the colour the word names. A right tap scores +1, a wrong or early tap costs −1 and a short lockout. First to 7 wins.
• Twin Beat (Co-op): notes slide toward each of you. Tap your pad as a note lands in your glowing box and build a combo together. Gold notes arrive on both sides at once, so hit them together for a SYNC bonus. Misses drain your shared bond bar: you win or lose as a team.

MADE FOR SHARING ONE SCREEN
• Every rule screen and result is shown twice, once for each player
• Both players tap I'M READY before a game starts
• Large thumb-sized controls at each end, and no scrolling or zooming during play
• Sound effects with a mute button, How to play and Home buttons on both sides

GOOD FOR
Friends, couples, siblings and parents with kids: a quick round at the café table, on the train, or while you wait. Rounds take one to two minutes.

FREE AND PRIVATE
Free to play, with no ads, no in-app purchases and no account. The app collects no data and needs no sign-in.

name: FactorFold
description: See how multiplication works, then practice the facts that still make you pause. Factor Fold turns the 1–9 times tables into a map you can tap. Open any fact to count its dots, split it into smaller groups, or flip the factors and see why the total stays the same. Try short, untimed drills with all tables or a single row. Missed facts go into Review and leave after two correct answers in a row. Activity shows which fact families you have tried and how your rounds went. Everything works offline, with no account, ads, or tracking.

name: FairSquad
description:
FairSquad helps coaches, organizers, and players create balanced teams and run smooth mini-tournaments right from the sideline — completely offline with no sign-in required.

BALANCED TEAMS IN SECONDS
• Build your roster with player names, skill ratings (1–10), and positions (Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder, Forward)
• Choose your team count or get smart recommendations based on available players and courts
• Automatic skill balancing across teams, including fair handling when teams have uneven sizes
• Drag and drop players between teams whenever you want to make quick manual tweaks

LEAGUE & CUP SCHEDULING (1–4 COURTS)
• Choose League (round-robin) with optional final and 3rd-place match, or Knockout Cup bracket
• Automatic match scheduling across 1 to 4 courts and rounds
• Enter scores live and follow updated standings (W, D, L, GD, Pts) or bracket progression in real time

SHARE, IMPORT & EXPORT
• Export the entire tournament (teams, match schedule, and standings) as a clean, shareable PDF
• Export and import team rosters as JSON or CSV via Files, Share Sheet, or URL

BUILT FOR THE PITCH
• 100% local on-device storage — no accounts, no ads, and no tracking
• Switch anytime between English and Norwegian, Light/Dark theme, and two layout styles

name: Far Signal
description:
This is a game app in the ‘choose-your-own-adventure’ style.
Your decisions determine the fate of the characters.
Quick decisions will determine their fate.

name: Feltgate: Slide Puzzle
description:
Soft slides. Clever little escapes.

Make a little room, find a clear path, and slide the berry-colored Key through the gate. Feltgate turns a classic sliding-block puzzle into a quiet world of soft felt, stitched edges, and satisfying moves.

200 PUZZLES, YOUR OWN PACE
Follow the Classic Route through six chapters. Start with a simple slide, then discover boards that ask you to think a few moves ahead. There is no timer in Classic, so take your time and enjoy the moment when everything clicks.

A LITTLE RUSH
Ready to race the clock? Jump straight into Gate Rush: ten timed challenges, all available from the start. Explore larger boards, different exits, and mirrored cycles in a deep night-felt palette. Each challenge gives you 3 to 4.5 minutes to free the Key. Pause whenever you need a break.

ROOM TO EXPERIMENT
Undo a move, restart a board, or ask for a free hint. Hints highlight a useful panel and direction, leaving the next slide to you. Clear a board to earn stars, then return to match the target in fewer moves. Match or beat the target without hints for three stars.

A GAME THAT FITS YOUR DAY
- Play every puzzle offline.
- Enjoy an ad-free experience with no in-app purchases.
- Start playing without an account.
- Keep progress and unfinished boards saved on your device.
- Choose sound, haptics, and grid-line settings.
- Play on iPhone or iPad.

One small slide. A little more space.

name: Fibre : muscu à la maison
description:
Fibre prépare tes séances de musculation à la maison, avec le matériel que tu as vraiment.

Tu indiques ton niveau, tes objectifs (muscle, force, tonification, cardio : coche-en plusieurs si tu veux) et ton matériel : haltères, élastiques, banc ou pas, barre de traction ou pas. Fibre ne te propose que des exercices faisables chez toi. Sans banc, rien d'incliné ni d'assis sur banc.

SÉANCE DU JOUR
• Un programme suivi jour après jour : Full Body, Haut/Bas, Push-Pull-Legs, Fessiers & Jambes, Bras & Épaules, Express 20 min
• Près de 300 exercices dessinés : départ et arrivée alternent pour montrer le mouvement
• Supersets, échange d'un exercice en un geste, séries et reps ajustables
• Objectif cardio : un finisher en intervalles termine la séance, avec une version sans saut

PENDANT LA SÉANCE
• Charge et reps saisies en deux touches
• Minuteur de repos, avec notification si l'iPhone est verrouillé
• Tes perfs de la dernière fois et une suggestion de progression
• Le repos s'affiche aussi sur l'écran verrouillé, et un widget montre ta séance du jour

TON CORPS, TES PRIORITÉS
• Touche un muscle sur le schéma du corps : il s'allume et Fibre le travaille en priorité

SUIVI
• Régularité sur 16 semaines
• Séries par muscle comparées à la zone efficace de 10 à 20 par semaine
• Records et courbe de 1RM estimé par exercice

SAVOIR
• 13 articles sourcés : fibres musculaires, volume, RIR, repos, progression, récupération
• Une fiche pour chacun des 17 muscles

HORS LIGNE, SANS COMPTE
Pas de compte, pas de pub, pas de suivi. Tout reste sur ton iPhone et fonctionne sans connexion.

Et un hamster qui s'entraîne avec toi.

Dessins d'exercices : Everkinetic (CC BY-SA 4.0) et dessins Fibre.

name: FileToys - PDF / File Tools
description:
FileToys – PDF, Word & Video Converter

**Convert PDF to Word, merge PDF files, split documents, compress videos, and edit files — all in one app!**

Stop switching between multiple apps. FileToys brings powerful PDF tools, document conversion, image editing, and video compression to your iPhone and iPad.

### PDF Editor & Converter
• Convert PDF to Word, images, and other supported formats
• Convert Word documents and photos to PDF
• Merge multiple PDFs into one document
• Split PDF files and extract selected pages
• Compress PDF files to reduce file size
• Rotate, reorder, and delete PDF pages
• Add watermarks to protect and personalize files

### Word & Document Tools
• Convert Word to PDF
• Create PDF files from text and documents
• Extract text from PDF documents
• Organize, rename, and manage files
• Convert and process multiple files in batches

### Video Converter & Compressor
• Compress videos to save storage space
• Convert videos to supported formats
• Trim and edit video clips
• Add watermarks to videos
• Extract audio from videos
• Reduce video file size for easier sharing

### Image Converter & Editor
• Convert JPG, PNG, HEIC, WEBP, and PDF
• Compress photos without unnecessary quality loss
• Resize, crop, rotate, and flip images
• Convert multiple photos to PDF
• Remove image metadata for privacy

### Fast, Offline & Private
• Works offline without an internet connection
• Files stay on your iPhone or iPad
• No cloud uploads or accounts required
• Process single files or entire batches
• Save to Photos or Files, or share instantly

**FileToys makes PDF conversion, document editing, video compression, and file management simple, fast, and private.**

Free PDF, image, and document tools. Advanced video and audio features available.

Questions or suggestions? Contact us through Support.

name: FilterLedger
description: Keep track of when you changed household filters. Name a filter, enter its last replacement date, and choose a service interval in months. FilterLedger calculates the next replacement date and shows when the entered schedule is overdue. Save each replacement, add notes, and find past entries without an account. The app calculates dates and keeps a log. It does not send reminders.

name: Firebird Members
description:
Firebird Members is the home for people who keep coming back to The Firebird Project, the theater & games company behind Help Me!!!!, Liar's Night, and other unpredictable live experiences.

Your member card lives here. Flip it over at the door and we'll scan you in. When a show goes up, you can claim your $10 ticket in the app. When we're hosting something just for members, you can RSVP here.

Membership is $10 a month and you sign up on our website, my.firebird.nyc. Join us, so you can be the next to say "you had to be there."

name: First Baseball Life
description:
Play a baseball career from your first day on a high school team to your last game as a pro. The BALL you earn across careers helps you develop your next player.

Read the pitch and time your swing as a hitter, or take the mound and choose your pitch and location. Enter the draft after high school or sharpen your skills in college first.

One purchase includes the full offline game, with no ads or in-app purchases. Careers are saved on your iPhone. Export a backup to Files to continue on another iPhone.

name: First Puppy Life
description:
The food bowl is empty again. Your pup is still licking it. Is that a hint about the little corgi you just brought home?

Spend 44 weeks together, one decision at a time. Plan walks, play and training around your work schedule. Choose what to feed your pup and when you both need a quiet week. On a tight budget, even a trip to the vet can change your plans.

Get to know one of six personalities through everyday moments. Fill a photo album, keep little souvenirs and look back on the choices that led to one of 16 endings.

One purchase includes the full game. Play offline, with no ads or in-app purchases. Available in English, Korean and Japanese.

name: Flacron Energy
description:
Flacron Energy replaces paper-based inspection, maintenance and safety workflows for industrial field teams in oil and gas, energy, utilities, mining, manufacturing, chemical and EPC operations.

FOR THE FIELD
• Scan an asset's QR code to open its record, history and open work.
• Run inspections with photos, video and notes, and keep working when the connection drops — changes sync when you are back online.
• Pick up assigned work orders, record what was done and close them out.
• Raise safety reports and follow permit-to-work steps from your phone.

FOR OPERATIONS AND HSE
• Role-aware dashboard with key figures for your sites.
• Asset register with status set by your team.
• Advisory AI that helps review photos and draft reports. AI output is advisory only and is always reviewed by a qualified person.
• Generate reports in PDF, Word and Excel.

BUILT FOR ENTERPRISE
• Company workspaces with roles such as Company Admin, Operations Manager, Field Inspector, Maintenance Technician, HSE Manager and Executive.
• Every record is scoped to your company.
• Two-step verification for sign-in.

Flacron Energy is used with a company account. Sign in with the account your organisation set up for you.

Terms of Use: https://www.flacronenergy.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.flacronenergy.com/privacy

Flacron Energy supports, but does not replace, your site's safety procedures, permits and the judgement of qualified personnel.

name: FlipSide: The Fracture
description:
FlipSide is a tactical card MOBA inspired by everyone’s favorite classic game: rock, paper, scissors.

Choose your cards in secret, reveal together and push toward your opponent’s base. Capture two of three lanes to win.

READ YOUR RIVAL
Slash, Guard and Feint counter one another for bonus power. Your card’s strength and abilities determine who wins each battle.

BUILD YOUR DECK
Choose 30 unique cards using up to two combat archetypes. Combine Vanguard, Bastion, Mindveil and Pyrebrand cards to create your own strategy.

FIGHT ACROSS THE FRACTURE
Adapt to three changing lanes, draft jungle buffs every third round and defend your territory with Home Turf Advantage.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Learn in the guided tutorial, practice solo or compete in casual, ranked and private online matches.

Online matches require an internet connection. Steam is not required on iPhone.

name: Folio Pair
description:
Folio Pair keeps one sewing order on this iPhone.

Tap one folio, then tap another to swap their places. The named folio is the first whose running sheet count passes the needle reach.

Change the reach and every folio stays in its place. The name can move to another folio. Export writes a text file of the current order from this iPhone.

Folios and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Folio: Keepsake Journal
description:
Folio: Keepsake Journal (Folio: Lưu Bút) is a notebook for the words you love: quotes, proverbs, memories and keepsake pages, arranged in a bookshelf of your own and read by turning real-feeling pages.

TURN PAGES LIKE A REAL BOOK
A smooth 3D page curl you can drag from a corner or the middle, with a soft paper sound and light haptics (both optional).

A BEAUTIFUL LIBRARY AND BOOKCASE
Every book has its own cover: cute, classic, or your own photo. Put your books on an oak, walnut or frosted-glass shelf.

WRITE, IMPORT AND EXPORT
- Write new pages: quotes, proverbs or long entries, with author names.
- Import from Google Docs, Word, Markdown or PDF. The app splits text into comfortable pages without losing a word.
- Export a book to Markdown to back it up or share it.

DECORATE EVERY PAGE
Turn photos into stickers on-device, place and arrange them freely. Insert pictures and the text flows around them. Long-press a sticker to edit or remove it.

COMFORTABLE READING
Choose text size, font and paper colour per page or per book. Optional soft piano music while you read.

LIQUID-GLASS DESIGN
Light, dark or automatic, with many wallpapers. Add your name and Folio greets you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your device.

The app is in Vietnamese.

For anyone who loves keeping a good sentence, a memory or a keepsake page, and wants to read them beautifully.

name: Foodie Companion
description:
**Foodie Companion — Your Personal Restaurant Journal**

Remember every great meal, discover your favorites, and keep your dining experiences organized in one convenient place.

Whether you're traveling, exploring restaurants close to home, or remembering that unforgettable meal from your last vacation, Foodie Companion makes it easy to capture and revisit your dining experiences.

**SAVE YOUR DINING MEMORIES**
- Record restaurants you've visited around the world.
- Save restaurant names, locations, and personal ratings.
- Add comments about your dining experiences.
- Capture photos or upload pictures from your photo library.
- Keep track of restaurant pricing and other useful details.

**ORGANIZE YOUR FAVORITES**
- Mark your favorite restaurants for easy reference.
- Pin important listings.
- Search and filter your restaurant collection.
- Sort restaurants by name, rating, price, or date.
- Hide listings without permanently deleting them.

**SHARE YOUR RECOMMENDATIONS**
Found an amazing restaurant? Share your recommendations with friends and family through your device's available sharing options.

Choose whether to include your rating, comments, or photos before sharing.

**PERFECT FOR TRAVELERS AND FOOD LOVERS**
From neighborhood cafés to memorable restaurants abroad, Foodie Companion helps you build your own personal collection of dining experiences.

Your restaurant journal travels with you, making it easy to remember where you've been and which places deserve another visit.

**Your meals. Your memories. Your Foodie Companion.**

name: For Free: Give & Get
description:
Everything here is free. Really.

For Free is the simplest way to give things a second home. Post what you no longer need - a sofa, a box of books, kids' clothes, a TV, even a car - and someone nearby picks it up. No prices, no fees, no selling. Every item on For Free is a gift.

FIND FREE THINGS NEAR YOU
Open Explore and see what people are giving away around you, closest first. Filter by category - home, cars, stays, furniture, books, electronics, clothes - or look everywhere, in any country.

GIVE SOMETHING AWAY
Add up to five photos, a title, a category and where it can be picked up. It takes about a minute, and everything stays free. When your gift finds a new home, mark it taken with one tap.

CONTACT THE GIVER DIRECTLY
Tap WhatsApp, Call or Email right on the listing. No in-app chat to check, no middleman - you talk to the giver the way you already talk to people.

NEED IT DELIVERED?
Too big to carry? Approved local delivery companies list their vehicles and service areas right on the listing, nearby ones first.

SAFE AND RESPECTED
Report anything that breaks the rules - reports are reviewed within 24 hours - and hide any giver you don't want to see again. Your photos and details stay yours, and you can delete your account and everything in it at any time.

Sign in with Apple or Google only when you post or manage your items; browsing needs no account at all.

Give what you don't need. Find what you do. All of it, for free.

name: Founder CardVault
description:
Founder CardVault turns the business cards you collect into contacts you can actually find again.

SCAN AND REVIEW
Point your camera at a card, or import a photo. Card text is read on your iPhone, and you check every field before you save. Add the back of the card too.

ORGANIZE
Sort contacts into groups like Startup, Corporate, Investor, or Community. Add notes, search by name or company, and browse by the day you met.

MY CARD
Create your own card once. Anyone can scan its QR code with their iPhone camera to save your details — no app needed on their side.

SHARE A CONTACT
Show a QR code for any saved contact. If the other person has Founder CardVault, it opens there; if not, they can add it straight to their phone’s Contacts. 
Optionally include the card photo: it’s encrypted on your iPhone and expires after 24 hours.

EXPORT
Export your contacts as a CSV file, or send them to a spreadsheet in your own Google Drive.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account to create. No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your contacts stay on your iPhone unless you choose to share or export them.

name: Frontrow: Voice Isolation
description:
Turn any seat in the room into the front row.

Frontrow is a private, offline audio recorder built to capture clear speech in real rooms—lectures, conferences, meetings, interviews, cafés, and panels—without cloud uploads, accounts, or robotic over-processing.

Record in raw 48 kHz lossless audio using your iPhone’s built-in directional microphones, let Frontrow isolate speech completely on-device, and smoothly dial in the exact balance between the speaker and the room.

CAPTURE CLEAN FROM THE START
• Two Studio Mic Modes: Choose Table mode (360° bottom mic) for roundtables and everyday meetings, or Stage mode (directional back mic) to focus on a distant speaker across the hall.
• Raw 48 kHz / 24-bit Lossless: Captures pure, uncolored audio in ALAC with a live waveform and calibrated dBFS headroom meter—no destructive effects baked in.
• Import Existing Recordings: Bring in Voice Memos or audio files from Files to isolate and mix them with the exact same engine.

100% OFFLINE VOICE ISOLATION
• On-Device AI: Strips away air-conditioning hum, crowd murmur, echo, and background distractions right on your iPhone.
• Lock-Screen Background Cleaning: Hit stop, lock your phone, and put it in your pocket—Frontrow finishes isolating automatically in the background with live progress on your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
• Powered by the open-source Inworld Voice Isolator model (Apache-2.0), running entirely offline on Apple Silicon.

NON-DESTRUCTIVE MIXING — NEVER ROBOTIC
• Room ↔ Front Row Slider: Unlike blunt one-switch noise removers, Frontrow keeps voice and room separate so you can blend smoothly between Room, Natural, and Front Row—keeping audience warmth or isolating pure speech whenever you want.
• Voice Boost Without Clipping: Automatically lifts quiet across-the-room speakers to a comfortable listening level while protecting loud peaks cleanly.
• Instant Mix / Raw Compare: Flip between your mix and the untouched original recording in a single tap to hear the difference immediately.
• Scrubbable Waveform & Speed Control: Drag directly across the waveform with a live timestamp preview and adjust playback speed effortlessly.

EXPORT ANYWHERE
• Save your Current Mix, Isolated Voice, or Original Raw recording.
• Export in compact 48 kHz M4A (256 kbps AAC) or studio-grade 24-bit WAV straight to the iOS Share Sheet, Files, AirDrop, or your favorite editor.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• 100% Offline: Your meetings, lectures, and conversations never leave your iPhone.
• No Accounts. No Cloud Uploads. No Tracking.

name: FTG Sports
description:
FTG Sports is the home of the FTG games. It starts with Diamond Gauntlet: a baseball card battler you play solo, one run at a time.

NINE INNINGS. ALWAYS A COMEBACK.
Every inning starts behind. Your lineup steps up one batter at a time. Play cards to shift the odds, then Swing. Score enough runs before the outs run out and the next inning waits, harder than the last.

BEND THE GROUND RULES
Before the first pitch, pick a Ground Rule that changes how the game plays. Earn more as you go. Hold up to five at once and build a run around them.

THE CLUBHOUSE
Between innings, spend your coins. Add players to your crew, train them, swap gear, and trim your deck. Every choice carries into the next inning.

PLAY ANYWHERE
- Offline play: a run needs no connection. Your run saves on the device, so you can stop and pick it up later.
- Light and dark modes that follow your device, or set them yourself.
- No account and no sign-in.

PUBLIC LEADERBOARD
Finish a run and post your score with a nickname you choose. The leaderboard shows only nicknames and scores. Share a score card with your friends.

TELL US WHAT YOU THINK
Found a bug or have an idea? Send feedback from inside the game. We read every note.

Your privacy: analytics are anonymous and you can turn them off on the Title screen.

name: Fuja da IA
description:
Você é um(a) Dev em corrida contra o tempo: a Inteligência Artificial está avançando linha por linha e só há uma regra — faça o deploy rápido ou seja substituído!

Em Fuja da IA, você desvia de tráfego intenso, trens expressos, rios com troncos móveis e racks de servidores em um mundo voxel retrô cheio de humor do universo de tecnologia e programação.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS:

- Jogabilidade Arcade Instantânea: Toque para avançar ou deslize para qualquer direção com resposta rápida e controles fluidos em 60 FPS.
- Três Níveis de Desafio: Escolha entre os modos JÚNIOR, PLENO e SÊNIOR, cada um com velocidade e ritmo próprios da IA perseguidora.
- 7 Skins Voxel Exclusivas: Ganhe cafés a cada linha avançada para desbloquear novos personagens na Loja de Devs:
  * Dev Clássico
  * Dev Front-end
  * Dev Home Office
  * Dev Hacker / Cyberpunk
  * DevOps & Cloud
  * Dev Sênior Café-Dependente
  * Cientista de IA
- Derrotas como Erros HTTP: Cada colisão gera uma exceção clássica de desenvolvimento, como HTTP 409 (Conflict), HTTP 503 (Service Unavailable), HTTP 404 (Platform Not Found), HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) e HTTP 416 (Range Not Satisfiable).
- Tela de Novo Recorde + Compartilhamento: Superou seu melhor placar? Comemore com destaque animado do seu personagem e compartilhe o print da conquista com seus amigos.
- Top 10 Ranking Local: Acompanhe suas melhores marcas separadas por dificuldade e compare com os bots do sistema.
- Áudio Retrô Completo: Trilha sonora chiptune em loop e efeitos sonoros arcade, com opção de configurar trilha, som e vibração separadamente.

Quanto tempo você consegue sobreviver antes do próximo erro fatal? Baixe agora e comece sua fuga!

name: Funke Academy
description:
Welcome to Olufunke Academy: a learning community for healthy relationships, strong marriages and a purposeful life.

Whether you're single, preparing for marriage, newly married or many years into your journey, Olufunke Academy walks with you. Men and women alike can take programmes from Olufunke Adetuberu and her facilitators, designed to help you grow in faith, love and purpose, at home, in your relationships, at work and in ministry.

PROGRAMMES FOR EVERY STAGE
• Preparing for marriage? Build a strong foundation before you say "I do"
• Already married? Grow deeper together and strengthen your home
• Single? Discover your purpose and prepare for the relationships ahead
• Programmes for men, women and couples

LEARN AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Watch video lessons whenever it suits you, and pick up right where you left off
• Read lesson notes and download the resources that come with each lesson
• Save the resources you want to come back to

JOIN LIVE SESSIONS
• See upcoming live sessions and Q&As with facilitators
• Add sessions to your calendar so you never miss one
• Get reminders before each session begins

GROW TOGETHER
• Join the community to ask questions, share what you're learning and encourage one another
• Start conversations and take part in topics with others on the same journey

COMPLETE ASSIGNMENTS
• Submit your assignments from your phone
• Receive feedback and track how you're doing

BE CELEBRATED
• Follow your progress through every programme
• Earn a certificate of completion when you finish, with a code anyone can use to verify it

STAY IN THE LOOP
• Notifications for new lessons, live sessions, assignment feedback and announcements

Your account works on up to three devices, and your progress follows you wherever you sign in.

The Olufunke Academy app is for learners with a place on one of the academy's programmes. Sign in with the account the academy has set up for you.

name: Furqany
description:
فرقاني مصحف بروايتي ورش عن نافع وحفص عن عاصم، بصفحات المصحف كما طُبعت.

• القراءة: 604 صفحة لكل رواية، تُقلَّب من اليمين إلى اليسار، مع الأحزاب والأثمان.
• التلاوة: استمع إلى القرّاء آيةً بعد آية، أو سورةً كاملة.
• التفسير: اضغط مطوّلًا على آية لقراءة تفسيرها أو نسخها أو حفظ موضعها.
• العلامات: احفظ موضع قراءتك وعُد إليه متى شئت.
• الأذكار: الأذكار مع مصادرها.
• اليوم: التاريخ الهجري، وتذكير بصيام الاثنين والخميس والأيام البيض، وبالصلاة على النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم وسورة الكهف يوم الجمعة.
• دون إنترنت: نزّل صفحات المصحف والتلاوات لتقرأ وتستمع دون اتصال، مع حجم كل تنزيل قبل بدئه.
• القراءة الليلية: لون هادئ للصفحة يريح العين.

بلا إعلانات.

name: Ga3da: Party Games
description:
Gathering (گعدة) is where your friends get together for quick party games, whether you're on the same sofa or each at home.

Open a room, share its code, and everyone's in within seconds.

• Private rooms: create a room and invite friends with a six-character code, a link or a QR code.
• On the same Wi-Fi? Your room shows up for friends nearby, no typing needed.
• Round after round: when a game ends, play again in the same room with the same seats.
• Results and medals: see who won every round, and look back at your play history.
• Tournaments: run a knockout or a league and follow the bracket until a champion is crowned.
• Friends: add friends by their @handle, see who's online, and invite them to your room.
• Friends' leaderboards: find out who's best at each game.
• Notifications: invitations and friend requests reach you even when the app is closed.
• Arabic first, in dark and light.

Sign in with your phone number, or with Apple or Google. Your number is never shown to other players, and you can delete your account from the app at any time.

Gathering is free, with no ads.

name: Garantaro AI: Warranty Wallet
description:
When your headphones stop working, find the receipt, the seller and the warranty end date in one place. Add a photo of the product so you can spot it at a glance.

Photograph a receipt or open a PDF. The optional AI model looks for products, prices, purchase dates and warranty periods. Review what it found before saving. If a period is missing, you can use your own default. Once downloaded, the model reads receipts on your device, even offline.

Set reminders before warranties expire, check upcoming dates in a widget and share a receipt when you need it. You can also back up your records or export the list as a CSV file.

name: Geist Energy
description:
Geist Energy | Fichas Digitales de Mantenimiento

Geist Energy es una aplicación diseñada para digitalizar y simplificar el registro de los trabajos de mantenimiento técnico, reemplazando los formularios tradicionales en papel por fichas digitales.

Nuestra plataforma permite documentar las intervenciones de mantenimiento de manera organizada, facilitando el registro de la información técnica y mejorando la trazabilidad de los servicios realizados.

Digitalización del mantenimiento

La aplicación está orientada a optimizar el proceso de elaboración de fichas de mantenimiento, permitiendo registrar las actividades realizadas de forma clara, estructurada y profesional.

Principales beneficios

• Digitalización de fichas de mantenimiento técnico.

• Registro organizado de intervenciones y trabajos realizados.

• Estandarización de la documentación de mantenimiento.

• Reducción del uso de formularios físicos.

• Mayor claridad y organización de la información técnica.

• Optimización de los procesos de registro en terreno.

Diseñada para el trabajo técnico

Geist Energy facilita la documentación de servicios de mantenimiento, ofreciendo una solución digital práctica para el registro de las actividades ejecutadas.

Tecnología aplicada al mantenimiento

Nuestro objetivo es impulsar la transformación digital de los procesos técnicos mediante herramientas que contribuyan a una gestión documental más eficiente, ordenada y profesional.

Geist Energy
Ingeniería, tecnología e innovación aplicada al mantenimiento.

Desarrollado por Servicios de Ingeniería Geist SpA.

name: Ghana Vouchers
description:
Ghana Vouchers is the fastest way to buy WAEC results checker vouchers in Ghana.

• Buy WASSCE, NOVDEC and BECE results checker vouchers
• Pay safely with Mobile Money through Hubtel
• Get your serial number and PIN by SMS instantly
• Add an email to receive a PDF copy
• Bulk prices when you buy 10 or more
• Lost your SMS? Retrieve your vouchers with your MoMo transaction ID
• Sign in to see all your orders, show or copy PINs, and send vouchers to another number
• Light and dark mode

Need help? Contact us on WhatsApp or by email from the Help tab, any time.

name: Gianz Coaching
description:
VisionFit è la piattaforma che ti consente di avere tutte le funzionalità inerenti al coaching e al coaching online. Potrai interagire con me per ricevere feedback utili sul tuo programma di allenamento, monitorare i tuoi progressi e condividerli velocizzando i tempi e avendo tutto direttamente sul tuo smartphone.

Con VisionFit potrai:

• Consultare il tuo programma tenendo traccia degli allenamenti completati e quelli da fare.
• Accedere ad una libreria digitale aggiornata contenente i video di tutti gli esercizi da eseguire.
• Restare in contatto con me tramite Chat.
• Caricare foto dei tuoi progressi fisici nel tempo.
• Monitorare i tuoi progressi registrando o aggiungendo le tue metriche (peso, massimali, ecc…).
• Tenere sempre a portata di mano consigli per la tua nutrizione.

Tutto in un’unica app!
Non ti resta che chiedermi l’invito per poter iniziare ad usufruire dei vantaggi dell’app.

name: Global Quran: Read & Listen
description:
Global Quran is a calm, beautiful Quran reader for your phone, tablet and computer.

READ
- The full Arabic text in a mushaf-style page with optional tajweed colours (madd, ghunnah, qalqalah and more)
- 100+ translations and transliterations, shown verse by verse
- Four ways to read: Read, Understand (translation first), Listen and Memorise
- Day and night themes, adjustable text size

LISTEN
- Verse-by-verse recitation with repeat and loop for memorisation
- Follow along as each verse is highlighted

OFFLINE
- Save any of the 114 surahs, text and audio, to read and listen on a plane or with no signal
- See how much space the offline library uses and manage it in one place

SAVE AND SYNC (optional)
- Save verses and keep your place
- Sign in with Google, Apple or email to resume where you stopped on any device
- You never have to sign in to read

PRIVATE
- No ads. No tracking across other apps or sites
- Anonymous usage statistics only if you allow them
- Delete your account and data from inside the app

Global Quran is part of GlobalQuran.com, built and maintained since 2006.

name: Golden A/S Employee
description:
Golden A/S Employee is the app of the staff of Golden Automation Systems (Golden A/S), the marine electrical, automation and navigation systems integrator based in Keratsini, Greece, with branches in Italy and the Netherlands.

An employee account issued by Golden A/S is required. The app is a companion to the Golden A/S portal and is not intended for the general public.

With it every employee can:
• clock in and out at the start and end of work; the position is taken once, at that moment, and is not tracked in between
• see the leave balances of the year: entitled, taken, pending, available
• ask for leave, by day or by hour, with a reason and a supporting document
• join a company leave period, such as the Christmas closure
• follow each request: waiting for the manager, waiting for HR, approved or rejected
• see training opportunities and apply
• read and acknowledge evaluations
• exchange private messages with the HR office

Requests are decided by the manager and by HR in the company portal; the app shows the answer.

The app works in English, Greek, Italian, Ukrainian and Bulgarian. It can be locked with Face ID or fingerprint.

name: Golf Mind DNA
description:
Golf Mind DNA shows how you think on the course, and turns it into a plan you can carry onto the first tee.

TAKE THE TEST
51 quick questions about real golf moments, about 9 minutes. You get your top 3 traits out of 12, your golfer type and the moment where pressure gets to you.

ONE THING AT A TIME
The app picks one thing to work on for the next three weeks, from your traits and where you lost shots in your last round.

ON THE COURSE
First-tee mode shows your routine big and simple, keeps the screen on, and gives you your words for your pressure spot.

PRE-ROUND WORDS
Three short lines you choose, read aloud with your one thing and your mantra in a calm coach voice, in English or Vietnamese. Or read a short passage once and hear your words in a copy of your own voice. It's saved on your phone, so it plays with no signal at the course.

AFTER THE ROUND
Log it in a few taps, for today or an earlier day: your score, whether you did your one thing, and where your mind cost you shots. See your pattern and how your scores move.

YOUR REPORT
Read your full report in the app, save it as a PDF, email it to yourself, and keep a pocket card on your phone.

Built around your strengths: no type is better than another, and every tip is written for the way you already play.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Your results stay in your account, and you can delete it any time in the app.

name: GovGate UAE
description:
GovGate helps entrepreneurs, investors and families get things done in the UAE: company formation, visas and residency, and all the paperwork in between — without queues or guesswork.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Order services: company setup, trade licences, residence and Golden visas, Emirates ID, document attestation and more.
• Follow a clear roadmap: see every step of your application, what is done, what is next and what we need from you.
• Keep documents in one place: scan a passport, Emirates ID or licence with your camera — key details are filled in automatically.
• Manage companies and family members: add shareholders, employees and dependants and track each person's applications.
• Talk to us: open a support request, send files and get answers from our consultants.
• Ask the assistant: get quick answers about your applications, by text or voice.
• Stay informed: notifications when a status changes or a document is needed.

MADE FOR THE UAE
• English, Russian and Arabic (with right-to-left layout).
• Sign in with email, Apple, Google or UAE PASS.

YOUR DATA
Documents are transferred over encrypted connections and used only to provide the services you order. You can delete your account at any time in the app or at govgate.ae/delete-account.

GovGate is operated by GOVGATE BUSINESS MARKETING MANAGEMENT, a private company licensed in Dubai. GovGate is not a government entity and is not affiliated with any government authority; we help you prepare and submit applications to the relevant authorities.

name: GPF Lista
description: GPF Lista è un taccuino della spesa in bianco e nero. Scrivi il nome di un articolo: l’app propone un simbolo e lo ordina per reparto. Quando trovi un prodotto, toccalo per segnarlo come preso.

name: Grade Run
description:
Grade Run checks a drain profile.

Drag one well invert. The drop over the spacing decides the grade of that reach. The reach flatter than the minimum you wrote is named. Changing the minimum does not rewrite the stored inverts.

Share an English well list. A stamped coordinate stays on the iPhone and is not part of the grade. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Greyib
description:
Greyib, proche de toi, juste pour toi.

Greyib est l'application de transport pensée pour la Mauritanie. Commande une voiture ou envoie un colis en quelques secondes, avec le prix affiché avant de partir.

COMMANDER UNE COURSE
• Indique ta destination dans « Où vas-tu ? »
• Choisis ta voiture : Voiture ou Voiture clim
• Vois le prix avant de confirmer, sans surprise
• Pars maintenant ou programme ta course pour plus tard
• Commande pour toi ou pour un proche

ENVOYER UN COLIS
• Un livreur à moto récupère et livre ton colis

PAYER COMME TU VEUX
• Cash ou paiement mobile : Bankily, Masrvi, Sedad, Moov Money et plus encore

SUIVRE TON CHAUFFEUR EN DIRECT
• Nom du chauffeur, modèle, couleur et plaque de la voiture
• Code de sécurité à donner au chauffeur pour être sûr de monter dans la bonne voiture
• Appel gratuit dans l'app, appel normal, WhatsApp ou messages rapides

TA SÉCURITÉ D'ABORD
• Bouton SOS pendant la course : appeler la police, alerter l'équipe Greyib ou envoyer ta position en direct à un proche

ÉCONOMISER
• Coupons de réduction et offres régulières
• Parrainage : invite tes amis et gagne des coupons

GAGNER AVEC GREYIB
• Tu es chauffeur ? Passe en mode chauffeur, reçois des demandes près de toi et suis tes gains et ta commission directement dans l'app

Enregistre ta maison et ton travail pour y aller en un seul toucher. Note chaque trajet pour nous aider à améliorer le service.

Greyib, proche de toi, juste pour toi.

name: Grinbits
description:
Grinbits is a cheerful social network for sharing funny, interesting and enjoyable everyday moments.

Share a bit with text or a photo, discover something that makes you smile, and follow people whose bits you enjoy.

• Discover funny and interesting bits
• Share everyday moments with text and photos
• Follow people and join conversations
• Like bits and reply to your favourites

Political discussion is prohibited, regardless of viewpoint. Grinbits is a place for the good stuff.

Built by Clear Code Wizards.

name: Ground & Pound
description:
Ground & Pound, c'est l'appli des fans de MMA : l'actu, les cartes de combat, les classements et les pronostics, au même endroit et en français.

L'ACTU MMA EN FRANÇAIS
• Les articles des principaux médias MMA français, réunis dans un seul fil.
• Pour chaque article, un résumé clair généré automatiquement, puis le lien vers l'article complet sur le site du média.
• Les combattants cités, avec leur record, leur classement et leur prochain combat.

TOUTES LES CARTES DE COMBAT
• Les soirées UFC, PFL, KSW et ARES, combat par combat : carte principale, préliminaires, catégories et horaires.
• Les résultats après chaque soirée : vainqueur, méthode, round.
• Un rappel 30 minutes avant le combat de ton choix.
• Une recherche pour retrouver n'importe quel combattant ou événement.

LES PRONOSTICS
• Avant chaque combat, choisis ton vainqueur.
• Découvre la répartition des pronostics de la communauté.
• Suis ta précision et ta série, et défie tes amis dans un classement privé.
Les pronostics sont un jeu entre fans : aucune mise, aucun argent, aucun gain.

CLASSEMENTS ET FICHES COMBATTANTS
• Les champions et le top 15 de chaque catégorie, plus le pound for pound.
• Pour chaque combattant : palmarès, taux de finish, répartition KO / soumission / décision, fiche technique, parcours et derniers combats.

À TA MANIÈRE
• Choisis les organisations que tu suis : leurs événements, leurs actus et leurs classements passent en premier.
• Gratuit.

Ground & Pound est une application indépendante, qui n'est ni affiliée ni soutenue par l'UFC, le PFL, le KSW, l'ARES ou les médias cités. Les noms et marques cités appartiennent à leurs propriétaires respectifs.

name: Grue Flottante
description:
Vous êtes aux commandes d'une grue flottante. Approchez le quai, tenez votre poste, levez les colis et posez-les sur votre pont ; puis naviguez jusqu'au navire et descendez chaque charge dans sa zone, entre les mâts, les haubans et les antennes. La charge se balance au bout du câble, le vent fait dériver l'engin, la houle le fait rouler : c'est le métier de grutier, sans casse réelle. Et à Brest, tout le port est à vous, du remorqueur à l'hélicoptère de sauvetage.

39 MISSIONS, QUATRE PORTS

• Port de commerce : un cargo à trois cales ouvertes, des conteneurs, une pelle de chantier de 44 tonnes au bord du limiteur de charge.
• Base navale : une frégate hérissée d'antennes, des caisses de munitions qui n'aiment pas les chocs, des conteneurs de missiles sous le mistral.
• Port de pêche breton : un chalutier, ses funes et ses tangons ; de la glace et des filets avant le coup de vent.
• Brest, le port militaire : un décor tracé d'après la vraie géographie et le vrai relief. De la rade à la base sous-marine, des bassins de Pontaniou jusqu'au fond de la Penfeld, sous le pont levant de Recouvrance et le téléphérique, avec ses quais animés et ses remorqueurs à appeler à la VHF.

Chaque mission a son heure, son vent, sa mer, parfois un courant ou une limite de temps. Une à trois étoiles selon la précision des poses, le temps et les incidents.

TROIS GRUES

• Le ponton-grue : 1 530 tonnes, flèche treillis de 42 mètres, deux pieux d'ancrage qui le clouent sur place.
• La grue « Alpaga », façon grue portuaire de Brest : elle s'amarre au quai ou à couple, déplie une fléchette de 15 mètres pour un second crochet, et couche sa flèche sur un chevalet pour passer sous les ponts.
• La GFA « Girafe », la grue du port des années 1990 : une tour en treillis, deux hélices et une manette par moteur, sa barge à couple.

Plus la charge est lourde, moins la grue porte loin : le limiteur veille. La charge part en ballant à chaque à-coup ; assistance anti-ballant réglable, ou coupée.

LES AUTRES MÉTIERS DU PORT

• Pilote : un navire sans machine et ses remorqueurs, ordre après ordre, jusqu'à la cale sèche.
• Remorqueur : aux commandes du RPC12, à couple, en flèche ou en pousseur, un engin jusqu'à son poste.
• Pneumatique : à 28 nœuds, la reconnaissance du port repère par repère, et la relève des équipes jusqu'à la grue.
• Hélitreuillage : à bord d'un hélicoptère de la Marine, treuilliste, pilote ou équipe de pont. Une civière à hisser, une pompe pour une frégate, un homme à la mer.

LE SIGNALEUR

Sur le quai, un élingueur guide la prise ; sur le navire, un signaleur guide la pose avec les gestes de commandement de grue : crochet, flèche, orientation, stop, arrêt d'urgence.

COMPOSEZ VOS CHANTIERS

Le créateur de niveaux reprend la vraie vie du port : l'engin, jusqu'à vingt colis, une barge à couple, une passe étroite ou un pont basculant, le contre-la-montre, l'heure, le vent, la mer, le courant. Il compose aussi des mises au bassin, des missions de remorqueur et d'hélitreuillage, et la navigation libre, sur l'eau comme en vol. Partagez vos niveaux par un simple lien.

DE NUIT, SOUS LA PLUIE, ET POUR APPRENDRE

Toute mission se joue aussi de nuit, avec projecteurs de travail et bâtons lumineux des signaleurs, ou sous la pluie. Deux formations font découvrir chaque commande, étape par étape, avant un premier chantier complet. Au pupitre tactile ou à la manette : SteelSeries, Xbox, PlayStation, MFi.

SANS RIEN DE SUPERFLU

Pas de compte, pas de publicité, aucun achat intégré, aucune donnée collectée. Tout se joue sur l'iPhone ou l'iPad, en plein écran, hors connexion : ciel, mer, navires, décors et sons sont fabriqués par le jeu lui-même. À Brest, une option fait jouer à l'heure, à la marée et à la météo du moment (météo : MET Norway).

Un jeu, pas une formation : Grue Flottante ne remplace ni une formation ni une habilitation de grutier. Données cartographiques de Brest : © les contributeurs d'OpenStreetMap ; relief : © IGN.

name: GTSport Group Drives
description:
Plan a route for your next club drive and share it with the people coming along. GTSport Group Drives brings the route, the group, and your iPhone’s navigation view together.

Before you leave, plan a route with stops, open a saved drive, or scan a route QR code. Use the iPhone share sheet to send an invitation.

During a drive, follow your route with the map oriented north up or in your direction of travel. Share your location with the group you choose while GTSport is open. If another driver has added a phone number, use a foreground voice command to start a call through your iPhone.

An account is required. Sign in and set up your route while parked. An internet connection is needed for sign-in and live group features.

name: Hadeed: Gym Workout Tracker
description:
Hadeed is a gym workout tracker and planner that works offline. It plans your week, shows every move as a figure that moves, logs your sets and counts your calories. No account, no ads, no subscription.

Open it, pick the days you can train, and Hadeed lays out the week: what to train each day, how many sets and reps, how long to rest. Then it tracks each day as you go.

A WEEK PLAN THAT TELLS YOU WHAT TO DO

• Pick any days, one to seven a week, at the gym or at home
• Each day comes with its moves, sets, reps and rest written in
• A warm-up before and a cool-down after, step by step
• A video of each session, in English or Arabic
• The week shows each day as you go: done, part done (3 of 6 moves), or still to come
• Six weeks of history, so you see whether the habit is holding
• Your week starts on the day you choose

Beginners get a full body plan that grows into upper/lower and splits as the days go up. Already have a program? Push pull legs, upper lower, full body, bro split, 5x5: build your own routines and put them on the same week.

5,800+ EXERCISES, AND YOU SEE EACH ONE MOVE

Over 5,000 exercises come with a drawn figure that loops through the rep, so you see the movement, not just a name. Each one has form steps, the mistakes people make, and the muscles it works. Barbell, dumbbell, machine, cable, kettlebell, band and bodyweight, so a home gym with one pair of dumbbells works as well as a full gym floor.

A COMPLETE WORKOUT LOG

• Sets, reps and weight, in kilograms or pounds
• RPE and RIR on every set, if you train by effort
• Warm-up sets counted apart from working sets
• Supersets for the exercises you pair together
• A rest timer that starts itself and shows your next set
• Notes on any exercise or session

Or tap the muscles you want on a front and back body map, and Hadeed builds the session, loaded with the weights you lifted last time.

FOOD DIARY AND CALORIE COUNTER

• Calories left today, with protein, carbs and fat
• Targets set from your goal: lose, keep or gain
• 122 common foods built in, plus your own foods and quick add

PROGRESS YOU CAN SEE

• Personal records for every lift, caught automatically
• Estimated 1RM, so you know your max without testing it
• Charts for volume and bodyweight, plus body measurements
• A muscle map showing what you have been skipping
• Streaks, a weekly goal, medals and levels

BUILT FOR THE GYM FLOOR

It opens instantly and never waits on a connection. Big buttons you can hit with chalk on your hands, a dark or light theme, and the screen can stay on mid-set.

NO INTERNET PERMISSION. AT ALL.

Hadeed cannot reach the network. Your training history stays on your phone. It works in a basement gym with no signal, on a plane, anywhere. No account, no email, no ads, no tracking, no analytics, nothing behind a paywall.

Back up to one file whenever you want, or export a CSV for any spreadsheet. Moving from another workout app? Hadeed imports the common export formats, so your history comes with you.

WHO IT IS FOR

Beginners who want to be told what to do today. Lifters chasing progressive overload. Bodybuilding, powerlifting, strength training, hypertrophy, calisthenics and home workouts. Anyone who kept a gym log in a notebook and wants it to add itself up.

Sixteen languages, including full right-to-left Arabic.

Hadeed is Arabic for iron.

name: Hadis ve Ayet
description: Hadis ve Ayet application

name: HaRow: Learn Japanese
description:
HaRow is a gentle Japanese word game for English speakers. Every word starts with the Japanese "H" sounds: は ひ ふ へ ほ (ha, hi, fu, he, ho).

HOW IT WORKS
• One Japanese word in the sentence is hidden. Read or listen, then tap the word that fits.
• Stuck? Tap the sentence to see it in English, or show the English meaning of each choice.
• Today's 3: just three questions a day — a little new, a little review.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 90 everyday words for daily life, travel, shopping, food and meeting people
• 10 original companions, each with their own voice
• Furigana you can turn on or off
• Daily Japan: finish Today's 3 to collect an illustrated card about Japan. 80 cards to collect.
• Every 5 new words raise your level and reveal more companions

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline. Pictures and voices are inside the app.
• Your progress stays on your device. You can save a backup file any time.

HaRow is a focused vocabulary companion, not a complete Japanese course. It is a friendly first step and a small daily habit.

by orechin studio

name: HDMIビュ
description:
USB-C搭載のiPadをHDMI映像のモニターとして使えます。映像機器を対応するHDMIキャプチャーにつなぎ、キャプチャーをiPadに接続してアプリを開いてください。
• 入力映像を全画面で表示します。
• 映像をタップすると、縦横比を保つ表示と画面いっぱいの表示を切り替えられます。
• USB音声入力に対応するキャプチャーからHDMI音声を再生できます。
• 操作パネルで音声の状態と出力先を確認できます。
iPadOS 17以降のUSB-C搭載iPadと、USB Video Class（UVC）対応のHDMIキャプチャーが必要です。
音声再生にはUSB Audio Class（UAC）対応の機器が必要です。映像入力にはHDMI出力用アダプターを使用できません。

name: Hearthvale: Island Builder
description:
Hearthvale is a strategy game of settling, trading and building on an island that is different every time you play.

Place your first settlements, gather Timber, Clay, Fleece, Harvest and Stone when the dice roll your numbers, and turn them into roads, settlements and cities. The first to ten victory points claims the vale.

PLAY AGAINST SMART RIVALS
Face two or three computer rivals. Choose basic rivals who build what they can, intermediate rivals who plan ahead, weigh scarcity and race you for titles, or a mix of both. Rivals only see what a real player would see: never your hand, the deck or the dice to come.

TRADE AT THE TABLE
Lay the cards you'll give on the table, ask for what you need, and offer the deal to every rival at once. Each one answers with a reason. Rivals bring you offers of their own, and harbors give you better rates with the bank.

EVERYTHING ON A TOUCH
• Build straight from the map: tap a glowing spot to preview, tap again to build
• Tap any intersection to see its tiles, their odds and any harbor
• Pinch to zoom and drag to explore the island
• Card reveals for every development card played
• Sound and haptics for dice, building, trades and the raider

THE FULL GAME
Snake-order setup, harbors, the raider, discards and robbery, five kinds of development cards, the Grand Highway and Strongest Guard titles, and hidden Monuments.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Hearthvale works completely offline. No ads, no accounts, no data collected. Your game saves after every move, so you can stop and pick it up exactly where you left off. Designed for iPhone and iPad.

name: Hebrew Kids: Learn Hebrew
description:
Hebrew Kids is a gentle first step into Hebrew for children aged 3 to 7 — even those who can't read yet. Everything happens through voice, pictures and play.

YOUR CHILD SPENDS A DAY WITH TOMI
Morning at home, the walk to kindergarten, playtime, lunch, a nap and a cozy evening with the family — 30 short episodes of 5–7 tasks each. Along the way your child learns 88 everyday words and phrases: family, toys, food, clothes, colors, numbers and polite words like "please" and "thank you".

NO READING REQUIRED
Alef, a friendly helper, says every question out loud. Your child answers by tapping pictures in the scene:
• find the object Alef names
• choose the right card
• listen to speech bubbles and give Tomi the right words
• drag a sticker to its place
• tap things in the right order
• repeat a word out loud after Alef
Mistakes are never punished: Alef gently repeats the word, and a glow or a pointing hand helps when needed.

WORDS THAT STICK
Every episode starts with a short warm-up of words from earlier episodes. Each word comes back after 1, 2, 4 and 7 episodes, and a word your child mixed up returns right in the next one, so new vocabulary isn't forgotten after one game.

REWARDS KIDS LOVE
• stars for every right answer
• levels that grow as stars add up
• a sticker album where well-learned words turn silver and gold
• an adventure map: after each episode Tomi walks on to the next stop, and your child sees what comes next
• calm instrumental music that softens whenever Alef speaks

FOR PARENTS
A parents' area behind a lock shows progress, learned words and play time. You can set a daily time limit, choose hints in Russian or English, turn Hebrew text and vowel marks (niqqud) on or off and slow down speech. Several children can play on one device, each with their own progress.

TRY IT FREE
The first 5 episodes are free. All episodes, including new ones as they come out, are available with a monthly or yearly subscription that a parent starts behind the parents' lock. Holiday episodes are free for everyone.

SAFE AND CALM
No ads, no chat, no links out of the app. Progress is stored on the device.

For families abroad, families planning aliyah and families already in Israel.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://hebrew-one.com/en/privacy/#hebrew-kids

name: Hikari Lookup
description:
Hikari Lookup checks fiber broadband availability at Japanese addresses on the official FLET'S Hikari, au Hikari and NURO Hikari websites, starting from a Japanese postal code and building selection. It explains maximum speeds and installation, and saves results and full-page captures on your device.

Official sites, addresses and building names remain in Japanese. Optional OpenAI address matching requires your consent and sends only relevant address components and displayed candidates through our server. No account or subscription is needed; this independent app is not affiliated with any ISP, and availability and speeds are not guaranteed.

name: Hit Variatie Radio
description:
Hit Variatie Radio brengt de beste piratenmuziek naar je iPhone. Luister naar de livestream en zie welke artiest en welk nummer op dat moment te horen zijn.

LUISTER ALTIJD EN OVERAL
Start en pauzeer de radio met één duidelijke knop. Luister verder op de achtergrond, gebruik de bediening op het vergrendelscherm en kies een beschikbare AirPlay-ontvanger.

NU SPEELT
Bekijk de meegestuurde artiest- en titelinformatie en de recente speellijst van Hit Variatie.

VERZOEKJE AANVRAGEN
Maak je verzoekje in de app en open het bericht in WhatsApp. Je controleert en verstuurt het bericht zelf.

DE ZENDER BIJ DE HAND
Bekijk het dj-overzicht, neem contact op en open de website of Facebook-pagina van Hit Variatie.

De app is gratis te downloaden en bevat geen in-app aankopen. Voor live radio is een internetverbinding nodig; je provider kan kosten rekenen voor mobiele data. De beschikbaarheid van nummers en titelinformatie hangt af van de uitzending en de verbinding.

App ontwikkeld door Patrick van der Stoop — Apex Utility Studio.

name: HiukkanenKoetin
description: ParticleCounter is an optical particle counter for cleanroom inspection. Set the sample flow, laser and channel split, and calculate particle size, coincidence error, filter background and channel-by-channel reading before measurement.

name: Holiday Planner
description:
Bring your holiday plans together with Holiday Planner.

Plan gifts, organize events, track orders, prepare meals and manage your seasonal budget, all from your iPhone.

• View your holiday countdown, upcoming activities, completed tasks and spending on the Dashboard.
• Add holiday events and important dates to the Calendar.
• Organize gifts by recipient, track expected arrivals and check off gifts as you wrap them.
• Track orders, estimated arrival dates and delivery statuses.
• Plan holiday meals and create shareable shopping lists.
• Manage holiday tasks and enable optional reminders for deadlines.
• Set a Season Budget and track your holiday spending.
• Star favourite gifts, events, meals and tasks to find them easily in Favourites.
• Copy reusable planning items between holiday seasons to make planning easier year after year.

Holiday Planner works offline and saves your plans directly on your device. Export a backup to keep a copy of your information or transfer your plans to another device.

Make holiday planning simpler, more organized and easier to manage in one place.

name: HomeAiTalk
description: HomeAiTalk is a personal AI voice client that talks to your Mac over a private Tailscale network. Audio stays on your gear.

name: HoofDash
description:
No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Just horses!

HoofDash is a cartoon show-jumping game. Your horse gallops around the arena by itself. Tap anywhere to jump the fences, and time your jumps to grab the golden trophies along the way.

CHOOSE YOUR TEAM
Pick from four horses (Conker, Misty, Honey and Domino) and four riders (Jemimah, Ruby, Sam and Isla) before every round.

FROM PONY CLUB TO OLYMPIC
Start with little cross-poles, then work your way up through Novice, Intermediate, Advanced and Grand Prix to Olympic. The fences get bigger, the horse gets faster and the sun starts to set.

LOTS OF JUMPS
Cross-poles, uprights, gates, hedges, wide oxers, triple bars, brick walls, water jumps, and doubles and trebles.

TROPHIES, ROSETTES AND LEADERBOARD
Jump into trophies for bonus points and fill your trophy cabinet. Clear fences in a row to score more. Knock three fences and the round is over, but a golden horseshoe gives you a life back. Win a rosette at the end of every round, try to beat your best score, and see how you rank on the Game Center leaderboard.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
Simple one-tap controls and works offline. No ads, no accounts and no tracking.

Game idea by Jemimah.

name: Hot Chickz
description:
Hot Chickz, now in your pocket.

Order our hot chicken tenders, sliders and meals for pickup at Coliseum or Pontiac, or get it delivered to your door. Pick your heat from No Spice to Reaper, take off what you don't want, and add sides and drinks in a few taps.

Your member card
Your Hot Chickz card lives in the app. Flip it to show your QR at the counter and your points are added after you pay. Earn more and unlock the black card, then the gold one.

Free food with your points
Use your ready points for a free milkshake, fries, a slider and more, online or at the counter.

Pickup or delivery
Choose pickup and the store you want, or choose delivery and we send it from the closest open store that has your whole order.

Pick your heat
No Spice, Mild, Hot, Blaze or Reaper. Remove pickles, coleslaw or sauce, and add extras your way.

Notifications that matter
Know the moment your points are added, a reward is ready or we reply to your message. Deals only if you want them.

Order again in one tap
Save your favorite orders, reorder your last meal, and track delivery live.

Happy Tears.

name: Humming Lullaby
description:
Turn the tune you hum into a lullaby for your baby.

HUM, AND WE LISTEN
• Tap Sing and hum a short melody, like "la-la-la".
• Your tune becomes colorful note bubbles you can see.
• Choose the beat (swaying or steady), speed and mood with a single tap.

A BETTER SONG, AUTOMATICALLY
• Slightly off notes are gently fixed so the melody sounds lovely.
• Pick from three versions of your main melody.
• Want to change something? Tap a bubble and move it with the game-style pad.

THREE LULLABIES, READY TO PLAY
• Your melody grows into a 16-bar lullaby in three styles: Snuggly, Warm & Toasty and Dreamland.
• Soft ocarina-like melody with harp, music box or pad accompaniment.
• Repeat play and a sleep timer that slowly fades out.
• Save and share the audio file to Files, Messages or SoundCloud.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything happens on your iPhone. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking.
• Your recordings never leave your device.

Note: If your melody is similar to an existing song, sharing it may raise copyright issues. You are responsible for what you share.

name: i apres
description:
i apres is the loudest Armenian party game, an Armenian Alias. Split into teams, pass one phone around and explain words before the time runs out. The team that guesses the most wins.

HOW TO PLAY
• 2 to 4 teams, one phone
• One player explains, the team guesses
• Swipe right when it's guessed, left to skip
• Every round has a new rule: round 1 — talk, round 2 — gestures only, round 3 — just one word
• First team to the target score wins, but the others always get a last chance

4000+ WORDS IN 25 TOPICS
Films and cartoons (with Russian and English titles under the word), famous Armenians, Armenian food and toasts, our slang, the good old days, landmarks, animals, sport, music, professions and more. Words don't repeat from game to game.

A DOG WITH CHARACTER
Our mascot celebrates your wins, teases you when you skip and comments on every topic.

FUNNY PUNISHMENTS
At the end the losers pick one of three punishments: dance kochari with no music, give a toast like a real tamada and more.

No ads, no accounts, works offline. Made in Armenia with love.

name: IBS Seminary
description:
The official app of the International Bible Seminary — the seminary portal, in your pocket.

Sign in once, and the app opens the sections your role needs: a student's courses and grades, a teacher's classes and visits, the office's daily work.

FOR STUDENTS
• Today's classes and your group's upcoming sessions at a glance
• Your courses, with materials, teachers' announcements and how far through the work you are
• Every assignment and deadline in one list
• Hand in work straight from your phone — even a photo of a handwritten page
• Grades and teachers' feedback as soon as they are posted
• The video library of the seminary's lectures and sermons

FOR TEACHERS
• Your teaching visits and flights; confirm or decline a requested visit in two taps
• Write a course once — handouts, photos of the whiteboard, voice notes, tests — and give it to any group
• Take attendance in the classroom: one tap per name, one Save
• Mark work student by student, with the work right beside the grade
• Review essays and answers students say were marked wrong
• See how a class is doing: grades, attendance and who could use a word
• Add a teaching visit to your own calendar

FOR COORDINATORS AND STAFF
• The whole teaching year: every visit, teacher, group and travel leg
• An arrivals board for the week, and a Needs Attention screen that flags double bookings, tight turnarounds and missing details before they become problems
• Admissions: the applications queue, and a people search that works in Latin or Cyrillic
• Academic: cohorts, teaching groups and which courses still need a teacher
• Media: post news with a photo taken on the spot, add events, refresh the video archive
• The bookshop's orders and catalogue, messages from the website, and the finance report
Each person sees only the sections their role opens.

EVERYWHERE IN THE APP
• English and Ukrainian, following your device language — the schedule content too, not just the buttons
• Sign in with Face ID
• Your last-loaded schedule stays readable offline
• Every schedule change can be undone, one step at a time

An account issued by the International Bible Seminary is required.

name: iliometro: Solar Calculator
description:
iliometro is a free set of tools for solar panels: for your home, for installers, for campers and boats. No ads, no account.

MEASURE AND PRODUCTION
• Measure: lay your phone on the panel to see tilt and compass orientation live, how far you are from the ideal angle and how much production you lose.
• Production: kWh per month and per year for your location, using PVGIS data from the European Commission.
• Forecast: today's and tomorrow's production hour by hour from the weather forecast, and the best time window to run the washing machine, the water heater or EV charging.
• Home-screen widget with today's kWh and the peak hour.

SUN AND SHADE
• Sun path today and at the solstices, with sunrise and sunset.
• Set an obstacle (building, tree, mountain) and see when it shades the panels and how much production it costs you. You can aim at it with the camera to measure it.
• Row spacing, so one row does not shade the next in winter.

ELECTRICAL
• Cables: cross-section in mm² and AWG, checked for voltage drop and ampacity.
• Strings: how many panels in series and in parallel within the inverter or MPPT limits, in cold and hot weather.
• Fuses and breakers for strings, AC side and battery.
• Batteries: capacity for the days of autonomy you want, with depth of discharge.
• Loads: list of appliances and Wh per day.
• Roof: how many panels fit.
• Payback: how many years until the system pays for itself, and the profit over 25 years.

EVERYDAY USE
• Electric car: how many kilometres a day your panels cover.
• Hot water and heat pump: how many panels you need.
• Camper and boat: energy balance for 12 and 24 V systems.

EQUIPMENT LIBRARY
• 785 models: 90 panels, 588 inverters, 39 charge controllers and 68 batteries, from Victron, Deye, EASun and other makers.
• One tap fills the calculators with the datasheet values.

ALSO
• PDF report of your project to share.
• A help page for every tool: what it does and the formula it uses.
• Languages: Greek, English, French, German, Dutch, Italian, Russian.

PRIVACY
• Your project stays on your device. Only rounded coordinates are sent to PVGIS (EU) and to MET Norway for the weather. Optional anonymous analytics, only if you allow it.

IMPORTANT
The calculations are an aid for design. Installation must be done by a licensed electrician.

name: Indexmere
description:
Indexmere is an offline workspace for building a real back-of-book index from your own manuscript. Entries, printed page locators, source evidence and version-specific references live in one project — on your device, with no account and no connection.

Most index tools treat the PDF page number as the page number. Indexmere separates the file page from the printed page: PDF page 18 can carry printed page 12, and every locator stores both. Add a second piece of evidence and the locator still reads "12, 18" — no duplicate page number sneaks into the index.

THE WORK

Import a PDF with a text layer, or ordered page images: reorder them, check the page count and text layer, preview the ends, name the version.

Map the pages: Roman, Arabic, appendix and unnumbered sections, front-matter offsets, per-page exceptions — confirmed, revisitable, kept as project data.

Mark evidence by reading the PDF natively: zoom, pan, drag a region or select text, then bind entry, locator and note. Every mark points back to a real page range.

Shape entries with heading, qualifier, entry type, parent entry, sort-as and note, live preview and duplicate warnings. Move, promote or group-move them; self-containment and descendant loops are blocked, and identity and evidence survive.

Connect references: See and See also targets come from the real entry list, unmatched source wording is preserved, and circular references are flagged.

name: Ink Trap
description:
Ink Trap keeps one plate on this iPhone.

Drag a trap width on an ink pair. The white gap is the registration slip times squeeze, minus the trap, and never below zero. The named pair is the widest gap that is still open.

Change the squeeze and the saved trap widths stay as you left them. Close the gap on the named pair and the name can move. Export writes the pairs to a file on this iPhone.

Pairs and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Inkwhistle Puzzos
description:
Night has fallen over the old tiled roofs of Inkwhistle Puzzos, and Thistle the hedgehog has his paper lanterns ready. Pale moths are waiting for a little warm light, but the owls dozing in their chimney pots must not be woken. Move the lanterns so the light lands in all the right places.

HOW IT WORKS
Tap a lantern, then tap an arrow. The lantern slides across the roof until a chimney, an owl, another lantern or the roof edge stops it. Each lantern lights its own tile and two tiles in every straight direction.
- Light every moth to finish the roof.
- Never let the light reach a sleeping owl.
- Chimneys and owls block the light behind them.
- Iron hooks catch a sliding lantern and stop it right on top.

name: InstallPros
description:
InstallPros is the iPhone app for InstallPros field teams. Run jobs, dispatch, estimates, and conversations from your phone — even when you are on a job site.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Open the job board and a job record to review the scope, schedule, and customer details
• Dispatch and follow work with your team
• Build and present estimates in the field
• Message customers and teammates in Conversations and Team Hub
• Take job photos with the camera and keep them on the job
• Sign in with Face ID
• Get push notifications, badges, and alerts when work needs you
• See a built-in offline screen if your connection drops

InstallPros is a native iPhone app, not just a shortcut to a website. Push notifications, Face ID, the camera, location, and badges are built into the app so they work the way you expect on iPhone.

The same live workspace you already use in a browser stays in sync here, so there is nothing extra to learn.

Need help? Visit https://installpros.io/contact-us/

name: Insurance CRM
description:
Insurance CRM, sigorta acentelerinin kullandığı Insurance CRM sisteminin resmî mobil uygulamasıdır. Acentenizin kendi sunucusuna bağlanır; müşterilerinizi, poliçelerinizi ve günlük işlerinizi telefonunuzdan yönetmenizi sağlar.

KOKPİT VE BENİM GÜNÜM
• Ayın üretimi, hedef ilerlemesi, ay sonu tahmini ve geçen yılın aynı dönemiyle karşılaştırma
• Bugünün görevleri, yaklaşan yenilemeler ve doğum günleri tek ekranda
• Temsilci sıralaması ve ekip paneli (yönetici rolleri için)

MÜŞTERİLER VE POLİÇELER
• Müşteri kartı: iletişim bilgileri, poliçeler, teklifler, görevler, notlar ve belgeler
• Poliçe listesi, detay, zeyil ve iade bilgileri
• Bir dokunuşla arama, WhatsApp ve e-posta
• Kamerayla ruhsat, poliçe ve hasar belgesi ekleme

YENİLEMELER VE GÖREVLER
• 7, 30 ve 90 gün içinde yenilenecek poliçeler
• Görev oluşturma, atama, erteleme ve tamamlama
• Gecikmiş ve acil işler için hatırlatma bildirimleri

SATIŞ RAPORLARI
• Temsilci bazında tarih aralığına göre satış raporu
• Branş ve sigorta şirketi dağılımı, günlük / haftalık / aylık grafik
• Hedef takibi ve önceki döneme göre değişim

WHATSAPP VE BİLDİRİMLER
• Müşteriden gelen WhatsApp mesajı için anında bildirim ve yanıt
• Görev, yenileme ve sabah özeti bildirimleri

GÜVENLİK
• Face ID / parmak iziyle hızlı ve güvenli giriş
• Rol bazlı yetki: Patron, Müdür, Ekip Lideri ve Temsilci yalnız yetkili olduğu verileri görür
• Verileriniz acentenizin sunucusunda kalır; uygulamada reklam ve takip yoktur

Not: Uygulamayı kullanmak için acentenizin Insurance CRM sunucusunda bir kullanıcı hesabınız olmalıdır. Insurance CRM'i acentenizde denemek için: balkay.net/insurance-crm

name: IntegratorLog
description:
IntegratorLog keeps a security integrator's sites in one place: the equipment, its inspections, what's wrong with it and what's on the truck. The app is the same IntegratorLog your office uses on the web, made for the phone.
