Inspections that work without a signal
Walk the building with the inspection on your phone: pass, fail or not applicable for each check, photos, notes and signatures. No signal in the mechanical room? Keep going: everything waits on the phone and syncs when you're back online.

Every site, system and piece of equipment
Doors, readers, locks, controllers, cameras, NVRs, intrusion panels and switches, with their models, serial numbers, locations, photos and history. Find anything with one search.

Deficiencies from finding to fixed
A failed check becomes a deficiency with its severity and photos, then follows it through quote, approval, repair and verification.

Inventory and fast scanning
Scan barcodes and QR labels with the phone's own scanner: find a part, receive a box, move stock to a vehicle, use it on a job, or count a shelf by scanning each item. Torch included for dark closets.

Notifications you choose
A new task, a customer's repair approval, an inspection due today, a change that needs your decision. They never include addresses or network details.

Built for security work
Two-step sign-in, optional Face ID or fingerprint lock, encrypted offline storage that stays on the phone, and no passwords or door codes stored anywhere, ever.

IntegratorLog is for integrators whose company already uses it: your company invites you, then you sign in with your email, password and code. Learn more at integratorlog.com.

name: Interview Coach
description:
Practice job interviews out loud with a simulated interviewer. Choose your target role, seniority, and interview track, then rehearse for a recruiter screen, a behavioral interview, or a role-specific conversation.

Answer at your own pace. The interviewer listens and asks follow-up questions based on what you say. When you finish, see which parts of your answers worked, read specific suggestions for improvement, and get three things to practice next.

Start voice practice without an account. Sign in with an email code to read and save your written report and transcript.

Prefer to practice at your desk? Open https://interview.604apps.com/app/ in Chrome on a compatible computer for a mock interview with an animated interviewer. The browser uses a different voice and AI model, so the follow-up questions can vary. Sign in with the same email to read your saved reports on either device.

On iPhone and iPad, voice practice requires Apple Intelligence to be enabled and the English speech assets to be installed. You can read saved reports on devices without Apple Intelligence. Speech is processed on your device. The app saves no audio or video recordings.

name: iQ Cam: Wireless Stage Camera
description:
iQ Cam is the companion camera app for iQ Pro. Put a spare iPhone on a tripod at the side of the stage, or hand it to someone for close-ups, and its live picture appears in iQ Pro as a camera source, ready for any camera cue. No cables and no capture card.

Requires iQ Pro running on another iPhone or iPad on the same Wi-Fi network. iQ Cam does not work on its own.

A CAMERA SOURCE FOR YOUR SHOW
• Pair it once from Paired Devices in iQ Pro's Settings, and it's listed in the Sources of every camera cue
• Use it like any other camera in iQ Pro, with colour grading, face tracking and frames
• Reconnects by itself if the network drops, while the viewfinder keeps running
• The camera settings show LIVE TO IQ PRO while the picture is reaching iQ Pro

A VIEWFINDER BUILT FOR THE JOB
• A full-screen viewfinder in a dark theme that won't light up the wings
• Tap to focus, pinch to zoom, then drag to reframe. iQ Pro gets the picture framed exactly as you see it
• Switch between the front and back cameras, and choose a lens such as 0.5× or 1× on iPhones that have them
• Turn on a framing grid to line up your shot

MANUAL CONTROL FOR STAGE LIGHTING
• Exposure, ISO, shutter speed, white balance, focus and zoom, each on its own slider
• Switch ISO, shutter, white balance or focus from Auto to Manual, so the picture doesn't brighten and darken every time the lights change

FACE TRACKING
Turn on face tracking and iQ Cam moves the zoomed-in shot to keep a face in frame, with its own tracking zoom. Faces are found on the iPhone itself.

PAIR ONCE, NO ACCOUNT
• Connects over your local Wi-Fi network, with no sign-in and no internet connection needed
• Open iQ Cam and it finds iQ Pro by itself. In iQ Pro, it appears as a Remote camera ready to pair and name, such as "Stage Left iPhone"
• iQ Pro remembers it, and you can remove it from Paired Devices at any time

FOR
Magicians, theatre and event crews, churches, schools and conferences: anyone who runs a show in iQ Pro and wants a live camera on the big screen without running a cable.

PRIVACY
iQ Cam sends its picture only to the iQ Pro device you pair with, over your local network. It sends picture only, no sound, and doesn't record or save anything. There's no account, no tracking and no data sent to us.

name: IRL Health
description:
Your body has stats. Now you can see them.

IRL Stats turns your real activity from Apple Health into three character stats — Strength, Cardio and Focus — with four levels each. Train and they level up. Skip training and they start to drop.

STRENGTH — strength training, HIIT, functional workouts.
CARDIO — daily steps, running, cycling, swimming, boxing.
FOCUS — mindful minutes, yoga, pilates and good sleep.

HOW IT WORKS
• Every 20 minutes of training = +11%. 100% fills a level.
• Daily cap of +33% per stat: steady training beats one huge session.
• Each stat has a training window. Miss it and you lose a bit every day until you train again.
• Hold level 4 for five days in a row to complete a Regime.
• Smart tips tell you exactly what to do today.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

MINIMAL BY DESIGN
A clean dark HUD. Three bars. No feeds, no noise.

PRIVATE
Athletes start at their real level: the app reads 90 days of history on first launch. Everything is calculated on your iPhone. No account, no servers, no ads, no tracking.

ONE-TIME PURCHASE
Pay once. No subscriptions. Ever.

Works with Apple Health. Apple Watch recommended for automatic workout tracking — or log workouts manually in the app.

IRL Stats is not a medical device. Consult a doctor before starting a new training program.

name: Isabelle: Vida na Cidade
description:
Live Isabelle's everyday life in the 3D town of Nova América!

Explore the town square, her house, the gym, Hotel Baunilha, the mall, the playground, the water park, the kart track, the bike path, the fishing pond and the Exhibition Park with its Ferris wheel. Talk to the townsfolk, complete missions, collect coins and build a music career with lessons, rehearsals and shows.

• Ride a bike, race karts and swim at the water park
• Fish at the lake and eat at the restaurant, served by the waitress
• Change outfits in the wardrobe: 20 looks, including swimwear
• Take care of Pirulito, the puppy who follows Isabelle everywhere
• Real day and night, with a Wake Up button when she gets sleepy
• Easy touch controls in landscape, with an automatic camera
• Also works with Bluetooth game controllers

Made for kids:
• No ads and no purchases
• No sign-up, no chat and no data collection
• Works offline
• Progress is saved automatically on the device

The game is in Brazilian Portuguese.

name: Ishxonam
description:
Ishxonam — удобная система автоматизации торговли и учета для магазинов, торговых точек и складов.

Основные возможности:
• Быстрое оформление продаж и кассовые операции (POS)
• Управление каталогом товаров, остатками и складом
• Контроль кассы, расходов и финансовых поступлений
• Подробная аналитика продаж и отчеты за смену
• Работа в офлайн-режиме и облачная синхронизация данных

Ishxonam помогает вести бизнес прозрачно, экономить время и повышать эффективность продаж.

name: JadesPavilion
description:
Jade Pavilion is classic Mahjong solitaire. Tap two matching tiles to clear them, and clear the whole board to win.

LEVELS
- 240 levels in 8 chapters, from 28 tiles on one layer up to 144 tiles stacked five high.
- Every board is dealt so it can be solved.
- Earn up to 3 stars on each level.

QUICK PLAY
- A new random board every time, at Easy, Medium, Hard or Expert.

KID MODE
- Small boards with big tiles and only 10 simple pictures.
- Tap a tile and its matches light up.
- Unlimited hints and shuffles, no timer, and the board never gets stuck.

HELPFUL TOOLS
- Hint: two tiles that match flash on the board, so you always know a move you can make.
- Shuffle rearranges the remaining tiles into a layout that can be solved.
- Unlimited undo.
- A full How to Play guide with a picture of every tile.

No ads, no accounts, and no data collected. Works offline and follows light and dark mode.

name: Jeb's Flight Reference
description:
Jeb's Flight Reference is a pocket reference for pilots and flight simulator enthusiasts. Everything works offline, there is no account, and nothing you type leaves your device.

REFERENCE CARDS
Searchable cards for radio and comms, airspace, weather, VFR, IFR and low-visibility operations: Morse code and navaid idents (tap a letter to hear it, decode any identifier), the phonetic alphabet, standard phraseology, transponder codes, lost communications, CAT I / II / III minima, METAR and TAF decoding and more. Pin the cards you use most.

LIGHT GUN SIGNALS
US, ICAO and Canadian light gun signals with their in-flight and on-the-ground meanings, how to acknowledge them, and a quiz mode to practise.

E6B
Crosswind and headwind, density altitude, descent planning on a 3 degree path, visual descent point, standard rate turn bank angle, approach category and ISA temperature.

SCRATCHPAD
Draw with a finger or pencil, type free notes, or fill the CRAFT clearance and ATIS templates. Notes stay on this device only.

TIMER
Stopwatch and countdown for approach timing, fuel tank switches and holding legs, with a UTC clock.

The same reference content ships in Jeb's Horizon EFB and Jeb's Electron EFB.

For reference and training only. Always follow your aircraft's approved documents, current charts and ATC instructions.

name: jello4friday
description:
Get ready to shake, bounce, and bump your way to victory in Jello 4 Friday!

Shake your iPhone Left, Right, Up, or Down to launch your cartoon Jello across 10 action-packed sports courts. Knock opponents off the edge or into traps, survive the 60-second round, and be the first to reach the target score!

GAME FEATURES:
• Directional Shake Controls: Flick your iPhone in any direction—the faster you shake, the harder you dash! Warm up right in the live Practice Zone on the home screen before jumping into a match.
• 10 Unique Sports Courts: Battle across Football, Basketball, Badminton, Tennis, Ice Hockey, Volleyball, Ping Pong, Boxing Ring, Bowling, and Golf Green—each with its own 2D court layout and circle, oval, and square traps.
• Slippery Water Hazards: Watch out for random water puddles that make you slide and deflect in unpredictable directions!
• 4 Jellos with Unique Strengths: Every round randomly assigns each player a different Jello:
  - Foodie Yellow (Fast Speed): Quicker dashes and higher top speed.
  - Impatient Red (Power Bump): Stronger knockback on impact.
  - Gentleman Blue (Heavy Defense): Harder for opponents to push around.
  - Passionate Purple (Water Balance): Better grip and stability on slippery water.
• Always a 4-Player Battle: Play Solo against 3 NPCs (with instant fast-forward if you get knocked out), or host a 2–4 player local Wi-Fi/Bluetooth match with friends—empty seats automatically fill with NPCs.
• 100% Offline & Private: No internet required, no accounts needed, and zero personal data collected.

name: Journey of Champions
description:
Meet 18 world chess champions, discover their stories, and test what you learned with 180 questions. Solve 570 exercises on the Silicio chessboard with its original pieces.

• Basic. Work through 360 mate-in-one and mate-in-two puzzles. Use hints and step through the solutions.
• Intermediate and Advanced. Solve 210 combination exercises. Recommended for players rated 1300 Elo and above.
• Your collection. Read each champion’s story, answer the questions, and complete 10 exercises to earn their gem. Collect all 18 gems to earn your diploma.
• Up to six profiles. Each player keeps their own progress on the device. Save and restore backups through Files.

The full course is included. Play offline with no account, ads, or subscriptions.

name: Judith
description:
Judith est l’outil de recherche juridique gratuit du cabinet Kohen Avocats. Posez une question de droit ou décrivez une situation, sans nommer personne : Judith cherche les textes et les décisions qui pourraient y répondre, et vous les montre sans rien rédiger à votre place.

Ce que Judith consulte
- Plus de 750 000 décisions de justice : Cour de cassation, Conseil d’État, Conseil constitutionnel, cours d’appel, cours administratives d’appel et tribunaux.
- Les textes en vigueur, avec leur lien vers Légifrance.
- La doctrine de l’administration fiscale, publiée au Bulletin officiel des finances publiques.
- Les articles du cabinet sur kohenavocats.com.

Ce que vous voyez
- Ce que Judith a compris de votre question.
- Une main de cartes, à faire glisser : le texte qui pourrait s’appliquer, puis les décisions qui pourraient répondre, avec le passage repéré et ce qui a été retenu dans l’affaire.
- Le texte intégral de chaque décision, le passage utile surligné, et le lien vers la source officielle.
- L’historique de vos questions, gardé sur votre appareil.

Ce que Judith ne fait pas
Judith est un outil de recherche assisté par une intelligence artificielle, pas un avocat : ce qu’elle affiche n’est ni un avis juridique ni une consultation, et ne crée aucune relation d’avocat à client. Pour savoir ce qu’il en est dans votre cas, le cabinet propose une étude préalable de votre dossier, réalisée par un avocat, en dehors de l’application.

Gratuit, sans compte
Aucun compte ni inscription. Le nombre de questions est limité par appareil et par jour. Le cabinet conserve vos questions douze mois pour améliorer l’outil : n’y mettez ni nom ni information sensible.

Éditeur : KOHEN & BROTHERS, société d’exercice libéral d’avocats inscrite au barreau de Paris.

name: Julekalender - 2026
description:
**En varm tanke hver dag i desember**

Desember er en tid for glede, omtanke og små øyeblikk som betyr noe.

Med 24 små gleder får du en koselig, nostalgisk julekalender fylt med gode ord, varme tanker og små påminnelser om det som virkelig betyr noe.

Bak hver av de 24 lukene venter et nytt, hjertevarmt budskap som kan gi deg et smil, litt motivasjon eller et øyeblikk med ro i en travel førjulstid.

** Dette finner du i julekalenderen:**

- 24 luker med gode, fine og motiverende ord.
- Et nytt, personlig budskap hver dag frem til julaften.
- Nostalgisk juledesign med varme farger og koselige detaljer.
- Stemningsfullt snøfall når du åpner appen.
- Fine animasjoner når julelukene åpnes.
- Valgfrie daglige påminnelser på et klokkeslett du bestemmer selv.
- Mulighet til å dele dagens juleglede med noen du er glad i.

**En liten pause med omtanke**

Du trenger ikke gjøre noe spesielt. Bare åpne dagens luke, les noen gode ord og ta med deg en liten dose glede videre inn i dagen.

Kanskje er dagens budskap akkurat det du trenger å høre. Eller kanskje kjenner du noen andre som trenger det?

**Laget med omtanke, for du fortjener noen gode og varme ord frem mot jul **

name: KanavaPuhallin
description: KanavaPuhallin is a calculator for ducted centrifugal fans: airflow, total pressure, impeller diameter and blade angle, duct cross-section and length, air leakage, efficiency and specific energy, as well as sound power level. Select a fan and match the impeller to the duct for an efficient, low-vibration operating point. The PDF report is free; the CSV table and DXF line drawing are Pro features.

name: KarkaisuUuni
description: KarkaisuUuni is a heat treatment furnace calculator: set temperature, heating time and temperature rise, element power, workpiece mass and cross-section, cooling rate and cooling medium, hardening depth and hardness value. Harden steel evenly to the target hardness without soft spots, distortion or quench cracks. The PDF report is free; the CSV table and DXF line drawing are Pro features.

name: KartioVaihde
description: KartioVaihde is a bevel gear calculator: gear module, number of teeth, tooth angle and tooth width, shaft torque and rotational speed, backlash, contact pattern, lubricating oil and bearing. Match the gears and dimension the shafts to transmit power without edge loading or tooth breakage. The PDF report is free; the CSV table and DXF line drawing are Pro features.

name: KartPulse Racing
description:
## 1. What the app is, and what makes it different

**KartPulse Racing – from logger to faster laps**

KartPulse Racing turns the data from your kart logger into something you can actually understand. Download sessions straight from **AiM MyChron** over WiFi, or import .xrk files. Right away you see lap times, sectors, top speed and where on the track you gain and lose time.

**What makes KartPulse Racing different?**

- **Straight from MyChron, no PC needed.** Connect to the logger over WiFi at the track and download your sessions in seconds. No Race Studio required.
- **Made for AiM MyChron.** Fetch straight from the logger at the track, no PC needed.
- **Compare racing lines with other drivers.** Put a guest's lap on top of yours and see exactly where the lines differ.
- **Watch the lap again.** Track map in 2D and 3D, coloured by speed. Replay several laps against each other and see where the gap opens up.
- **Made for karting, not for engineers.** Simple numbers and clear colours instead of a hundred graphs. Ideal lap, best sectors and track record are ready straight away.
- **Setup and notes next to your times.** Write down gearing, tyre pressure, track width, carburettor and weather for each session, so you know what worked next time.
- **Tracks recognised by GPS.** All sessions at the same track are grouped together, and you can compare with earlier days.
- **Your data stays yours.** Everything is stored on your own device.
- **6 languages:** English, Norwegian, German, French, Italian and Spanish.

Made by a racing family, for racing families.
*KartPulse Racing by RW Production*

---

## 2. Getting started – 10 easy steps

1. **Create your profile.** Enter your name, pick a colour and a photo, and choose which MyChron you have.
2. **Turn on WiFi on your MyChron** (Menu → WiFi).
3. **Connect your tablet or phone to the WiFi network "MyChron5 ID …".**
4. **Tap "Fetch from MyChron".** The 20 newest new sessions are ticked. Tap "Download selected". Sessions you have fetched before are not fetched again.
5. **Open a session.** You see every lap, your best lap, sector times and top speed.
6. **Check your ideal lap.** It shows how fast you could go with your best sectors put together.
7. **View the track map.** Switch between 2D and 3D, and tap play to replay laps against each other. Tap "Racing line" to see the lines up close.
8. **Find where you lose time.** Pick up to 4 laps in the graphs and compare speed, RPM and time difference around the track.
9. **Add notes and setup.** Enter weather, tyre pressure, gearing and what went well, for each session.
10. **Compare and tidy up.** Use "Compare sessions" against another day or a guest, and see your track records in "Log". Tap trash to delete a session, or ⋯ next to a day to archive or delete the whole day.

**Tip:** The app only reads from the logger. It never changes settings and never deletes sessions on your MyChron.

name: Keelmark
description:
Το Keelmark είναι φορητό εργαλείο ποιοτικού ελέγχου για ένωση τμημάτων γάστρας στο ναυπηγείο και στη δεξαμενή. Καταγράφεις διάκενα, αποκλίσεις Χ/Υ, επιπεδότητα και γωνία, τα συγκρίνεις με αρχείο ανοχών και βλέπεις αμέσως έγκριση ή απόρριψη.

Πώς το χρησιμοποιείς
1. Άνοιξε Έργα και φτιάξε νέο έργο: όνομα, αριθμός γάστρας, τμήμα Α/Β, αρμός και αρχείο ανοχών.
2. Πάτα Νέα μέτρηση. Γράψε διάκενο, Χ, Υ, επιπεδότητα και γωνία. Πρόσθεσε σταθμό, πλευρά και στάδιο (πριν ή μετά τη ραφή). Η κρίση αλλάζει όσο πληκτρολογείς.
3. Διόρθωσε με την πρόταση στο πλατό (παρέμβυσμα, πλάνισμα ή μετατόπιση του τμήματος Β).
4. Τσέκαρε τη λίστα 12 βημάτων, σημείωσε τη βάρδια και υπέγραψε τον ποιοτικό έλεγχο.
5. Άνοιξε Αναφορά για κείμενο ή CSV και μοίρασέ την. Όταν η λίστα είναι πλήρης, σήμανε το έργο ολοκληρωμένο.

Εργαλεία
Αντιστάθμιση διάκενου, στοίβα παρεμβυσμάτων, μετατόπιση τμήματος, θερμική διαστολή, συστολή συγκόλλησης, σειρά διακένων και προσαρμοσμένα αρχεία ανοχών. Μπορείς να φορτώσεις τιμές από το τελευταίο έργο.

Τα έργα μένουν στη συσκευή. Χωρίς λογαριασμό, χωρίς κάμερα, χωρίς αποστολή σε διακομιστή.

name: Keshli
description:
Keshli puts Marrakech in the palm of your hand.

Discover the best places in town through short videos: restaurants, brunch spots, cafés and pastry shops, spas and massages, hammams, barbers, beauty salons, activities for kids, gyms, padel and golf.

FOR EVERY PLACE
• A short video to get a feel for it in seconds
• Opening hours, price range and neighbourhood
• Directions in one tap with Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze
• Call or message on WhatsApp straight from the listing

MARRAKECH EVENTS
Festivals, shows, races, nights in the desert: see what's happening in town and set a reminder so you don't miss a thing.

YOUR MARRAKECH
• Keep your favourite places in "My list"
• Explore the city on the map
• Search by category, neighbourhood or mood
• Use the app even offline

The app is in French. No account, no ads, no tracking: Keshli respects your privacy.

name: Kesho: Tasks & Shared Lists
description:
Kesho means tomorrow. A to-do app for what has to happen today, and for everything that can honestly wait until tomorrow.

TASKS
• Lists, folders and subtasks
• Templates: keep the packing list and start from it every time
• Notes, due dates and reminders
• Repeats: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly
• “Upcoming” shows what is due, across all lists

SHARED LISTS
• Invite someone with a link
• Share a whole folder: every list in it, also the ones added later
• Changes arrive within about a second
• Assign a task, so it is clear who gets the bread

EVERYWHERE
• iPhone, Android and the browser
• Works offline and syncs when you are back online

YOUR DATA
• No ads, no tracking
• No password: you log in with a code sent by email
• Works on one device without an account
• Export everything or delete your account, at any time

Kesho is free.

name: Kethuda Network
seller_name: YALCHEN YAZILIM VE KUYUMCULUK LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Kethuda Network (KetNet) — farklı sektörlerden doğrulanmış işletmeleri, ürünleri, hizmetleri ve etkinlikleri tek ticaret ağında keşfedin.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
• Doğrulanmış Yerel İşletmeler: Güvenilir esnaf ve işletmeleri bulun, vitrinlerini inceleyin.
• Zengin Ürün ve Hizmet Kataloğu: İhtiyacınız olan ürün veya profesyonel hizmetlere hızla ulaşın.
• Doğrudan ve Güvenli Sipariş: İşletmelerle aracısız iletişim ve hızlı sipariş oluşturma.
• Yerel Etkinlikler ve Fırsatlar: Şehrinizdeki güncel etkinlik ve kampanyalardan anında haberdar olun.

Kethuda ile yerel ticaret artık çok daha yakın ve güvenli!

name: Khabara: Learn Pashto
description:
خبره Khabara is a small app for learning Pashto, made by one person as a passion project for a heritage language.

WHO IT IS FOR
Khabara is for people who grew up around Pashto and want to speak it with family, and for beginners starting from zero. Every word and phrase is shown in Pashto script, in Latin letters, and in English, so you can start before you can read the script.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Follow the lesson path: 15 units in three stages, from first greetings to everyday conversation.
• Learn more than 800 words in 20 categories, such as family, food, colors, time and feelings.
• Learn 160 everyday phrases grouped by situation, such as greetings, shopping, directions and emergencies.
• Learn the numbers, then practise them in a matching round.
• Read an illustrated story, The Meeting, with audio for each line and short comprehension questions.
• Sing along with Zma Watan, an original Khabara song, line by line with a translation.
• Play three word games: Alwat, Baraan and Kabul Runner.
• Review with spaced repetition, which brings a word back just as you are about to forget it.
• Test yourself with four kinds of quiz: multiple choice, listening, typing and matching.
• Flip through flashcards by category whenever you like.

TWO DIALECTS
Choose Peshawari or Kandahari in your profile and switch at any time. Most vocabulary is shared. Where the two differ, you see the form for the dialect you chose.

HOW PROGRESS WORKS
You earn XP for lessons and reviews, set against a daily goal. Keep a streak going, unlock achievements, and see your stats: words by mastery level, a streak calendar and your weekly activity. Your progress is saved to your account, so it is the same on iPhone, iPad, Android and khabara.app.

GOOD TO KNOW
• You need an account. Sign in with Apple, with Google, or with an email and password, which you can create in the app or on khabara.app.
• The app needs an internet connection.
• Pronunciation audio is computer-generated speech, and the song was made with AI tools.
• Works on iPhone and iPad, with light and dark themes.

PRIVACY
Khabara has no ads and does not sell your data. It stores your account details and your learning progress so the app can work, and you can delete your account and its data at any time from your profile.

CONTACT
Khabara is a one-person project and it is still growing. Send a note from Profile, then Send feedback, or write to khabara.app@gmail.com. Word requests are very welcome.

name: Kibar Hırsız
description:
1924 İstanbul'u. Geceler uzun, konaklar sessiz, müzeler korunaksız sanılır. Sen Kibar Hırsız'sın: kimseye zarar vermeyen, ama hiçbir kilidin de önünde duramadığı centilmen bir hırsız.

KÜÇÜKTEN BAŞLA, EFSANE OL
Fatih'teki bir kunduracının evinden başla; dükkânlara, mağazalara, müzelere ve sonunda Saray Hazinesi'ne uzan. Her hedefin bir başarı şansı var ve bu şansı sen değiştirirsin.

PLANINI YAP
Çatıdan mı gireceksin, kömürlükten mi, yoksa uşak kılığında ön kapıdan mı? Her yolun bir bedeli var. Bu gecenin havasına da bak: sisli gecede kimse seni görmez, bayram gecesi evler boştur, dolunayda her yer aydınlıktır.

GERÇEK ZAMANLI SOYGUNLAR
Sessiz giriş, soygun ve kaçış gerçek zamanlı ilerler. Yolda bir köpek havlar, bekçi düdük çalar, kilit sıkışır. Ne yapacağına sen karar verirsin; kilidi ve kasayı kendi ellerinle açmayı da deneyebilirsin.

EKİBİNİ KUR
Gözcü, kilitçi, şoför, kaçakçı... Her ekip üyesinin kendi yeteneği ve kendi payı var. Sen yokken bile ufak işler çevirirler.

YATAKÇILAR VE KARABORSA
Soygundan çıkan gümüş şamdanı, inci kolyeyi, murassa hançeri yatakçılara sat. Biri güvenli ama cimri, biri cömert ama zabıtanın gözü üstünde. Pazarlık senin elinde.

DÜNYAYA AÇIL
İstanbul sana dar gelince Atina, Kahire, Paris ve Monte Carlo seni bekler. En büyük vurgun: Monte Carlo kumarhanesi.

KOLEKSİYON VE BAŞARIMLAR
Bizans tacı, firavun maskesi, prenses mücevherleri... Setleri tamamla, 27 başarımı topla, karakterine yeni bir görünüm seç.

HER GÜN YENİ BİR GECE
Günlük ödüller, her gün değişen gece havası ve soygun bitince gelen bildirimler. Oyun bitmez: güvenlik her soygunla artar, her şehirde yeni bir meydan okuma vardır.

İnternet gerekmez, reklam yoktur, hiçbir veri toplanmaz.

name: KilnMotif
description:
Draw an ornamental tile, assemble a repeat, and see how the colors meet from one tile to the next.

In the Motif workspace, start with a blank tile or an editable studio sample. Drag Bézier anchors and handles, split curves, trace shapes by hand, and repeat a layer with mirrors or quarter turns. Edit the palette, paint fills and outlines, or transform a whole layer around a chosen point.

In the Layout workspace, arrange your motif as a repeating surface. Change the repeat rule, set the size and grout, and rotate or mirror individual tiles. Browse the seam proof to compare sampled colors on both sides of every interior join.

Keep several projects on your device, save named versions, and compare them with your current design. Export a single tile or the full arrangement as a PNG bitmap or an SVG vector file.

All editing, proofing, and file generation work offline. No account is required.

name: KinnnBand
description:
KinnnBand turns your iPhone into a push-to-talk field radio. Throw the steel switch, tune the knob to a channel, hold the knurled key and talk. Release, and everyone on the channel hears the roger beep.

Radios talk phone to phone over Wi-Fi and Bluetooth, with no account to make and no server in between. It works in the backcountry, at a festival, across a campsite or around the house.

FIND EACH OTHER IN SECONDS
• Radios nearby appear on the speaker grille with their callsign and channel.
• One tap on JOIN puts you on their channel.
• When a radio joins yours, you hear a double blip, feel a haptic tick and see its callsign light up on the display.

TALK TO EVERYONE, OR TO ONE
• Talk to the whole channel, or pick one radio for a direct call. The rest of the channel stays clear.
• Send a call tone to buzz a friend's phone when you need them to pick up.

YOUR CREW, REMEMBERED
• Radios you join become contacts. Give them your own names.
• Switch on alone and your radio finds your contacts' channel by itself.

TALK WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Put the KinnnBand Talk control on the Action Button: press to talk, press again for over.
• Talk, Silence and Say Again from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island while the radio is on.
• Add Talk and Silent to Control Center, or say "Talk on KinnnBand".

A RADIO THAT FEELS LIKE ONE
• Strict half-duplex: one voice at a time, with a busy tone if someone has the floor.
• A live phosphor waveform shows every voice as it arrives.
• Radio voice: bandpass and compression for clear speech, played through the loudspeaker or the earpiece.
• Two faceplates: Olive Drab with a phosphor display, and Glacier with a daylight display.

QUIET WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Say Again replays the last transmission from memory. The next one wipes it.
• Pocket Whisper silences the speaker in your pocket and shows live captions, made on your iPhone.
• Add KinnnBand to a Focus and the speaker goes silent while that Focus is on.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, and nothing is collected.
• Voice goes straight from phone to phone, encrypted per channel. Audio is never saved.
• Private channels use a key that travels only by your join code, by QR or AirDrop.

BUILT FOR EVERY SHAPE OF IPHONE
• iPhone Duo: a desk set when propped and a two-sided tent radio for the table.
• Apple Watch: talk from your wrist through your iPhone, and turn the Digital Crown to change channel.
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in StandBy.

KinnnBand is free, with every feature included.

Radios need to be within Wi-Fi or Bluetooth range of each other, or on the same Wi-Fi network. Apple Watch talks through its paired iPhone.

name: Klangheld Pro
description:
Klangheld Pro is the complete practice workshop for everyone who plays an instrument, sings or teaches. The app listens, analyzes and shows you what to work on next. Everything runs on your device: no account, no subscription, no ads, no tracking.

PRACTICE
• Practice session with microphone, metronome and live feedback
• Metronome with accents, subdivisions and tuplets
• Tuner with 36 temperaments – equal, just, historical (Werckmeister, meantone, Vallotti …), microtones, maqam and shrutis
• Tone exercise and live analysis of intonation, attack, dynamics and spectrum
• Rhythm builder, polyrhythms, cadences and accompaniment

RECORD & ANALYZE
• Audio or video recordings analyzed in depth: intonation, timing, dynamics, attack and tone
• Assessment and PDF report
• Progress: compare recordings over weeks

SHEET MUSIC
• Library: scan scores with the camera or import PDFs
• Music stand next to every recording – turn pages by tapping or with a Bluetooth pedal
• Play & check: play a piece and see which notes were off

BODY
• Findings, body map and exercise plan for breathing, posture, embouchure and grip
• Observe your posture with the camera

SPECIAL
• Fine tuner down to 1/32 tone
• Intonation trainer with flashcards

ROOM
• Noise traffic light and noise exposure for rehearsals and lessons

PRIVACY
Recordings, scores and profiles stay on your device and are stored encrypted. Klangheld Pro sends no data.

Klangheld Pro is available in 33 languages.

name: Klaus - Secret Santa
description:
Psst… someone's about to draw your name.

Klaus is the easiest way to run a Secret Santa — for friends, family, classmates and coworkers. Make a group, share one code, and Klaus does the rest. And don't worry: Klaus never tells.

 START IN SECONDS
Name your group, set a budget and an exchange date, then share one invite code or link. Everyone joins from their own phone — no sign-up forms, no spreadsheets, no paper slips in a hat.

 A FAIR DRAW, EVERY TIME
Klaus draws names for everyone in one tap. Nobody gets themselves, and you can add rules so partners or roommates don't draw each other. Not sure about the budget or the date? Run a quick group poll.

 YOUR OWN SECRET ENVELOPE
Everyone opens a private envelope to see who they're buying for. Only you know your giftee — not even the organizer can peek.

 WISH CARDS — BYE, BAD SOCKS
Fill in what you love, your sizes, favourite colours and the things you'd rather not get. Your Santa sees it, so your gift actually lands.

 CHAT IN SECRET
Ask your giftee anything without giving yourself away. Drop little clues to keep them guessing. Messages melt away after a few hours, and report and block are always one tap away.

 WHO'S YOUR SANTA?
Collect clues, make your guess before the big night, and earn bragging rights if you're right.

 ONE BIG REVEAL
Gather everyone, start the countdown together and break the seal on Reveal Night to see who had who. Then say thanks with a sticker and a note, and vote for the best gift of the year.

 MORE TO LOVE
• An advent calendar with a little surprise every day
• Birthday reminders for the people in your groups
• Not just Christmas: birthdays, Valentine's, Easter and graduation swaps too
• Available in English, Georgian, French, German, Spanish and Portuguese

 SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No account needed to start. Add your email later to keep your groups on a new phone, using a 6-digit code — no passwords. Delete your account any time from your profile.

Free, with no ads.

Questions or ideas? Write to us at secretsantaapp77@gmail.com — Klaus reads every message (and keeps every secret).

name: Ku Letter Slide
description:
Ku Letter Slide – A Fun and Addictive Puzzle Adventure!

Get ready to slide, think, and solve! Ku Letter Slide is a fun and challenging puzzle game that puts your logic and problem-solving skills to the test.

Your mission is simple: move each box across the board and deliver it to its matching letter target. But don't be fooled by its simple rules! Every level brings new challenges, tricky obstacles, and puzzles that require careful planning.

Can You Solve Every Puzzle?

Plan your moves, find the perfect path, and deliver every box to its destination. Put your brain to the test and become the ultimate Ku Letter Slide puzzle master!

name: Kultakätkö
description:
Kultakatko on puolustuspeli, jossa lohikuningas pitää linnakettaan pystyssä pimeyden tunkeilijoilta. Et pelaa automaatin varassa: jokainen loitsu on sinun valintasi.

MIKÄ TÄMÄ ON

Yön kylmyys laskeutuu linnakkeen kiville. Tornien väliin hiipii varjoja, aaveita ja kivisiä olentoja, jotka eivät tunne armoa. Linnake ei sorru hetkessä, mutta se kuluu pala palalta – ja jokainen murtuma on sinun virheesi. Linnake ei korjaudu itsestään. Se on sinun vastuullasi.

Ei rekisteröitymistä. Ei pelin sisäisiä ostoksia. Peli alkaa heti, kun avaat sen.

PELAAMINEN

Kenttä avautuu suoraan edessäsi. Linnake on alhaalla, ja sinä olet sen suojelija.

• Napauta kenttää: Tulipallo syöksyy kohti sormeasi.
• Kaksoisnapauta: Riimukilpi nousee koko kentän ylle.
• Kolmoisnapauta: Ketjasalama hyppii vihollisesta toiseen.
• Pyyhkäise ylös: Tulimyrsky syttyy ja polttaa kaiken tieltään.
• Taustan painikkeet: Kutsuvat Jäänovan ja Meteorin.

Jokainen loitsu kuluttaa energiaa. Energiaa kertyy läpäistyistä tasoista – ei lahjana, vaan ansaittuna palkkiona. Sitä ei voi ostaa. Ainoa tapa saada energiaa lisää on pelata tarkemmin ja välttää turhaa loitsimista.

TASON RAKENNE

Kampanja jakautuu viiteen lukuun ja yhteensä 20 tasoon. Kaikki luvut eivät ole heti auki.

Uusi luku avautuu, kun edellisen luvun kaikki tasot on läpäisty. Yksittäinen taso avautuu, kun saman luvun edellinen taso on suoritettu. Jokaisesta läpäistystä tasosta voit ansaita enintään kolme tähteä sen mukaan, kuinka paljon linnakkeen kestävyyttä on jäljellä. Kolme tähteä vaatii lähes koskemattoman linnakkeen.

Luvut kiristävät tahtia: luvassa on yhä tiheämpiä aaltoja, kestävämpiä vihollisia ja yhä tiukempia hetkiä aaltojen torjumiseen. Viimeinen taso ei ole pelkkää massaa – siellä sinua odottaa Pimeydentäjä.

VIHOLLISET

• Varjo imee valoa ja etenee suoraan kohti linnaketta.
• Aave liukuu suojien läpi.
• Kivinen ei pysähdy helpolla, vaikka ottaa osumaa.
• Horna hylkää maan ja kaartaa suoraan ylös.
• Jakaja halkeaa kahtia osumasta, ja molemmat osat jatkavat etenemistään.
• Pimeydentäjä hallitsee näitä kaikkia.

Kaikkien vihollisten toiminnan ja jokaisen loitsun omat tiedot löydät Codexista.

LOITSUT JA KEHITYS

Käytössäsi on kolme kehityspuuta: Lohikäärme, Siivet ja Taidot. Niiden kautta parannat muun muassa vahinkoa, kantamaa, nopeutta, suojausta, aaltojen hidastamista sekä avaat uusia loitsuja. Jokainen haara edellyttää edeltäjänsä, joten et avaa kaikkea kerralla. Käytettävissä oleva energia ratkaisee, kuinka pitkälle etenet.

Tähdet, läpäistyt tasot, kukistetut viholliset ja heitetyt loitsut tallentuvat omiin tilastoihisi, ja peli nostaa saavutuksiasi esiin sopivilla hetkillä.

SUORAAN ASIAAN

Ei pelin sisäisiä kauppoja. Ei turhaa hälyä. Ei keskeytyksiä. Sinun pelisi, sinun linnakkeesi ja sinun tapasi pitää se pystyssä.

name: KuormusVaaka
description: KuormusVaaka is a scale calculator for capacity, resolution, load cell sensitivity, table levelling, linearity and filtering. Set up a stable and repeatable weighing station that reads the true mass despite tilt, draught and floor vibration. The app works without an internet connection.

name: Laf Ebesi: Çapraz Bulmaca
description:
Laf Ebesi'ne hoş geldin evladım! İpuçlarını çöz, satırları doldur, pembe sütundaki gizli kelimeyi bul.

NASIL OYNANIR
Her bulmacada 5–8 ipucu var. Cevapları yaz, satırlar dolsun. Her satırın bir harfi pembe sütunda birleşir ve gizli kelimeyi oluşturur. Çözmeden tahmin edersen bonus coin!

50 KATEGORİ, YÜZBİNLERCE BULMACA
Türkiye, İstanbul, Osmanlı, Anadolu kültürü, futbol, hayvanlar, uzay, bilim, tarih, mutfak, deyimler ve atasözleri… Her kategoride binlerce bulmaca. Bütün ipuçları Türkçe ve özgün olarak yazıldı.

GÜNÜN BULMACASI
Her gün herkese aynı bulmaca. Çift ödül, ekstra lig puanı ve seri!

LİG, TURNUVA VE ÖDÜLLER
Kullanıcı adını seç, 50 kişilik ligde yarış. Her pazar ilk 15 üst lige çıkar. Haftalık ve aylık turnuvalarda sıralamaya gir; coin, ipucu ve SINIRSIZ CAN kazan!

DÜELLO VE ARKADAŞLAR
Arkadaşına ya da rastgele bir rakibe meydan oku: o gün en çok bulmaca çözen kazanır.

42 ROZET
Bulmaca, ustalık, günlük seri, kâşif, lig, turnuva ve düello rozetlerini topla.

- Tamamen ücretsiz, gerçek parayla satın alma yok
- Reklam yok
- Bulmacalar internetsiz de oynanır

name: Lakewise
description:
Learn Microsoft Fabric in short, game-like lessons that fit between meetings.

Follow a skill path per track (Ingest, Store, Transform, Serve, Govern, Intelligence), answer scenario-based questions, earn XP, build a daily streak and collect Bronze, Silver and Gold medals. Practice exercises let you drag and drop a real pipeline together.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Verified: every question links to the official Microsoft Learn page it is based on, with the supporting sentence quoted.
• Current: new and preview Fabric features are added regularly, without an app update.
• Role-based: pick Architect or Data Engineer and get the right lessons in the right order.
• Exam-minded: skill areas follow the DP-600 and DP-700 study guides.
• Three languages: English, Dutch and French.
• Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

TOPICS INCLUDE
OneLake, Lakehouse and Warehouse, Spark runtimes and environments, pipelines and Dataflows Gen2, mirroring, Eventhouse and real-time intelligence, Direct Lake, security and governance, CI/CD, and AI features such as data agents.

Lakewise is an independent learning app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Microsoft. Microsoft and Microsoft Fabric are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. Lessons are based on public Microsoft Learn documentation.

name: Lampada: Ukrainian Bible
description:
Lampada is a Ukrainian Orthodox library on your phone: the Bible in Metropolitan Ilarion (Ivan Ohienko)'s translation, the Gospel translated by Pylyp Morachevsky, the Apostle, the Psalter, a prayer book, canons and akathists, and a church calendar with feasts, fasts and the readings of the day. Read at home, on the go and at church. Everything works offline, with no ads and no account.

The app and all texts are in Ukrainian.

BOOKS
• The Bible translated by Ivan Ohienko, with the translator's notes
• The four Gospels translated by Pylyp Morachevsky
• The Apostle: the Acts and the Epistles in the order of the liturgical book
• The Psalter with troparia and prayers: 20 kathismata, prayers before and after reading, the Rule of Twelve Psalms
• Prayer book: morning and evening prayers, prayers before and after Holy Communion, prayers for Ukraine and its defenders, the moleben for victory, prayers for the family, the sick, the departed, travel and every need
• Canons: of repentance, to the Theotokos, to the Guardian Angel, before Holy Communion, for the sick, and the Great Canon of St Andrew of Crete
• Akathists to our Lord Jesus Christ and to the Most Holy Theotokos

CHURCH CALENDAR
• Week, month or whole-year view, 2026–2030, by the Revised Julian calendar
• Great feasts in red, as in the printed church calendar; fasts, the tone and the name of each Sunday
• The saints of every day
• The Apostle and Gospel readings for 2026, Matins Gospel included: tap one to open the passage
• Today's feast and fast under the date on the home screen

VERSE OF THE DAY
• A new verse every day on the app's home screen, a festal one on great feasts
• A Verse of the Day widget for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen

COMMEMORATION
• Your own lists of names "For health" and "For the departed", set inside a short prayer, like a paper commemoration book
• The names stay on your phone only

READING
• Continue reading where you left off
• Bookmarks on any verse or prayer
• Light, sepia and dark themes; choice of font, size and line spacing
• The screen stays on while you read, handy during services
• Red initials and rubrics, like in old church books

SEARCH
• Search words in all books at once or in one
• Jump to a reference: type «Ів 3:16» or «Пс 50»

iPHONE, iPAD AND iPHONE DUO
• On iPad in any orientation; on large screens the text sits in a comfortable column

Free: no ads, no purchases, no account.

name: Lanternline Free
description: Superbikes after dark on the real Marina Bay street layout: 19 turns between concrete walls and debris fences, the skyline in the bay. Bikes that lean, not cars on two wheels: countersteer into the corner, feel the weight move, find the trail-braking window. Four difficulty presets from Rookie to Expert, a riding school with medals, a five-round championship, replays with a helmet cam and a TV director, photo mode, and a riding analysis that tells you which corner cost you the lap. Gamepad, keyboard or tilt; the same physics on every one.

name: LanternParlor
description: Bring a lantern riddle table to your next gathering. Lantern Parlor is an offline toolkit for solving English riddles, hosting two-team rounds, and writing clues of your own. Try 24 built-in riddles across everyday objects, nature, and wordplay. Guess at your own pace, ask for hints, and review each answer. When friends join, choose a deck, name both teams, and run a timed round. The public table shows the clue and scores, while a separate host screen holds the answer and scoring controls. Save your own decks for future gatherings and use them in solo or host mode.

name: Learning Basics ABC 123
seller_name: THE WHEELCHAIR RAMP ACCESSIBILITY PROGRAM COALITION
description: Learning Basics ABC 123 is an educational app that is designed to aid in learning the English and Spanish alphabets and basic numbers. The app is straightforward and has a very clean presentation for children. The user can select to display only the alphabet, only numbers 0-9, or both. Numbers and letters can be presented in order, or scrambled. The user can choose to present numbers and sound, or silence the spoken letters.

name: Lehr Core
description:
Lehr Core keeps one glass piece on this iPhone.

Drag a surface temperature on a section. Core temperature is the surface plus thickness times rate times 0.08. A section is above strain when its core is hotter than the strain point. The named section is the hottest core still above strain.

Change the strain point and the saved surface temperatures stay as you left them. Save a run and the name stays on this iPhone, with a local notice. Compare puts each core on the strain line.

Sections and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Leonida Companion: Map & Guide
description:
Your companion for exploring Leonida. See every location on one interactive map, filter by what you are hunting, and tick things off as you find them.

MAP: thousands of pins in clear groups: collectibles, activities, crime, vehicles, shops, food and places. Search, save favourites, and jump to the next nearby location.
CHECKLISTS: progress for every category, with screenshots and notes for each location.
GUIDES: missions chapter by chapter with objectives you can tick off, cheat codes with one-tap copy, and background articles.
SEARCH: find places, missions, cheats and lore in one box.
Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Unofficial fan app. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

name: Leonida Guide: Map & Database
description:
Leonida Guide is an unofficial companion app: guide to the state of Leonida.

INTERACTIVE MAP
- A full map of the state with thousands of places: shops, food, hotels, vehicles, activities, districts and more
- Clean badges and automatic grouping, so the map stays readable at every zoom level
- Filters for every type of place, search, and a "saved only" view
- Works offline: the map tiles are built into the app

COLLECTIBLES
- Murals, dancer cards, base jumps, knife flights, hidden packages and more
- Tick items off, watch your progress grow, and jump from any item straight to its spot on the map
- Your progress is saved on your device

TROPHIES
- The full trophy list with tips for each one
- PlayStation 5 and Xbox views, each in its own colours
- A spoiler shield that keeps hidden trophies hidden until you want to see them

DATABASE AND CHEATS
- Characters, vehicles and weapons in one searchable place, with short descriptions where they are available
- The complete cheat list with button codes, for PlayStation and Xbox

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress never leaves your device.

The database is updated continuously, and the content refreshes in the background without waiting for a new app version.

Unofficial fan-made app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and related names are trademarks of their respective owners. Map data and parts of the content come from community projects (GTADB, GTA Wiki on Fandom), credited in the app.

name: Licgzm
description:
Welcome! We’ve put great care into building this product and look forward to your valuable suggestions.


Licgzm turns the things you keep into a small private museum. Catalogue a coin, a record, a stamp block, a ticket stub or a family heirloom, give it photographs and a placard, and hang it in exhibitions of your own.

Licgzm works completely offline and needs no account or login. Your catalogue and photos stay on your iPhone.

CATALOGUE EVERY PIECE
• Name, description, category, condition and quantity
• Date acquired and where or how you found it
• Estimated value per piece, with totals that respect quantity
• Storage location, so you always know which shelf, box or drawer it lives in
• Tags and personal notes for provenance and memories
• An automatic accession number for every record (CUR-2026-0001, CUR-2026-0002…)

PHOTOGRAPHS, FRAMED
• Add several photos from the camera or your library
• Choose a cover photo and reorder the rest
• Full-screen viewer with pinch and double-tap zoom

A GALLERY, NOT A SPREADSHEET
• Browse your collection as framed artwork or as a compact list
• Search names, descriptions, notes, tags and locations
• Filter by category, exhibition, condition, favourites and acquisition dates
• Sort by newest, oldest, A–Z or value

EXHIBITIONS
• Group pieces into rooms such as "Family Heirlooms" or "Tides & Harbours"
• A piece can hang in several exhibitions at once
• Pick a cover piece and write the story that ties them together

INSIGHTS
• Total entries, pieces, estimated value and favourites
• Items by category, acquisitions per year, most valuable and newest pieces
• Where your collection is stored, location by location

YOUR DATA, YOUR FILES
• Export your catalogue as CSV or as a PDF catalogue with thumbnails
• Create a full backup file (photos included) and import it again later, replacing or merging
• Recovery snapshots are taken automatically before imports and clean-ups
• Ten standard categories, plus your own custom ones

JUST LOOKING?
Licgzm opens empty and ready for your first piece. To explore first, go to Settings → Load sample data to fill the galleries with fictional sample pieces, and remove them again with one tap — your own records are never touched.

A gold-on-black design with an optional light appearance, haptic feedback and a typographic design inspired by museum placards.

name: Light Up Tower Jump
description:
A blackout has left the city in the dark. Play as a technician and climb a power tower in this one-button vertical platformer. Tap to kick off walls, dodge drones and spikes, and land on the next ledge. Your grip only lasts a moment, so make each jump count.

Start with one jump in Normal mode, unlock a double jump at 30 m and a triple jump at 120 m. Reach 1,000 m to light up the tower and city and unlock Hard mode. Keep climbing after the summit to set a new altitude record.

In 100 m Time Attack, the clock starts on your first jump. Land on a power terminal to open a shortcut and see how much time you can shave off your best run.

name: Lingventure: Çocuk İngilizcesi
description:
Lingventure, 2-8. sınıf öğrencileri için 3D bir hikâye dünyasında oynayarak İngilizce öğreten bir eğitim oyunudur. Çocuk okulda, evde, kantinde ve parkta karakterlerle İngilizce konuşur, görevleri çözer; her doğru seçimle hikâye ilerler.

MEB İNGİLİZCE PROGRAMINA GÖRE
• MEB İngilizce Dersi Öğretim Programı'nın (2-8. sınıf) 50 teması, her temada 5 hikâye: toplam 250 hikâye
• Programdaki 2.400'den fazla kelimenin tamamı hikâyelerde geçer
• Her hikâyenin sonunda bir değer: paylaşmak, yardımlaşmak, dürüstlük

İNGİLİZ AKSANIYLA SESLENDİRME
• Bütün diyaloglar British English ile seslendirildi
• Oyunun içi tamamen İngilizce; kısa görevler, resimler ve seslerle çocuk bağlamdan anlar
• Sesli cevap ve telaffuz pratiği: çocuk cümleyi söyler, hangi kelimeyi doğru söylediğini görür

OYUN GİBİ ÖĞRENME
• Karakterlerle konuşma, eşya bulma, kapı şifresi yazma, doğru rafı bulma görevleri
• Kelime defteri: öğrenilen kelimeler aralıklı tekrarla geri gelir (tanıma → dinleme → yazma)
• Mini oyunlar: cümle dizme, balon patlatma, kelime yakalama, eşleştirme, "hangisini duydun?", tema yarışması
• Kitabım: hikâyedeki seçimler çocuğun kendi kitabına dönüşür
• Ön test ve son test ile gelişim ölçümü

VELİLER İÇİN
• Hesap ve giriş yok: yalnızca bir takma ad ve sınıf seçilir, ikisi de cihazda kalır
• Reklam yok, satın alma yok, sohbet yok, yabancılarla iletişim yok
• Veli alanı kilitlidir; haftalık ilerleme raporu oradadır
• Sesler indirildikten sonra internet olmadan da oynanır

Gizlilik: https://lingventure.eminstudios.com/gizlilik/
Destek: https://lingventure.eminstudios.com/destek/

name: Liquidators
description:
Chernobyl, 26 April 1986. Unit 4 has exploded, and fallout is drifting toward Pripyat and the villages. Somebody has to go in.

Liquidators is a strategy game about the clean-up. Build crews along the fallout's path to stop it before it reaches the towns, and keep each crew alive while you do it.

EVERY DOSE COUNTS
Firefighters, dosimetrists, water trucks, bulldozers, excavators and remote-controlled robots each do a different job, and each takes radiation while they do it. The bar over every crew is its dose: at the limit they go home, and a fresh crew must take their place. Hot ground burns through crews in minutes. Robots feel nothing, until the radiation fries their electronics.

THE WHOLE CAMPAIGN
Six operations follow the real clean-up, from the first night to the sarcophagus in November: the roof fires, sand and lead from the air, the Red Forest, the rain that carries fallout into the rivers, and the race to entomb the reactor.

YOUR TOOLS
- Helicopter sorties that drop sand and lead on a cloud, or on the burning core itself
- Evacuations: buses take the people away before the fallout arrives
- A radiation map that shows where the ground is deadliest
- Reservists, upgrades and support from the Government Commission between operations

A GUIDED START
A narrated training session shows you everything, step by step, and points at exactly what to tap.

IN MEMORY
Every crew you send is written into the ledger. The game is dedicated to the hundreds of thousands of people who did this work.

name: livePlanit
description:
livePlanit puts every live-tracked race in one place. Find your race, from any timing company or race director on livePlanit, and follow it as it happens.

FOLLOW THE RACE LIVE
• A live course map with runners' positions, the course line and every timing point
• Splits as runners cross each timing mat, with pace and projected finish times
• Finish times, overall places and age-group results as soon as they post

FOLLOW YOUR RUNNERS
• Follow friends and family by name or bib number
• Get a notification at each split and at the finish
• Keep everyone you follow in one list, across races

RACING? SHARE YOUR POSITION
• Turn on GPS tracking during your race so family and friends can see where you are on the course
• You choose when tracking starts and stops
• Share your location with friends you pick, and turn it off any time

EVERY RACE IN ONE LIST
• Live now, upcoming and recent races from every organizer on livePlanit
• Recent races and their results stay in the list until the race's next edition

No account needed to follow races and view results. Create a free account to follow runners, get notifications and share your location.

livePlanit is part of the PlanitSuite family of race-day tools.

name: LocalSR: Photo Upscaler
description:
LocalSR makes small, blurry and blocky photos sharper, right on your iPhone.

Pick a photo, or share it to LocalSR from Photos or any other app. LocalSR enlarges it up to 4× and cleans up blur and JPEG blocks, then saves a new photo next to the original. Your original isn't changed.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
• No account, no sign-up, no uploads. LocalSR works offline.
• The models run on the Neural Engine. On first use, LocalSR checks which chip of your iPhone gives correct results fastest and uses it.
• A 12 MP photo takes about 2 seconds on an iPhone 17 Pro and about 6 seconds on an iPhone 11 Pro.

WHAT YOU GET
• Up to 3 MP: 4×. Up to 12 MP: 2×, or 4× with Full 4× in Settings. Larger photos are reduced to 12 MP first.
• Two models: Best for the most detail, Fast for many photos at once.
• Compare before and after with a slider and zoom in to check the details.
• "Upscale with LocalSR" in the share sheet, for one photo or many.
• Keeps the date and location of the original.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT DOES
LocalSR sharpens what is in the photo. It can add fine texture, but it can't bring back detail that isn't there: text that can't be read in the photo stays unreadable.

Free and open source (MIT): github.com/HerRei/local-upscale

name: LocaSub: Live Captions
description:
LocaSub turns speech around you into live captions and translates them as people talk. Recognition and translation run on your iPhone, so your conversations stay on your device.

LIVE CAPTIONS
Captions appear the moment someone speaks. Show both languages, the translation only, or the original only. Stage mode fills the screen with large, single-line text you can hold up or share.

FACE TO FACE
Split the screen so two people can talk across languages. Each side reads the conversation in their own language.

PICTURE IN PICTURE
Leave the app and keep captions floating over whatever you're doing.

SESSIONS YOU CAN COME BACK TO
Every session is saved with its audio. Search across sessions, replay any moment, and export as Markdown, SRT subtitles, or M4A audio.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
LocaSub has no server and no accounts. Speech recognition uses Apple's on-device speech engine, and translation uses Apple's on-device Translation. You can optionally download extra local models for faster English recognition and for titles and summaries.

Make captions look the way you like with adjustable size, colors, and background.

name: Logicpaint
description:
LOGICPAINT — PAINT BY LOGIC

Turn numbered clues into pixel art. Logicpaint is a nonogram (picross) puzzle game you buy once and own forever.

NO SUBSCRIPTIONS. NO ADS. NO INTERNET.
• Pay once, play forever — no monthly fees, no in-app purchases
• Fully offline: play on planes, subways, anywhere
• Zero data collection, no account, no tracking

PUZZLES THAT NEVER RUN OUT
• Five grid sizes: 5x5, 10x10, 15x15, 20x20, 25x25
• Four difficulty levels for every skill
• Algorithm-generated puzzles with guaranteed unique solutions
• A new daily challenge every day, with streak tracking

SOLVE YOUR WAY
• Fill, mark and clear cells with drag-to-fill
• Hints, undo/redo, conflict detection and adjustable mistake limits
• Pinch-zoom and pan on large grids

CREATE & SHARE
• Draw your own puzzles, or import a photo and turn it into a puzzle
• Export and import .logicpaint files

BUILT FOR APPLE
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and Dynamic Island widgets
• Siri Shortcuts via App Intents
• Live Activities for your solve timer
• On-device AI explanations on supported devices (iOS 26+)
• Full VoiceOver and Dynamic Type support

YOUR PUZZLES STAY YOURS
Everything is stored locally on your device. Logicpaint has no servers, requests no permissions it doesn't need, and collects no data.

Questions or support: tiansuqun@outlook.com

name: Loop Leg
description:
Loop Leg checks an expansion loop on a pipe rack.

Drag the outer leg. The original length and the temperature rise decide how long that leg must be. The pipe whose built leg falls short is named. Changing the metal does not rewrite the built leg.

Share an English line list. A lean reading stays on the iPhone and is not part of the length. There is no account and nothing to buy.
```

name: LoreStudioApp
description:
Bring your imagination to life with a creative studio for building fictional characters, designing worlds, writing dialogue, and organizing original stories.

Whether you enjoy character design, creative writing, worldbuilding, or visual storytelling, everything you need to develop your ideas is available in one place.

CREATE ORIGINAL CHARACTERS

- Create and customize detailed character profiles.
- Add portraits and avatars from your own photo library.
- Define personalities, appearances, interests, backgrounds, and speaking styles.
- Organize characters by categories, tags, and fictional worlds.
- Design personalized character cards.

BUILD YOUR OWN WORLDS

- Create fictional worlds with unique settings and descriptions.
- Organize locations, groups, characters, and important events.
- Connect characters through a visual relationship map.
- Manage background information and story timelines.

CRAFT DIALOGUE & CHAT SCENES

- Write and edit conversations between fictional characters.
- Customize dialogue, character expressions, and scene backgrounds.
- Add images, sound effects, and timing to your scenes.
- Preview your written conversations with animated playback.

PLAN & DEVELOP STORIES

- Organize stories into chapters and individual scenes.
- Build visual storyboards and arrange story sequences.
- Create alternative story paths and dialogue choices.
- Develop your own story ideas using customizable templates.

DESIGN & EXPORT

- Create visual character cards with customizable layouts.
- Present your dialogue scenes with animated effects.
- Export your creative projects as images, videos, or supported document formats.
- Back up and restore your projects using local files.

EXPLORE SAMPLE PROJECTS

Get started with included sample characters, fictional worlds, dialogue scenes, and storyboards. Explore how the creative tools work, customize existing examples, or build something entirely your own.

YOUR CREATIVITY, YOUR SPACE

All creative tools work offline. Your projects, imported images, and written content are stored locally on your device.

No account is required. Conversations are fictional scenes written and edited by you, rather than live messaging or automated character responses.

Designed for both iPhone and iPad, with an intuitive interface that makes it easy to create, organize, and revisit your imaginative projects.

Create characters. Build worlds. Tell your own stories.

Subscription and Payment Rules:

1. Subscriptions are processed through the Apple App Store. Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon purchase confirmation.
2. All subscriptions automatically renew 24 hours before the current subscription period expires. You can cancel auto-renewal at any time. To avoid the next renewal charge, please cancel at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
3. Renewal fees will be charged to your Apple ID account within 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period, at the rate of your selected plan. No refunds will be issued after a successful renewal.
4. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time by going to iPhone Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/cem-apps-center/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/cem-apps-center/privacy-policy

name: Ludo Nile
description:
Play Ludo Nile offline on iPhone or iPad. Challenge the computer or share one device with family and friends. Choose two, three or four players and take turns rolling the die and moving your pieces.

In River Sprint, each player has two pieces and starts with one on the board. In Classic, all four pieces start in the yard. Roll the exact number to reach home and bring all your pieces home to win.

Your match is saved on your device so you can pick up where you left off. Switch between Arabic and English and turn the sound on or off while you play.

name: Macaron Lane
description:
Swap sweets, line up three or more of a kind, and help Maca open a whole street of little pastry shops.

Macaron Lane is a cosy match-three puzzle game. Every level has an order to fill and a set number of moves: clear the sweets it asks for, open cake boxes, scrape away the icing and untie the ribbons before the moves run out. Plan your swaps and set off chains for more stars.

SPECIAL SWEETS
• Line up four for a striped sweet that clears a whole row or column.
• Make an L or T shape for a bomb, or a square of four for a whirl that flies to where it's needed.
• Line up five for a rainbow that clears every sweet of one colour.
• Moves you don't use become a sweet shower at the end of the level.

THE LANE
• Each shop has 10 carefully tuned levels. Finish them to open the next shop along the street, and earn stars to decorate it.
• Win coins to spend on boosters: the hammer, row and column clears, and a shuffle.
• Collect stars and each shop decorates itself: a gilded sign, a flower box and fairy lights.
• Stuck on a level? After a few tries the game quietly lends a hand.

MADE TO BE CALM
• Maca, a pistachio macaron in a raspberry beret, explains each new piece as it appears.
• Gentle music, sounds and haptics you can switch off.
• Plays offline. Your progress syncs across your devices with iCloud.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts and no tracking. Coins are earned by playing, never bought. Nothing is sent unless you choose: anonymous usage counts and crash reports are both off until you agree when asked or turn them on in Settings.

name: Making The List
description:
Make Christmas planning feel lighter. Create a private family, build wish lists, share product links and photos, and keep every surprise organized.

Adults can reserve gifts, record what they paid, and track delivery and wrapping without revealing those details to the recipient. Family roles keep shopping information private, while each person can manage their own list. Parents can also create PIN-protected child profiles for list-only use on a shared device, with no child email or signup required.

Making The List also includes money wishes, private invitations, profiles for people who do not use the app, shared family gifts, profile photos, spending totals, safety reporting, and family-owner blocking controls. Your family data is never used for advertising or cross-app tracking.

name: Malarker
description:
Malarker is a bluffing word game for 3 to 9 friends in the same room, each playing on their own iPhone. One person hears a strange word, everyone else explains what it means, and only one of them is telling the truth.

How it works

Each round, one player is the Mastermind. Everyone else gets a secret role on their phone. One of them, the Truth-Teller, sees the real definition. The rest are Bluffers, and they have to invent a definition on the spot and sell it.

Everyone gives their explanation out loud. Then the Mastermind picks the one they think is honest. If they’re right, they and the Truth-Teller both score. If they’re wrong, the Bluffer they picked takes the points.

Ready to play in under a minute
You don’t need to prepare anything or hunt for obscure words. Malarker comes with over 300 hand-picked terms, from rare words and niche jargon to odd facts and slang. Each word has a real definition you can check, plus a pronunciation guide so nobody stumbles on the first syllable.

Your phone keeps the secret
Tap and hold to see your role. Let go and it’s covered again, so the person next to you can’t sneak a look. Nobody has to say “everyone close your eyes,” and nobody gets stuck being the dealer.

Everyone plays, nobody runs the game
Malarker tracks whose turn it is to speak, rotates the Mastermind, and keeps score. That means the friend who usually runs game night finally gets to play too.

A reveal everyone sees at once
When the Mastermind locks in a pick, the answer appears on every phone at the same moment. You’ll know right away who fooled the table.

Join in seconds
Share a room code, a link, or a QR code. There are no accounts and no sign-up. Just pick a nickname and an emoji and you’re in.

A full game takes about 30 minutes with 4 to 6 players. It works for parties, dinners, dorm nights, and groups who’ve only just met. Every player needs an iPhone and an internet connection.

Download Malarker, get your friends around the table, and find out who’s the best liar you know.

name: Malbat
description:
Mala Haco & Izêr signifie « la famille de Haco et Izêr ».

Malbat est l'arbre généalogique privé de votre famille, dans votre poche. « Malbat » veut dire « famille » en kurde.

Parcourez votre arbre
• Un arbre interactif : déplacez-vous, zoomez à deux doigts, recentrez-le sur n'importe quel membre
• Une fiche par personne : parents, frères et sœurs, unions, enfants, dates, lieux, événements, notes et photos
• Une recherche qui ignore les accents, pour retrouver un proche même sans le clavier de sa langue
• La liste des noms de famille et les statistiques de l'arbre

Enrichissez-le ensemble
• Corrigez une date, ajoutez un enfant, un conjoint, des parents, un événement, une note ou une photo
• Chaque contribution est vérifiée par l'administrateur de l'arbre avant d'apparaître
• Suivez vos propositions : en attente, acceptée ou refusée

Un espace privé
• Rien ne s'affiche sans compte : l'arbre n'est visible que par les membres de la famille
• L'administrateur invite chacun par un lien relié à sa fiche ; sans invitation, vous pouvez demander un compte en expliquant qui vous êtes
• Les photos ne sont jamais publiques et leurs données de localisation sont retirées
• Aucune publicité, aucun pistage

Pour l'administrateur de l'arbre
• Validez ou refusez les propositions et les demandes de compte depuis votre téléphone
• Envoyez les invitations par SMS, WhatsApp ou e-mail

Sans connexion, retrouvez votre fiche et ce que vous avez ouvert récemment.

Langues : français, English, Türkçe, Kurdî.

Malbat fonctionne avec le site malbat.org. Un compte est nécessaire pour utiliser l'application.

name: Marina Jam
description:
The marina is packed and the golden yacht wants to head out to sea. Slide the other boats back and forth to clear its way to the harbour mouth.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a boat forwards or backwards along its length
• Stone jetties and pontoons never move: work around them
• When the way is clear, sail the golden yacht out between the red and green lights

FEATURES
• 100 levels across 10 harbours, from Terracina and Capri to Monaco, Mykonos and Dubrovnik
• Every level is checked by computer: you always see the fewest moves possible
• Three stars for the best solution, unlimited Undo
• Harbours grow from 6×6 to 8×8 berths, with jetties in the middle of the basin
• Endless Regatta after level 100
• Hints when you get stuck
• No timers, no ads, works offline

name: Markeťáčik
description:
Markeťáčik je slovenský marketingový systém pre malé firmy, živnostníkov a agentúry. 73 nástrojov v jednej appke: sociálne siete, e-maily, weby, reklamy, faktúry aj umelá inteligencia. Váš marketing bez agentúry, v telefóne vždy po ruke.

SOCIÁLNE SIETE
Príspevky na celý mesiac dopredu. Kalendár publikácií, AI návrhy textov a hashtagov, plán pre Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn aj TikTok a redakčný plán pre každého klienta.

E-MAIL MARKETING
Kampane bez Mailchimpu. Vizuálny editor a hotové šablóny, AI napíše text e-mailu, automatické sekvencie a prehľad otvorení, klikov a odhlásení.

AI STUDIO
Váš osobný marketér. Články, e-maily, príspevky aj reklamy za sekundy, v tóne vašej značky.

WEBY A SEO
Viete, kde ste v Googli. Pozície kľúčových slov, landing pages a formuláre, monitoring dostupnosti webov a sledovanie konkurencie.

FAKTÚRY A CESŤÁKY
Aj papiere sú vyriešené. Faktúry, zálohy a cenové ponuky s QR platbou, párovanie platieb z banky, kniha jázd, cestovné príkazy a výkazy práce.

KLIENTI A PROJEKTY
Adresár klientov, obchodné príležitosti, projekty, úlohy a tikety s upozornením na to dôležité.

BEZPEČNOSŤ
Každá firma má vlastnú databázu. Šifrovanie, denné zálohy, dvojstupňové prihlásenie a súlad s GDPR.

V APPKE
1. Upozornenia na nové tikety, termíny a správy
2. Prihlásenie uloženým heslom alebo cez Face ID
3. Faktúry a exporty uložíte do telefónu alebo pošlete ďalej
4. Apple Watch: dnešné príspevky, vaše úlohy a tikety na zápästí

Prihlásite sa rovnakým e-mailom a heslom ako na moj.marketacik.sk.

name: MathGeeks Graphing Calculator
description:
A full graphing calculator built for algebra, trigonometry and precalculus students, with the familiar handheld-calculator layout used in class.

TYPE IT THE WAY IT LOOKS
• Enter fractions, square roots and powers the way they're written on paper
• Get exact answers: √12 shows as 2√3, sin(π/3) as √3/2, 2/3 + 1/4 as 11/12
• Switch between fraction and decimal with one key
• RAD/DEG toggle, π, e, logs and inverse trig

GRAPH AND EXPLORE
• Enter up to six Y= functions, each in its own color
• TRACE along any curve and read the coordinates
• View a table of values for every function
• ZOOM and WINDOW controls to frame your graph

BUILT-IN PROGRAMS
• QUADS: enter a quadratic and see standard, vertex and factored form, the vertex, the axis of symmetry and which way it opens
• TRIG: graph sine, cosine and tangent, or build a trig equation from a maximum and minimum point, then step through the key points

MADE FOR STUDENTS
• Works completely offline, so it's ready in class, at home or on the bus
• Light tap feedback on every key
• Share any screen as a picture to send to a teacher, tutor or classmate
• No ads, no accounts, no data collected

Made by Math Geeks Tutoring, Manhattan Beach, CA.

name: Matix POS
seller_name: SISMATIX INTERNATIONAL CO FOR COMPUTER INFORMATION SYSTEM SERVICES WLL
description:
Matix POS — نقطة بيع كاملة تعمل على الآيفون والآيباد.

سجّل مبيعاتك، اطبع فواتيرك، وتابع مخزونك من جهاز واحد. التطبيق جزء من نظام Matix ERP، فكل بيعة تصل حساباتك في نفس اللحظة.

• بيع سريع
امسح الباركود أو اختر الصنف من القائمة. أضف خصماً على سطر أو على الفاتورة كلها، واقبل الدفع نقداً أو بالبطاقة أو مقسّماً بينهما.
• طباعة مباشرة على الطابعة الحرارية
الجهاز يرسل الفاتورة للطابعة على شبكة المحل مباشرة — بدون كمبيوتر ولا برنامج وسيط. يكفي عنوان الطابعة مرة واحدة.
• يدعم العربية والإنجليزية بالكامل
الواجهة والفواتير بالعربية الصحيحة، وتبديل اللغة بضغطة واحدة.
• طلبات محلية وتوصيل واستلام
افتح طلباً، علّقه، وارجع له بعدين. تابع طلبات التوصيل وسائقيها.
• عملاء ونقاط ولاء
اربط الفاتورة بعميل، واحسب نقاطه تلقائياً.
• تقارير ووردية
افتح ورديتك وأقفلها بتقرير Z كامل.

• يعمل على الآيفون والآيباد
نفس الحساب، ونفس البيانات، على أي جهاز.
Matix POS للمحلات التي لديها اشتراك في نظام Matix. للاشتراك تواصل معنا.

name: MealCue: Cook Together
description:
One meal. Better timing.

MealCue helps coordinate the dishes you cook together. Save your meal, enter each dish’s estimated duration, and follow a plan that works backwards from a shared serving time.

• Save reusable meals with up to eight dishes.
• Start individual timers when cooking actually begins.
• Running late? Add five or ten minutes to pending starts without extending food already cooking.
• Resume saved plans and countdowns after reopening the app.
• Enable optional local reminders to start or check food.

ON IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH
Saved meals sync directly between your paired iPhone and Apple Watch. Start a cooking session on either device and view its latest received state on the companion. Start, finish and delay controls remain on the device that began the session. Offline updates wait for connectivity; companion views may be out of date while disconnected. iPad supports local planning and timers without Watch pairing.

FREE TO USE
No account, ads, subscriptions, analytics, or developer-hosted backend. Your plans stay on your devices.

You choose the durations. MealCue is a timing aid, not a doneness or food-safety detector. Always supervise cooking and check safe holding conditions. Notification delivery depends on your device settings.

name: Mémo INC
description:
Mémo INC est l'aide-mémoire de poche du sapeur-pompier pour la lutte contre les incendies de structure. Il fonctionne entièrement hors ligne.

101 FICHES COURTES ET ILLUSTRÉES, EN 9 RUBRIQUES
• Connaître le feu : combustion, transferts de chaleur, flashover, backdraft, FGI
• Lecture du feu et risques
• Tactique et MGO : les 11 critères, AIDES, attaque de transition, repli défensif
• Eau et établissements : DECI, poteaux et bouches, LDT, division, pertes de charge
• Techniques d'extinction : gas cooling, extinction directe, indirecte, combinée, pré-backdraft
• ARI et milieu vicié : binôme, contrôle croisé, 270 bar, autonomie, recherches
• Sauvegarde opérationnelle : règle des minimums, NELAR, gestion de l'air
• Sauvetages et mises en sécurité : échelles, facteur de chute, syndrome du harnais
• Ventilation opérationnelle : ventilation d'attaque, antiventilation, stoppeur de fumée, CO

Chaque fiche tient sur un écran : les valeurs clés en tête, un schéma, les points d'attention et la référence du document source.

CALCULATEUR HYDRAULIQUE
Décrivez votre établissement tronçon par tronçon (70 puis 45, division à 2 lances…) : l'app estime les pertes de charge et la pression à mettre à la pompe. Elle donne aussi l'autonomie de la réserve d'eau selon le débit.

204 QCM POUR RÉVISER
Par rubrique ou sur tout le programme, en QCM ou en cartes.

PRATIQUE
• Recherche instantanée par mot-clé
• Favoris et notes personnelles sur chaque fiche
• Mode sombre
• Aucune publicité, aucun compte, aucune donnée collectée

SOURCES
Les fiches résument les documents de doctrine publiés par la DGSCGC (ministère de l'Intérieur) : GDO « Interventions sur les incendies de structures » et GTO « Établissements et techniques d'extinction », « Engagement en milieu vicié », « Sauvegarde opérationnelle », « Sauvetages et mises en sécurité », « Ventilation opérationnelle ».

Mémo INC est un aide-mémoire pédagogique. Il ne remplace ni la formation ni les consignes de votre SDIS et du COS. Application indépendante, ni éditée ni validée par la DGSCGC ou un SDIS.

Conçue par un sapeur-pompier professionnel.

name: Mémo SR
description:
Mémo SR est l'aide-mémoire de poche du sapeur-pompier en secours routier. Il fonctionne entièrement hors ligne.

69 FICHES COURTES ET ILLUSTRÉES
• Doctrine et marche générale : MGO, les 5 i, zonage, lecture de l'accident
• Sécurité et EPI
• Matériels : outils hydrauliques, vérins, étais, coussins de levage
• Énergies et véhicules : électriques, hybrides, GPL, GNV, hydrogène, airbags
• Véhicule sur ses roues, sur le côté, sur le toit : stabilisation, ouvertures, pavillon, tableau de bord, tunnel
• Techniques complémentaires et poids lourds
• Signalisation temporaire d'urgence
• Incendies de véhicules

Chaque fiche tient sur un écran : les valeurs clés en tête, un schéma et les points d'attention.

144 QCM POUR RÉVISER
Par thème ou sur tout le programme, en QCM ou en cartes.

PRATIQUE
• Recherche instantanée par mot-clé
• Favoris et notes personnelles
• Mode sombre
• Gratuite, sans publicité, sans compte, aucune donnée collectée

SOURCE
Les fiches de doctrine, d'énergies et d'incendies résument le guide de doctrine opérationnelle « Opérations de secours en milieu routier » (DGSCGC, juillet 2025).

Mémo SR est un aide-mémoire pédagogique. Il ne remplace ni la formation, ni les consignes de votre SDIS et du COS, ni la fiche d'aide à la décision du véhicule. Application indépendante, ni éditée ni validée par la DGSCGC ou un SDIS.

name: MeowParty
description: MeowParty helps you compose playful cat party scenes on your iPhone. Build a timeline with characters, soundscapes, particles, and ambience, then preview the show on a local stage.
