Capture meows in Sound Lab for fun tags you can send into Workshop. Keep cat profiles and behavior logs in Archive, or start from Gallery templates. Create and save everything on your device with no social feed required.

name: Mercy Property
description:
Mercy Property handles your UK property for you, wherever in the world you live.

Buying or renting from abroad? We view homes on your behalf and send you photos, video and honest notes. Selling? We manage the whole sale and deal with the estate agent for you. Own a rental? We look after your property, tenants and rent.

Your account keeps everything in one place:
- Track every request step by step, from booking to completion
- Get an alert on your phone when your request moves forward, a message arrives or a payment is confirmed
- Message our team directly and get replies in the app
- Upload documents by photo or file, and receive documents securely
- See exactly what you owe and how to pay, in pounds or in Naira

WHAT WE DO
- Viewing on your behalf: £50 plus transport, with a full report after the visit
- Track a property you view yourself: £20
- Solicitor introduction: £150, to a regulated UK solicitor
- Mortgage broker introduction: £150
- Tenancy and move-in support when renting: from £50
- Managed sale: £50 to start, and £1,000 only when your home sells
- Property management: tailored quote
- Initial consultation: free

FIND PROPERTIES FAST
Search Rightmove, Zoopla and OnTheMarket by location, then paste a listing link straight into your account and we take it from there.

PAY YOUR WAY
Pay by bank transfer to our UK account. Customers in Nigeria can pay in Naira, using today's UK dealer rate. Our services are delivered in person in the UK and are paid for outside the app.

Mercy Property is a trading name of MERCYPROPERTY LIMITED, registered in England and Wales (company number 13542622).

Questions? Email info@mercyproperty.com, WhatsApp +44 7417 465478 or visit mercyproperty.com

name: Midnight Assembly
description:
At midnight, the toy store comes alive. And the toys don't want you to leave.

Sneak through dark aisles with your flashlight, search gift boxes for keys and tools, and pull the levers that unlock the exit before the big clock strikes 6. Get caught and you're locked in a cage, so hide, sneak and be clever.

- 6 nights in each world, and every night is different: colour codes, blackouts, early risers and a guard at the door
- A boss on night 6: get past the Giant Soldier and the Big Cat
- Two worlds: the Toy Store and the Pet Store
- Collect 12 stickers to unlock flashlight colours and silly hats
- Three difficulties: Peaceful, Nightmare and Extreme
- Play in 3D first-person or the classic top-down view

Spooky, not gory. No ads, no accounts, no chat and no tracking.

Midnight Assembly was dreamed up by an 8-year-old game designer, Omark, and built with his dad.

name: Mini Crazy Eights: Card Game
description:
Crazy Eights, you against the CPU.

Mini Crazy Eights is the family card game for iPhone and Apple Watch: seven cards each, a top card to match, and an 8 that changes everything.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Match the top card by suit or rank — or play an 8 and call the suit
• Draw until you can play; pass only when the stock can't help
• Go out first to score the cards left in the other hand — 8s count 50
• First to 100 wins the game

CHOOSE YOUR OPPONENT
Relaxed plays any card that fits, 8s included. Steady keeps its 8s and calls the suit it holds most of. Sharp also steers play toward the suits you have drawn on.

BUILT FOR BOTH SCREENS
• iPhone: the table, your hand and the suit to match, in one view
• Apple Watch: the top card, the called suit and only your playable cards
• One download covers both

FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS
A coffee, a queue, the last ten minutes of a commute. Open it and deal.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO WI-FI NEEDED
Everything runs on-device. Your record stays on your phone.

name: Mini Cribbage: Card Game
description:
Two-handed cribbage, you against the CPU.

Mini Cribbage is the full game for iPhone and Apple Watch: deal six cards each, lay two away to the crib, cut the starter, then peg, count and race to 121.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Discard two to the crib and cut the starter
• Peg to 31 — fifteens, pairs, runs and the last card
• Count every hand and the crib: flushes, nobs and his heels
• First to 121 wins; win with the loser under 91 and it's a skunk

CHOOSE YOUR OPPONENT
Relaxed keeps the best hand on average and plays safe. Steady is the full game. Sharp watches what you keep and holds out for a lower count as the game runs down.

A HINT WHEN YOU NEED ONE
Stuck on a discard or a peg? Ask for a hint and see the play the engine would make, and what it scores.

BUILT FOR BOTH SCREENS
• iPhone: the score lanes, the count, your hand and the crib in one view
• Apple Watch: the scores, the count and your cards, with one main button
• One download covers both

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO WI-FI NEEDED
Everything runs on-device. Your record stays on your phone.

name: Mini Gin Rummy: Card Game
description:
Gin rummy to 100, you against the CPU.

Mini Gin Rummy is the classic game for iPhone and Apple Watch: ten cards each, one discard, and a race to meld before your opponent does.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Draw from the stock or take the discard, then discard one
• The engine finds your best arrangement — runs, sets and the least deadwood
• Knock at 10 or go gin, with lay-offs, undercuts and the 25-point bonus
• First to 100 wins the game

CHOOSE YOUR OPPONENT
Relaxed knocks late and only picks up cards it can meld. Steady is the full game. Sharp watches what you pick up and holds out for a lower count as the stock runs down.

BUILT FOR BOTH SCREENS
• iPhone: your arrangement, the deadwood count and the draw, in one view
• Apple Watch: the scores, the stock and your cards, with one main button
• One download covers both

FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS
A coffee, a queue, the last ten minutes of a commute. Open it and deal.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO WI-FI NEEDED
Everything runs on-device. Your record stays on your phone.

name: Mini Solitaire: Klondike
description:
A proper game of Klondike, built for the spare minute.

Mini Solitaire is Klondike solitaire for iPhone and Apple Watch. Seven columns, four homes, one deck — with tap-to-move cards, unlimited undo and a hint when the table goes quiet.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap a card to send it Home, or onto a Column — the app picks the legal move
• Draw 1 or Draw 3, set once and kept for the next deal
• Unlimited undo, plus Auto-move for the housekeeping
• A Hint when you're stuck, worked out from the cards on show

A DAILY DEAL
Every day brings a new deal, the same for everyone. Solve it to build a streak; the clock runs while you play.

BUILT FOR BOTH SCREENS
• iPhone: the whole table — stock, waste and all seven columns — in one view
• Apple Watch: the top card of each column, with Draw, Move and Auto-move on the wrist
• One download covers both

FOR THE IN-BETWEEN MOMENTS
A coffee, a queue, the last ten minutes of a commute. Open it and deal.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS, NO WI-FI NEEDED
Everything runs on-device. Your record and daily streak stay on your phone.

name: MiniTerminal: Agentic Terminal
description:
MiniTerminal is an SSH and Mosh terminal for iPhone and iPad.

TERMINAL
• Terminal emulation by libghostty-vt: 24-bit color, mouse reporting, bracketed paste, hyperlinks and Kitty images
• A key bar with esc, ctrl, alt, tab and an arrow joystick; choose, order and hide its keys
• Hardware keyboards and trackpads, several windows on iPad, external displays
• Themes, fonts and VoiceOver support

CONNECTIONS
• SSH with passwords, keys, keyboard-interactive login and one-time codes (TOTP)
• Mosh, for sessions that survive network changes
• Jump hosts, local, remote and dynamic port forwarding, and connection reuse
• tmux: pick a session when you connect, switch windows from the sidebar, come back to the same session after a reconnect
• SFTP file browser with previews
• Automatic reconnect after a dropped connection

KEYS AND SECURITY
• Generate keys on the device, or protect one with Face ID in the Secure Enclave
• Passwords and keys stay in the iOS Keychain; a changed host key is always shown as a warning
• Optional iCloud Sync for hosts, identities, snippets and settings, and, if you choose, passwords and keys through iCloud Keychain

MORE
• Command snippets you can type into any session with one tap
• Log Location While Connected: records where each session was connected in the on-device event log
• Agent (optional): bring your own Anthropic API key and Claude can work the app and the terminal for you; it asks before anything sensitive

No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Minna de Daifugo
description:
No deck of cards? No problem. Your iPhones are all you need for Daifugo!
Minna de Daifugo is a local multiplayer version of Daifugo (President / Tycoon / Scum), the classic Japanese card game, for friends in the same room. No internet, no Wi-Fi, no account, no pairing: one person creates a room, everyone else opens the app and joins. Your hand shows only on your own iPhone, so the bluffing and suspense feel just like the real thing.
No internet connection or account is needed. There are no ads and no in-app purchases.

PERFECT FOR
- Parties, family gatherings, camping, school trips and long train rides
- Places with no signal, or when you don't want to use mobile data
- Whenever you forgot to bring a deck of cards

FEATURES
- No internet, Wi-Fi or sign-up needed. No server involved
- Easy connection: "Create room" or "Join room" with a 4-digit room number
- 3 to 6 players in total, humans and CPU players together
- Not enough friends? CPU players fill the empty seats, so you can start with just 1, 2 or 3 people
- Your hand is private. Everyone can see the field and how many cards each player has left
- Cards you can't play are dimmed automatically, so beginners can follow along
- 8 Stop, Revolution, Spade 3 Counter and more come with animations, sound effects and vibration
- Card exchange from the 2nd game on: Tycoon and Rich choose which cards to hand over
- Rankings per game plus running totals (Tycoon +2 / Rich +1 / Commoner 0 / Poor -1 / Beggar -2). Points are just game scores: no money or betting of any kind
- If someone disconnects, the game waits 20 seconds, then a CPU steps in; when the player returns, they take over right away
- Closed the app by accident? Tap "Resume" on the home screen to pick up where you left off
- Available in English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese

HOUSE RULES YOU CAN CHOOSE
Pick your favorite rules when you create a room (only Revolution is on by default).
- Revolution (4 of a kind reverses card strength)
- 8 Stop (playing an 8 clears the field)
- Spade 3 Counter (the 3 of Spades beats a single Joker)
- Fall from Grace (if the Tycoon doesn't finish 1st, they drop to Beggar)
- Sequence (3 or more consecutive cards of the same suit) / Sequence Revolution (5 or more)
- Jack Back (playing a J reverses strength until the field clears)
- Suit Lock (if the same suit repeats, only that suit can be played)
- Illegal Finish (finishing with an 8, Joker, Spade 3, etc. is a foul)
- Number of Jokers (0 to 2)
Daifugo is also known as "Daihinmin" in some regions. The rules are always available inside the app with the "Rules" button.

HOW TO PLAY
1. One person taps "Create room", chooses a nickname, player count and rules, and goes to the lobby
2. Everyone else taps "Join room", picks the nearby room and enters a nickname
3. The host taps "Start" and the cards are dealt (CPU players fill any empty seats)
4. Take turns playing cards or passing. The first to empty their hand becomes the Tycoon!
5. Tap "Next game" to exchange cards and play another round, as many times as you like

PLAY ALONE TOO
Create a room and tap "Add CPU" to play against computer players on a single iPhone.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Turn on Bluetooth. iOS asks for Bluetooth permission the first time you use it. The app does not use your location
- Nicknames are shared only with nearby players over Bluetooth. There is no chat
- Everyone playing together needs this app on their own device
- Connections work best when everyone is nearby, such as in the same room. Keep the app open while you play

Gather your friends and let the best player rise to Tycoon!

name: MinuteSlate
description:
Keep meeting notes, decisions and the next action in one place.

Create a meeting with its calendar date, participants and context. Add notes or decisions in sequence, then create actions with an owner, optional due date and notes. Preview the current meeting summary before sharing it.

Follow actions across meetings with open, completed or overdue filters and search by task, owner or meeting. Complete or reopen an action as work changes. Archive a meeting while keeping its actions available, or confirm deletion of the meeting and its records together.

MinuteSlate uses local calendar dates. Today is not overdue, and completed actions are excluded from overdue results. It does not record audio, transcribe meetings, send invitations or deliver background reminders.

Core records are stored locally, with no app account, advertising SDK or analytics SDK. Settings can export or delete local records. The app includes a read-only online-destination configuration feature. At launch and each return to the foreground, a valid enabled HTTPS destination may open automatically through the system. When unavailable, the app restores local features. About provides the current status, refresh and manual-open controls. External websites have their own data practices.

name: Mira: Try On Outfits
description:
Mira puts your whole wardrobe in your pocket, tidy and easy to browse, and lets you see yourself in an outfit before you put it on.

YOUR WARDROBE
• Photograph your clothes or choose photos from your library. Mira removes the background on your iPhone, so every piece looks clean.
• Add many photos at once.
• Browse by Tops, Bottoms, Dresses, Shoes and Other.

OUTFITS
• Pick pieces and arrange them on a canvas: drag them around and pinch to resize.
• Save outfits, edit them later, and share them as a picture.
• Not sure what to wear? Today's outfit suggests a combination from your own clothes.

TRY IT ON
• Add one full-body photo of yourself and see yourself wearing any outfit, created by AI.
• 3 free try-ons every day.
• Try-on shows the look, not the fit.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads.
• Your wardrobe stays on your iPhone.
• Your photo leaves your iPhone only to create a try-on, and only after you agree. Mira's server doesn't keep it.

name: Mocka Warriors
description:
MOCKA WARRIORS is an old-school beat 'em up with 16-bit pixel art and a chiptune soundtrack, set in the streets of São Paulo.

You are MOCKABOY, a punk from the MockaBoyz electronic duo, and the city has been taken over by neo-nazi gangs. Your mission is simple: KILL ALL THE NZS!!!

STAGE 1 – ROLÊ NO CENTRO
Fight your way through downtown São Paulo, from the streets to the doors of Madame Satã, where the boss JOSEF M and his nunchaku are waiting for you.

STAGE 2 – BACK TO MOOCA ROOTS
Head to the old industrial neighbourhood of Mooca at night. The gangs are back – and now the MOTOHEAD bikers come crossing the screen on their motorcycles. Knock them down before they run you over!

STAGE 3 – A NIGHT IN SANTOS
Hit the seafront of Santos at night, from the clubs to the cathedral square. The FUNKEIRO and PLAYBOY gangs rule the streets, and the DELIVERY DE MAGRELA riders come pedaling across the screen. Grab the CHAPINHA bottles for extra points and get ready: at the end, not one but two SURFISTA CALHORDA are waiting for you at the BNH!

FEATURES
• Classic side-scrolling brawler action
• Punches, kicks, combos and flying kicks
• Pick up the baseball bat and use it against the gang
• A lot of Enemies to defeat!
• BONUS: grab the MiniDisc to become invincible for 15 seconds – in stage 2 your hits are twice as strong. Also grab the bottles to earn point!
• Original chiptune music by The MockaBoyz 
• Touch controls designed for iPhone and iPad

Powered by The MockaBoyz. Programmed by VJSpetto.
The MockaBoyz are VJ Spetto & Beto Noffs.

name: Monexio
description:
Welcome! We take every piece of feedback seriously and look forward to hearing from you.


Monexio is a cosy, colourful home for the words you type again and again. Save message templates, links and notes once — then copy them in a single tap.

FILL IN THE BLANKS
Write templates with placeholders like {name}, {date} or {next step}. When you tap Fill & copy, Monexio asks for each value, shows a live preview and puts the finished text on your clipboard. {date} fills in today's date for you.

FOLDERS THAT FEEL REAL
Your collections appear as file folders in a bright two-column grid. Give each one a name, a colour and a symbol, then tap it and watch it open into its clips. Move clips between collections any time; delete a collection and its clips simply move to Unfiled.

THREE KINDS OF CLIPS
• Templates — replies, emails and messages with optional placeholders
• Links — a title and URL you can copy or open in your browser
• Notes — anything you want close at hand

FIND ANYTHING FAST
• One big search bar looks through titles, text, links, tags and collection names, with matches highlighted
• Filter by one or more tags and by type
• Sort by most recent, A–Z or most used
• Star your favourites and keep them in their own tab
• Recently used shows the last eight clips you copied or opened

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• One clear confirmation and a light haptic each time you copy
• Use counts and "last used" times on every clip
• Duplicate a clip to make a variation in seconds
• Light and dark appearance

YOUR DATA, ON YOUR IPHONE
Monexio needs no account and no sign-in. An internet connection is needed to open the app; once inside, you can use your local clip library offline. Export a JSON backup file and import it again whenever you like, or export every clip as a plain text file through the share sheet. Recovery snapshots are saved automatically before imports and clean-ups so you can step back if needed.

WANT TO LOOK AROUND FIRST?
Monexio starts empty and ready for your own clips. Open Settings and tap Load sample data to explore with realistic examples, then remove them in one tap — your own clips are never touched.

You can choose to share crash reports and usage statistics to help improve Monexio. Your clips are never uploaded.

name: Mono Timer
seller_name: DIONIS RODRIGO MOREIRA TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMACAO LTDA
description:
Mono Timer é o cronômetro de treino para quem leva o treino a sério. Simples, direto e com números grandes, para você enxergar o tempo de longe enquanto treina.

TABATA E INTERVALOS
Monte seus treinos com rondas, ciclos, exercícios e descansos. Defina a preparação inicial e o descanso entre ciclos, reordene os intervalos arrastando e acompanhe quantas rondas faltam.

TIMER
Um timer progressivo para contar o tempo total do seu treino.

CRONÔMETRO
Configure a preparação e o tempo de exercício e deixe o app conduzir o treino.

TREINO REAL
Organize grupos que entram em momentos diferentes do treino. O app avisa com um sinal sonoro quando é a vez de cada grupo começar.

FEITO PARA A ACADEMIA
• Números grandes e alto contraste
• Alertas sonoros nos últimos segundos e no fim de cada intervalo
• Modo paisagem para deixar o celular apoiado
• Suas configurações ficam salvas no aparelho
• Sem cadastro, sem anúncios e sem coleta de dados

name: MopedKursen: Mopedkörkort AM
description:
Plugga till teoriprovet för AM-körkort – oavsett om du ska köra moped, mopedbil eller EPA/A-traktor. MopedKursen samlar över 1 000 egenskrivna körkortsfrågor, sju teorikapitel, vägmärken och övningsprov med samma upplägg som kunskapsprovet. Börja utan kostnad och lås upp allt med ett engångsköp.

ETT KÖRKORT – FYRA FORDON
AM-körkort kan du ta från 15 år. Det ger dig rätt att köra:
• Moped klass I (EU-moped, 45 km/h)
• Mopedbil
• Moped klass II
• A-traktor (traktor a) – det som i vardagen kallas EPA-traktor
Teoriprovet är detsamma oavsett fordon. Appen passar därför lika bra om du ska ta mopedkörkort, moppekörkort, EPA-körkort eller körkort för mopedbil.

ÖVER 1 000 FRÅGOR MED FÖRKLARING
• Egenskrivna körkortsfrågor
• Förklaring till varje svar, så att du förstår varför
• Källhänvisning till lagtexten
• Dagens pass som repeterar det du har svarat fel på

ÖVNINGSPROV SOM PÅ RIKTIGT
• Fullt prov: 70 frågor på 50 minuter. 5 av frågorna räknas inte, och du behöver 52 rätt av 65
• Kortare prov: 20 frågor på 15 minuter eller 40 frågor på 30 minuter
• Gå igenom dina fel efter provet och se vad du behöver träna mer

VÄGMÄRKEN
• Vägmärkesprov med 20 frågor
• Träna per grupp: varningsmärken, väjning och stopp, förbudsmärken, påbudsmärken och anvisningsmärken

MOPEDTEORI I SJU KAPITEL
• Sju teorikapitel som täcker det du behöver kunna
• Uppläsning – lyssna i stället för att läsa
• Ordlista som förklarar svåra ord
• Läranderesa i tre etapper som visar hur långt du har kommit

PLANERA FRAM TILL PROVDAGEN
• Lägg in ditt provdatum och planera pluggandet efter det
• Checklista för hela vägen: körkortstillstånd, utbildning och prov

SÅ TAR DU AM-KÖRKORT
1. Ansök om körkortstillstånd.
2. Gå AM-utbildning hos en behörig utbildare. Den är minst 17 timmar: 10 timmar teori och 7 timmar praktik, varav 5 timmar körning i trafik. Sedan 1 februari 2026 kan utbildningen även göras i mopedbil.
3. Gör kunskapsprovet hos Trafikverket.
AM-körkortet har en prövotid på ett år.

GRATIS ATT BÖRJA – ENGÅNGSKÖP 99 KR
Utan kostnad ingår:
• Två teorikapitel
• 20 övningsfrågor
• Ett kort prov
• 20 vägmärkesfrågor
Vill du ha allt låser du upp hela appen för 99 kr. Ingen prenumeration, ingen reklam och inget konto.

FUNGERAR OFFLINE
Plugga på bussen, i skolan eller i garaget – appen fungerar utan uppkoppling.

BRA ATT VETA
MopedKursen är en fristående app utan koppling till Trafikverket eller Transportstyrelsen. Appen ersätter inte den obligatoriska AM-utbildningen hos en behörig utbildare, utan hjälper dig att plugga teorin inför kunskapsprovet.

Frågor eller synpunkter? Besök mopedkursen.se/support

name: Mossfall--Sluice Terrace
description:
Johdata vettä alas vuorenrinnettä pitkin kivisiä altaita.

Liikuta puisia sulkuluukkuja, valitse jokaiselle altaalle yksi veden ulosvirtausreitti ja anna veden virrata vasta, kun veden syvyys ja paine-ero sen sallivat. Vesimäärä säilyy aina samana. Vettä ei lisätä eikä poisteta, eikä altaiden pohjalla ole tyhjennysaukkoa. Aikaa ei tarvitse kilpailla vastaan.

Tarkkaile altaiden seinämiin merkittyä meripihkanväristä tavoiteviivaa. Leveämmät altaat tarvitsevat enemmän vettä saavuttaakseen saman vedenkorkeuden. Avaa yksi reitti lyhyeksi hetkeksi, pidä luukkua auki tasaisen virtauksen ajan tai käynnistä useita valmiiksi asetettuja luukkuja samanaikaisesti ja seuraa veden rauhallista virtausta altaasta toiseen.

Kaksikymmentäneljä huolella suunniteltua kenttää jakautuu neljään lukuun, joiden tunnelmat vaihtelevat sumusta saniaisiin, hämärään ja kuunvaloon. Ansaitse kivisinettejä ratkaisemalla jokainen vesireitti, palaa suosikkikenttiisi ja seuraa parhaita siirtomääriäsi.

Mossfall on rauhallinen logiikkapuutarha pelaajille, jotka nauttivat suunnittelusta, kärsivällisyydestä ja vedenpintojen tasapainottamisesta.

name: Muffle: SMS & Arama Filtresi
description:
Muffle, istenmeyen SMS ve aramaları internet bağlantısı, hesap veya harici sunucu kullanmadan doğrudan iPhone'unuzda sessizce filtreleyen gizlilik odaklı bir koruma aracıdır.

%100 CİHAZ İÇİ VE SIFIR VERİ TOPLAMA
Mesajlarınız, arama kayıtlarınız ve kurallarınız cihazınızdan asla dışarı çıkmaz. Muffle herhangi bir analitik aracı, takip kodu veya reklam ağı içermez.

AKILLI SMS FİLTRESİ
• 6 Hazır Spam Paketi (120+ Kural): Bahis & Kumar, Yatırım/Kripto, Sahte Kargo & İcra, Oltalama & Sahte Banka, Sahte Kredi & İş İlanı ve Reklam/Kampanya paketlerini tek dokunuşla açıp kapatın.
• Ticari Kod ve Link Koruması: B001–B999 ticari ileti kodlarını ve kısaltılmış bağlantıları (bit.ly vb.) otomatik olarak İstenmeyen klasörüne ayırın.
• Türkçe Karakter Duyarlılığı: Türkçe karakterli ve karaktersiz tüm spam yazım varyasyonlarını yakalar.
• Güvenli Liste (Whitelist): Banka doğrulama kodları, tek kullanımlık şifreler ve resmi bildirimler asla engellenmez.
• Canlı SMS Simülatörü: Kendi kurallarınızı örnek mesajlarla uygulama içinde anında test edin.

ARAMA KALKANI VE ARAYAN ETİKETİ
• Sessiz Engelleme veya Etiketleme: İstenmeyen numaraları telefonunuz hiç çalmadan reddedin veya arayan ekranında kendi belirlediğiniz etiketi (ör. Muffle: Pazarlama / Spam) görün.
• Seri Blok Engelleme: Aynı seriden arayan çağrı merkezleri için son 2 haneyi (100 numara) veya son 3 haneyi (1.000 numara) tek dokunuşla engelleyin.

ÇEVRİMDIŞI YEDEKLEME
Tüm özel kelime ve numara kurallarınızı bulut kullanmadan yerel bir JSON dosyası olarak dışa aktarın ve dilediğiniz zaman geri yükleyin.

Not: iOS gizlilik kuralları gereği SMS filtresi yalnızca rehberinizde kayıtlı olmayan göndericiler için çalışır. Kurulum için Ayarlar üzerinden Mesajlar ve Telefon izinlerini bir kez aktif etmeniz yeterlidir.

name: Munch Run 3D
description:
Meet Pizza Pete – the fastest slice in town! Hungry Hank is chasing him, fork in hand, and he's starving.

Munch Run is a colorful 3D endless runner set in a world made entirely of food. Dodge, jump and slide your way through giant pancakes, rolling donuts, churros and hot dogs, collect donuts, and see how far you can go before you become someone's lunch.

RUN THROUGH 4 DELICIOUS WORLDS
• Sweet Street – lollipops, cupcakes and giant donuts
• Fruit Farm – watermelons, pineapples and strawberries
• Sushi Bay – maki rolls, onigiri and torii gates at sunset
• Choco Canyon – chocolate bars, cookies and marshmallows

DON'T GET EATEN!
Bump into something and Hungry Hank catches up and takes a bite – you'll keep running with a bite mark! Get hit again before you escape him and… CHOMP. Game over.

UNLOCK TASTY CHARACTERS
Spend the donuts you collect in the Character Shop:
• Pizza Pete
• Big Bun the burger
• Nigiri Nik
• Kiki Cupcake
• Taco Tito
• Scoops the ice cream

FEATURES
• Simple swipe controls – swipe to switch lanes, jump and slide
• Bright, cartoon 3D graphics
• Original upbeat soundtrack and haptic feedback
• Speed increases the further you run
• Beat your best score
• Play offline – no internet needed
• No ads, no accounts

How far can you run before you get munched?

name: My Coffee Spot
description:
Choose your city, name your café and make it your own. Pick a style, change the colors and decorations, and create a menu filled with drinks and treats. Mix a signature drink to give your spot its own flavor.

Explore the map to discover other players’ cafés. Order something with game coins, collect stamps in your Coffee Passport and save your favorite spots for later.

Meet animal visitors, collect their stickers and share a postcard from your café. From seasonal decorations to little details in your guestbook, there’s always something to make your spot feel like home.

Create your spot, explore at your own pace and see where your coffee journey takes you.

name: My Easy Chess
description:
MY EASY CHESS: PLAY, SHARE & REVIEW
Enjoy the timeless game of chess with friends on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

My Easy Chess makes playing chess simple, social and enjoyable. Challenge a friend over your local Wi-Fi network, play together on the same device, or import a chess game in PGN format to review every move.
No account required. No online gaming servers. Just chess.

PLAY TOGETHER OVER WI-FI
Challenge friends to real-time chess matches over your local network.
Play chess with friends over a local Wi-Fi network, even without an Internet connection. Simply connect your devices to the same network and start playing!
Play across all your Apple devices: play on your Mac while your friend plays on their iPhone or iPad, My Easy Chess works seamlessly across Mac, iPhone and iPad. As long as you're connected to the same Wi-Fi network, you'll find each other instantly and start playing together. No account, no internet connection required.
• Create a game or join an available match.
• Automatically discover other players on the same local network.
• Play across compatible iPhone, iPad and Mac devices.
• Choose to play as White or Black.
• Chat with your opponent during a match.
• Offer a draw, resign or request a rematch.

TWO PLAYERS, ONE DEVICE
Prefer playing face-to-face?
Enjoy a chess match with a friend on a single iPhone, iPad or Mac. Simply take turns playing on the same chessboard.

SHARE YOUR GAMES IN PGN FORMAT
Great chess games deserve to be shared.
Export your game in PGN (Portable Game Notation), the standard format used to record chess moves.
• Share the move history of a completed game.
• Send PGN notation to a friend using compatible sharing apps.
• Keep a record of memorable matches.
• Exchange game notation with other chess players.

IMPORT & REVIEW CHESS GAMES
Received a PGN game from a friend? Bring it into My Easy Chess and replay the match.
• Import a chess game in PGN notation.
• Reconstruct the game on the chessboard.
• Navigate through the moves, one by one.
• Revisit key positions and explore how the match unfolded.
• Review games received from other My Easy Chess users or compatible PGN sources.
Whether you want to relive a memorable victory, understand a critical mistake or simply follow a friend's match, My Easy Chess makes game review easy and intuitive.

CHOOSE YOUR MATCH FORMAT
Play at your own pace with adjustable chess clocks and time controls.
• Play without a time limit.
• Choose between different match durations.
• Use clock increments for more flexible games.
• Enjoy relaxed games or faster challenges.

PERSONALIZE YOUR CHESSBOARD
Make the game your own with elegant customization options.
• 8 chessboard themes.
• 3 chess piece styles.
• Light and dark appearance options.
• Clear board coordinates and move indicators.
• An intuitive interface designed for comfortable gameplay.

CLASSIC CHESS, ESSENTIAL FEATURES
Enjoy standard chess rules and useful match features:
• Legal move validation.
• Check, checkmate and stalemate detection.
• Castling, en passant and pawn promotion.
• Move history and chess notation.
• Draw offers, resignation and rematches.
• PGN export, import and move-by-move review.

DESIGNED FOR iPHONE, iPAD AND MAC
Enjoy chess across your compatible Apple devices with a familiar and intuitive interface.
Play locally with a friend, challenge someone over Wi-Fi or review a shared game whenever you like.

CHESS WITHOUT COMPLICATIONS
No registration. No online matchmaking. No subscription required.
Just play, share and enjoy the game.

name: My Gaming Ledger
description:
My Gaming Ledger is a private record of your casino trips. Track what you played, where you played, what you won or lost, and the markers you've taken and paid back.

TRACK SESSIONS LIVE
• Start a session at the table with a running timer
• Add money or take a marker in a tap
• See your session on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Log past sessions you forgot to start

KNOW YOUR REAL NUMBERS
• Win/loss, time played and win/loss per hour
• Reports by trip, day, game, category, casino and year
• Best and worst games at a glance

KEEP MARKERS SEPARATE
• Track casino credit as debt, never as a win or loss
• See what you still owe on each trip
• Attach photos of markers and receipts

SHARE YOUR TRIP
• Create a phone-sized summary picture of a trip or session
• Save it or send it through Messages or Mail

REFERENCE CARDS
• Blackjack strategy charts, baccarat drawing rules and craps dice odds
• Pick a card for a session and open it from Home

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Face ID lock
• No accounts, ads or tracking
• Syncs through your own private iCloud
• Export your records to CSV

My Gaming Ledger is a record-keeping app. It does not offer gambling or real-money wagering. Strategy cards are for reference only, rules vary by casino, and no strategy guarantees a win. Please gamble responsibly. In the US, help is available at 1-800-GAMBLER.

name: My Jigsaws
description:
“My Jigsaws” is a distraction-free, native jigsaw puzzle game for Mac, iPad, and iPhone. Choose a picture from your device or try the included sample puzzles, pick a piece count, and start solving!  The game includes features to help you solve your puzzles, such as:  * Loupe to inspect puzzle pieces from up close and see the details. * Hints that point to pieces that can be connected to help you find connections easier. * Adjustable puzzle piece sizes to make the gameplay experience comfortable for different screen & window sizes. * Progress in puzzles is saved, and they can be resumed at a later time. * See your progress and time, and keep track of your lifetime puzzle statistics. * Preview the picture of your puzzle as you are solving it. * Rearrange the pieces around the edges to make room in the middle or around the image preview. * Collapse the button tray to the corner to reduce distractions to the minimum.
* Create trays to sort and store pieces.
* Show only the edge pieces to help you get started with a new puzzle.  Made for your device  * On Mac, play with a mouse or trackpad and choose puzzles with up to 500 pieces. * On iPad, play with touch or Apple Pencil. Choose up to 300 pieces on iPad mini or 400 on larger iPads. * On iPhone, enjoy puzzles with up to 100 pieces in a layout designed for the smaller screen.  In this first release, the puzzle piece counts are based on my personal devices and experience. Future releases may include more variety in puzzle piece counts based on feedback from you, including bugs that I may have missed or performance improvements. Puzzle pieces are generated to fit the proportions of your picture, so their shapes may vary.  Your puzzles and progress are stored locally on your device. “My Jigsaws” doesn’t require an account or an internet connection to play, it’s entirely offline.  Enjoy!

name: MyMarsa® Admin
description:
The Marsa operations desk, in your pocket.

MyMarsa® Admin is the native app of Marsa Control, for Marsa's own staff. It is part of Marsa Bay® (also known as Marsa® and Marsa-Bay®), the Flagship of Kenzie, SAUDI GULF HOSTiNG, in English and Arabic.

For Marsa staff only. A customer account or a business account has no access of any kind.

Run the desk:
- Overview: the live figures that your role may open
- Conversations: open a live chat, take over, reply, add an internal note, hand back to Marsa AI when she is on, transfer, close and reopen
- Human handover: the queue of chats waiting for a person, with who is busy and who is free
- Calls and call backs: read them and mark a call back as done
- Tickets: open, reply, move to the right department or person, or hand to a business
- Alerts: see them and acknowledge them
- Marsa AI and her helpers: the state, hours and limits of each helper and of each of her sixteen Operators, and the Marsa AI dashboard with status, usage and spend, and the safety log (read only)
- People and the audit log, for the roles that may read them

Every person sees only what their role allows. Opening a conversation is recorded in the access log, as on the website. Customer words and private details appear only where the website shows them. The master switch and the limits of Marsa AI stay on the website.

Features such as Marsa AI and the telephone line are switched on later. Until then the app says so plainly and shows nothing that did not happen.

A password alone opens nothing. Sign in with your password and a second step: Face ID or your fingerprint, or your Authenticator code. Register your iPhone in seconds with the Marsa Bay® App Clip.

Need help? Email support@marsa-bay.com or visit marsa-bay.com.

name: MyMarsa® Admin Call Connect
description:
Your team's chat, handover and calls, in one app.

MyMarsa® Admin Call Connect is for the team of a business, government body, bank, fintech, corporate or community account that uses a Connect workspace. It is part of Marsa Bay® (also known as Marsa® and Marsa-Bay®), the Flagship of Kenzie, SAUDI GULF HOSTiNG, in English and Arabic. It is free to download, and business accounts are free for now.

Marsa staff use MyMarsa® Admin, and customers use MyMarsa® Customer Connect. This app is for the members of a workspace.

Run your workspace:
- Workspace picker, for accounts that belong to more than one workspace
- Overview: the queue, who is online, calls waiting, call backs due and alerts
- Inbox and queue: read a chat, reply, add an internal note, take over, hand back to Marsa AI when she is on, transfer to a person or a department with a note, close and reopen, and see the same customer's earlier chats
- Calls: live calls and call backs waiting, the call log with numbers hidden except the last digits, voicemail with its words and a Call back now button, hours and switches (read only), and usage
- Customers: the list and each profile
- Online and away: you show as online to your team while the app is open, and you can set yourself away

The roles of your workspace apply: Owner, Manager, Agent and Viewer see and do only what their role allows. Every action is checked on the server exactly as on the website, and you can reach only your own workspace.

Alerts appear inside the app while it is open. Push notifications are not part of this version.

Call Connect, the telephone line and Marsa AI are switched on later. Until then the app says so plainly, and no call that did not happen is ever shown.

Sign in with your Marsa account: your password and a second step, Face ID or your fingerprint, or your Authenticator code. Register your iPhone in seconds with the Marsa Bay® App Clip.

Need help? Email support@marsa-bay.com or visit marsa-bay.com.

name: MyMarsa® Harbour
description:
Your Marsa, in one harbour.

MyMarsa® Harbour is your own control panel for Marsa. It is part of Marsa Bay® (also known as Marsa® and Marsa-Bay®), the Flagship of Kenzie, SAUDI GULF HOSTiNG, in English and Arabic. It is free to download and free for customers.

Keep everything in order:
- Overview: who is signed in, with your email masked until you tap, and shortcuts
- My bookings and orders: one list across the marketplaces where you have booked or ordered, newest first, each opening to its details. Booking PINs and private details show only when you tap, for a short time, then go blank
- My free panel: a to-do list, appointments, notes and your own colours. Your notes are private to you. A panel is created only when you choose to create it
- Sign-in and security: see your passkeys with their device and last use, whether your Authenticator is registered, how many recovery codes are left and your active sessions, and sign out everywhere else with one tap
- Data and privacy: see your consents, with links to the website to export your data or close your account
- Settings: English or Arabic, and sign out

Adding or removing sign-in methods stays on the website, and the app points you there. Nothing is written until you tap. You see only your own data.

Sign in with your password and a second step: Face ID or your fingerprint, or your Authenticator code. Register your iPhone in seconds with the Marsa Bay® App Clip.

Need help? Email support@marsa-bay.com or visit marsa-bay.com.

name: MyVault: Clip & Save
description:
**MyVault – Your Personal Content Library**

Ever save an Instagram Reel, TikTok, or Facebook video only to forget where you saved it?

Meet MyVault, your personal library for saving, organizing, and rediscovering the content you love.

Instead of having useful videos, ideas, tutorials, and inspiration scattered across multiple social media platforms, bring everything together in one convenient place.

**SAVE CONTENT FROM ACROSS SOCIAL MEDIA**

Save links to your favorite content from:
- Instagram
- TikTok
- Facebook
- Other supported platforms

**ORGANIZE EVERYTHING AUTOMATICALLY**

Keep your saved content organized with categories and subcategories. Whether it's automotive tips, home improvement ideas, business inspiration, recipes, fitness advice, or something else, MyVault helps keep everything where you can find it.

**AI-POWERED ORGANIZATION**

Spend less time sorting through saved content. Let AI help understand, categorize, and organize your saved links so your personal library stays useful and easy to navigate.

**FIND WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR**

Looking for that video you saved weeks ago? Search your library and find the content you need without scrolling endlessly through social media saves.

**YOUR IDEAS. YOUR LIBRARY. YOUR VAULT.**
Whether you're collecting business ideas, saving DIY tutorials, researching products, or keeping track of things you want to try later, MyVault gives you one place to keep it all organized.

Stop losing great ideas. Start building your personal vault with MyVault.

name: Nata: Learn Portuguese
description:
Nata is a flashcard app for English speakers learning the Portuguese of Portugal. You can learn two ways, and mix them:

• Start from scratch: ready-made decks of words, verbs, grammar and sounds. Words and grammar are sorted by level, from beginner (A1) to advanced.
• Learn from what you read: photograph a page from a book, a menu, a sign or a newspaper, and turn the words you meet into flashcards, with their sentence.

PORTUGAL'S PORTUGUESE
• Pronunciation from Portugal for every word that has one, read aloud with a European Portuguese voice.
• Grammar the European way: estar a fazer, chama-se, o meu livro, tu with friends.
• Example sentences chosen to avoid Brazilian forms.

READ
• Photograph a page or choose a photo. The text is recognised on this device.
• Every word is coloured by how well you know it.
• Tap a word for its meaning and the form it is in: falámos → falar, preterite, nós.
• Pronouns attached to the verb are understood: dá-me, fazê-lo, chama-se.
• See the grammar points the passage uses.

STUDY
• Words: about 19,000 entries with gender, pronunciation and example sentences. Levels A1 to C2, estimated from frequency.
• Gender: o or a for each noun, with the ending rules and their exceptions.
• Verbs: one card per tense, from the present to the future subjunctive. Conjugation tables coloured by status.
• Grammar: 53 points from A1 to B2, each with an explanation, examples, common mistakes and gap-fill questions. Points found in your reading come first, and your own sentences become questions.
• Sounds: reduced vowels, nasal vowels, the s that sounds like sh, and the other sounds of Portugal.
• Dictation: listen to a word and type it, with an accent bar for ã, õ and ç.

Spaced repetition schedules every card, and a daily reminder tells you how many are due. Memory aids flag false friends (puxar means to pull) and irregular verbs.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on this device, or in your own iCloud account if you turn on sync. Backups are plain files you keep.

Dictionary data from Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0). Example sentences from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

name: NatioPass: citizenship exams
description:
DISCLAIMER: NatioPass is an independent app. It does not represent any government or public body and is not affiliated with one. Official sources are listed below and inside the app (More > Official sources).

NatioPass helps you practise for the exams asked for nationality or residence in Spain and in France. Everything is explained in your language: English, French, Arabic or Spanish.

SPAIN: CCSE (free, no limit)
• 300 original practice questions on the five parts of the exam
• Short game-like stages, stars and a daily goal
• Mock exam: 25 questions in 45 minutes

SPAIN: DELE A2
• 30 complete mock exams: reading, listening, writing and speaking
• 600 listening recordings, with a slow-speed button
• Your writing and speaking corrected in seconds, with a mark out of 25 and clear advice
• Vocabulary (800 words), 20 grammar lessons, 240 model phrases

FRANCE: CIVIC EXAM (free, no limit)
• 400 original practice questions on the five themes of the programme
• Mock exam: 40 questions in 45 minutes
• Every answer explained in your language

FRANCE: FRENCH TEST (A2, B1, B2)
• Writing and speaking tasks, corrected in seconds with an estimated level
• Reading and listening series with a timer

PRICE
The CCSE, the French civic exam, the vocabulary and a trial of the corrections are free. Full access is a single payment for 4 months. No subscription, no automatic renewal.

OFFICIAL SOURCES OF INFORMATION
Spain:
• https://www.mjusticia.gob.es/es/ciudadania/nacionalidad
• https://www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=BOE-A-2015-12047
• https://cervantes.org/es/examenes/ccse
• https://cervantes.org/es/examenes/dele
France:
• https://www.service-public.gouv.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/N111
• https://formation-civique.interieur.gouv.fr/
• https://www.france-education-international.fr/test/tcf-irn

All questions and exercises are original, written by us from the official programmes. They are not the official exam questions. Corrections are made by artificial intelligence: the mark is an estimate, not an official result.

name: Natoor: Wi-Fi Security
description:
Natoor shows what's on your home Wi-Fi and helps you make it safer and faster, in plain language.

YOUR PLAN
Natoor turns everything it finds into a short checklist: fix risky issues, check devices you don't recognize, answer a few router questions, update your router, test your speed and find dead spots. Each step says what you gain, and ticks itself off as you go.

SEE EVERY DEVICE
Scan your network in about 15 seconds. Natoor names devices where it can — phones, TVs, printers, cameras, speakers — and shows which services each one makes reachable. Mark devices as Trusted or Unrecognized, and change your Wi-Fi password if someone shouldn't be there.

FIX WHAT'S OPEN
Every open port comes with what it is, how risky it is and how to close it. After you fix something, recheck just that issue to confirm.

A SECURITY SCORE YOU CAN RAISE
Get a grade for your Wi-Fi from what Natoor observed and a short router checklist: WPA3, WPS, remote admin, UPnP and more.

SPEED TEST AND TIPS
Measure download, upload, ping, jitter and latency under load, see what your connection is good for, and get tips picked from your results to make your Wi-Fi faster.

SIGNAL MAP
Walk around your home and measure each room. Natoor shows signal bars for every place, recommends where to move your router, and where a mesh point would help.

UPDATES
Step-by-step instructions for updating each kind of device, and a checklist to track what you've updated.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Scan results stay on your iPhone. Natoor only looks — it never tries passwords, opens camera feeds or changes router settings.

Available in English and Arabic.

Only scan networks you own or manage.

name: NBXFort
description: NBXFort Buchungseinträge verteilen Daten innerhalb eines festgelegten Zeitraums auf bestimmte Kategorien. Ein einzelner Datensatz kann in mehrere Segmente unterteilt werden; eine bestimmte Ausgabe lässt sich – abhängig von den jeweiligen Details – sogar auf verschiedene Reisedaten aufteilen. Im Rahmen des Abgleichs können Sie Einträge aufklappen, um zu sehen, wie die Kosten verteilt wurden, und den Ursprung der tatsächlichen Ausgabe nachvollziehen. Die Daten lassen sich nach Zahlungsdatum betrachten oder – basierend auf dem jeweiligen Abrechnungszeitraum – in monatliche Berichte integrieren. Bevor Sie historische Angaben zu zurückgelegten Strecken korrigieren, können Sie eine Vorschau darauf erhalten, wie sich diese Änderungen auf die Kosten in angrenzenden Zeiträumen auswirken könnten. Zudem haben Sie die Möglichkeit, am Monatsende alle Posten, denen zuvor kein konkreter Verwendungszweck zugewiesen wurde, zusammenzufassen und zu kategorisieren.

name: Neatly Kept
description:
When did you last change the sheets? Is the water filter due for replacement? Neatly Kept helps you track the little things you do to care for your home.

• See what’s due next. The home screen sorts routines by due date, and each routine shows its last completion and next due date.
• Log now or catch up later. Swipe left to log a chore you finished today, or open its details to choose yesterday or another past date and add a note.
• Start with an illustrated preset. Choose from 64 presets across cleaning, home maintenance, kitchen care, and bath and linens. You can also create your own routines.
• Set a rhythm that suits you. Choose a repeat interval and an optional reminder time, or just keep a record.
• Look back by date. Routines completed on the same day appear together in the timeline, along with any notes you added.

Neatly Kept requires no account. Routines, history, and preferences are stored on your device. Available in English and Simplified Chinese, with light and dark appearance options.

name: Nectaroll
description:
Nectaroll is a fruit puzzle about rolling a nectar orb across orchard pools. Collect fruits in the exact recipe order, then reach the goal before you run out of moves.

Melt ice, ride whirlpools, and use sour tiles to reverse your next roll. Clear island stages, brew recipes in the Blend Lab, unlock journal stories, and play a new Daily Dew board each day.

Sign in with Apple, continue with Google, or play as a guest. Your orchard progress is saved on this device.

name: Netavcı: YKS Deneme Analizi
description:
Denemeni gir, yarın hangi konuya çalışacağını hemen gör.
Netavcı her konunun sana kaç puan getireceğini hesaplar, boş bıraktığın soruların bedelini gösterir ve yarınki çalışmanı dakikasıyla planlar. Üyelik yok, internet gerekmez.

• Konu konu puan karşılığı: TYT, AYT ve YDT'nin 316 konusu, YKS'deki soru sıklığına ve senin başarına göre sıralanır
• Boşta kalan net: şık elediğin halde boş bıraktığın soruların sana neye mal olduğu
• Günlük ve yedi günlük plan, sınav tarihine göre kısalan tekrar takvimi
• ÖSYM 2026 verisiyle puan tahmini ve sıralama aralığı
• Yanlış defteri, ders ders gelişim grafikleri ve paylaşılabilir ilerleme kartı

İlk denemeni girmen yeterli; üye olmadan, birkaç dakikada başlarsın.

KONU KONU PUAN KARŞILIĞI
Her konu için üç şeye bakılır: o konudan YKS'de ortalama kaç soru çıktığı, senin o konudaki başarın ve konunun ne kadar çabuk oturduğu. Sonuç puana çevrilir, çünkü sayısal öğrencisi için AYT Matematik'teki bir net, TYT Matematik'teki bir netten çok daha fazla puan eder. Liste bu farkı hesaba katarak sıralanır: "Türev +2,25 net, İntegral +2 net…"

BOŞ BIRAKTIĞIN SORULAR
YKS'de dört yanlış bir doğruyu götürür. Hiç fikrin olmayan bir soruda işaretlemenin beklenen getirisi sıfırdır; ama bir şıkkı bile eleyebildiysen boş bırakmak net kaybettirir. Girişte "kaç boşta şık eleyebildim" dersin, o denemede masada kalan neti görürsün.

YANLIŞIN KAYNAĞI
Her yanlışı bir tiple işaretleyebilirsin: bilgi eksiği, dikkat, işlem hatası, yanlış okuma, süre ya da kararsızlık. Uygulama tabloyu özetler: yanlışların çoğu konu eksiğinden değil de dikkat ve işlemden geliyorsa bunu sayıyla söyler, çünkü konu tekrarı o netleri geri getirmez.

BUGÜN VE BU HAFTA
Günlük plan, ayırdığın süreye sığar ve o gün çalıştıklarını düşer. Yedi günlük plan aynı konuyu üst üste vermez, deneme gününü haftada en fazla bir kez yerleştirir. Sınav yaklaştıkça oran kendiliğinden değişir: yeni konu azalır, tekrar ve soru çözümü artar. Son iki haftada yeni konu önerilmez.

TEKRAR TAKVİMİ
Çalıştığın konu 1, 3, 7, 16 ve 35 gün sonra tekrara gelir. Sınav tarihini girdiysen aralıklar kalan güne göre kısalır.

DENEME GİRİŞİ
Klavye açmadan, dokunarak girilir. Net, puan tahmini ve sıralama aralığı her dokunuşta güncellenir. Son kullandığın yayın hazır gelir. Ders başına süre girersen hangi testin diğerinden dakika çaldığını da görürsün.

İLERLEME
Toplam netin yanında her dersin kendi grafiği var: toplam yükselirken düşen dersi kaçırmazsın. Son sekiz haftanın çalışma süresi, seri ve en iyi netin bir arada. İstersen bunları adın ya da okulun yazmayan bir karta döküp paylaşabilirsin.

YANLIŞ DEFTERİ
Yanlış yaptığın sorunun fotoğrafını Fotoğraflar'dan seçip eklersin, hata tipini ve kısa notunu yazarsın. Defter de tekrar takvimine girer.

HATIRLATMA
İstersen her gün seçtiğin saatte bir hatırlatma ve Pazar akşamı o haftanın özeti gelir: kaç saat çalıştın, kaç deneme girdin.

KAPSAM
TYT, AYT ve YDT; 316 konu, her birinin yanında YKS'deki ortalama soru sayısı. Sayısal, eşit ağırlık, sözel ve dil puan türleri.

PUAN VE SIRALAMA HAKKINDA
Net, boş analizi ve konu sıralaması kesin hesaptır. Sıralama tablosu ÖSYM'nin 2026 YKS sayısal bilgilerinden alınmıştır. Puan ise tahmindir, çünkü ÖSYM'nin dönüşümü o yılın adaylarına bağlıdır. Bu yüzden sıralama tek bir sayı değil, bir aralık olarak gösterilir. Netavcı bağımsız bir uygulamadır; ÖSYM ile bağlantısı yoktur, kullandığı sayılar ÖSYM'nin kamuya açık istatistikleridir.

VERİ TAŞIMA
Tüm kayıtların telefonunda durur. Yedeği tek dosya olarak Dosyalar'da istediğin klasöre kaydedebilir ya da paylaşabilir, yeni telefonda geri yükleyebilirsin. Denemeleri ve yanlış defterini CSV olarak da alabilirsin.

Netavcı ÖSYM ile bağlantılı değildir; bağımsız bir çalışma aracıdır.

Görüş ve hata bildirimi: contact@albovix.com

name: Ngeong!
description:
A pampered house cat slips out through an open window with nothing but its collar and bell. Out there, it turns out, every alley has a boss. Take the islands of Nusantara turf by turf, beat their champions, and steal their signature moves.

Ngeong! is a 1v1 pixel-art fighting game with cats, made for phones. The controls are one stick and four buttons: Claw, Pounce, Jurus and Dash. No motion inputs to memorise, yet plenty of depth for those who want to get good.

REAL CAT MOVES
Hiss to parry, land on your feet, jump off fences, Zoomies, even a hairball fireball. A cornered cat low on health fills its Fury bar at once. Fill the Fury bar and unleash a Pamungkas, cut-in and all.

A JOURNEY ACROSS NUSANTARA
From the alleys of Jakarta to the Highest Rooftop: Java, Sumatra, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Bali and Nusa Tenggara, Maluku and Papua. Every region has painted stages, a story, and champions who rise again at half health. Every champion you beat teaches you their move.

YOUR CAT, YOUR STYLE
Pick the colour of the collar and bell, the fur, pattern, eyes, ears, tail, even the pitch of the meow. Put moves on your buttons, craft your own combo strings with Combo Craft, choose a Signature Pounce and Instincts, train your stats, and dress your cat up in the Salon.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
- Night Watch: a night run that is different every time.
- Daily Fight: one new fight a day, the same for every cat.
- A 7-day bowl: a reward for every day you come back.
- Neighbours: fight other players' cats, played by the CPU.

PLAY ONLINE
Challenge a friend with a room code, find a quick match, or climb the Ranked Fight queue. See where you stand on the Champions Board for all of Indonesia and your province. Online, trained stats and accessories are switched off to keep it fair: only your choice of moves and your hands count.

NEW TO FIGHTING GAMES?
Fight School teaches the controls step by step, the Santai road is there for newcomers, and a coach helps in your first fights.

YOUR SAVE IS SAFE
No account needed. Your save is copied to the cloud after a win and can be brought back on another phone with a 10-letter Cat Code.

No in-app purchases: everything is bought with Salted Fish earned in play. Rewarded ads play only when you choose to watch one. In Bahasa Indonesia and English.

name: Noelvyn
description:
Noelvyn is a cozy Christmas puzzle game about planning Santa’s gift delivery route.

Help Santa navigate snowy village grids, match the right gifts to each house, and finish every delivery before your moves run out. Slide across ice, avoid fences and snow piles, use one-way paths, and hop through chimneys to find the smartest route.

Features:
• 75 handcrafted levels across 5 festive chapters
• Grid-based path planning with ice slides, one-way roads, and teleports
• Color-matched gift deliveries and gift stations
• Undo, restart, star ratings, and local progress s     aving
• Achievements, daily gift rewards, and cozy holiday music
• Fully offline — no account and no internet required

Think carefully, move wisely, and bring Christmas joy to every house in Noelvyn.

name: NomYet?
description:
Bowl patrol comes to Apple HomeView. The Napfduo display widget shows your pet’s photo and feeding status on a compatible setup, so everyone sees whose bowl is still waiting. Log a meal on iPhone or Apple Watch.

Invite your household through iCloud to share a private feeding log. Everyone can check who fed each pet and when on their own device. NomYet? tells you when it’s showing an older saved status.

Give each dog and cat a photo and their own plan with one to three meals a day. Tap to log a meal, and undo it if you tapped the wrong one.

On iPhone, put one widget per pet in a stack. Swipe up or down to check on the whole crew.

You can also keep your feeding log on one device. Available in English, German and Swiss German in the app.

name: Not Another TV
description:
Not Another TV is only a player. It contains no channels, playlists or other content, and we do not provide any. You add a playlist from your own provider and you are responsible for having the right to watch it.

Not Another TV plays the playlist you already have, on your iPhone and iPad.

- Add a playlist link (M3U) or a login from your own provider
- Channels neatly grouped, with favourites and search
- A programme guide when your provider sends one
- Someone you trust can set up the app for you from a distance with a pairing code
- Free, no ads, no account needed to watch

name: Nourishly
description:
Møt Nourishly, en rolig kalori- og måltidsdagbok laget for hverdagen.

Logg frokost, lunsj, middag og mellommåltid med noen få trykk. Se kalorier igjen, protein, karbohydrater, fett og fiber samlet, og følg fremgangen uten å gjøre hvert måltid til en prøve.

**EN DAG DU KAN LES**
I dag-siden samler det viktigste: energibalanse, makroer, vann, nylige måltid og et nyttig forslag til neste måltid. Veiledningen endrer seg med dagen og er støttende, ikke dømmende.

**EN DAGBOK SOM TÅLER LIVET**
Velg dato, se måltidene i rekkefølge, dupliser et kjent måltid eller slett en registrering. Legg til et personlig notat, juster porsjoner og fyll inn næringsverdier du allerede kjenner. Alt lagres lokalt på iPhonen.

**IDEER, IKKE REGLER**
Utforsk fargerike oppskrifter med tydelige ingredienser, enkel fremgangsmåte og beregnet næring. Filtrer på proteinrik, balansert, vegetar, frokost eller raske måltid, og legg oppskriften rett i dagboken.

**FREMGANG MED SAMMENHENG**
Se ukentlig eller månedlig kalorirytme, vekttrend, dager med proteinmål, vann og milepæler. Bruk refleksjonsfeltet til å merke deg energi, metthet og rutiner i stedet for å jage et perfekt tall.

**PRIVAT FRA GRUNNEN**
Ingen konto. Ingen dagbok i skyen. Ingen annonser eller sporing på tvers av apper. Registreringene blir på enheten, og varsler spørres det bare om når du selv slår dem på.

Nourishly gir generell oversikt over mat og vaner. Appen er ikke et medisinsk verktøy og erstatter ikke råd fra helsepersonell.

name: Noxa Player
description:
Noxa Player is an unofficial, community-made client for Noxa. EmeryTech develops and supports the player. For help with the iPhone app, visit https://github.com/emerytech/noxa-player/issues.

Bring your Noxa movie and TV libraries to iPhone. Browse movies, seasons, and episodes, or tune in to Retro TV for a channel-surfing experience built from your library. Open the guide to see what’s on and what plays next. Start Over takes you to the beginning of the current program, and Done returns you to the live channel.

Connect to your own Noxa server or one shared with you. Remote viewing requires a reachable server and a viewer account. You can also explore the included sample library without signing in.

name: Nudgio
description:
Nudgio lets any AI agent ask you for a decision and get your answer back. One MCP tool call for the agent, one tap for you.
  
Your agent keeps working in the background. When it reaches a decision it should not make alone, it calls Nudgio. A notification arrives on your iPhone or iPad with the question and who is asking. Tap a button or type a short reply, straight from the notification, and the answer goes back to the agent as the result of its call. It picks up where it left off.
  
WHAT AGENTS ASK
• "Draft reply to Sarah is ready. Send it?"
• "All 212 tests passed, 3 migrations will run. Deploy?"
• "Quote is 6% above last order, delivery in 9 days. Approve?"
• "Covering all three regions adds an hour. Continue?"
  
BUILT AROUND THE QUESTION
• Buttons, a typed reply, or both. The agent decides.
• Every request ends as answered, expired or cancelled, so an agent can reason about silence.
• "Yes, but change the greeting" is a normal answer, not an edge case.
• An inbox of every question, with the agent's context and your answer.
• Mute a noisy agent for an hour, or revoke its key for good.
• Optional Face ID lock.
  
WORKS WITH ANY MCP CLIENT
Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, n8n, scripts and custom agents connect in one line. Create an agent at nudgio.co.uk, give it the key, and its questions reach your phone.
  
Nudgio requires a free Nudgio account.

name: NumberCraft: Visual Math
description:
NumberCraft is a tactile, 100% offline visual mathematics studio by Edios Digital Memory Platform LLC, crafted for learners, educators, and independent study across iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Every concept is grounded in concrete, interactive models you can tap, adjust, rotate, hear aloud, and print—with zero subscriptions, zero ads, and zero internet dependency.

SIX INTERACTIVE VISUAL MATH STUDIOS

1. Ten-Frame Counter & Number Bonds
• Build number sense across Single Frames (1–10), Double Teen Frames (11–20), and Subtraction Bonds (10 - X).
• Tap recessed slots to place or remove tactile counters, toggle numbered counting badges, and launch Count With Me for step-by-step spoken enumeration.

2. Base-10 Place Value Blocks
• Construct three-digit numbers using gridded Hundreds flats (100s), segmented Tens rods (10s), and golden unit cubes (1s).
• Watch live expanded-form equations (100 + 40 + 5 = 145) update dynamically as blocks change.

3. Dynamic Multiplication Area Arrays
• Adjust rows and columns (1–10 × 1–10) to visualize multiplication as rectangular unit-square area and repeated addition.
• Tap Rotate 90° to inspect the commutative property visually in real time.

4. Visual Fraction Bar Equality Lab
• Compare aligned 1 Whole, Halves, Fourths, and Eighths strips side by side.
• Discover equivalent fractions (1/2 = 2/4 = 4/8, 1/4 = 2/8, 3/4 = 6/8) with instant decimal and reduced-fraction readouts.

5. 3D Isometric Unit-Cube Volume Builder
• Customize rectangular prism Length, Width, and Height (1–5) in crisp isometric 3D geometry.
• Toggle Separate Layers to see exactly how H horizontal layers of L × W cubes combine into total cubic volume and surface area.

6. 60-Second Math Blitz & Guided Practice
• Test visual fluency across number bonds, place value sums, arrays, equivalent fractions, and 3D volume in a fast 60-second sprint.
• Includes Watch How It Works animated visual demonstrations, a live Visual Insight Coach, printable practice worksheets via AirPrint / Save-to-PDF, and one-tap progress JSON export.

BUILT FOR PRIVACY & FOCUS
• 100% Offline Architecture: All interactive studios, speech coaching, and worksheet exports run completely on-device with no accounts, no analytics, and no external servers.
• Native Spoken Equations: Powered by Apple AVSpeechSynthesizer with selectable Slow and Normal counting paces—playing clearly on iOS even when the mute switch is enabled.
• Data Not Collected: Zero personal data collection and zero cross-app tracking.

name: NUVEFORT
description:
Every receipt adds up. NUVEFORT keeps your grocery receipts, spending and shopping list together.

Scan a receipt, choose one from Photos, or enter it by hand. NUVEFORT reads the photo on your device. Compare the original with the store, date, total and items before you save. Resume a draft whenever you need to.

- Set a weekly or monthly grocery budget and see how much you have left.
- Follow six months of spending and see which aisles account for your totals.
- Find receipts by store or item and export purchase records as a CSV.
- Organize your shopping list by aisle, check off items and see restock suggestions for repeat purchases.

NUVEFORT works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Receipt recognition works offline. There’s no account, subscription or advertising.

name: NVR Eye
description:
NVR Eye is the iPhone and iPad app for the camera server you run at home. See your cameras, catch every event, and close the garage, all without sending your video to anyone else's cloud.

YOUR CAMERAS, YOUR SERVER
NVR Eye connects only to the server your household runs. There's no account with us and no subscription, and your video goes only between your phone and your own hardware. Alerts are end-to-end encrypted on the way, even when they pass through our push relay.

ALERTS THAT SHOW YOU WHAT HAPPENED
• Rich notifications with a snapshot of what was seen
• Press and hold to watch the event's animated preview
• Live and Save Clip buttons right on the notification
• Time-sensitive alerts that get through Focus when it matters
• Alerts grouped by camera, and a "While you were away" list for anything you missed
• End-to-end encrypted: alert content is sealed on your server with a key only your phone has, so neither Apple nor our push relay can read it

ALL OF IPHONE
• Widgets for a camera, your latest activity, and doors and locks, with a one-tap Close or Lock
• Lock Screen widgets for door status and your last alert
• A Live Activity in the Dynamic Island when a garage door is left open, with a timer and a Close button
• Control Center control to close or lock a door
• Siri and Shortcuts: "What did NVR Eye see?", "Is the garage open?", "Close the garage"
• Spotlight search for cameras and saved clips
• Add your cameras, sensors and doors to Apple Home
• Face ID app lock and a choice of app icons

SAFE BY DESIGN
Opening a garage or unlocking a door always needs Face ID or your passcode, and never runs from a widget. Closing and locking are always one tap.

FOR THE WHOLE HOUSEHOLD
Several homes in one app, invitations by link or QR code, and each person picks their own alerts.

TRY IT FIRST
Tap Explore the Demo to try every feature with a sample home. No server needed.

Requires a camera server you run yourself (setup guide linked in the app). Works with Frigate NVR and Home Assistant. NVR Eye is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Frigate or Home Assistant projects.

name: OathstepRPG
description:
Oathstep is an old-school idle RPG with one rule: real effort is the only currency.

Every step you take becomes Vigour, which you spend walking the map and running agility courses. Every workout becomes Energy: runs, rides, swims, rows, gym sessions, anything. Energy pays for everything else: chopping, mining, fishing, smithing, cooking, fighting and more. Nothing else produces either. No gems, no ads, no purchases.

CONNECT APPLE HEALTH Oathstep reads your steps and workouts from Apple Health and turns them into rewards automatically. Harder sessions earn more. You can also log workouts by hand.

IDLE-FRIENDLY Start an action and close the app. It keeps going for up to 12 hours, and the log tells you what happened while you were away. Turn on notifications to hear when your action stops.

OLD-SCHOOL DEPTH • 18 skills levelled 1–99 on the classic XP curve • 24 places joined by roads and shortcuts, under fog that lifts as you walk • 9 agility courses, 26 monsters, elites, lore beasts and 7 bosses • 3 raids, 6 expeditions, 23 quests and 45 milestones • 22 pets, 15 tameable companions whose bond grows with your real steps • A collection log with more than 600 slots

REAL LIFE GATES THE BIG MOMENTS Bosses only appear when you hit a real goal, such as 12,000 steps today or 20 km of cardio this week. Every gate offers several options, so no single kind of training is required.

HONEST NUMBERS 10,000 steps is 100 Vigour and 33 Energy. A 30-minute workout is 75 Energy, about 75 actions. Open the app each day for a small daily ration, so there's always something to do.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN No account, no tracking, no analytics. Your save stays on your iPhone and, if you like, in your own private iCloud.

name: Officially The Move
description:
Officially The Move shows you where everyone's going out tonight in Delray Beach, Boca Raton and Fort Lauderdale.

Pick a night, see which bars people are heading to and what it costs to get in, then lock in your own spot. When people pick a bar, their faces show up on the map, so you can see where the night is happening before you leave the house.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Bars and prices: see walk-in and ticket prices for each bar, any night
- The map: see the faces of everyone going to each spot
- Your calendar: say where you're headed tonight or any night ahead
- Socials: add your Instagram or Snapchat if you want people to find you
- Hide my face: still count toward a bar's crowd without showing your photo

SAFETY
- 18 and over only. You must be 21 or older to drink, and every bar sets and checks its own age rules.
- Every new profile photo is checked automatically before anyone else can see it.
- Report or block anyone from their profile. We review reports within 24 hours.
- Delete your account any time from your profile.

The Move doesn't support underage drinking. Plan a safe ride home.

Questions or feedback: support@officiallythemove.com

name: OHM: Resist Repeat Rise
description:
name
OHM: Resist Repeat Rise

subtitle
Workouts, nutrition, progress

promo
Pick your sport, set your goal, break your resistance. Programs, 3D movement guides and nutrition tracking for the gym, running, swimming, boxing, tennis and more.

keywords
workout,gym,fitness,calorie,diet,weight loss,training,exercise,running,calisthenics,macro,protein

description
Challenge yourself. OHM brings your training, nutrition and progress together. Resist. Repeat. Rise.

BUILT AROUND YOUR SPORT Fitness, calisthenics, running, walking, cycling, swimming, yoga, football, basketball, boxing, tennis and dance. Pick your sports and tell OHM what you want from each: your first 5K, harder hits, round-by-round stamina, your first pull-up… OHM shapes your plan around it, and every sport gets its own color, motto and progress screen.

PROGRAMS AND 3D MOVEMENT GUIDES 29 ready-made programs: full body, 5×5 strength, push/pull/legs, no-equipment home workouts, conditioning and sport-specific programs (striking power, jump power, shoulder care, swimmer dryland, injury prevention). All 109 exercises come with a 3D animation from the side and the front, the muscles worked and the most common mistake.

DURING YOUR WORKOUT Tick off your sets and the rest timer starts by itself. See what you lifted last time; OHM tells you when you set a record. Finish and a shareable card is ready.

NUTRITION Daily calorie, protein, carb, fat and water targets based on your age, height, weight and goal. A 161-item food list with Turkish home cooking. Targets rise a little on training days, and after a few weeks of logging they adapt to how much you really burn.

PROGRESS Weight chart with an arrival estimate, exercise records, weekly streak and progress photos. Progress for each sport in its own measure: km and pace for running, metres for swimming, rounds for boxing, sets for tennis.

APPLE HEALTH Your runs, walks, rides, swims, matches and steps come in from Health automatically. Gym sessions you log in OHM are written to Health and count toward your Move ring. Nothing is counted twice.

MOTIVATION Level up with the Ω you earn, collect 18 badges and keep your weekly streak. Reminders arrive on the days and at the time you choose.

CALISTHENICS AND MOBILITY Step-by-step skill paths for pull-ups, push-ups, legs, core and handstands. Six stretching routines that play with a timer, from a morning wake-up to a desk break.

RESPECTS YOUR PRIVACY No account, no ads, no tracking. All your data stays on your phone. Turkish and English.

OHM is not a medical app; calories and targets are general estimates.

betaDescription
OHM personalizes workout programs, an exercise library with 3D movement guides, nutrition and progress tracking around your sport. In this test version you can try onboarding, programs, Apple Health and per-sport progress.

whatToTest
Thanks for trying OHM!

Please look at:

Onboarding: sex, sports and sport goals. Did the suggested programs fit you?
Do a gym workout: tick your sets. How do the rest timer and the end-of-workout card feel?
Exercise pages: does the 3D animation explain the movement? Does any movement look off?
Profile → Apple Health → connect: do your runs and steps show up under Progress → Your sports? Did your gym session reach Health and your Move ring?
Nutrition: can you find the foods you eat?
Send anything that confused you or that you'd like to see, with a screenshot, through TestFlight ("Share Beta Feedback").

name: OhStamp
description:
Turn a photo into a postage-style stamp with a camera that feels like a mechanical press. Take a photo or choose one from Photos, pick a die, paper color, and cancellation mark, then press to punch out your design.

Keep your favorites in your stamp album. Add a name, notes, or an optional city, and find your stamps again by searching or filtering by die, paper, and mark. Share the finished stamp or save it to Photos.

Make five stamps for free and share a vertical Story image. A one-time OhStamp Pro purchase unlocks unlimited stamping, every standard style, custom albums, and additional export options.

name: Oil Atelier - Oil Painting
description:
Pick up a loaded brush and leave a mark with body. Mix up to three pigments in one stroke, let wet paint mingle, and switch the light to see the ridges on your canvas.

Start from a blank surface or bring a photo. Turn it into oil brushwork in the app or generate a numbered guide and paint it at your own pace. Try a new brush on a practice canvas. Save editable paintings on your device and export finished images to Photos or share them. Works offline without an account.

name: Olvidex
description:
Olvidex brings self-destructing messages to iMessage. Send text, photos, short video clips, and voice notes that delete themselves after a timer you choose.

SEND RIGHT FROM MESSAGES
Open any conversation, tap +, and choose Olvidex. Write the line that shows on the bubble, add your text, photo, clip, or voice note, pick a timer, and send.

YOU PICK THE TIMER
5 seconds, 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute, 5 minutes, 1 hour, or 24 hours. The countdown starts when they open it, not when you send it. A message nobody opens is deleted after 7 days.

ENCRYPTED ON YOUR IPHONE
Your message is encrypted on your iPhone before it's sent. The key travels only inside the bubble, so the Olvidex server only ever holds encrypted data, and only until the message expires.

OPENS ONCE, ON ONE PHONE
Each message opens on one iPhone only. When the timer ends, it's deleted from the server and can't be opened again.

STAY IN CONTROL
Tap your own bubble to see your copy and whether it's been opened. Changed your mind? Delete for Everyone removes it right away, opened or not.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Olvidex never asks for your name, email, phone number, or contacts.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The line you write on the bubble stays in the conversation like any message. Only the content inside expires.
• No app can stop someone from photographing their screen with another device. Only send what you're comfortable sharing.
• Requires iPhone with iOS 16 or later and iMessage. Olvidex messages can't be opened on Android, Mac, or the web.

name: OneMan-ERP
description:
OneMan-ERP adalah aplikasi resmi karyawan CV Cahaya Manis Sejahtera (Manis Manis). Semua urusan kepegawaian sehari-hari kini ada di ponsel Anda, tanpa perlu antre ke bagian HRD.

ABSENSI DARI PONSEL
• Absen masuk dan pulang langsung dari ponsel, dilengkapi foto dan lokasi kerja
• Catat waktu istirahat
• Lihat jadwal shift hari ini dan riwayat kehadiran Anda

CUTI, IZIN, DAN LEMBUR
• Ajukan cuti dan izin kapan saja
• Pantau sisa cuti tahunan dan status persetujuan atasan
• Ajukan lembur dan lihat hasil persetujuannya

GAJI DAN KINERJA
• Lihat slip gaji Anda secara aman
• Pantau skor KPI bulanan

INFORMASI PERUSAHAAN
• Terima pengumuman perusahaan melalui notifikasi
• Lihat data kepegawaian: jabatan, cabang, dan ID karyawan

UNTUK ATASAN DAN HRD
• Setujui pengajuan cuti, izin, lembur, dan koreksi absensi tim langsung dari ponsel

PRIVASI
Lokasi hanya dibaca saat Anda membuka halaman absensi dan melakukan absen; aplikasi tidak melacak lokasi di latar belakang. Kamera hanya digunakan untuk foto absen.

CATATAN
Aplikasi ini khusus untuk karyawan Manis Manis. Akun diberikan oleh HRD perusahaan; tidak ada pendaftaran akun umum.

name: oolux
description:
oolux is a colour grading tool built the way a photograph is actually made. It takes your picture back to the light that fell on the scene, exposes it onto a colour negative, and prints it in a darkroom, one physical step at a time. Every control is a real setting with a real unit: light in kelvin, exposure in stops, film speed as EI, filtration in CC.

It is made for photographers who already think in those terms, and for anyone who wants to learn them.

SHAPE THE LIGHT FIRST
Before the film, the Artist stage works on the scene itself: key light colour in kelvin, fill light in stops, light softness, graduated ND and colour graduated filters, tone zones from shadows to highlights, surface colour by hue, and up to four local layers painted with a brush, a gradient, a circle, or a person or subject mask found on the device. Then apply the film.

THE CHAIN
• Capture: scene light as a black-body spectrum. Film has no white balance, so a daylight stock under tungsten records it warm, as the light and the film's layer sensitivities dictate.
• Lens: defocus, diffusion, chromatic aberration, vignetting and colour compensating filters on the lens, with the meter reading through them.
• Film: three emulsion layers with characteristic curves, spectral sensitivities and sharpness modelled on manufacturers' published data. Grain, halation and edge effects live on the negative, not on top of the picture. View the negative itself on a light table.
• Print: colour paper curves, print exposure in stops, enlarger filtration in CC, easel cropping and edge burning. A Test Strip and an Analyzer, like a real darkroom.
• Minilab: automatic correction that reads the negative the way a lab machine does. Set it to zero and print by hand.
• Time: how a colour print fades in an album or on a sunlit wall (estimated rates).

BLACK AND WHITE
Panchromatic stocks, coloured lens filters with exposure compensation, development from N to N+2, and variable-contrast paper grades. Spectral filter behaviour verified against manufacturer data under specific conditions.

THE CAMERA
On iPhone, a camera that offers only what the phone really has: its lenses, its shutter times and its aperture. Natural keeps the sensor's own RAW data. Long, Motion, Action and Freeze are shutter times, not effects. Camera Control works as the shutter and selects the lens.

FOR THE WORK
• Opens RAW from the camera and the phone, including DNG with a scene-linear decode, plus HEIC with HDR, JPEG, PNG and TIFF.
