• Live preview on the GPU, full-resolution export to JPEG, HEIC and 16-bit TIFF, including the negative itself.
• On iPhone, edits are saved over the original as an edit you can revert in Photos.
• Scopes at every point of the chain: histogram, waveform, parade, vectorscope and zones.
• Recipes to start from, and your own saved looks. Each export carries its recipe.
• A separate creative layer for LUTs and curves, kept apart from the physical chain. Export your look as a .cube for your editing or video software.
• A technical datasheet of every photo as a PDF.
• Every stage explains itself in its info card, with figures drawn from the same data the app uses.

A NOTE FOR CREATORS
If you came for a quick look for your next reel, you are very welcome here. There are no one-tap filters, though. Start from a recipe, move one real setting at a time, and you will learn why film looks the way it does. Your look will be yours, and it will stay consistent from one frame to the next.

ONE PURCHASE
iPhone, iPad and Mac with Apple silicon. No subscription, no account, no in-app purchases, no export limits. Everything is processed on your device.

Film and paper profiles are models built from published technical data. oolux is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by any film or camera manufacturer.

name: OperatorSafe Driver
description:
OperatorSafe Driver is the driver app for transport companies that use OperatorSafe. You need a company code from your transport manager to sign in.

DAILY WALKROUND CHECKS
• Complete your daily vehicle or trailer check on your phone in a couple of minutes.
• Report a defect with a note and photos. Serious defects are flagged to your transport manager straight away.
• Works with no signal: your check is saved on the phone and sent when you are back in range.

EVERYTHING ELSE IN ONE PLACE
• Report an accident with the time, place, photos and the other party's details.
• Read and sign letters, toolbox talks and other documents sent by your company.
• See and sign your tachograph infringement reports.
• Complete your driving licence check when asked.

SIMPLE TO USE
• Sign in with your driving licence number or driver card number and a 4 digit PIN.
• Your completed checks are kept by your company as part of its maintenance record.

OperatorSafe is transport compliance software for UK operators of lorries, vans and trailers. To find out more, visit operatorsafe.co.uk.

name: Orbit Relay: Retro Pinball
description:
Orbit Relay is an offline pinball game inspired by physical arcade tables. Its wood cabinet frames an illustrated observatory playfield with steel rails, colored insert lamps, and a dot-matrix scoreboard. Hold and release the launcher to set your shot power. Time both flippers to keep the ball in play.

• Light all three upper lanes to complete the relay and raise your score multiplier.
• Hit four bumpers and the coral target bank to build your score.
• Play three balls per game. Each ball gets one retry if it drains within five seconds.
• Play with touch controls or a compatible game controller.
• Adjust sound and haptics independently. Pause and come back to the same game.
• Chase your personal best offline, with no account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: OreQuest - Mining & Geology
description:
OreQuest is a complete field engineering office in your pocket for mining engineers, geologists, mine surveyors and site supervisors. It brings essential calculations of desktop mine-planning software to the pit, the drift and the outcrop — working 100% offline.

One-time purchase: no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases. All 36 tools included across 32 languages.

OPEN PIT • 3D bench design: draw the toe, set bench height, face angle and berm; instant volume, tonnage, overall slope and 3D DXF export • Haul road & ramp alignment: cut and fill volumes, minimum width and stopping sight distance • Drill & blast: square/staggered pattern, charge, delays; USBM PPV vibration, air overpressure, flyrock range and Kuz-Ram fragmentation • Optimum pit: nested pit shells (Lerchs-Grossmann / Max-Flow) from a 3D block model, strip ratio and NPV • Pit inspection checklists and stockpile volume

UNDERGROUND • Drift axis & profile (arch, horseshoe, rectangular), excavation volume and tonnage • Rock bolts & shotcrete support from Q/RMR • Room-and-pillar tributary area & Obert-Duvall safety factor • Sublevel caving ring layout & recoverable tonnage • Roof wedge analysis from three joint sets and bolt safety factor • Ventilation network: Hardy-Cross airflow balancing, fan duty, air power and shaft power

GEOLOGY & RESOURCE • Clinometer: lay your phone on the rock surface for dip, dip direction and strike • Equal-area Schmidt stereonet for poles and planes • QR-labelled sample register and drillhole / core logging (RQD & TCR) • Resource estimation: compositing, variograms, Ordinary Kriging / IDW, 3D block model and Measured/Indicated/Inferred classification • Lab QA/QC control charts (±2σ / ±3σ) and grade-tonnage curve

GEOTECHNICS • Bieniawski RMR89, Barton Q-system and GSI classification • Kinematic analysis: planar, wedge and flexural toppling feasibility on the stereonet • Slope stability: Hoek & Bray planar failure and Simplified Bishop critical slip circle

FIELD, SURVEY & TEAM • Coordinate conversion: WGS84, UTM, ITRF96 3° TM and ED50 3° TM • RTK & stakeout: external GNSS receiver (Wi-Fi/TCP NMEA), fix status, azimuth & distance • Drone DEM & point clouds (XYZ): stockpile volume and cut/fill • CAD import (DXF, Shapefile, LandXML) and live GPS field map (Satellite, Topo, Hillshade, OSM) with GeoJSON, DXF, CSV & PDF export • Field notebook, project backups (.oqp) and one-tap PDF field reports

HSE & OPERATIONS • Incident reports with 5 Whys, work permits with gas tests (O₂, CH₄, CO, H₂S), LOTO checklists • Safety statistics (LTIFR, TRIFR, severity rate) • Fleet & cycle study (match factor, hourly production) • Water/environment monitoring, sunset warning and man-down alarm

Important: Design, stability and resource results are preliminary; obtain a qualified engineer's approval before acting on them. Phone sensor measurements are approximate.

name: ORIX Audio
description:
ORIX Audio is a recorder and an audio laboratory in one app. Record a meeting, a lecture or a voice note, then see it, measure it, transcribe it and export it — without an account and without your audio leaving your device.

RECORD
• Six presets, from compact AAC to 24-bit WAV and Apple Lossless
• Keeps recording when the screen is locked; the Lock Screen shows the recording in progress
• Markers, pause and resume, live level meters with clip detection
• If the app is closed unexpectedly, the audio already captured is offered for recovery

SEE THE SOUND
• Waveforms coloured by the frequencies actually present at each moment
• Spectrum analyzer with selectable FFT size and window, peak hold and a frequency cursor
• Zoomable spectrogram with six palettes, including colourblind-friendly and high-contrast

MEASURE
• Peak, RMS, crest factor, clipping, silence
• Loudness to ITU-R BS.1770-4: integrated, short-term and momentary LUFS, loudness range, true peak
• Spectral centroid, bandwidth, rolloff, flatness and band energy
• Levels are relative to digital full scale (dBFS); the app does not measure sound pressure

TRANSCRIBE AND SUMMARIZE
• Transcription runs on your device, in the languages your device supports
• Search, edit, label speakers by hand, export subtitles
• On devices with Apple Intelligence: summaries, key points, action items and decisions written on-device from the transcript, each linked to the line it came from

EDIT AND EXPORT
• Trim, split, merge, fades, gain, normalize, remove silences — never altering the original
• Noise reduction, filters, equalizer, compressor
• Export WAV, AIFF, CAF, Apple Lossless or AAC; transcripts as text, Markdown, SRT, WebVTT, CSV, JSON or PDF; analysis reports; waveform and spectrogram images
• Import audio files and the audio of your videos

AUTOMATE
• Build workflows such as Analyze → Transcribe → Summarize → Export and run them on many recordings

PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no uploads
• Optional Face ID lock

Recording conversations is regulated in many places. Tell people when you record and get consent where the law requires it.

Speakers are not identified automatically. Summaries are generated by an on-device model from an automatic transcript and can contain errors.

name: ORIX Camera
description:
ORIX Camera is a camera for people who want to know what their camera is doing.

Open it and shoot: Auto mode needs nothing else. When you want control, it is one tap away, and every control drives the actual camera.

AUTO
• Point and shoot with tap to focus and expose
• Exposure compensation, self-timer, burst
• Short, factual hints: clipped highlights, low light, slow shutter, tilted horizon

PRO PHOTO
• Manual ISO, shutter speed, exposure compensation, focus and white balance on precise dials
• Each lens of your iPhone, selected directly
• RAW (DNG) and Apple ProRAW on iPhones and lenses that support them
• Options your camera cannot offer stay visible, with the reason

PRO VIDEO
• Resolution, frame rate and codec selection: H.264, HEVC, and Apple ProRes on supported devices
• 180° shutter in one tap, focus pulls between two marks
• Audio meter, remaining recording time, heat indicator
• Time-lapse and slow motion

MONITORING
• Histogram, luminance or RGB, computed from every pixel of the live image
• Focus peaking with adjustable sensitivity and colour
• Zebras with adjustable threshold, shadow warning
• False colour and clipping warning
• Grids, aspect guides, safe framing, level

CREATIVE
• Long exposure and light trails, built up live in the viewfinder
• Night stack: several frames aligned and merged for less noise
• Bracket fusion for scenes with bright skies and dark shadows
• Intervalometer

EDIT AND ORGANISE
• Non-destructive editor: your original is never modified
• Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, white balance, curves, crop, straighten, looks
• Undo, redo, before and after
• Library with albums, favourites, search and duplicate detection
• Full metadata inspector

EXPORT
• JPEG, HEIC, PNG, TIFF, or the untouched original
• Choose size, quality and colour space
• Remove location or all metadata when sharing

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No cloud. No ads. No tracking.
• The app contains no networking code
• Photos and videos stay in the app's library on your device until you export them
• Photos access is add-only: ORIX Camera can save a copy to your library but never reads it

GOOD TO KNOW
• Video is recorded in 8-bit SDR. HDR and Log recording are not available in this version.
• Long exposure, light trails and night stack are computed from the video stream and saved at its resolution.
• Zoom within a lens is digital.
• Features depend on your device and lens; the app tells you what yours supports.

name: Orrivane
description:
An astrolabe that listens.
Draw a chord on a turning brass plate. The sector where your stroke begins is the color you ask for: Ember, Tide, or Violet. The length of the sweep is the meter: Quick, Even, or Slow.
Sweep with the clock and let go to gather. A star of that color and shape must already be standing in the gold window, and it must be the next mark of the night. A true hearing, near the middle of the window, returns a breath.
Sweep against the clock to call. The matching star is drawn into the window and rides there for a moment. Then gather it. A call spends one breath.
Eight plates open in order, from Kindling Rim to Orrivane Itself. Seal a night to keep it. Clarity remembers leftover breath, unbroken hairlines, and how centered each star was heard. The same chord twice turns the sky away. When the air is gone, the night leaves. When the last hairline breaks, the plate shatters.
One finger. Portrait. The stars keep their rings until you ask.

name: Ownly
description:
OWNLY adalah pusat kendali aset dan inventaris pribadi untuk rumah tangga. Lihat apa yang perlu perhatian: jadwal perawatan, barang mendekati kedaluwarsa, dan stok yang menipis.

• Katalog aset (kendaraan, elektronik, perkakas) dan inventaris dengan lokasi dan kategori
• Jadwal perawatan dan pengingat, termasuk notifikasi
• Catat pembelian, nilai aset, dan biaya kepemilikan
• Simpan dokumen (garansi, faktur, STNK) dan QR untuk tiap barang
• Kunci aplikasi dengan PIN atau biometrik
• Cadangkan dan pulihkan data, amankan akun dengan Apple atau Google
• Bahasa Indonesia dan English

Gratis, tanpa iklan.

name: Özcoşar Hukuk
description: Özcoşar Hukuk, Özcoşar Hukuk & Danışmanlık bürosunun kendi çalışanları için hazırlanmış büro içi uygulamasıdır. Uygulamayı yalnızca büronun verdiği hesapla giriş yapan çalışanlar kullanabilir.

name: Özel Becerik Sürücü Kursu
description: Bu uygulama, Özel Becerik sürücü kursu adaylarının ehliyet sınavına hazırlanmasına yardımcı olmak için tasarlanmıştır. Uygulamada, sınavda çıkabilecek sorular, konuların açıklamaları ve video dersler bulunmaktadır. Kullanıcılar, uygulama üzerinden pratik yaparak bilgilerini pekiştirebilir ve sınavda başarılı olma şanslarını artırabilirler.

name: PacketKit: Network & Security
description:
PacketKit puts the small tools a network or security engineer reaches for all day into one app. It is open source, with no ads, no account and no tracking.

NETWORK
• Subnet calculator and VLSM splitter (IPv4 and IPv6)
• CIDR summarizer: paste a messy prefix list, get the minimal route set
• Wildcard mask and ACL converter
• MTU / MSS calculator for stacked encapsulations
• Transfer-time calculator
• Config diff that can skip comments and whitespace
• Ping, measured as a timed TCP connect
• TCP port check for a few ports on a host you operate
• DNS lookup: your system resolver next to DNS over HTTPS
• Whois that follows referrals
• TLS certificate inspector: issuer, expiry, days left, and whether the chain is trusted
• MAC / OUI vendor lookup that works offline
• Local interfaces and public IP

SECURITY
• Defang and refang indicators for tickets and chat
• IOC extractor: IPs, domains, URLs, emails, hashes and CVEs out of any text
• Email header analyzer: hop chain with delays, SPF, DKIM and DMARC verdicts
• CVSS v3.1 base score calculator
• JWT decoder that never sends the token anywhere
• Hashes: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and SHA-512 of text or a file, with compare
• Timestamp converter: epoch, Windows FILETIME, ISO 8601
• Decoder workbench: Base64, URL, hex, HTML entities and ROT13, chained

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
The calculators, decoders and analyzers run on your device. Paste a config, a token or a log line and it goes nowhere. Only the network tools use the network, and they talk only to the host you name.
Privacy policy: https://netopsfieldnotes.com/tools/packetkit/privacy/

OPEN SOURCE
The code is public: https://github.com/labaccessnow/packetkit

name: Padel Kélibia
description:
L'application officielle du Padel Club Kélibia : votre terrain et vos tournois dans votre poche.

RÉSERVER UN TERRAIN
• Les créneaux libres de chaque terrain, jour par jour
• Une demande en quelques secondes : le club la confirme et vous êtes prévenu par notification
• Vos réservations à venir et votre historique au même endroit
• Annulation depuis l'application jusqu'à 6 heures avant la partie
• Rappel automatique 2 heures avant de jouer

TOURNOIS
• Les tournois du club : poules, tableau final, consolante, Americano
• Le programme des matchs, avec vos matchs mis en avant
• Résultats mis à jour en direct pendant le tournoi
• Notification dès que le programme est publié

VOTRE COMPTE
• Connexion avec Google ou Apple, sans mot de passe
• Votre abonnement et vos carnets de séances, une fois votre numéro validé par l'accueil du club
• Application en français et en anglais

ESPACE STAFF
L'équipe du club gère depuis l'application le planning du jour, les demandes de réservation, les réservations prises par téléphone, le blocage de créneaux et les scores des tournois.

Padel Club Kélibia — Avenue Ali Belhouane, Kélibia
https://padelkelibia.com

name: Pagefold – Photo Journal
description:
Pagefold turns your trips, weekends and big moments into albums that feel like a real notebook. Every page is a blank canvas: add your photos and videos, arrange them the way you remember the day, and write about it in your own hand.

A REAL NOTEBOOK
• Pages fill the whole screen and turn with a realistic page curl.
• Every album sits on your desk as its own notebook, with a cover photo and a label.
• Choose dotted, lined, grid, kraft, blackboard or cream paper.

ARRANGE FREELY
• Add many photos and videos at once from your library.
• Drag, pinch and twist to place them anywhere, at any size and angle.
• Layer them, duplicate them, straighten them, and undo any change.

FRAMES WITH CHARACTER
• Polaroid, washi tape, border, rounded, circle, film strip and postage stamp.

WRITE IT DOWN
• Captions, dates and notes in six handwritten styles.
• Underline them, put them on a paper label, or stamp them like "LIVED".

VIDEOS THAT COME ALIVE
• Videos play silently right on the page.
• Tap any video to watch it full screen with sound.
• Tap any photo to see it full screen and zoom into every detail.

ORIGINAL QUALITY
• Photos and videos are kept exactly as they came from your library, never re-compressed.
• Pages show light previews, so albums open fast and take little space.

SYNCED WITH ICLOUD (PRO)
• Every change is saved to your private iCloud and appears on your iPhone and iPad.
• Full-quality originals stay in iCloud and download when you open them.
• Reinstall the app and your albums come back.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your memories stay on your devices and in your own iCloud.

Share any page as an image, browse all pages at a glance, and make Pagefold yours in Settings: page curl or slide, default paper, frame and handwriting.

PAGEFOLD PRO
Your first album is free, with every feature. Pagefold Pro unlocks unlimited albums and iCloud sync. Choose monthly or yearly (auto-renewing), or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gheorghe96.github.io/pagefold-privacy/

name: Pamuk: 2 Player & Mini Games
description:
Play dozens of ad-free mini games in one place, completely free and with zero interruptions.

Tired of forced video ads, paywalls, and mandatory sign-ups after every level? Pamuk brings together an ever-growing collection of original mini games designed and coded by 11-year-old indie creator Deniz. Whenever Deniz publishes a new game, it appears right inside the app without waiting for an update.

DOZENS OF MINI GAMES IN ONE APP
- Parkour & Runner: Pamuk Parkur (100-level 3D sky obby), Slime Jump (100 stages), Kedi Sürüsü, Kedi Koşusu
- Racing & Reflex: Rushing Cars (3D highway traffic racing), Flex (10 endless skill challenges), Reflexes, Perfection, Circle Survival
- Simulation & Adventure: Market Simülasyonu (3D supermarket sim), Derin Olta (fishing & island upgrades), Tower Fight (3D block tower & boss battles)
- Strategy, Puzzle & Relax: Kedi Savunması (tower defense), Sonsuz Kule (with 2-player co-op), Puzzle Room, Relaxibility (13 fidget toys), Kedi Şansı, Paket, Sector Clicker, Dice Roll, Cat Logo

2-PLAYER & LIVE DUELS
- Same-device 2-player competition in Reflexes and Perfection
- Live duels and global leaderboards in Pamuk Parkur, Flex, and Rushing Cars
- Two-player co-op mode in Sonsuz Kule

SAFE, SIMPLE & NO REAL MONEY
- Zero ads and zero in-app purchases
- Play immediately as a guest without an account, or pick a nickname with an optional password to sync progress across iPhone, iPad, and web
- Built-in nickname filter, blocking, and reporting tools

Note: An internet connection is required to load games from the live library.

name: Paname Club
description:
Que faire à Paris ce soir ? Dis-le simplement, Paname Club te répond.

JE VEUX SORTIR…
Ce soir, demain, ce week-end, à deux, entre amis, en famille, gratuit, moins de 20 €, près de toi : choisis, ou écris ta sortie avec tes mots (« un concert pas cher dans le 11e pour deux »). Trois idées fortes, chacune avec sa raison.

TOUT PARIS, CHAQUE JOUR À JOUR
Plus de 20 000 sorties : concerts, expositions, théâtre, humour, danse, cinéma, festivals, ateliers, visites, soirées. Les grandes scènes (Philharmonie, Olympia, Comédie-Française…), les expos du moment, la dernière chance, le gratuit de la semaine.

LA CARTE ET « AUTOUR DE MOI »
Ce qui commence près de toi, lieu par lieu.

ALERTES CONCERTS
Suis tes artistes et tes lieux : une notification quand ils annoncent une date à Paris, quand la billetterie ouvre, et la veille de ta sortie.

LE CLUB
Match pour swiper les sorties, le quiz « Tu préfères » et ton ADN culturel, le Drop du lundi (5 idées choisies pour toi), les défis de la semaine, les badges et le Top des membres.

TES SORTIES, PARTOUT
Garde une sortie, dis « J'y vais », ajoute-la à ton calendrier, trouve l'itinéraire, partage-la. Tes sorties gardées restent disponibles sans réseau.

Les réservations se font sur les billetteries et les sites des lieux. Les horaires et les prix sont à vérifier auprès de l'organisateur.

name: PaperSignal
description: Give a favorite phrase a place on your iPhone with Paper Signal. Start with a blank design or choose one of six original styles, then add a main line and a smaller note. Pick a typeface, change the alignment, and drag your words into position. Preview the design on example Lock Screen and Home Screen layouts to see where the clock, widgets, icons, or dock might overlap your text. Find a nearby clear spot automatically if the text overlaps. Keep editable designs in your library or export full-resolution PNG and JPG images to Photos or the share sheet. Everything works offline.

name: parlingy
description:
parlingy teaches you a language one bright little lesson at a time.

bite-size lessons take you from zero to ordering coffee, finding the station and talking about your day. every phrase is spoken by a natural voice for its language. tap the snail to slow it down, and finish each lesson with a listening question.

what's inside
• 9 languages: japanese, korean, mandarin chinese, spanish, french, italian, german, portuguese and english
• short lessons: read it, hear it, pick the answer. miss one and it comes back at the end
• flashcards with spaced repetition, so each word comes back right before you'd forget it
• talk with your buddy: role-play real situations, one reply at a time
• short stories built from words you already know
• japanese kana, korean hangul and mandarin tones, with a sound for every letter
• a daily goal, gentle reminders and a streak that grows with you
• four colour palettes, one tap

try a lesson first, no account needed. sign in with apple, google or your email whenever you like, and your lessons, flashcards and streak follow you to every device.

start with one language, free.

name: PartFit: Appliance Filters
description:
PartFit answers one question: which filter or panel actually fits the appliance in front of you, and where that answer comes from.

Point the camera at the model plate, or at the label on the cartridge you are about to throw away. Text is read on the device and nothing is uploaded.

WHAT YOU GET
- Fitment by appliance model, or by the part number printed on the old cartridge
- A grade on every answer: Explicit (the manufacturer lists this exact model against this part), Rule (the maker states a model prefix or series rule, so you confirm before buying), or Part only (just the consumable is documented)
- A source link on every claim, so you can open the manufacturer's own page and check it
- Replacement intervals with reminders at 14, 3 and 0 days
- A replacement log with part numbers and cost history
- CSV and JSON export with the evidence columns included
- No account, no subscription, no ads. Works in airplane mode and in a basement.

COVERAGE, HONESTLY
Refrigerator water filters, humidifier water panels and air-purifier filter sets from Samsung, LG, GE, Whirlpool, AprilAire, Levoit and comparable brands. Each entry is pinned to the page it came from. If your model is not covered, PartFit says so and shows the closest series instead of guessing. If two manufacturer pages disagree about one model, both are shown side by side.

WHERE THE ANSWERS COME FROM
Every entry carries the manufacturer URL, the date it was checked and a grade. Manufacturer pages change and pages get pulled; the app records what was read rather than assuming it stays true.

PartFit is an independent reference tool, not affiliated with any appliance manufacturer. Brand and model names identify the equipment you own.

name: Paste Release
description:
Paste Release keeps a stencil board on this iPhone.

Drag a pad width on the aperture grid. Area ratio is the opening over the foil wall. Aspect is the short side over the foil. A pad sticks when the ratio is under 0.66 or the aspect is under 1.5. The named pad is the sticking one with the lowest ratio.

Change the foil thickness and the widths stay as you saved them. Save a run, then compare two runs on the limit line. Share sends the status, the named pad, and the area ratio.

Pads and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Pebble: Little Good Things
description:
The little things are worth remembering.

Pebble is a quiet place to keep the good in your day. Write a few words, add a photo if you like, and place a stone. Over time, your cairn becomes a collection of moments that matter to you.

KEEP THE SMALL GOOD THINGS
A warm cup. A kind word. The sky on the way home. Save a moment in a few words, with an optional photo.

COME BACK TO YOUR MEMORIES
Tap a stone to read it again. Search by a word, browse by date, or rediscover a saved moment.

A LITTLE HELLO FROM YEARS PAST
“On this day” brings back memories from the same date in previous years. Choose optional anniversary reminders when you want a gentle nudge.

YOURS TO KEEP
Edit your words, remove a memory, or export a backup containing your words and photos. Restore a backup to add missing memories without replacing the ones already here.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No account required. No ads. No analytics. No streaks to maintain.

Your memories are stored on your device. You choose where to save exported backups.

Made for iPhone and iPad, with layouts for both Duo displays.

Start with one small good thing.

name: PebbleSphere
description:
Welcome to Pebble Sphere, the first-of-its-kind dating platform exclusively designed for the dwarfism community. We believe that everyone deserves a space where they feel seen, understood, and celebrated. Pebble Sphere isn't just another dating app; it's a dedicated environment built to foster meaningful connections, friendships, and romantic relationships among little people.

Finding a partner who understands your unique perspective shouldn't be a challenge. With Pebble Sphere, we’ve removed the barriers and created a streamlined experience focused on what matters most: genuine connection. Whether you are looking for a lifelong partner or a supportive friend within the community, our platform provides the tools to help you find exactly what you’re looking for.

Key Features:
- Tailored Discovery: Our Main Feed allows you to browse profiles specifically within the dwarfism community. View photos, bios, and essential details like height and age to find someone who resonates with you.
- Intuitive Matching: Use our simple swipe-to-like system. If the feeling is mutual, it’s a match! No more guessing games—just clear, exciting connections.
- Real-Time Messaging: Once you match, dive into our secure chat interface. Share stories, photos, and get to know each other through our seamless, real-time messaging system.
- Detailed Profiles: Express yourself fully. Upload your best photos, write a compelling bio, and list your interests. Your profile is your canvas to show the world who you are.
- Customizable Preferences: Take control of your dating life. Set your preferred age range and maximum distance to find matches that fit your lifestyle and location.
- Privacy & Safety: We prioritize your security. With robust reporting and blocking features, you can ensure your experience remains positive and respectful.

Join Pebble Sphere today and become part of a growing community where hearts connect without boundaries. Your next great love story starts here.

name: Penfolk: Pen Pals Worldwide
description:
Penfolk is a pen pal app for people who like to take their time. Write to people around the world, learn a language together, and make friends who write back.

Open letters
Post a letter to everyone, or read what others wrote and answer the ones that speak to you. A topic helps the right people find it.

Find your people
Filter by the languages someone speaks and the ones they are learning, by country, city, interests and what they are looking for.

Conversations with room to breathe
Send photos and voice notes, start a poll, share a travel plan or a Top 3 list. Write when you have something to say.

Communities and events
Join communities around a language, a place or a hobby, talk in channels, and see what events are coming up.

A feed that stays quiet
Posts from everyone or just the people you follow, newest first, plus who just joined. Nothing is ranked to keep you scrolling.

Safe by design
Blocking works both ways and you can report any profile or message. Free accounts can start 10 new conversations a day, which keeps spam down.

Free to use. One optional plan if you want more.

Made in Belgium by an independent developer.

name: Perfriends
description:
Планирование дел и встреч:
1) Работает через Siri (Привет, Siri, Perfriends новый план)
2) По желанию подключение к телеграмм (напоминания, работа с делами из ui телеграмм)
3) Профиль, ачивки друзьям и за выполненные дела
4) Можно шарить дела между группами. Все участники видят дела, могут их заводить и вносить изменения

name: PersonalSessionManager
description:
Session Planner turns your AWS re:Invent schedule into a calendar you can read at a glance.

Sign in once with your AWS Builder ID and the app shows what the conference site already holds for you: the seats you have reserved, the sessions you were invited to, and your favorites. There is nothing to enter twice.

A CALENDAR, NOT A LIST
• Each day is a timeline with your reserved and invited sessions as blocks.
• Sessions that overlap sit side by side, so a clash is obvious.
• Favorites stay out of the way until you ask for them, then appear as one marker per hour that opens the list.

KNOW WHEN A WALK IS TOO TIGHT
• The app warns you when two sessions in different venues are less than 30 minutes apart.

FIND AND CHANGE SESSIONS
• Search the whole catalog by code, title, speaker or topic.
• See only your own sessions, or only sessions that still have seats.
• Add or remove a favorite, reserve a seat, or cancel a reservation. Every change is made on the conference site itself, and the app then shows what the site says.

WORKS WITHOUT A CONNECTION
• Your calendar is saved on the phone, so it opens in a crowded hall with no signal. Update when you are back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• You sign in on AWS's own page. The app never sees your password.
• Your sign-in is kept in the iPhone's keychain, on this device only.
• No analytics, no ads, no tracking, and no server of the developer's.

TRY IT FIRST
• No Builder ID? Choose "Try the sample conference" to explore every screen with made-up sessions.

Requires an AWS Builder ID registered for the event to show a real schedule. Session information is provided by the AWS Events API. Session Planner is an independent app and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Amazon Web Services. AWS and re:Invent are trademarks of Amazon.com, Inc. or its affiliates.

name: Pflänzchen
description:
Pflänzchen is a little plant that grows when you drink water.

Every time you drink a glass, tap the faucet. Water arcs into the pot and your plant perks up. Three glasses in a day counts that day toward your streak, and your streak is what makes it grow.

FROM SEED TO BLOOM
Your plant grows through five stages, each in its own world: a seed at dawn, a sprout in the morning light, leaves in the golden afternoon, a bud at dusk under the first stars, and a full bloom glowing under the moon. Stages stay unlocked once you reach them.

IT NEEDS YOU
Go too long without water and your plant starts to wilt, and the colors fade with it. Leave it for a day and a half and it dies. Replant and start again from a seed.

A PLANT WITH A PERSONALITY
Name your plant and pick how it talks to you: Chill, Dramatic, or Thirsty. Its reminders come in that voice: a gentle nudge, a crisis, or loud enthusiasm.

ON YOUR WRIST
Water from your Apple Watch. If your iPhone is out of reach, the water is delivered when it reconnects.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

name: Photo Milau
description:
Photo Milau helps you prepare photos, signatures and documents for online application forms in Nepal. Choose your form, add an image, and get a file sized to its limits.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Resize photos to exact pixel dimensions
• Compress files to a KB limit
• Set DPI when a form requires it
• Crop, zoom and rotate with a simple guide
• Make a plain photo background white
• Clean up a signature into dark ink on white
• Combine document scans into one PDF
• Check format, dimensions and file size before uploading
• Enter custom limits from any form or notice
• Use the app in English or Nepali

FORMS INCLUDED
• Lok Sewa and provincial PSC
• Police recruitment and police report
• Teacher Service
• e-Passport document scans
• Driving license
• US DV photo
• College, entrance and National ID forms through custom limits

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your files are processed on your device. Photo Milau has no account, ads, analytics or tracking, and your files are not uploaded to us. Temporary files are deleted automatically.

PLEASE CHECK YOUR NOTICE
Requirements can change and may vary between forms. Photo Milau shows the source for its limits and labels how far each one has been confirmed. Always follow your official notice. The app checks file size, format and dimensions, but it cannot guarantee that a form will accept your file.

INDEPENDENT APP
Photo Milau is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government, commission or public office. It does not submit forms or enter you in any program.

Official sources:
Public Service Commission: psc.gov.np
Department of Passports: nepalpassport.gov.np
Department of Transport Management: dotm.gov.np
Department of National ID and Civil Registration: donidcr.gov.np
US Department of State: travel.state.gov

name: Photos Safe at Home
description:
Photos Safe automatically copies your iPhone photos and videos to your home NAS: Synology, QNAP, UGREEN, Nextcloud or any WebDAV server.

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
• They go only from your phone to your NAS: no servers of ours, no account, no ads, no data collected.
• Your password stays in the iPhone Keychain.
• Nothing is deleted: photos stay on your phone and in iCloud, the app only makes an extra copy.

ON ITS OWN
• On iOS 27, new photos are sent even when the app is closed, managed by iOS.
• If your NAS is reachable from the internet over HTTPS, it works away from home too.
• Ready-made Shortcuts: "when I get home" or "when I plug in".
• Night mode for the first copy: black screen, phone charging, and by morning everything is on the NAS.

TIDY
• One folder per year (or per year and month, or all together).
• Date and time taken go in front of the file name, so alphabetical order is shooting order.
• Always the original file (HEIC, JPEG, RAW/DNG, MOV), with no conversion, including Live Photo videos.
• No duplicates: every file is checked after copying.

IF WEBDAV DOESN'T ANSWER
• At home the app can also use SMB, the Windows and macOS file sharing.

What you need: a NAS or server with WebDAV turned on, and a user with a password.

name: Physics Lab - Wild Crocodile
description:
Predict it. Test it. Explain it. A pocket physics lab for middle and high school.

Twelve hands-on labs with real units and real equations, so what students measure matches what they would find in a classroom lab.

TWELVE HANDS-ON LABS

• Gravity & Air: Drop a steel ball and a feather from 10 m on Earth, the Moon, Mars or Jupiter, with or without air. See terminal velocity happen.
• Projectile Launcher: Choose an angle and speed and launch at a target. Compare the range with R = v² sin 2θ / g, then switch on air resistance.
• Inclined Plane: Tilt a ramp until the block lets go. Measure how grippy ice, wood, carpet and rubber are, and discover μ = tan θ.
• Friction Table: Aim and shoot a cue ball. Watch friction (μ) slow every ball at a steady rate, and compare the predicted stopping distance with the measured one.
• Momentum Carts: Crash two carts with springy or sticky bumpers. Watch total momentum stay the same while kinetic energy can disappear.
• Pendulum: Change the string length, mass and gravity. Measure the period, compare it with T = 2π√(L/g), and watch kinetic and potential energy trade places.
• Springs & Hooke's Law: Hang masses, stretch the spring and let it bounce. Discover F = kx, and that a spring bounces just as fast on the Moon.
• Waves & Sound: Shake a guitar-length string, find standing waves at f = n·v/2L, and hear the pitch.
• Wrench & Bolt: Loosen a stuck bolt with a real-world wrench. Slide your grip along the handle and discover why the end of the handle (or a pipe extension) wins.
• Torque Seesaw: Drag 1, 2 and 5 kg weights onto a lever, move the pivot, and balance the torques. A live table shows τ = F × r for every weight.
• Buoyancy Tank: Drop cork, ice, an egg or steel into oil, fresh water, sea water or the Dead Sea. Will it float, and how deep?
• Orbits: Fire Newton's cannon from a giant mountain. Find circular orbit speed, escape speed and the 24-hour geostationary orbit.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT

• Predict first. Tap Predict on any live graph and sketch what you think will happen, with a finger or Apple Pencil. Then run the experiment and see how close you were.
• Made for iPhone Duo. Unfold the Duo and each lab opens like a book: the experiment on the left page and the Lab Notebook (live graph, measurements, controls) on the right. iPad and iPhone in landscape get the same two-page spread.
• Real numbers. Meters, seconds, kilograms, joules and newton-meters. Students can check every result with the formula they are learning.
• Built for the classroom. Export any graph as a picture and its data as a spreadsheet (CSV) for lab reports. Every lab has a printable worksheet with a data table and analysis questions, plus a teacher answer key.
• "Think about it" questions in each lab guide students from what they see to why it happens.

No ads, no accounts, no data collection.

name: PicConverter
description:
Convert photos and image files to PNG, JPEG, or HEIC on iPhone and iPad without replacing your originals. Choose what you want to do right from Home.

• Edit one image: crop, rotate, apply filters, or use morphology tools. Compare with the original. Choose the output format and options in the editor, select Photos or a folder, then tap Create copies. You can also apply a saved recipe to the current edit.
• Convert formats in bulk: select up to 20 images and convert their format without applying edits or recipes. Set the output options, select Photos or a folder, and create new copies.
• Batch & recipes: arrange and save reusable steps such as resizing, padding, perspective correction, straightening, thresholding, denoising, edge detection, and manual solid fill or mosaic. Run a recipe once without saving it, or reuse it later. Review every result: mosaic does not guarantee anonymity.

Where offered, set quality, a background for transparent areas, or an optional file-size limit. If the final file cannot meet the selected limit, the item reports an error. HEIC availability depends on the device. Animated input uses the first frame. Output copies do not inherit source location or capture metadata. Up to 100 MB, 40 megapixels, and 12,000 pixels per side per input.

Image processing runs on your device. Saving to Photos uses add-only access; your selected Photos or Files provider may download originals or sync your saved copies. There is no developer upload server. The app supports 10 display languages and is a paid download with no ads or in-app purchases.

name: PilotCalc: E6B Flight Computer
description:
Every number a pilot needs before and during a flight, on one screen each.

PilotCalc is an E6B flight computer rebuilt for the iPhone: 24 tools, no account, no subscription, and it works with the radios off.

WHAT IS INSIDE
Plan - wind triangle (true heading, groundspeed, wind correction), crosswind and gusts against your runway, density altitude, pressure altitude, true altitude in cold air, CAS to TAS, TAS to Mach, top of descent, descent rate and angle, climb gradient.
Performance - weight and balance with a CG envelope check, and a POH correction tool that applies the factors from your own chart.
Navigate - leg time and fuel, endurance, true/magnetic/compass heading, VOR radial intercept, cloud base, sunrise and sunset.
Reference - standard atmosphere and a unit converter (kt, mph, km/h, ft, m, NM, SM, inHg, hPa, lb, kg, gal, L, C, F).

WHY PILOTS KEEP IT OPEN
No crashes to work around, no hunting through menus: each tool is one screen with big numbers and the formula behind them. Results update as you type. Nothing is hidden behind a tutorial.

HONEST ABOUT LIMITS
Advisory only. Not for primary navigation. Every result must be checked against your POH and approved sources. No aircraft performance tables are built in - where your POH gives a factor, you enter that factor and PilotCalc applies it. Holding-pattern entry is deliberately absent until a flight instructor reviews the rule set.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no analytics, no ads, no servers. Your flight log and feedback drafts stay on the device. Feedback is written by you and sent by you; it never includes the numbers you entered.

ONE PURCHASE
Pay once, keep it. No subscription, no upsells, no locked tools.

name: Ping Pong Duel
description:
Pick an animal, grab your paddle, and play table tennis with your finger.

Ping Pong Duel is a fast, friendly table tennis game with real rules: the ball bounces, clears the net, and spins. Drag your finger to move the paddle, time your return, and race to 21 points. You have to win by two, and serves swap every five points.

CHOOSE YOUR ANIMAL Play as Bruno the Bear, Zippy the Fox, Dash the Cheetah, or Otto the Octopus. Each one plays differently, with its own power, speed, spin, and reach, and its own special move: Bear Slam, Spin Storm, Turbo Dash, or Eight Arms.

MAKE IT YOURS Choose fur colors, hats, glasses, shirts, pants, and shoes. Unlock more in the store with coins you earn by winning, including a top hat, a crown, and six paddle designs.

LOTS TO DO

Take on Easy, Medium, or Hard computer opponents
Win the 8-player Rival Cup tournament
Complete three new daily challenges every day and build a streak
Climb the rival ladder and keep your win record
Use potions for a short boost: slow the ball, grow your paddle, and more
Practice with a ball machine, serve drills, and smash returns
Play in a backyard, on a rooftop, in a rec room, or at the beach, and pick your table color

BUILT FOR EVERYONE

Plays completely offline
No ads, no sign-in, and no in-app purchases
Settings for sound, haptics, paddle speed, left-handed mode, a high-contrast ball, and colorblind-friendly colors

The leaderboard is a rival ladder of computer players. Your win record and coins are saved on your device.

Ready to play? Pick your animal and serve.

name: PinguGlide--Slide Ahead
description:
IcelaneFish muuttaa napajäätikön tarkkuutta vaativaksi liukupalapeliksi.

Pingviinit liikkuvat vain suoraan eteenpäin. Kun ne lähtevät liikkeelle, ne liukuvat pysähtymättä, kunnes vastaan tulee lumivalli, jäälohkare tai kentän reuna. Liikettä ei voi pysäyttää kesken liu'un, joten jokainen reitti on suunniteltava ennen pyyhkäisyä.

Vaihda Jään työntö -tilaan, kun haluat napauttaa jäälohkaretta ja siirtää sitä ruutu kerrallaan. Pudota lohkare kuoppaan avataksesi kulkureitin ja liu'uta sitten pingviini oranssin kalalaatikon päälle suorittaaksesi tason.

Huolella suunnitellut kentät muuttuvat vähitellen haastavammiksi, kun mukaan tulee kaksi jäälohkaretta, kulmareittejä ja kapeita siltoja. Sivutyökalut auttavat tutustumaan jääkenttään: Kalalaatikko-opas sisältää tietoa maastosta, Reittiluonnoslehtiö auttaa harjoittelemaan pysähtymispaikkoja ja Jääkentän käsikirja kokoaa pelisäännöt sekä paikallisen edistymisen.

Selkeä ja valoisa jääteema, helposti hahmotettavat pelitilojen vaihdot ja lyhyet napsahdusäänet pitävät huomion suunnittelussa ja oikean reitin löytämisessä kalalaatikolle.

name: Pitch Band
description: Pitch Band keeps one pot on bands 0 through 4. A band sticks only while the pot sits on band 2, and only until three bands are stuck. Heating past band 4 scorches the pot back to 0 and leaves the stuck bands where they are. Cooling from 0 comes back. Scrape removes only the last band that stuck. The sentence says the next band can stick, the pot scorched, the head is pitched, the lay came back, or which band the pot is on. Names, notes, and the bands stay on this iPhone.

name: Pitot Traverse
description: Pitot Traverse is an offline HVAC duct airflow tool. Lay out an Equal Area point grid on a rectangular or round duct, enter velocity pressure or velocity at each point, and read face-average velocity and CFM. Compare measured airflow to design CFM with Pass, Short, or Excess. Export a text report or CSV. No account. Optional jobsite coordinates stay on this phone.

name: Planet – Kalender & Notizen
description:
Planet ist ein Kalender, der aufgeräumt bleibt.

HEUTE – WIE AUF PAPIER
Du siehst nur den heutigen Tag. Wisch nach oben, und die nächsten Tage erscheinen als Zeilen – tippen, schreiben, fertig. Kurz tippen hakt ab, lange drücken bearbeitet. So siehst du jederzeit, wie weit du bist.

TAGESPLAN MIT ZEITSTRAHL
Feste Termine für jeden Tag, werktags oder bestimmte Wochentage. Seitlich wischen wechselt den Tag, der rote Punkt zeigt die aktuelle Uhrzeit.

NOTIZEN, DIE SCHÖN AUSSEHEN
Fünf Schriften, Checklisten zum Antippen, Aufzählungen, Suche und angeheftete Notizen – flüssig auch bei sehr langen Texten.

ASSISTENT PER SPRACHE ODER TEXT
Sag „Morgen um halb drei Zahnarzt“ – Planet fragt nach, in welchen Kalender es soll, liest alles vor und trägt erst nach deinem „Ja“ ein. Mit Apple Intelligence auf dem Gerät und Siri-Stimme.

APPLE & GOOGLE KALENDER
Auf Wunsch gleicht Planet sich in beide Richtungen mit Apple Kalender und Google Kalender ab.

IPHONE UND MAC
Über deine private iCloud bleiben iPhone und Mac automatisch gleich. Auf dem Mac mit Wochenansicht, Menüleiste und Tastenkürzeln.

Erinnerungen 15 Minuten vorher, Hell- und Dunkelmodus, keine Werbung, kein Tracking.

name: PlantAxiom Extensions
description:
PlantAxiom Extensions adds six free engineering tools to Safari on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Turn on only the ones you need. They work offline, need no account and collect no data.

ENGINEERING CALCULATORS
30 plant engineering calculators inside Safari: voltage drop, cable size, motor current, short-circuit current, NPSH available, pump power, valve Cv, bolt torque, bearing life, LMTD, OEE, MTBF and more. Search 200 more on plantaxiom.com.

UNIT CONVERTER FOR DATASHEETS
Type or paste 150 psi, 1,250 gpm, 75 hp or 12,000 BTU/h and see bar, m³/h, kW and every other unit at once. 19 engineering unit groups. On a Mac, select a value on any page and right-click › Convert units.

QR CODES AND EQUIPMENT LABELS
A QR code for the page you are on, any text, a contact or a Wi-Fi network. Print QR asset tags for pumps, valves and machines on standard label sheets.

OFFLINE PDF AND FILE TOOLS
Merge, split, reorder, rotate, compress, number, watermark and sign PDFs. PDF to JPG or text, images to PDF, DXF to SVG, CSV and JSON. Files are processed on your device and never uploaded.

PROJECT PLANNER
Gantt chart, critical path and float, with ready plans for a maintenance shutdown, FAT/SAT, a line installation, commissioning and more. Export to CSV for Excel.

NEW TAB FOR ENGINEERS
A calm new tab page: a plant engineering rule of thumb every day, industry news from plantaxiom.com, quick calculators, your own links, a to-do list and shift notes.

HOW TO TURN THEM ON
iPhone and iPad: open Safari, tap the page menu next to the address bar, tap Manage Extensions and switch on the PlantAxiom extensions. Mac: open the app and click Open Safari Settings, then tick the extensions.

PRIVACY
The extensions do not collect, store or send any personal data. Calculations, plans, notes and files stay on your device. Links to plantaxiom.com open only when you tap them.

Made by PlantAxiom, free engineering calculators and plant guides: plantaxiom.com

name: Platinwerk
description:
PlatinWerk helps you plan a DIY renovation: you enter the sizes of your rooms, work out how much material you need, keep track of the costs and tick off the work as you go.

Start a project and add each room with its length, width and ceiling height. Add the doors and windows, and the app works out the floor and ceiling area, the wall area without openings and the perimeter, and draws a simple floor plan.

From a room you open the calculators for paint, tiles, laminate and wallpaper, and they take the room's sizes automatically. The paint calculator gives you the litres and the right combination of buckets for the walls or the ceiling. The tile calculator counts tiles and boxes including waste, the laminate calculator counts packs and skirting boards, and the wallpaper calculator counts rolls and strips and allows for the pattern repeat. With "Add to estimate" the result goes into the project's estimate. If you calculate the same room again, the line is updated rather than added twice.

The estimate keeps materials and labour in one list. Enter prices and a budget, and you can see how much is left or how far over you are. Lines that still have no price are marked.

Each project type has a checklist template for painting, tiling, flooring, wallpapering or a bathroom, with tasks for preparation, shopping, the work itself and finishing. You can use the template or write your own tasks.

You can also take photos before, during and after the work and keep them with the project. When you need to show or buy something, export a PDF report with rooms, costs, checklist and photos, or a CSV list of materials for the DIY shop.

name: Playora Games
description:
Playora réunit plus de 30 jeux dans une seule app au design en verre liquide : arcade, réflexion, mots, duels à deux… il y en a pour tous les goûts et toutes les envies.

UN DÉFI CHAQUE JOUR
Chaque jour, un nouveau défi t'attend. Réussis-le pour gagner un coffre et découvre son contenu : de l'XP, des pièces pour tes jeux préférés, des tapis de cartes ou des fonds animés exclusifs. Enchaîne les jours pour une série et des coffres en argent puis en or !

 ARCADE
Blocs, Nova Strike, Neon Rush, Mini Racing, Rallye Drift, Offroad Challenge, Envol, Basket, Bowling et Billard à deux joueurs.

 RÉFLEXION
Sudoku, Démineur, Solitaire, 2048, Code secret, Taquin, Labyrinthe et Paires.

 MOTS
Mot mystère, Pendu, Mots mêlés et Petit bac.

 À DEUX
Morpion, Quatre en ligne, Gomoku, Points et carrés, Sprouts et Dessin à tour de rôle : passe le téléphone à ton voisin !

 DÉFIS RAPIDES
Bataille navale, Allumettes, Pierre-feuille-ciseaux et Plus ou moins.

 TA PROGRESSION
Gagne de l'XP dans chaque jeu, monte de niveau, débloque de nouveaux fonds, bats tes records et collectionne les objets des coffres.

 POURQUOI TU VAS L'ADORER
• Aucune publicité
• Aucun achat intégré
• Aucun compte à créer
• Fonctionne sans connexion Internet
• Aucune donnée collectée : tout reste sur ton iPhone

name: Plus Out
description:
Plus Out is a calm number puzzle.

Every board is a five-by-five grid of numbers from 0 to 3. Tap a cell and it goes up by one, along with the four cells touching it. After 3 comes 0 again. Clear all 25 numbers before you run out of taps.

It sounds simple. Then a tap fixes one corner and breaks another, and the fun is finding the few taps that clear it all.

TEN CHAPTERS, 150 BOARDS
The boards get harder as you go, through ten chapters that each have a colour of their own. After that, Legend boards keep coming.

THREE STARS A BOARD
One for clearing it, one for never pressing undo, and one for par, the fewest taps possible. Replay any board to chase the stars you missed.

NOTHING IN THE WAY
While you play, the buttons fade away and only the board is left, floating over its colour. Every tap ripples out behind it.

FIVE WAYS TO PLAY
• The main game: 150 boards in ten chapters
• Rush: clear as many boards as you can before the clock runs out
• Daily: one board a day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak going
• One Life: the whole game in one run, with no undo and no retries
• Friend: race someone next to you on the same boards, best of five. It works over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, no internet needed

A short tutorial shows you the rules, and hints are there when you're stuck.

No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no in-app purchases. It works fully offline.

name: Pocket Strata
description:
Two tunnels lead into the same mine. A vein of copper lies close to the entrance, but the quartz you came for is seven rows down. Which rock do you drill first?

Tap a tile to inspect it. Cut a path from the surface, open a conductor to link different minerals, then choose the ore that starts the chain. Leave the right piece in place and a single strike can reach both sides of the mine.

Bring the marked mineral back to camp to finish each survey. You can return early to sell a small haul and recharge. The tunnel you opened, the rock you chipped and the junction you activated will still be there when you go back.

Play all three Copper Garden mines for free. A one-time Full Game Unlock adds twelve mines in Shale Hollow and Prism Vault. Break brittle shale to open shortcuts, connect two junctions and work toward a fifteen-mineral chain. Spend the Credits you earn on your drill, field kit and chain, and fill a cabinet of twelve mineral specimens along the way.

name: PodNook
description:
PodNook is a podcast player that does the essentials well: subscribe, listen, and download for offline. No sign-in, no ads, no analytics — your subscriptions and listening progress stay on your iPhone.

SUBSCRIBE BY URL
• Paste any RSS or Atom feed address; PodNook reads the artwork, author, show notes and episodes
• Bring your library over from AntennaPod, Overcast or Pocket Casts with OPML import
• Refreshes on launch, when you come back after 15 minutes, and whenever you pull down (conditional requests keep it light on data)

BACKGROUND PLAYBACK THAT WORKS
• Lock screen and Control Center controls: play/pause, back 15 s, forward 15 s, previous and next episode
• Unplugging headphones pauses; a phone call resumes afterwards
• 0.8×–2× speed, remembered across episodes
• Progress saved every 5 seconds, auto-advance to the next queued episode

OFFLINE DOWNLOADS
• HTTP Range resume: continue after losing the network, backgrounding, or restarting the app
• Playback prefers the downloaded file, so flights and subways are fine
• See progress and storage per episode, delete one or clear them all

QUIET BY DESIGN
• Compact width gets a glass tab bar; regular width switches to a side rail (iPad and foldable iPhone included)
• Dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver throughout
• Settings only for what matters: default speed, episodes kept per show, clear downloads and artwork cache

PRIVACY
• Collects no data: no account, no ad SDK, no analytics SDK
• No access to contacts, location, photos or the microphone
• Network requests happen only for the feeds and audio you choose
• Delete the app and everything is gone — there is no server copy

NOTES
• Podcast content comes from third-party RSS feeds and is the publisher's responsibility
• 1.0 does not include CarPlay, a sleep timer or chapters; they are planned
• Free, with no in-app purchases

name: Ponche
description:
Ponche es el punto de venta para negocios de comida y antojos: paleterías, neverías, snacks, botanas locas y más. Cobra en segundos desde tu iPhone o iPad y controla todo tu negocio desde el panel del dueño.

COBRA RÁPIDO
• Catálogo con fotos y categorías, pensado para tocar y cobrar.
• Opciones, sabores y toppings por producto, con precios automáticos.
• Efectivo (con cálculo de cambio), tarjeta o transferencia.
• Descuentos y anulaciones con aprobación del dueño por PIN.
• Tickets en impresoras térmicas por Bluetooth o red local.

CONTROLA TU CAJA
• Apertura y corte de caja con conteo de efectivo y diferencias.
• Historial de turnos, ventas por cajero y por forma de pago.

INVENTARIO QUE SE DESCUENTA SOLO
• Cada venta descuenta los insumos según la receta de cada producto y topping.
• Existencias por sucursal y avisos cuando algo se está acabando.

PANEL DEL DUEÑO
• Ventas del día, semana, mes y año; ticket promedio y lo más vendido.
• Ventas por hora y por forma de pago.
• Equipo: invita a tus empleados y decide qué pueden hacer.
• Varias sucursales en un mismo negocio.

AVISOS AL DUEÑO
Recibe notificaciones de ventas, aperturas y cortes de caja, descuentos, anulaciones y existencias bajas, estés donde estés.

Ponche también funciona en la web, con tus mismos datos.

El ticket que imprime Ponche no es un comprobante fiscal.

name: Potebixm
description: PotebixmThis solution is designed for those who manage payment settlements. When recording bills, you can specify an offset ratio for each individual charge. During settlement, funds are allocated based on due dates—or you may manually select specific batches for deduction—and cash payments are then linked to the corresponding charges. In cases involving refunds, the restoration of available credit, or payment corrections, these can be processed directly through the original settlement record. For day-to-day receipts and payments, you simply enter the amounts and the relevant accounts, while bank reconciliation allows for line-by-line verification against transaction records. A "source" designation is used to track pending credit, installment calendars and cash flow plans help you monitor future payment schedules, and monthly reports provide a clear breakdown of actual cash transactions versus settled service charges.

name: Prime KPI
description:
Prime KPI Tracker is the scoreboard for the Prime team: one place to track the work that builds a recruiting season and to see how you and your team are doing.

TRACK YOUR WEEK
• Log your hours each day and watch your weekly totals against the Standard.
• Keep every recruit in your leads list, from first contact to meeting set, meeting had, and signed.
• Follow-up reminders so no lead goes cold.

ETLB ASSIGNMENTS
• See every assignment for the week, turn in notes, photos and videos, and check off your progress.
• Earn the week by finishing everything assigned to you.
• Check in at team meetings with a quick photo.

LEADERBOARD AND TEAM
• Leaderboards by week, month or custom range.
• Team pages that roll up each leader's downline.
• The Hype board for shout-outs and wins.

TRAINING TRACKER
• Managers log 1:1 trainings with new signees, track licensing steps, and see who met this week, team by team.

STAY IN THE LOOP
• Notifications for new assignments, due-tomorrow reminders and shout-outs.
• The team calendar for trainings, meetings and events.

Prime KPI Tracker is for members of the Prime team. Sign in with the name and PIN you set up when you joined.

name: Primeira Fitness®
description:
Primeira Fitness, l'équipement de ceux qui s'entraînent pour de vrai.

Retrouve toute la boutique Primeira dans ton téléphone : la ceinture de force PrimeLock™ et la Signature Collection, notre édition limitée brodée en France.

THE BELT PRIMELOCK™
• Cliquet PrimeLock™ : serrée ou relâchée en 2 secondes, entre deux séries
• 20 crans d'environ 1 cm pour un réglage précis
• Deux leviers indépendants : elle ne s'ouvre pas sous la charge
• 13 mm d'épaisseur, étui de rangement inclus

SIGNATURE COLLECTION
• T-shirt oversize en coton épais 240 g/m²
• Broderie Primeira Fitness®, fabriqué en France
• Série limitée à 100 exemplaires

DANS L'APPLI
• Ajout rapide au panier en un geste
• Tes favoris toujours sous la main
• Performance Center : outils gratuits pour construire ton programme, calculer tes charges et trouver ta taille de ceinture
• Primeira Loyalty : gagne des points à chaque achat et monte de niveau
• Les drops et les offres en avant-première grâce aux notifications

LIVRAISON ET RETOURS
• Livraison offerte en France dès 89 €
• Échange de taille facile, 30 jours pour changer d'avis
• Paiement sécurisé, en 4× sans frais avec PayPal ou Klarna

Chaque séance se mérite. Earn it.

name: Princess Passenger
description:
The princess just escaped the royal palace, jumped into your car and yelled: "DRIVE!"

Now the King's guards are right behind you. Steer through winding roads, dodge guards and barriers, and keep the princess calm. If her panic meter fills up, she jumps out of the car!

DRIVE THROUGH FIVE MAGICAL WORLDS
• Royal Castle
• Enchanted Forest
• Sunny Village
• Frozen Peaks, where the icy road makes you slide
• Dragon Lands, with glowing lava

Each world has its own road, obstacles and music.

FEATURES
• Simple one-finger controls: just drag to steer
• Throw glass slippers to knock guards out of your way
• Collect gems and beat your best score
• Pick up flowers to calm the princess down
• A chatty princess with plenty to say about your driving
• Original soundtrack for every world
• Plays fully offline, anywhere

How far can you drive before the princess jumps out?

name: Proctor Curve
description:
Proctor Curve fits moisture–density points on this iPhone.

See OMC and max dry density, overlay ZAV, drag a probe or field point, and judge dry or wet of OMC.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Proof of Humans
description:
Real people. Real meetups. Every human here is ID-verified.

Proof of Humans is a new way to meet people nearby — built for real life instead of endless scrolling.

POST AN INTENT, NOT A PROFILE
Feel like coffee, a walk, a pickup game or a study session? Post an Intent: say what you want to do, pick a 15, 30 or 60 minute window and a curated venue nearby. Verified people around you can join — or join theirs. No swiping through profiles. No messaging strangers.

EVERYONE IS ID-VERIFIED
Every member verifies their government ID before they can post or join. Names and photos stay blurred until you both say yes — you see who someone really is before you meet, never before.

NO CHAT UNTIL YOU BOTH ACCEPT
When you match, the app opens a chat and hands you a single-use 4-digit Meetup Code. Meet, confirm the code together, done. No endless pen-palling. No flaking.

EARN COINS WHILE YOU WAIT
Play quick skill games — trivia, reaction tap, memory match, word scramble and more — while your Intent is open. Coins add up to real gift cards, and meetups pay the most.

BUILT FOR TRUST
- 100% ID-verified community
- Report and block on every profile
- Reliability scores and no-show tracking keep people honest
- Curated venues in public places

GO UNLIMITED
Post 7 Intents a week for free, or go Unlimited for $13.28/month and post without limits.

New in town? Want to grow your circle? Just tired of texting people who never show up? Proof of Humans gets you from "want to hang out" to actually hanging out — with real, verified humans.

name: PropBalance: Prop Balancer
description:
PropBalance is a professional, hardware-agnostic propeller vibration analysis and dynamic balancing tool for piston, turboprop, experimental and ultralight aircraft.

MEASURE
Live RPM, 1/rev amplitude (IPS or mm/s, peak or RMS) and phase lag from a once-per-rev tachometer. Order tracking with synchronous resampling and averaging, a Welch spectrum with 1x, harmonic, blade-pass and engine-order markers, a phase polar plot with per-revolution scatter, and a full harmonic table.

TRUST THE NUMBERS
Every reading carries quality gates: revolutions averaged, tach health, RPM stability, channel synchronisation, SNR, phase uncertainty, scatter and coherence. Source-separation checks flag when 1/rev is probably not mass imbalance: strong 2/rev or 0.5/rev, blade-pass dominance, unstable phase, amplitude that does not follow RPM squared, resonances and engine orders near 1/rev.

BALANCE
Baseline, trial weight, solve, correction and check run, with iterations from the stored influence coefficient and a full history. An interactive propeller diagram for any blade count and rotation direction. Single plane, plus multi-plane least squares with two or more sensors. Corrections are split only onto the weight locations you enter from your approved data; otherwise they are clearly labelled theoretical. Predicted residual with Monte Carlo uncertainty.

PROFILES
Aircraft, engine and propeller details, blade count, diameter, rotation, pitch type, material, tractor or pusher, RPM range, gear ratio, tach reference, sensor locations and orientations, balancing planes, weight locations and your manufacturer references. Multi-engine and contra-rotating with independent channels. Templates included.

HARDWARE
Built-in simulator with 12 engineering scenarios (no hardware needed). A 2-channel USB audio interface with an IEPE accelerometer and optical tach (same clock, so phase is valid). A Raspberry Pi 5 acquisition unit over Wi-Fi with automatic discovery. Bluetooth sensors (phase only when timing skew is within specification). CSV import. Device motion for trend only.

REPORTS AND RECORDS
PDF and CSV reports with conventions, measurements, gates, solutions, uncertainty, limitations and the safety statement. Sensor calibration tracking and a tamper-evident audit log.

APPLE VISION PRO
A life-size 3D propeller in your space or anchored to a printed marker on the spinner: live 1/rev and correction vectors, trial and correction weights at the right clock angles, your weight locations as holes, floating polar and spectrum windows, and spatial step-by-step guidance. USB audio is not available on Vision Pro.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no server. Your data stays on your device.

FREE AND PRO
Free: the simulator and every scenario, live monitoring, FFT, one aircraft profile, CSV import and the single-plane solve on simulated data.
PropBalance Pro: balancing on real hardware data, multi-plane, unlimited profiles and templates, PDF and CSV reports, session history and audit export, and the Raspberry Pi, USB and Bluetooth drivers. Monthly, yearly (7-day free trial) or lifetime.

IMPORTANT
PropBalance is an engineering and maintenance-assistance tool. It is not certified balancing equipment and has no airworthiness approval. Calculated corrections are theoretical. Weight placement, engine runs and return to service must follow the applicable approved or accepted maintenance data and be performed or supervised by appropriately qualified personnel.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://www.orchaerospace.com/privacy#propbalance

name: Pulau Rinoya
description:
Pulau Rinoya adalah kota virtual di atas pulau berbentuk cincin di tengah laut. Setiap warganya orang sungguhan, dengan paspor, alamat, dan cerita sendiri.

JADI WARGA
• Ambil tiket gratis dengan username, nama panggilan, dan PIN
• Naik pesawat Rinoya Air, mendarat di Bandara Rinoya, dan paspormu distempel
• Pilih unit di Apartemen Laguna atau rumah di komplek warga

JELAJAHI PULAU
• Peta pulau hidup: kapal, pesawat, lumba-lumba, dan siang-malam mengikuti jam sungguhan
• Tangkap Rinoyan, makhluk asli pulau, dan lengkapi albummu
• Bertamu ke Villa Pak Rino, kunjungi Monumen Pelopor dan mercusuar
• Dengarkan 108,8 Rinoya FM bersama Kak Noya

BERSAMA WARGA LAIN
• Ngobrol di Rinoya Hall dengan pesan, stiker, dan pesan suara
• Naik tingkat lewat misi dari Pak Rino
• Pilih brand dan UMKM yang buka outlet di pulau

Koin, emas, dan hunian hanya berlaku di dalam pulau. Obrolan dijaga dengan penyaring kata, tombol Lapor, dan Blokir.

name: Puppet Archers
description:
Wooden puppets, swinging planks and a bow that only fires straight when you draw it just right.

Drag back like a slingshot to aim, hold to draw, let go to shoot. Let go when the bow flashes gold for a perfect draw: the arrow flies faster and hits harder. Arrows drop with gravity and the planks sway on their ropes, so every shot is a little different. Aim for the head, jump out of the way, and knock the other puppet off its perch.

The enemies keep changing. Big timber brutes soak up arrows, guards hide behind wooden doors, and hawkeye snipers rarely miss. Every tenth stage is a boss on a chained platform: a foreman who fires three arrows at once, a warden whose door grows back, a puppeteer who shoots twice.

Earn gears and spend them in the Workshop on health, stronger arrows, a quicker draw and more stamina. Unlock six special arrows on the way: the punch arrow, sticky honey, a saw that cuts ropes, chili fire, a magnet that bends toward the target and a dandelion that sends enemies floating. Level up and your puppet gets a new look every level.

Got a friend nearby? Play 2 PLAYERS on one iPhone or iPad: left half against right half, first to three rounds wins.

Features:
- 30 hand-made stages, then stages that never end
- A boss every ten stages
- Six special arrows and four enemy types
- Workshop upgrades and a new look every level
- Two players on one device
- A short tutorial that teaches the controls in seconds
- Plays offline. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected

name: Pyre.Chat: Multi Stream Chat
description:
Pyre.Chat is a multi stream chat app for people who live in more than one chat at once. It merges Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok chat into a single feed, so you can read, reply and moderate every channel you care about from one screen on your iPhone.

WHO IT IS FOR

• Streamers who go live on more than one platform and want to read one conversation instead of four tabs
• Moderators who look after several channels and need one set of tools that works everywhere
• Viewers who follow a few favourite streamers and want their chats side by side

ONE FEED FOR EVERY CHAT

• Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok messages arrive in one timeline, in order, each line marked by its platform
• Pick the channels you follow: your own, the ones you moderate, or any you like to watch
• Open more than one tab for separate feeds, or keep everything in one
• Mentions and highlights are collected in their own view, so you never miss a question aimed at you
• Ignore rules hide the lines and the people you do not want to see
• Adjust the font size for the room and the phone you are holding

BUILT FOR MODERATORS

• Delete a message, time a user out or ban them, and the action runs on the platform the message came from
• Moderation runs as you, through each platform's official API, with the permissions you hold on that channel
• Streamers can turn on chat history for a channel they own, so they and their mods see what a viewer said before acting

EMOTES, BADGES AND COLOURS

• Platform emotes and badges render the way they do on the original site
• Third-party emotes from 7TV load for the channels that use them
• An emote picker with a Most Used tab makes replying quick

SIGN IN WITHOUT TYPING

• Already signed in on your computer? Scan a QR code from pyre.chat and the phone signs in without typing anything
• Or sign in with your Pyre username and password
• Your platform connections are saved to your account, so the next sign-in on any device reconnects everything

ONE ACCOUNT, EVERY DEVICE

• Pyre.Chat also runs in the browser at pyre.chat, as a desktop app and as a browser extension
• The same account unlocks Pyre.Stream, the broadcasting suite, and Pyre.Bot, the chat bot for your channel and every channel you moderate

PRIVACY

• Chat history is off by default and only a streamer can switch it on for a channel they own
• Viewers can type !nolog in a channel to stop new messages from being recorded there
• We do not sell your data. The full policy is at pyre.chat/privacy

SUPPORT

Use the support button inside the app, visit pyre.chat/about, or write to support@pyre.support.

Pyre.Chat is made by Pyre.Studio. Twitch, YouTube, Kick and TikTok are trademarks of their respective owners. Pyre.Chat is an independent app that connects to them through their official APIs.

name: Qingzhu Guandan
description:
Play Guandan in Simplified Chinese on your iPhone or iPad. Qingzhu Guandan brings the four-player partnership card game to a quiet practice session or a table of nearby friends.

PRACTICE OFFLINE
Play with a computer partner and two computer opponents. The game is included in the app and works offline from the first launch, without an account. Ask for a hint and read its explanation in Chinese, adjust the computer players' pace, or switch on autoplay. Your solo game saves on this device so you can return to it later.

PLAY WITH NEARBY FRIENDS
One player hosts a table and shares a separate four-digit PIN for each guest seat. Two, three, or four people can play, with computer players filling empty seats. Each player sees their own hand on their device. Keep Wi-Fi enabled, allow Local Network access, and keep the devices nearby with the app open. An internet connection or shared router is not required.

MAKE THE HAND YOUR OWN
Tap to select cards and drag to rearrange your two-row hand. Choose how to play a wild-card combination when more than one declaration is possible. Clear turn indicators, hand sorting, play history, and layouts for iPhone and iPad help you follow the table.

FOLLOW THE MATCH
Play with two decks, heart-level wild cards, bombs, promotion, tribute, and return cards. When you receive tribute, choose an eligible card to return before play begins. The in-app rules explain the game's casual rule set.

Nearby guests can restore their reserved seat while the same host table remains open. Closing the host's table ends that nearby session. Solo hints and autoplay are practice features; nearby players make their own decisions.

name: QTurn Tycoon
seller_name: LUIS MIGUEL DE MATOS FILIPE SIMOES
description:
One day. One quarter. Thirty turns to build the most valuable company in your industry.

QTurn Tycoon is a business strategy simulation built for management and MBA students, and for anyone who wants to feel what running a public company is like. Each real day is one fiscal quarter. You lock in your decisions, the quarter closes, and an earnings report tells you what happened.

PICK YOUR INDUSTRY
Semiconductors & AI Hardware, Biopharmaceuticals, Renewable Energy & Grid Storage, Global Hospitality & Travel, or Fast-Fashion & Direct-to-Consumer. Each sector has its own customers, cost structure, risks and levers. Play a solo game while you wait for your live quarter. Get a push with your results when the next quarter opens.

FACE TEN RIVALS
Eleven companies fight for the same customers. Rivals play distinct strategies: the price-cutter, the innovator, the cash-hoarder, the premium brand, the leveraged consolidator and more. Play them solo, or play live against classmates and friends through Game Center, with AI filling any empty seat.

DECIDE LIKE A CEO
Price, capacity, R&D, contracts, hedges, debt and dividends. A live budget shows how every move changes earnings, cash and your credit rating before you commit. Capacity takes quarters to build. Covenants bite. Analysts set a consensus, and the market rewards a beat and punishes a miss.

EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED
Every game deals its own hand from a 60-card event deck per sector: rate hikes, supply shocks, export controls, viral boycotts, record heatwaves. Most are everyday shifts. A few are shocks that can make or break a sector.

LEARN FROM EVERY CLOSE
Each quarter brings a full earnings report: income statement, balance sheet and cash flow, budget-versus-actual variance, and the analysts' view of your stock.

WIN ON SHAREHOLDER RETURN
The ranking orders all eleven companies by total shareholder return per share: share price plus dividends. Highest return after quarter 30 wins. Compare yourself on Game Center leaderboards for each sector.

MADE FOR THE CLASSROOM
Classroom mode lets an instructor close each quarter as soon as decisions are locked, so a 30-quarter game fits into a course or a single workshop.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected. Solo games run entirely on your device.

Interface in English. Case material (companies, events and levers) is in English, the language of the business cases.

name: QuadTracker for Video Poker
description:
Four aces with a kicker. Kings an hour later. By the end of the night, can you remember every quad you hit?

QuadTracker replaces the paper pad next to your video poker machine. One tap logs a quad, and a second tap picks the rank. For aces, 2s, 3s and 4s, it asks whether you caught the kicker. Straight flushes and royals go in by suit. Each beverage comp takes one tap.

Your first tap starts the session, so there's nothing to set up when you sit down. Pause the clock when you leave for dinner. If you tap the wrong button, Undo stays at the top of the screen for five seconds. If you forget to end a session, you can set the end time later, even when the session ran past midnight.

The Report screen answers the questions players ask at the machine.
• How long since my last quad? The drought clock counts it in hours and minutes.
• Am I running hot or cold? A gauge compares your quads with the number expected for your time played, at about one quad every 423 hands.
• Which quads have I hit? You see all 13 ranks with a count for each.
• How long since my last royal?
• What was my best night, my fastest pair of quads and my longest dry spell?

A quad plays a coin rollup, and a royal plays a handpay jingle. The mute button and your iPhone's silent switch both turn the sounds off.

You don't need an account. QuadTracker shows no ads and collects no data, and everything you log stays on your iPhone.

QuadTracker is a record-keeping tool. It does not offer gambling, it cannot predict or change results, and it is not affiliated with any casino or machine maker.

name: Quarz Health
description:
Quarz shows your Polar Flow data on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

All values come from Polar. Quarz calculates no values, scores or ratings of its own and only shows what Polar has determined. To put a value in context, Quarz compares it with your own earlier values.

Day: Nightly Recharge, HRV, heart rate at night, breathing rate and sleep for one day, each compared with your previous 30 days. Plus Cardio Load with acute load and tolerance.

Sleep: The sleep stages of a night as a timeline, with heart rate, HRV and breathing rate on the same time axis.

Heart rate: Heart rate over the day and from your training sessions on one timeline, which you can drag and zoom from 30 minutes to two weeks.
