Training: All training sessions by month, filtered by sport if you like, with heart rate curve, time in heart rate zones and training load.

Polar hands out most values for only 28 to 30 days. Quarz keeps everything it has fetched. You can import older training sessions from your Polar account's data export.

Quarz has no server of its own. The app fetches the data directly from Polar and stores it only on the device. It only reads and changes nothing at Polar. Quarz contains no advertising and no analytics or tracking tools.

Without a Polar account you can look at Quarz with sample data. For your own data you need a Polar account and a Polar watch or sensor.

Quarz is not an app by Polar and is neither developed nor supported by Polar. Polar and Polar Flow are trademarks of Polar Electro Oy.

name: Quashed App: Christmas Planner
description:
Christmas doesn't start in December. It starts the week you decide to be ready for it.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no tracking. We never receive your data; your Christmas is kept in the app on your iPhone.

Christmas Quashed is a planner for the whole season, not only the gift list. From the week you install it, it counts back from Christmas and gives you a plan: a short list of jobs for every week, reminders when you want them, a budget for each person, and one place to keep track of everything you buy.

Christmas chaos? Quashed.

A PLAN FOR EVERY WEEK
The Budget. Clothes and Sizes. The Wish Lists. Advent Calendars. The Children's Gifts. The Big Food Shop. Every week has a goal and a handful of jobs, timed back from Christmas. Tick them off, add your own, or hold a week and move it to other dates. Fall behind and the jobs you didn't finish move forward for you.

REMINDERS AND YOUR CALENDAR
Book any job for a day and time: a notification, an event in your calendar, or both. Turn on a weekly heads-up on the day you choose, so the week's jobs are waiting for you.

MONEY YOU CAN SEE
Give each person a budget and set a Christmas Limit for the whole season. Home shows what you've set aside, what you've spent and what's left, and warns you before you go over.

LOG GIFTS FAST
Quick Log asks a few plain questions (who, what, how much, where) and files the answer in seconds. Add a picture if you like, or save a picture from someone's page and fill it in later. Every gift has a stage: Idea, Planned, Ordered, Waiting, Purchased, Made it / Have it, or Wrapped. Ideas keep their price on record without counting toward your budget.

TAKE A LIST TO THE SHOP
Quick List builds a list for the shop you're heading to, or the person you're shopping for, from what you've already logged. Send it or copy it in one tap, so nothing gets bought twice.

CHECK YOUR WORK
The Full Log shows everything by person. Tap Still to buy, Shops, Money out or Missing info, tick things off as you get them, and mark or delete several at once.

A PAGE FOR EVERYONE
People, and household things like food, decorations and stockings, each get their own page with a budget, their gifts and your notes. Add a photo of each person if you like.

KEPT ON YOUR IPHONE
The app makes no internet connection of its own, so it works with no signal. Lock it with Face ID or a PIN so nobody finds out what Santa is bringing. Light and dark modes.

The week's jobs also have optional video buttons. They open a YouTube search only when you tap one; nothing is sent otherwise.

THE HONEST LIMITS
- It lives on one phone. There is no syncing and no shared lists.
- We never see your data, so we can't back it up. Your iPhone's iCloud Backup includes it, and Settings has a one-tap export to Files.
- The lock keeps people out of the app. It isn't encryption.
- It's a planner, not a bank statement. Check your own totals.

No ads. No subscription.

Made for one family in a kitchen, and shared because it worked.

name: Quench Inch
description:
Quench Inch keeps one heat-treat bar on this iPhone.

Drag the mark. The named station is the last one the mark has passed. Hold that station and the name moves to the next station. The mark stays put.

Thickness scales the displayed inch. Stored colors stay on their stations.

Stations and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Quentis
description:
Το Quentis είναι ημερολόγιο πεδίου για επικαθίσεις εναλλακτών θερμότητας.

Καταχωρείτε κάθε μονάδα, εισάγετε θερμοκρασίες και παροχές θερμής/ψυχρής πλευράς, και υπολογίζονται το φορτίο Q, το LMTD, ο πραγματικός U, η αντίσταση επικαθίσεων Rf, ο βαθμός απόδοσης ε και η προσέγγιση θερμοκρασίας. Η τάση του Rf προβλέπει ημέρα καθαρισμού. Ειδοποιήσεις εμφανίζονται όταν Rf, προσέγγιση ή ε ξεπερνούν τα όριά σας. Μετά τον καθαρισμό συγκρίνετε U και Rf πριν/μετά.

Πώς χρησιμοποιείται
1. Από το τετράγωνο κουμπί κάτω δεξιά ανοίξτε Εξοπλισμός. Προσθέστε μονάδα: όνομα, τύπος, θέση, επιφάνεια A, U_clean.
2. Ανοίξτε Καταγραφές. Επιλέξτε μονάδα, εισάγετε εισόδους/εξόδους και τουλάχιστον μία παροχή (m³/h) και αποθηκεύστε. Στην καρτέλα βλέπετε Q, U, Rf, ε.
3. Ανοίξτε Τάσεις για το διάγραμμα Rf και την προβλεπόμενη ημέρα καθαρισμού. Τα όρια ορίζονται εκεί ή στις Ρυθμίσεις.
4. Μετά τον καθαρισμό ανοίξτε Συντήρηση, καταχωρήστε την εργασία και προαιρετικά νέα καθαρή βάση στην επόμενη μέτρηση.
5. Το δελτίο στην αρχική δείχνει υγεία μονάδας, ανοιχτές ειδοποιήσεις και το επόμενο παράθυρο καθαρισμού.

Χωρίς λογαριασμό. Τα δεδομένα μένουν στη συσκευή. Μόνο φωτεινή εμφάνιση.

name: Quick Draw: Scribble Showdown
description:
Quick Draw: Scribble Showdown is the drawing and guessing game for the whole family, conveniently made for one iPad and your TV!

One person draws. Everyone else shouts out guesses. Beat the clock, rack up points, and pass the iPad to the next player.

PUT IT ON THE TV
Use Screen Mirroring and Quick Draw shows its own big-screen view: the drawing as it happens, the team, the clock and the score. The word stays secret on the iPad!

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Just Play: no teams, one running score, just draw and guess
• Teams: name your teams and players, and Quick Draw keeps track of whose turn it is to draw
• Corral: both teams shout out guesses on every drawing, and whoever gets it first scores, so nobody sits out
• Turns of 1, 1½ or 2 minutes, with as many skips as you like

NEARLY 6,000 THINGS TO DRAW
• Over 4,600 words in Easy, Medium and Hard, from cactus to chandelier
• Ideas and phrases for a challenge
• Over 800 picture puzzles: draw the pieces, not the answer (bee + leaf = belief)
• Pick your categories: animals, food, sports, places, make-believe and more
• Holiday packs that show up in season, starting with Thanksgiving!

CUSTOM SHOWDOWN RULES
Turn on the star for bonus rules that keep everyone in the game:
• Steals: after the buzzer, the other team gets a shot at every drawing that was skipped
• On fire: three in a row, and every word after that is worth extra
• Quick draw: bonus points for a guess in the first 10 seconds
• The Showdown: to finish, each team's best drawer gets a minute and everyone from both teams guesses
Turn each rule on or off in Settings.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• Draw with your finger or Apple Pencil
• Hold the eraser to erase
• History and stats for every game you've played
• No ads, no accounts, and no data collected

name: QuizTango
description:
Make a little room for curiosity with QuizTango.

Try the Daily quiz, explore an untimed Practice round, or catch up on a missed day. Discover questions about science, history, geography, flags, maps, nature, sports, arts and culture. Choose a quiz region and keep exploring.

Bring friends together in a live quiz room, or share a challenge link and compare results. Adult players can start as guests. Younger players’ social modes use eligible family cards under a verified adult account and age-group restrictions.

Keep up to five player cards under one sign-in, each with separate scores and progress. Start without email, then optionally link an email to use your account on another device.

Play in multiple languages. Players can choose optional daily and weekly game-hosting reminders on their device. Previously fetched Practice packs can be used offline; ranked play and social games need an internet connection.

Available at no cost at launch, with no ads, in-app purchases or automatic billing. Future paid features would require a separate, explicit purchase or subscription trial confirmation.

Privacy: https://quiztango.com/privacy/
Support: https://quiztango.com/feedback/

name: Ramadan Habits: Family
description:
Ramadan Habits helps you and your family keep up with fasting, the five prayers, Taraweeh, Quran reading, adhkar and sadaqah, one day at a time.

• Today: tick off each prayer and habit, count Quran pages and tasbeeh, and see how much of the day is done.
• Azkar: morning and evening adhkar, after prayer, before sleep, and Ramadan duas from Hisn al-Muslim, with a counter for each. Finishing the morning or evening list ticks it on your checklist.
• Prayer times: calculated on your phone for your city with the right method, such as Umm al-Qura for Saudi Arabia, with a live countdown to iftar and the end of suhoor. Use your location, change the method or Asr time, or move any prayer by a few minutes to match your mosque.
• Family on every phone: create a family, invite adults with a code, and everyone's checklist stays in sync across their phones. Manage members and kids' phones in one place, with an in-app guide that walks you through setup. Signing in with Apple is optional.
• Kids' mode: connect a child's own phone or tablet with a 6-digit code, no account needed. They get a simple checklist with stars and bigger buttons, and only their own items.
• Reminders: choose a reminder for each prayer, at the adhan or a few minutes before, set a daily time for any habit, and send a gentle reminder to a family member's phone.
• History: day streaks, a Ramadan calendar of how each day went, and a 7-day view of every habit.
• Your way: Arabic and English, light and dark themes, hide the habits you don't need, or add your own.

Private by design: no ads and no tracking. Without an account, everything stays on your phone. With family sync, we store only what's needed to share your family, and you can delete your account from the app at any time.

name: Range Book: Shooting Log
description:
Range Book is a logbook for shooters and reloaders. It keeps your guns, ammo, loads and range trips in one place, and does the ballistics math from your own numbers.

AT THE RANGE
• Range trips: date, place, distance and weather, with every shot string you fire.
• Bluetooth chronograph: connect an Athlon Rangecraft and each velocity lands on the trip as you shoot.
• Live target: point a Longshot spotting-scope camera at the target and Range Book marks each hit as it lands, matched to its velocity.
• Target photos: snap the target and Range Book finds the holes, measures each group (size, mean radius, distance from your aim point) and tells you how many clicks to move your scope.
• Works with no signal: the app keeps a copy of Range Book on your phone.

BALLISTICS
• Bullet path out to 2,000 yards with drop, wind drift, spin drift, velocity, energy and time of flight.
• Compare zeros side by side, including a point-blank zero worked out from your target size.
• Dope cards in MOA or MIL, set to your scope's clicks, with the hold shown on the reticle.
• Weather from your location: temperature, pressure, humidity and wind.
• True up your velocity from where your shots actually land.

RELOADING
• Recipes with powder, primer, brass, bullet, charge and length.
• Ladder tests: velocity by charge, SD and ES, group size by charge.
• Component inventory: powder, primers, brass and bullets on hand.

GEAR
• Guns with barrel, twist, sight height, optic and round count.
• 1,400+ factory rifle, pistol and shotgun loads with the maker's published BC and velocity, so you don't have to look them up.
• Optics, suppressors, magazines, ranges and notes.

REPORTS
• Print a range report with your groups drawn on your target photo, each shot's velocity and the group sizes.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Range Book connects to a Range Book server: free, open-source software you (or your club) run at home. Your data lives on that server, not ours. No ads, no tracking, no account with us.

Don't have a server yet? Enter demo.rangebook.org and tap "Try it as a guest" to try everything with sample gear. The guest demo doesn't save anything. To set up your own server, see rangebook.org.

name: Rattil Quran: Madinah Mushaf
seller_name: AL TITI ESTABLISHMENT FOR SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY
description:
“And recite the Quran with measured recitation.” (73:4)

Rattil Quran gives you the pages of the Madinah mushaf exactly as printed by the King Fahd Complex, one page at a time, in the script your eyes already know.

• Turn pages like a printed mushaf: swipe to the next page, and the app reopens where you stopped.
• Instant search across the whole Quran as you type. No tashkeel needed, any form of alef or hamza works, and the words are highlighted in the ayah.
• Type a surah name, a page or juz number, or 18:10 to go straight there.
• Tafseer mode: tap any ayah to read its tafseer from nine books, seven in Arabic (al-Muyassar, as-Sa'di, Ibn Kathir, at-Tabari and more) and two in English. al-Muyassar works offline.
• Lenient search: type a word as it is read, or as the mushaf writes it (الصلوة، ابرهيم، الرحمان), and still find its ayah.
• A Friday reminder to read Surah al-Kahf, and a daily wird reminder that names the page you stopped at.
• Bookmarks for pages and single ayat, plus “where you left off”.
• Surah and juz index, and a quick slider through the pages.
• A calm night mode, and the screen stays on while you read.
• Read offline: download the whole mushaf once.
• Works with Wadhakkir, our adhkar app: open morning, evening and sleep adhkar in one tap, and verses in Wadhakkir open here at their place in the mushaf.

No account and no ads. Anonymous usage statistics only, with no advertising ID. Your bookmarks and reading place stay on your phone.

Mushaf pages by the King Fahd Complex for the Printing of the Holy Quran. Search text from the Tanzil project. Tafseer texts via quran.com.

name: Readmark: Read Aloud
description:
Read your books. Listen your way.

Readmark is a simple, powerful EPUB and TXT reader that turns your documents into spoken words. Read along as you listen, or put your phone away and keep enjoying your books in the background.

No subscriptions, no accounts, no internet required. Just your books, your pace, and your reading experience.

READ AND LISTEN TOGETHER
Follow along with synchronized sentence and word highlighting as Readmark reads aloud. Jump between sentences or long-press any word to start listening from that point.

LISTEN ANYWHERE
Keep listening while using other apps or with your screen locked. Pause and resume playback using your headphones or your iPhone's media controls.

MAKE READING YOUR OWN
Choose your preferred voice and language, adjust reading speed and pitch, and save voice presets for different listening experiences.

FIND AND SAVE WHAT MATTERS
Search through your documents, navigate between matches, and highlight meaningful sentences. Your highlights are saved between sessions and can be exported as a TXT file.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Your books stay on your device. Readmark works entirely offline, without requiring an account or sending your documents to external servers.

Whether you're reading a novel, studying a document, or listening to a book while doing something else, Readmark makes it easy to enjoy your content your way.

name: Recall 16
description:
카드 16장의 숫자, 문양, 위치를 기억하고 두 장을 고르는 기억 포커 게임입니다.

카드가 뒤집힌 뒤 공개되는 공용 카드 3장과 내가 고른 카드 2장으로 포커 족보를 완성하세요.

혼자 연습
• 암기 시간 10초, 20초, 30초 선택
• 내 조합과 해당 판의 최고 조합 비교
• 전체 카드판 복기

AI 대전
• 입문, 보통, 고수의 세 가지 난이도
• 입문 5승으로 보통, 보통 5승으로 고수 해제
• AI가 카드를 고르는 과정을 실시간으로 표시
• 설정에서 AI 선택 표시 켜기·끄기

플레이 기록
• 최근 30판과 누적 통계 저장
• 난이도별 승수와 해제 상태 저장

회원가입 없이 오프라인으로 플레이할 수 있습니다. 앱 내 광고와 인앱결제는 없으며, 현금·칩 베팅이나 경품은 제공하지 않습니다.

name: RecipeRatio
description: Scale a recipe when you need more or fewer servings. Enter the original and target serving counts, then add ingredients with their quantities and units. RecipeRatio scales each amount together and keeps the original units. Save the scaled recipe to reference later, add a note, or copy the ingredient list. The app works offline.

name: Rehla | رحلة
description:
رحلة هو تطبيق لمشاركة الرحلات بين المحافظات العراقية.
  ابحث عن رحلة متجهة إلى محافظتك، احجز مقعدك بضغطة واحدة، وتابع موقع السائق مباشرة أثناء الرحلة.

  للركاب:
  • البحث عن الرحلات حسب المحافظة والتاريخ
  • حجز المقاعد ومتابعة السائق على الخريطة
  • الدردشة مع السائق وتقييم الرحلة

  للسائقين:
  • نشر الرحلات وتحديد عدد المقاعد والسعر
  • استقبال طلبات الحجز وإدارتها
  • محفظة لمتابعة الرصيد والأرباح

name: Renoma
description:
See where your brand or a person you monitor is mentioned in the news, on websites and on social media. Sign in to Renoma to open the monitoring profiles you have access to.

Catch up on new findings
Open Overview to see the latest scan results and outstanding critical findings. Select a finding to see its source, publication date and the original content.

Explore your social accounts
See follower counts and post performance for the accounts connected to your profile. Choose a date range to compare likes, views and engagement. Available metrics vary by social network.

Read reports and receive alerts
Open daily, weekly and monthly reports in the app. Enable notifications to hear when your profile has a new report or a critical finding.

Available features depend on your account type, monitoring plan and profile permissions.

name: Residenz Panorama Arosa
description:
The app of the owners' association Residenz Panorama, See Egg Weg 2 & 4 in Arosa. It replaces the paper booking sheets and brings together everything about living in the building.

BOOK THE LAUNDRY AND SAUNA
• See free slots in the day plan or the weekly overview
• Reserve the washing machine, dryer and sauna in a few taps
• Confirmation and reminder by push notification and email
• View and cancel your bookings at any time

REPORT DAMAGE
• Report damage and faults in shared areas, with photos
• The caretaker is notified immediately
• Follow the status and the caretaker's reply in the app

ANNOUNCEMENTS
• News from the caretaker and management, for example about snow clearing or maintenance work
• Important contacts and emergency numbers always at hand

FOR HOLIDAY GUESTS
• No account needed: scan the QR code in the apartment and enter your name
• Access lasts for your stay and ends automatically

FOR CARETAKER AND MANAGEMENT
• Handle reports and reply to them
• Send announcements to all owners and, if desired, to guests
• Manage apartments, users, rooms and QR codes

The app is intended solely for residents, guests, the caretaker and the management of Residenz Panorama. Accounts are set up by the management. Available in German, English, French, Italian and Dutch.

name: Rhoosh: Singles at Your Event
description:
Rhoosh shows you the other singles going to the same event as you, and nobody else.

It is invite-only: you’ll need the code from your event’s host. Enter it, RSVP, and meet the singles on that guest list before the night begins.

Galas, charity balls, cocktail parties, conferences, work receptions, dinners, weddings: wherever you’re headed, someone you’ll like is probably on the guest list. When your event uses Rhoosh, you can meet them before the night begins.

HOW IT WORKS
• RSVP: join your event’s guest list with the invite code from your host.
• Meet the guests: swipe through the other singles who have RSVP’d, or like a particular photo or prompt and add a comment.
• Match with guest profiles: like someone, and if they like you back, it’s a match. Say hello before you arrive.
• Get a notification when you match, get a message, or someone likes your photo or prompt (if you turn notifications on).

MADE FOR THE ROOM
• Every RSVP is for one.
• Private, invite-only events: hosts share a code, and only people with it can see the guest list.
• Profiles built for events: up to six photos, prompts like “Find me at the party”, and the basics.

SAFETY FIRST
• Only members attending the same event can see each other.
• Block or report anyone, from their card, their profile, the guest list or your conversation, and unblock later in Settings.
• Slurs and threats are blocked automatically everywhere; explicit language is also blocked on profiles and comments.
• Every report is reviewed by a person.
• Delete your account and data at any time from your Profile.

Rhoosh is for adults 18 and over.

Terms: https://rhoosh.com/terms
Privacy: https://rhoosh.com/privacy

name: Rime
description:
Rime on suomalainen lukukirja taivaalle, tuulelle ja omille lukemillesi.

Valitse taivas ja pilven laji, kirjoita Boforin asteikko ja aseta suunta sormella tai kompassilla. Lämpö, ilmanpaine, sade, näkyvyys, paikka ja muistiinpano ovat valinnaisia. Kun lukema on valmis, saat yhden lauseen ja lasiputken kuvan — molemmat syntyvät vain siitä, mitä itse kirjoitit. Tämä ei ole sääennuste eikä pilventunnistus kuvasta.

Lokissa rivit järjestyvät päivittäin. Yksittäisen lukeman voit avata, jakaa tekstinä tai korjata. Suunta-välilehdellä vertaat kirjattua suuntaa laitteen osoittamaan. Asteikko-välilehdellä on Bofori, pilvet, sade ja lasikuviot sekä vanha FitzRoy-muistisääntö erikseen merkittynä.

Ensimmäisellä käynnistyksellä ohje tulee juurinäkymänä, ei ponnahdusikkunana. Ilmainen. iPhone, pysty. iOS 15 tai uudempi.

name: Rink Soundboard
description:
Rink Soundboard puts game-day sound at your fingertips. Built for youth hockey emcees, scorekeepers and volunteers who run music between whistles.

• One-tap tiles — add your own audio files or songs from Apple Music, then tap to play.
• Perfect clips — set a start point and play length for every song, so the best part plays every time.
• Goal Horn — a big red button with several arena-style horns, or use your own.
• Organ cues & effects — Charge!, Let's Go!, Hey!, Build-Up, Drum Roll, Penalty, plus one-minute announcements.
• Built for the rink — fade-out STOP, instant Stop Now, Pause and Resume, and the screen stays awake.
• Categories — Goal, Penalty, Warm-ups, Timeout, Intermission and Between Whistles.
• Track what's played — used tiles darken so you don't repeat songs; Reset Usage starts fresh.
• Game mode lock — prevents accidental edits during a game.

Apple Music songs require an active Apple Music subscription. Please make sure your rink or organization holds the appropriate music performance license for public play.

name: Rise & Solve
description:
Meet the alarm clock with a little big-brain energy.

Rise & Solve pairs a cute cloud mascot with wake-up alarms and quick math challenges. Set a one-time alarm for a specific date, or build a routine with your chosen weekdays.

YOUR MORNING, YOUR MATH
Choose Sleepy for additions and subtractions, Stretch for signed multiplication, or Brainiac for decimal two-step questions. Enter positive, negative, or decimal answers with a custom keypad.

FRESH CHALLENGES
Random alarm questions remember the last 50 questions at each difficulty on your device to keep things fresh, even across app restarts.

ENTER THE BRAIN GYM
Infinite reps. Zero burpees. Play unlimited math questions, choose your difficulty, and track your session score. No timer or alarm sound. Leave whenever you like.

MAKE SOME MORNING NOISE
Choose from three original alarm sounds: Sunshine siren, Arcade wake-up, and Cosmic radar. Preview each sound before choosing it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, ads, analytics, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. No developer-operated server or external database. Your alarm settings and question history stay on your device.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 26.1 or later and alarm permission. Scheduled alarms use Apple's AlarmKit. Solving the question stops playback inside the app; iOS retains its system Stop controls, and force-closing can bypass the in-app challenge.

name: Roll Offset
description:
Roll Offset names the run whose angle is more than 8 degrees from square.

Travel is the square root of roll squared plus rise squared. The angle is the rise against the roll. Drag the roll. If it is more than 8 degrees from 45, the farthest offset is named. A travel longer than the stick is not stored. Changing the stick does not rewrite the roll. The last offset stays.

A bay mark stays on the iPhone and does not change the triangle. Share the call when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Rookling Chess
description:
Rookling Chess is a clean, friendly chess board for your iPhone and iPad. Play the computer at six levels, or pass the device to a friend. It is free, works without the internet, and has no ads, accounts or purchases.

PLAY THE COMPUTER
• Six levels, from Beginner to Expert
• Choose White, Black or a random side
• Ask for a hint or take a move back at any time

PLAY A FRIEND
• Two players on one device
• Optional board turning after each move

EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT
• Full rules: castling, en passant, promotion, check, checkmate and every draw rule
• Tap or drag to move, with legal moves shown
• Chess clocks from 1 to 30 minutes, with increment
• Step back through the whole game move by move
• Captured pieces and material count
• Your win, loss and draw record for each level
• Four board colors, sounds and vibration
• Games resume where you left off

FOR KEEN PLAYERS
• Copy, save or share games as PGN
• Load any PGN or FEN position and play on from there

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no tracking, no accounts
• Nothing leaves your device

name: RoomRoster Move Log
description:
Know where your labeled equipment belongs and keep a record of its moves with RoomRoster Move Log.

Create rooms, add uniquely tagged assets, and record moves between locations. Each saved move updates the asset's current room and retains a history snapshot of where it came from and where it went.

• Organize rooms with names, area notes and details.
• Maintain assets with a label, unique tag, category and notes.
• Move an active asset to another room with a date and note.
• Search move history by asset name, tag or room.
• Open and share individual move records.
• Archive assets and restore them when they are active again.
• Retain move-history snapshots after an asset is deleted.
• Export local JSON and clear local records with confirmation.

RoomRoster Move Log is a manual roster. It does not track physical location, scan equipment or monitor devices automatically.

Core records are stored on your device. No app account is required. An optional online destination can be controlled by a public configuration lookup; enabled destinations open through the system, and unavailable configuration returns you to local features. External websites have their own policies.

name: Rooted in Truth
description:
**Rooted in Truth — Grow Deeper in the Word**

Grow in biblical knowledge, strengthen your faith, and find encouragement for life's challenges with Rooted in Truth, a Christian learning and spiritual growth app.

Designed for those beginning their faith journey and those seeking deeper theological understanding, Rooted in Truth brings Scripture, Christian education, and faith-based encouragement together in one place.

**Explore Rooted in Truth:**

- **Bible Study:** Explore Scripture, biblical characters, and essential Christian teachings.
- **Theology & Doctrine:** Study foundational Christian beliefs and deepen your understanding of theology.
- **Three Learning Levels:** Explore Foundation, Growth, and Deep Roots study materials designed for different levels of understanding.
- **Personal Learning Dashboard:** Track completed lessons and continue your learning journey.
- **Emotions & Mental Health:** Find Scripture-based encouragement and spiritual support for anxiety, depression, anger, hopelessness, and other life challenges.
- **Christian Living:** Explore ways to apply biblical principles to everyday life.
- **Devotions and Reflection:** Discover opportunities for prayer, encouragement, and spiritual reflection.

Rooted in Truth encourages thoughtful biblical study while respecting the importance of personal growth, compassion, and spiritual understanding.

Whether you're exploring Christianity for the first time or seeking to strengthen your knowledge of Scripture, Rooted in Truth offers a place to learn, reflect, and grow.

**Important:** Rooted in Truth provides educational and faith-based encouragement. It does not replace professional mental health care, medical treatment, or emergency services.

**Stay rooted in Scripture. Grow deeper in truth.**

name: Rukn: Employee Self-Service
description:
Rukn is the employee self-service app that puts your workday in your pocket. Check in, follow your attendance, submit requests and see your full HR file, in Arabic or English.
Rukn works with your company's Rukn account. Your employer gives you your sign-in details.
CHECK IN WITH ONE TAP
• Record your punch from the home screen
• See your shift hours and whether you're within check-in time
• Track the hours you've worked today against your daily target
YOUR ATTENDANCE AT A GLANCE
• Monthly calendar with every day color-coded: present, absent, excused and weekend
• Tap any day to see first in, last out, hours worked and the difference
• Submit an excuse for an absence straight from the calendar
REQUESTS IN THREE STEPS
• Choose a category: leave, attendance, finance or other services
• Pick the request type, add dates, notes and attachments, and send
• Filter your requests by status and type, and follow each one from pending to approved
ALWAYS KNOW YOUR LEAVE BALANCE
• See the days available to book right now
• Annual entitlement, accrued to date, used this year and year-end balance
• Leave history and scheduled leave in one place
YOUR HR FILE IN YOUR POCKET
• Personal information, identification and address
• Staffing details: job title, department, manager and joining date
• Salary breakdown with basic pay and every allowance
• Contract details, including probation and contract period progress
• Documents such as your national ID and passport, with validity status
• Company assets assigned to you, such as laptops and equipment
STAY IN THE LOOP
• Company announcements in one feed
• Notifications when your requests and excuses are approved or rejected
BUILT FOR YOU
• Full Arabic and English interface, with right-to-left layout in Arabic
• Gregorian and Hijri dates side by side
• Change your language and password from your profile
Questions or feedback? Contact us through Support in the app or visit rukn.co.

name: Run Bro!
description:
RUN BRO! THE ULTIMATE COMEDY RUNNING GAME!

Life is coming after Bro, and the only way out is to RUN!

Get ready for a hilarious arcade adventure where everyday problems become exciting challenges.

Run from Mom, bill collectors, bosses, bullies, and more as you race through colorful environments filled with obstacles, surprises, and rewards.

GAME FEATURES

46 Exciting Levels
Experience seven days of hilarious challenges plus a final showdown.

Unique Characters
Every level introduces a new reason to run and a different character chasing Bro.

Jump, Slide, and Swing
Avoid obstacles, grab ropes, swing across dangerous areas, and keep moving.

Collect Coins
Earn coins during gameplay and spend them on helpful items in the Corner Store.

Power-Ups and Special Items
Use banana peels, rocket sneakers, flowers, and other items to help Bro escape.

Checkpoints and High Scores
Reach checkpoints, beat your personal best, and unlock new challenges.

Colorful Arcade Graphics
Enjoy vibrant environments, entertaining animations, and fast-paced action.

CAN YOU ESCAPE?

From Mom chasing you over unfinished chores to bill collectors demanding payment, every level brings a new adventure.

Run faster. Jump higher. Dodge everything.

Download Run Bro! and start running today!

name: RunBite: Run Tracker & Steps
description:
RunBite records every run with your iPhone's GPS and turns it into a shareable route photo.

◆ GPS run tracking
Draws your route live on the map and tracks distance, pace, active time and calories. Paused time is counted separately, and tracking continues with the screen off.

◆ One-tap route photo
After each run RunBite creates a full-screen share image with a large route map plus distance, pace, time, calories, start and finish time — ready for Instagram, Threads and WhatsApp.

◆ Daily steps
Real step and floor counts from your iPhone's motion sensor, with a 7-day trend. Below goal shows red, goal met turns green. Set your own daily goal.

◆ Runner nutrition
Pre-run, post-run, hydration and everyday food ideas with protein, carb and fat info.

◆ Monthly training plan
Easy runs, intervals, tempo and long runs — tick them off as you go.

◆ Privacy
Everything stays on your iPhone. No ads, no tracking.

Available in English, 繁體中文 and 简体中文 (change in Settings › RunBite › Language).

Note: continued use of GPS can decrease battery life. Exercise within your own limits.

name: Rx Mobility: Elke dag op maat
description:
Rx Mobility werkt zonder tracking. De app heeft geen account, geen advertenties en geen analytics. Er gaat niets naar een server: je testresultaten, sessies en instellingen blijven op je eigen iPhone. Daarom staat er in de App Store bij Rx Mobility "Geen gegevens verzameld".

Rx Mobility maakt mobility een dagelijkse gewoonte. Je begint met een korte test, en daarna krijg je elke dag een routine die is afgestemd op jouw scores en jouw sport.

DE TEST
Doe 10 bewegingen en schuif het poppetje tot het op jouw eindhouding lijkt. Je krijgt een score van 0 tot 100 voor schouders, overhead, thoracaal, heupen, achterketen en enkels, je verschil tussen links en rechts en je focusgebieden. Na 30 dagen test je opnieuw en zie je je vooruitgang.

ELKE DAG EEN ROUTINE
• Kies 8, 15 of 22 minuten
• Afgestemd op je testscores en je sport, en elke dag anders
• Wissel oefeningen, vervang ze of laat ze weg
• Geen materiaal bij de hand? Kies voor alleen oefeningen zonder hulpmiddelen

VOOR EN NA JE TRAINING
• Activatie: warm op voor squat, snatch, deadlift, pull-ups en meer
• Herstel: kom na je training weer tot rust
• Werk gericht per zone, of kies een klassieker: Ochtend, Bedtijd, Bureau, Reizen, Rotatie of Onderrug
• Maak je eigen protocollen

DE SPELER
• Timer met geluidssignalen en trillingen
• Loopt door met je scherm op slot
• Wisselt automatisch van kant
• +15 seconden of een makkelijkere variant als je die nodig hebt

72 OEFENINGEN
Elke oefening heeft een bewegend, getekend poppetje, uitleg in stappen en waar je het moet voelen.

BLIJF BEZIG
• Reeks en kalender
• Maanddoel in minuten
• Dagelijkse herinnering
• Sessies opslaan als workout in Apple Gezondheid

JOUW GEGEVENS ZIJN VAN JOU
• Geen tracking en geen analytics
• Geen account, geen e-mailadres nodig
• Geen advertenties
• Werkt volledig offline
• Apple Gezondheid: Rx Mobility schrijft alleen je workouts, en leest nooit iets uit

Rx Mobility is geen medisch advies. Stop bij pijn.

name: RYNO People
description:
RYNO People records your team's working hours as the law requires — no sheets filled in from memory.

• Clock in by holding the phone to a tag on the wall: two seconds.
• Daily, signed and retained; it can't be filled in afterwards.
• Shift and zone planner, and a downloadable working-time report.
• Overtime review: every day with extra hours is flagged for the administrator until it is checked.
• Built for hospitality and small teams.

name: Saber: AI Note Companion
description:
Saber turns the conversations in your room into notes you can use.

Set your phone on the table and tap record. A few minutes after something is said, it's a clear, numbered note. As the conversation goes on, Saber keeps a summary up to date: what was decided, what's still contested, the highlights, and the action items, with who owns each one.

RECORD THE ROOM
 - One tap to start, from the app, Control Center, the Action Button, or Siri ("Record with Saber")
 - Keeps recording with the screen locked, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
 - No connection? Keep going. Audio waits on your phone and sends when you're back online
 - Long stretches of silence are skipped, and recording stops by itself after ten quiet minutes

A SUMMARY THAT KEEPS UP
 - Decisions, highlights, points of contention and open questions
 - Action items split into yours and everyone else's
 - Suggested follow-up questions

ASK SABER
Ask anything about what was said: "What did we decide about the launch date?" Saber answers from your notes. If Saber got something wrong, say so, and the summary is corrected.

TYPE A NOTE ANYTIME
Add a line of your own mid-meeting, and it joins the notes in place.

KNOWS YOUR VOICE
Record an 8-second voice sample and Saber can tell your lines from everyone else's. The sample stays on your phone and is sent only with your own recordings.

FOR MORE THAN MEETINGS
One-on-ones, interviews, classes, and game night at the table: if it's said in the room, Saber can take the notes.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Audio is transcribed and immediately discarded; it is never stored. Your notes are encrypted at rest. Saber doesn't sell your data or use it for advertising.

Saber works with the same account on the web and in the Saber Chrome extension, so your notes are everywhere you are.

A Saber account is required. Sign in with Apple, Google, Microsoft, email or phone.

Saber records what your phone's microphone hears. Recording laws vary by place: let people know when you're recording.

name: Saboura - Document Organizer
description:
Saboura is a simple, smart school companion for students and teachers. Organize your documents, read Saudi textbooks for every grade, take notes, record lessons, and let AI summarize and proofread, all in one app in Arabic and English.

SAUDI TEXTBOOKS
• Primary, intermediate and secondary stages, every grade and term, in one place
• Arabic and English books together, with many display styles: list, compact, grid, shelf, cards and more
• Download a book or the whole collection for offline reading, or import your own PDF files
• Subject libraries: mathematics, sciences, computing, engineering and more
• A dedicated Tahsili section

STUDY LINKS
• Solutions, exams, worksheets, summaries and curriculum distribution
• Organized by stage, grade and term
• Add and keep your own links

READ AND WRITE
• Read and annotate PDF files, and read text files
• Notepad: type, write with the pen or Apple Pencil, or both
• Whiteboard for free drawing and sketching
• Notes and page bookmarks

VOICE RECORDING
• Record lessons and lectures with your choice of quality and playback speed
• Convert speech to text automatically in your language
• Fix spelling and grammar, and summarize right after transcription

ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
• Summarize long text and recordings: short summary, key points, detailed summary, or tasks and decisions
• Check spelling and grammar
• Works on your device with Apple Intelligence, or with a simple built-in method that needs no AI and no account
• Optional: connect your own key for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok or DeepSeek. Off by default, and text is sent only when you start an action

STUDY AND SCHOOL
• Ready-made subject folders for your role and class
• Homework, exams, reminders and a daily summary
• Weekly class timetable

ORGANIZE AND SHARE
• Folders, groups and favorites
• Export and share as PDF, images, text or audio
• Undo for every change
• Trash with restore

PRIVATE AND PROTECTED
• Passcode and Face ID lock, and hidden app preview
• Your files stay on your device and originals are never modified
• Optional iCloud Sync across your devices
• No ads, no tracking, no account

Designed for school students and teachers: simple to use, with powerful options when you need them.

Saboura is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Ministry of Education. Textbook and study links point to publicly available sources.

name: Sajjil - AI Meeting Notes
description:
Turn every meeting into clear notes, without typing.

Tap record. Sajjil writes down what's said as you speak, then gives you a summary, the key points and the to-dos. All on your iPhone, even offline.

name: Salon Huddle
description: Salon Huddle is the all-in-one app for salons, barbers and beauty businesses. See your day at a glance in a diary built around your team, keep client records and colour formulas, manage stock, and keep track of targets, tips and chair rent. Take deposits and card payments through your own Stripe account. This app is for salon owners and their teams: sign in with your Salon Huddle account.

name: Sanguo Showdown: 1v1 Fighter
description:
Remember crowding around an arcade cabinet after school, slamming the buttons in a one-on-one fight to the last sliver of health? Sanguo Showdown brings that rush back to your phone: a hand-drawn 1v1 fighting game where the great warriors of Wei, Shu and Wu settle it with special moves, combos, super attacks and dazzling ultimate arts!

No internet, no mobile data and no ads. Sit down with a friend, turn on Bluetooth or a Wi-Fi hotspot and fight one-on-one: on the train, camping, anywhere without a signal. One purchase gets you the whole game, with no in-app purchases.

FIFTEEN LEGENDARY WARRIORS
Cao Cao, Xiahou Dun, Zhang Liao, Dian Wei, Sima Yi, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Huang Zhong, Zhuge Liang, Sun Ce, Zhou Yu, Gan Ning, Taishi Ci and Sun Shangxiang, each with moves built around their weapon: glaive, spear, halberd, bow, feather fan or twin swords. Clear the game to unlock the mightiest of all, Lu Bu.

SUPERS AND ULTIMATE ARTS
Fill your rage gauge to unleash an ultimate art with a full-screen cut-in and over-the-top effects. Every warrior shouts the name of their special move.

ARCADE MODE
A story opening, a run of battles with a bonus stage along the way, then a rival fight, the final boss and an ending for every warrior.

VERSUS AND CHALLENGES
Fight the computer at four difficulty levels, battle friends over Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, or take on Survival and Time Attack with local leaderboards.

TRAINING MODE
Input display, combo damage and a recordable dummy: practice your motions and confirm your combos.

CONTROLS MADE FOR PHONES
An arcade-style arc of four buttons, A, B, C and D, plus a virtual stick. Move, resize and fade every button, with haptics and a beginner tutorial.

ALSO
- A gallery with each warrior's art, move list and profile
- An English fight announcer, with warriors shouting their moves in Chinese
- In-game text is in Traditional Chinese

Contains weapon-based fighting.

name: Santral Asistan
description:
Santral Asistan, yenilenebilir enerji santrallerinin (HES, RES, GES, JES, biyokütle) işletmecileri için hazırlanmış bir izleme panelidir. EPİAŞ Şeffaflık Platformu'nun açık verisini kullanır; EPİAŞ şifreniz istenmez.

BUGÜN EKRANI
• Dünün üretimi, KGÜP'e göre sapması, tahmini net kazancı ve dengesizlik etkisi
• Bugünün KGÜP planı ve saat saat PTF'si
• Yarının PTF'si açıklanınca ortalama, en yüksek ve en düşük saat

KAZANÇ VE ÜRETİM
• Günlük, aylık, yıllık ve santralin tüm geçmişi için üretim ve tahmini kazanç
• YEKDEM, sabit TL/USD ve piyasa (PTF) tarifeleri; toplayıcı sözleşmesindeki satış oranı
• Excel ve PDF rapor

KGÜP, GİP VE DENGESİZLİK
• Sapma karnesi: GİP düzeltmesi, KGÜP üstü üretim, bildirimli ve bildirimsiz eksik
• KGÜP sonradan değişince GİP işlemini yakalar, fiyatını girmenizi hatırlatır
• Yarının KGÜP'ü yayınlanınca bariz giriş hatası (tüm gün sıfır, kapasite üstü) varsa uyarır

DURUŞLAR VE KESİNTİLER
• Duruş kaydı ve her duruşun MWh / TL kaybı
• KGÜP'te üretim varken santralin durduğu saatleri kendisi bulur
• EDAŞ planlı kesinti duyurularını santralin bağlı olduğu köylere göre takip eder (şimdilik Çoruh EDAŞ)

BİLDİRİMLER
• Her sabah dünün kazancı
• Yarının PTF'si, KGÜP kontrolü, GİP işlemi ve planlı kesinti bildirimleri
• Uygulama kilidi: Face ID / Touch ID

Hesaplar davetle açılır: erişim için info@santralasistan.com adresine santralinizin adıyla yazın. Tutarlar EPİAŞ açık verisiyle hesaplanan tahminlerdir; resmi uzlaştırmanın yerini tutmaz.

Gizlilik: https://panel.santralasistan.com/gizlilik

name: Schrod’s Window
description:
Night has fallen on a quiet street. One window is still dark. Turn a mirror and watch a thin beam of light find its way home.

Explore five houses, each with a different trick of the light. In the greenhouse, split a beam to reach two windows. In the workshop, turning one mirror moves its partner. Backstage, a moon switch lifts the curtain. At the last house, two bells must ring together.

Keep an eye on the windowsills. Schrod, a ginger cat, is following a runaway spool of thread.

There are 60 puzzles. Open any window on the street map, undo a turn, or ask for a hint. The map remembers which rooms you have lit and your best turn count for each one. Close the game halfway through a puzzle and pick up on the same board when you return.

Play in English or Russian. No account is required.

name: SCK App
description:
O app SCK reúne num só lugar os sistemas SCK que a sua empresa usa: agenda e atendimento do salão (SCK Beleza), câmeras ao vivo e gravações (SCK VMS), gestão de redes, CFTV, atendimento pelo WhatsApp (SCK Connect), gestão e mais.

• Entre uma vez com a sua conta SCK, com verificação em duas etapas.
• Veja só os sistemas que a sua empresa contratou e troque de empresa com um toque.
• Câmeras ao vivo e gravações com vídeo nativo.
• Agenda do dia, horários livres, compareceu e pagamento direto do celular.
• Caixa, despesas e resumo do dia, da semana e do mês.
• Funciona nos temas claro e escuro, em português e inglês.

O app é para clientes da SCK Soluções Digitais. Para acessar, a sua empresa precisa ter uma conta na plataforma SCK.

name: ScopeScale: Image Measure
description:
Measure a feature in a microscope image using a reference in the same image. Open an image from Files or start with the included synthetic calibration slide. Mark the two ends of a known distance, enter that distance in micrometers, then mark the two ends of a feature. See both segments on the original image and get the calibrated distance.

Use zoom and pixel nudges for tighter endpoint placement. Capture several labeled measurements on one image and share a tab-separated measurement table. All image processing happens on device.

Requires a same-plane reference at the same magnification. Intended for visual measurement, without specimen identification or medical interpretation. No account, network service, or subscription.

name: ScratchTrax
description:
ScratchTrax is a user-friendly multitrack recorder for capturing song ideas on-the-go with simple editing and optional effects to make them sound like they weren't recorded on a phone or tablet. Whether you're laying down a new idea that you don't want to forget, recording an idea to share with bandmates, or just having fun with friends, ScratchTrax is the perfect tool. Record one part, layer another on top, and build a full arrangement from anywhere creativity sparks!

RECORD
Up to 12 individual tracks
Combine tracks to free up space
Label each track
Control per-track and master volume

EDIT
Cut, trim, and fade with smooth curves
Zoom on tracks to fine-tune them to the split second

SHAPE THE MIX
Select from genre presets including Folk, Pop, Rap, Rock, Jazz, and Blues
Room, hall, or chamber reverb
Echo, warmth, and a one-tap polish
9-band EQ on every track and a master EQ

KEEP AND SHARE
Save every song to your library
Share finished songs as audio
Collaborate with friends who use ScratchTrax

No account, no subscription, and no ads. Pay once and it’s yours.

name: Scroll Bhagavad Gita w/ Audio
description:
Scroll The Bhagavad Gita puts all 700 verses of the Gita in a simple, beautiful feed — one verse per screen, in the original Sanskrit with transliteration and a clear English translation. Swipe up for the next verse, just like scrolling a feed, and let the Gita become part of your day.

READ
• All 18 chapters and 700 verses in Devanagari Sanskrit
• Roman transliteration under every verse (can be turned off)
• Two classic English translations: Swami Sivananda and Shri Purohit Swami
• Jump to any chapter or verse with the verse picker, or shuffle for a surprise

LISTEN
• Read-aloud mode: hear each verse recited in Sanskrit, followed by a calm, natural English narration
• Plays verse after verse, hands-free, and keeps the screen awake while it reads
• Every recording is built in — no internet needed

STUDY
• Study view for each verse: word-by-word meanings, both translations and a chapter summary
• Discover: short, curated reflections on the Gita's big ideas — who is the doer, the nature of the self, action without attachment — each linked to its verses

MAKE IT A HABIT
• Verse of the day on the home screen
• Daily reading streak and per-chapter progress
• Like verses to build your own collection, and share any verse with friends

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Everything works offline; your likes and progress stay on your device
• Dark, light and automatic themes, adjustable text size

Whether you are reading the Gita for the first time or returning to it daily, Scroll The Bhagavad Gita makes its wisdom easy to carry with you.

name: SDR-Doppler
description:
Work the amateur satellites without chasing the Doppler shift. SDR-Doppler predicts the passes for your station, tunes your radio's downlink and uplink in the satellite's frame and keeps both corrected for the whole pass. Turn your radio's dial as usual: the uplink follows.

One app for your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

HIGHLIGHTS

• Doppler correction of downlink and uplink, sent to your radio during the whole pass
• Tuning in the satellite's frame: a QSO stays where it is in the passband
• Lock: the uplink follows the downlink through the transponder, also on inverting transponders
• Uplink calibration per transponder: find your own signal once, it is remembered
• Follows your radio's dial (one-knob tuning)
• Tracking pauses with a clear reason when the radio doesn't take a frequency, and resumes with one click
• Transponders of the amateur satellites included (SatNOGS DB): linear, FM with CTCSS, digipeaters; change them or add your own
• "What am I hearing?": which satellite above the horizon has a downlink near the frequency you hear
• Notes per satellite

PASSES, SKY PLOT AND MAP

• Pass prediction for your favourites, with a 24-hour timeline and pass cards
• Sky plot with the pass, the satellite, the sun, the moon and your antenna
• Map with ground track, footprint and night side, also as a globe
• Azimuth, elevation, range, range rate, altitude, sunlit or eclipse, path loss
• Orbital elements refreshed daily from AMSAT and CelesTrak, or imported from a TLE file

ROTATOR

• Drives your rotator: Hamlib rotctld, Yaesu GS-232A / B and compatible controllers, EasyComm II, SPID Rot2Prog, Hy-Gain DCU-1, Green Heron RT-21, PstRotator, and through rotctld many more, over USB (Mac) or the network
• Rotator planner: ready before AOS, lead window, flip over the top for 180° elevation rotators, overlap, park after the pass
• Azimuth-only rotators work too
• Or let the radio app drive its own rotator: SDR-Doppler sends it the directions over the Common Radio™ Interface

ALERTS

• Spoken AOS, LOS and countdown for the selected satellite
• Notifications before the passes of your favourites

YOUR RADIO

SDR-Doppler talks to the app that controls your radio, on the same network, over the Common Radio™ Interface. It works with these HAM radio apps by the same developer, version 27.1.1 or later:
• SmartSDR for FlexRadio
• SDR-Control for Icom (and SDR-Control Mobile)
• FT-Control for Yaesu
• TS-Control for Kenwood
• K4-Control for Elecraft
The app is found by name on the network; modes, transmit receiver and CTCSS tone are set for you. Any other program with a TCI server works too.
Two receivers (full duplex), one receiver in split, or receive only. A Demo Radio shows how it all works before you connect your own.

SUPPORT

Made by a ham for hams: DL8MRE. Personal support is included: use Contact Support in the app. A detailed manual is available from inside the app.

REQUIREMENTS

• macOS 26 or later, iOS 26 or later
• SmartSDR, SDR-Control, FT-Control, TS-Control or K4-Control (version 27.1.1 or later), or a program with a TCI server, and a radio for the satellite bands
• Optional: a rotator controller

name: SE Visit Notes
description:
SE Visit Notes is an internal app for the sales and field team of Surface Experts of Coastal SE Florida (Savageable, Inc.). It is for our staff only. You need a company account to sign in, and there's nothing in it for the general public.

Reps use it to record each property visit in a few minutes, on site:

• Visit details: property, contact type (sales visit, QC, inspection, phone, email, or text), and who they met.
• Contacts: choose an existing property contact or add a new one. You can tap "Scan business card" to fill in the name, title, phone, and email from a card. The text is read on the phone with Apple's Vision framework, and the card photo isn't kept.
• Walk-through: common areas and units, with repairs picked from our price list, quantities, and photos or videos for each line.
• Repairs sold, estimate requests, and next steps with follow-up dates.
• Works with no signal: the form opens from data saved on the phone. Submitted notes wait in an Outbox and send themselves when the connection returns, with no duplicates.

Notes go to our office system for follow-up. Nothing is sent to customers from the app.

Support: ovanin@surfaceexperts.com · 404.693.0000

name: Sealoria
description:
Transform a blank wax surface into detailed dimensional artwork with SEALORIA, a focused digital studio for sculpting and exploring editable wax reliefs.

Shape the surface using raise, lower, smooth, press, and directional drag tools. Adjust brush size and strength to create precise marks, soft transitions, engraved details, and raised forms.

Explore your artwork with tools designed for relief creation:

• Sculpt responsive wax surfaces
• Adjust softness, resistance, and recovery
• Inspect shaded surfaces, height maps, and cross-sections
• Measure surface height with a precise point probe
• Create and compare artwork variations
• Combine multiple relief components into layered compositions
• Undo and redo creative operations
• Save artwork locally as editable SEALORIA documents
• Export and share preserved artwork packages

SEALORIA keeps the creative process editable, allowing you to revisit materials, geometry, variations, and composition without flattening your work into a static image.

Designed for artists, makers, engravers, and anyone exploring dimensional surface design.

name: Seodam Geotag - 여행경로저장, GPS
description:
Seodam Geotag는 여행 중 지나간 길을 빠짐없이 기록하는 GPS 경로 기록 앱입니다.
"그날 몇 시에 어디에 있었지?"를 나중에 정확히 확인하고, 기록한 경로로 사진에 위치를 넣을 수 있습니다.

■ 멈출 때까지 계속 기록
• 화면을 끄거나 앱을 닫아도, 아이폰을 다시 켜도 직접 정지할 때까지 이어서 기록합니다 (위치 접근을 '항상 허용'으로 설정해야 합니다)
• 기록 간격: 연속(실시간), 1초~1시간, 수동 중에서 고르고 최소 이동 거리도 정할 수 있습니다
• 위치 방식: 'GPS만(오차 30 m 이내)'과 'GPS + 기지국·Wi-Fi' 중에서 고릅니다
• 멈춰 있을 때 GPS 쉬기: 한자리에 오래 머물면 GPS를 쉬게 해 배터리를 아낍니다
• 지금 위치를 한 번만 기록하거나, 기록을 마치고 새 경로를 바로 시작할 수 있습니다

■ 현지 시각과 한국 시각을 함께
• 모든 지점을 그곳의 현지 시각(서머타임 포함)으로 보여 줍니다
• 해외 여행 기록을 한국에서 볼 때는 그때의 한국 시각도 함께 보여 줍니다
• 여행마다 시간대를 직접 고를 수 있고, 서머타임 수동 보정과 기준 시간대도 설정할 수 있습니다

■ 지도로 다시 보기
• 여행 목록: 달마다 묶어 보여 주고, 연도·이름·날짜로 찾을 수 있습니다
• 여행 지도: 지점을 누르거나 막대를 움직여 그 순간의 시각·좌표·이동 거리를 확인합니다
• 기록이 없는 구간(지하철·비행기 등)은 회색 화살표로 구분해 보여 줍니다
• 튄 지점 정리: 가지 않은 곳에 잘못 찍힌 지점을 한 번에 정리하고, 언제든 되돌릴 수 있습니다
• 되돌아가기: 지나온 길을 분홍색으로 보여 주며 출발점이나 고른 곳까지 되돌아가도록 돕습니다
• 지도 종류: 일반, 위성, 위성 + 지명

■ 가져오기와 내보내기
• GPX·KML·KMZ·CSV 파일을 가져옵니다. 이미 있는 여행과 겹치면 합칠지, 따로 둘지, 건너뛸지 고릅니다
• GPX·KML·KMZ·CSV로 내보냅니다. GPX에는 시간대와 메모까지 담겨 사진 편집 앱의 위치 태깅에 바로 쓸 수 있습니다
• 여러 여행을 하나로 합치거나, 끝난 여행에 이어서 기록할 수 있습니다

■ 자동 백업
• iCloud Drive의 'Seodam Geotag' 폴더에 여행마다 GPX 파일을 자동으로 백업합니다
• 아이폰 안에도 백업을 남겨 파일 앱의 '나의 iPhone › Seodam Geotag'에서 볼 수 있습니다
• 설정에서 마지막 백업 시각을 확인하고, 바로 백업할 수도 있습니다

■ 개인정보
• 회원가입, 광고, 추적이 없습니다
• 기록은 내 아이폰과 내 iCloud Drive에만 저장되며, 개발자에게 전송되지 않습니다

※ 백그라운드에서 GPS를 계속 사용하면 배터리 사용량이 늘어날 수 있습니다. 기록 간격과 'GPS 쉬기' 설정으로 배터리 사용을 줄일 수 있습니다.

name: Service Station or Cheese?
description:
Is it a motorway service station or a British cheese? It's harder than it sounds.

Sparkenhoe. Pease Pottage. Lord of the Hundreds. Rothersthorpe. Gallybagger. Each card shows a name: you decide if it's somewhere to stop on the M6, something to put on a cracker, or (occasionally) both.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Quick 10: ten random cards. Perfect for the next junction.
• Marathon: every card, shuffled. For the long haul up the M1.
• Hard Mode: only the obscure ones. For true connoisseurs of curd and car park.

LEARN SOMETHING EVERY CARD
After each answer you get a fact: which motorway the services are on and what makes them notable, or where the cheese is made and what it's made from.

194 CARDS
99 UK motorway service stations, 93 British cheeses from Cornwall to Orkney, and a couple that are genuinely both.

SEE HOW YOU DID
Finish a round for your score, your best streak, a breakdown by category and a title — from "Needs a Service Break" all the way up to "The Unstoppable Cheese Wheel".

GREAT FOR CAR JOURNEYS
One person reads, everyone shouts. No internet needed, no accounts, no adverts, no in-app purchases.

From the maker of Service Station League Table.

name: ServiceQuill
description:
Keep a practical service register for your workshop. Add equipment, its storage location, the last service date and an interval. ServiceQuill calculates the next due date and brings overdue equipment into view.

Record a service with its date and notes. Each service stays in the history while the next due date is recalculated. Search the register, filter overdue items and browse the service ledger. This is an on-device logbook, without scheduled notifications or remote monitoring. Follow the manufacturer’s maintenance and safety instructions.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: SessionTap School Edition
description:
SessionTap is a behavior data collection app for schools. Tap a button each time a behavior happens, or start and stop a timer while it lasts, and keep your eyes on the student instead of a clipboard.

WHO IT'S FOR

Special education teachers, paraprofessionals, school psychologists, behavior specialists and RBTs who collect frequency and duration data during the school day.

REUSABLE BOARDS

A board is a set of buttons, one per behavior. Create your own or start from five built-in templates: ABA Basics, Classroom Assessment, Simple Counter, Sports Scouting and UX Research. Set a board up once and reuse it for every session.

TWO EVENT MODES

Frequency: tap to count. Each tap is timestamped.
Duration: tap to start, tap to stop. Several durations can run at the same time.

TIMERS THAT SURVIVE INTERRUPTIONS

Lock the device, take a call or switch apps, and the session keeps running. SessionTap records absolute timestamps, so duration timers stay accurate when the screen turns off.

REVIEW AND EXPORT

After each session you see counts, rates per minute and each behavior's share of the session. Filter the timeline by behavior, add notes, and export the session as a CSV file for spreadsheets or your district's records.

FOR SCHOOLS AND DISTRICTS

The School Edition is licensed per device or user through Apple School Manager. Every feature is included, with no in-app purchases and no limit on sessions.

NO ANALYTICS

This edition collects no data. It has no analytics, no accounts and no SessionTap server. Boards, sessions and notes are stored on the device and leave it only when someone exports a CSV, or as part of the device's own backup. Recording, review and export all work offline.

name: Seyvilo: IPTV Player
description:
Seyvilo is a media player for your own IPTV sources. Add an Xtream Codes account or an M3U playlist you are authorized to use, and browse live TV, movies and series in one clean, dark interface designed for iPhone and iPad.

Seyvilo does not provide, sell or include any channels, streams or content. You bring your own source.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Add several sources (Xtream or M3U) and switch the active one from the top bar
• Refresh a source at any time and see when it was last updated
• Watch live TV, movies and series with categories, search and sorting (A-Z, recently added, rating)
• Continue watching: resume movies and episodes where you left off, jump to the next episode
• Recent channels, favorites, watchlist and watch history, with options to clear history and recent channels
• Protect adult categories with a PIN; unlock with Face ID or your device passcode if you forget it
• Choose subtitle and audio tracks; a second playback engine takes over when a stream needs it
• Built for iPad: multi-column layouts, a split-view Settings screen and large posters
• A dark, premium look everywhere

PRIVACY
Your sources and viewing history stay on your device. Seyvilo has no accounts, no ads and no tracking.

A demo mode with sample media lets you try the app without adding a source.

name: Silicon Chess Extract
description:
Go from the book to the board. Open a chess PDF and extract the games or fragments you want to replay, study, or save as PGN. It works with text PDFs and scans. Recognition runs on your iPhone or iPad.

• Select your pages. Open a PDF from Files, zoom in, and choose up to 20 pages per extraction. Supports password-free PDFs up to 180 MiB.
• Review uncertain moves. See the original crop and the available readings. The PGN stops at an uncertain move. Confirm it against the crop to continue.
• Replay the game. Step through the moves, explore variations, and return to the point where they branch. Keep and review the author’s comments alongside their moves.
• Start from a diagram. Review the pieces, confirm the starting position, and export the continuation with its FEN.
• Organize your study. Save, search, and replay games in the local PGN library. Import an existing PGN or export a single game or a full database.

Reads English and Spanish chess notation and printed figurines. Recognition quality depends on the page and scan. PDFs and the library stay on your device. Works offline with no account, ads, or subscriptions.

name: Silm Magazine
description: Read Bengali Islamic articles, thoughtful essays, and contemporary insights from Silm Magazine

name: Singing Santa Watchface
description:
Bring a jolly Santa to your wrist this Christmas.

Singing Santa is an Apple Watch app with a cheerful Santa standing in a cozy Christmas scene. Tap the screen and he dances and sings a happy Christmas song for about half a minute. Tap again to stop him. A big clock, the date, the weather and your daily stats are always at hand.

FEATURES
• Animated Santa who dances and sings when you tap the screen
• 10 backgrounds: cozy fireplaces, Christmas trees, Rudolph, a snowman, snowy cabins, Santa's workshop and a plain glow
• 10 clock styles, from playful to classic
• 30 color themes for the time, date and stats
• Current weather with day and night icons
• Heart rate, steps and battery at a glance
• 12-hour or 24-hour time
• Dimmed always-on look that keeps the time easy to read
• Music switch: let Santa dance quietly when you prefer
• Bonus animated watch face: Santa dances each time you raise your wrist

CUSTOMIZE FROM YOUR IPHONE
Open the app on your watch, then use the companion iPhone app to pick a background, a clock style and a color theme. A live preview shows the look before you send it to the watch. You can also turn the music and the weather on or off and choose 12-hour or 24-hour time.

WATCH APP AND WATCH FACE
Singing Santa is a watch app: Santa and his song are in the app while it's open on your Apple Watch. From the iPhone app you can also install a matching animated watch face: an Apple photo watch face where Santa dances by the fireplace each time you raise your wrist. It includes a complication that opens the app with a single tap. You can also add the complication to your favorite watch face or to the Smart Stack.

Tip: to keep the app on screen longer, open Settings on your watch, go to General, then Return to Clock, and choose After 1 hour.

WEATHER AND HEALTH DATA
The weather comes from Apple Weather and uses your watch's location while the app is open. Singing Santa reads your steps and heart rate from Apple Health to show them on your watch. Your data stays on your devices.

HELP AND SUPPORT
The iPhone app includes a FAQ section with answers to common questions and a contact page if you need us. The More tab shows our other animated watch faces.

REQUIREMENTS
Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or newer, paired with an iPhone running iOS 17 or newer.

Merry Christmas!

name: Sirat Alarm
description:
Sirat Alarm vendos alarme sipas vakteve të namazit dhe ditëve të shënuara, jo vetëm në orë të caktuar.

KUR BIE
• Në orë të caktuar, si një alarm i zakonshëm
• Para, në kohë ose pas çdo vakti: Imsaku, Lindja e diellit, Dreka, Ikindia, Akshami, Jacia
• Minutat i zgjedh vetë, p.sh. 30 minuta para Jacisë ose 10 minuta pas Akshamit

KUR VLEN
• Çdo ditë ose vetëm në ditët e javës që zgjedh
• Vetëm gjatë Ramazanit, në netët e Ramazanit ose jashtë Ramazanit
• Në data hixhri (p.sh. ditët e bardha 13, 14, 15)
• Në festat dhe ditët e shënuara, atë ditë, një ditë para ose pas
• Në data të caktuara

ALARM I VËRTETË
• Bie edhe kur telefoni është në heshtje ose në Focus
• Shfaqet në ekranin e kyçur, në Dynamic Island, në StandBy dhe në Apple Watch
• Shtyrja me numërim në ekranin e kyçur
• Tingulli: alarmi i telefonit ose ezani
• Shënimi yt del kur bie alarmi, p.sh. "Lexo suren Kehf"

KALOJE VETËM KËTË HERË
Para se të bjerë alarmi, të del një njoftim me "Shtyje" dhe "Kaloje këtë herë". Nëse je zgjuar para alarmit të Sabahut, e kalon vetëm për atë ditë; herët e tjera bie normalisht.

PËRKUJTUES
Përveç alarmeve, mund të krijosh edhe përkujtues të qetë me njoftim dhe shënimin tënd.

VAKTET NGA SIRATI
Alarmet sipas vakteve marrin kohët nga aplikacioni Sirat në të njëjtin iPhone, saktësisht si i shfaq Sirati (qyteti, takvimi, ndryshimet e Ramazanit). Alarmet në orë të caktuar punojnë edhe pa Siratin.

PA REKLAMA, PA TË DHËNA
Sirat Alarm nuk ka reklama, nuk kërkon llogari dhe nuk mbledh asnjë të dhënë. Gjithçka mbetet në telefonin tënd.

name: Sınacıoğlu Films
description:
Sınacıoğlu Films çiftlerine özel uygulama.

Düğün fotoğraf ve film sürecinizin her adımı telefonunuzda:

• Süreç takibi: Anlaşmadan teslime kadar fotoğraf ve filminizin hangi aşamada olduğunu görün.
• Albüm seçimi: Fotoğraflarınız yüklendiğinde albümünüz için favorilerinizi tek dokunuşla seçin ve bize gönderin.
• Teslim linkleri: Fotoğraf ve videolarınızın indirme linkleri hazır olduğunda burada açılır.
• Çekim rehberi: Düğün gününe hazırlık için kısa ve pratik notlar.
• Klip müzikleri: Düğün klipleriniz için şarkılarınızı uygulamadan iletin.
• İstekler: Rötuş, albüm kapağı ya da teslimle ilgili isteklerinizi doğrudan ekibimize yazın.
• Hediyelik: Baskı, kanvas tablo ve albüm siparişi verin.
• Bildirimler: Fotoğraflarınız hazır olduğunda, isteğinize yanıt geldiğinde ve linkleriniz açıldığında haberiniz olsun.
• Face ID ile hızlı ve güvenli giriş.
• Fotoğraflarınızı galerinize kaydedin ya da paylaşın.

Giriş bilgileriniz çekiminiz planlandığında size SMS / WhatsApp ile iletilir.

name: Skandora
description:
Miért nem internetezik a hal? A csattanót meghagyjuk neked.

A Skandora magyar skandináv keresztrejtvényekkel hozza el a rejtvényújságok hangulatát a telefonodra. Minden rejtvényhez jár egy rajz és egy vicc, amelynek a poénja maga a megfejtés.

Kezdésnek tíz ingyenes rejtvény vár, aztán hetente érkezik egy új. 

Egy kávé mellé, egy hosszú vonatútra vagy vasárnap délutánra. A kezdőcsomagot és a letöltött heti rejtvényeket internet nélkül is előveheted. Reklám és regisztráció nélkül.

name: Sky Delivery Traveler
description:
Make more of your existing journey with Sky Delivery. Add your flight between Washington Dulles and Addis Ababa, choose the items and quantities you can carry, and let Sky coordinate inspected shipments for your route.

• Add your flight and available carrying capacity.
• Reserve eligible available items during the reservation window.
• See clearly which items are reserved, assigned, or still being matched.
• Coordinate pickup and destination handoff with the Sky team.
• Track assigned earnings and paid history.
• See your Travelers Club tier and progress as you complete flights.
• Message Sky directly and read trip notifications in your Inbox.

Availability, assignment, and earnings depend on your route, timing, capacity, and Sky confirmation. Review the booking, cancellation, liability, and payment rules in the app before participating.

name: Slabcast: Brick Breaker
description:
Make every bounce count.

Slabcast is an offline brick-breaker game of satisfying rebounds, sculpted clay blocks, and small moments of focus. Drag to aim, release a stream of porcelain balls, and find the angle that clears the shelf.

A CLASSIC ROUTE OF 200 LEVELS
Explore six chapters of clay-brick puzzles. Learn wall rebounds, work through tighter spaces, and put each cast to good use. Continue your saved attempt or jump to any Classic level from Settings. Every level is open from the start.

A NEW DAILY CHALLENGE
Meet a fresh arrangement every day, with three minutes on the clock. Play as often as you like and improve your personal best. The on-screen Restart button instantly gives you a fresh board and a full timer.

SIMPLE CONTROLS, SATISFYING POSSIBILITIES
Preview your rebounds before you release. Break numbered bricks, trigger row and column strikes, extend your cast with Triad, redirect a ball with Wedge, and collect Spare for an extra ball. Clear every brick before time runs out or the shelf reaches the danger line.

ROOM TO FOCUS
Enjoy rounded blocks, a recessed game board, warm colors, and gentle sound effects. Pause whenever you need; the countdown also stops when you leave the app. Adjust sound, haptics, and motion in Settings.

MADE FOR YOUR SCREEN
Play with an adaptive layout on iPhone or a spacious portrait board on iPad.

OFFLINE, FROM THE FIRST CAST
No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts or tracking. No links out of the game. Your progress and personal records stay on your device.

Aim. Bounce. Find your flow.

name: Slippery Slope: Tough Choices
description:
Your coworker takes credit for your idea. The cashier hands you too much change. A friend asks if you liked their terrible haircut.

What would you really do? Only you need to know.

Slippery Slope is a game of small, everyday dilemmas for adults. Each card is a real-life moment at work, with money, friends, dates, family or the neighbors. Swipe left or right to decide. No lectures, no wrong-answer buzzer, no game over.

YOUR ANSWERS STAY PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no data collected. Everything you choose stays on your phone, so you can answer honestly.

EVERY DECISION EARNS COINS
You get coins for deciding, not for being perfect. Save them up to unlock new themes: Shopping, Travel, Dining, Tech, Housing, Leadership, Online, Side Hustle, Sports, Community, Pets, Commute, Spouses and Exes.

1,400+ DILEMMAS, NO REPEATS
Every card is different, and you won't see the same one twice. Themes rotate.

UNFILTERED (OPTIONAL, 18+)
Want it harder? Switch on Unfiltered for dilemmas without the house rules: cheating, crime, betrayal and cruelty. It's off until you choose it, and it's free.

DAILY DILEMMA
One special card a day for bonus coins. Keep your streak going.

GUT CHECK MODE
Think less, decide faster. A short timer, double the coins.

SEE WHERE YOU SLIDE
Your profile page shows what your choices say about you: honesty, fairness, giving credit, owning mistakes and the courage to speak up. Watch your Slope meter move from Slippery to Rock solid, week by week. It never touches your coins.

SHARE A DILEMMA
Turn any card into an image and ask your friends what they'd do.

MADE FOR GROWN-UPS
A clean, modern look in light or dark mode. Play in English, Spanish, German or French. Works offline.

How slippery is your slope?

name: SlotCairn
description:
Give each task a defined place in your day. Choose a start time and duration, add notes and see your agenda ordered on a timeline. SlotCairn flags overlapping blocks so you can adjust them or keep both intentionally.

Mark work complete, browse and search all blocks, and review planned and completed time over the last seven days. Your records persist between launches. No calendar permission or external calendar synchronization is required. Overlapping minutes are counted separately; this is planned effort, not unique occupied time.

Your records stay on this device. Sharing is initiated by you. No account, advertising or purchases are required.

name: Slow Cooker Guide
description:
Slow Cooker Guide is a small, honest recipe book for your slow cooker. It works with no internet connection, has no account and no ads, and keeps nothing but your own choices on your phone.

RECIPES WITH SOURCES
16 recipes: stews, soups, main dishes, a breakfast and a dessert. Most come from U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs nutrition publications, one from FoodSafety.gov, and one is based on a published blog recipe. Every recipe shows where it came from, with a link and the date it was checked against that source. Method steps are written fresh for the app.

FIND SOMETHING TO MAKE
Search by name, ingredient or main protein. Filter by Low or High setting, cook time, course, or recipes that need no stovetop.

WHAT CAN I MAKE?
Tick the ingredients you have in My Pantry and see what you can make now, what is missing one ingredient, and what is missing more. Mark staples like salt and oil as "always have".

COOK WITH IT
Ingredients show the source's own amounts, with US and metric conversions where units convert. The cooking view shows one step at a time in large text, readable from across the kitchen.

FOOD SAFETY
Meat and poultry recipes show the safe internal temperature to check, and the app includes slow cooker food-safety guidance based on U.S. government sources, in its own words. The agencies do not endorse the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no internet access. Your favorites, pantry and unit setting stay on your device.

name: Slumbra: Sleep Sounds & Alarm
description:
Slumbra is a quiet sleep app. Pick a sound you like, set your alarm and put your phone down. In the morning, get last night in one sentence, and over time find out what really works for you.

27 SLEEP SOUNDS
All synthesized in code, looping seamlessly:
• Noise: brown, pink, white, green, fan, air conditioner
• Water: light rain, heavy rain, rain on a tent, dripping eaves, creek, river, waterfall, lakeside, ocean waves
• Nature: wind, campfire, summer-night crickets
• Everyday: airplane cabin, night train, purring cat, heartbeat
• Meditation: singing bowl, wind chimes, three low pulsing tones
Layer a second sound, each with its own volume.

FADES OUT WHEN THE ROOM GOES QUIET
With the microphone on, the sound fades out after the room has been quiet for a while. Or choose 15, 30 or 60 minutes, or play all night.

TONIGHT'S SUGGESTION
Answer three quick questions (mood, body, how noisy the room is) and get a sound mix for tonight. Rate the night in the morning and future suggestions take it into account.

AN ALARM THAT RINGS ON A LOCKED PHONE
Slumbra keeps running through the night with the screen off, plays your sound and wakes you on time, with a 9-minute snooze. If the battery gets very low, it stops the sound and logging and keeps only the alarm.

SMART ALARM (OPTIONAL)
In a window before your alarm (up to 30 minutes), if Slumbra hears you moving more, it wakes you a little early. Otherwise it rings at your set time.

LAST NIGHT IN ONE SENTENCE
Time in bed, whether the alarm was on time, and roughly how many minutes may have been snoring. Every night is kept in History: tap one to see its sound, time to settle and rating.

MY EXPERIMENTS
Compares only your own nights: which sounds and settings went with better ratings and settling down sooner. With enough nights, it suggests the next mix worth trying.

THE MICROPHONE NEVER RECORDS
With the microphone on, Slumbra only measures loudness each minute and estimates snoring on your phone. No audio is recorded, stored or uploaded. Snoring results are estimates and can be wrong.

SLEEP DEBT
Based on how long you want to sleep, Slumbra adds up how much time in bed you've missed over the last 14 days and suggests a bedtime. This uses time in bed, not measured sleep.

PRIVACY
• No account
• Your sleep records stay on your phone; clear them any time in Settings
• No ads, no tracking

Languages: English and Traditional Chinese (follows your phone's language).

Slumbra is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition. If you often sleep poorly or are concerned about snoring or breathing pauses, talk to a doctor.

name: SnorkelShelf
description: Manage beach and water-sports rentals from your phone—even offline at the shore. Track gear inventory, customers, checkouts, due dates, returns, and deposits in one place. Log maintenance, see what’s available or overdue, and keep your shop records on-device with no account required.

name: Softly: Stress & Body
description:
Softly reads the data your Apple Watch saves to Health and compares today with your own usual levels, so you can see whether your body is more strained or more relaxed than usual. It never compares you with other people or general norms.

BODY STATE
Last night's sleep, sleep HRV, resting heart rate, breathing rate, blood oxygen and wrist temperature, plus your heart rate and HRV while still today, come together in four levels: Great, Normal, High and Overload. High needs at least two measures clearly off at once, so one odd number won't alarm you.

STRESS TODAY
While you're awake, every 10 minutes gets a level based on your heart rate and HRV while still. Times when you walk or exercise aren't counted as stress and show in grey.

WATCH REMINDERS
If stress stays high for half an hour while you're still, your Apple Watch taps your wrist and suggests a minute of breathing. The watch reads your heart rate itself, so it doesn't wait for your iPhone to sync.

HRV FROM EVERY HEARTBEAT
Softly works out RMSSD from the beat-to-beat data your watch records, which shows better whether you're relaxed or under stress right now. HRV asleep and awake are compared separately.

SLEEP SCORE
Time asleep, waking at night, deep and REM sleep and sleep HRV. When you wake up, Softly tells you how you slept and what cost the most points.

TRENDS AND JOURNAL
See a week, a month or three months at a time, and the hours you're most often high or relaxed. Tag coffee, exercise or alcohol and see how your HRV changes afterwards.

PRIVACY
Everything is calculated on your iPhone and Apple Watch. Nothing is uploaded. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 18 or later and an Apple Watch with watchOS 11 or later. No watch? Try the demo data first.

Softly is not a medical device and can't diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. If you feel unwell, see a doctor.

name: SoilTrace: Texture Triangle
description:
