Turn sand, silt and clay percentages into a USDA soil texture class and plot the sample on a ternary triangle. Edit each fraction, read back the total and compare two mixes on the same diagram. The example shows how sand, silt and clay shift the same sample toward a different class.

Keep named samples and field notes in a local logbook. Reopen previous samples, compare them and share a tabular summary. Sampling and testing happen outside the app.

Works offline with no accounts, ads or ongoing charges.

name: Sought: Quiet Search
description:
Sought removes the suggestions and recommendation feeds that appear around Google Search and YouTube in Safari, so you see the results you asked for and the video you opened, and nothing chosen for you.

Sought's core is a Safari content blocker. Safari applies its rules itself, so Sought never sees the pages you visit, your searches or your history. One rule stops the search box from requesting autocomplete and trending suggestions, so partial searches stay on your iPhone. Other rules hide the Trending searches list, results modules such as People also ask, Related searches and Top stories, and YouTube's home feed, Shorts, related videos and end screens. Each one has its own switch.

Content blockers stay on in Private Browsing by default, so Sought works in every private tab with no account and no change to your default search engine. A short checklist walks you through Safari's settings, including turning off Safari's own search suggestions in the address bar, and shows whether the blocker is on.

KEY FEATURES:
• Block autocomplete and trending searches on Google
• Hide People also ask, Related searches, Top stories and AI Overviews
• Hide YouTube's home feed, Shorts, related videos and end screens
• Works in Private Browsing with no sign-in
• Quiet Mode from the app, Control Center, Shortcuts or a Focus
• Optional Lens extension: send Shorts to the standard player and turn off autoplay

Sought makes no network requests and collects no data. There is no account, no tracking and no advertising.

Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

Sought is not affiliated with Google LLC or YouTube. Google and YouTube are trademarks of Google LLC.

name: SpeakLoop: Speaking Coach
description:
SpeakLoop helps intermediate and advanced English learners turn passive vocabulary into active spoken English through a focused daily routine of short monologues, idiomatic rewrites, and shadowing.

Note: The in-app interface is currently in Japanese, designed for Japanese-speaking learners practicing English speaking.

KEY FEATURES
- One-Tap Voice Monologues (up to 5 minutes): Pick a topic by difficulty (Easy / Standard / Challenge), preview target phrases from your phrasebook, and record locally right away.
- Phrasebook-Aware AI Coaching (BYOK): Connect your own Gemini, OpenAI, or Claude API key stored securely in iOS Keychain. SpeakLoop selects underused and pinned expressions from your phrasebook, weaves 1-2 naturally into an idiomatic American English rewrite, and tracks usage counts automatically.
- Shadowing & Voice Comparison: Review natural rewrites, thought-group slash scripts, pronunciation/linking tips, and quick feedback. Practice with native TTS (0.5x to 2.0x with loop playback) and compare directly against your own recording.
- 100 Built-In American Spoken Expressions: Includes discourse markers, reactions, phrasal verbs, and everyday idioms. Add your own expressions or save AI suggestions with one tap.
- Standard Markdown Export: Share or copy single entries or multi-day Markdown bundles using the standard iOS Share Sheet.
- Privacy First: No developer backend server. Audio and text are sent directly to your chosen AI provider only when you request coaching (when using Claude without an OpenAI key, Apple Speech Recognition is used for transcription).

name: Spend Billionaires Money Game
description:
What would you do with a billionaire’s fortune for a day? KEŞKE is a free spend money game that lets you find out.

Pick a scenario and get a giant play budget, from $1 billion all the way to $375 billion. Buy a coffee or a supercar, a private island or a rocket launch, a skyscraper or a smart city built from scratch. Changed your mind? Sell it and the money comes straight back.

HOW TO PLAY
• Choose a scenario: tech tycoon, football star, online creator, retail giant and more.
• Explore at your own pace with no time limit, or race the clock in a 60-second round.
• Buy one at a time, ×10, ×100 or as many as the budget allows.
• Finish the round, see your spending story and share your result with friends.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT
• 50+ things to buy, from everyday treats to mega projects
• Personal records: total spent first, different picks as the tie-breaker
• Fast, clean, ad-free billionaire simulator
• Play in English, Spanish, Portuguese or Turkish
• No account needed, works offline

If you have ever wondered how it feels to spend billionaires’ money, this rich simulator is for you. Can you spend every last dollar?

Please note: all money, prices and budgets in the game are virtual. No real purchase, payment, investment or donation takes place. Scenarios are for entertainment only, don’t represent anyone’s real wealth and are not affiliated with any person.

name: Sphere – Drive, Deliver, Earn
description:
Sphere Driver helps delivery partners receive, manage, and complete delivery requests conveniently.

From pickup to drop-off, the app provides the information and tools you need to manage each delivery and keep customers informed throughout the journey.

Key features:

• Receive and review delivery requests
• View pickup and drop-off information
• Accept available delivery requests
• Navigate to delivery locations
• Update delivery progress and status
• Manage active deliveries
• View your completed delivery history
• Keep customers informed with real-time updates

Sphere Driver brings your delivery information together in one place, helping you stay organized while completing trips.

Download Sphere Driver and start managing your deliveries.

name: Spider Felt: Solitaire
description:
Play Spider solitaire on a green felt table with original cream cards and brass details. Build eight same-suit runs from King to Ace to clear the table.

• Choose one, two, or four suits.
• Drag a card or select it and tap its destination.
• Undo a move, ask for a hint, or restart the same deal.
• Pick up where you left off with automatic local saves.

The table adapts to iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo. Play offline without accounts or ads.

name: Spool Stick
description:
Spool Stick checks a pipe spool on the phone.

Drag each cut onto the centerline. Every weld gap for this size comes off before the end fitting is compared with the far mark. Within 2 mm is on the mark. Past that, the longest cut is too long, or the shortest cut is too short. Changing the gap does not rewrite a stored length.

Share an English summary or a CSV. A spoken heat number stays on the iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Spot Survey: Land & Plot Area
description:
Spot Survey is an offline-first field notebook for estimating the horizontal plan area and perimeter of land plots using an iPhone or iPad and an optional measuring tape.

Built for landowners, farmers, field operators, and rural planners who need transparent, reproducible measurements without accounts, subscriptions, or cloud lock-in.

FOUR WAYS TO ESTIMATE HORIZONTAL AREA
• GPS Corner Recording (3–26 Corners): Stand stationary at each physical marker in boundary order (A–Z). Spot Survey waits for steady GPS convergence, averages 30 seconds of foreground observations weighted by reported accuracy, and preserves every raw observation.
• Combine GPS Shape + Tape Lengths: Enter horizontal side and optional diagonal lengths in metres (m) or feet (ft) to refine GPS shape estimates with a weighted least-squares fit, conflict detection, and next-diagonal suggestions.
• Enter Coordinates from Multiple Phones: Paste or type WGS84 decimal-degree coordinates sent by helpers standing at distant markers, review boundary order, and freeze a source-labelled area offline.
• Standalone Tape Sketches: Calculate 3-side triangles and confirmed convex 4-corner + diagonal plots from horizontal tape measurements alone—no location permission required.

FIELD-GRADE TOOLS & HONEST QUALITY
• Repeat Walk & Drift Check: Re-record Corner A to inspect session drift, or walk all markers a second time to compare same-phone repeatability and optionally create a reviewed equal-weight mean boundary.
• Selective Corner Editing & Immutable History: Re-record a single corner in place, insert a missed bend, reorder corners, or remove an accidental point without erasing earlier evidence or rewriting historical revisions.
• Local Area Units: Automatically displays regional units alongside square metres (acres, hectares, square feet, cents, gunthas, decimals, gaj, ropani, rai, sotka, and more) using offline public-domain boundaries.
• Outdoor High-Contrast Mode: Switch between Automatic, Light, Dark, and bright-sunlight Outdoor contrast anytime.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN — ZERO DEVELOPER SERVERS
• All plots, raw GPS recordings, entered coordinates, and drafts live locally on your device.
• Optional Street & Satellite Map View: Every plot includes an offline boundary diagram. If you choose to view map imagery, enable built-in iOS/iPadOS Apple MapKit or store your own Google Maps API key / Apple Maps token strictly in device Keychain.
• Export & Portable Backup: Share one-page PDF reports (with Unicode script support), KML files for Google Earth/GIS, or SHA-256-verified portable backup files (.spotsurvey.json).

EXPECTED ACCURACY BY METHOD (UNVERIFIED ESTIMATES)
• GPS + Tape Side Lengths (Best for Small & Medium Plots): GPS sets corner shape while your horizontal tape sets scale. Displays a provisional modelled 95% range from explicit assumptions (3 m per GPS corner, 2 cm + 0.1% per tape reading, 0.2% tape scale; unverified by field certification).
• GPS Corners Only (30s Weighted Capture): Smartphone GPS typically drifts 2–5 m per corner (more near trees or walls). On small plots (under 0.5 acre) this can shift area by 5–25%, while having smaller relative impact on larger open fields.
• Repeat Walk & Drift Check: Measures same-phone repeatability and session drift; shared multipath bias is not removed.

IMPORTANT SURVEYING & LEGAL DISCLAIMER
Spot Survey estimates horizontal plan area inside markers selected by the user; ground slope does not add plan area. Smartphone GPS positions carry several metres of uncertainty, and our ±2% engineering design target is unverified and not legally certified. Spot Survey does not determine property ownership, resolve boundary disputes, establish cadastral or legal parcel lines, or replace a licensed land surveyor.

name: Spring Water
description:
Spring Water — быстрый заказ питьевой воды с доставкой до двери.

В приложении:
• Питьевая вода 19 л и бутыли
• Кулеры для воды — напольные и сенсорные
• Механические и электрические помпы
• Аксессуары для воды

Как это работает:
1. Выберите товары в каталоге и добавьте в корзину.
2. Укажите имя, телефон и адрес — или отправьте свою локацию, чтобы курьер точно нашёл вас.
3. Подтвердите заказ — мы перезвоним и привезём воду.

Удобно:
• Без регистрации и паролей
• Оплата при получении
• Статус заказа во вкладке «Мои заказы» и push-уведомления о его изменении
• Русский, узбекский и английский язык
• Светлая и тёмная тема

Работаем ежедневно с 08:00 до 21:00. Вопросы и предложения: +998 99 165 99 66.

name: Sprue Feed
description:
Sprue Feed keeps one wax tree on this iPhone.

Tap a pattern, then tap a branch to hang it there. Feed ratio is the wax on that branch divided by section and superheat, plus a thin-branch loss. The named pattern is the largest one on the branch still above 1.

Change superheat and every pattern stays on its branch. Shift moves the named pattern onto the branch with the most spare, and the name can move. Share writes a text summary from this iPhone.

Patterns and runs stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: stage voice rec
description:
Keep your eyes on the stage and capture what matters.

stage voice rec is a focused audio notebook for rehearsals, performances and creative work. Press and hold to record, then release to save. You can also start and stop with a button. On a supported iPhone, Auto mode lets you tilt the device to begin recording and tilt it back to save, with tactile feedback.

EVERY NOTE HAS ITS MOMENT
Each recording saves the local date and time when it starts. Listen back, edit the title, mark notes as done and move between notes with a tap. Share individual audio recordings when you need to.

ORGANIZE YOUR REHEARSAL
Create, rename and delete folders inside the app. Switch folders directly from the note list, or move any note to another folder. Optional automatic organization uses the transcribed text to match folder names. If several folders are mentioned, each receives its own copy.

CONNECTED TO STAGE CREATE 2
Enter the same group name in both apps and enable Send Position in stage create 2. stage voice rec can receive the production timecode and save it with each new recording. Use Go to timecode to return the sending device to that moment while the matching group is connected. Group features require an internet connection and stage create 2 on the sending device.

TRANSCRIPTION IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Optional Apple speech recognition turns the spoken text into the note title while keeping the original audio. The app and transcription support English, German, French, Italian, Spanish and Russian. Choose a language in Settings or use the device language automatically. Speech recognition availability depends on the device and language and may require an internet connection.

Your recordings and note folders are stored locally in the app. Microphone access is needed for recording; speech recognition permission is needed only for transcription.

name: Stained Glass Sunday
description:
A kingfisher rests above a bend in the river. A fox curls up in ember-colored glass. A single pane turned the wrong way breaks the picture. Tap it into place and watch the lines meet. When the whole window fits together, amber light spills across the sill.

Restore 30 stained glass windows in the workshop. The first sun teaches you to turn the glass by touch. Later, a brass link turns a neighboring pane with yours. Silver sends it the other way. Follow a fork through two branches, trade misplaced pieces across a bridge, and turn a keeper to open the way.

Open the pattern book for a look at the finished window, undo a turn, or leave a tricky piece for later. Your work stays on your device. Return to the collection to see the windows you’ve brought back to light.

Play offline, with optional glass sounds, touch feedback and reduced motion.

name: Starry Paws
description:
Fly through space with magical animals! Starry Paws is a gentle, colourful game where a capybara, a red panda, a snow leopard and a panda flap their fairy wings through the stars. No ads, no tracking and no in-app purchases.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag your finger anywhere to fly
• Collect smiley stars for points (pink super stars are worth extra)
• Dodge the grumpy meteors, because each one costs a life
• Grab a rainbow magic orb to turn into a different animal

EVERY ANIMAL HAS A SPECIAL POWER
• Capybara – Chill Bubble: time slows down and meteors bounce away
• Red Panda – Star Magnet: every star zooms straight to you
• Snow Leopard – Snowy Starfall: it snows stars, worth double
• Panda – Giant Panda: grow huge and smash meteors into stars

Collect 15 stars to charge your power, then tap to use it. Fly through five dreamy zones, from Twinkle Way to Candyfloss Nebula, and beat your best score.

GAME CENTER (OPTIONAL)
Switch on Game Center scores in Settings to share your high scores on the Starry Paws leaderboard.

YOUR PRIVACY
Everything stays on your device. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Starry Paws was dreamed up by Eliana. We hope you love flying with her animals!

name: Steady Play
description:
Steady Play is a music player built for one job: keeping your Apple Music library playing smoothly on AirPlay speakers all over your home.

YOUR OWN LIBRARY
• Songs, Albums, Artists and Playlists, with a quick A–Z strip and search
• "Downloaded only" plays the songs stored on your iPhone or iPad, so a busy Wi-Fi network is less likely to interrupt the music
• Recently Added, Recently Played and Most Played, right on the Library home

WHOLE-HOME AIRPLAY
• Play to one AirPlay speaker or many at once
• Rooms shows your speakers and which ones are playing
• Sonos and Denon HEOS speakers: see each speaker's volume and change it directly from Steady Play
• Other AirPlay 2 speakers show when they're playing

KEEPS PLAYING
• If the music stalls, Steady Play notices and picks it back up
• Lets you know when a speaker drops out
• Your queue and your place in the song are saved, so you can carry on where you left off

A QUEUE THAT'S YOURS
• Play next, add to the end, reorder or remove songs
• Shuffle, Repeat all and Repeat one

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Now Playing takes its colors from the album art
• On iPad, a full-screen player with the album art beside the controls in landscape

Steady Play needs access to your Apple Music library. Songs that aren't downloaded stream from Apple Music, which requires a subscription. Speaker volume control works with Sonos and Denon HEOS speakers on the same Wi-Fi network as your iPhone or iPad.

Steady Play isn't affiliated with Apple, Sonos, or Denon.

This is a recreational project so there may be bugs.

name: Stella Poker - Texas Hold'em
description:
Stella Poker is an app for learning how to think about Texas Hold'em while you play against CPU opponents.
Practice on your own at your own pace: no connection and no sign-up needed.

- vs CPU (plays offline)
・Play CPU opponents at tables of 2 to 9 players, even without a connection.
・Two formats: Elimination (blinds rise until one player is left) and a set number of hands ranked by points.
・CPU opponents have playing styles: near-GTO, tight, loose and aggressive.
・Stacks are counted in points.

- House rules
・Choose the betting structure: no-limit, pot-limit or limit.
・Turn on straddles, bomb pots, double boards, run it twice and the 7-2 game.

- Learning
・Hints: when you're unsure, check a near-GTO choice and its frequencies (e.g. "raise 70% / call 30%"). These are precomputed approximations.
・Hand review: after each hand, look back at where your play differed from near-GTO play.
・Drills: preflop and postflop decisions, bet sizing, pot odds, required equity, outs, hand reading and ranges. Results are shown in four grades: Best, Close, Small loss, Big loss.
・Glossary: tap a term in a hint or review to see a short explanation on the spot.
・Lessons: short lessons on pot odds, equity, MDF, the bluff-to-value ratio and mixed strategies.

- Stats and hand history
・See your VPIP, PFR, 3-bet, c-bet, aggression and more, compared with common ranges.
・Replay every hand from your vs CPU games, including everyone's cards, and export them as hand history text.

- Please note
・No account needed. No ads. No in-app purchases.
・Points are an in-game score only. They can't be bought or exchanged for anything. Each game starts fresh, and points don't carry over.
・Your game history and settings are stored on your device. Content is sent to our server only when you send feedback.

name: Still Rosary
description:
Still Rosary is a quiet place to pray the Catholic Rosary, with all four sets of mysteries and no sign-in required.

Use Guided mode to read each prayer, or Beads mode to count prayers at your own pace. Close a rosary to save your place and resume when you’re ready. Keep private intentions, revisit completed rosaries in Journal, or look up prayers and mysteries in the offline handbook.

Read a daily verse from the Douay-Rheims 1899 Bible. Save it on your device, share it as text or an image, or add the verse widget to your Home Screen. The daily verse is not the Mass reading. An optional local reminder can help you make time to pray.

On Apple Watch, pray and save your progress offline without your iPhone. Watch data stays separate. On iPhone and iPad, iCloud sync is off by default and, if enabled, syncs only completed rosaries.

Still Rosary is independent and is not affiliated with a church or diocese.

name: StockTally Sheet
description:
Keep your item catalog and manual inventory counts together with StockTally Sheet.

Record an expected quantity for each uniquely identified item, start a count session, and enter what you actually observe. Compare the result with the expected snapshot to find matched, missing and excess quantities.

• Maintain items with a unique SKU, location and notes.
• Create count sessions with a title and date.
• Add each eligible item once per session and enter a whole observed quantity.
• View net variance and a per-item variance report.
• Close sessions to protect their lines, then explicitly reopen when needed.
• Keep historical expected-quantity snapshots when catalog details change.
• Archive and restore items, share reports, and export local JSON.

StockTally Sheet supports manual record keeping. It does not connect to a point-of-sale system or perform automatic stock synchronization.

Core records are stored on your device. No app account is required. An optional online destination can be controlled by a public configuration lookup; enabled destinations open through the system, and unavailable configuration returns you to local features. External websites have their own policies.

name: Stowberth
description:
Stowberth is a portrait 3D harbor loft. Goods have spilled across the floor. Hang them on a short row of hooks, then seat each one in its cradle before the draft blows the rail clear.

Swipe to orbit the room. The camera is part of the work: some goods sit tucked behind the left side, and the left wall is weather. Face the weather and the draft climbs faster. Face the lee and the keel is kinder. Tap a good to lift it onto a hook. Tap the matching cradle to seat it. Hold a good if you want its name whispered.

Four stacks wait on the atlas. Copper Galley, Ribbon Loft, Token Hold, and Pebble Dock each hold six berths. Early berths are still air, just hooks and cradles. Later berths add the loft's own rules. Twins share a shine, so a vial can pass for a jar until you look closer. A rope seals one cradle until its partner is half full. The newest hook is the echo, and that good has to be seated before the older ones. The last berth of a stack uses every rule at once.

You bring three tools and leave one behind. Undo Knot puts a seated good back on its hook. Kin Whisper names what is still on the floor. Gull Magnet hangs the good the emptiest open cradle still needs. Calm Weight leans on the keel and drops the draft. Each tool has a few charges.

A berth closes in two ways. Seat every good and the calm bell rings. Spill too many times and the cargo goes back to the floor. You can try the berth again, or ease the draft once and give yourself one more spill. Grades are Calm, Brisk, and Gale, from how steady the watch was: spills, the best chain of seats, and how high the draft climbed. There is no star chase and no online board.

Night Tide is a local berth seeded from the date on this device. Tomorrow's tide is different. Yesterday is not stored, only the stamp if you kept one. Stamps, chains, tool habits, and a generated keeper name stay on the phone. Stowberth does not ask you to sign in, type, or connect.

Open on the Wharf Bell and continue into the next open berth. The deck primer and the watch notes are there when you want them. They are not a gate.

name: Stud Gap
description:
Stud Gap checks a flange face on the phone.

Drag one stud off the bolt circle. The chord loses the hole diameter, and that ligament is compared with the bore edge and the outside edge. The stud that falls short is named. Changing the limits does not move a stored hole. A socket that is wider than the neighbor chord names that pair, and it does not move the studs.

Share an English summary or a CSV. A place stamp stays on the iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Studio Daman
description:
Studio Daman is the all-in-one digital learning platform built to guide students step by step through driving licence exams, professional certifications, and dedicated training tracks.

It brings updated official quizzes, HD video courses, and learning resources together in one clean, fast mobile workspace optimized for iPhone, iPhone Duo, and iPad.

WHAT YOU GET WITH STUDIO DAMAN
• Multiple driving licence categories and professional qualification tracks in a single app.
• Translated courses and multilingual study support (Italian, English, Punjabi) so every student can learn comfortably.
• A growing catalogue: newly released courses, video modules, and quiz banks sync directly to your student account.

KEY FEATURES
• Seamless Quiz & Video Integration: watch a chapter video lesson and jump straight to the matching topic quizzes (and back) in a single tap.
• Official Exam Simulations: realistic timer, question count, and error thresholds matching exam-day rules.
• Topic-by-Topic Practice & Error Review: focus on specific syllabus chapters or review the questions you miss most often.
• Audio Playback & Voice Support: listen to questions and explanations while studying on the go.
• Glossary & Study Tips: check key terms and practical notes directly from your quizzes.
• Synced Readiness & Progress Analytics: track accuracy, syllabus coverage, video completion, and study streaks across web and mobile.

FREE DEMO & STUDENT ACCESS
Try the built-in Free Demo right away, or sign in with your Studio Daman account to access all assigned courses and future catalogue additions.

name: SubLens: Subtitle & Translate
description:
SubLens makes subtitles for any video and translates them into the language you want, right on your phone. No account, and no audio is sent to a server.

SUBTITLES FOR VIDEOS ON YOUR PHONE
Pick a video from Photos or Files. SubLens detects the spoken language, turns speech into text and builds timed subtitles. Each part can be watched as soon as it is done.

LIVE SUBTITLES FOR ONLINE VIDEOS
Paste a YouTube link and watch in the official player. While it plays, SubLens listens and writes subtitles line by line. What it has heard is saved, so next time the subtitles are there instantly.

TRANSLATE INTO 10 LANGUAGES, OFFLINE
Vietnamese, English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Indonesian, French, Spanish and German. Each language pack downloads once; after that, translation runs entirely on the device.

TWO SUBTITLES AT ONCE
See the original line plus one or two translations together. Great for learning English, Japanese, Korean or Chinese from real videos.

FULL SCREEN WITH THE TRANSCRIPT ALONGSIDE
Turn sideways for a bigger picture and open the transcript panel to read along. Tap any line to jump there; the transcript follows the current line.

SUBTITLES THAT LOOK THE WAY YOU LIKE
Choose the background, font and text size: Classic, Cream, Black box, Outline or Light box.

MORE ACCURACY WHEN YOU NEED IT
Three recognition levels: Fast, Balanced and Accurate. Switch to Accurate for the cleanest text.

LIGHT ON YOUR PHONE
SubLens adapts when the phone warms up, and Battery saver keeps long sessions cool.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Speech recognition and translation run on the device. Audio is used briefly to make subtitles and then deleted; only the subtitle text is kept. No ads, no tracking.

The app speaks Vietnamese, English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

name: Subways Live
description:
See the railway come to life.

Subways Live brings the clean, colourful maps of subways.live to your iPhone and iPad. Pick a network, zoom into the details, and explore its stations and trains.

MAPS YOU CAN EXPLORE
Pan and pinch through beautifully drawn rail maps. Zoom close enough to read station names across city and national networks.

TRAINS AND STATIONS
See train positions where available. Tap a train or station for details, departures, and service alerts. Open supported trains in TrainsFYI to explore further.

YOUR FAVOURITES, UP FRONT
Heart a map to keep it in your Favourites section. Your favourites stay on your device, and the app remembers the map you last chose.

LIGHT OR DARK
Choose a bright white map or a deep black background, with detail panels that follow your chosen appearance.

MAPS THAT STAY WITH YOU
Bundled map diagrams work offline. Connect to receive map updates, current train positions, departures, and alerts.

Explore networks including New York City, Toronto, London, Paris, Tokyo, Hong Kong, Chicago, the San Francisco Bay Area, Montreal, Vancouver, GO Transit, Amtrak, and VIA Rail.

Provided by TrainsFYI.

Data availability varies by network. Some train positions are estimated from published schedules and may differ from actual service. Live information requires an internet connection.

name: Sudoku Düello
description:
Mantıkla oyna. Rakibini yen.

Dört zorluk seviyesinde sınırsız Sudoku, her gün yeni bir günlük meydan okuma ve gerçek rakiplere karşı çevrimiçi düello.

• Çevrimiçi düello: Aynı bulmacayı aynı anda çöz, önce bitiren kazanır. Üç hata yaparsan elenirsin.
• Puanlı sıralama: Kazandıkça puanın (ELO) artar, liderlik tablosunda yüksel.
• Günlük meydan okuma: Her gün yeni bir bulmaca, seri tut, aylık kupa topla.
• Dört seviye: Kolay, Orta, Zor, Uzman. Kazandıkça yeni seviyeler açılır. Her bulmacanın tek çözümü vardır.
• Eğlenceli 6x6, Killer, Buz ve 16×16 Sudoku ile meyve modu.
• Teknik dersleri ve alıştırmalar: Sudoku tekniklerini adım adım öğren.
• Not, hızlı kalem, akıllı ipucu, geri al, otomatik tamamla ve hızlı giriş modu.
• Hatırlatıcı, puan, seri ve 5 farklı renk teması.
• Açık ve koyu tema, Türkçe ve İngilizce.
• Hesap açmadan hemen oyna.

name: Sudoku Düello: Online Kapış
description:
Sudoku'yu hiç bu kadar heyecanlı oynamadın!

Sudoku Düello'da iki oyuncuya aynı bulmaca gelir ve süre başlar. Rakibinin ilerlemesini canlı izlerken kareleri doldur; bulmacayı ilk bitiren kazanır.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Arkadaşınla 4 haneli oda koduyla kapış ya da tek dokunuşla rastgele rakip bul
• İki oyuncu da aynı anda, aynı bulmacayı çözer
• 2 yanlış hakkın var; hakların biterse rakibin kazanır
• Bulmacayı ilk tamamlayan maçı alır

LİGLER VE ELO
• Herkes 1000 ELO ile Bronz III ligde başlar
• Dereceli maç kazandıkça puanın artar; Gümüş, Altın, Platin, Elmas, Usta ve Büyükusta liglerine terfi et
• Sıralama tablosunda zirve için yarış

JOKERLER
• İpucu: Rastgele boş bir kareyi doğru rakamla doldurur
• Bilgi Sorusu Jokeri: Coğrafyadan tarihe, bilimden spora 4 şıklı bir soru gelir. Doğru bilirsen ekstra ipucu kazanırsın!

ÖZELLİKLER
• 5 zorluk seviyesi: Çok Kolay, Kolay, Orta, Zor ve Uzman
• Her bulmacanın tek bir çözümü var
• Rakip bulamazsan bota karşı antrenman yap
• Not (kalem) modu ile aday rakamları işaretle
• Rövanş iste, sonucunu arkadaşlarınla paylaş
• Galibiyet, seri ve en iyi süre istatistiklerin
• Adil oyun: tüm hamleler sunucuda doğrulanır
• Üyelik yok, reklam yok; hemen oyna

Sudoku Düello'yu indir, ilk düellona şimdi başla!

name: Sukê Sushi & Poke
description: Seja bem-vindo(a) ao nosso novo aplicativo, onde você pode escolher seus produtos preferidos e recebê-los na comodidade de sua casa, com opções de TakeAway ou Delivery. Comprar e agendar é fácil e rápido, economize tempo e dinheiro sem abrir mão de um serviço de excelência. Experimente agora e sinta a diferença!

name: Sundow Pongy
description:
Sundow Pongy is a calm, solo table tennis game built for quiet evening play.

Drag your paddle freely across the screen for smooth, responsive rallies against a gentle AI opponent. No online connection required. Play anywhere, anytime.

Choose from Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty to match your skill level. Toggle ball landing preview and assist controls to learn the rhythm, or turn them off for a pure challenge.

Play in peaceful themed courts including Sunset garden, Sakura garden and Seaside café. Switch the atmosphere between morning, afternoon, night and rain to set your mood.

Customize your paddle in the workshop. Change colours, rubber textures and stickers to make your racket unique.

Perfect for short, relaxing sessions. Enjoy steady rallies and satisfying table tennis moments without pressure.

Features

- Offline single player matches
- Three adjustable difficulty settings
- Optional assist and ball landing preview
- Multiple themed courts and atmosphere options
- Full paddle customization
- Simple touch drag controls

name: SunList
description:
SunList is a simple, fast to-do list that helps you plan your day.

Start each morning in My Day: pick the tasks that matter today and get them done. Everything else waits quietly in your lists.

FEATURES
• My Day – a fresh daily plan every morning
• Smart lists – Important, Planned, All and Tasks, always up to date
• Your own lists with colors and icons
• Steps – break bigger tasks into small ones
• Due dates, reminders and repeating tasks: daily, on weekdays, weekly, monthly, yearly or every few weeks
• Notes for every task
• iCloud sync across iPhone, iPad and Mac
• One-tap import from Microsoft To Do: lists, tasks, steps, due dates, reminders, repeats and notes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your tasks stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. We never see them.

SunList is made in the Czech Republic by a small independent team. We read every message at support@labelino.cz.

name: SuperFrame: Photo Picker
description:
SuperFrame uses AI models running on your device to find your favorite photos, quickly and privately.

Point it at a trip, an album or a busy month, and it studies every photo for focus, lighting, smiles, closed eyes and several other signals to help you choose the best photos. It does the same for your videos, finding the frames worth saving as photos.

Your photos never leave your device. There's no account and no ads, and SuperFrame never deletes or edits your photos.

name: Superhostem
description:
Superhostem je moderní aplikace pro hostitele a správce krátkodobých pronájmů, apartmánů a penzionů. Umožňuje vám mít kompletní přehled o ubytování a hostech neustále po ruce.

HLAVNÍ FUNKCE A VÝHODY:

• Přehled rezervací a kalendář:
Mějte okamžitý přehled o všech příjezdech, odjezdech a probíhajících pobytech. Žádné zmatky v termínech.

• Správa nemovitostí a pokojů:
Snadný přístup k detailům vašich nemovitostí, přístupovým kódům, Wi-Fi informacím a poznámkám k jednotlivým jednotkám.

• Kniha hostů a online check-in:
Přehledná evidence hostů a jejich údajů potřebných pro ubytovací agendu a místní poplatky.

• Automatizace a UbyPort:
Příprava a kontrola hlášení cizinců pro Cizineckou policii bez zbytečného ručního přepisování.

• Přehled úklidů a provozu:
Mějte vy i váš tým jasno v tom, kdy je potřeba uklidit a připravit apartmán pro další hosty.

• Okamžitá push oznámení:
Důležité informace o nových rezervacích a změnách dostanete ihned formou notifikace do mobilu.

Aplikace Superhostem šetří váš čas, eliminuje rutinní administrativu a pomáhá vám poskytovat profesionální servis hostům odkudkoliv.

name: Swearby: Friend Reviews
description:
Swearby is the review app where your real friends decide what's worth buying.

Most reviews are written by strangers — or by bots. On Swearby, reviews are ranked by recommendations from real people, and the recommendations from your own friends count the most.

HONEST REVIEWS, RANKED BY REAL PEOPLE
• Browse what's trending today, this week or all time
• See which reviews your friends swear by
• Everything people spend on: food & drink, travel, fashion, beauty, tech, home, experiences and more
• Verified creators from every platform and every country — filter Trending by country

SWEAR BY IT — TELL YOUR FRIENDS
• Found something great? One tap recommends it to your friends
• Save reviews for later and share them anywhere

REAL FRIENDS, NOT FOLLOWERS FOR SALE
• Friends are people whose phone number you have
• Phone verification keeps bots and fake accounts out
• Your contacts are matched securely and never stored

SEARCH WHAT PEOPLE ACTUALLY USE
• Find products and brands, with typo-tolerant search
• Official brand pages show every review — good and bad
• Brands can never edit, hide or reorder reviews

TRANSPARENT BY DESIGN
• Paid or gifted posts are labeled #ad
• Sponsored placements are always marked "Sponsored"
• Report any review or account, block anyone, and delete your account any time

Swearby is free. Write your first review, add a few friends, and see what the people you trust swear by.

Terms: https://getswearby.app/terms
Privacy: https://getswearby.app/privacy

name: Takat
description:
Takat is a training and food log for your iPhone.

• Workouts with a 3D demo for every exercise, ready-made programs, or build your own.
• Food log with a food database, barcode scanner and fibre tracking.
• Meal estimates from a photo or a description, nutrition label reading and a weekly report, written by Claude, an AI service by Anthropic. Included, with a daily limit. For adults, needs an iPhone, available where Anthropic offers Claude.
• Recovery from your watch, band or ring: Takat reads sleep, heart rate, steps and workouts from the Apple Health app.

Your data stays on your iPhone. Estimates can be wrong: check them before you rely on them.

name: TakeLumo: Video Teleprompter
description:
TakeLumo records you with the front camera while your script scrolls over the picture, right next to the lens. The text is only on your screen – it is never part of the video.

MADE FOR TALKING TO THE CAMERA
• Text in any colour, including black on a light background
• Speed in words per minute – your speaking pace, not an arbitrary number
• Or set the reading time and let the app work out the speed
• Drag the reading line closer to the lens so you keep eye contact
• A framing guide tells you when you are centred and at a good distance

VIDEO THAT IS READY TO POST
• Full-quality recording straight to Photos, up to 4K
• Presets for social networks and for highest quality
• Optional HDR, 60 fps, background blur and studio light where your device supports them
• Retake with one tap; play the last take right away
• An unfinished recording is never thrown away – whatever can be played is saved

YOUR SCRIPTS
• A library of scripts with word count and reading time
• Paste text or import TXT, RTF and PDF files
• Works with a keyboard or a presentation remote

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Nothing is sent anywhere – scripts and videos stay on your device

Questions or ideas: support@micanstudio.com

name: Tala Sensory Games
description:
Tap anywhere and something lovely happens.

Tala Sensory Games is nine calm, colourful games in one endless feed, for kids and grown-ups who need a moment to settle. Swirl glowing light with your finger, pour a rainbow ball pit, set off fireworks, honk at passing boats, hear sirens, trains and planes, splash paint, pop balloons, run your finger across wind chimes and pop bubbles. Swipe up for the next game. It never ends and there is nothing to learn.

Made to feel good
- A gentle buzz on every tap
- Soft, satisfying sounds, no sudden noise
- No points, no timers, no streaks
- No ads, nothing to buy

Good for
- Calming down after a big feeling
- Waiting rooms, car rides and winding down at bedtime
- Fidgeting and stimming in a quiet, safe way
- Little hands: easy enough for toddlers

Works on iPhone and iPad, and offline.

From the makers of Tala, the app that helps non-speaking children communicate.

Tala Sensory Games is for relaxing and play. It is not a medical treatment.

name: Tales in Hiding
description:
Can you spot an owl at a boat race? What about a pair of chopsticks floating in a space station? Pick a book from the shelf in Tales in Hiding and see what you can find!

Start with a picture clue. Look at its shape and colors, then search the scene. Is that a ladybug on the picnic blanket, or a red button? Tap your find and listen for a little sparkle. Find all ten objects to unlock the next chapter. If one has you stumped, a hint can show you where to look.

Which book will you open first?

• The Brass Compass — Peek inside a pirate captain’s cabin and climb up to Cloudbreak Lighthouse.
• Fernwood Hollow — Meet the woodland crowd at the Lily Pad Regatta. Even the tiniest critters have come to watch the race!
• Moonbeam Station — Visit the Saturn Ring Rink, then float over to the Zero-G Noodle Bar.
• The Dewdrop Fairies — Follow the fairies on their morning droplet run and see what’s hiding at the Pollen Balloon Meet.
• The Midnight Bakery — Follow the Braided Bread Walk. Can you spot a little train among all those loaves?
• The Traveling Puppet Show — Take a peek backstage. There’s plenty to discover between the puppets and props.

There are 48 illustrated scenes to explore. Open a favorite chapter again and you’ll get a different mix of things to find. Need a break? Your book remembers where you left off.

Made for curious kids ages 6–8. Play offline on iPhone or iPad. One purchase includes all six books, with no ads or in-app purchases.

name: Tally - Business Tracker
description:
**Run your business. Keep everything in Tally.**

Tally is a simple business organiser that helps you keep track of your money, costs, inventory, equipment and goals — all in one place.

Whether you're running a small business, selling products or managing a side hustle, Tally gives you a clearer picture of how things are going.

**TRACK YOUR MONEY**

• Record business revenue and expenses.
• Keep profit and cash flow separate.
• Track monthly and recurring costs.
• Monitor your savings and financial goals.
• View your financial activity over time.

**MANAGE YOUR BUSINESS**

• Keep track of your inventory and stock.
• Record your equipment and its value.
• Organise business tasks.
• Save items to your business wishlist.
• Keep important business information together.

**SEE YOUR PROGRESS**

• View charts and business statistics.
• Check your weekly, monthly and yearly totals.
• Review your all-time business performance.
• Create and share Tally recaps.

**BUILT FOR SMALL BUSINESSES**

Tally is designed to make managing the everyday parts of running a business easier. Spend less time organising scattered information and more time working on your next goal.

Keep your business moving with Tally.

name: Tango Blackout
description:
I tētahi pō o te tau 1986, ka mate katoa ngā rama o Tango Beach. Nō muri tata mai, ka totoro mai te Haze, he kohu kawa e horo ana i te takutai. Engari i te pito o Tango Pier kotahi tonu te mīhini hiko e ngunguru ana i roto i te pōuri. Nāu tērā mīhini ināianei.

Ko Tango Blackout he kēmu hākinakina pika e titiro ana koe mai i te taha. He pakiwaitara tēnei mō te pupuri i te rama kia kā, pō mai, pō atu.

Te pō tuatahi. Ka ringihia e koe te wahie ki te Tango Generator, ā, ka tū te kahu hiko ki runga i te wāpu. Kia maumahara: ka kainga e ia haerenga, e ia whare hou, e ia taputapu ka hangaia, tētahi wāhi o tōna kaha. Ki te kore he wahie, ka hinga te kahu.

Te pō tuarua. Ka eke koe ki te motokā tuwhera, ka anga atu ki te Boardwalk, ki te Neon Strip, ki te Haze Core rānei. Kāore e rite te whenua ururua i ia haerenga, nā te mea ka hangaia hou ia wā: he tāhuahua one, he motokā kua waikura, he tohu neon kua pōuri, he pouaka, ā, i raro i ngā huarahi he awakeri wai para. Patua ngā mea katoa kia makere mai te Scrap, te Wood, ngā Circuits, te Fuel me te Goo. Kei tō mata tētahi kanohi ārai, ā, he poto tōna hā. Me hoki koe ki te motokā i mua i tōna mimiti.

Te pō tuatoru. Ka tomo koe ki roto i ngā whare kua whakarērea: he motel, he teihana wahie, he karapu pō, he arcade, he hōtera kua totohu, he whare ika i te marina, me tētahi whare rama ka pikitia mā ngā arawhata. Ka huri kē te āhua o ngā rūma i ia toronga. I tētahi wā ka waipuke te papa, i tētahi atu kua horo te papa o runga, ā, i ētahi rūma ka kitea he kōhanga pāpaka. Ki te kitea he pakitara pereki e tūtakina ana i tētahi rūma taonga, rapua he kēna wahie, ka pahū ai.

Te pō tuawhā. Kei waho rā e whā ngā tāngata kua herea: he kaiahuwhenua, he kaiwhakatika mīhini, he kaiwhakaora, he kaihokohoko. Wetekina ō rātou here, kawea rātou ki te wāpu, ā, mā rātou e whakatuwhera ētahi whare me ētahi ratonga hou.

Te pō tuarima. Ka tipu tō kete patu ki te iwa: Neon Bat, Pocket Pistol, Beach Blaster, Spear Gun, Tide SMG, Surf Shotgun, Flare Gun, Boom Box me Neon Sword. He ara pupuhi motuhake tō ia patu. I te Workshop ka taea ia patu te whakapiki ki te taumata tuarima, ā, i ētahi taumata ka huri tōna whanonga: ka roa ake te pupuhi raupapa, ka maha ake ngā matā, ka hōhonu ake te weronga, ka tahu te matā ahi, ka whakapōauau te ngaru oro. Ka taea hoki e koe te kākahu pare kotahi te whakakākahu: ko te Lifeguard Vest ka hanga mirumiru ārai i muri i te patunga, ko te Surf Wetsuit ka whakaroa i te hā o te kanohi ārai, ko te Roller Pads ka whakatere i tō oma, ka whakateitei i tō peke, ko te Scrap Plate ka tāpiri ora, ko te Battery Belt ka whakatere i te hokinga mai o ngā matā, ko te Neon Jacket ka huna i a koe kia roa ake.

Ā, ia ata, ka hoki koe ki Tango Pier. Ka hangaia e koe te Workshop, te Mask Lab, te Greenhouse, te Fuel Still, te Clinic, te Radio Mast me te Armory. Ka piki tō taumata, ka tohaina ō piro, ā, ka whakarongo koe ki ngā tono a te Navigator.

Kāore te rama e kā mōna anō. Kei a koe te mahi.

name: TangoQuiz
description:
TangoQuiz teaches your ear the tango orchestras. Listen to a recording, pick the orchestra, and hear the difference grow from one Lesson to the next.

After every answer you see who made the recording: the orchestra and its singer, the year and the composer, with the leader’s restored portrait. When there is a sourced fact about the people behind it, you read it too, with its source.

• Today’s Lesson: a short Lesson every day, the orchestras you know least first, each one at its own Step
• Today’s five: the same five recordings for everyone, every day. The sooner you answer, the more Points.
• Your ear: a ring for every orchestra that fills with Mastery, from Familiar to Good to Strong
• Orchestra pages: what to listen for, its periods, the orchestras players mix it up with, recordings to hear and couples dancing to it. When you mix two up, hear them side by side.
• Meet: before a new orchestra joins your Lessons, meet it: what to listen for and the recordings to know
• Starting point: a short first check, so each orchestra starts at the right Step
• Live game: one phone or TV plays the recording and everyone answers on their own phone. Made for a class or a table at the milonga.
• Groups: a class or a milonga’s regulars, with a board for the week and the teacher’s orchestras
• Duels: play a friend on the same recordings
• Friends: follow them and see their day
• The League: a weekly league with other listeners
• Your own avatar
• Your streak, with reminders when you want them
• Widgets for your streak and Today’s five, a Live Activity for your duel, and “Play today’s five” with Siri

Play as a guest, or sign in to keep your games on every device.

Multiple choice only. No ads, and nothing to buy.

name: Tap Master: Cyber Reflex
description:
Step into the neon grid and test your ultimate reaction speed with Tap Master: Cyber Reflex!

Engineered for lightning reflexes, tactical focus, and rhythm timing, Tap Master challenges operatives to eliminate emerging target cores before their depleting countdown rings expire. Chain consecutive strikes to build high-voltage combo multipliers, unleash game-altering cyber arsenal skills, and conquer 6 adrenaline-fueled game modes.

Whether you have 60 seconds to spare or want to master the art of millisecond precision, Tap Master delivers an exhilarating arcade experience tailored for mobile mastery.

=========================================
6 EXHILARATING GAME MODES
=========================================
• CLASSIC RUSH: The definitive 60-second reflex race. Chain hits, harvest green Chrono Extenders, and push for record-breaking scores.
• SURVIVAL GAUNTLET: High stakes, 3 shields. Zero tolerance for misses as spawn velocities relentlessly ramp up.
• PRECISION SNIPE: Shrinking cores and concentric rings. Hit dead center to claim Bullseye bonuses.
• FRENZY STORM: Multi-target orbital trajectories and chaotic velocity overdrive for true reflex veterans.
• ZEN FLOW: Zero timers, zero pressure. An infinite flow state accompanied by responsive cyber harmonics.
• DAILY ANOMALY: A new daily global seed with specialized gameplay modifiers and bounty rewards every 24 hours.

=========================================
5 TACTICAL ARSENAL SKILLS
=========================================
Turn the tide of combat in real time with deployable cyber abilities:
• Chrono Shift: Warps temporal flow, slowing all target countdowns by 65%.
• Energy Barrier: Erects a protective forcefield that absorbs misses and defuses hazardous bombs.
• EMP Pulse: Discharges a radial electromagnetic shockwave, instantly harvesting all active targets on screen.
• Overclock 2X: Ignites an overdrive matrix, doubling all score gains for 8 seconds.
• Defuse Wave: Transforms dangerous volatile mines into pure, collectible Energy Stars.

=========================================
THE CYBER WORKSHOP & CUSTOMIZATION
=========================================
• Tactical Skill Upgrades: Advance your skills from Tier 1 to Tier 3 MAX, expanding durations and charge reserves.
• Core Target Skins: Customize your targets with bespoke holographic designs including Core Ring, Hex Grid, Quantum Pulse, and Neon Crosshair.
• Dynamic Visual Themes: Personalize your interface with Neon Cyber, Solar Flare, Matrix Digital, and Deep Abyss palettes with zero-reload seamless switching.
• Orbital Supply Crate: Claim periodic tactical supply drops featuring free Energy Stars and skill recharges.

=========================================
PREMIUM HARDWARE & POLISHED EXPERIENCE
=========================================
• ProMotion 120 FPS Support: Experience silky smooth animations and hyper-responsive touch latency on compatible iPhone and iPad displays.
• Tactile Haptic Feedback: Custom-tuned haptic impulses provide visceral tactile confirmation on every tap.
• Dynamic Screen Shake: Toggleable combat screen shake for punchy visual impact.
• Seamless Multi-Language Support: Instant one-tap toggle between English and Simplified Chinese.
• iPad & Safe-Area Optimized: Flawless layout adaptation across iPhone Dynamic Island, Notch, and full iPad console views.
• 100% Privacy & Offline Ready: Zero advertisements, zero third-party tracking, and zero forced online accounts. Your progression stays 100% private and sandboxed on your device.

Clear the grid. Master your reflexes. Become the Quantum Tap Master.

name: Tape to Tape Hockey
description:
Tape to Tape times your hockey shifts automatically. Start it on your Apple Watch before the game, then just play: no buttons, no taps on a sweaty screen.

ON THE ICE
• Shifts are detected from your wrist's motion and posture. You get a buzz at 30, 60, 90 and 120 seconds into each shift.
• Play time leaves out stoppages, like the game clock does.
• On the bench: your last shift's length, your rest and your peak heart rate.
• A color bar shows how hard you're working, from easy gray to all-out red.
• Hit the Watch three times with your glove to mark a moment to find in the video later.

AFTER THE GAME
• Every game on your iPhone: shifts, ice time and play time, active calories and peak heart rate.
• An effort score built from time in each heart-rate zone, from Easy to Very hard.
• Each shift's length, rest before it, and average and peak heart rate.
• A timeline of the game, with your marked moments.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Tape to Tape learns your maximum heart rate from your past workouts, so there's nothing to enter. Your data stays on your iPhone, Apple Watch and in Apple Health. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Requires Apple Watch.

name: Telepathia: Train Your Mind
description:
AI is doing more of our thinking every day. Telepathia is ten minutes a day of the opposite: a mind gym for focus, memory, dreams and perception, with every result measured honestly.

THE DAILY WORKOUT
A short guided routine each day: calm breathing, a focus drill and one perception exercise. Keep your streak and watch your weekly progress.

DREAM JOURNAL
Speak or type your dream the moment you wake. Telepathia finds your recurring dream signs, links dreams to what happened in your day, and teaches lucid-dreaming techniques with research behind them. Optional AI pattern insights describe what keeps coming back, only when you ask.

BLIND PERCEPTION TRAINING
A structured exercise adapted from 1970s-80s research protocols: a hidden picture is locked in before you start, you sketch your first impressions, then pick from five. Chance is 1 in 5, and your record shows honestly whether you beat it. Every session carries a "Verified fair" check.

MIND DUELS
Challenge a friend: one sends a symbol, the other receives. Scores are kept fairly on both phones.

THE ACADEMY
Guided programs for calm focus, perception, lucid dreaming and intuition, narrated by a calm studio voice.

FUN LAB
Quick brain games for pattern-spotting and gut feel. Play alone or with friends, each on their own phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no selling of your data, no advertising trackers.
- Your journal is visible only to you.
- Private mode keeps everything on your phone.
- Report or block anyone, and download or delete everything at any time.

HONEST ABOUT THE SCIENCE
Telepathia is a training tool and a set of experiments, not a promise of special powers. Breathing, meditation and dream journaling are well supported; perception and telepathy research is still debated, and the app explains both sides. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

FREE TO START
Telepathia is free to start. Optional Plus and Premium plans unlock the full Academy, unlimited entries, insights over time, timestamped proofs and monthly tokens for AI insights.

For adults 18 and older.
Privacy: https://telepathia.si/privacy
Terms: https://telepathia.si/terms

name: Tengri Chess
description:
Tengri Chess is classic chess played by the peoples of the steppe.

Choose two of nine nations - Kazakhs, Kyrgyz, Sakha, Altai, Tuvans, Tatars, Mongols, Buryats and Bashkirs - and lead their armies across a wooden board. Every army has its own costumes, horses, weapons and yurts, and behind each side lies its homeland: mountains, taiga, deserts, rivers and the landmarks of its cities.

- Full chess rules, including castling, en passant and promotion
- Play against the computer at five levels, from beginner to strong
- Two players on one device, with the view leaning toward whoever is to move
- Undo and redo moves, with a full game record
- The last five games are kept; save the ones you like and replay them move by move
- Tap a place in the landscape to learn about it
- Made for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo
- No ads, no accounts, no data collected

name: Termax Tur Operasyonu
description:
Termax, tur ve aktivite firmaları için rezervasyon ve operasyon uygulamasıdır. GetYourGuide, Viator, TurB2C ve kendi satışlarınızdan gelen bütün rezervasyonlar tek yerde toplanır.

Bugün ekranı
• Günün bilet sayısı, kişi sayısı, ilk alınış saati ve tahsil edilecek tutar tek bakışta
• Gün şeridiyle yarına ve geçmiş günlere hızlı geçiş

Bilet kartları
• Sola kaydırın: müşteri geldi ya da gelmedi
• Sağa kaydırın: müşteriyi arayın ya da WhatsApp'tan yazın
• Dokunun: rezervasyonun bütün ayrıntıları

Operasyon
• Günlük operasyon listesi, alınış saatleri ve araç planı
• QR kodla bilet okutma ve girişte kontrol

Bildirimler
• Yeni rezervasyon ve iptal anında telefonunuza gelir

Firma yönetimi
• Turlar, fiyatlar, cari hesaplar, kasa, raporlar ve kullanıcılar
• Bütün ayarlar telefondan da değiştirilebilir

Termax kullanmak için bir Termax firma hesabı gerekir. Hesap açmak için termaxtravel.com adresini ziyaret edin.

name: Terniva
description:
**Plan your tracks. Monitor every run. Keep your railway moving.**

Terniva is a practical model railway management app designed for railway enthusiasts, hobbyists, and model train layout builders.

From designing track layouts and organizing electrical blocks to recording locomotive test runs, inspecting turnouts, and tracking maintenance, Terniva brings essential model railway tools together in one organized iOS workspace.

### Interactive Track Layouts

Create and edit model railway layouts using an interactive track editor. Arrange straight tracks, curves, and turnouts, manage connections, and organize track sections with precise measurements.

### Electrical Block Management

Organize power districts, feeder connections, and isolation points on your railway layout. Record voltage measurements, inspect electrical sections, and maintain detailed wiring reference notes.

### Locomotive Test Runs

Track locomotive testing sessions with timers, lap counters, and route records. Log operating time, track segments, stops, and unexpected incidents during test runs.

### Maintenance & Inspections

Create maintenance tasks for tracks, turnouts, and locomotives. Record cleaning activities, equipment inspections, repairs, and follow-up checks.

### Fault Tracking & History

Mark derailments, power interruptions, and other issues directly on your track layout. Review recurring problems, compare test runs, and preserve a complete maintenance history.

### Key Features

- Interactive railway track editor
- Track and turnout management
- Electrical block and wiring records
- Manual voltage measurement logs
- Locomotive inventory and profiles
- Test run timers and lap tracking
- Derailment and fault location mapping
- Track and locomotive maintenance tasks
- Repair and reinspection records
- Historical run comparisons
- PDF reports and data export
- Offline functionality and local data storage

### Built for Model Railway Enthusiasts

Terniva combines layout planning, practical inspection tools, and organized recordkeeping to help you manage every part of your model railway.

Whether you're building a new layout, testing locomotives, troubleshooting a turnout, or maintaining your railway collection, Terniva keeps your work structured and accessible.

**Design the layout. Track the details. Enjoy the journey.**

name: TextLoom: Cleanup Recipes
description:
Build a repeatable cleanup sequence for multiline text.

Enter text in Workbench and start with Quick cleanup to trim line edges and remove blank lines. Create your own named recipe with an ordered sequence of up to 20 rules: trim, remove blank lines, remove exact duplicate lines, sort, uppercase, lowercase, number lines or replace literal text. Edit, reorder and remove rules to control the result.

Preview the selectable output and its line and UTF-16 counts before saving a named run. Saved runs retain the original input, output and rule summary even after a recipe changes. Search, rename, share or delete these snapshots.

Processing is local and uses literal replacement, not regular expressions or an online AI service. Input and output are each limited to 100000 UTF-16 units. Line endings normalize to LF; duplicate removal is case-sensitive and keeps the first occurrence. There is no automatic clipboard reading or document import.

Core records stay locally on this iPhone. There is no app account, purchase, advertising or analytics SDK. More > Settings can export the local JSON or delete business data after confirmation. Device backups and copies you deliberately share are managed separately.

Online destination: at launch and every return to the foreground, the app reads its dedicated public CloudKit configuration while a white cover is shown. A valid enabled HTTPS destination opens automatically through the system. Disabled, missing, invalid, failed or timed-out reads (maximum 2.5 seconds), or a system-open failure, restore the local interface and existing edits. More > About shows status, Refresh configuration (updates status without opening) and Open website (manual, enabled only for a valid current destination). The initial Development and Production configuration is off (enabled=0) with an empty URL. There is no active business website or reviewer login. Local business data is never synchronized to CloudKit. External sites have their own data practices. This behavior is the same for all users.

name: The Isle - fans
description:
Sync your main screen in two clicks and receive real-time location updates.

With our app, you no longer need to switch between windows; the map and your location stay right in front of you without having to switch the game window to the background.

name: Thread Engagement
description:
Thread Engagement names the stud whose engaged length is shorter than one diameter.

Tap Add a thread. Each tap adds 2 mm. If the engaged length is still shorter than the diameter, the shortest stud is named. A length deeper than the nut is not stored. Changing the diameter does not rewrite the engaged length. The last stud stays.

A photo stays on the iPhone and does not change the thread. Share the call when you choose to. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Three Kingdoms Rising
description:
Remember crowding around an arcade cabinet after school, feeding in coins and fighting side by side with your friends? Three Kingdoms Rising brings that rush back to your phone: a hand-drawn 2.5D side-scrolling brawler where you lead the Five Tiger Generals into armies of thousands and take down the great warlords of the age with combos, dashes, throws and specials!

No internet, no mobile data and no ads. Get together with friends, turn on Bluetooth or a Wi-Fi hotspot and play with up to four players: on the train, camping, anywhere without a signal. One purchase gets you the whole game, with no in-app purchases.

FIVE TIGER GENERALS
Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, Zhao Yun, Ma Chao and Huang Zhong, each with their own combos, dash attacks and special moves.

NINE BATTLES PLUS BONUS STAGES
From Bowang and Changban to Red Cliffs, Fancheng and Xuchang, plus two timed bonus stages. Fire, cliffs, falling rocks, arrow storms, night and rain: every stage plays differently.

EIGHTEEN BOSSES
Lu Bu, Xiahou Dun, Cao Cao and more, each with signature moves of their own.

UP TO 4-PLAYER CO-OP
Link up over Bluetooth or a Wi-Fi hotspot and fight together with up to four players. One player opens a room and the others join.

HARD-HITTING ACTION
Blade trails, afterimages, hit-stop and haptic feedback make every blow land with weight.

ALSO
- Easy, Normal and Hard difficulty
- Touch controls built for phones and tablets
- Fully voiced generals, bosses and story narration
- English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean

Contains blood in combat.

name: TileMargin
description: Estimate how many square tiles and whole boxes a rectangular floor needs. Enter the floor dimensions in metres, the tile side in centimetres, the number of tiles per box, and a waste allowance. TileMargin shows the floor area, estimated tile count, and whole-box quantity. Save results by room, add notes, and copy an estimate when you need to share it. Estimates are area-based and do not lay out tile patterns or cuts.

name: ToneArm: Offline Music Player
description:
ToneArm plays the music you already own — beautifully, and without an internet connection.

No subscription. No ads. No account. Just your songs, on a turntable-inspired player that works on a plane, on the train, in the mountains or anywhere your signal doesn't.

BRING YOUR MUSIC IN
• Wi‑Fi upload: open the address on any computer, enter the PIN and drag your files in. Browse and play your library from the browser too.
• Import from the Files app, iCloud Drive or a USB drive.
• Paste a direct link to an MP3 or M4A file.
• MP3, AAC/M4A, ALAC, FLAC, WAV, AIFF and CAF — lossless included.

A LIBRARY THAT ORGANIZES ITSELF
• Albums, artists and genres are built automatically from your tags.
• Embedded cover art, or find missing covers online with one switch.
• Edit covers yourself.
• Smart playlists: Recently Added, Recently Played and Top 25 Most Played.
• Your own playlists and Favorites, with swipe actions and quick search.

A PLAYER THAT SOUNDS RIGHT
• Gapless playback for albums, so live records and DJ mixes flow as one.
• Smart crossfade between everything else, from 0 to 12 seconds.
• Sound Check evens out volume using ReplayGain tags or its own analysis.
• Built-in equalizer.
• Up Next queue with Play Next / Play Later, smart shuffle that spreads out artists, repeat one or all.
• Autoplay keeps the music going with similar songs from your library.
• Long recordings remember where you stopped, with ±15 s skips and 0.75–2× speed.

EVERYWHERE YOU LISTEN
• Lock Screen and Control Center controls, with full-screen cover art.
• AirPlay 2, including multi-room speakers.
• Home Screen widget and Control Center controls.
• Siri and Shortcuts: "Play the playlist Evening Drive in ToneArm".
• iPhone and iPad, light and dark mode.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your music stays on your device. ToneArm has no account, no tracking and no analytics. The Wi‑Fi server only runs when you switch it on, is protected by a one-time PIN and turns itself off when idle.

ToneArm is for music you own or have the right to use. It does not stream, and it does not download music from streaming services.

name: Toonazo
description:
¿Te acuerdas de cómo era tu caricatura favorita? Demuéstralo… sin mirar.

Toonazo es un juego de fiesta para dibujar de memoria. A cada jugador le sale un personaje distinto de las caricaturas de toda la vida y tiene unos minutos para dibujarlo en su teléfono. Después se muestran los dibujos uno por uno y el resto tiene que adivinar quién es. Las risas vienen solas.

SOLO UNO NECESITA LA APP
• Quien organiza crea la sala en su iPhone y comparte un código QR o un enlace.
• Los demás se unen desde el navegador de cualquier teléfono, tablet o computador, sin instalar nada ni crear cuentas.
• El organizador acepta a quién entra. Se puede sumar gente entre rondas.
• Funciona en tu red Wi-Fi o con el Hotspot de tu iPhone. No necesita internet.

DIBUJA DE MEMORIA
• Todos dibujan al mismo tiempo, cada uno con su propio personaje en secreto.
• Elige la dificultad: Fácil (5 minutos), Media (3 minutos) o Difícil (1 minuto y medio).
• 7 pinceles (lápiz, plumón, pincel, spray, neón, caligrafía y tiza), 20 colores, borrador y deshacer.
• ¿Terminaste antes? Marca "¡Listo!" y, cuando todos estén listos, se pasa a adivinar.
• ¿Estás solo? Practica dibujando de memoria mientras llegan tus amigos.

ADIVINA Y REACCIONA
• Los dibujos aparecen uno por uno, con una pista de cuántas letras tiene el nombre.
• Escribe tu respuesta: Toonazo entiende tildes, mayúsculas y errores de tipeo, y te avisa si estás "¡casi!".
• Reacciona a cada dibujo con emojis y, cuando se revela el personaje, deja un comentario.
• Gana más puntos quien adivina primero. Y si dibujas bien, ganas más: sumas por cada persona que te adivina (más si lo hacen rápido) y un bono si te adivinan todos.

CARICATURAS DE TODAS LAS ÉPOCAS
• Más de 300 personajes en 7 épocas: clásicos, años 80, 90 y 2000, actuales, anime y latinos.
• Elige las épocas que quieras para que la partida sea a la medida de tu grupo.

COMPARTE TUS OBRAS MAESTRAS
• Al final de cada ronda, genera una tarjeta con tu dibujo, el personaje, cuántos te adivinaron y las reacciones, lista para tus historias de Instagram.

TU PRIVACIDAD
• Toonazo no tiene cuentas, ni servidores, ni anuncios. Los dibujos viajan solo por tu red local, entre los teléfonos de la partida, y se borran al cerrar la sala.

Toonazo usa nombres de personajes solo como consigna para dibujar. No está afiliado ni respaldado por los dueños de esos personajes.

name: TooTii
description:
Speak fluently like in the movies.

TooTii turns scenes from films and cartoons into short lessons. You hear real speech, read the transcript line by line, learn the words that matter, and practise saying them out loud.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Watch short lessons built from films and cartoons, with the transcript beside the video
- Replay, loop or slow down any line
- Study each lesson's words with meanings, examples and pronunciation
- Practise speaking: record yourself and hear it played back
- Keep a daily streak and follow your progress
- Book private or group live lessons with real teachers and message them in the app

Listen, read, speak, and talk with a real person.

The microphone is used only when you start a speaking exercise or join a live lesson. The camera is used only in live video lessons.

name: Tornem
description:
Know which muscle groups are still resting.

Log your workout in seconds: choose the muscle groups you trained and how long you want them to rest, 24, 48 or 72 hours. Tornem shows how much time is left for each one and lets you know when it's over.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See at a glance which muscle groups are still resting and when their rest ends.
• Log a workout with 11 muscle groups, even if you trained earlier today or yesterday.
• Get a notification when the rest you chose is over.
• Look back at your history and see the status of every workout.
• Filter your history by status, muscle group and period.

SIMPLE BY DESIGN
• Start right away, no sign-up needed.
• Sign in with Apple to keep your progress.
• Works without an internet connection.
• Light and dark mode, in English, Spanish and Catalan.

No ads. No tracking.

Tornem counts the rest time you choose. It is not a medical tool.

name: Toronto Minyanim Zmanim
description:
Toronto Minyanim puts every minyan in the city in your pocket. See accurate, up-to-date davening times for shuls across Toronto and Thornhill, organized by Shachris, Mincha and Maariv, alongside today's zmanim.

FEATURES

- Live minyan times for the whole city, updated daily
- Shachris, Mincha, Maariv and Mincha & Maariv views
- Daily zmanim: Alos, Neitz, Sof Zman Krias Shema, Mincha Gedolah, Plag, Shkiah and more
- Daf Yomi of the day
- Near Me: sort shuls by distance (your location never leaves your phone)
- Shul directory with addresses and one-tap navigation
- Friday and Erev Yom Tov schedules handled automatically

NO SMARTPHONE NEARBY? Minyan times are also available any time by text or call at (365) 360-4011.

Toronto Minyanim is a free community project of Congregation Ahavas Torah. Know of a time change or a new minyan? Suggest a correction right in the app.

name: TourneyPics
description:
TourneyPics makes tournament photography simple for families, teams and the photographers who shoot them.

FOR PARENTS AND PLAYERS
• Find your tournament and your athlete's game by age group, club or pool
• Reserve an individual, sibling or full-team photo package
• Add your athlete's name, jersey number and position so the photographer knows exactly who to shoot
• Pay the way your photographer accepts, and see all your bookings in one place

FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS
• Your whole tournament schedule: every game, field and time, updated live
• Jersey-number badges with each player's position and how many photos they purchased
• Interactive field maps showing your current field, your next game, and where the rest of the crew is
• Block out breaks, hand games to a teammate, and mark who was photographed
• Push notifications when your schedule changes

FOR PHOTOGRAPHY BUSINESSES
• Load tournaments and schedules, set packages and prices, and assign photographers
• Track bookings, payments and each photographer's pay per day and per tournament

You Play. We Capture.

name: Traducentia: Sworn Translation
description:
Traducentia is the fastest way to get an official sworn translation for Spain, without leaving home.

Scan your document with the camera, get a fixed price instantly and receive a translation certified and signed by a sworn translator-interpreter appointed by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

WHY TRADUCENTIA
• Sworn translators appointed by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs: every translation is certified and signed.
• Accepted by every Spanish authority: immigration offices, courts, registries, notaries and universities.
• Fixed price upfront, VAT included. No surprises.
• Guaranteed delivery: short documents in 24-48 business hours, with an urgent option.
• Delivered as a PDF with a qualified electronic signature and, if you need it, on paper.
• More than 40 languages: English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Arabic, Romanian, Ukrainian, Russian, Chinese and many more.

IT'S THAT EASY
1. Scan or choose your document: birth, marriage or criminal record certificates, degrees, transcripts, passports, contracts, court rulings…
2. Get the price and delivery date instantly.
3. Pay securely with Apple Pay or card.
4. Track your order in real time and download your translation.

GET A QUOTE WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
Calculate the price or request a quote without signing up. Your quotes stay saved on your phone so you can pay whenever you like.

YOUR WHOLE ORDER IN YOUR POCKET
• Notifications at every step.
• Direct messages with our team.
• Invoices and translations always at hand.
• Face ID sign-in.

YOUR DOCUMENTS, PROTECTED
Your files are encrypted, only the assigned translator can access them, and they are deleted when the legal retention period ends.

Questions? Message us on WhatsApp or call us right from the app.

Traducentia is a service of AF Abogados y Peritos Judiciales SLU.

name: Tsunami Fitness & Pool
description:
Tsunami Fitness & Pool — приложение бассейна и фитнес-клуба в Караганде. Здесь можно посмотреть расписание групповых занятий на ближайшие 14 дней, узнать время тренировки и имя тренера.

Войдите в личный кабинет, чтобы:
- Записываться на занятия и отменять записи.
- Проверять срок действия абонемента и остаток посещений.
- Показывать электронную карту на ресепшене или отмечать вход по QR-коду клуба.
- Просматривать историю посещений.
Расписание, новости, адрес и контакты клуба доступны без регистрации.

name: Tuoremura
description:
Tuoremura on tuore seinä kahdella penkillä. Kalkissa säädät raekokoa, vettä, vetoja ja paksuutta, ja luet pidon ja tasaisuuden. Värissä säädät väriä, sivellinvettä, kerroksia ja odotusta, ja luet kylläisyyden ja leviämisen.

Yksi askel kerrallaan. Ei elämiä, ei ajastinta, ei mainoksia eikä tiliä. Mitä kirjoitat, pysyy tällä laitteella.

• 64 kalkkiaskelta — levitä seinä ja lue pito
• 78 väriaskelta — maalaa tuoreelle ja lue leviäminen
• Kirja säilyttää vain sen, minkä itse jätät
• Polku aukeaa järjestyksessä; pidä ikkuna, niin seuraava aukeaa
• Etusivun palaute jää laitteelle

Tuoremura ei kerää eikä lähetä mitään. Ei analytiikkaa eikä mainoksia. Jos poistat sovelluksen, seinä katoaa.

name: Twelve Scrolls
description:
Twelve Scrolls is a Bible game for young and old: an adventure to enjoy together, with the whole Bible to discover along the way, in order, from Genesis to Revelation.

Open the first scroll and step into the days of Noah. Lend a hand as the ark is built, see the animals come, and watch for the dove. When the story is told, turn to the next scroll: Abraham under the stars, Joseph in Egypt, the road out of slavery, the walls of Jericho, a shepherd with a sling, Elijah's altar, Daniel among the lions, the fishermen by the lake, the empty tomb, and the first churches.

YOU LEND A HAND
You are a reader who steps into the story, never a Bible character. The story is the Bible's own, and nothing you do changes it. You fetch and carry, guard and search, listen and learn, and you meet the people the Bible tells about.

PLAY, AND LEARN AS YOU GO
• Every quest belongs to a Bible story and names the passage it comes from.
• Many quests end with a question about the story. A wrong answer earns a hint and another try.
• Finishing an age completes its scroll: the story, its lesson, its promise, and a question to talk about together.
• Sayings from Job, Psalms, Proverbs and the Letters wait along the road, and are kept in the scroll of their age.

TWELVE SCROLLS, TWELVE AGES
• Each scroll is one age of the Bible, walked in order.
• The world is drawn again for each age: its towns, its people and its dangers.

A WIDE LAND TO WALK
• From Egypt and Sinai through Canaan to Babylon and Ararat: a quarter of an hour to cross on foot.
• Towns, camps and wells are safe ground. The wild places are not.
• Quests with several steps, a journal, a map, and a marker that shows where the story goes on.
• Music that changes with the place.

FOUR CALLINGS
• Shepherd: quick and sure with a sling, like young David.
• Warrior: sword and shield, strong and hard to knock down.
• Prophet: frail in the hand, mighty in prayer.
• Levite: a temple singer who heals and blesses.

MADE WITH CARE FOR THE TEXT
• The stories are retold in the game's own words, each with its reference. One short verse for each scroll is quoted from the Legacy Standard Bible (LSB).
• Jesus and God are never drawn. Witnesses and narration speak.
• Enemies are driven off, never killed. If you faint, you wake at the nearest well and nothing is lost.
• Strength is not in equipment. Gear stays plain, and the armour of God is given in the course of the story, never bought.

GOOD TO KNOW
• For iPhone, iPad and Mac. Your journey is saved in iCloud and follows you from one device to the next.
• No advertising. No in-app purchases. Nothing to sign up for.

name: Typewriters
description:
Fold your iPhone halfway and it becomes a typewriter: the keyboard below, platen, paper and carriage above. Every keystroke clacks, the bell rings before the end of the line, and a swipe pushes the carriage return lever back.

FOUR CLASSICS
The 1900 Underwood No. 5, archetype of the modern typewriter. The Erika 5 from Dresden, the travel typewriter of the 1930s. The Olivetti Lettera 22, a 1950 design icon. And the 1961 IBM Selectric with its typeball. Each machine has its own keyboard layout, typeface and sound.

TYPE LIKE BACK THEN
• Overtype instead of delete: backspace only moves the carriage
• Bell near the margin, carriage locks at the end of the line
• Feed paper, turn the platen, eject the sheet
• Finished pages go to your archive and can be shared
• Optional: carriage return by moving your hand in front of the front camera

EXPLORE
• Fact sheet for every machine with production years, design, weight and sources
• “Explore the Parts”: tap the type basket, escapement, platen knob and more
• Timeline of typewriter history
• Original factory colors, from Lettera olive green to Selectric blue

MADE FOR FOLDING
Fully open, you browse the collection; half folded, you type; closed, the cover display shows a compact gallery. On iPhones without a hinge, a switcher lets you change views.

Everything stays on your device: no sign-in, no ads, no tracking.

name: Unprotected Seth: The Game
description:
Unprotected Seth: The Game is free, with no ads and no purchases. It is an original story told in its own world, written by Seth Reiber from his own notes on the road.

In September 2026 Seth Reiber drove alone from New York to Utah and back in an electric car named Eidolon. Somewhere along the way the Bureau of Anomalous Fauna started sending him work.

Unprotected Seth: The Game is a top-down adventure built from that drive. Each stop is an abatement order from HOWL, the Bureau's contract system. Every order is its own region and dungeon, with its own tool, weapon and outfit, and each one asks a little more of you than the last.
