Brew a garlic cure for the werewolves of the Allegheny. Burn a corn-wight nest out of an Airbnb in Indianapolis. Remember, at the right moment, that you own an RPG, and discover that every round comes out of your pay.

Features
· Pixel art and an original chiptune score
· A camera that films everything except anomalous fauna: whatever vanishes from the shot is a specimen
· Dungeons with keys, shutters, pressure plates, mini-bosses and bosses that rarely go down the way you'd expect
· The ledger: the Assessor files your affidavit, and payment is released on filing and not before
· Outfits earned along the route, and Cloris, a severed head in the front trunk who gives rude hints and lies about a third of the time
· After the record: replay any filed order, a filing archive, a register of specimens, achievements, and New Game+
· Play with touch controls or a game controller
· Connect an external display and the game moves to the big screen while your iPad or iPhone becomes the controller, inventory and settings
· Options for text size, screen shake, flashes, a colour-blind palette, and an assist mode
· Saves at every doorway
· Completely free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account, no data collected

Every line of the story is Seth's own writing, adapted from his notes on the road. The Bureau of Anomalous Fauna is fiction. HOWL, its contracts, and its alerts are part of a story told along a real drive. They are not real emergency alerts.

name: Unwritten: Ink Roguelite
description:
The world of Unwritten exists only because someone wrote it down. Now a grey fog is erasing it, page by page, and you are one of the erased.

Wake on a stone bier with no name and no memory. Put on the horned bone mask, take up a blade, and walk into a world being written in crimson ink around you. Every run is a new page: new paths, new foes, new choices.

• FAST, READABLE COMBAT: Dodge, strike and punish. Every enemy telegraphs its attack, and every death is a lesson.
• 30 WEAPONS, 13 GLYPH SPELLS: Cleavers, glaives, harpoons, censers and more, plus fire, frost, storm and shadow glyphs.
• BUILD YOUR LEGEND: Three inks, Cinnabar, Azure and Verdigris, shape every run. Mix them for powerful combinations.
• TEN GUARDIANS: Each boss is a forgotten soul with a story to uncover, from the Thorn Queen to the Pendulum.
• HIDDEN DUNGEONS: Cracked walls, ink-sealed doors and trial rings hide optional challenges and rare rewards.
• A HUB THAT REMEMBERS: Return to the Edge between runs. Forge new weapons, grow the Sign Tree and watch your progress written into the world.
• HAND-INKED WORLD: Every blade of grass is a brush stroke. Volumetric light, ember-lit crypts and a world that fades at its edges.
• MADE FOR PHONES: One-thumb controls, portrait and landscape, short sessions, no ads, no purchases, works offline.

Your story was erased. Write it back.

name: UP2048
description:
Slide. Merge. Think ahead.
Up2048 puts a fresh spin on the classic number-merging puzzle with four difficulty levels, each offering its own rules and challenges.
Swipe in any direction to combine matching tiles, earn points, and work toward your target. Start with a spacious 5×5 grid, enjoy the classic 4×4 experience, or take on tougher challenges with extra tiles and blocked spaces.

**FOUR DIFFICULTY LEVELS**
- Easy – Relax and build your strategy on a 5×5 board.
- Medium – Enjoy the classic 4×4 number puzzle.
- Hard – Face tougher tile spawns and fewer chances to recover.
- Very Hard – Overcome blocked cells and challenging moves.

**KEY FEATURES**
- Four unique difficulty levels
- Simple swipe controls and smooth animations
- Undo, hints, and tile removal on supported levels
- Save and resume your progress
- Track best scores and personal statistics
- Dark mode, sound effects, and haptic feedback
- English and Vietnamese language support
- Fully offline gameplay with no account required

Whether you're looking for a relaxing mental break or a serious strategy challenge, Up2048 offers a fun way to test your planning skills.
Every move matters. How far can you go?

name: Upavasa: Mindful Fasting
description:
What if every meal became a prayer? Upavasa helps you eat mindfully, give thanks before meals, live short, gentle fasts as sacred time and listen to what your body and heart are telling you. No weight goals, no calories: only presence.

MINDFUL MEAL
Your phone gently vibrates at a steady pace: at each vibration, put down your cutlery, breathe and savour. A simple way to slow down and rediscover the taste of every bite.

THE GENTLE FAST TIMER (12 TO 16 H)
A short window, lived as sacred time, always listening to your body.
• 12 h · 13 h · 14 h · 16 h
• Offering the last meal
• Welcoming the waves
• The inner space
• Preparing the return

YOUR SAFETY FIRST
• No weight-loss goals, no calorie counting, no weighing.
• Not suitable for under-18s or for people who are pregnant or breastfeeding.
• Diabetes, another health condition, medication or a history of eating disorders: talk to your doctor first and do not fast without their approval.
• If you feel unwell, weak or dizzy, stop and eat. Stopping is part of the practice too.
• Drink water regularly during your fasting window.

9 GUIDED PRACTICES
• Gratitude before the meal
• The first three bites
• The hunger compass
• The silent meal
• Opening a time of fasting
• Riding the wave of hunger
• Breaking the fast gently
• The inner feast
• The prayer of the empty bowl

FASTING IN SPIRITUAL TRADITIONS
• Upavasa, dwelling near the divine (Hinduism)
• Ramadan, the fast of the heart (Islam)
• Lent and the Desert Fathers (Christianity)
• Yom Kippur, the day of forgiveness (Judaism)
• Uposatha, the day of observance (Buddhism)
• Oryoki, just enough (Zen Buddhism)

YOUR INNER JOURNAL
How do your body, heart and mind feel? No judgement, just listening.

SIMPLE AND RESPECTFUL
• Available in 28 languages, works offline
• Free · no account · no ads

This app is 100% free: follow me on Instagram
→ instagram.com/tom_against_the_matrix

The Sacred Frequency Generator
Accompany your meditations, prayers and fasting time with sacred frequencies (432 Hz, 528 Hz, Solfeggio): the device I use and recommend.
→ sacredfrequencygenerator.com

Upavasa is a spiritual and mindfulness companion. It is not a weight-loss programme, medical advice or a treatment.

name: Urban fitness
description:
- Oficiálna aplikácia Urban fitness 
- Sieť prémiových fitnesscentier na Slovensku s jedinečným moderným dizajnom a špickovými strojmi  značky gym80, New-Tech, Freemotion a Technogym.
- Bližšie informácie nájdete na webe

name: US Citizenship Test Game 128
description:
Learn with FUN! Study all 128 civics questions for the US citizenship (naturalization) test, step by step, just like playing a game.

Meet Liberty the bald eagle. Liberty guides you through every question, one at a time, so studying feels light instead of stressful.

WHAT YOU GET
- All 128 civics questions and answers from the 2025 USCIS civics test
- A story map with regions to explore, and up to 3 stars per question so you see what you have mastered
- Chat-style lessons with Liberty, one question at a time
- Mock tests: Civics test, the 65/20 version for older applicants, plus Listening, Reading and Writing tests
- Listen to questions and answers read aloud
- Practice speaking your answers out loud
- N-400 tools: filing date check, English exemption check and a documents checklist
- Translations in your own language: Vietnamese, Spanish, Chinese, Tagalog, Korean, Portuguese, French, Russian, Hindi, Arabic and Haitian Creole

WHY IT WORKS
Short sessions and cartoon fun help the answers stick. Study a few minutes a day and walk into your interview ready.

MICROPHONE
Speaking practice uses your device microphone and speech recognition. It is optional: you can still use every other feature if you decline microphone access.

NOTE
Some answers depend on who holds an office at the time of your interview (for example the President or Speaker of the House). Always check the official USCIS page for the latest names: https://www.uscis.gov/citizenship/find-study-materials-and-resources/check-for-test-updates

DISCLAIMER
This app is NOT affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by USCIS or any government agency. It is an independent study aid. Question content is based on publicly available USCIS study materials.

name: UT Thickness Map
description:
UT Thickness Map puts ultrasonic thickness readings on an unrolled equipment grid.

Color cells against t_min and corrosion allowance, find the thinnest spot, compute corrosion rate, and drag a patch circle for local stats.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: utt
description:
utt turns what you say into text, right on your iPhone. Tap the microphone, talk, tap again: the text is copied and ready to paste anywhere.

No account. No cloud. What you say is fully private.

SAY IT
• Tap once to start, again to stop
• NVIDIA's Parakeet speech model runs on the iPhone itself, also without a connection
• Understands 25 European languages, English and Dutch among them
• Leaves out uh and um
• Turn an audio file into text, too

FIX IT
• Tap a word to select it, tap another to select up to there
• Replace, delete or change the capitals of a selection
• Find and replace across the whole transcript
• Undo, or go back to what was heard

TEACH IT
• Replacements: tell utt once that it hears "Mira" and you write "Meera"
• They apply to every new transcript: whole words, any capitals

FROM ANYWHERE
• A Home Screen widget and a control for Control Center, the Lock Screen and the Action Button
• Ask Siri: "Dictate with utt"
• A Live Activity on the Lock Screen while you talk, to stop from there
• Back Tap, through a shortcut
• The text lands on the clipboard

KEEP IT
• Every transcript in a searchable history
• Swipe to copy, swipe to delete

The speech model (461 MB) is downloaded once, from Hugging Face, when you tap Download. After that, utt works offline.

In English and Dutch. Questions? See utt.jurrejan.com/iphone/support

name: Value Change: valute grandi
description:
Value Change è il convertitore di valute più semplice che ci sia: una sola schermata, tasti grandi come quelli di un telefono per anziani, numeri ben leggibili e nessun menu complicato.

COME SI USA
• In "Ho" scegli i soldi che hai, toccando la bandiera
• In "Ricevo" scegli i soldi in cui li vuoi cambiare
• Scrivi l'importo con la tastiera grande: il risultato compare subito, in verde
• Il pulsante giallo con le frecce scambia le due valute

PENSATA PER TUTTI, ANCHE PER I NONNI
• Tasti enormi che si "abbassano" come tasti veri e vibrano quando li premi
• Caratteri grandi e colori ad alto contrasto
• Tasto "Ascolta": il telefono legge ad alta voce il risultato, per esempio "100 euro corrispondono a 92 franchi svizzeri e 17 centesimi"
• Tasto rosso "C" per ricominciare da capo

CAMBI AGGIORNATI IN TEMPO REALE
• Con internet i cambi si aggiornano da soli ogni minuto
• In alto vedi sempre l'ora dell'ultimo aggiornamento: toccala per aggiornare subito
• Senza internet l'app funziona lo stesso, con gli ultimi cambi salvati: perfetta in viaggio

TUTTE LE VALUTE PIÙ IMPORTANTI
Euro, dollaro americano, sterlina inglese, franco svizzero, yen, yuan, dollaro canadese e australiano, lira turca, dirham, corone, zloty, fiorino, real, peso, rupia, baht e molte altre: oltre 55 valute, con la bandiera e il nome in italiano. Le più usate sono in cima all'elenco; per le altre basta scrivere "dollaro" o "sterlina" nella ricerca.

NESSUN DATO RACCOLTO
Niente registrazione, niente pubblicità, nessun tracciamento.

I cambi sono indicativi (fonti: Coinbase ed ExchangeRate-API): banche e uffici cambi applicano tassi e commissioni proprie.

name: VanTrack
description:
VanTrack is the maintenance tool for delivery fleets, especially Amazon Delivery Service Partners (DSP). Your company creates your account and you sign in with the company code: there is no sign-up in the app.

FOR DRIVERS
• The daily van inspection in a minute, with photos of what fails.
• Fault reports from the road, with severity and photo.
• Notices about your van of the day and what happens with your reports.

FOR MANAGERS AND ADMINISTRATORS
• A dashboard with the month's spend, who covers it (DSP, Amazon, refundable) and the vans in the shop.
• Each van with its history: repairs, quotes, inspections, faults, notes and state changes.
• Repairs with invoice, lines, receipt and warranty; record the shop exit from the phone.
• Shop quotes: approve, reject, PDF, directions and call the shop.
• Notes with photos and van editing with VIN lookup.
• Maintenance and fleet reports by period, downloadable as PDF, Excel and Word.
• Real-time notices, in English and Spanish.

VanTrack is not affiliated with Amazon and does not replace the company's DOT/FMCSA obligations: it is a record-keeping and organization tool.

name: Varda Residue
description:
فيردا تطبيق يساعد المزارعين والمهندسين الزراعيين على تنظيم أعمال المزرعة ومتابعة الحقول وعمليات الرش، مع أدوات لتقييم متبقيات المبيدات ومتابعة جاهزية الحصاد.

مزايا التطبيق:

• إدارة الحقول وتسجيل المحاصيل والمساحات والمواقع.
• تسجيل عمليات الرش والمستحضرات المستخدمة ومواعيد التطبيق.
• عرض تقديرات متبقيات المبيدات ومقارنتها بالحدود المرجعية المتاحة للأسواق المحددة.
• متابعة تقديرات فترات الانتظار وجاهزية الحصاد وفق البيانات المسجلة.
• عرض ظروف الطقس ونوافذ الرش للمساعدة في تخطيط العمليات الزراعية.
• متابعة خلايا النحل والكائنات النافعة وعرض معلومات مرتبطة بتأثير عمليات الرش عليها.
• تنظيم تقييمات الممارسات الزراعية الجيدة ومتابعة البنود والإجابات.
• حفظ صور الحقول والمستندات على الجهاز وربطها بالحقل.
• واجهة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية.

تعتمد النتائج على دقة البيانات المدخلة والمعلومات المرجعية المتاحة. التقديرات أدوات مساعدة لاتخاذ القرار، ولا تُعد شهادة مطابقة أو بديل عن التحليل المخبري أو تعليمات ملصق المبيد أو استشارة المختصين.

name: VeinFable
description:
VeinFable is a dedicated digital studio for creating fine marbled paper. Float colors in a virtual bath, pull delicate veins through the fluid surface, and transfer the composition onto custom paper sheets.

Shape pigment using intuitive fluid gestures: place drops, pull drag strokes, comb parallel waves, and swirl organic curls. Formulate bespoke color recipes in the pigment mixer and observe how tone density evolves with dilution. Revisit recorded passes step-by-step, adjust stroke width and intensity, or branch historical iterations into brand-new studio studies.

Position, scale, and rotate your transfer window across the fluid surface before proofing your sheet. Experiment with single prints, structured grids, symmetrical mirror repeats, or offset tile patterns. Tailor paper grain, margins, and spacing to perfect your printmaking composition.

KEY FEATURES:
• FLUID PIGMENT SIMULATION: Seed vibrant floating pigment drops and sculpt intricate marble veins using Drag, Comb, and Curl tools.
• CUSTOM COLOR MIXER: Formulate bespoke studio pigments and calibrate tone intensity with precision dilution controls.
• PROCESS TIMELINE & BRANCHING: Scrub through recorded operations with a full history timeline. Revisit, re-tune, or branch any previous step.
• FLEXIBLE TRANSFER COMPOSITION: Move, rotate, and resize the paper sampling frame over the fluid tray with live preview.
• PRINTMAKING REPEAT LAYOUTS: Seamlessly compose single prints, 2x2 grids, four-way mirrored tiles, or offset drop repeats.
• EDITION ARCHIVES & DUAL COMPARISON: Save fluid trays and paper settings as paired editions. Compare live adjustments against saved proofs using an interactive split divider.
• HIGH-RESOLUTION EXPORT: Render master artwork up to 3,072 pixels on the longest side as lossless PNG, or export editable project bundles.
• LOCAL & PRIVATE BY DESIGN: 100% offline workflow. No account registration, zero advertising, and no data tracking. Your creations stay on your device.

For technical inquiries or studio assistance, contact our developer support desk directly at PryzgodaHeggie713@outlook.com.

name: Velqovra
description:
velqovra is a private desk for a small studio’s books. It opens on this month: what came in, what went out, and what the studio kept. Money sits in pockets. Spending is planned with envelopes. Dues and aims stay on the same device as the slips.

Post a slip with the keypad. Names come from the studio lists, so nothing is typed. Move money between pockets without changing what the studio owns. Hold a month when every envelope stays inside its plan and the set-aside jar received its share.

Review splits money out into a ring, a year of bars, and a plain statement you can copy. Study Bearing is a fixed composite shipped inside the app. It describes a phase. It is not a forecast, not a market feed, and not an official statistic. Set-aside is a classroom worksheet, not tax advice and not a filing.

Hale Studio’s sample books are already on the desk, so you can read a full year before you post anything of your own. Restoring the sample from More puts those books back. Preferences, slips, and records stay on this device. Cove Ledger does not use an account, the network, or a cloud.

name: Veranda: Jogos sem Pressa
description:
O Veranda reúne jogos clássicos feitos para quem tem mais de 65 anos: letra grande, cartas e peças grandes, e um toque basta. Sem relógio, sem pontos, sem anúncio e sem conta.

OS JOGOS
• Paciência: o clássico com cartas grandes. Toque na carta e ela vai sozinha para o melhor lugar.
• Damas: contra o iPad, no nível fácil, com as regras brasileiras.
• Caça-palavras: palavras do dia a dia, deitadas ou em pé. Toque na primeira e na última letra.
• Jogo da memória: de 6 a 20 cartas, com fotos ou figuras.
• Sudoku: 4 por 4, 6 por 6 ou 9 por 9.
• Resta 1: o tabuleiro em cruz, com dica que mostra um caminho que ainda dá certo.
• Complete o ditado: "Água mole em pedra dura..." Escolha o fim entre três.

FEITO PARA QUEM TEM MAIS DE 65
• Nenhum texto pequeno e botões do tamanho de um dedo, com contraste alto.
• Um toque basta. Arrastar cartas e peças também funciona, mas nunca é obrigatório.
• Desfazer sem limite e Dica sempre à mão. Nada de "você perdeu".
• Cada jogo explica como jogar na primeira vez, em poucos passos e com exemplo.
• Fundo claro ou verde, alto contraste e baralho em quatro cores.
• A partida fica guardada sozinha: fechou, volta de onde parou.

PRIVACIDADE
Sem conta, sem cadastro e sem anúncio. Funciona sem internet; só o jogo da memória busca fotos de paisagens quando há conexão. Nada sobre você sai do iPad.

Os jogos exercitam atenção, memória e coordenação. Não substituem acompanhamento de saúde.

name: VeriArk
description: VeriArkIdeal for reviewing monthly expenses. Track income and expenditures in USD by account, select a reconciled month as a benchmark, and then drill down from the variance to specific charges and debits. Users can batch-reclassify entries, resolve tagging conflicts item by item, split a single transaction into multiple line items, and allocate refunds back to the month of the original expense. Reconcile balances against statements, match individual transactions, and track outstanding items. Use the interactive date slider to compare cumulative spending against the same period in previous months. Once a monthly report is saved, you can view the history of revisions—including the reasons for changes and the original records—and resume any incomplete reconciliation from your saved drafts.

name: Verilift
description:
Verilift est l'outil de terrain des entreprises qui contrôlent les appareils de levage : ponts roulants, palans, potences, élingues, manilles, accessoires.

SUR LE TERRAIN, MÊME SANS RÉSEAU
• Le parc de vos clients est dans le téléphone : cherchez par numéro d'étiquette, de série ou par client.
• Scannez le QR code de l'étiquette ou lisez le tag NFC posé sur l'équipement : sa fiche s'ouvre.
• Programmez vous-même les tags NFC depuis la fiche de l'équipement.

LE CONTRÔLE, POINT PAR POINT
• La check-list de la famille d'appareil se déroule : conforme, non conforme, sans objet.
• Notez ce qui ne va pas, donnez l'avis : apte, apte avec réserves, inapte.
• Faites signer au doigt. Le contrôle signé part dès que le réseau revient, et le certificat est émis.

COMPRENDRE UN ÉTAT D'UN COUP D'ŒIL
• Chaque équipement affiche son état : conforme, à contrôler, en retard, sous réserve, à l'arrêt.
• En cas de réserve ou de refus, l'app montre pourquoi : points non conformes, remarques, observations.
• Ouvrez les certificats Verilift et les rapports des organismes agréés (SECT, Vinçotte…) lus et encodés au bureau.

Verilift fonctionne avec un espace entreprise sur verilift.tech : le bureau y gère clients, parc, rapports d'organismes et certificats ; les contrôleurs utilisent l'app. Les espaces s'ouvrent sur invitation.

name: Vertxpulse
description: VertxpulseConsolidate your fixed deposits, daily income and expenses, and scheduled payments into a single chronological ledger. A financial calendar displays funds already received, upcoming maturities, and items awaiting reconciliation. Upon maturity, you can link entries to the original bank transaction records, separate principal, interest, and fees, and roll over the principal into a new deposit term. If an error occurs during this breakdown, you can make corrections while retaining a view of the original and updated records. A cross-period principal tracking feature allows you to trace the origin of funds that have been combined and rolled over. Schedule specific dates for payments—such as tuition or housing costs—and compare the timing of incoming funds against outgoing payments; if the same funds are inadvertently allocated to multiple obligations, you can easily adjust the source or the date. Record daily income and expenses on the go, search entries by amount, and resume working on any interrupted settlements or payment drafts.

name: VEXQOSiO
description:
VEXQOSiO is a private workspace for reading and organizing your U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs decision letters.

Scan pages with the camera, select photos or open a PDF. VEXQOSiO reads the text on your device and keeps a draft so you can return to it. Check each condition against the original wording, jump to the source page or open a plain-language guide.

- Search saved letters by name, date or condition.
- Estimate combined ratings and monthly compensation. The chart updates as you change ratings, household details and SMC-K.
- Keep track of follow-up dates, organize notes for claim exams and record symptoms in a private journal.
- Export an original letter or your journal as a PDF when you choose.

Explore the guided example to see how letter review works. VEXQOSiO is independent of the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs. Use VA.gov for official claims, instructions and benefit determinations.

name: VibeOut: Live Café Vibes
seller_name: SUHOB INTEGRATED COMPUTER SOLUTIONS CO. W.L.L
description:
Is it buzzing or dead? Stop guessing. VibeOut shows you the live vibe at cafés, restaurants and hangout spots around you, called by real people who are there right now.

SEE THE VIBE, LIVE
• Live energy map: hot spots glow, tap a pin to peek
• "Hot rn" and "near you" lists so you know where everyone's heading
• Vibe breakdown for each place: dead, warming, lively, on fire

CALL IT YOURSELF
• At a spot? Tap to call the vibe in one second
• Add quick tags so people know what to expect
• Your calls help everyone nearby pick the right place

RACE YOUR SQUAD
• Leaderboards for everyone or just your squad
• Share your code, add friends, see who's out the most
• Earn your spot at the top by calling vibes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No sign-up, no email, no phone number needed
• Ghost mode hides you from leaderboards and turns off analytics
• Report or block anyone in a tap
• Delete your account and data any time from inside the app

Find the vibe. Go out. VibeOut.

name: Vice FM
description:
Every drive needs a station.

Cruise through a lineup of curated stations, then tap one to tune in. Turn on Live Dial for the feeling of catching a song halfway through, or switch to On Demand and pick what plays next.

• Spin the dial. Browse stations without interrupting what’s playing, and save your favorites for the next drive.
• Catch it mid-song. Live Dial simulates joining a station already in progress. It isn’t a live broadcast.
• Take over the playlist. Open a station’s track list in On Demand to pick a song, shuffle, or repeat.
• Set the scene. Choose a city or comic-panel backdrop, import your own photo, change the tint, or swap your Home Screen icon.

Browse stations and track lists without a subscription. In-app streaming requires an eligible Apple Music subscription and permission to access Apple Music. Song availability varies by country or region. Vice FM doesn’t rebroadcast real radio stations or include original game audio.

name: VICTORYMX
description: VICTORYMX Cash costs are allocated based on a "first-exchanged, first-used" principle; simply click on a USD amount to view the specific batches from which it originated. When making a card payment, record the transaction in the original currency first, then update the entry with the actual amount debited once it appears on your statement. Bank statements can be imported via CSV; the system matches dates, descriptions, and transaction amounts, identifies duplicate entries, and allows you to split a single debit across multiple expense categories or currency exchange batches. At the end of the month, you can verify expenses, review exchange gains or losses, check for unmatched transactions, and access historical monthly reports. Before retroactively updating past records or reversing an import, you can preview the specific amounts and months that will be affected.

name: Vinyl Scanner: Record ID
description:
Flip through a crate, snap a cover, and know exactly what you're holding.

HIGHLIGHTS
• Liner notes: facts about the album, the artist and its place in music history, plus a fun fact
• Listen on Spotify, Apple Music or Amazon Music in one tap
• Share any record as a good-looking card

Vinyl Record Scanner identifies LPs and singles from a photo of the cover or centre label, the barcode on the back, or the catalogue number on the spine. It shows the exact release: artist, title, label, catalogue number, year, country and format. When there are several pressings, it lists them so you can pick yours.

WHAT IT DOES
• Cover photo first: point, shoot, done. We read barcodes and catalogue numbers in the photo, then ask our AI when needed.
• Honest confidence: every photo match shows how sure we are. When we're not sure, we say so, suggest the back cover or label, and offer "Is it one of these?" alternatives. We never present a guess as a fact.
• Barcode and catalogue-number lookup for exact pressings.
• Notable pressings highlighted (promos, early originals, limited and coloured editions).
• "You already own this": your collection is checked on every scan.
• Your crate: save records with your own photos, notes and what you paid. Everything stays on your phone, no account needed.
• See prices: opens Discogs or eBay in your browser for current listings. Any values we show are estimates.
• 8 languages: English, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Português (Brasil), Español (Latinoamérica), 日本語, 简体中文.

META GLASSES ON IPHONE
Meta AI, Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses connect to the iPhone app for voice and audio: say "hey vinyl, scan this" and hear the answer in your glasses. The photo is taken with your iPhone camera. The glasses camera and Display features are not available on iOS yet.

FREE TO USE
5 free identifications every day.

ABOUT THE DATA
Release information comes from MusicBrainz, the open music encyclopedia (CC0). We don't show marketplace prices or catalogue cover images from other services. Photo matches can be wrong, so check the label or catalogue number before you buy or sell.

Made by Artisan Reality, the team behind Perfect Pitch and Musician Assistant.

name: Virtual Command Wing
description:
Virtual Command Wing turns your iPad into a remote lighting control surface for grandMA3 onPC. Adjust fixtures, program presets and control playbacks from the stage over your local network.

• Control faders and executor keys with live feedback from grandMA3.
• Adjust fixture attributes with five encoders and Absolute, Relative, Fade and Delay layers.
• Use the command keypad and follow the grandMA3 command line.
• Access groups, presets, sequences, pages and macros.

Requires grandMA3 onPC on a Mac or Windows computer on the same local network and the included Virtual Command Wing plug-in. In the app, go to Settings and tap Download Plugin. An online account is unnecessary.

Virtual Command Wing is independently developed software compatible with grandMA3 onPC.

name: Vivirota
description: Vivirota is a fruit disc puzzle. Spin concentric rings of cherries, citrus, grapes, and melon until every spoke lines up. Clear radial sync boards and recipe rays across four chapters, earn stars for tidy solutions, and return for a daily rotor. Unlock fruit lore in the codex as you play. Sign in with Apple, continue with Google, or enter as a guest.

name: Vizbva
description:
Virginia isn't boring. You just need to know where to go.

Meet VIZB, your connection to events, experiences, and communities across Virginia.

Whether you're looking for a night out, a creative workshop, a networking opportunity, or something new to experience, VIZB helps you discover what's happening around you.

DISCOVER WHAT'S HAPPENING
Explore local events, meetups, parties, workshops, and community experiences.

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Connect with the events and communities that match your interests.

PLAN YOUR NEXT EXPERIENCE
Explore event details and find opportunities to get out, show up, and experience more of Virginia.

SUPPORT LOCAL CULTURE
Discover experiences created by local organizers, artists, entrepreneurs, and community builders.

From Hampton Roads to Richmond and beyond, VIZB is helping people rediscover what Virginia has to offer.

Better events. Better people. Better energy.

Virginia isn't boring. Stay tapped in.

name: Volvelle
description:
Volvelle is a paper time wheel for finding a meeting time across cities.

Each city is a paper disc. Turn the wheel and every city's time moves together under the window at the top, so you see at a glance when a call works for everyone.

FEELS LIKE PAPER
Drag to turn. The wheel carries on with a flick and settles on the quarter hour, with a light tick in your hand for each quarter hour it passes.

YOUR CITIES
Choose two to four cities from a list of 39 around the world. The first is home. Reorder them any time.

RIGHT ACROSS DAYLIGHT SAVING
Every city follows its own time zone rules for the day you turn to, including clock changes.

ACCESSIBLE
VoiceOver reads every city's time and turns the wheel a quarter hour per swipe. With Reduce Motion on, the wheel snaps instead of spinning.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no permissions, no ads, no tracking. Your cities stay on your iPhone.

name: VORA Asia
description:
VORA Asia is a marketplace for physical goods. Browse products in the Myanmar and Global catalogs, compare product details, and save items to your favorites.
Shop your way
• View product photos, options, prices, and buyer reviews.
• Buy directly or use Vora Bot to guide you through checkout.
• Check delivery options and shipping costs before ordering.
• Chat with sellers and keep track of your orders and vouchers.
VORA Asia supports English, Burmese, and Thai.

name: VouchBite
description:
VouchBite is a restaurant guide made only of your friends. No strangers. No fake reviews.

Give every place a stamp: Vouch, Meh, or Pass. Add a one-line note if you like. Only friends you accept can see your stamps.

• See where your circle eats, on one table
• Search real places and see them on the map
• Keep a "want to go" list
• Add friends with a private invite code
• Block and report anyone, and delete your account any time

Sign in with Apple or your email. No ads. No tracking.

name: Voyara
description:
Found a travel video you love? Voyara turns it into a guide you can actually follow.

Paste a link from YouTube, Instagram, TikTok or a travel blog. Voyara finds the places mentioned in it and shows each one with a photo, a short note from the creator, and its spot on a map. No sign-in is needed to try it.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Turn any travel link into a list of places with photos and map pins
- Open every place in Google Maps, or get a ride with Uber
- Ask a question about any place and get an answer grounded in the guide
- Look up stays on Booking.com and find tickets and activities on Klook, GetYourGuide or Thrillophilia
- Save guides to your account and open them again later
- Collect your favourite places from many guides on one map
- Group guides into a trip and build a day-by-day plan with opening hours, travel legs and where to stay
- Move stops between days, take them off the schedule, change your hotel, or rebuild the plan
- Share a trip with friends so you can plan it together

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Sign in with Apple, Google or your phone number. You can delete your account and all your data from the Profile screen at any time.

A NOTE ON LINKS
Book stay and Find tickets open partner sites such as Booking.com, Klook, GetYourGuide and Thrillophilia. Voyara may earn a commission if you book through them. This never changes the places we show you.

Voyara is operated by Biswajit Nayak.

name: VuiMap - Hành trình ký ức
description:
VuiMap turns your travel photos into an animated journey on the map. It reads the GPS location and the real capture time of each photo, groups them into stops, and animates your trip along real roads, ready to save as a video.

PICK PHOTOS FAST
• Photos grouped by day. Swipe across to select many at once.
• Select a whole day, a whole album, or a time range, and filter to photos with location.
• Capture time is read from the photo itself, so photos received via chat apps or AirDrop still stay in the right order.

ROUTES THAT FOLLOW REAL ROADS
• Routes follow real roads and avoid pointless U-turns.
• 9 ways to travel: walking, motorbike, car, train, plane and more, each with its own line style and pace. Planes turn toward their destination and take off.
• Tap any stop to rename it, with nearby place suggestions.

MAKE IT YOURS
• 12 templates: Diary, Neon Night, Cinema, Vintage Map, Minimal, Tropical, Postcard, Aurora, Magazine, Cherry Blossom, 3D Adventure, Retro 80s.
• 9 photo styles: polaroid, Ken Burns, film strip, 3D postcard flip, frosted glass and more.
• Floating particles, arrival effects, intro styles, light trails and film grain.
• 29 music tracks by mood, or pick your own audio file.

SHARE
Export the journey as a video to your Photos, share it anywhere, or export without music to add a trending sound on TikTok.

Try the sample trip to see it right away.

Sample music: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), CC BY 4.0.
The app interface is in Vietnamese.

name: VyraTV: IPTV & M3U8 Player
description:
VyraTV is a fast, ad-free player for your own IPTV playlists. Add an M3U link or file – or simply sign in with your Xtream server, username and password – and watch live TV, movies and series, beautifully organized and ready in seconds.

WATCH YOUR WAY
• Live TV with categories, search and favorites – and Last Channel to jump back with one tap
• TV guide with what's on now and next, plus program reminders – for Xtream providers and M3U playlists with an XMLTV guide
• Catch-up: watch programs you missed, or start the current one over, when your provider keeps an archive
• Movies and series with posters, filters and Continue Watching (Xtream)
• My Shows: follow a series and get a notification when a new episode is out
• Mini player: keep watching in a corner while you browse, and drag it to any corner
• Keep listening with the screen locked, continue in Picture in Picture, and set a sleep timer
• AirPlay to your Apple TV or AirPlay-compatible TV

PLAYS ALMOST ANYTHING
• Apple's native player for HLS and MP4
• A built-in engine for MKV, AVI, MPEG-TS and more – chosen automatically
• Automatic retries and clear messages when a stream is down
• Audio tracks and subtitles shown with flag and language name, with adjustable subtitle style

FAST WITH HUGE PLAYLISTS
• Imports 100,000+ channels without slowing down
• Smooth scrolling and instant search

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Playlist links and logins are stored in the iOS Keychain on your device
• Parental PIN to keep adult categories hidden

Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Turkish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish and Finnish.

IMPORTANT
VyraTV is a media player only. It does not include any channels, subscriptions or content. You need your own playlist from a provider you are authorized to use. A demo playlist with public test streams is included so you can try the app first.

name: Wascon Service
description:
Wascon Service is the field app for Wascon, Inc. grinder pump service technicians and office staff.

• Service calls: log a call, set the priority, assign a tech and schedule it. The tech gets an email.
• Service reports: start a report from a call with the customer already filled in. Record readings, parts and labor, add photos and a customer signature, and email the PDF.
• Pump repairs: tag every pump pulled for repair and track it from pickup to the shop, quote and customer approval, repair and return, including which shop has it and any loaner left behind.
• Customers & sites: every address Wascon has serviced, with visit history, last tech, and one-tap call and directions.
• Manuals: service manuals, wiring diagrams and spec sheets, ready to open on site.

Wascon Service is for Wascon employees. Sign in with the personal Wascon code from your office.

name: WearCare
description:
Care for the clothes you love with WearCare. Choose from four visual styles—Original, Blush, Neon, and Emerald—with illustrated artwork and gentle on-device transitions.

Explore garment-care information and follow supported care sequences with in-app timers. Choose a fabric and stain to see available guidance; unsupported combinations direct you toward professional care.

Always follow your garment care label and cleaning-product instructions. General educational notes are not professional assessment or a guarantee of results.

Optional camera and photo previews stay on your device for the current session. The app does not identify fabric or stains from images. Clearly labeled sample scenarios are available to explore.

Keep the app open while using a timer: background and lock-screen alerts are not provided. Treatment history is not saved in this release.

Create a private workspace without an email or password. Save its recovery key, and use Privacy & data to export local preferences or delete the workspace. AI concierge is unavailable in this free release.

name: Webics Client Portal
description:
The Webics Client Portal app is for Webics clients. Sign in with the email address on your Webics account and we'll email you a 6-digit code. No password needed.

What you can do:

- See what's due at a glance, with your open invoices and support requests on the tabs
- Open any invoice, pay it securely, and save or share the PDF
- Ask us for help: start a support request, add a photo or file, and read our replies
- Check your hosting, email, SEO and other services and when they renew
- Look after your account: business details, people and permissions, sign-in security, payment methods, domains and the messages we've sent you
- Call us in one tap

Built for iPhone:

- A tab for each part of your account, with a native screen for every page
- Pull down to refresh, anywhere
- Lock the app with Face ID if you like
- Press and hold the app icon to jump straight to your invoices or a new support request

Private by design: the app has no ads and does no tracking. Card payments are entered on our payment provider's secure page, never stored by the app.

Webics is a web design and digital marketing agency based in Nowra on the NSW South Coast. Need a hand? Call 1300 932 427.

name: WedgeLab: Golf Short Game
description:
Stand over a greenside shot and decide how to play it. WedgeLab guides you through 28 days of chipping practice, from reading the lie to choosing a landing spot and rolling the ball inside two yards.

Set up your own wedge bag on day 2. Record lofts or club markings, compare measured carry, and practice anything from a PW runner to a 58° or 60° high pitch. See the setup from above and replay the swing for 20, 30 and 40 yards. Test yourself from level short grass on days 1, 14 and 28. On days 19 and 20, learn sand entry and score ten first-shot escapes. On days 24 and 26, choose a safe landing area and score ten tries at the two-yard circle from sand. Repeat a ten-ball specialty set anytime.

Log the number of successful shots and compare results by club, shot and distance. The course works offline in English and Simplified Chinese. Progress stays on your iPhone. Export a backup to Files or iCloud Drive whenever you choose.

name: WeSync: Restaurant Team Chat
description:
WeSync is team communication built by restaurant managers, for restaurants, from one location to a multi-unit group. It replaces the group text with organized spaces for every store.

CHANNELS FOR RUNNING EACH STORE #shift-notes for handoffs between shifts, #opening-closing, the #86-list, #maintenance and more, kept separate for every location.

GROUP CHATS FOR THE WHOLE CREW All Team, Shift Swaps, Servers, Kitchen Crew and any group you need, plus private direct messages. Direct messages stay private, even from admins.

SHIFT CONFIRMATIONS Ask a crew to confirm a shift and see who's coming, who can't and who hasn't answered before service.

TASKBOARD AND TO-DOS Daily, weekly and monthly tasks with photo proof, shared boards for work done together, and personal to-dos with reminders.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE A store calendar with the dress code, your own schedule, and every photo and document shared in a chat, filed by store automatically. Search across all of it.

FOR DIRECTORS AND OWNERS See every location at a glance, follow what's happening across stores, and add or remove people everywhere in a minute.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT RESPECT YOUR TEAM Get notified about shift confirmations, direct messages, tags and tasks assigned to you. Notifications never show what was written on your lock screen.

WeSync is for teams whose company uses it. Your manager adds you, or your company's admin can start at wesync.info. Want to look around first? Start a free 7-day demo with a sample restaurant group.

name: WiFi Analyzer & Who's on WiFi
description:
See who's on your Wi-Fi in seconds, get told when a new device joins, and find out how well your internet and router really work.
Free, no account, no ads. Your device list stays on your devices.

WHO IS ON MY WI-FI
• Scan your network and see the phones, computers, TVs, printers, speakers, cameras and smart-home devices that answer
• Names from Bonjour, Windows names and your router, with how sure each name is
• MAC address and maker for devices that answer (iOS and iPadOS 27 or later; private Wi-Fi addresses show no maker)
• Give devices names, owners and icons, mark the ones that are yours, and see when each was first and last seen
• Get told when a new device joins (in the app, and in the background when iOS allows it)
• Watch the devices you care about and get told when they leave or come back
• Merge duplicates when a phone changes its private address
• "This week": new devices, devices not seen lately, router latency and speed tests, built from your own scans
• Open a device in your browser or in an SSH, screen sharing or file sharing app
• Export as CSV or JSON, back up and restore everything in one file

SPEED TEST AND WI-FI QUALITY
• Internet speed test: download, upload, latency and latency while busy, using Apple's test server, with a history
• Live Wi-Fi quality: router response time, jitter and loss, with a walk test (tone and vibration) to find weak spots
• Measure room by room and compare
• Wi-Fi speed between two of your own devices running the app

NETWORK TOOLS
• Ping, traceroute, port scan, DNS lookup, Whois
• Wake-on-LAN, IP and subnet calculator, MAC maker lookup, Bonjour service browser
• Share your Wi-Fi as a QR code

FIX IT IN YOUR ROUTER
• Open your router's page inside the app, with the address found for you
• Default sign-in hints published by router makers
• Step by step: remove a device, change your Wi-Fi password, check your Wi-Fi security

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• Scan progress as a Live Activity and in the Dynamic Island
• Widgets for your last scan, your devices and your watched devices
• A Control Center button to scan, and "Scan my Wi-Fi" with Siri

ON THE MAC (included)
• Real signal and noise in dBm, nearby networks and a channel graph with a less-crowded channel suggestion
• Live Wi-Fi signal in the menu bar
• Sidebar, keyboard shortcuts and a Settings window like every Mac app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No tracking. No servers of ours
• Scans and labels stay on your device. Optional iCloud sync of your labels uses your own private iCloud, and is off until you turn it on
• Location is asked only to show your Wi-Fi name; scanning never needs it

GOOD TO KNOW
• iPhone and iPad apps can't read Wi-Fi signal in dBm or list nearby networks; the app shows what iOS allows and says so. The Mac version shows them
• Only devices that answer show up; some sleep or hide, and your router's own list is the final word
• No app can block a device or show saved Wi-Fi passwords; the app shows the real steps in your router instead
• Use the scanner and port scan only on networks you own or manage

name: WiFi Poker Club
description:
Host your own Texas Hold'em home game – right from your devices.
WiFi Poker Club lets up to 8 friends play together over your local Wi-Fi network. One player hosts the table, the others join in seconds: tables on the network are found automatically. No internet connection, no sign-up, no servers – just your friends and the cards.

PLAY ACROSS ALL YOUR DEVICES
You on your Mac, a friend on iPhone, another on iPad – everyone at the same table. Each player sees their own hole cards privately on their own screen.

YOUR GAME, YOUR RULES
• Up to 8 players
• Starting stacks set by the host
• Show stacks in chips or in big blinds
• Fixed blinds, or blind levels that rise over time
• Ready-made structures for quick games or long tournaments
• Side pots and all-ins handled automatically

NEVER LOSE A GREAT HAND
• Saved Games: every game is recorded in full – actions, bets, stacks and results
• Replay any game step by step
• Detailed hand history

DESIGNED TO LOOK GREAT
• Clean, modern design
• Several table themes, including dark mode
• Avatars to pick from: characters and animals

4 LANGUAGES
English, French, German and Spanish: switch at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Games stay on your local network. No account, no tracking.

WiFi Poker Club is for entertainment only. It does not offer real-money gambling or any chance to win money or prizes.No Real-Money Gambling: This app does not offer gambling, betting, or real-money play. It is intended solely for educational, strategic, and recreational use, including local network multiplayer without any real-money stakes.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: WiFi Speed Test: Ping & Jitter
description:
WiFi Speed Test measures the internet connection your iPhone or iPad is using right now, whether that is Wi-Fi or cellular.

Tap GO and the app runs four measurements in a row:
• Ping: the round-trip time to the test server, in milliseconds
• Jitter: how much that round-trip time varies between samples
• Download: how fast data reaches your device, in Mbps
• Upload: how fast your device can send data, in Mbps

A live gauge shows the speed as it is measured, and a step indicator shows which phase is running. When the test finishes you get a summary of all four results.

HISTORY
Every completed test is saved on your device with its date, server, ping, jitter, download and upload. Open any result for details, or swipe to delete it. Your history stays on your device.

OPEN SERVERS, OR YOUR OWN
Tests run against servers from the community server list of LibreSpeed, an open-source speed test project. Pick a server near you from the list in Settings or straight from the Test screen. If you run your own LibreSpeed server, at home or at work, add its address in Settings and test against it, including on your local network.

YOUR SETTINGS
• Show speeds in Mbps or MB/s
• Night Mode: a near-black theme you can turn on whenever you like, independent of the system appearance
• Adjust the download and upload test durations and the number of ping samples

PRIVACY
No account and no sign-up. No ads, no analytics and no tracking. The app talks only to the speed test server you choose and to the public server list. Like any internet connection, the server you test against can see your IP address. The app itself sends nothing to the developer.

Works on iPhone and iPad.

name: WillCare
description:
WillCare helps families make sure their loved ones take their medication on time — without calling again and again.

One person in the family (the Admin) sets up the medication schedule. The person who takes the medication gets a reminder on their own phone and simply taps "Taken". If a dose isn't confirmed, the family is notified so they can help.

REMINDERS THAT ARE HARD TO MISS
• Reminders right at dose time, with a dedicated sound
• Full-screen alarm for important medications (iOS 26.1 or later) — rings even in Silent or Focus mode and stops on its own once the dose is confirmed
• "Remind me later" when now isn't a good time, with a clear deadline
• Confirm directly from the Lock Screen

YOUR FAMILY ALWAYS KNOWS
• Admins see the status of every dose: taken, not confirmed yet, or overdue
• Family alerts when a dose isn't confirmed by the deadline
• Send another reminder to your parent's phone with one tap
• A tidy history of every dose

EASY FOR PARENTS
• Large, clear and simple screens
• A "Today's medications" list with check marks
• Follows the iPhone text size, supports light and dark mode
• English and Indonesian

MANAGE TOGETHER
• Create a family circle and invite members with a link or QR code
• Several Admins can manage the schedule together
• Change a dose time for today only or from now on, and stop medications that are no longer needed
• Turn the alarm on or off for each medication

WillCare is a reminder tool, not a substitute for advice from your doctor or pharmacist. Always follow your healthcare provider's instructions.

Free to use.

name: WINK Authenticator
description:
WINK Authenticator adds a second step to signing in. After you turn on two-step verification on a website or a WINK system, the app gives you a new six-digit code every 30 seconds. Type the code after your password and only someone holding your phone can sign in.

It works with any service that offers "authenticator app" codes (the standard TOTP and HOTP codes), and it works completely offline: no account, no sign-up, no cloud.

ONE CODE AT A TIME
• Codes stay hidden until you tap Generate on the account you need
• That code keeps refreshing until you tap Stop or leave the app

ADD ACCOUNTS
• Scan the QR code a website shows, or pick a screenshot from your photos
• Or type the setup key by hand
• Import accounts exported from other authenticator apps, with a step-by-step guide for apps that can't export

WORK AND PERSONAL
• Put each account in Work or Personal and filter the list with one tap

MOVE TO A NEW PHONE
• Encrypted phone-to-phone transfer that works between iPhone, iPad and Android
• A matching check number on both screens confirms the transfer

BACKUP AND RECOVERY
• Password-protected backup file (AES-256) you can keep in Files, Drive or email to yourself
• Keep each account's recovery codes, behind Face ID or Touch ID
• A reminder when your backup is out of date

MORE
• Add a website to an account and open it with the code already copied
• Access that ends on a date you set, for temporary or support accounts
• See which of your devices have each account

SECURITY AND PRIVACY
• Codes and keys stay on your device in its secure storage
• Optional lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your device passcode
• Codes are hidden in the app switcher; copied codes clear from the clipboard after a minute
• No ads or tracking; anonymous crash reports help us fix problems

name: wiwizi - Movie, TV & Anime
description:
wiwizi is your personal discovery, tracking and community companion for movies, TV series and anime.

• Discover & Filter: Browse trending movies, series and anime, newly released titles and genre collections on one clean screen.
• Track Your Watchlist: Organize Plan to Watch, Watching, Completed, On Hold, Dropped, Favorites and custom lists with episode progress tracking.
• Details, Cast & Trailers: Inspect ratings, cast, seasons, genres and trailers in a unified view.
• Surprise Me: Not sure what to watch tonight? Pick your mood or use your taste profile for instant tailored recommendations.
• Community & Reviews: Share ratings and reviews, react to posts, follow users and unlock badges & avatar frames.
• Synced Across Web & iOS: Everything stays synced with your wiwizi.com account.

name: Wool Face
description:
Wool Face checks a cold-pipe jacket.

Drag the outer wool. Heat through each layer, then the still air, decides the face temperature. The outer layer is named when that face is below the dew point. Changing the dew point does not rewrite stored thicknesses.

Share an English layer list. A spoken note stays on the iPhone and is not part of the temperature. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Worth: Local Finds
description:
Find your next local food spot with Worth.

Explore an initial selection of three Orlando restaurants, compare source-matched license information, read community opinions, and save places to revisit. Open a place for more details and share it with others.

Worth separates official-source information from community opinions. A license match is not a safety rating; inspection records may be unavailable. Photos are illustrative and do not necessarily depict the listed venue. Source dates and limitations appear in the app.

Location is optional. Saved places and blocked-reviewer preferences stay on your device. You can report reviews and block reviewers from a place’s detail page.

This first release has limited coverage and does not guarantee venue availability, current inspection results, or live prices. Confirm current details directly with a venue before travelling or purchasing.

name: yBlog
description:
Smart glasses are the next big platform. yBlog tells you which ones are actually worth it, with data, not hype.

We are an independent lab. We open every device, measure it on our bench and publish the numbers behind every score. No paid placements, no copy-pasted spec sheets.

TEARDOWNS DOWN TO THE BOARD
• Internal architecture, sensors, chips and build quality
• Bill of Materials and design trade-offs explained
• Hardware limits vs. software bugs: we tell you which is which

REVIEWS BUILT ON MEASUREMENTS
• Battery over a real 12-hour day
• Display brightness measured in nits
• AI and voice latency, audio, camera and BLE stability
• Companion apps and SDKs tested from a developer's point of view
• Video reviews you can watch right in the app

YSTORE: TESTED FIRST, THEN LISTED
• Like-new smart glasses and AR devices at lower prices
• Every unit goes through our lab: condition, battery health, lab hours
• Delivery in the EU, UK and US, 14-day returns
• Track your orders in the app

YBOOST AND YCOIN
Share yBlog with the community, earn yCoin and spend them as a discount on the yStore.

NEVER MISS A TEARDOWN
• Push notifications when a new review drops
• Newsletter with subscriber-only discounts
• Right now: a personal 25% code and the Christmas draw for Dymesty AI smart glasses

Whether you are about to buy your first pair of AI glasses, you build apps for XR, or you just love opening gadgets, yBlog is your lab in your pocket.

yBlog is made by Ycommy Ltd · ycommy.blog

name: Yen Win: Football Auction
description:
Yen Win turns football management into a blind auction.

Each lot shows only a national flag or a club crest. Win the bid and you get the surprise player inside. Your budget is limited and your squad has 14 spots (11 starters + 3 subs): every bid is a risk, every pass an opportunity.

HOW TO PLAY
• Auction: Bid against your opponent on the same lots. Bronze, Silver, Gold and Elite tiers give you a hint; Black Box lots reveal nothing.
• Formation: When your squad is complete, choose 4-4-2, 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1 or 5-3-2. 4-3-3, 4-2-3-1 and 5-3-2 each beat one of the others; 4-4-2 is the balanced, safe choice.
• Lineup: Place your players on the pitch. Players in their natural position play at full strength; out of position they lose power. Neighbours from the same nation or club build chemistry.
• Match: The match is simulated from team strength in seconds. Goals, possession and the player of the match appear instantly.

JOKERS
Pick two per match from Scout, Discount, Freeze, Spy, Captain and Versatile. Win matches to earn more.

YOUR OWN STAR
Create your own player, train them with points earned from matches, teach new positions and bring them into your squad.

• Online 1v1 matches, about 5 minutes
• 10 languages
• No account needed, no ads

All player and club names in the game are fictional.

name: YSIE 2
description:
YSIE 2 turns what you already say into Spanish lessons.

Record a conversation in the app, or share a voice note you sent on WhatsApp. Within 24 hours we show you the ideas you could practice. You choose the ones you want, and each one arrives in the app as an audio lesson of about 12 minutes, in Mexican Spanish.

HOW IT WORKS
• You hear a phrase in Spanish, pause, and say it out loud.
• Each phrase is built up from the end, the way people really learn to speak.
• Every lesson is yours for 3 days of practice.
• Lessons are saved on your phone and play without internet.

PRICE
The app is free to download. Each lesson is a one-time purchase of $1.99 USD (priced by Apple in your local currency). There is no subscription.

ADULTS ONLY (18+)
Lessons are prerecorded: there is no live tutor and no pronunciation correction. Scripts are written with AI and spoken by synthetic voices. If you record someone else, ask for their permission first.

Spanish in your own words.

name: YUANX SE
description: YUANX SEDesigned for bookkeeping within personal or professional financial management, this system allows you to enter income and expense notes into a quick-entry log. You first verify the purpose, amount, and account, then select the specific category for the entry. For transactions like course fees paid via multiple methods, you can allocate the total across different items while tracking the difference between the actual total paid and the original amount. Transfers between your own accounts are recorded as both an outflow and an inflow. Refunds can be logged immediately and subsequently linked to the original payment. Pending or estimated amounts remain in your financial plan, with balances updated only when the actual transaction occurs. A personal dictionary feature lets you assign specific accounts or categories to frequently used shorthand terms. When you need to review past records, you can locate the original entry from your transaction history, search for specific batches using keywords, amounts, or accounts, and visualize balance trends alongside the composition of your expenses.

name: Yuppi – Enjoy your phone
description:
Yuppi helps you free up iPhone and iPad storage without losing anything important.

CLEAN UP: I SUGGEST, YOU DECIDE
Yuppi finds duplicates, similar photos, bursts and old screenshots and suggests what to remove. In each similar series it already keeps the best shot, the sharpest and best exposed. Tap a photo to see it large, zoom in, and choose KEEP or REMOVE.

LIGHTER VIDEOS
4K and slow-motion videos take a lot of space. Yuppi compresses them to 1080p HEVC: they stay in your library with the same date and place, you compare before and after, and you delete the original only if you're happy.

WHAT'S SAFE IN ICLOUD
If you use iCloud Photos with "Optimize Storage", see what exists only on your device and what is already safe in the cloud. Yuppi recommends the right iCloud plan, or tells you when a flash drive is enough.

MOVE TO A FLASH DRIVE OR SSD
Connect a drive: Yuppi shows your largest items, copies them sorted by year and month, checks they arrived intact, and only then asks whether to remove them from your device.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
• The analysis runs on your iPhone or iPad: no photo is uploaded anywhere.
• No account, no ads, no subscriptions.
• It never deletes anything on its own: you always decide, and photos stay 30 days in "Recently Deleted".

A SURPRISE FOR TRAVELERS
Yuppi hides a secret feature for trips: before you leave it checks you have enough space, and when you're back it reminds you to tidy up your photos. Can you find it?

One purchase, forever.

name: YY6 Coil Courier
description:
Touch and drag to pull the marble along a route. Change a coil to repel, combine two fields to trim your momentum, and share the heat between your hands. A held damper helps you settle into the final socket.

Explore 24 main routes and eight Night Dispatch challenges. Learn with live lessons, adjust a practice field in the workshop, or place your own checkpoints in Route Plotter. Your badges and recorded paths stay on your device.

An English, portrait physics puzzle with all content included. No accounts, advertisements, purchases or network connection are required.

name: Zaku’s Lightning Circuit
description:
Rotate wire tiles clockwise to connect the power source to every lamp. When the circuit is ready, tap Strike and watch Zaku send lightning down the line.

Pick any of 500 stages across 100 districts. Beat the countdown, undo a turn or reset the board and try again. From stage 201, spare parts add a twist: you don’t need every tile. Later boards grow to 9 × 7.

Play in English, Japanese, Spanish, Portuguese or Korean, including Zaku’s dialogue and every repair request. The game follows your device language by default. Use the gear on the home screen to switch at any time. Your progress and preferences stay on your device. No account required.

name: ZeliAsetma
description: When reconciling personal expenses at the end of the month, you can combine expenses from two different periods to trace the difference between the number of trips, the average price per trip, or a specific expense. For daily expense tracking, first select the activity, then enter the amount. Transportation and parking fees for the same trip can be combined, and the number of trips covered by a single deduction can be added later. Opening the amount range will show the original transaction history; combining this with the median will help determine your typical spending. When encountering refunds across periods, you can check the arrival date in your account and also return to the original activity to view the net cost. Save frequently checked items as a file; after adding or organizing them, you can view the changes in the numbers item by item.

name: Zero SST
description:
Zero SST es una aplicación móvil para gestionar actividades operativas y técnicas en campo de forma organizada y segura.

Permite consultar información de clientes, revisar órdenes de servicio, registrar actividades, diligenciar inspecciones preoperacionales, documentar condiciones de seguridad y sincronizar la información con la empresa.

Con Electro, los equipos de trabajo pueden realizar sus labores con mayor agilidad, mantener registros actualizados y facilitar el seguimiento de cada servicio desde cualquier lugar.

name: Кладка
description:
Кладка — головоломка с кирпичами на поле 6×6. Перетаскивай фигуры, собирай полные ряды и столбцы — и они разлетаются на кирпичи.

КАК ИГРАТЬ
• Внизу всегда три фигуры — ставь их на поле в любом порядке
• Полный ряд или столбец выбивается
• Несколько рядов сразу и серия подряд умножают очки
• Игра кончается, когда ни одна фигура больше не помещается

140 ТУПЫХ ФРАЗ
После каждого хода игра что-нибудь говорит: «Коч-коч, братан!», «Танцуй, пантера!», «Тунг-тунг-тунг, сахур!», «Я не тупой, я стена», «Два плюс два — кирпич» и ещё больше сотни максимально тупых фраз. Под некоторые кладка пускается в пляс.

УДОБНО
• Фигура сама встаёт на ближайшее свободное место — целиться не нужно
• iPhone и iPad; на iPad играть можно в любом положении экрана
• Без рекламы, без покупок, без интернета
• Партия и рекорд сохраняются

В фразах есть грубоватый юмор. Голоса озвучены синтезом речи.

name: СМАРТУЧЕТ Касса
description:
СМАРТУЧЕТ Касса — касса для кафе, кофеен, фастфуда и кондитерских на планшете. Работает с облачным сервисом учёта СМАРТУЧЕТ: меню, техкарты, склад и отчёты настраиваются в личном кабинете на смартучет.рф, а касса на планшете принимает заказы.

• Заказы в зал, с собой и на доставку, модификаторы и заметки для кухни.
• Оплата наличными, картой, СБП и смешанная, оплата позже, скидки и бонусы гостей.
• Кассовые смены с пересчётом наличных и Z-отчётом.
• Печать чека и бегунков для кухни и бара на сетевой термопринтер.
• Работа без интернета: заказы копятся на планшете и уходят в облако, когда связь вернётся.
• Тот же планшет может стать экраном кухни или табло выдачи заказов.

Для работы нужен аккаунт СМАРТУЧЕТ. Зарегистрируйтесь на смартучет.рф, создайте точку продаж и подключите планшет кодом из раздела «Устройства точки».

Чеки через онлайн-кассу (ККТ) пробивает Windows-версия кассы; приложение на планшете их не печатает.

name: Твої Шахи
description:
Твої Шахи — шахи, що завжди з вами. Грайте проти комп’ютера будь-де: у дорозі, в літаку чи там, де немає зв’язку. Інтернет не потрібен.

ДЛЯ НОВАЧКІВ І ДОСВІДЧЕНИХ
• Тренувальна партія: легкий суперник, поради тренера під час гри й необмежене скасування ходів
• Розділ «Як грати» з наочними діаграмами: як ходить кожна фігура, рокіровка, взяття на проході, перетворення пішака, шах, мат і нічия
• 6 рівнів складності — від новачка до майстра

ЗРУЧНА ГРА
• Торкніться фігури, щоб побачити можливі ходи, або перетягніть її
• Підказка найкращого ходу
• Скасування ходу, пропозиція нічиєї, здача
• Шаховий годинник: 3, 5, 10 хвилин або 15 + 10
• Список ходів у стандартній шаховій нотації
• Автозбереження: продовжуйте партію будь-коли
• Повні правила шахів, зокрема трикратний повтор позиції та правило 50 ходів

ВАШ СТИЛЬ
• Чотири теми дошки
• Звукові ефекти та вібровідгук (їх можна вимкнути)
• Українська й англійська мови

ПОВАГА ДО ВАС
• Без реклами
• Без акаунтів і реєстрації
• Без збору даних: усе зберігається лише на вашому пристрої
• Безкоштовно

Якщо гра вам до душі, ви можете підтримати розробку кнопкою «Підтримати проєкт» в налаштуваннях. Це добровільно і нічого не змінює в грі.

name: Твої Шашки
description:
Твої Шашки — класична гра, яка працює без інтернету.

• Чотири варіанти правил: українські, бразильські, англійські та міжнародні 10×10
• Гра проти комп'ютера з п'ятьма рівнями складності або удвох на одному пристрої
• Підсвітка допустимих ходів і обов'язкових взять
• Підказки та скасування ходу
• Журнал ходів і повтор партії
• Три теми дошки: класична, нічна, дерево
• Українська та англійська мови
• Гра не збирає ваших даних

name: חיפוש מק״טים
description:
חיפוש מק״טים – קטלוג ציוד רפואי שנועד להקל על עבודתם של חובשים, אח"מים ונגדי רפואה

האפליקציה מאפשרת לאתר ציוד רפואי במהירות, לזהות פריטים באמצעות תמונות וליצור רשימות הזמנה בצורה פשוטה ונוחה.

מה האפליקציה כוללת?

• קטלוג הכולל אלפי פריטים, ערכות וטבלאות.
• חיפוש לפי שם או מק״ט.
• מאות תמונות לזיהוי ציוד רפואי.
• הגדלת תמונות לצפייה בפרטים.
• העתקת מק״טים בלחיצה אחת.
• שמירת פריטים במועדפים.
• היסטוריית חיפושים ופריטים שנצפו.
• יצירת רשימות הזמנה הכוללות מק״טים וכמויות.
• דירוג תוצאות חיפוש לפי רלוונטיות ופופולריות.
• אפשרות להציע תיקונים, פריטים חדשים ותמונות.

האפליקציה זמינה בחינם, בעברית ובממשק נוח המותאם לשימוש יומיומי ובשטח.

האפליקציה היא מיזם עצמאי ואינה אפליקציה רשמית של צה״ל. היא מיועדת לאיתור ציוד ומק״טים בלבד ואינה מספקת ייעוץ רפואי או הנחיות טיפול.

name: المسبحة - أذكار وتسبيح
description:
المسبحة — رفيقك في الذكر والتسبيح، بتصميم هادئ وأذكار كاملة من «حصن المسلم».

◆ تسبيح والشاشة مقفلة
ثبّت أي ورد أو المسبحة على شاشة القفل، وأكمل ذكرك دون أن تفتح الهاتف:
• على أندرويد: كل ضغطة على زر رفع الصوت أو خفضه تسبيحة، حتى والشاشة مطفأة، والذكر والعدّاد ظاهران في إشعار على شاشة القفل.
• على آيفون: لوحة على شاشة القفل والجزيرة الديناميكية؛ المسها في أي مكان لتسبّح.

◆ رجّة عند الوصول للعدد
حدّد العدد الذي تريده (٣٣، ٩٩، ١٠٠، ١٠٠٠ أو أي رقم) فيهتزّ الهاتف عند بلوغه، فلا تحتاج للنظر إلى الشاشة.

◆ أذكار كاملة بلا نقص
• أذكار الصباح • أذكار المساء • أذكار بعد الصلاة • أذكار النوم • أذكار الاستيقاظ • أذكار منوعة
مع عدد التكرار لكل ذكر، وفضله، ومن أخرجه. ينتقل التطبيق تلقائياً إلى الذكر التالي حين تُكمل عدده.

◆ مسبحة حرة
اختر الذكر أو اكتب ذكرك الخاص، وحدد الهدف، وتابع عدد الدورات.

◆ إحصائيات متراكمة
تُحفظ كل تسبيحة: مجموعك منذ البداية، واليوم، والأسبوع، والشهر، والأيام المتتالية، وأفضل يوم، وعدد مرات إتمام كل ورد، وأكثر ما سبّحت به.

◆ خصوصيتك محفوظة
بلا حساب، بلا إعلانات، بلا إنترنت. كل بياناتك تبقى على جهازك فقط.

name: تنزيلات - Tanzilat
description:
Tanzilat is your shopping companion for finding savings across the stores you already love. Made for shoppers in Saudi Arabia and the Gulf, it brings coupons, deals and gift cards together in one place, in Arabic and English, so you don't have to search store by store. Whether you're ordering dinner, refreshing your wardrobe, topping up a game or planning a trip, open Tanzilat first and check what you can save. It is a discovery app: you find the offer here, then finish your purchase on the store's own website or app.
  
  WHAT YOU CAN DO 
  • Browse coupons, deals and gift cards, each with its own tab
  • Copy a coupon code with one tap, then open the store to use it 
  • Explore offers by store or by category, such as restaurants, fashion, groceries, travel and more 
  • Search for a store or a code 
  • See expiry dates so you know what's still valid 
  • Use the app in Arabic or English, with full right-to-left support
  
  LOG IN FOR MORE Browsing is open to everyone. Log in with your phone number to unlock more coupons, deals and special offers. You can sign out or delete your account at any time from Settings.
  
  FRESH, SEASONAL EXPERIENCE Look out for special offers and themed screens during holidays and festivals, with no app update needed.
  
  GOOD TO KNOW 
  • Tanzilat doesn't sell products and doesn't take payments in the app. Offers open on the store's own website or app. 
  • Some links may be affiliate links, which means we may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
  • Store names and logos belong to their owners. Tanzilat isn't affiliated with or endorsed by the stores shown. 
  • Offer availability, prices and codes are set by the stores and can change or expire at any time.

  Support: https://tanzilat.shop/support.html 
  Privacy Policy: https://tanzilat.shop/privacy.html
  Disclaimer  :  https://tanzilat.shop/disclaimer.html

name: د غسان الترجمان
description:
د غسان الترجمان يساعدك على طلب مواعيدك لدى العيادة ومتابعة حالتها من مكان واحد.

اختر اليوم والساعة من الأوقات المتاحة وأرسل طلب الموعد إلى العيادة. يبقى طلب الحجز بانتظار الموافقة حتى تؤكده العيادة، ويمكنك متابعة القبول أو الرفض أو الوقت البديل المقترح وإلغاء الموعد من التطبيق.

سجّل الدخول بالبريد الإلكتروني أو باستخدام Apple أو Google. بعد تأكيد البريد أو الدخول عبر مزود الحساب، يُجهّز حسابك تلقائياً دون انتظار موافقة إدارية على التسجيل.

يعرض التطبيق الحجوزات وحالتها وبيانات حساب الوصول فقط. لا يعرض الملفات السريرية أو الصور أو المرفقات أو الحسابات المالية، ولا يقدم تشخيصاً أو إرشادات علاجية.

يمكنك إدارة حسابك وتسجيل الخروج وطلب حذف حساب الوصول من صفحة حسابي. راجع سياسة الخصوصية للتفاصيل المتعلقة بالبيانات والسجلات التي تحتفظ بها العيادة.

name: دلني: أرسل عنوانك للمندوب
description:
المندوب سألك: وين البيت؟
بدل ما ترسل لوكيشن، وبعدين صورة، وبعدين تشرح بالصوت… دلني يرسل كل شي برسالة وحدة.

احفظ بيتك مرة وحدة:
• الموقع على الخريطة، أو الصق رابط قوقل ماب
• صورة الباب وسهم يوضّح وين بالضبط
• رقم البيت، الدور، الشقة، والعنوان الوطني
• تعليمات جاهزة: اتصل علي إذا وصلت، خلّ الطلب عند الباب، اطلع بالمصعد…

وبعدها بضغطة:
• من كيبورد دلني داخل الواتساب: اضغط «بيتي» والرسالة تنكتب بروحها
• أو من التطبيق: أرسل كرت العنوان مع رابط الخريطة لأي تطبيق

الرسالة بالعربي والإنجليزي، عشان أي سائق يفهمها.

خصوصيتك أولاً:
• كل شي محفوظ في جوالك بس، بدون حسابات
• ما نجمع أي بيانات
• الكيبورد ما يقرأ ولا يحفظ اللي تكتبه

بيتك، بيت أهلك، الدوام، الاستراحة… كلها جاهزة للمندوب.

name: مساعد الفلاح
description:
مساعد الفلاح هو تطبيق زراعي متكامل يعمل محليا بالكامل على هاتفك دون الحاجة إلى تسجيل دخول أو اتصال بالإنترنت، لمساعدة المزارع على تنظيم الحقول ومتابعة عمليات الري والتسميد والمصروفات طوال الموسم بدقة.

أبرز المميزات:

1. إدارة الحقول ومراحل النمو:
- تسجيل قطع الأراضي والمحاصيل مع تحديد المساحة (فدان، قيراط، هكتار، دونم، متر مربع) ونوع التربة ونظام الري.
- متابعة نسبة تقدم المحصول والمرحلة الحالية من الإنبات حتى الحصاد، والعد التنازلي لموعد الجمع المتوقع.
- حساب موعد الرية القادمة تلقائيا حسب نوع المحصول والتربة ونظام الري، مع تحديث الجدول عند تسجيل كل رية.
- مستشار الدورة الزراعية لتقييم تعاقب المحاصيل واقتراح المحاصيل الأنسب للموسم التالي.

2. جدول المهام والعمليات الزراعية:
- توليد خطة مهام موسمية تلقائية عند إضافة كل حقل (ري، تسميد، وقاية، فحص ميداني، حصاد).
- تصنيف المهام حسب الأولوية وتاريخ الاستحقاق (اليوم والمتأخرة، القادمة، المنجزة) مع جدولة الرية التالية تلقائيا فور إتمام الرية الحالية.

3. خمس حاسبات زراعية دقيقة:
- حاسبة التسميد (NPK): حساب صافي العناصر المطلوبة وتحويلها إلى كميات وأكياس الأسمدة التجارية (يوريا 46%، نترات نشادر 33.5%، سلفات نشادر 20.6%، سوبر فوسفات 15.5%، MAP 12-61-0، سلفات بوتاسيوم 50%، مركب 20-20-20).
- حاسبة مقننات الري: حساب كمية المياه بالمتر المكعب وزمن تشغيل الطلمبة أو شبكة التنقيط والوفر المائي مقارنة بالري بالغمر.
- حاسبة البذور والكثافة النباتية: حساب عدد النباتات وكمية التقاوي المطلوبة مع تصحيح نسبة الإنبات.
- حاسبة الرش وفترة الأمان (PHI): حساب عدد تعبئات الرشاشة وجرعة المبيد لكل خزان وتاريخ الحصاد الآمن.
- محول الوحدات الزراعية: التحويل الفوري بين الفدان والقيراط والهكتار والدونم والمتر المربع مع مرجع الأوزان والمكاييل.

4. موسوعة المحاصيل والمشخص الميداني:
- دليل مرجعي يضم 14 محصولا رئيسيا (القمح، الذرة الشامية، الأرز، الطماطم، البطاطس، البصل، الخيار، الفلفل، الفول البلدي، البرسيم المصري، الموالح، الزيتون، النخيل، العنب) بمواعيد الزراعة ومقننات التسميد والمياه ومراحل النمو والآفات الشائعة.
- مشخص تفاعلي لأعراض النبات (الأوراق، الساق، الثمار، الجذور) للمساعدة في تمييز نقص العناصر والآفات الحشرية والأمراض الفطرية مع إرشادات الوقاية وفترة الأمان.

5. السجل المالي والنسخ الاحتياطي المحلي:
- تسجيل مصروفات التقاوي والأسمدة والمبيدات والوقود والعمالة وإيرادات البيع لكل حقل.
- تحليل الإيرادات والمصروفات وترتيب بنود التكلفة وحساب صافي العائد مع إمكانية مشاركة ملخص الموسم.
- تصدير واستعادة النسخ الاحتياطية محليا بصيغة JSON، مع إتاحة بدء العمل ببيانات نموذجية أو من الصفر.

name: مندوب حاضر
seller_name: POWER LINE ENGINEERING & INVESTMENT CO. LTD
description:
مندوب حاضر — تطبيق مناديب التوصيل في منصّة حاضر السودانيّة. اتّصل، واستقبل أقرب طلبات التوصيل إليك، وسلّمها، واكسب.

■ طلبات من كلّ أقسام حاضر
مطاعم وبقالات وصيدليات ومتاجر ومياه وغيرها — كلّ طلبٍ يحتاج توصيلاً يصل أقرب مندوبٍ متّصل.

■ أنت تختار
• «تفعيل الاتصال» حين تكون جاهزاً، و«إيقاف الاتصال» حين تنتهي.
• مدى الاستلام: تلقائي أو ٢ أو ٣ أو ٥ أو ٧ كم.
• منطقة عملك: تختارها عند التسجيل، وتصلك طلباتها وحدها.

■ التوصيل خطوةً بخطوة
• تفاصيل الطلب وعنوان العميل على الخريطة، وفتح الملاحة بضغطة.
• رمز التسليم يثبت أنّ الطلب وصل صاحبه.
• العميل يتابع توصيله مباشرةً.

■ محفظتك وحسابك
• رصيدك وحركته، وشحن المحفظة بإيصال التحويل البنكي.
• الاشتراك المميّز لمن يريد العمل بلا عمولة على كلّ توصيلة.
• دخولٌ برقم الهاتف وكلمة المرور، وبالبصمة أو بصمة الوجه.

■ لشركات التوصيل
لوحة الشركة داخل التطبيق: أعمال الأسطول، وإضافة المناديب وإيقافهم، والحساب والمحفظة والاشتراك.

■ الخصوصيّة والموقع
يستعمل التطبيق موقعك وأنت متّصل فقط — ولو كان في الخلفيّة أثناء استعمالك الخرائط — ليعرض عليك الطلبات القريبة وليتابع العميل توصيله. يتوقّف حين تضغط «إيقاف الاتصال». استمرار تحديد الموقع في الخلفيّة قد يزيد استهلاك البطارية.

التسجيل بموافقة إدارة حاضر ومستندات المندوب.

name: مواقيت غيث
description:
مواقيت غيث رفيقك اليومي للصلاة: مواقيت دقيقة حسب موقعك، وأذان يصلك في وقته، ومصحف وأذكار في مكان واحد. بدون إعلانات، بدون تسجيل دخول، وبدون أي تتبّع.

مواقيت الصلاة والأذان
• مواقيت دقيقة حسب موقعك أو مدينتك، مع اختيار طريقة الحساب
• أذان بأصوات مختارة: الحرم المكي، الحرم المدني، العفاسي، القطامي، الدوسري وغيرهم
• تنبيه قبل الأذان وتنبيه للإقامة بالدقائق التي تحددها لكل صلاة
• عدّاد الصلاة القادمة على شاشة القفل والجزيرة الديناميكية

الويدجت
• ويدجت مواقيت الصلاة للشاشة الرئيسية وشاشة القفل
• ويدجت أذكار متجددة يتغيّر فيه الذكر خلال اليوم
• ويدجت المناسبات والتقويم الهجري

القرآن الكريم
• مصحف كامل بخط واضح مع العلامات والملاحظات
• تلاوات لعدد من القرّاء مع التفسير
• قسم الحفظ مع «اختبر نفسك» بالتعرّف على قراءتك
• إذاعات القرآن الكريم

الأذكار والعبادات
• أذكار الصباح والمساء وأذكار اليوم بصوت مسموع
• مسبحة إلكترونية
• اتجاه القبلة بالبوصلة
• التقويم الهجري والمناسبات الإسلامية

مصمم لك
• واجهة عربية كاملة ودعم للإنجليزية
• ألوان متعددة تتغيّر معها أيقونة التطبيق والويدجت
• خصوصيتك أولاً: إعداداتك محفوظة على جهازك فقط

name: نظام الجمعيات الشبابية
description:
«نظام الجمعيات الشبابية» تطبيق واحد للجمعيّات الشبابيّة المشتركة في النظام — يدخله كلّ واحد بصلاحيّاته.

للمدير التنفيذي والإدارة:
• النظام كاملاً بالبريد وكلمة المرور: موقع الجمعيّة، الحوكمة، المالية، الامتثال، والموسم — من جوالك.

للمشرف:
• امسح بطاقة الطالب بالكاميرا للتحقّق وتسجيل الحضور.
• امنح العملات، وبِع عند الكاونتر، وأضف نقاط الفرق — ضمن الحدود التي تحدّدها الإدارة.
• أدِر المتجر وانشر الأخبار والتكريم.

للطالب:
• بطاقتي: بطاقة المشارك برمز QR يمسحه المشرف.
• البنك: رصيد عملات الموسم وحركاته، والراتب القادم، وحوالات بين المشاركين.
• المتجر: اشترِ من متجر الموسم بعملاتك.
• الجدول: الأنشطة والرحلات، وتنبيه قبل كلّ نشاط بعشر دقائق.
• الصلاة: مواقيت أمّ القرى لمدينة الموسم، والأذان بصوته يصلك والجوال مقفل.
• الأخبار والتكريم، ونقاط الفرق والترتيب، وشخصيّتك الرمزيّة بدل صورتك.

الطالب والمشرف يدخلان برمز البطاقة التي تسلّمها الجمعيّة. لا إعلانات، لا تتبّع، ولا صور للمشاركين.

name: 똥깡아지
description:
똥깡아지는 부모가 초대한 가족끼리 아기 사진과 영상을 나누는 비공개 앨범입니다.

• 부모는 아이폰에서 사진과 영상을 올리고, 초대와 가족의 열람 권한을 관리할 수 있어요.
• 가족은 받은 초대로 앨범을 열고, 사진과 영상을 전체 화면으로 볼 수 있어요.
• 다섯 가지 리액션으로 마음을 전하고, 간직하고 싶은 사진과 영상은 아이폰 사진 앱에 저장할 수 있어요.
• 최근 올라온 소식을 보거나 월별로 추억을 찾을 수 있어요.

앨범을 보려면 가족에게 받은 초대가 필요합니다. 부모용 앨범을 시작하는 방법은 고객지원 페이지에서 확인할 수 있어요.

name: 빙글빙고: 산책
description:
오늘 산책, 빙고로 해 볼까요?
지금 있는 곳 주변의 실제 가게와 장소로 빙고판을 만들어 드려요. 가까이 가면 칸이 저절로 채워져서, 걷는 동안 휴대폰을 꺼낼 필요가 없어요.

• 지도와 같은 모양의 빙고판 — 위쪽이 북쪽이에요
• 공원·길·가게 등 지도에 있는 여러 장소로 만드는 판
• 가까이 가면 자동 완료, 잠금 화면에서 현황 확인
• 찍기만 하면 휴대폰이 알아서 판정하는 사진 칸
• 빙고 한 줄 / 전체 코스 추천 경로
• 친구와 함께: 링크로 초대하거나 근처 사람을 바로 초대 — 별명과 칸 수만 공유
• 좋아하는 동네 가게를 응원하면 빙고판에 나와요

회원가입이 없어요. 위치와 걸은 길, 사진은 휴대폰에만 저장되고 서버로 보내지 않아요.

걷는 동안에는 주변을 잘 살펴 주세요.

name: 엘맨 톡
description:
엘맨 톡은 같은 회사 직원끼리 대화하고 공지를 나누는 사내 메신저입니다.

이 앱은 회사 직원 전용입니다. 회사 ERP에 등록된 직원 계정(휴대폰 번호, 사원번호, 비밀번호)으로 로그인하며, 앱 안에서 새 계정을 만들 수 없습니다. 계정이 없으면 회사 담당자에게 문의하세요.

대화
- 1:1 대화와 단체 대화
- 메시지마다 안 읽은 사람 수 표시
- 답장, @멘션, 보낸 메시지 수정과 삭제
- 사진, 동영상, 파일 보내기와 대화방별 사진/파일 모아 보기
- 메시지 속 링크, 전화번호, 이메일을 눌러 바로 열기
